### 34. [Where the Image Sits: Vision-Text Order Bias in Jev](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28535v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28535

**作者：** Youzhi Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28535v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28535v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文考察 Jev 式单次 prefill 决策模型中图文相对顺序的影响：在固定选项列表下比较 prefix、pre-question、pre-options、suffix 四种图像位置对 argmax 翻转率、总变差、准确率与校准的作用，并提出平均 prefix 与 pre-question 两个前向分布的 P+Q 读出。

**相关性简评：** 属于对视觉证据位置如何影响最终决策读出的诊断性失败分析，直接关联「答案是否真正使用视觉内容」与位置、注意力结构对内部视觉表示的效应；其无生成、单次读出的设定也便于核查证据到决策的通路，但结论是否可迁移到多步 latent 推理仍需阅读原文。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where the Image Sits: Vision-Text Order Bias in Jev

**abstract/A1：** Jev-style system-1 decision models read a choice from a single prefill. They restrict the next-token distribution to the supplied option labels and return a distribution over the options, with no generation and no parsing. Recent work shows that generative vision-language models are sensitive to the relative order of image and text tokens. We ask whether that sensitivity reaches this Jev-style readout. The answer is always read at the end of the prompt, so moving the image changes the distance from the visual evidence to the decision, but never the position at which the decision is read. Using four placements---prefix, pre-question, pre-options, and suffix---and holding the option listing fixed, we measure argmax flips, total variation, accuracy, calibration, and label marginals. Suffix placement flips 41.0% of decisions and lowers accuracy by 18.6 points. Averaged over the four slots, the curve is monotone, not U-shaped. That shape differs from prior results on generative vision-language models. The effect survives a battery of controls. We also introduce prefix--question averaging (P+Q), a two-forward readout that averages the prefix and pre-question distributions. It is at least as accurate as prefix and outperforms the prior baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Youzhi333/Visual\_Tex\_Order\_Bias\_Jev.

</details>

### 35. [EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28574v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28574

**作者：** Xinyu Cao、Tianjie Ju、Zhuosheng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28574v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28574v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EvoViM：冻结多模态模型将交互经验写成可递归修订的视觉程序，直接保留图像并在像素上计算，同时回溯失败到丢失或误用证据的操作；在六个含延迟查询的任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 该工作正面处理延迟查询下视觉证据的保留、筛选与使用，并做证据丢失/误用的操作级归因，与 LVR 的视觉细节保留和贡献分配直接相关；不过其状态存于外部视觉程序而非模型 latent，可供对照核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 26 figures. Project page: https://evovim.github.io/

</details>

### 36. [LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28575

**作者：** Zhaozhi Wang、Mingrui Wu、Jiaming Zhao、An-Syu Li、Jun Luo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28575v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LoopSight：循环复用共享 Transformer 核心的视觉 Transformer，增设 Gated Prediction Memory，用 cross-attention 门控在 patch 与通道层面控制写入，把用于读出的持续预测状态与不断演化的计算状态分离，并以渐进循环编码和对截断高斯采样的循环次数做监督。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应循环计算与预测工作区这一关注点，其「预测状态与计算状态分离、跨迭代门控写入」可为 latent 状态的保持与更新方式提供参照，循环次数采样训练与读出稳定性分析也与长度泛化和动态计算成本相关，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory

**abstract/A1：** Looped vision transformers extend computation for visual reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared Transformer core. A challenge is to preserve useful prediction information across loop iterations while allowing the computation state to evolve. In this paper we introduce LoopSight, a looped vision transformer that uses Gated Prediction Memory (GPM) to maintain a persistent prediction state for readout, separate from the core's evolving computation state. At each iteration, a cross-attention gate uses the core's candidate features, the previous prediction state, and the current task state to control writes at the patch and channel level. The model decodes its prediction from the updated memory. We condition the shared core on the current iteration using asymptotic loop encoding and train the model by supervising its prediction at loop counts sampled from a truncated Gaussian distribution. LoopSight outperforms LoopViT across three model scales on ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2. On ARC-AGI-1, LoopSight-Small achieves 67.4% pass@2, a gain of 6.6 percentage points over LoopViT-Small with comparable parameter counts and FLOPs. LoopSight also outperforms LoopViT on Visual Sudoku and ImageNet classification. Further analyses on ARC-AGI-1 show that LoopSight preserves more already-correct predictions and maintains more stable readout features as its computation state continues to evolve. The code will be released at https://github.com/feufhd/LoopSight.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 10 figures

</details>

### 37. [CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28589v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28589

**作者：** Zhaoxi Wang、Jiahao Lai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28589v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28589v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CLOSE 提出免训练的在线自评估验证器以抑制 VLM 物体幻觉：以记忆分位数（仅依赖排名）设阈、由无标注图像冷启动并在线更新，融合自提问与基于四个隐藏状态信号伪标签训练的打分器，被拒对象回滚并通过阶梯回退与识别表拦截其复现。

**相关性简评：** 四个隐藏状态信号用于判定物体是否存在，可直接对照内部状态是否保留视觉证据、以及拒绝与回滚这类停止决策的收益成本；其免标签在线校准究竟是依据视觉证据还是表面统计，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused with self-asking by rank to separate what self-asking leaves mixed. Refused objects are rolled back and banned through a laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts their reappearance under other wordings. On COCO, refusing 20% and 40% of object mentions reduces the CHAIRs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 42% and 87% (F1 +1.9 and -6.1 points); refusing 20% and 35% reduces the reachable hallucinations of Qwen3-VL-8B (official counts minus CHAIR-script miscounts) by 79% and 96% (F1 +0.5 and -5.3). An external vocabulary further extends the check beyond the official vocabulary.

**comment/C1：** 41 pages (8-page main text and appendix), 25 figures, 24 tables

</details>

### 38. [Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28632v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在 grounded VLM 中，用写框前隐状态经固定线性映射读出框，并以该读出与写出框的不一致作为 self-prediction residual，单遍检测落在其他物体上的错误框，并在 RefCOCOg 上跨多个模型评估其增益。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 VLM 内部状态是否保留任务必要的物体与视觉证据，以及答案是否使用 latent 内容；该残差可供核查视觉证据筛选、错误检测与有限复核预算下的停止决策，但需确认其捕获的是错误对象而非一般错误。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models

**abstract/A1：** Grounded vision-language models write boxes as text, and the mean probability of their coordinate tokens says little about whether a box is right. We study a single-pass signal for boxes on another object, which matter when only the object counts. A linear map, fitted per model to its own answers without labels, reads a box from the hidden state before writing. Its disagreement with the written box, the self-prediction residual, flags boxes on another object although the read-out is far less accurate; the residual's weight was fixed with labels on two models. On a replication list of 1,200 RefCOCOg test items, the residual, averaged over six models, raises the detection of these errors for each of fifteen single-pass scores, by 0.026 to 0.049 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) on a label-free probe and probes trained on 2,000 labelled items. Over all errors, adding it to the label-free probe moves AUROC, averaged over the models, by less than 0.02 (95% interval). With a fifth of answers reviewed, the share of all errors caught moves from 0.518 to 0.524, that of boxes on another object from 0.505 to 0.607 (post hoc): the residual changes which errors are found, not how many, and in cost-weighted recall it breaks even when such a box costs about 0.86 times another error, and its gain is positive in point estimate at equal costs. These gains come from RefCOCOg lists of MS-COCO images.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included (65 pages). Code: https://github.com/chen4study-hub/spred

### 39. [LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28635v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28635

**作者：** Chengzhong Wang、Lang Lin、Xinyang Liu、YueQin Yin、Mingyuan Zhou、Shengwei An

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28635v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28635v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LoopSeek，将长视频问答中的证据搜索与回答生成解耦：由不生成文本的 System I 角色代理在视频窗口树上做类型化决策来选帧和修正搜索，冻结的 System II 仅基于选定帧作答一次。

**相关性简评：** 其「搜索不写文本、仅输出概率决策」、证据评估与搜索修正直接关系到 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本及视觉证据筛选；可核查这种紧凑决策状态是否减少冗余计算，以及固定帧预算下的漏检与长度泛化表现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Long video question answering requires finding relevant evidence before reasoning over it. With a limited frame budget, single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence, while adaptive search often relies on repeated text generation to decide where to look. We introduce LoopSeek, a framework that decouples evidence search from answer generation through a division of labor between a non-thinking System I and a generative System II. Our key insight is that search can be expressed as a sequence of small, typed decisions, allowing System I to find the evidence that System II needs. Four System I role agents navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence, and revise the search without generating text. To align search with System II, System I learns from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, and the verifier's evidence estimates steer the search without calling System II, which stays frozen and answers once from the selected frames. On five long-video benchmarks, with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B reading 32 frames, LoopSeek improves average accuracy from 53.5 to 63.9 over the uniform baseline and takes 32--80\\% less GPU time per question than agentic methods.

</details>

### 40. [CrossPanel: Exposing the Answer-Evidence Gap in Scientific Figure Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28641v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28641

**作者：** Zhengyang Lu、QianhongWen、Chenpeng Wang、Qiang Huang、Ziyang Ling、Huan Li、Chenziao、Yibo Qiu、Xiaojie Cheng

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28641v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28641v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CrossPanel 基准（2,650 道人工审校问题），通过跨面板绑定与依赖追问暴露科学图表理解中的「答案—证据」缺口，并用响应审计把对象选择、实验条件、跨面板绑定和局部读数分开，再以提示干预检验失败能否修复。

**相关性简评：** 其核心正是视觉证据是否被正确绑定并真正用于答案，对「答案是否正确但依据错误」这一贡献分配与证据筛选问题提供了可核查的诊断范式和干预结果，与 LVR 中视觉细节保留和证据使用评价直接相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CrossPanel: Exposing the Answer-Evidence Gap in Scientific Figure Understanding

**abstract/A1：** A correct answer to a scientific-figure question can conceal an incorrect account of the experiment. Reading evidence across panels requires keeping each observation attached to the object and conditions that give it meaning. We introduce CrossPanel, a benchmark of 2,650 human-reviewed questions that exposes this answer-evidence gap. Its tasks combine parallel observations or follow dependent queries, while a response audit separates object selection, experimental conditions, cross-panel binding, and local readout. Across 15 vision-language models on 251 diagnostic questions, 8.42%-56.64% of correct answers contain explicit factual errors. The audit distinguishes coherent readings of the wrong target from incorrect readings of the right one. Controlled interventions then test how these failures can be repaired: verified object-condition hints, which withhold the requested measurement, raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's target-query success by 22.81 percentage points on 57 questions, while additional image tiles alone yield little improvement. Other models benefit most from combining both forms of assistance. These findings identify experimental attribution as a distinct requirement alongside local perception, and make both measurable beyond final-answer accuracy.

</details>

### 41. [S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28649v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28649

**作者：** Muxin Fu、Peike Yu、Guibin Zhang、Wenrui Zhou、Runze Liu、Lang Feng、Fuchao Yang、Feng Chen、Yixuan Li、Mengao Zhang、Shiying Zhang、Wen Shen、Ling Pan、Shuicheng Yan、Bo An

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28649v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28649v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出现有 MLLM 缺乏多视角融合与视角变换能力，提出用一小组 spatial tokens 在模型内部承载融合后的 3D 场景，并通过监督使其在推理时按视角重新表达，配合探针检验两项能力及推理速度。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联 LVR 中「几何与任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态」：其空间 token workspace、重表达监督及撤除 token 后的能力残留，可供核查 latent 表示是否真正承载并参与推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence

**abstract/A1：** Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.

</details>

### 42. [ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28673v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28673

**作者：** Sarosij Bose、Arindam Dutta、Konstantinos Karydis、Amit K. Roy Chowdhury

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28673v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28673v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练、查询条件化的多视图流程：先把查询分解为概念，经粗检索打分、多样性去冗余与按目标可见性/可回答性的重排序筛出少量图像，再做可选定位与自验证作答，并配套 judge 式评测。

**相关性简评：** 其核心主张「瓶颈在于选出使查询可回答的视图而非更强的 3D 表示」与视觉证据筛选、证据充分性判断直接相关，可供核查 latent 推理中如何挑选与重排视觉证据；但论文未涉及内部 latent 状态与动态计算。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding

**abstract/A1：** 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

</details>

### 43. [Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28684v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28684

**作者：** Fawaz Sammani、Nikos Deligiannis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28684v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28684v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文考察自回归 LVLM 多模态推理中视觉 token 的必要性：沿生成步与 Transformer 深度分析视觉注意力动态，并用跨时间、跨层的因果干预移除视觉 token，验证视觉依赖既非全程持续也非各层均匀，据此在仅小幅掉点下削减大量输入 token。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系「LOOK」的时机与成本：揭示视觉证据影响集中于生成初期与中间层，可供核查按步、按层筛选或延迟注入视觉证据的设计，以及为何保留完整视觉上下文可能冗余。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models solve multimodal reasoning tasks by retaining hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, allowing every generated token to attend to the visual tokens at any time during the generation process. However, whether continuous access to these visual tokens is necessary remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how visual token influence evolves along two dimensions: generation time and transformer depth. Using long-form visual reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, we first analyze the attention dynamics across generation time and transformer depth. We identify a temporal and depth-wise structure in the use of visual information. Visual attention peaks during the initial generation steps and then rapidly declines as attention shifts toward previously generated reasoning tokens. Across depth, visual influence is concentrated in intermediate layers and becomes very weak in the final layers. We further verify these observations with causal intervention that removes all visual tokens across generation time and model depth. These interventions confirm that visual-token dependence in multimodal reasoning is neither temporally persistent nor uniformly distributed across transformer depth. Thus, retaining the complete visual context at every layer and decoding step may be unnecessary. Our experiments demonstrate that we can remove up to 59\\% of tokens from the full input prompt across generation time and 11\\% across all transformer layers, while incurring only a very small performance drop. On video benchmarks, up to 65\\% of the input prompt tokens can be removed during generation without affecting performance.

</details>

### 44. [Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28726v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28726

**作者：** Siyuan Li、Ethan Lin、Xiang Li、Tianming Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28726v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28726v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Railbound-Bench：模型观察铁路谜题布局，在预算内铺设轨道并提交完整方案，由模拟器统一运行判定，失败后可看结果重试最多五次；主集 200 题仅少数模型能解，另有 180 题控制实验考察「知道任务规则」与「实际使用规则」的差距。

**相关性简评：** 该工作以失败反馈修复与等 token 预算重试作对照，发现视觉反馈修正的故障未必带来可解方案，可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用、重试与停止决策的成本收益，以及「信息在但未被利用」的旁路问题提供核查基准。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at https://github.com/liaoyanqing666/Railbound\_Bench.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/liaoyanqing666/Railbound\_Bench

</details>

### 45. [JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28766v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28766

**作者：** Yonghuang Wu、Zhenyang Liang、Pengfei Wang、Yize Ma、Guoqing Wu、Jinhua Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28766v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28766v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究十亿像素病理全片图像上的 VLM 多步导航，提出 JevNavAgent：2B 模型在单次前向中直接预测预定义决策空间（停止、空间候选、答案头）的分布，不生成 token，由确定性代码执行导航，并以离线反事实轨迹对齐加在线轨迹级 GRPO 训练。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 中「LOOK/STOP」的收益与成本问题，其解码自由的单前向决策头、因子化停止头与轨迹级 RL 监督，可供核查无 token 生成的状态更新能否替代自回归动作解码，以及正检测/负排除的停止不对称如何影响证据获取与误停。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology

**abstract/A1：** Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.

</details>

### 46. [Inference Dynamics: Image Classifiers Keep Using Visual Cues After They Are Removed](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28795v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28795

**作者：** Ruiqi Wang、Mingming Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28795v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28795v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Inference Dynamics 过程级框架，通过逐层用去除线索的参考状态替换原图状态，追踪视觉线索影响在网络深度中的演化，发现定位性先下降而可撤销性后崩溃，并提出在锁定前进行 Evidence Reset 的干预方法。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断视觉证据如何保留在内部状态并持续影响决策，与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留、视觉证据筛选、信息坍缩及干预深度问题密切相关，其逐层替换分析可供核查 latent 状态中内容与因果作用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inference Dynamics: Image Classifiers Keep Using Visual Cues After They Are Removed

**abstract/A1：** Image classifiers are typically evaluated by their final predictions, treating inference as a static image-to-label mapping. Reliability, however, also depends on whether a model can relinquish evidence after that evidence disappears. We reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: removing a local visual cue from its original location may not remove its influence on the prediction. Once captured by early layers, the cue can become distributed across later representations, making \`\`no longer visible'' different from \`\`no longer relied upon.'' We introduce Inference Dynamics, a process-level framework for tracing how cue influence evolves and remains withdrawable across network depth. Given an image and a matched cue-removed reference, we replace cue-aligned states in the original branch with their reference counterparts at successive layers and measure recovery toward the cue-free prediction. The resulting trajectory separates evidence locality from decision-level withdrawability. Across datasets and architectures, we find locality declines before withdrawability collapses: cue-induced information becomes less concentrated at its original support while its effect remains active, before entering an evidence lock-in stage. Consequently, fixed late-stage correction may alter the final readout without removing accumulated cue dependence. We therefore propose Evidence Reset, which selects an input-dependent layer before lock-in and reconstructs cue-aligned states toward their cue-free counterparts. Our results establish evidence withdrawability as a process-level dimension of classifier reliability and suggest a new intervention principle: correction depth should follow the dynamics of evidence rather than be fixed in advance.

</details>

### 47. [Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead for Vision-Language-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28839v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28839

**作者：** Qihang Chen、Tengjie Li、Hongwei Lu、Jason Wu、Chyna Qu、Shikui Tu、Lei Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SG-LL：先用冻结空间教师把几何先验蒸馏进与策略相连的空间 token，再学习一个相对当前场景的未来信息压缩 latent，由当前策略上下文和 Action Expert 初始特征预测（不看未来观测），最后以零初始化残差融合注入 Action Expert 以改进动作生成，并在 LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN 及三项真实操作任务上评测。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及「预测性 latent 表示如何进入动作生成」，与关注未来工作区、视觉证据保留及 latent 是否被真正使用的兴趣高度契合；可供核查预测 latent 是否携带空间与未来证据、零初始化融合是否被利用，以及预测成本与收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead for Vision-Language-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action (VLA) models benefit from strong semantic representations that support object recognition and instruction understanding. However, precise manipulation also depends on resolving object locations and workspace relations, and on selecting actions with an estimate of how the scene will evolve. Existing geometry-aware methods make the current scene more explicit, while predictive methods model future observations or representations. Yet future information is often neither grounded in a control-relevant spatial state nor directly used to guide action generation. We introduce Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead (SG-LL), which uses the grounded present as the reference for predicting an actionable near-future representation. A frozen spatial teacher first distills geometric priors into policy-connected spatial tokens. A current-conditioned bottleneck then learns a compact latent that captures future information relative to the present scene. This latent is predicted from the current policy context and initial Action Expert features, without access to future observations or the spatial teacher. Finally, zero-initialized residual fusion incorporates the predicted latent into the Action Expert to refine action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and three real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements over in both simulation and real-robot settings.

</details>

### 48. [Bridging Blind Spots With Words: Decentralized Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Language-Constrained Communication](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29112v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29112

**作者：** Soumyabrata Chaudhuri、Joydeep Ghosh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.IR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29112v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29112v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文形式化 N 个代理各自观察不同视角、在受限语言消息预算下协作回答空间查询的去中心化多视图空间推理问题，构建了隔离多视图整合查询的基准，并实证检验语言预算带来的性能损失及带信用分配的强化学习对去中心化模型的提升。

**相关性简评：** 多视图证据筛选与预算约束下的信息传递直接关联「视觉证据被保留多少、传给谁」，其信用分配训练也对应贡献分配与监督问题；但推理状态是自然语言消息而非 latent 表示，可与 latent 通信中的信息坍缩对照核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bridging Blind Spots With Words: Decentralized Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Language-Constrained Communication

**abstract/A1：** As multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) get increasingly used as collaborative partners across embodied robotics, AR/VR, and multi-user systems, spatial reasoning is now often distributed across agents with partial environment visibility, necessitating spatial reasoning integration. Prior work in language-mediated spatial integration is however strictly limited to simplified two-agent scenarios. To address this gap, we first formalize the general problem of decentralized multi-view spatial reasoning, where N agents observe distinct viewpoints, exchange budget-constrained natural language messages, and collaborate to enable a listener to answer spatial queries. We then introduce a novel multi-view spatial benchmark to isolate queries that demand non-trivial multi-view integration. Through an extensive empirical study, we discover that the penalty of restricting decentralized spatial reasoning to natural language with limited budget is far smaller than suggested by prior two-agent literature. Nevertheless, we observe that substantial headroom still remains for multi-agent spatial reasoning in this setting, as evidenced by a significant gap between current centralized performance and an oracle best-of-K ceiling. Moreover, we show that reinforcement learning with credit assignment substantially bolsters the decentralized model, effectively closing the gap with the centralized baseline.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 13 tables, 4 figures

### 49. [RAVEC: Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29142v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29142

**作者：** Junjie Yang、Rui Qian、Xutao Mao、Yuhe Wu、Mingda Zhang、Jiaxuan Luo、Yang Tan、Qiang Huang、Zhisheng Chen、Yanfeng Li、Dawen Tian、Changmiao Wang、Tao Tan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29142v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29142v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RAVEC，通过抑制标注证据区域构造成对视觉对比，得到带符号的修正方向，并用局部奖励一致性与跨问题奖励支持进行筛选和预算分配，将视觉损失加入 GRPO 训练以改进多模态推理。

**相关性简评：** 直接处理视觉证据敏感性、中间决策的贡献分配与训练监督，并明确推理时仅用原图；其证据方向筛选和风险分配可供核查 THINK/LOOK 中视觉证据选择与信用分配的联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAVEC: Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves multimodal reasoning, but response-level feedback provides limited guidance on which intermediate decisions to correct. Visual interventions reveal sensitivity to image content, yet this sensitivity alone does not establish reward alignment or support across questions. We introduce RAVEC (Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction), which selects visual corrections using local and cross-question reward support and jointly determines their strengths within each response. Paired Visual Evidence Contrast (PVEC) compares predictions from an exponential moving average teacher at the same sampled response prefix under the original image and a version with its annotated evidence region suppressed, yielding signed correction directions. Credit-Risk Allocation (CRA) screens these directions using local reward alignment and reward support from other questions, excluding all responses to the source question. It then solves a response-level budgeted allocation problem, assigning additional cost to directions that locally reduce predictive entropy. The resulting signed visual loss augments Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) during training. Inference uses only the original image and question. Across ten multimodal benchmarks, RAVEC achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared methods with both 3B and 7B Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct models, outperforming GRPO by 2.67 and 1.39 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations support the combined design of evidence alignment, credit qualification, and risk-aware allocation. The project is available at https://yangjj007.github.io/ravec/.

</details>

### 50. [RVLM: Fewer Tokens, Better Resolution Scaling, Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29146v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29146

**作者：** Savya Khosla、Chris Dongjoo Kim、Alex Schwing、Derek Hoiem、Christopher Clark、Sangho Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29146v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29146v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** RVLM 用免训练的 Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher 分割把图像划为连通区域，将 ViT patch 池化为变长视觉 token，并保留 patch-区域映射以做粗到细解码，在 VQA、指向、分割等任务上以更少 token 匹配或超过同训练 patch 基线。

**相关性简评：** 涉及视觉 token 预算下细节与空间证据的保留：其消融显示区域须覆盖全图、保持连通并保留小结构，可供核查 token 压缩如何影响推理可用的视觉证据与 grounding；未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RVLM: Fewer Tokens, Better Resolution Scaling, Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tokenize images using fixed spatial grids, so visual token count grows with pixel area rather than scene content. We propose to group neighboring patches based on their visual appearance, allowing tokens to represent coherent image regions rather than fixed spatial windows. We introduce RVLM, a VLM trained to use regions rather than patches as its visual units. Analyzing region construction for general-purpose VLMs, we find that regions must cover the full image, stay spatially connected during end-to-end training, and preserve fine structure such as small text, while semantic grouping adds little. RVLM therefore partitions images using training-free Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher segmentation, assigns each ViT patch to a region, and pools patches within each region into a variable-length sequence of visual tokens. The patch-to-region assignment is retained to support spatially precise prediction through coarse-to-fine decoding. Across tasks spanning VQA, pointing, counting, segmentation, and depth estimation, RVLM matches or improves example-weighted task performance while using 21.5% fewer visual tokens than an identically trained patch baseline. The advantage grows with image resolution, reaching a 5.3-point gain while using 51.8% fewer visual tokens at the highest-resolution setting. The gains are largest on spatially demanding tasks, where prior token-reduction methods degrade most sharply. RVLM adds no model parameters and improves inference throughput by up to 35.9%. On unseen pathology and satellite images and on video benchmarks without any video training, RVLM performs on par with the patch baseline while using 2-3$\\times$ fewer visual tokens. These results establish regions as a scalable alternative to patch-based visual representations while preserving the spatial precision required for grounded prediction.

</details>

### 51. [Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29150v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29150

**作者：** Yan Wang、Yiran Song、Zizhuo Gong、Jianxiang Qi、Zhongxing Xu、Lingfei Qian、Minquan Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29150v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29150v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出跨放大倍率的来源验证任务 CMPV，构建含 306 万坐标监督样本的 PyraFault 基准，并设计 ZoomTrace 验证器，判断放大观察是否确实来自声称位置，在证据不足时弃答。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接处理视觉智能体中的证据来源核验、伪证据筛选与弃答，与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、证据充分性判断及 LOOK/STOP 决策相关，可供核查验证器对静默失败和下游推理成本的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images

**abstract/A1：** Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation using spatially disjoint competing matches. On 503,320 test examples, ZoomTrace achieves 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC, compared with 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR. Further evaluations reveal trade-offs in reliability estimation and limitations in vision-language models, cross-dataset retrieval, and calibration. Integrating ZoomTrace into visual agent tool paths reduces exposure to corrupted observations and silent failures, while downstream accuracy improvements depend on the agent and verification threshold.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Counting Symbols on Technical Drawings: A Benchmark and Verified Rewards for MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Today's MLLMs can count objects in natural images. However, when asking them how many bolt holes appear in a mechanical drawing or how many nitrogen atoms are in a chemical structure, they often struggle. Counting in technical drawings remains challenging, as objects can be small, densely packed, or even implied by drawing conventions. To study this problem, we introduce CountDrawBench, a benchmark including floor plans, electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and molecular structures, with 1,574 counting questions and instance-level annotations where available. Besides evaluation, we introduce Code-Verified RL, a reinforcement learning framework that teaches MLLMs to count with executable feedback. Our method combines three complementary rewards: a count reward that checks the final answer, an instance-matching reward that verifies object locations, and a zoom-based reward that checks counting consistency across local image regions. All three are integrated into a unified GRPO objective. Extensive experiments reveal that even leading MLLMs struggle on CountDrawBench, with the best evaluated model achieving only 59.3% accuracy. Our method improves Qwen3.5-9B from 49.3% to 54.3% accuracy, outperforming all evaluated open-source baselines. These results establish CountDrawBench as a challenging testbed for technical drawing understanding and demonstrate the value of code-verified rewards in these tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 53. [Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29361v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29361

**作者：** Yichen Zhao、Fenghe Tang、Wenxin Ma、Rongsheng Wang、Zihao Wan、Shaohua Kevin Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29361v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29361v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了配对的平扫与增强医学VQA数据，检验「注意力图即视觉感知关键」这一假设，发现注意力模式相近时答案仍可相反，且对 visual values 的双向干预比注意力权重更能改变预测，据此提出 VIVID，用增强图像的视觉 value 引导从 CE 到 NC 的 on-policy 蒸馏。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「视觉内容经 value 通道进入内部状态并影响答案」的因果干预诊断，直接可供核查LVR中视觉证据是否被真正使用、注意力与信息坍缩的关系；但改进落在训练期蒸馏，未涉及推理期latent状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values

**abstract/A1：** Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID.

</details>

### 54. [Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29477v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29477

**作者：** Chenxi Wang、Bin Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29477v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29477v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究自适应视觉 token 路由，将路由收益分解为「动作分配」与「图像匹配」两部分，并通过固定任务内动作次数、与随机配对比较，在 ChartQA 和 TextVQA 上诊断 Qwen2.5-VL 路由器的实际收益来源。

**相关性简评：** 该诊断直接关联视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」的收益—成本问题：它区分了「更常启用高分辨率」与「为具体图像选对动作」两种贡献，可供核查视觉细节获取是否被有效使用，以及分辨率选择策略的评估是否混淆了任务难度与匹配质量。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing

**abstract/A1：** Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

### 55. [CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29489v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29489

**作者：** Xixi Jiang、Pingcheng Dong、Chen Yang、Xin Yang、Kwang-Ting Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29489v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29489v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析视觉 token 剪枝在多模态大模型解码层造成的输出偏移，将其闭式分解为图像摘要误差与注意力分配误差，并提出 CAR：用覆盖式选择保留显著且不冗余的视觉 token，再用闭式 logit bias 把被丢弃 token 的注意力重新分配给保留 token，从而在激进剪枝下维持 VQA 与视觉定位性能。

**相关性简评：** 其对解码层输出偏移的分解把「视觉信息丢失」与「视觉 token 注意力份额下降」分开度量，与 LVR 关心的视觉细节是否留在内部状态、答案是否真正使用视觉证据直接相关，可供核查视觉旁路与信息坍缩的诊断方式；但方法本身是推理加速式剪枝，未涉及 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation

**abstract/A1：** Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\\%$ on VG, against $26.5\\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

</details>

### 56. [Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29551v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29551

**作者：** Peng Chen、Chao Huang、Yangyang Liu、Maodong Wu、Jinyi Xu、Mingbo Yang、Yunkang Cao、Fangjun Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29551v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29551v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EVAD：先做全局视觉评估定位可疑区域，再用 MCTS 引导语义细化与空间扩展来逐步获取并整合细粒度视觉证据，以支持工业异常判断。

**相关性简评：** 其主动证据获取、证据筛选与决策整合直接对应 LVR 中「LOOK」及停止决策问题，可供核查多步搜索的触发、终止条件与证据对答案的因果作用；但任务限于工业异常检测，迁移性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在八个指令微调模型上，以匹配的因果评测比较 Tuned Lens 熵/散度等标量摘要、最终状态探针与原始中间状态探针在生成中途弃答中的预测价值，并在两个模型规模和基准上实际执行停止策略，分析准确率—计算量权衡。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联 STOP 决策与动态计算：其核心发现是原始中间状态更利于排序，而标量 lens 特征的增量优势较弱，且 token 节省会高估 wall-time 收益；这些证据可供核查中途停止所用内部信号与成本评价，但作者明确限定为对标量特征的实证结论。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scalar Tuned Lens Summaries Offer Limited Incremental Value for Mid-Generation Abstention

**abstract/A1：** Mid-generation abstention aims to stop an unpromising response before spending its remaining computation budget. Intermediate transformer states may help predict eventual correctness, but whether scalar summaries of their vocabulary predictions add useful evidence is less clear. We compare Tuned Lens entropy and divergence features with final-state and raw intermediate-state probes under matched, causal evaluation. Across eight instruction-tuned models on MATH-500, raw intermediate states improve ranking, whereas scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline. Scalar hybrids have positive exceptions, but their advantage over position-matched permutation controls is small. Cross-fitted residual comparisons further show that gains over a final-state probe need not require aligned scalar features. Actual stopping runs on two model sizes and two benchmarks reveal a separate accuracy--computation trade-off, with token savings overstating wall-time savings for scalar policies. The evidence supports a restricted empirical conclusion about these scalar features, not a general negative claim about intermediate representations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted in EACL 2027

### 58. [Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29592v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29592

**作者：** Qi Wu、Xiaoyu Liu、Ao Wang、Rongsheng Wang、Wenting Chen、Wenxuan Wang、Qingsong Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29592v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29592v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出医学闭式 VQA 存在「稳定错误」：即使移除或错配图像证据，模型仍给出高置信、可重复的错误 yes/no 答案，从而使基于采样稳定性的 HAC 类校准失效；为此提出反事实答案敏感性 CAS，用纯文本、黑图、损坏图像等干预检验承诺答案是否仍被视觉证据支持，在 7 个 VLM、3 个基准上以 AUROC +0.150 优于 HAC 系列。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断答案是否真正依赖视觉证据（视觉旁路与捷径），其反事实干预与「决策边界偏移」信号可供核查 LVR 中视觉信息使用程度与停止/可靠性判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity

**abstract/A1：** As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. When shortcut-driven errors are themselves stable, sampling agreement can remain deceptively high. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS), which shifts reliability estimation from answer stability to evidence sensitivity. CAS uses cross-modal counterfactual interventions, such as text-only, black, and corrupted images, to audit whether a committed yes/no answer remains supported when visual evidence is invalidated. Across 7 VLMs and 3 benchmarks, CAS outperforms the best HAC-family scores across all evaluated settings, achieving a macro-averaged AUROC gain of +0.150 for error detection. Mechanistic analysis further shows that CAS recovers hidden errors in the HAC-confident region and that its strongest standalone signal is counterfactual decision-boundary shift rather than hard prediction stability. Our findings suggest that closed-ended evaluation should test visual dependence, not only answer stability, in safety-critical medical contexts.

</details>

### 59. [Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29728v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29728

**作者：** Junzhou Chen、Jindong Wang、Gang Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29728v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29728v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究视频 LLM 推理蒸馏中，教师与学生因视频采样不同造成的观测条件错配，提出先蒸馏推理先验、再在多观测下优化执行，并用执行感知参考正则化约束调整。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、轨迹训练和监督信号直接相关；其观测条件化执行可供核查是否实质提升证据使用，而非仅拟合教师答案分布。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.

</details>

**作者：** Lang Lin、Tianyu Chen、Yi Gu、Yang Zhao、Xinran Song、Xinyang Liu、Jianpeng Cheng、Mingyuan Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29773v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29773v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 S1Arena-MM 基准，覆盖图像、视频、音频的 94 项任务共 51,060 题及 102 个闭环游戏环境，统一比较 33 个开源 System-1 单次前向模型与 MLLM 在决策准确率、概率校准和实时延迟上的表现。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接量化单次感知决策与额外 thinking tokens 的收益和代价，并考察实时闭环中的延迟损失，可供核查 THINK/STOP 的适用边界；但未分析 latent 状态或视觉证据使用，机制层面联系有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?

**abstract/A1：** Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. We evaluate 33 open models: 12 System-1 models and 21 MLLMs read at the answer token. On static decisions, the best System-1 model leads the best MLLM by 4.9 percentage points on images and is within one point of it on video and audio. Post-training for decisions mainly improves the probabilities: on video, a System-1 model has a lower Brier score than the MLLM that it is post-trained from in 10 of 12 pairs. With up to 2,048 thought tokens per question, the most accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, and thinking raises the Brier score of most MLLMs. Closed loops separate the models: three System-1 models built on a 27B MLLM reach 22.0-33.3% progression in BALROG, and no other model exceeds 9.7% with thinking off. In real-time GameWorld, latencies of up to 1.1 s per decision cause no measurable loss of progress for System-1 models. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages. Lang Lin, Tianyu Chen, Yi Gu, Yang Zhao, Xinran Song and Xinyang Liu contributed equally. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM ; media: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Swindl/S1Arena-MM

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29969

**作者：** Xiaoqian Hu、Ruihong Qiu、Yanran Tang、Sen Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29969v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CARE-3D：先用 SFT 建立 3D 场景中的工具交互，再用 GRPO 优化 grounded reasoning，并以返回证据的反事实归因和分组覆盖采样改进中间工具选择的信用分配与探索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes

**abstract/A1：** Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \\href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D}.

</details>

### 62. [Post-Training Agents for Long-Document Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30090v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30090

**作者：** Sushant Mehta、Logan Ritchie、Edwin Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30090v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30090v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向跨页、图表密集的企业长文档推理，对 Kimi-K2.7 进行长上下文后训练：先做特权上下文在线自蒸馏，再用评分标准奖励做 RL；评估时结合文本与选定页面图像，并联合报告准确率、token 和交互轮数。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉证据筛选、多跳证据整合、验证与停止决策及训练监督；其「先统一检查全部来源，再核查内容」的轨迹变化，可供核查 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本以及长上下文下的动态计算。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Post-Training Agents for Long-Document Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Professional documents are a long-context workload that retrieval-style benchmarks do not capture. In a ten-domain enterprise collection, a task's evidence is spread across a source document of median length 27 pages (mean 48.8, maximum 873); a third of tasks rest mainly on charts, drawings, and maps; and 70.9% require two or more reasoning hops. We post-train Kimi-K2.7, an open-weight foundation model, at its full context window on 1,465 expert-authored tasks with atomic rubrics from that collection, training rank-32 adapters with one round of privileged-context on-policy self-distillation followed by two rounds of rubric-reward reinforcement learning. We render each PDF as text for training and as extracted text plus selected page images at evaluation. The smoothed RL training reward rises from 0.37 in the first tenth of the run to 0.67 in the last. On the 100-task GDP.pdf holdout, served in a 262,144-token window, strict pass (all rubric criteria met) more than doubles after the second round, from 11.0% to 24.5%, with gains across input lengths up to 240K tokens. Mean tokens generated stay flat (9,803 to 9,733), so the gain does not come from longer outputs. GPT-5.6 Sol's leaderboard strict pass is 30.7% at a measured 3,422 tokens. On 220 out-of-domain GDPval tasks, where the model runs as a long-horizon tool-using agent, mean rubric reward rises from 0.571 to 0.746 after the third round and zero-credit tasks fall from 54 to 10, while messages per task fall 18%, from 70.9 to 58.2. In paired trajectories, the third round replaces a context-thrashing retry loop with one up-front check of all sources, and verification extends from checking that files exist to checking what they contain. We argue that long-context evaluation of agents should report accuracy jointly with tokens and turns, and that datasets of long documents should ship text and image renderings alongside each PDF.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the Third Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) at NeurIPS 2026. 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables

</details>

### 63. [When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30130v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30130

**作者：** Ziqing Ge

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30130v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30130v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在五个模型、两个长上下文基准上分析把长文本渲染成图像的「光学上下文压缩」，发现推理 VLM 的图像输入会带来 1.5–3.5 倍解码长度增长，并给出压缩比与输入输出价格之比构成的收益换算条件及图像优先回退策略。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉输入路径的收益与成本核算：OCR 可恢复 98.7% 词仍出现推理变长，说明视觉旁路的问题不止信息坍缩，可作为 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本权衡与视觉证据筛选的对照；其模型与基准能否外推到 latent 推理状态尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs

**abstract/A1：** Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 64. [RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30145v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30145

**作者：** Yiheng Du、Jingqi Tian、Xu Jiang、Jiexuan Zhang、Shuyu Wang、Zecheng Tang、Jian Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30145v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30145v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RMR-VLA，在 VLA 内部加入显式循环记忆推理步骤：每次更新先从视觉证据推断事件，再修订任务状态并在当前场景中 grounding 子目标以指导动作生成；记忆决策以文本 token 表达，并用 GRPO 由 rollout 奖励优化，在 RoboMME 与 LIBERO-Mem 上评测。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 关注的推理状态跨更新携带与视觉证据如何决定当前目标，可供核查的是状态以文本 token 而非 latent 承载、以及记忆内容被动作生成实际使用与贡献分配的程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).

</details>

### 65. [PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30167v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30167

**作者：** Dankai Liao、YuFeng Wu、Ziyue Wang、Guanxi Liu、Tianyi Zhang、Zeyu Liu、Linghan Cai、Yueming Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30167v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30167v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文形式化“病理专家主导的流式诊断”，基于五位病理学家在 1,791 张 TCGA 全切片上的阅片轨迹构建 PathStreamBench，并提出两阶段训练的 PathStream，以诊断注意力损失把注意力引导到累积的视觉与文本证据上，联合学习流式响应与会话级诊断。

**相关性简评：** 阅片轨迹中的响应时机与证据累积直接对应 LOOK/STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选，可供核查其增量状态如何组织与更新；但状态以显式描述和图像视图承载，并非 latent 推理状态，与 LVR 内部表示的对应关系仍需阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology

**abstract/A1：** Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists' viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline's 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.

</details>

### 66. [Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30193v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30193

**作者：** Ziyu Liu、Zeyi Sun、Xiaoyi Dong、Yuhang Cao、Haodong Duan、Dahua Lin、Jiaqi Wang、Yuhang Zang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30193v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30193v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Visual-RFT++ 统一强化微调框架，将细粒度视觉感知与多模态工具使用（实时搜索、代码图像操作）纳入可验证奖励训练，并构建 MAT 工具基准。

**相关性简评：** 其工具调用式视觉证据获取与逐步推理训练直接关联 LOOK/THINK 的收益成本、证据筛选和停止决策，可供核查奖励设计是否促使模型真正使用视觉信息而非语言先验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO's 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.

**comment/C1：** Our code is available at https://github.com/Liuziyu77/Visual-RFT

</details>

### 67. [VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30226v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30226

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30226v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30226v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** VeriWorld 是面向交互式 3D 环境空间推理的可验证基准，用可执行动作和确定性验证，在同一实例上对比纯视觉、结构化及组合输入，诊断 VLM 的感知、推理及其衔接失败。

**相关性简评：** 其「视觉到结构差距」与动作空间/harness 混杂直接关联 LVR 中视觉证据是否被内部使用、感知-推理接口及评价归因，可供核查视觉信息保留与贡献分配的实验设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic findings. First, models often perform much better when task-relevant information, such as object identity, current state, or target location, is given explicitly than when it must be read from the rendered scene, revealing a recurring visual-to-structure gap. Second, action-space and harness design can change outcomes even under the same task and information condition, showing that interaction protocol is itself a confounding variable. VeriWorld is open-sourced to support reproducible and fine-grained evaluation of spatial reasoning in VLMs.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code at https://github.com/VITA-Group/VeriWorld and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld

</details>
