### 68. [Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30290v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30290

**作者：** Miaoyu Li、Boyang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30290v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30290v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「可分性」与「可组合性」两项技能定位原则，并给出多技能可解释框架 DISCO：用跨技能贡献挑选技能专属注意力头，并首次设计度量来评估这些头的可分性与可组合性，在三个 VLM 和四类视觉推理技能上验证。

**相关性简评：** 直接研究 VLM 视觉推理技能在内部注意力头上的定位与跨技能干扰，其可分性、可组合性度量可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与多假设 latent 的贡献分配和技能叠加方式，但未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. For identification, we propose Separable Head Selection, which selects skill-specific attention heads based on their contributions across skills. For evaluation, we are the first to design metrics for measuring separability and composability of identified heads. Extensive experiments on three VLMs and four fundamental visual reasoning skills demonstrate the effectiveness of DISCO. It achieves the highest separability, outperforming the strongest baseline by 24.80, 18.38, and 13.75 points across the three models, respectively, while also achieving the highest composability on all three models.

</details>

### 69. [Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30320v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30320

**作者：** Zijie Jin、Shuai Zhao、Haoran Tao、Chaomin Huang、Liwen Luo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30320v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30320v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「证据依赖」这一度量：在视频时序定位中固定答案，分别编辑标注区间内的帧与同视频其他等量帧（安慰剂），比较两者引起的答案似然下降，并据此构造可训练目标；发现 SFT 与 IoU 奖励 RL 虽提升准确率 9–20 点，但证据依赖未超过基座模型。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」与视觉旁路问题；其安慰剂对照审计、依赖度目标及掩蔽帧的行为差异，可供核查迁移到 LVR 的因果证据筛选与贡献分配评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding

**abstract/A1：** In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event's frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer's likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model's, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit's frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model's own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop rule out learning to react to any edit. With them, evidence dependence rises in all five base models we train, and the weight on clean supervision controls how much. Added to IoU-reward training, the objective raises evidence dependence while keeping the accuracy gain. Masking the event's frames makes the trained models decline or miss the event more often than their base; masking as many other frames does not. The dependence moves to another event when the query names it, and holds on a second dataset and under patch scrambling, an edit never used in training.

**comment/C1：** Preprint, 47 pages. Code, models and data: https://jinzijie-bupt.github.io/Accuracy-Is-Not-Evidence/

</details>

### 70. [Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30424v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30424

**作者：** Yutong Li、Haoyu Zhao、Daoguo Dong、Ziyi Ye、Yugang Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30424v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30424v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Spatial-Zero：无需外部数据，由 proposer 指定物体配置与问题、Coder 将其转为可执行场景程序并渲染多视图图像与显式几何，Geometric Oracle 校验可见性与答案唯一性并导出标签来监督 Solver，同时用验证结果反馈难度以迭代自演化；在六个空间推理基准、三个 VLM 骨干上均有一致提升。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 VLM 对度量距离、三维关系与视角几何的表示与训练问题，其「可执行场景程序 + oracle 校验标签 + 难度反馈」为视觉证据筛选与训练监督分配提供了可供核查的线索，但未涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data

**abstract/A1：** Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, including appendices. 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text

</details>

### 71. [Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30617v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AuxCA：在 GRPO 中依据辅助几何线索对 token 生成的影响（ACD）做细粒度优势加权，并加入辅助线索使用奖励，使模型不显式绘图也能习得可迁移的辅助构造策略。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉证据筛选及训练期贡献分配直接相关，其「线索对生成的影响」度量可供核查 latent 视觉信息是否被答案实际使用，及辅助构造策略的跨域泛化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving

**abstract/A1：** Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \\textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Clues Dependency (\\textbf{ACD}) to quantify the influence of auxiliary visual clues on token generation and integrate it into GRPO through fine-grained advantage weighting. Furthermore, we incorporate an auxiliary incentive reward to encourage the effective use of auxiliary geometric clues in correct solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AuxCA-8B outperforms the explicit-plotting baseline Bagel-Canvas and achieves competitive performance with leading proprietary models on auxiliary-dependent plane geometry problems. Improvements on analytic geometry, solid geometry, and external benchmarks further suggest that the learned strategies can transfer beyond the training domain. Code is available at https://github.com/fukua23/AuxCA

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS2026

</details>

### 72. [How Do Deep Networks Encode and Selectively Use Information? Shared Encoding and Conditional Signed Readout in Vision and Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30854v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30854

**作者：** Kaixiang Shu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30854v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30854v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用视觉分类器的背景纹理编辑和冻结语言模型中的实体绑定编辑，分析隐藏单元分块如何共享编码上下文信息，并把局部输出变化分解为带符号的通道与通路贡献，再用单元抑制和剪枝实验验证该条件读出机制。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 关心的内部状态是否保留视觉细节与实体关系、答案是否真正使用这些内容；其共享编码与带符号条件读出的分解，可供核查 latent 内容的选择性使用、视觉旁路与信息坍缩。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Do Deep Networks Encode and Selectively Use Information? Shared Encoding and Conditional Signed Readout in Vision and Language Models

**abstract/A1：** How can trained deep networks retain contextual information across internal representations while using it selectively in a decision? We study this question through controlled background-texture edits in vision classifiers and entity-binding edits in frozen language models. Across both modalities, factor perturbations preserve recognizable structure across pre-fixed, mutually disjoint blocks of hidden units: visual channel blocks match their complements more closely for the same image than for other images under the same texture edit, while language blocks transfer a relational direction fitted under one query role to rank relational states within held-out name pairs under the other role. We then decompose the local output change into signed channel and pathway contributions. In a convolutional classifier, net channel-level reinforcement ($R^{(512)}&gt;1$) coexists on individual images with cancellation between positive- and negative-weight groups ($R^{(2)}&lt;1$). Holding weights, the paired relation edit, and red/blue answer words fixed, switching prompt presentation reverses the mean finite selection effect in Qwen2.5. Two held-out tests validate this mechanism. Attenuating development-selected antagonistic units amplifies edit effects on unseen inputs; in a vision transformer, attenuating the same frozen units in one forward pass increases the mean magnitude of the background-edit effect on one class margin and reduces it on another, with the opposite pattern for a second group (four-cell paired interaction $+78.30\\times 10^{-5}$ logit). Finally, combining conditional channel variance with fixed downstream readout weights predicts single-channel pruning recovery across ten cuts. These results show how shared encoding and conditional signed readout can coexist in vision and language models.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30881

**作者：** Gen Li、Pengyang Xie、Xiao Xiao、Chuanzhi Tong、Ziyang Ji、Zhigang Xu、Huiwen Bai、Zihao Xing、Yanxiang Zhou、Yifei Yuan、Xiaoqing Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AnchorCredit：利用策略模型从输出锚点到前文推理句的注意力估计句子—组件关联，从而在多可验证奖励任务中把组件级优势分配给真正相关的推理，无需额外标注或独立判别器；并构建 7,200 条产品图文样本的 ProductAttr 基准验证其优于现有基线。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「贡献分配与监督」问题——将推理片段与具体属性奖励对应，避免整体优势广播误罚有效推理；其注意力关联估计是否反映语义内容而非位置或注意力伪影，可供进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AnchorCredit: Output-Anchored Credit Assignment for Structured Generation with Multiple Verifiable Rewards

**abstract/A1：** In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related methods typically compute group-relative advantages from response rewards and broadcast the same advantage to every generated token in a response to guide policy updates. However, we identify a systematic problem of cross-component credit misassignment in tasks with multiple verifiable results, such as joint multi-attribute prediction: low rewards for some components can penalize a well-performing component and its associated reasoning. To address this problem, we propose AnchorCredit. The method uses the policy model's attention from output anchors to preceding reasoning sentences to estimate sentence-component associations and assign component-specific advantages to the relevant reasoning, without additional relevance annotations or a separate relevance discriminator. To support the study of credit assignment with multiple verifiable rewards, we construct ProductAttr, a benchmark of 7,200 real product image-text samples. Experiments show that AnchorCredit outperforms existing baselines on this benchmark. Experiments on the public Nutrition5k dataset further support the method's effectiveness in this setting.

</details>

### 74. [Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30895v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30895

**作者：** Bohe Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30895v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30895v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出两个主动式任务辅助基准主要奖励「知道何时」而非「看到什么」：一个完全不看视频、仅按固定时间报警与确认步骤的计时器在 Ego-MC-Bench 上取得 0.373 的 mistake F1，超过所有已发表结果。作者将其形式化为 video-blind frontier，并提出 Evidence-Contrastive Training，用同一录像、同一已用时刻的负样本配对进行微调，使时间无法区分正负，2B 模型在约 15 GPU 小时内于两个基准的四个随机种子上均越过该前沿，并通过等时间配对判别、时间戳重标定与换录像等实验显示决策确实跟随视频内容。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 关注的「视觉旁路与信息坍缩」诊断及「何时停止、证据是否足够」决策问题；其等时间对比负采样可能可供核查为抑制时间先验捷径、强化视觉证据使用的训练线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock

**abstract/A1：** Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 10 figures, 27 tables

</details>

### 75. [Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30909v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30909

**作者：** Yicheng Zhang、Xun Zhang、Jingyuan Ma、Tianyu Yu、Yuan Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30909v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30909v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 Second-Look Prompting：在输入中重复图文对，使因果注意力下每个视觉与文本 token 都能看到完整多模态上下文；在 12 个基准、9 个开源与 3 个专有模型上验证平均分提升，并分析「问题引导第二次图像注意力」与「额外视觉 token 充当 prefill scratchpad」两种机制。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及「LOOK」式重复暴露视觉证据的收益与成本，且指出额外 token 的隐状态保留答案相关信息，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用、以及 token 位置与注意力结构如何影响内部状态表征。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding

**abstract/A1：** Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.

</details>

### 76. [Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31021v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31021v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31021v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的 LatentParse：由一个 analyst VLM 借助预定义工具探测 CLIP、DINOv3 与 VGGT 的 latent 特征，完成物体定位、跨视角跟踪与视角间运动测量，再蒸馏为简短文本报告，与图像一同交给目标 VLM 回答多视角空间推理问题。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「视觉几何与跨视角对应信息是否留在内部表示中、又如何被 VLM 实际使用」这一主线，其文本化证据旁路可供核查是否缓解信息坍缩，以及收益中有多少来自 analyst 工具设计而非 latent 内容本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ActSpace-Bench：在 72 个真实扫描室内场景、234 个探索回合和 994 个问题上，让 VLM 从单视角出发主动导航取帧、收集证据后作答，并用同预算随机游走与 oracle 路线分离「找证据」和「空间推理」，评测了 23 个模型。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本、证据获取与推理的贡献分解，以及掩蔽证据下的弃答判断；其「强模型受限于记忆、弱模型不优于随机游走」的结论可供核查探索轨迹中证据保留与视觉旁路问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to them? We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering. To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning. Every question is verified to require exploration and answered from 3D annotations, masked-evidence questions test whether models know when to abstain, and over 95% of sampled questions are confirmed correct by human verification. Evaluations of 23 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized VLMs reveal that the strongest models do seek evidence with purpose but lose much of it to limited memory, whereas weaker and specialized models explore no better than a random walk or fail to reason over the evidence they are given, pointing to memory and evidence-grounded reasoning as the next targets for active spatial intelligence.

</details>

### 78. [Parasite Features: Causal Abstraction Through Spurious Pathways](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26711v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26711

**作者：** Denis Sutter、Qing Yao、Sasha Boguraev、Julian Minder、Antonio Di Maio、Thomas Hofmann、Kyle Mahowald、Tiago Pimentel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26711v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26711v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出因果抽象类可解释性方法可能被表示空间中两条方向的组合路径欺骗，从而发现虚假的「parasite features」，并在句法一致与两位数加法任务中用 Distributed Alignment Search 验证了这一点。

**相关性简评：** 其关于因果抽象等价检验与虚假通路的警示，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正承载任务特征、以及表示对齐搜索的因果归因是否可靠；但任务为纯文本与算术，向多模态情境迁移仍需检验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Parasite Features: Causal Abstraction Through Spurious Pathways

**abstract/A1：** Causal Abstraction defines a notion of \\emph{equivalence} between a neural network and an algorithm, thus serving as a powerful framework for mechanistic interpretability. In this paper, however, we show the existence of a class of \\emph{spurious features} which straightforwardly pass such equivalence tests. Suppose there are two directions in a model's representation space where: (i) one discriminates the input based on some feature, and (ii) the other steers the model towards a certain output. Interpretability methods based on Causal Abstraction (e.g., Distributed Alignment Search) can \\emph{spuriously} simulate these directions' combined behavior by leveraging pathways passing through them, giving the impression that the model implements this feature. In such cases, we say the method discovered a \\defn{parasite feature}. Experimentally, we show that Distributed Alignment Search finds parasite features using linear alignment maps in two tasks: syntactic agreement and two-digit addition. Our paper highlights an important consideration for Causal Abstraction and contributes to the ongoing debate about best practices for mechanistic interpretability.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. 25 Pages, 5 Figures, 2 Tables

</details>

### 79. [AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26910v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26910

**作者：** Congyuan Yu、Runping Tian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26910v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26910v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** AstronautBench 基于游戏 Outer Wilds 构建跨 episode 的智能体自我改进基准，在同一轮次中并行测量三件事：世界知识问答正确率、答案是否被智能体自己引用的画面与位置证据支持（由两个不同模型家族的 LLM judge 核查）、以及实际到达的游戏进度；八 episode 基线显示三者并不同步增长。

**相关性简评：** 其「知识正确但未必有自身视觉证据支持」的诊断视角与双 judge 证据核查流程，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容对答案的因果支撑与视觉证据筛选；但对象是具身游戏智能体的跨 episode 知识积累而非 VLM 内部推理状态生成，迁移价值需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents are expected to improve themselves from their own experience across episodes, with fixed weights. Self-improvement in an embodied world cannot be read from one measure. Existing benchmarks measure task progress, world-knowledge question answering (QA), and episodic memory, but a correct answer does not show that the agent ever observed the evidence for it, and progress does not show what the agent learned. We introduce AstronautBench, which measures one agent's self-improvement through three views on the same run: what it knows, whether its own evidence supports that knowledge, and how far it gets in the world. It is built on the game Outer Wilds, where each episode is a 22-minute loop after which the world resets, only the agent's knowledge carries over, and progress is gated by knowledge. After every episode, we measure the places reached and ship-log rumor facts revealed, the correctness of answers to 164 questions about the world, and whether each answer is supported by the frames and position the agent cites from its own recorded play. Two LLM judges from different model families check every answer. In eight-episode baselines with GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon planners, which act through a learned controller or their own gamepad inputs, the three views do not move together, so any one of them alone gives an incomplete picture of whether the agent is improving. The GPT-6.1 Sol agent's correct answers grow from 14.6% to 26.8% of all questions, but at episode 8 only 59 to 68% of them are supported by its cited evidence. It reveals no new rumor facts after episode 3, while the places it reaches and its memory keep growing. More than half of the answers that become correct after episode 3 cite only evidence from earlier episodes.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 80. [Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26954v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26954

**作者：** Jingchen Sun、Jiaxing Zhang、Qingqiao Hu、Dingqiang Ye、Yuqi Jia、Yijun Liang、Di Fu、Yunjie Tian、Dongdi Zhao、Changyou Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26954v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26954v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Future-OPSD：利用无标注的过去-未来视频对做 on-policy 自蒸馏，并定义 foresight score 与对比式特权优势，使 VLM 在预测未来事件或下一步动作时更关注决策相关的未来信息、抑制无关上下文。

**相关性简评：** 其「前景分数+对比特权优势」本质上是对哪些未来视觉证据值得学习的贡献分配与筛选机制，可供核查如何借鉴到 latent 视觉证据加权、轨迹监督与无关上下文抑制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at https://jingchensun.github.io/future-opsd/

</details>

### 81. [Disentangling Verbalized Evaluation Awareness and Refusal through Neuron-Level Intervention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27032v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27032

**作者：** Jingyuan Feng、Gouki Minegishi、Andrew Gambardella、Takeshi Kojima、Yusuke Iwasawa

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27032v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27032v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在大型推理模型中定位「言语化评估意识」（VEA）神经元，通过对比 VEA 与非 VEA 推理片段的激活加以识别，并做神经元级干预；发现抑制这些神经元不仅降低 VEA 率，还在无 VEA 的 rollout 中减少拒答，并进一步拆解出下投影向量中的拒答成分。

**相关性简评：** 其「文本仅解释 4–10% 行为变化」的分离手段与对未言语化内部状态探针，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用、以及显式轨迹与内部状态的贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Disentangling Verbalized Evaluation Awareness and Refusal through Neuron-Level Intervention

**abstract/A1：** As large reasoning models (LRMs) become more capable, reliable evaluation becomes essential. LRMs can sometimes recognize that they are being evaluated, a phenomenon known as \\emph{evaluation awareness}. This phenomenon raises concerns about whether safety behavior, particularly refusal behavior, generalizes from evaluation to deployment. Prior work manipulates \\emph{verbalized evaluation awareness (VEA)} through activation steering and observes higher refusal rates when VEA is present, but the mechanisms underlying this connection remain poorly understood. We identify \\emph{VEA neurons} by contrasting their activations in VEA and non-VEA reasoning segments. Intervening on 5,000 VEA neurons reduces the VEA rate from 12.6--51.8\\% to at most 1.4\\% across the model benchmark combinations in our main experiments, and lowers a probe score for unverbalized evaluation awareness (unVEA). In QwQ-32B, VEA-neuron intervention also reduces refusal even in rollouts without VEA; VEA text itself explains only 4--10\\% of the decrease. We further show that their down-projection vectors contain refusal components, and preserving these components during intervention partially restores refusal while maintaining VEA suppression, accounting for about half of the refusal decrease and providing a mechanistic explanation for the connection between evaluation awareness and refusal. Finally, across the OLMo 3 SFT, DPO, and RLVR checkpoints, the VEA rate on SorryBench and StrongREJECT is similar after SFT and DPO but substantially higher after RLVR, alongside an increase in the number of VEA neurons. Together, these findings show that VEA text itself has a limited effect on refusal, and that VEA neurons integrate evaluation awarenss and refusal.

</details>

### 82. [Auditing and Adapting kNNGuard for Long-Context Prompts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27084v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27084

**作者：** Niccolò Ronchetti

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27084v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27084v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文审计无训练 kNNGuard 在长上下文提示上的性能崩塌（隐状态漂移、MiniLM 的 256 token 截断、长文压缩为末 token 向量造成信号稀释），并提出长度路由双 bank、长上下文 embedding 与跨中间 token 的 strided window pooling 三种无训练修补方案。

**相关性简评：** 其「末 token 单向量稀释」诊断与按中间位置池化读取隐状态的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度受位置与读取方式影响、以及长上下文下证据是否被保留提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing and Adapting kNNGuard for Long-Context Prompts

**abstract/A1：** Training-free activation guardrails such as kNNGuard score prompts by comparing last-token LLM hidden states (the Layer Ensemble branch, kNNGuard LE) and sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Embedding-kNN) against a small reference bank (50 examples per class), combining the two branches into a Fused Ensemble (kNNGuard FE). While effective on short inputs (up to 256 tokens), standard kNNGuard degrades substantially on long inputs (over 1000 tokens): averaged across Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, kNNGuard LE AUROC drops from 0.742 (0.777 and 0.706) to 0.554 (0.587 and 0.521) on Content Harm Moderation (Aegis-2.0), and from 0.994 (0.995 and 0.992) to 0.556 (0.598 and 0.513) on RAG Hallucination Detection (HaluBench). We trace this degradation to three causes: (1) hidden-state drift as sequence length increases, (2) hard 256-token truncation in MiniLM, and (3) signal dilution when a long document is compressed into a single final-token vector. We then evaluate three training-free adaptations: a Length-Routed Dual Bank, a long-context embedding model (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), and Strided Window Pooling across intermediate token positions. On Content Harm Moderation, dual-bank routing and strided window pooling raise long-context kNNGuard LE AUROC from 0.554 to 0.828 (+0.274 AUROC) and fused kNNGuard FE AUROC from 0.721 to 0.886 (+0.164 AUROC) with no latency overhead from bank routing. On RAG Hallucination Detection, where the guardrail must verify logical consistency between a generated answer and a retrieved passage, sentence-embedding kNN remains near random chance across all lengths, while length-matched LLM hidden states (kNNGuard LE) recover medium-length detection (AUROC = 0.853) but remain limited on over-1000-token passages (AUROC = 0.607) due to final-token dilution over long contexts.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 83. [ORION: Exact Canonical-State Supervision for Systematic Generalization in Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27087v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27087

**作者：** Sibi Gokul、Jyoti Prakash Meher

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27087v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27087v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ORION 用辅助头监督精确的规范执行状态，把 Transformer 的 latent 轨迹锚定到合法计算流形上；在 Folding、GridShift、CLRS-30 上以 2×2 因子设计对比 RoPE 与该方法，发现 RoPE 主要恢复长度外推、ORION 主要恢复深度外推且两者收益可加。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本算法推理，但其对中间状态的精确对齐监督与深度外推结论，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练、状态贡献分配及长度与深度泛化工作区的迁移可能。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ORION: Exact Canonical-State Supervision for Systematic Generalization in Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive Transformers generally fail on out-of-distribution reasoning due to two primary reasons: positional corruption over long sequences and structural state drift across deep execution steps. We introduce ORION, a framework that supervises exact canonical execution states via auxiliary heads to anchor latent trajectories to valid computational manifolds. Across Folding, GridShift, and CLRS-30, a pre-registered 2 x 2 factorial shows that RoPE and ORION address orthogonal axes. RoPE recovers length extrapolation (59.8%), while ORION recovers depth extrapolation (66.7%). Moreover, their combination complementarily achieves strict additive gain in joint length-depth extrapolation, while either method alone offers near satisfactory results. Negative controls confirm that the gain depends strictly on exact canonical alignment; hashed state statistics fail to constrain depth extrapolation.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages

</details>

### 84. [Reasoning in Two Dimensions: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27100v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27100

**作者：** Chenruo Liu、Quan Zhang、Qi Lei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27100v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27100v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 CoT 表示为语义推理图，把模型预测依赖分解为「语义支持 vs 额外推理历史」和「通往答案 vs 偏离路径」两轴，据此给出全局与步骤级的忠实性、低效性指标，并导出图感知微调目标。

**相关性简评：** 其依赖度分解与干预式指标可供核查：能否改造为判断 VLM 答案是否真正依赖视觉证据或 latent 推理状态，而非表面轨迹，从而服务视觉旁路与信息坍缩诊断；当前对象为纯文本 CoT，迁移性待评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reasoning in Two Dimensions: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency

**abstract/A1：** Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning exposes intermediate steps, but a correct answer does not establish that an LLM relies on the dependence expressed by those steps or reasons efficiently. We operationalize CoT faithfulness and efficiency within a common framework. Specifically, we represent a CoT as a semantic reasoning graph and decompose the model's predictive dependence along two complementary axes: dependence explained by semantic support versus additional reasoning history, and dependence allocated to answer-reaching versus off-path reasoning. This decomposition yields global and step-level measures of unfaithfulness and inefficiency. Controlled interventions show that the proposed metrics respond to hidden dependence and induced off-path reasoning as intended. Across mathematical and multi-hop reasoning tasks, answer-level unfaithfulness is consistently associated with greater predictive uncertainty, whereas both unfaithfulness and inefficiency exhibit weak or inconsistent associations with answer correctness. We further derive theoretically grounded, graph-aware fine-tuning objectives that improve the targeted reasoning properties without directly optimizing the computationally expensive metrics or compromising answer accuracy. Results indicate that accuracy and brevity provide incomplete assessments of reasoning quality: reliable CoT evaluation should also consider whether the LLM's predictive dependence is faithfully represented and efficiently allocated.

</details>

### 85. [A Plan or an Adversarial Example? A Round-Trip Check for Latent World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27124v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27124

**作者：** Huiyuan Tian、Chih-Yung Wen、Shijian Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27124v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27124v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 latent world model 规划结果究竟是「计划」还是模型的对抗样本，发现 CEM 迭代越多预测代价越低、却丢掉已解问题，且模型自身预测不暴露这些失败；为此提出 round-trip check，用小网络从预测状态反解动作块之和并惩罚不一致，在不重训模型、仅增 0.2%–3.1% 规划时间下改进 CEM 与 MPPI。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测代价下降但真实成功下降、模型内部信号无法自证」的诊断与反解一致性校验，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、latent 内容是否被真正使用及推理结果验证提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Plan or an Adversarial Example? A Round-Trip Check for Latent World Models

**abstract/A1：** If we optimize an image until a classifier is confident it shows a cat, we may get an adversarial example, not a cat. Planning with a latent world model is a similar search for actions whose predicted future is closest to the goal. Is the result a plan, or an adversarial example of the world model? We show that it can be either. On the released DINO-WM and LeWM, more iterations of the cross-entropy method (CEM) lower the predicted cost but lose up to half of the problems CEM had already solved. The model's own predictions do not reveal these failures. We propose a simple test that executes the plan after every iteration and counts the problems a planner solves and then loses. Unlike an image, a plan comes with its actions, which our round-trip check reads back from the predicted states with a small network, penalizing mismatches. The check reads back the sum of each block of five actions, the part that two consecutive predicted states determine. Without retraining the world model and at only 0.2% to 3.1% more planning time, it improves the widely used planners CEM and MPPI on three released world models, and gains more where planners lose more problems. Without replanning, success rises from 0.39 to 0.76 on Wall with DINO-WM and from 0.56 to 0.94 for MPPI on JEPA-WM. With replanning (MPC), it rises from 0.70 to 0.81 on Cube with LeWM.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文系统分析 LVLM 的多层视觉表示，在异常检测任务上比较逐层特征与多层融合，跨多种监督级别和分类器考察各层对下游性能的贡献，并给出面向视觉中心任务的表示选择经验。

**相关性简评：** 其区分深层语义与浅/中层细粒度外观、并比较逐层与融合策略的做法，可供核查 LVR 中承载视觉证据的内部层选择与融合；但研究对象是异常检测而非推理状态生成，属方法线索而非直接主线。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Analyzing Multi-Layer Visual Representations of Large Vision-Language Models for Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** In this paper, we analyze multi-layer visual representations in large vision-language models (LVLMs) and examine the effectiveness of layer-wise features and multi-layer fusion for anomaly detection. Representative LVLMs connect visual encoder features to a language model through a projector. In this design, deep visual encoder features carry high-level semantics and alignment with text representations, whereas shallow and intermediate layers retain information relevant to vision-centric tasks, such as local appearance and fine-grained shape. It is therefore important to choose layer representations and fusion methods according to the nature of the downstream task. Focusing on anomaly detection, we compare layer-wise features and multi-layer fusion across multiple supervision levels and a variety of classifiers, and examine from several perspectives how multi-layer visual representations affect downstream performance. By analyzing the resulting performance differences, we further discuss the contribution of each layer representation to anomaly detection and provide empirical insights into representation selection for vision-centric tasks.

**comment/C1：** Presented at MIRU2026

</details>

### 87. [DepthMSA: Combinatorial Training and Budget-Aware Depth Allocation for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27198v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27198

**作者：** Pan Wang、Jie Peng、Zhimin Li、Jingxian Chen、Hui Ji、Huanrui Yang、Pengfei Zhou、Tianlong Chen、Jingtong Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27198v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27198v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DepthMSA，在多模态情感分析中为各模态分配不同的编码深度：用「组合式 anytime 训练」以一次全深度前向监督融合头覆盖所有跨模态深度组合，推理时由无需训练、成本感知的分配器在样本级 FLOPs 预算下选取验证集校准误差最低的配置。

**相关性简评：** 论文揭示模态编码器计算成本与深度收益的不匹配，其跨深度组合监督与按预算选择深度的做法，可为 LVR 中按样本分配 THINK 深度/视觉编码成本、平衡收益与开销提供方法线索，但任务与内部状态机制不同，需核查能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DepthMSA: Combinatorial Training and Budget-Aware Depth Allocation for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

**abstract/A1：** State-of-the-art multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) models rely on large pretrained encoders, yet typically process every modality to its full depth, regardless of its computational cost or predictive contribution. This raises a fundamental question: how should limited computation be allocated across modalities to preserve predictive performance? We reveal a substantial mismatch between the computational cost of modality encoders and the predictive benefit of processing them more deeply, suggesting that different modalities require different encoding depths. However, enabling heterogeneous depths introduces a key challenge: representations extracted at different depths must still be effectively fused. To address this, we propose $\\textbf{DepthMSA}$, a budget-aware framework that supports flexible modality depths within a single MSA model. Specifically, we introduce combinatorial anytime training, which supervises the fusion head across all cross-modal depth combinations using a single full-depth encoder pass. At inference, a training-free, cost-aware allocator selects the configuration with the lowest validation-calibrated error under a sample-specific FLOPs budget. On CMU-MOSEI, DepthMSA maintains accuracy within one percentage point of the full-depth model while reducing measured FLOPs by 45\\%, or by 82\\% with a separately trained skip-enabled variant. When a CLIP visual encoder dominates computation, the allocation shifts toward reducing visual depth, achieving 56\\% fewer FLOPs at unchanged accuracy. Compared with ADMN, an adaptive layer-allocation method that trains a controller for each budget, the skip-enabled variant reaches its accuracy with 3.2$\\times$ fewer FLOPs and lower latency, without any per-budget training. Our project is available at https://pwang322.github.io/DepthMSA/.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages

</details>

### 88. [GRACE: Controlled Evidence Interventions for Diagnosing and Improving Knowledge Integration in GraphRAG](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27350v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27350

**作者：** Minh Pham、Quang Nguyen、Phong Kieu、Cong Tran

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27350v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27350v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 GraphRAG 基准 GRACE，对每个证据子图施加切断支撑路径、加入类型兼容干扰项、接入高度数枢纽和用反事实实体替换答案四种受控干预，并提出结合局部/全局图注意力、问题条件证据引导与校准支撑门控的 QCFSE-SA 模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「相关事实未必联合充分」的发现及校准图支撑门控，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、支持组合与停止/弃答决策；但该工作非视觉、非 latent，迁移可行性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRACE: Controlled Evidence Interventions for Diagnosing and Improving Knowledge Integration in GraphRAG

**abstract/A1：** GraphRAG combines a language model's parametric knowledge with retrieved graph evidence, yet aggregate accuracy cannot show whether failures stem from missing paths, distractors, or conflicts with model knowledge. We introduce GRACE, a benchmark built by executing LC-QuAD 2.0 queries over Wikidata and applying four controlled interventions to each evidence subgraph: severing a support path, adding type-compatible distractors, attaching high-degree hubs, and replacing the supported answer with a counterfactual entity. Questions and option positions remain fixed across the five states. The validated benchmark contains 4,028 questions and 20,140 question-graph pairs. These comparisons reveal that question-only routing cannot distinguish evidence states, while relevance guidance can improve answerable states yet hurt when the support path is severed: relevant facts may not jointly suffice to answer. We propose QCFSE-SA, which combines typed local attention, global graph attention, and question-conditioned evidence guidance with a calibrated graph-support gate. With the factual context and generator held fixed, it improves controlled-state accuracy from 57.17% to 62.78% (+5.61 points; question-clustered 95% CI \[+5.04, +6.17\]) and broken-state accuracy from 55.41% to 67.85%. Over-abstention on semantic distractors remains an open challenge.

**comment/C1：** pages, 3 numbered figures, and five graph-state illustrations. Submitted to SOICT 2026

</details>

### 89. [Beyond Linear Decodability: Understanding and Improving Instruction Following in World Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27401v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27401

**作者：** Bokai Ji、Jiapeng Chen、Yi Zhang、Zeyuan Ding、Yong Dai、Xiaozhu Ju、Jian Tang、Lemao Liu、Dejing Dou、Yong Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27401v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27401v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究世界动作模型为何不遵循测试时语言指令，发现目标信息在跟随与不跟随模型中的线性可解码性存在显著差异，据此提出线性可解码性监督 LDS，并用先验—指令竞争机制解释行为差异。

**相关性简评：** 其「信息已编码但未控制行为」的诊断、线性探针监督及因果干预，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案使用、表征可读性与实际贡献的区分提供可核查线索；但研究对象是操作动作模型，迁移到视觉推理仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Linear Decodability: Understanding and Improving Instruction Following in World Action Models

**abstract/A1：** World action models (WAMs) exhibit strong manipulation capabilities yet often fail to follow test-time language instructions. Prior work shows that non-following (NF) WAMs encode information about the instructed target, but this information does not control their behavior. By comparing NF WAM with its instruction-following (IF) counterpart, we find that target information is substantially more linearly decodable in IF WAMs, despite being encoded in both. Motivated by this observation, we introduce linear decodability supervision (LDS), a simple yet effective auxiliary training objective that promotes the linear decodability of the instructed target information. On LIBERO-CF, InternW0-$Δ$ with LDS achieves a success rate of 74.6% and a grounding rate of 89.2%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 26.8 and 42.9 percentage points, respectively. The effectiveness of LDS challenges the prevailing interpretation that encoded target information does not contribute to WAMs' behavior. To reconcile this apparent contradiction, we propose a prior-instruction competition mechanism, which explains NF and IF behavior as arising from the dominance of prior and instruction signals, respectively. We provide causal evidence for this mechanism by evaluating two training-free interventions derived from it. We reinterpret LDS through this mechanism, showing that it acts as a form of instruction signal enhancement. Finally, more comprehensive evaluations across diverse manipulation tasks and visual domains demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of LDS.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://ruflect-intelligence.github.io/LDS-Homepage/

</details>

### 90. [Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27443v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27443

**作者：** Aasheesh Singh、Vishal Vaddina

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27443v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27443v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何后训练小模型在 agent 任务中「何时向更强的 advisor 求助」，提出多阶段配方的 ADAPT，仅用策略自身 rollout 与环境结果监督，在 TextWorld、LiveCodeBench、GAIA 上以少量求助调用显著提升成功率，并验证换用未见 advisor 后仍有增益。

**相关性简评：** 其「成本感知地决定何时求助、并跨步利用外部信息」的决策训练，与 LVR 中何时调用视觉模块（LOOK）及何时停止（STOP）的收益–成本权衡可供核查，无奖励模型的自身轨迹结果监督也可能为轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索；但对象是纯文本外部 advisor，迁移到视觉证据筛选仍需自行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for cheap, high-throughput agentic deployment, but they remain weak at multi-step reasoning and tool use that long-horizon tasks demand. We study how to post-train an SLM to seek advice from a stronger model and act on that advice itself, following an advisor-executor pattern. Out of the box, this pattern fails across open- and closed-source small-model families: wiring an SLM to an advisor is a harness-design matter that is not enough on its own. A post-training recipe is needed to teach the model when to ask, in a cost-aware fashion, and how to follow advice across steps. Our method, ADAPT (ADvisor-Aware Post-Training), is a multi-stage recipe that instills this behavior, learning entirely from the policy's own rollouts supervised by the environment's outcome, with no learned reward model or human annotation. Across three domains, compared to an untrained harness baseline, ADAPT improves success rate in embodied text reasoning (TextWorld) from 24.5% to 77.3%, code generation (LiveCodeBench) from 21.8% to 56.0%, and deep web search (GAIA) from 17.5% to 49.3%, while querying the advisor sparingly (~1.0-2.1 calls per task). On the two long-horizon domains it closes 70-85% of the gap to an oracle that perfectly times when to ask for advice, and on code generation it exceeds that oracle. The gains persist when the advisor is replaced by one unseen in training, showing that the learned help-seeking policy is robust to a changing advisor rather than tied to the one it was trained with.

**comment/C1：** Published at the OE-Agent Workshop (Open and Efficient Agentic AI for Resource-Constrained Environments) at ACML 2026 14 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 91. [Turnout: Adaptive Attention Switching for Efficient Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27500v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27500

**作者：** Anna Kuzina、Mart van Baalen、Paul N. Whatmough、Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27500v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27500v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Turnout：对预训练全注意力模型做事后线性化并保留原全注意力路径，用蒸馏训练线性分支，再用强化学习得到一个逐层在 full 与 linear attention 间切换的策略，奖励同时考虑答案正确性与内存占用，从而在推理任务上取得更优的精度—效率前沿。

**相关性简评：** 以固定大小状态替代增长的 KV cache 会压缩长生成中的细节，与 LVR 关注的视觉信息坍缩和长推理成本相近；其学习式逐层切换策略可供核查是否能作为「何时保留完整证据/增加计算」这一 THINK-LOOK-STOP 决策的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Turnout: Adaptive Attention Switching for Efficient Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc transformer linearization replaces the key-value cache of full attention, which grows linearly with generation length, with a fixed size state. This change reduces memory consumption but often hurts accuracy. In reasoning tasks, which require long generations, this effect is especially pronounced. In this work we introduce Turnout, a method that mitigates accuracy loss as a result of linearization, while maintaining its memory-reduction benefits. We apply post-hoc linearization to a pretrained full-attention model, training a linear path through distillation while leaving the original full-attention path unchanged. During response generation, the resulting hybrid model retains both paths and uses a learned policy to control when each layer switches from full to linear attention. We train the policy with reinforcement learning using a reward that balances answer correctness and memory use. Empirical evaluation of our method shows that the learned adaptive policy achieves a better accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier on reasoning tasks compared to fixed switching and static hybrid baselines.

</details>

### 92. [Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27610v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27610

**作者：** Tommaso Salvatori、Matteo Forasassi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27610v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27610v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 predictive coding 在深层网络中误差信号不稳定或消失的问题，提出 circular 网络，让深度来自能量最小化而非堆叠层，并证明其收敛到平衡点近似 deep equilibrium 模型的不动点迭代；在图像分类、Sudoku 约束满足和自回归语言建模上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其用循环迭代换取有效深度、以能量最小化更新内部状态的机制，与 LVR 关注的 loop 式状态更新、动态计算和迭代推理步数直接相关，可供核查循环平衡点是否可作为 latent 推理状态的生成与训练载体；但未涉及视觉语言推理或视觉证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth

**abstract/A1：** Predictive coding networks perform credit assignment through an energy minimization process. Despite their ability to train models with arbitrary network topologies, they have mostly been used to train feedforward architectures to match the performance of backpropagation. However, they fail to do so when the models become too deep, because error signals become unstable or vanish as they travel through many layers. We address this limitation with circular networks, which get their depth directly from the energy minimization, rather than from stacking layers. Formally, we prove that convergence to an equilibrium of the energy functional of a circular predictive coding network approximates the fixed-point iteration process of a deep equilibrium model, showing that circularity alone suffices to unlock effective depth. Empirically, we show that circular models (i) outperform other predictive coding models of the same size on image classification tasks, matching the accuracy of state-of-the-art predictive coding ResNets and VGG networks despite having substantially fewer parameters; (ii) solve constraint satisfaction problems that require many steps of iterative reasoning, a task not feasible with feedforward models at all, reaching 99.3% test accuracy on Sudoku-hard via nested energy minimization loops; and (iii) scale to autoregressive language modeling by training a circular transformer on TinyStories and WikiText-103, before out of reach for predictive coding models. These results have direct implications for physical neural networks, where computational depth can be traded for recursion on a fixed-size circuit.

**comment/C1：** 25 Pages, many figures, preprint

</details>

### 93. [Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27839v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27839

**作者：** Chrisantus Eze

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27839v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27839v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一个多智能体科研主张验证框架：用 Advocate、Skeptic、Arbitrator 的非对称角色降低角色嵌入相似度，以 Belief-Delta 收敛准则替代固定迭代停止，并用独立 NLI 分类器审计逐字证据片段。

**相关性简评：** 其证据驱动的停止规则与证据锚定审计，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策和视觉证据筛选的设计；角色嵌入相似度的度量方式也可能为 latent 相似度分析提供参照，但任务为纯文本验证，与视觉推理尚无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent systems for scientific claim verification increasingly rely on role-structured LLM debate to pressure-test hypotheses. However, when debating agents are instantiated from the same underlying base model, they share identical latent representations, making self-critique bias structurally inevitable. Static fixed-iteration protocols compound this by either halting prematurely before evidence stabilizes or wasting inference compute after convergence. We present \\sys{}, a multi-agent research verification framework that addresses both failure modes. First, we introduce an asymmetric role architecture comprising an Advocate, Skeptic, and Arbitrator with opposing epistemic directives, producing significantly lower role-embedding similarity (0.852 vs.\\ 0.918 for symmetric Multi-Agent Debate \[MAD\], $p = 5.82 \\times 10^{-8}$) and surfacing more contested claims (22.0\\% vs.\\ 15.4\\%). Second, we propose the Belief-Delta ($\\DB$) convergence criterion, an evidence-grounded stopping rule that eliminates over-iteration (0.0\\% vs.\\ 62.5\\% for Fixed-$3$) while cutting LLM calls by 2.4$\\times$. Third, each supported claim is anchored to a verbatim literature snippet audited by an independent NLI classifier, achieving a 21.7\\% hallucination rate (comparable to 25.9\\% for a Self-Refine critic, $p = 0.61$) while establishing auditable evidence grounding. Across 200 runs on 40 research hypotheses evaluated with DeepSeek-R1-32B, \\sys{} balances compute efficiency with rigorous epistemic verification.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ICAART 2027

</details>

### 94. [Functional Depth Is Learned: Isolating the Computation That Layers Produce Only Together](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27911v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27911

**作者：** JaeSeong Kim、KyungTae Lim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27911v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27911v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 inclusion-exclusion 精确分解，度量仅当指定层共同作用时才出现的「连通计算」，并在 Pythia、OLMo、Amber 的公开 checkpoint 上追踪其随预训练增强、对困惑度的因果影响及与成对表示相似度的负相关。

**相关性简评：** 其连通计算分解与 identity ablation 可供核查 LVR 中深度收益与跨层贡献分配，并提示表示相似度不等同于实际跨层依赖；但论文对象是纯文本语言模型，多模态与 latent 推理联系需自行迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Functional Depth Is Learned: Isolating the Computation That Layers Produce Only Together

**abstract/A1：** Transformer performance scales with depth, but layer count merely counts the opportunities for sequential computation: layers could still behave as nearly independent refinements that barely depend on one another. We study how transformers develop functional depth during pretraining, introducing an exact inclusion-exclusion decomposition that isolates the connected component, i.e., the computation that appears only when a specified set of layers acts together under identity ablation. Tracking this quantity across public checkpoints of Pythia, OLMo, and Amber yields three findings. First, write-relative connected coordination strengthens from its initialization or earliest-checkpoint baseline as pretraining proceeds, across all measured interaction orders. Second, these connected components are behaviorally consequential under direct intervention: deleting them damages perplexity more than deleting a norm-matched random direction at the same site in all 35 measured model-order cells. Third, pairwise representation similarity is consistently negatively correlated with pairwise connected coordination across seven models, yet the two signals are not interchangeable: similarity- and coordination-based block-removal criteria often agree in Pythia but diverge on Amber. Together, these results suggest that architectural depth provides the opportunity for sequential computation, while pretraining progressively organizes cross-layer dependencies within that depth.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 95. [ORDO: Fine-Grained Motion Understanding in Video LLMs via Order-Dependent Supervision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28097v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28097

**作者：** Jiaye Luan、Chaoning Zhang、Pengcheng Zheng、Dongshen Han、Sheng Zheng、Ping Guo、Caiyan Qin、Yang Du、Yang Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28097v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28097v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ORDO 框架，通过时间反转配对、匹配空间范围等构造使标签在打乱帧序后不可恢复的「顺序必要监督」，配合六种运动原语的课程数据，对视频 LLM 的 LoRA 做答案级训练与真实视频自蒸馏回放，提升细粒度运动理解。

**相关性简评：** 其「丢弃顺序后标签分布不变」的数据构造思路，可能为核查 latent 推理状态是否真正使用视觉证据、而非从静态线索走旁路提供可借鉴的监督与诊断设计，值得进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ORDO: Fine-Grained Motion Understanding in Video LLMs via Order-Dependent Supervision

**abstract/A1：** Video large language models (video LLMs) answer a wide range of questions about real videos, yet they remain weak at fine-grained motion such as whether an object speeds up or slows down. Existing methods train these models on synthetic motion clips, on order pretext tasks such as reordering shuffled clips, or with rewards that compare ordered and perturbed frames. None of them requires that the label be unrecoverable from the frames once their order is discarded, so a model can fit such data from static cues without learning to use frame order. We propose ORDO, a framework that builds this requirement into the training data. We define order-necessary supervision as data in which the unordered set of frames has the same distribution under competing labels, and we realise it for motion attributes with three constructions, time-reversal pairing, matched spatial extent and uniform interval coverage. A procedural curriculum of six motion primitives instantiates these constructions, and low-rank adapters of the language model are trained on it with an answer-level objective and self-distillation replay on real videos. With 4,000 synthetic clips, ORDO raises the mean accuracy over four motion benchmarks by +7.6, +4.9 and +5.1 points on Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-VL-8B and Molmo2-8B, while the same training with shuffled frames changes it by less than one point. Code and generator will be made publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary material

</details>

### 96. [Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28116

**作者：** Jian Xu、Delu Zeng、Qibin Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28116v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Single-tool Rejection Retry（SRR）基线——最强生成器加现成验证器、在同预算下重试至首个被接受样本——审计四个 agentic 文生图系统的增益，并用闭式分析给出精度上限、路由增益范围与离线蒸馏实验。

**相关性简评：** 其把「验证器重试」与多步 agent 循环的增益分离、并给出预算—精度上限的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 轨迹相对采样与验证的贡献分配、停止决策，以及「用被选中样本训练是否有信息增益」这一轨迹监督问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Agentic text-to-image systems wrap generators in loops of planning, routing, verification and refinement, and report large gains on compositional benchmarks, almost always relative to a single sample. We ask how much of the gain survives against Single-tool Rejection Retry (\\ours): the strongest generator already in the system's pool, an off-the-shelf verifier, and retries that stop at the first accepted image under the system's own budget. Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. A closed-form analysis predicts the accuracy of SRR at every budget and shows that its gain is capped by the verifier's likelihood ratio. The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval). We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5 less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy. In our offline distillation experiments selected samples teach the generator no more than random ones, which a short information argument explains. We end with a reporting checklist for agentic generation papers.

</details>

### 97. [Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28285

**作者：** Haibin Tong、Liangliang Xin、Yamei Zhu、Jiang Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28285v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向一阶马尔可夫式推理，提出将历史 KV 缓存压缩为定长状态接口，把长链预测改写为可独立训练的单步转移目标，并用外循环推进状态、内循环按需分配计算的双环 Transformer。

**相关性简评：** 其显式状态瓶颈、循环深度与转移一致性训练，可能为 LVR 的状态更新、动态计算和链长泛化提供方法线索，但纯文本设定及视觉证据能否纳入定长状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 2 figures. Preprint

</details>

### 98. [When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28341v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28341

**作者：** Gün Kaynar、Boshen Yan、Carl Kingsford

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28341v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28341v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 RetryRealistic 故障注入测试床，评估四个工具型 LLM agent 在 9 类工具故障下的恢复表现，发现「静默摄取」导致自信编造，并提出 verification-first Monitor 以校验工具输出、降低编造率。

**相关性简评：** 其「静默摄取」与验证优先监督可供核查 LVR 中视觉或工具证据在进入推理状态前是否被校验，以及重试、停止决策与 CoT 审慎对证据筛选的作用；虽非视觉推理工作，方法线索较明确。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文构建开放框架，将7B扩散生成器适配为统一视觉感知模型，以RGB图像输出深度和多种分割，并系统诊断共享适配器下的任务竞争、权重合并与检查点选择。

**相关性简评：** 其生成式感知接口与训练诊断可供LVR核查：验证流损失与下游精度反相关、多样本集成改善尺度，可能提示生成似然不宜直接充当潜在推理状态或答案的验证器。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space

**abstract/A1：** Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to \\emph{open} generators, and if not, what fails? We answer with \\textbf{Open Vision Banana (OVB)}, an open framework that adapts the 7B diffusion generator of Qwen-Image-2.1 into one instruction-driven model for metric depth, semantic, instance, and referring segmentation, using a single shared low-rank adapter and public data. Each task is a \\emph{task contract} whose RGB encoder, instruction, and decoder share one specification and are checked before training. Studying 42 externally evaluated checkpoints from two 100k-update runs, six exact weight-space merges, and eight controlled shorter runs, we find that the gap to the closed system is specific and measurable. Geometry is learned early while absolute scale is not: median-aligned NYUv2 $δ\_1$ stays at 0.89--0.93 throughout training as unaligned $δ\_1$ wanders between 0.11 and 0.50. The scale is not committed by a single sample: a ten-seed ensemble lifts unaligned $δ\_1$ from 0.348 to 0.516 without retraining. Depth and 2D segmentation compete for the shared adapter, and weight merging moves along this trade-off without escaping it. Finally, lower validation flow loss comes with lower Cityscapes accuracy (Spearman $ρ\\approx-0.9$ between loss reduction and mIoU), so the loss cannot select checkpoints. We release code, contracts, training data, and all evaluation outputs.

</details>

### 100. [WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28553v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28553

**作者：** Xuan Yao、Jiahao Zhang、Rongjunchen Zhang、Kaixuan Huang、Junyu Gao、Changsheng Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28553v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28553v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** WorldWeave 研究 VLN 与 EVT 的跨任务世界模型，通过 inverse-forward dynamics 从状态变化中学习 latent action，并将未来状态预测融入任务特定表示以支持决策。

**相关性简评：** 其 latent action、共享预测动态与预测状态融合，可能为 LVR 的潜在状态更新、预测工作区及跨任务表示共享提供方法线索，可供核查未来预测是否真正参与决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Mobile embodied agents continuously alter their observations through their own motion, while external dynamics further shape future interactions. Different mobile embodied tasks therefore capture complementary patterns of state evolution, yet jointly learning world dynamics across such interactions remains less explored. We investigate this problem through Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) and Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), which respectively involve navigation toward a stationary goal and interaction with a moving target. We propose WorldWeave, a cross-task world model that couples shared predictive dynamics with task-specific adaptation. Instead of conditioning state transitions on heterogeneous physical actions, WorldWeave learns latent actions from observed state changes via inverse-forward dynamics, establishing a shared transition representation across tasks. The resulting future-state predictions are adaptively integrated into task-specific representations for downstream decision making. Experiments across multiple VLN and EVT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over specialized baselines.

</details>

### 101. [CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28591v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28591

**作者：** Lan Wei、Haosong Peng、Sicheng Tian、Tianyu Qi、Wenchao Xu、Lei Xue、Yufeng Zhan、Yuanqing Xia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28591v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28591v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文观察多视图 3D Transformer 中部分层的跨视角注意力分布相似，据此提出免训练框架 CAR3T：复用参考视图的注意力输出，并以离线风险校准加在线动态层选择，在保留全部 token 的前提下把选定层的注意力代价从二次降为线性。

**相关性简评：** 其「按输入决定哪些层可复用状态、并建模多次复用决策的累积漂移」可供核查 LVR 中跨深度 latent 缓存与复用、相似度阈值选择及误差累积问题，但原文面向 3D 重建而非推理，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction relies on global attention for cross-view aggregation, but the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views, making inference increasingly expensive for larger inputs. Existing acceleration methods compress tokens or sparsify attention, potentially losing geometric detail or restricting cross-view aggregation while leaving redundancy among attention outputs underexploited. We observe similar cross-view attention distributions in certain layers, revealing an opportunity to reduce repeated global aggregation through output reuse. However, the layers suitable for reuse vary with the input, and reusing one layer alters the features received by later layers. Similarity at individual layers therefore cannot characterize the combined effect of multiple reuse decisions on output drift. To address these challenges, we propose CAR3T, a training-free framework combining reference-view attention output reuse with offline risk calibration and online dynamic layer selection. Calibration models cumulative reuse risk, while online selection adapts reuse to each input under a calibrated budget. CAR3T retains all input tokens and attends to the keys and values of all views, reducing the core attention computation in selected layers from quadratic to linear. Experiments on VGGT, DA3, and $π^3$ show forward speedups up to $1.41\\times$ with at most 100 views and $1.75\\times$ on longer sequences, with accuracy trade-offs across backbones and datasets.

</details>

**title/T1：** Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience

**abstract/A1：** How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.
