### 137. [TouchBench: Can Vision-Language Models Feel Invisible Physical Properties?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26883v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26883

**作者：** Ziyao Zeng、Ziyi Kou、Chuan Qin、Mia Huang、Roger Boldu、Zhiwen Fan、Daniel Rakita、Eric Whitmire、Li Guan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26883v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26883v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TouchBench，一个头戴视频与 137 通道全手触觉同步的自中心多模态基准，把可由图像回答的问题（Tier A）与依赖相机外物理属性（Tier B）的问题区分开，并提出将触觉统计以文本提示注入 VLM 的 Tactile-as-Prompt。

**相关性简评：** 其 Tier B 诊断显示 VLM 在任务必要信息不在视觉输入时接近随机，且文本接口优于学习式触觉编码器，可供核查「视觉旁路」与任务必要证据如何进入推理状态的问题，但未涉及 latent 推理状态本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TouchBench: Can Vision-Language Models Feel Invisible Physical Properties?

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for embodied perception and reasoning, yet their physical understanding is largely evaluated on questions answerable from images. Many properties critical to manipulation, such as an opaque bottle's fill level or an object's compliance, may only be revealed through touch. We introduce TouchBench, an egocentric vision-language-tactile benchmark that distinguishes visually answerable questions (Tier A) from those involving properties hidden from the camera (Tier B). It pairs head-mounted video with synchronized 137-channel whole-hand tactile sensing, comprising 900 clips from five participants across 11 tasks, with 900 absolute and 4,102 relative questions. Four state-of-the-art VLMs average 66.4% accuracy on Tier A relative questions but only 49.8% on Tier B, near chance (50%). To bridge this gap, we propose Tactile-as-Prompt (TaP), which presents 34 interpretable tactile statistics as text, enabling VLMs to reason with touch without a learned tactile encoder. TaP raises zero-shot Tier B relative accuracy to 62.9% and reaches 73.1% after leave-one-user-out fine-tuning, outperforming video alone (67.4%) and a learned tactile-token encoder (67.3%). The gains extend to unseen objects and users. On a separate 20-hour in-the-wild corpus, tactile text improves fine-tuned contact-question accuracy from 67.1% to 75.5%. These results highlight the limits of vision-only physical reasoning and establish language as an effective interface for tactile perception.

</details>

### 138. [Looking Right Is Not Being Right: Evaluating the Geometry of Agent-Built 3D Scenes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26937v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26937

**作者：** Ziyang Long、Yen-Liang Lin、Shifan Zhu、Allen Tu、Meher Gitika Karumuri、Chenqi Li、Srikumar Sastry、Sarosij Bose、Mellon M. Zhang、Hsin-Jung Yang

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出以激光扫描为参照的几何评分（曲面、深度、家具布局，0–100 分），在 30 个真实房间上评测视觉语言智能体由视频构建可编辑 3D 场景的几何准确度，并分析几何输入的作用、智能体的自我核查与修订行为，以及一种对照输入点云的几何误差报告能否提升修订收益。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选和验证环节相关：结果显示渲染图自检主要改善外观而非几何，误差报告迫使智能体比对输入与已建场景后才提升修订增益，可供核查「看哪里」与「是否验证了任务必要几何信息」之间的差距。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Looking Right Is Not Being Right: Evaluating the Geometry of Agent-Built 3D Scenes

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language agents can reconstruct rooms from video as editable 3D scenes, but convincing renders do not establish geometric accuracy. We introduce a scan-referenced evaluation and use controlled experiments to study reconstruction accuracy, the role of geometric inputs, and agents' ability to verify and correct their scenes. Our geometric score measures surface, depth, and furniture placement agreement with laser scans of 30 real rooms on a 0-100 scale. The strongest tested agent, GPT-6 Astra, scores 51.4 from video alone, while a dense reconstruction from the same video scores 75.9. Given the point cloud used for that reconstruction, Astra produces an editable scene that scores within three points of it. Agents also inherit input errors: rescaling the supplied geometry changes scene scale almost proportionally. During revision, viewing renders improves appearance more consistently than geometry. Logs of their tool calls show that agents repeatedly measure their inputs but rarely compare them with the scenes they build. To provide this missing check, we introduce a geometric error report that compares each saved scene with the agent's input points and lists the largest discrepancies. Without new geometric evidence, the report raises the revision gains of GPT-6.1 Terra and Sol by 3.9 and 5.5 points over concurrent controls.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 6 figures. Project: https://github.com/Albertlongzi/looking-right-being-right

### 139. [Can Reasoning and Image Description Enhance Yes/No Visual Mathematical Understanding?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27302v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27302

**作者：** Guangcheng Song、Weichuan Wang、Linqi Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建成对的视觉数学是/否判断评测集，在多种 prompt 与输入条件下比较主流开源 VLM，考察 CoT 显式推理与文本图像描述（替代或补充视觉输入）能否提升判断准确性与配对一致性。

**相关性简评：** 其结果（推理有助稳定判断、文本描述常无效甚至有害）可供核查 LVR 中「视觉旁路」与信息坍缩：文本化中间表示是否丢掉了任务必要的视觉细节，以及推理期是否真正使用视觉证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Reasoning and Image Description Enhance Yes/No Visual Mathematical Understanding?

**abstract/A1：** Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general visual tasks, yet their ability to understand mathematical images remains limited. This paper investigates whether explicit reasoning and textual image descriptions can enhance VLMs' performance on binary yes/no visual mathematical questions. To achieve this, we curated a paired evaluation set to benchmark prominent open-source VLMs under varying prompt and input conditions. In particular, we leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and use textual descriptions, either replacing or augmenting visual inputs, to isolate and evaluate mathematical comprehension. Our results show that explicit reasoning improves performance, especially in paired consistency accuracy, while textual image descriptions do not consistently help and may degrade performance. These findings suggest that reasoning is important for stable visual mathematical judgement, whereas description-based intermediates require more careful design.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27381v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27381v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 VMSA 框架处理长视频问答：构建片段字幕、实体事件、实体感知片段三类互补外部视频记忆作为检索证据源，并从成功 agent 轨迹中归纳「记忆技能」，指导迭代式证据检索、推理与验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「选哪个记忆源、何时停止检索并验证」的决策与技能库式轨迹监督，可供核查与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 策略及证据筛选的联系，但推理状态仍为外部文本记忆而非 latent 表示，需读原文确认成本与跨间隔证据连接的实现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.

</details>

### 141. [AppCon-Bench: Perception and Misperception of Material Appearance in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27453v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27453

**作者：** Santiago Jimenez-Navarro、Ana Serrano、Belen Masia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27453v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27453v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 AppCon-Bench，包含五个任务，在受控的几何与光照变化下考察 VLM 能否对材质外观作出前后一致的判断，并与人类被试对比，分析系统性差异与共性。

**相关性简评：** 属于 VLM 感知诊断类基准，直接涉及「视觉细节与中层次属性是否被保留」这一表示问题，可供核查多视角、多光照下视觉证据不变性的失败模式；但其不含 latent 状态生成或推理期机制，与 LVR 的联系限于表示诊断层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AppCon-Bench: Perception and Misperception of Material Appearance in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Identifying the same material across changes in illumination or geometry is a critical ability for robust vision systems. Humans exhibit remarkable material appearance constancy, being able to recognize the intrinsic physical properties of an object's surface material across variations in extrinsic, confounding factors such as the lighting or the shape of such object. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong performance across a wide range of semantic vision tasks, yet their ability to interpret subtle mid-level perceptual attributes remains less understood. We introduce AppCon-Bench, a benchmark comprising five tasks designed to assess material appearance constancy under controlled variations in geometry and illumination, and evaluate representative VLMs alongside human observers, investigating their ability to maintain consistent material judgments across viewing conditions and experimental contexts. After thorough analysis, we identify several key findings that reveal both similarities and systematic differences between human and VLM material appearance perception, highlighting the value of evaluating perceptual successes and failures beyond overall accuracy and informing areas of improvement for current VLMs.

</details>

### 142. [Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27529v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27529

**作者：** Jee Eun Kim、Donghyeon Choi、Sangjune An、Hae Beom Lee、Kyong Hwan Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27529v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27529v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RoHa-SGG，用根因分析 agent 定位冻结 SGG 模型在哪些组件丢失真值三元组及原因，再由提议 agent 搜索推理代码（harness）修改，在 Visual Genome 和 PSG 上免训练提升多种 SGG 模型。

**相关性简评：** SGG 属结构化视觉关系推理，其跨模型/数据集的失败组件归因与推理期 harness 优化，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据保留、失败定位和外部计算分配提供诊断线索；但方法不涉及 latent 推理状态，需核查其根因分析能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation

**abstract/A1：** Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.

</details>

### 143. [MoHA: Model-Conditioned Harness Adaptation for Long-Video Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27646v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27646

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MoHA，将长视频理解 agent 的执行 harness 视为受模型条件约束的优化对象，依据失败校准轨迹诊断 planner 与 harness 的不匹配，并调整规划侧的概览、记忆、验证支持及观察侧的 OCR/ASR 等能力配置。

**相关性简评：** 其模型条件化的证据获取、验证与执行结构可供核查 planner-observer 分工如何影响 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本，但研究位于 agent 系统层而非 latent 推理，联系仍需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoHA: Model-Conditioned Harness Adaptation for Long-Video Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-video understanding increasingly relies on agentic systems that actively acquire evidence rather than process fixed video representations. Their execution harnesses must coordinate language-level planning with video-level observation and evidence acquisition, yet are typically fixed across model stacks. We therefore introduce MoHA, a framework for model-conditioned harness adaptation that adapts a common initial execution harness to the specific planner and observer models it hosts. MoHA treats the harness itself as a model-conditioned optimization object: under the same task distribution and initialization, different planner-observer stacks can benefit from different executable harnesses. Starting from a common initial harness, MoHA analyzes failed calibration traces to diagnose model-harness mismatches and adapts both planner-side reasoning support, such as overview, memory, and verification, and observer-side capability assignments, including OCR and ASR specialists. After structural adaptation, MoHA separately calibrates observer execution configurations for the hosted model stack. Across three frozen planner stacks, MoHA improves Video-MME Full accuracy by 6.2-27.1 percentage points and Video-Holmes accuracy by 3.1-20.1 points over the fixed initial harness. Cross-model transfer further shows that the adapted harnesses generalize only partially to other models, highlighting the harness as a model-conditioned optimization layer for long-video understanding. Code is available at https://github.com/roverx12345/MoHA.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/roverx12345/MoHA

</details>

### 144. [Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27741v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27741

**作者：** Yao Tong、Jiaxin Qi、Dingyu Zhang、Jianqiang Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27741v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27741v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PlayScriptBench，用于评估 VLM 能否依据游戏状态合成可执行的游戏控制程序，并给出 Explore、Perception、API Construction、Strategy Composition 四阶段分解流水线，在 16 款游戏上测试。

**相关性简评：** 该基准把逐步交互改为一次性合成可执行控制器，联合考察视觉 grounding、游戏动态理解与长程策略，可供核查 VLM 的视觉证据保留、推理状态能否沉淀复用以及逐步调用的计算成本与停止决策问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have endowed multimodal agents with increasingly strong visual perception and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, making VLM-based autonomous game playing feasible. Existing game benchmarks primarily evaluate whether an agent can select appropriate actions from the current visual state across different scenarios and games. However, most of them adopt a step-by-step interaction paradigm where the current visual observation is sent to the agent before each action. In practical deployment, this paradigm introduces two fundamental limitations: the game loop must wait for model inference, making real-time interaction impractical, and repeated VLM calls incur substantial cost. Therefore, we propose PlayScriptBench, a script-based game benchmark that evaluates whether VLMs can synthesize an executable game-playing program from game states. This setting jointly evaluates visual grounding, understanding of game dynamics, long-horizon strategic reasoning, and executable program synthesis, providing a more comprehensive assessment of game-playing agents. To support more tractable evaluation for current general-purpose VLMs, we further introduce a four-stage pipeline --- Explore, Perception, API Construction, and Strategy Composition --- that decomposes controller synthesis into game exploration, state perception, interface construction, and strategic control, enabling agents to progressively construct an executable program. Experiments on 16 games spanning 4 genres show that even strong VLMs struggle on our benchmark, revealing a substantial gap between passive visual game understanding and executable closed-loop game control. These results establish script-based controller synthesis as a complementary direction for benchmarking VLM-based game-playing agents.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages (main paper with appendix), 3 figures, 13 tables

</details>

### 145. [ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27858v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27858

**作者：** Jiyoon Pyo、Jacob Arndt、Yao-Yi Chiang、Dalton Lunga

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27858v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27858v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 ENC-QA，一个基于 NOAA 电子航海图的诊断基准，用约 7.7 万个问题评估 VLM 的细粒度要素识别、空间推理及结合证据判断更新严重性的能力。

**相关性简评：** 其递进式子集与证据干预直接考察模型是否利用感知和空间证据作出判断，可作为视觉细节保留与证据使用诊断的参考，但领域专属性较强，需核查题目设计能否迁移到 LVR 分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts

**abstract/A1：** Nautical charts encode safety-critical maritime information through standardized symbols, attributes, text, and heterogeneous geometries. Interpreting these charts and assessing the navigational significance of successive chart updates requires recognizing nautical features, determining their spatial relationships, and applying navigational knowledge. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to nautical-chart interpretation, yet systematic evaluation of their fine-grained nautical feature recognition, chart-based spatial reasoning, and application of navigational knowledge to assessing chart changes remains limited. We introduce ENC-QA, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 77,312 questions derived from 6,612 National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs). The benchmark evaluates four complementary capabilities: ENC Perception, Spatial Reasoning, Joint Perception and Spatial Reasoning, and Application. Of these, 8,227 questions form a progressive subset that decomposes selected chart-change cases into linked questions progressing from change detection to criticality assessment, enabling case-level analysis of how models use perceptual and spatial evidence to determine the navigational significance of chart changes. Evaluations of 10 open-weight VLMs reveal substantial limitations in fine-grained nautical feature recognition and feature-grounded spatial reasoning. Controlled evidence interventions show that relevant perceptual and spatial information improves change-criticality accuracy. Our findings establish ENC-QA as a diagnostic resource for nautical-chart understanding and safety-critical navigational decisions. We will release the benchmark and evaluation code upon publication.

</details>

### 146. [Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28176v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28176

**作者：** Yucheng Zhou、Junwei Sheng、Jianbing Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28176v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28176v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Med-Agentic：把医学视觉诊断中的 agentic 工具调用内化为带能力标签的结构化 CoT，使模型在一次前向中生成标签式「能力调用」，并用多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（以图像与当前标签为条件的 token 级双因子教师路由）训练。

**相关性简评：** 能力标签化 CoT 接近「何时 LOOK／何时推理」的显式调度，token 级教师路由为监督粒度与贡献分配提供可核查线索；但推理状态仍是文本 token，不涉及 latent 表示与动态计算，需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28592

**作者：** Chengyin Hu、Dehe Zhao、Dingyi Lu、Qike Zhang、Jiaju Han、Banglong Nong、Xu Kang、Jiujiang Guo、Kalibinuer Tiliwalidi、Jiahuan Long

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28592v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28592v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Fog Manipulation Attack（FMA），以零梯度方式优化一个共享的 3D 雾状态，同时破坏可见光与热红外的互补线索，使可见-红外 VLM 在双输入下同时出现语义失败，并迁移到 captioning 与 VQA。

**相关性简评：** 文中「跨模态补偿被消除」及恢复干净伴随视图可找回 64%–74% 答案的分析，为视觉证据在 VLM 答案中的实际作用提供了定量诊断线索，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留与证据使用；但属攻击/鲁棒性研究，未涉及 latent 推理状态本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Fog Becomes a Weapon: Atmospheric Attacks on Visible-Infrared Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Existing adversarial attacks on vision-language models (VLMs) and cross-spectral perception primarily rely on conspicuous, unnatural artifacts, such as vivid adversarial patches or active light beams, that lack physical stealthiness, whereas prior weather attacks largely overlook how one atmosphere simultaneously affects heterogeneous sensors. This raises a key scientific question: can a purely natural, shared fog environment simultaneously disrupt complementary visible and thermal infrared cues without artificial surface modifications? We introduce Fog Manipulation Attack (FMA), a zero-gradient attack that optimizes a common 3D fog state to induce simultaneous semantic failures in visible-infrared VLMs. FMA links shared, depth- and layer-aware atmospheric propagation along scene paths with band-specific imaging physics---visible airlight scattering and thermal path radiance---allowing one realistic fog state to erode both modalities' distinct cues. Experiments show that FMA more than doubles simultaneous failure rates over fidelity-matched random fog, transfers to captioning and VQA, and removes cross-modal compensation, where restoring a clean companion view recovers 64%--74% of lost dual-input VQA answers.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 8 figures. Supplementary material (23 pages) is available as an ancillary file

</details>

**作者：** Junyi Yang、Zheng Si、Yilin Zhai、Pengpeng Ouyang、Hongxi Wang、Kangze Li、Mo Chen、Sicong Zhang、Hua Wang、Dongyuan Wu、Dong Chen、Mingliang Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建了公路基础设施巡检的多模态基准 HighwayVerse，提出从异常检测、异常识别、状况分析到养护决策的 HIIP-Chain，并用以全链正确为准的 Final 指标评测 12 个 MLLM，另给出免训练检索增强框架 LaneRAG。

**相关性简评：** 其分阶段链式诊断与 Final 指标可供核查 MLLM 是否在后续阶段仍保留并使用前序视觉证据，与视觉细节保留和多步推理评价相关；但属特定巡检应用，未涉及 latent 状态生成，借鉴价值主要在评测设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HighwayVerse: A Chain-of-Inspection Benchmark for Highway Infrastructure Anomaly Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Practical highway infrastructure inspection entails progressive diagnostic reasoning from visual perception to maintenance decisions, yet existing benchmarks remain confined to isolated tasks, leaving Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) insufficiently evaluated across sequential inspection stages. Meanwhile, current datasets focus primarily on highway pavement defects, falling short of real-world inspection across diverse infrastructure components such as highway pavements, guardrails, glare screens, and drainage systems. To address these gaps, we formulate the Highway Infrastructure Inspection Progression Chain (HIIP-Chain), spanning Anomaly Detection, Anomaly Recognition, Condition Analysis, and Maintenance Resolution, and introduce HighwayVerse. HighwayVerse comprises 14,143 real-world Ground and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection records spanning 100 and 17 anomaly categories, respectively, with 84,858 expert-reviewed question-answer pairs. We evaluate 12 open-source and closed-source MLLMs using the chained metric Final, which credits a correct maintenance decision only when all preceding diagnostic stages are completed correctly. Results show that although models achieve relatively high accuracy when initially judging whether an anomaly is present, their markedly lower Final scores expose struggles across downstream recognition, analysis, and decision-making. This discrepancy indicates that current MLLMs do not fully comprehend specific highway anomaly patterns beyond superficial initial judgments. Furthermore, we propose LaneRAG, a training-free retrieval-augmented framework that provides hierarchical reference guidance achieving consistent performance improvements across diverse MLLMs. Our dataset, evaluation benchmark, and source code will be publicly released.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 CivilCADBench：基于真实土木工程图纸及源 CAD 文件（超过 25 万实体）构建基准，包含专家审校的理解问答，以及需要模型重建可编辑 CAD 文件、完成整套图纸与新设计的 agentic 任务，并用确定性打分器在几何、图层、文字和尺寸上与设计师源文件比对，评测七个前沿 MLLM。

**相关性简评：** 其核心发现——模型能准确读取与重绘打印内容，却难以恢复图层等文件组织结构——可作为多模态模型是否保留「像素中不存在但任务必需」结构信息的诊断线索；但该工作面向土木绘图域，未涉及 latent 状态生成或推理机制，故仅需按需查阅。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets

**abstract/A1：** Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. Unlike parametric 3D CAD models, these drawings are dense, layered, and multi-sheet; and since prints are lossy projections with no pixel trace of layers, a file can print correctly yet remain wrongly organised. CivilCADBench comprises three task families of increasing difficulty: understanding tasks are evaluated with 2,183 expert-reviewed questions ranging from single sheets to whole sets, while reconstruction and design tasks are agentic, requiring models to rebuild printed pages as editable CAD files, either as single pages or entire drawing sets, and to produce new designs. These tasks are performed across 232 pages, 28 sets, and 19 design tasks, and evaluated by a deterministic scorer that compares model outputs with the designers' source files on geometry, layers, text, and dimensions. We evaluate seven frontier MLLMs on CivilCADBench, and find that they read and redraw printed content accurately but recover the file structure poorly: the best model scores above 90% in understanding and single-page reconstruction, yet only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design. Grounded in real engineering practice, CivilCADBench exposes both the capabilities and the limitations of frontier models in professional civil engineering, laying a foundation for next-generation models and agentic systems for intelligent civil engineering.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://agenticivil.com/civilcadbench/

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OmniDecisionBench，将 45 个数据集（192,975 条记录）按五种能力族、十二个评测角度和四种 typed 接口组织，同时评分为准确率与候选概率校准；验证层还单因子改变视觉呈现、文本证据充分性和目标数据集，用于比较 System One 模型与通用 VLM 的能力边界。

**相关性简评：** 其 selective risk、ECE 校准与「仅渲染选项」等证据充分性诊断，可能为 LVR 中「何时 STOP/是否弃答」及视觉证据筛选的评价提供现成切面；但论文不涉及 latent 内部状态，与表示和状态更新的联系需读原文核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal System One models answer visual tasks with typed decisions and native probabilities, yet no holistic evaluation compares them with general VLMs or maps either class's capability boundaries. We introduce OmniDecisionBench, a holistic benchmark of multimodal System One models. Its main evaluation assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration. A validation layer adds three single-factor diagnostics varying visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency, and target dataset. Across three System One models and two general VLMs, three regularities emerge. First, strengths depend on angle and metric: System One models lead discrete tasks overall with lower ECE15 on most perception, reading, and reasoning angles (Jev 1.14: 80.14% accuracy, 4.50% ECE15), while general VLMs lead ordinal grading and outperform Jev 1.14 among the three models tested on direct Box grounding. Second, multi-image and abstract reasoning bound every model, where confidence rather than accuracy separates them. Third, reliability shifts with the input: rendering only options nearly triples Jev 1.14's selective risk at nearly flat mean signed bias, and donor risk cutoffs often exceed target risk across unseen datasets and task families. OmniDecisionBench thus maps which model class suits each angle and where reliability ends. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/Glax147/OmniDecisionBench.

</details>

### 151. [Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28997v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28997

**作者：** Anay Sinhal、Amit Sinhal、Arpana Sinhal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28997v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28997v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在结直肠组织病理九分类零样本任务上，仅改变请求的输出格式（九类概率分布 vs. top-3 排序），在验证集与外部中心评估 MedGemma-27b-it，发现准确率下降约 14 点，主因是「禁止评论、推理与给出选定答案」的指令，并比较了首 token logit 熵与陈述式置信度在选择性预测中的路由效果。

**相关性简评：** 该诊断显示「禁止推理/禁止作答」的显式约束会改变 VLM 判断，且内部 logits 信号优于文本化置信度，可供核查 LVR 中答案约束、停止决策与置信信号选择的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology

**abstract/A1：** Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 \[-0.1594, -0.1353\], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 \[-0.1484, -0.1196\], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 \[+0.1623, +0.2134\] and +0.1911 \[+0.1648, +0.2181\], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 \[-0.0300, +0.0280\] and -0.0214 \[-0.0494, +0.0071\]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 \[+0.1722, +0.1974\] versus +0.0493 \[+0.0377, +0.0649\] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 6 figures; Supplementary Table S1 and Supplementary Material S2 in ancillary files. Corrects one result reported in the companion preprint "Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches" (Sinhal et al., arXiv, 2026)

</details>

### 152. [MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29154v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29154

**作者：** Kewei Wei、XueXiang Wen、Bocheng Hu、Weili Xu、Haiyang Yu、Kaiyue Zhou、Gaoang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29154v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29154v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 MVAgent 框架，为每个视频配置一个负责本视频观测规划与私有历史记录的 LocalAgent，再由 GlobalAgent 指令各 LocalAgent 并将报告与联合观测结合，完成跨视频推理；在 CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid 上以多种 Qwen3.5 与 GPT-6-sol 验证其准确率与速度收益。

**相关性简评：** 将观测决策与跨视频判断分离，并以私有观测历史约束证据，可为 LVR 中「何时看、看什么、如何筛选视觉证据并决定停止」的 LOOK/STOP 分工提供参照，但其推理仍以文本报告为中介，未涉及 latent 状态，具体成本与停止机制需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

</details>

### 153. [Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29167v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29167

**作者：** Chenyu Wang、Mingyu Chen、Wenchao Li、Kayhan Batmanghelich

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29167v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29167v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文把 3D 胸部 CT 报告生成重构为 LLM agent 协调的一组视觉问答决策：用 JEPA 式视觉-语言联合嵌入预测训练判别式（非生成）感知模块，完成报告检索、病灶识别与细粒度属性刻画，再由 RL 训练的 agent 主动获取患者视觉证据，并交由独立编辑器成文。

**相关性简评：** 与「视觉证据筛选」及把感知与推理/生成解耦的关注直接相关；可供核查 agent 的查询与证据取舍是否真正决定最终结论（而非装饰性调用）、判别式感知的 amortized 成本是否成立，以及证据以何种形式进入 LLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation

**abstract/A1：** Chest CT reports repeatedly assess the same anatomical regions for findings and their attributes, such as whether a lung nodule is present and where it is located. These assessments suggest learning to answer visual questions directly, rather than coupling perception to open-ended text generation. Yet current CT report generation models largely follow generic vision-language modeling, which may miss subtle abnormalities when training data are limited. We therefore formulate report generation as a set of visual question-answering decisions coordinated by a large language model (LLM) agent. This decouples visual perception from reasoning and report writing: perception can be learned as a discriminative, non-generative task, while the LLM focuses on reasoning over patient context and posing relevant visual queries. We introduce Rad-VL-JEPA, which unifies report retrieval, finding recognition, and fine-grained attribute characterization through vision-language joint-embedding prediction. Building on this perception module, an agent trained with reinforcement learning (RL) acquires patient-specific visual evidence, while a separate editor incorporates the evidence into the final report, further separating evidence acquisition from report realization. Experiments show that Rad-VL-JEPA achieves strong performance on fine-grained CT understanding tasks with lower amortized per-query inference time than a generative VLM baseline trained with the same CT encoder and VQA data. The resulting reporting system outperforms strong VLM-based and agentic baselines.

</details>

### 154. [CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29305v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29305

**作者：** Yibing Fu、Huidong Xie、Yihao Niu、Wei Ji、Heming Dong、Ziyue Wang、Jingyu Chen、Jun Zhao、Haoyuan Hu、Hongming Shan、Lai Jiang、Mai Xu、Yueming Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29305v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29305v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 CT-Navigator，让通用 MLLM 借助 2D 视觉与工具调用能力，在 3D CT 解读中逐层探索切片、调用放射科工具并给出可追溯的视觉证据，用 8904 条视觉思维链轨迹冷启动、再以 RL 优化策略，并发布 CTNavi-Bench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其分层视觉探索与工具调用是显式版的「看哪里、取什么证据」，可作为 latent 视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策的对照；V-CoT 轨迹与信息量优先的 rollout 采样也提供证据监督线索，但未涉及内部 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation

**abstract/A1：** Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \\textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \\textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \\href{https://github.com/fyb99/ct\_navigator}{GitHub}.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断 VLM 描述中对象级视觉细节的流失与「典型化」偏差，与视觉细节保留、信息坍缩问题相关；其「描述→重建→比对」探针可能可供核查 latent 状态中任务必要信息保留程度的评测设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Polytropos: What Do Vision-Language Model Descriptions Make of a Cultural Object?

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models have become a new kind of describer, writing about almost anything people see, and their descriptions now shape how cultures are known by people and by other models. Descriptions of cultures tend to turn particular things into types, and what a description loses shows what its describer lacks. We introduce Polytropos, a benchmark that measures what model descriptions of cultural objects keep of the particular object by turning each description back into an image and comparing it with the original photograph. On 374 objects from the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Getty, with 1,870 descriptions from five models and 230 written by curators, reconstructions are recognised as the recorded culture more often than the photographs, at 54.55% to 59.09% against 52.14%, yet 16% to 21% of objects change outcome and only 0.49% of reconstructions are identified as the specific object. On the same objects, models lose recorded cultures at a rate similar to curators but gain more. Model descriptions give each object many faces, each typical of its culture and almost none the object itself.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 GRPO 虽提升胸片报告的语言与临床准确性，却对异常识别的视觉表征改善有限，因而提出选择性区域视觉蒸馏：用区域监督训练教师模型，以区域特征替换逐一核验教师特征是否有用，再用空间门控残差适配器只蒸馏已验证特征。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「VLM 内部状态是否保留任务必要的视觉细节」，其「特征替换核验 + 门控适配以少干扰原表征」可供核查 latent 视觉证据筛选与旧能力保持问题；但无推理期状态生成，跨任务可迁移性仍待阅读全文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation

**abstract/A1：** Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.

</details>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities

**abstract/A1：** Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MORSE：以训练轨迹中反复出现的失败为线索，在线检索论文、模型卡和代码，自动修订流式视频系统的记忆 harness（证据保留与检索方式，并可引入预训练感知模型），再在冻结 VLM 上按答案质量与延迟逐级筛选修订。

**相关性简评：** 「有限帧存储下单遍决定保留何种证据」及按失败原因筛选、检索证据的循环，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选和获取证据决策有直接交集，可供核查；但其优化对象是外部 streaming memory harness 而非模型内部 latent 状态，机制迁移性需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research

**abstract/A1：** A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://zhangce01.github.io/morse/

</details>

**作者：** Seongrae Noh、SeongEun Hong、HyeongYeop Kang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30096v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文揭示视觉决策模型对选项分组存在概率不一致：「A 或 B」的概率低于 A 与 B 之和，并提出 CORE 通过重新分组选项、训练各组概率汇总回原选项分布来提升一致性，且不降低准确率。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及 VLM 答案概率与决策评价；其分组边缘化一致性可供核查多假设或证据汇总时的概率使用，但未触及内部 latent 状态或推理轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question about an image with one probability per option, and software uses them directly. We show that the probabilities depend on how the options are grouped: a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B. This under-additivity appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and remains after fine-tuning on labels. We propose CORE, which asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers to all these questions toward one target distribution over the original options, summed into each question's groups. On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces the total variation distance between the answer to a regrouped question and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same questions. At all five model sizes, CORE reduces this distance without lowering accuracy.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://seongraenoh.github.io/core/

</details>

### 160. [Could This BE Any More Wrong? Teaching VLMs to Know What They Don't Know in Document Extraction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30119v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30119

**作者：** Varad Srivastava、Victor Casas Hernandez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30119v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30119v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 VLM 在扫描金融文档结构化抽取中无法提示字段错误的问题，提出把已有 token logprob 对齐到 JSON 中每个字段跨度以获得逐字段置信度，并用高不确定字段构造 GRPO 课程微调，同时以模型作伪标注判官。

**相关性简评：** 逐字段置信度与基于拒绝曲线的评估为「STOP」何时停止或弃答提供了可核查的廉价信号，但该方法不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用，需核实其最小值 token 概率能否迁移到推理型多模态任务。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Could This BE Any More Wrong? Teaching VLMs to Know What They Don't Know in Document Extraction

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models can extract structured fields from scanned financial documents, yet they provide no indication of when a field might be wrong. We derive per-field confidence estimates from the token log-probabilities the model already produces, via a token-to-span alignment procedure that maps logprobs onto each extracted value within the structured JSON output. Evaluated on two benchmarks (CORD v2 receipts, Kleister NDA legal contracts) with three VLM families, the minimum token probability per field achieves Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) 0.74-0.91 for error detection, far exceeding verbalized confidence (0.53-0.56). The uncertain fields form a natural training curriculum: fine-tuning via Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves accuracy from 78.5% to 87.5% on CORD (67 examples) and from 70.7% to 75.1% on multi-page NDA contracts (259 examples), while substantially improving error detection on Kleister NDA (AUROC 0.70 to 0.85, Area Under the Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC) 0.78 to 0.92). The loop requires no annotation beyond the training-split ground truth, demonstrating that confidence-guided curriculum selection transfers to complex multi-page documents when combined with native multi-image training. A frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4) used as a pseudo-label judge achieves ~92% reward agreement with ground truth on both benchmarks, suggesting this loop can operate without human annotation.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the AI4Finance Summit at ICAIF '26 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance), Milan, Italy. An extended version with a revised experimental protocol will follow

</details>

### 161. [OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30161v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30161

**作者：** Bao Quoc Trinh、Tin Van Huynh、Kiet Van Nguyen、Ngan Luu-Thuy Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30161v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30161v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建首个大规模原生越南语视觉蕴涵基准 OpenViVE（62,268 个图文假设对，来自 10,378 张具文化背景的图像），用 LLM 与人工结合的流程减少仅凭文本假设的捷径，并评测带双向 co-attention 的 PhoBERT-ConvNeXt 双流模型。

**相关性简评：** 其中「Contradiction 准确率由 96% 降至 66%」的捷径削减诊断与 LVR 关注的视觉证据是否真被使用、视觉旁路问题直接相关；但该任务是单步分类而非 latent 状态推理，co-attention 融合对推理期状态生成的借鉴有限，主要价值在证据依赖评测可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment

**abstract/A1：** Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.

</details>

### 162. [PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30235v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30235

**作者：** Kanghui Tian、Shuai Dong、Yuhan Zhu、Congcong Wang、Ji Zhao、Tianxiang Jiang、Zhixiong Zhang、Shengyuan Ding、Yi Wang、Jiaqi Wang、Yu Qiao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30235v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30235v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PixelOne 研究 GUI grounding 中的高精度低延迟点击定位：把先选行列、再逐级放大候选区域的搜索式 teacher 的空间知识，通过空间蒸馏与框监督迁移给学生，使其在原生分辨率截图上一次前向完成「决策头选视觉 token + 轻量像素头框内定坐标」。

**相关性简评：** 与「视觉细节在小控件定位中是否被下采样抹掉」及「以单次前向替代迭代放大（LOOK）的计算成本取舍」直接相关，可供核查其空间蒸馏是否真能保留搜索式证据筛选的收益，以及固定分箱与原生分辨率的失配分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding

**abstract/A1：** GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

</details>

### 163. [Object-Centric Differentiable Logic Networks for Abstract Visual Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30736v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30736

**作者：** Hanne Say Eren、Ana Ezquerro、Ozan Özdenizci

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30736v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30736v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Slot-Dwn，将无监督对象中心感知与基于查找表的多头可微无权重网络结合，在布尔空间中完成符号逻辑推理，并在抽象视觉推理基准上测试规则泛化、小样本异常检测与多关系推理。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉关系推理、OOD 泛化和表示中任务必要信息是否保留直接相关，但其可微逻辑/LUT 关系瓶颈是否构成 LVR 意义上的 latent 推理状态（而非显式符号计算）尚待核查，可作 P2 阅读。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Object-Centric Differentiable Logic Networks for Abstract Visual Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Human visual intelligence enables efficient reasoning capabilities on abstract visual problems with bounded cognitive resources and minimal experience, and yields remarkable generalization to novel problems with its ability to draw relational analogies and modular abstractions. In contrast, deep learning models require exhaustive task-specific training on large datasets, making them prone to exploiting visual shortcuts and resulting in poor generalization. While neuro-symbolic approaches attempt to bridge this gap by decoupling perception from reasoning with dedicated computation units, existing solutions rely either on explicit rule supervision or parameter-heavy transformer architectures that reintroduce the computational inefficiencies they aim to solve. We introduce Slot-Dwn to address these limitations, a novel neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies unsupervised object-centric perception with logic-based symbolic reasoning. Our model utilizes a Multi-Head Differentiable Weightless Network (MH-DWN) that performs efficient reasoning entirely in Boolean space using look-up tables (LUTs). Our framework reduces visual perception complexity and introduces a LUT-based relational bottleneck with sparse input routing to minimize computational overhead. We evaluate Slot-Dwn across various abstract visual reasoning benchmark tasks targeting systematic rule generalization, sample-efficient anomaly detection, and multi-relational reasoning. We demonstrate that Slot-Dwn yields competitive performance with respect to the state-of-the-art, under extreme out-of-distribution regimes, while requiring up to 52% fewer trainable parameters, with significantly faster convergence.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建了面向 360° 全景视频的 OmniV-Bench，含 4,123 段 ODV 与 8,923 条人工标注 QA，覆盖通用、空间和时空理解共 11 项任务，并配套提出采用视角引导证据初始化与自适应工具调用的 agentic harness 来提升 MLLM 的沉浸式时空推理。

**相关性简评：** 论文对 MLLM 时空理解的诊断与「视角引导证据初始化 + 任务相关证据获取」的可核查线索，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、主动 LOOK 及证据使用问题相关；但其证据获取发生在视频输入与工具调用层面，是否涉及内部 latent 状态的保留与利用仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?

**abstract/A1：** Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

</details>

**作者：** Safal Thapaliya、Jiatan Huang、Debapriya Chatterjee、Yanfang Ye、Chuxu Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31068v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31068v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UMAMI 多模态数据集与基准，将食物图像与营养档案、个体摄入记录关联，并设计视觉营养问答、个性化推荐和情境感知替代三项诊断任务，用配对样本和输入控制检验视觉身份与用户情境对决策的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其区分食物记录选择错误与营养规则应用错误，并检验「遵守规则未必对齐真实摄入」，可为 VLM 如何筛选并真正使用视觉与结构化证据提供评测思路；但属特定应用领域，与 latent 推理状态生成机制联系有限，任务设计能否迁移仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions

**abstract/A1：** Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at https://umami-benchmark.github.io.

**comment/C1：** 40 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables. Dataset, code, and dashboard: https://umami-benchmark.github.io

### 166. [Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31238v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31238

**作者：** Zihang Lin、Huaiyuan Qin、Liangli Zhen、Qing Guo、Jun Liu、Yew-Soon Ong、Hongyuan Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31238v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31238v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 发现自监督 ViT 在纯白噪声上特征仍会形成空间连贯的「幻想性」子空间，该子空间主导 DINOv2/v3 的特征方差并抑制物体涌现，据此提出无需训练的 PSC 校准来缩放这些方向。

**相关性简评：** 对内部视觉状态中真实内容与模型自生成空间结构的分离、以及视觉证据筛选有直接参考，并提示 latent 相似度分析可能被此类子空间混淆；但未涉及推理过程或多模态生成，具体联系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic

**abstract/A1：** In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26702

**作者：** Zibin Geng、Yitong Bao、Jia Li、Xuefeng Jiang、Sheng Sun、Yuwei Wang、Min Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26702v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26702v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 SACP，将含噪标签的 prompt learning 视为生成过程，把潜在干净标签预测与实例相关的标注生成解耦，用冻结 VLM 语义先验加轻量视觉残差构造标注通道，并以广义 EM 的软后验优化，另设后验感知记忆在测试时保留标签不确定性。

**相关性简评：** 其以软后验建模潜在干净状态、并按实例保留不确定性的做法，或可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 假设的加权与视觉证据可信度估计；但任务限于分类标签噪声，与推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Model the Annotation, Not the Noise: Semantic Annotation-Channel Prompt Learning against Noisy Labels

**abstract/A1：** Parameter-efficient prompt learning has become a cornerstone for adapting pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), yet it remains highly vulnerable to label noise in few-shot Web and retrieval scenarios. Existing noise robust methods typically rely on hard sample selection or deterministic label correction, which discard valuable semantic ambiguity and overlook how observed annotations are actually generated. To bridge this gap, we reformulate noisy prompt learning through the perspective of data generation, proposing SACP, a Semantic-aware Annotation Channel-based Prompt learning framework. Instead of suppressing noise heuristically, SACP decouples latent clean-label prediction from instance-dependent annotation generation. By integrating frozen VLM semantic priors with lightweight visual residuals, SACP constructs a structured annotation channel optimized via generalized expectation-maximization with soft posteriors. Furthermore, a posterior-aware memory is introduced to preserve label uncertainty during test-time inference. Extensive experiments across different synthetic benchmarks and the real-world noisy Food101N dataset demonstrate that SACP achieves state-of-the-art performance against its counterparts in different label noise patterns, especially under severe asymmetric noise.

</details>

**作者：** Bao Pham

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26797v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26797v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文（学位论文）以能量模型与联想记忆为框架，论证扩散模型（含 uniform-state 离散扩散语言模型）可视为联想记忆：训练样本周围形成吸引盆，数据增多时盆地收缩并出现混合样本的「伪态」，作者跨数据集与架构（含 Stable Diffusion）测量盆地的体积、能量与曲率，并用条件熵诊断记忆与泛化的共存。

**相关性简评：** 其吸引子动力学与盆地几何描述状态如何被检索和稳定，可能为 latent 推理状态的更新与「记忆还是新生成」判别提供分析工具，条件熵式诊断也可供核查是否能用于停止决策；但该文无视觉语言推理实验，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Memorization and Generalization in Generative Models: A Perspective From Energy-based Modeling and Associative Memory

**abstract/A1：** Generative models now write working code, produce realistic images, and hold long conversations, yet the mechanisms behind their intelligence still evade our understanding. This thesis explores that puzzle through Associative Memory (AM), in which patterns are stored as energy minima and retrieved through attractor dynamics. Beyond their capacity, AMs form new minima known as spurious states, long regarded as a failure of memory. We argue that this failure is where creativity begins, and that memorization and generalization can coexist as outcomes of one retrieval process. First, we show that diffusion models behave as AMs. With little data, a diffusion model forms a distinct basin of attraction around each training sample. As the data grows, these basins shrink, and spurious states emerge as attractors that blend stored samples yet match none of them. They are the first signs of generative capability. We characterize this transition by measuring the volume, energy, and curvature of these basins across datasets and architectures, including Stable Diffusion. We then turn to language and move beyond the energy-based view of AM. We show that uniform-state discrete diffusion models are AMs capable of retrieving unseen data, with basins of attraction that arise from conditional likelihood maximization alone. As the training set grows, basins around training examples contract while basins around unseen examples expand, until corrupted test sentences are recovered as reliably as training ones. Conditional entropy exposes this coexistence within a single sequence and cheaply diagnoses where a model lies along the transition. Together, these results suggest that AM is a general principle defined by basins of attraction, and that memorization and generalization can coexist within one model. AM thus offers a framework for asking when a generative model recalls and when it creates.

**comment/C1：** A thesis that discusses the coexistence of memorization and generalization in generative models

</details>

### 169. [Don't Discard Your Rollouts: Reusing Teacher RL Traces for Student Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26803v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26803

**作者：** Vashisth Tiwari、Emma Strubell、J. Zico Kolter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26803v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26803v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究如何复用教师模型 RL 训练中已采样但被常规蒸馏丢弃的 rollout：把复用视为数据选择问题，按 prompt 通过率排序，先用易题做 SFT 热启动、再用混合成败题做 DPO，并用教师 log-likelihood 筛选与学生兼容的 completion，在数学与代码任务上接近标准蒸馏效果。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 RL 蒸馏，与视觉无关；但其「按难度与师生兼容性筛选轨迹、再分阶段监督」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中推理轨迹训练、监督信号分配与低质量轨迹剔除的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Don't Discard Your Rollouts: Reusing Teacher RL Traces for Student Distillation

**abstract/A1：** RL post-training methods such as PPO and GRPO are computationally expensive, with substantial resources devoted to sampling rollouts, which contain multiple completions per prompt along with their respective rewards. Canonical distillation, however, discards these traces and uses more compute to regenerate data from the final teacher. We ask if and how we can reuse the saved teacher RL rollouts to distil student models. Reusing rollouts is non-trivial: naive SFT on the rollouts underperforms canonical distillation, and naive DPO, while performant, is unstable, collapsing on weaker students. We show that treating rollout reuse as a data selection problem using metadata already recorded during GRPO substantially reduces this gap. We use prompt pass rates to order the data, using the easiest prompts for an SFT warm start prior to using mixed-success prompts for DPO. For each prompt, we use saved teacher log-likelihoods as a proxy for selecting student-compatible completions. Across mathematical reasoning and Python coding tasks, with students from multiple model families, our two-stage recipe achieves comparable average performance to canonical distillation, while incurring no additional inference cost for dataset construction.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**title/T1：** NitroGen: Observations on the Action Dynamics, Visual Instruction Following, and Spatial Exploration

**abstract/A1：** NitroGen is an open vision-action foundation model for game control. It is trained by behavior cloning on online gameplay videos. In this paper, we study the frozen controller in Hollow Knight and Trackmania as examples along three dimensions: action adaptation, visual instruction following, and spatial exploration. Our results indicate that NitroGen can adapt its actions to local context, but it lacks the planning, recovery, and exploration needed for longer-horizon game control.

### 171. [Self-Supervised Learning with Recursive Quadrature Filters for Neural Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26856

**作者：** Mirko Morello、Shivang Rawat、David J. Heeger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SP、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26856v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出用预测误差自监督训练递归正交滤波（RQF）编码器：窗口模式下由当前窗摘要预测后续窗摘要，密集模式下由当前状态预测未来对数功率，再在冻结或微调编码器上训练读出层，并在四个 EEG 基准上以极小参数量接近 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 其「当前隐状态预测自身未来活动」的自监督目标与对角 SSM 状态更新，可供核查 LVR 中潜在推理状态的轨迹式监督与状态可预测性设计；但与视觉推理主线无直接关联，迁移仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Supervised Learning with Recursive Quadrature Filters for Neural Time Series

**abstract/A1：** We develop self-supervised methods for training Recursive Quadrature Filter (RQF) encoders on unlabeled time series. RQFs are biologically motivated, complex-valued temporal filters that form a special class of diagonal state-space models (SSMs). Each RQF acts as a band-pass filter whose selectivity is determined by two learnable parameters: its tuning frequency and bandwidth. We separately introduce a self-supervised learning objective based on prediction error; the encoder is trained so that its current state predicts its own future activity. In the windowed mode, the summary of the current window predicts the summary of a later window; in the dense mode, the state at the current timestep predicts future log-power. Each RQF encoder is pretrained on a dataset and then a readout (e.g., a task-specific classifier) is trained on the output of the RQF encoder, with the encoder either frozen or fully fine-tuned. For multichannel EEG and intracranial recordings, a shared encoder processes each channel separately, and a spatial readout combines the channel representations using electrode locations. Across four neural benchmarks using scalp or intracranial EEG, the pretrained RQF system performs close to the state of the art while using a small fraction of the parameters of the competing models. For example, a 110k-parameter RQF system achieves 0.9247 +/- 0.0022 test AUROC on 100-s TUAB segments, above SAMBA (0.9054) at the same context with 9 times as many parameters, and 0.9040 +/- 0.0019 on 10-s segments, comparable to EEG foundation models with 3.2M-369M parameters.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for the Brain and Body. Code: https://github.com/Sequel-Institute/rqf-ssl

</details>

### 172. [FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26865v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26865

**作者：** John J. Han、Adam Schmidt、Jingpei Lu、Zooey He、Muhammad Abdullah Jamal、Jie Ying Wu、Omid Mohareri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26865v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26865v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对外科机器人模仿学习示范稀缺的问题，FlowScope 用 1149 台手术的立体视频无监督预训练 ACT 主干，任务是预测由现成深度与光流模型算出的场景流（场景点的度量 3D 运动），预训练后丢弃流预测头，部署时仍是标准 ACT、无额外推理开销。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及 LVR 或 VLM 推理，但其「预测度量 3D 运动」这一视觉预训练目标与 2D 轨迹、单深度、无尺度流的消融对比，以及深度探针分析，可能为 LVR 中内部状态如何保留任务必需的几何信息提供可供核查的训练侧线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies

**abstract/A1：** Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

</details>
