### 277. [ReSUL: Learning Regional Sensor Utility for Robust Multisensor Semantic Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28084v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28084

**作者：** Yiwen Wang、Jiahao Qin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28084v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28084v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ReSUL 研究多传感器语义分割在传感器错位或损坏时的鲁棒性：路由器预测全传感器、排除与重配准三条路径相对固定参考的类别平衡 Brier 风险降幅，据此分配区域空间混合权重，在 MFNet 多种扰动条件下多数领先。

**相关性简评：** 以反事实路径的任务风险降幅监督「何处保留、何处排除」视觉证据，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供线索，但需核查其区域路由与推理期 latent 状态的联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReSUL: Learning Regional Sensor Utility for Robust Multisensor Semantic Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** A corrupted sensor observation is not necessarily useless: misalignment can place informative scene structure at the wrong location. Robust multisensor segmentation must determine where to retain this evidence, where to exclude it, and where repair can recover its value. We introduce Regional Sensor Utility Learning (ReSUL), which learns these choices through their effect on segmentation risk. ReSUL compares full-sensor predictions, sensor-exclusion paths, and a re-registration path for displaced thermal inputs. A router predicts each path's signed reduction in category-balanced Brier risk relative to a fixed reference, then uses these estimates to allocate spatial mixture weights. This supervision connects spatial allocation to measurable task benefit without requiring fault labels at inference. MFNet experiments compare project-trained models under eleven clean and disturbed input conditions. ReSUL ranks first in 10 of 11 conditions in both ImageNet-1k and ImageNet-22k comparisons. Under severe thermal displacement, it reaches 54.58% and 55.63% mIoU, exceeding the strongest competing method in each group by 7.19 and 5.63 percentage points. Fixed-bank MFNet ablations show that utility supervision improves all eleven condition means over task-only routing. These results support learning how to use disturbed observations through their regional prediction benefit. Code is available at https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/ReSUL.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 278. [Efficient Memory-Constrained Video Object Segmentation via Subspace Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28087v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28087

**作者：** Hai-Anh Le、Le-Trung Nguyen、Enzo Tartaglione

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28087v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28087v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对基于记忆库的视频目标分割，发现连续帧记忆特征存在稳定的低维子空间冗余，提出免训练、模型无关的 MSI 插件，用子空间迭代压缩流式记忆特征，在多种架构上减少约 25% 记忆占用并保持分割精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「视觉记忆特征低秩子空间随时间去冗余」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中跨步视觉证据缓存的压缩与视觉细节保留之间的权衡，但原文面向分割而非推理，是否适用需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient Memory-Constrained Video Object Segmentation via Subspace Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Memory-based architectures for video object segmentation (VOS) have achieved remarkable performance by maintaining dense feature representations from past frames in a streaming Memory Bank. However, storing these features over time incurs substantial memory overhead and computational cost. In this work, we identify significant temporal redundancy in memory representations, where consecutive frames exhibit highly overlapping low-rank subspaces that remain stable over time. Building on this observation, we propose Memory Subspace Iteration (MSI), a training-free, model-agnostic plugin that exploits temporal subspace stability to efficiently compress streaming memory features. Extensive experiments on standard VOS benchmarks demonstrate that MSI preserves segmentation accuracy across multiple architectures while reducing the memory bank footprint by up to 25%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Hai-Anh-LE/MSI\_WACV2027.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向第一视角人体活动识别，提出教师引导的多模态双表征重构预训练框架：用冻结的、可见标签的视频教师与惯性教师分别向多模态学生提供密集的模态专属目标，学生在时间稀疏输入上训练，稀疏视频帧下收益更明显。

**相关性简评：** 其用模态专属教师目标替代单一融合监督，可能为 LVR 中融合表征如何保留视觉与运动等互补信息、避免信息坍缩提供可核查的监督设计线索，但论文本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teacher-Guided Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction for Egocentric Human Activity Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Egocentric Human Activity Recognition (Ego-HAR) leverages complementary cues from first-person vision (V) and inertial sensor data (S) to recognize daily activities, where video mainly captures appearance and object-related context while inertial signals capture motion cues that video may miss. However, existing pre-training methods typically supervise the fused representation with a single joint objective, which may underemphasize the complementarity between the two modalities and limit the model's ability to learn from distinct modality-oriented signals. To address this issue, we propose Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction (MDR2), a teacher-guided pre-training framework in which frozen, label-informed video and inertial teachers each provide dense, modality-specific targets to a multimodal student trained on temporally sparse inputs. On the EvIs-Kitchen dataset, MDR2 improves noun/verb F1-macro over the supervised M-Baseline by 9.20/6.17 points at K=4 video key frames and by 1.21/1.82 points at K=32. These results show that MDR2 consistently achieves higher mean recognition performance across the evaluated video-observation settings under the unified backbone setting, with more pronounced gains under sparse inputs.

</details>

### 280. [Scale-Aware Reference Attention for Mannequin-to-Model Gown Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28101v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28101

**作者：** Guang Yang、Fengchen Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28101v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28101v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SARA：把输出目标与每张参考图的缩放级别输入开放 diffusion transformer，使输出注意力偏向同尺度参考，并用织物微距照片作参考、以整衣与放大目标混合训练；同时发布 Kiss3000 数据集与不依赖像素对齐的 zoom-crop 评测协议。

**相关性简评：** 按显式尺度元信息调制参考注意力、偏好同尺度参考的做法，可能为 LVR 中多尺度视觉证据筛选与注意力路由提供线索；其放大裁切加 VLM 判官评价局部保真的协议也供核查，但任务属图像生成，迁移性需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scale-Aware Reference Attention for Mannequin-to-Model Gown Generation

**abstract/A1：** Formal gowns are sold online with photos of models wearing them, and buyers zoom in to inspect sequins, lace and beading. Image editors can turn a photo of a gown on a mannequin into a convincing photo of a person wearing it, but they receive every reference photo without any notion of its magnification, and the fine detail of the gown is lost when the output is viewed up close. We propose scale-aware reference attention (SARA), which tells an open diffusion transformer the zoom level of the output and of every reference photo, biases the attention of the output toward references of a similar zoom level, uses macro photos of the fabric as references, and is trained on a mix of whole-garment and zoomed targets. To train and evaluate it, we introduce Kiss3000, a dataset of 915 high-resolution mannequin photos and 2274 on-model photos of formal gowns with cross-domain pairs and splits by style, and zoom-crop evaluation, which compares garment crops at full, half and local scale without pixel alignment and judges local fidelity with two vision-language models gated on control crops. With this protocol, Nano Banana Pro at 4K, the highest-resolution commercial editor we test, loses or redraws local detail on 14 of 20 test gowns. At 1536x2048 pixels, both judges prefer SARA over a LoRA fine-tuning baseline on 18 test items and the baseline on 6 (p=0.023), and over the base model on 26 against 4 (p=5.9e-5), while SARA keeps the gown design as often as the baseline.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 281. [Intervene or Trust CLIP? Competence-Gated Adaptation for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28104v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28104

**作者：** Haoyue Liu、Chenhao Zhu、Yu Huo、Haoran Shou、Shuguang Cui、Xiaoying Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28104v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28104v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究无源跨域小样本下的 CLIP 适配，发现 token 级干预是否有益取决于冻结 CLIP 对目标域支持集的识别能力，据此提出 CoGA：用支持集准确率与 margin 在训练前决定干预视觉 token 还是融合冻结预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「按冻结模型能力门控视觉干预」及偏差—方差解释，可能为 LVR 中判断何时依赖现有视觉表示、何时介入或更新视觉状态提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Intervene or Trust CLIP? Competence-Gated Adaptation for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning

**abstract/A1：** Source-free cross-domain few-shot learning (SF-CDFSL) adapts a pre-trained vision-language model such as CLIP to a distant target domain from a handful of labeled images, without access to source data. Recent methods improve the fine-tuning of CLIP with token-level interventions and apply them in the same way to every target domain. In this paper, we find that whether an intervention helps depends on how well frozen CLIP already recognizes the target domain: in 5-way 1-shot tasks, intervening improves accuracy by 0.72 points where frozen CLIP misclassifies most support images, but lowers it by 1.31 points where frozen CLIP already classifies them well, and the support set of a single episode suffices to tell the two cases apart; a bias-variance analysis explains both. Based on this finding, we propose Competence-Gated Adaptation (CoGA), which measures frozen CLIP's accuracy and margin on the labeled support set and decides, before training, whether to intervene on the visual tokens or to trust CLIP by fusing the adapted prediction with the frozen one. CoGA adds no trainable parameters and uses no query labels. On the four BSCD-FSL target domains, CoGA achieves the best average accuracy, 59.56% (1-shot) and 68.96% (5-shot), outperforms ATHA and TIR by at least 2.82 and 1.39 points on the same episodes, and consistently improves three further backbones, three parameter-efficient fine-tuning frameworks and five further target domains.

</details>

### 282. [Gradient-Free Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision Models via Agentic Coding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28105v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28105

**作者：** Khayrul Islam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28105v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28105v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「Agent edit」：让编码 agent 在无梯度更新的情况下编写程序，直接设定冻结的 COCO 检测器类头中新类别的权重，仅用少量标注图与有限次 mAP 反馈迭代，并发现多数 agent 程序可归约为三个部分构成的、无需 agent 的公式。

**相关性简评：** 其「以有限反馈的代码编辑替代梯度优化、再把 agent 程序提炼为固定公式」的模式，可能为 LVR 中的搜索与验证、贡献分配以及把搜索摊销进固定计算提供线索；但任务本身不涉及多模态推理状态，需人工核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gradient-Free Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision Models via Agentic Coding

**abstract/A1：** Adapting a vision model to new classes from a few labeled images usually relies on gradient fine-tuning, which is unstable with so few images. We ask whether a coding agent can replace gradient descent for this task. We propose the Agent edit, a method in which a coding agent writes a program that sets the new class weights in the class head of a frozen COCO-trained detector, with no gradient step. The agent runs the detector on the labeled images a limited number of times and sees how much its edit lowers COCO mAP; the program rebuilds the weights without the agent. In the same head and with the same labels, the Agent edit outperforms full-decoder fine-tuning at five shots on 2 of four fine-grained sets, by 11.2 and 12.3 F1 points, and ties on the rest. At ten shots, fine-tuning ties with or outperforms it. Moreover, when the new classes are scored jointly with the COCO classes, the AP of the COCO class to which they belong falls by up to 33.3 points, and limiting that loss lowers F1 on the new classes. Most of the agent's programs share three parts, which we write as a formula that needs no agent. A classifier on frozen backbone features reaches a higher F1 than every method inside the head on every set. Hence a coding agent can replace gradient descent only in part: inside the head and at five shots.

</details>

### 283. [Cyclic Discrete Diffusion: A Novel Multi-Class Segmentation Refinement Technique](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28107v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28107

**作者：** Libo Chen、Souvik Ghosh、Vinay P. Namboodiri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28107v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28107v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把多类分割精化建模为离散标签空间上的扩散过程：像素每步按固定速率「跳转到下一类或保持」，在循环标签拓扑上形成有限状态的 Markov 正反向过程，反向动态可解析，并用谱隙分析讨论收敛性，在多类语义、实例与二值分割上验证区域与边界质量提升。

**相关性简评：** 其离散状态转移、正向—反向精化与有限可控步数，可能为 LVR 中离散 latent 推理状态的迭代更新方式和 STOP 停止决策提供方法线索；但该文不涉及多模态推理，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cyclic Discrete Diffusion: A Novel Multi-Class Segmentation Refinement Technique

**abstract/A1：** We cast image segmentation refinement as a discrete diffusion process. To solve this task we introduce Cyclic Discrete Diffusion (CDD), a novel forward-reverse formulation with a cyclic label topology that maps a discrete label set to the uniform distribution and back. Instead of injecting Gaussian noise as is done for continuous diffusion, CDD evolves segmentation masks through label jumps: at each step, every pixel either remains in its current class or jumps to the next label with a fixed rate. This jump-or-stay mechanism defines a finite-state Markov process with bounded forward and reverse steps, featuring analytically consistent and tractable reverse dynamics. CDD operates natively in a multi-class label space, enabling joint refinement of all classes in a single pass without requiring class-wise decomposition, as commonly needed in prior binary refinement approaches. The proposed formulation admits a finite and controllable number of refinement steps, for which we analyze the convergence properties through spectral gap analysis. We evaluate CDD across diverse segmentation tasks, including multi-class semantic, instance-level, and binary segmentation refinement. Our method consistently improves both region accuracy and boundary quality across multiple backbones and datasets.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 25 pages

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28119

**作者：** Hongyu Zhou、Yubo Peng、Luping Xiang、Kun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28119v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28119v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VRTG：先用图像中的目标线索从雷达点云中挑选少量信息量高的测量，建立视觉目标与雷达回波的标定式一对一关联以精化距离，再把关联特征与视觉上下文转换为可与现有相机-雷达融合网络对接的 radar token；在 RADIal 上每帧仅用四个雷达点即接近全雷达模型性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「视觉线索筛稀疏证据、再跨模态生成缺失特征」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中真实观测证据与生成代理之间的区分、视觉旁路何时替代传感器证据，以及证据筛选与贡献分配的评测方式；但论文目标是检测指标，未涉及 latent 推理状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Beyond Pixels: Radar Feature Generation from Images and Sparse Returns

**abstract/A1：** Camera-radar fusion benefits from complementary visual and geometric information but often relies on complete radar representations, leading to substantial computing overhead. However, the extent to which visual information can compensate for limited radar measurements remains insufficiently explored. Therefore, we propose Vision-informed Radar Token Generation (VRTG), which exploits cross-modal information to generate task-relevant radar features from camera images and sparse radar measurements. Specifically, VRTG first leverages image-derived object cues to select a limited number of informative radar points. It then establishes calibrated one-to-one associations between visual objects and radar returns, using matched measurements to refine object ranges while retaining visual estimates for unmatched objects. Finally, the associated object features and visual context are transformed into radar tokens compatible with existing camera-radar fusion networks. Experiments on RADIal demonstrate that VRTG achieves 90.76\\% vehicle-detection F1 and 86.68\\% free-space mIoU using only four radar points per frame, approaching the performance of the full-radar model.

</details>

### 285. [Separating Module Gain From Transport Plan Contribution in Audio-Visual Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28120v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28120

**作者：** Vu Nhat Minh Pham、Cong Khanh Nguyen、Minh Tuan Le、Van Thong Huynh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28120v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28120v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在音视频动态面部表情识别中，试图把跨模态 Sinkhorn 路由模块带来的增益同其传输计划本身的贡献分开，用参数匹配变体与不重训练的替换干预做对照评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「参数匹配控制＋在不重训下替换内部计划（均匀化、行置换、仅保留边缘乘积）」的归因设计，可能为 LVR 中区分 latent 内容是否真被使用、还是仅由架构或参数增益解释，提供可供核查的方法线索；但任务与视觉语言推理距离较远，且多数差异在折叠依赖性放大下尚未分辨。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Separating Module Gain From Transport Plan Contribution in Audio-Visual Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition

**abstract/A1：** A cross-modal routing module can improve over its backbone while its transport plan accounts for no demonstrable part of that improvement. In ABVnet with DFEW, Sinkhorn cross-modal routing (SCR) exceeds the retrained baseline by 0.87 unweighted average recall (UAR) points, a resolved difference, yet sits 0.17 points above an individually trained, parameter-matched pooled variant, an unresolved difference that establishes no equivalence; under the development protocol the comparison with the baseline reverses. Separating the two needs comparisons a module-against-backbone test cannot supply: parameter-matched variants changing only the plan rule, and interventions replacing the plan without retraining. The evaluation covers MMA-DFER and ABVnet on DFEW and MAFW, and MMA-DFER on CREMA-D, with a single training run per configuration and paired fold intervals. ABVnet with DFEW motivated the follow-up after the broader results were available. Replacing the plan everywhere with a uniform one reduces UAR by 0.72, whereas permuting its rows gives an unresolved difference of -0.20 UAR points; permutation is less damaging by 0.51 UAR points, a resolved contrast. Replacing the plan with the product of its own marginals, preserving both marginals and removing only frame-specific mixtures, reduces UAR by 0.70. These reductions concern reliance at inference; attribution of the module gain to the transport plan remains unestablished. Under the 1.5 fold-dependence widening, the baseline gain remains resolved, whereas the replacement reductions and the paired contrast are unresolved.

</details>

### 286. [ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28124v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28124

**作者：** Bangfeng Yan、Chaoning Zhang、Yuanhao Liu、Pengcheng Zheng、Mengyuan Li、Wei Dong、Sheng Zheng、Yang Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28124v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28124v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReMiC，一个免训练的 3D VLM 视觉 token 剪枝框架：以 minimax 层次聚类把保留 token 当作原始观测的原型，在固定 token 预算下最小化最大表示误差，并用局部原型初始化与全局原型精炼分配预算。

**相关性简评：** 其「用原型最小化最大表示误差」的度量方式可能可供核查如何量化视觉证据压缩后的信息损失与代表性 token 选择，但该方法是静态输入剪枝，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering

**abstract/A1：** 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\\times$ faster inference speed.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 287. [DINO-KNN: Training-Free Multiclass In-Context Segmentation via Nearest Neighbors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28127v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28127

**作者：** Hussain Alasmawi、Numan Saeed、Mohammad Yaqub

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28127v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28127v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DINO-KNN：冻结 DINOv3 编码器下把所有参考图像 patch 存入单一记忆，目标 patch 由 k 近邻距离加权投票一次性完成多类分割，无需训练或 mask 解码器，并在八个数据集、R=1–15 上验证随参考数增加而持续提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「参考 patch 记忆 + 近邻投票 + 单次多类联合决策」可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、外部记忆读取与多假设标签分配的做法，但不涉及 latent 状态生成或推理轨迹，联系限于检索式决策机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DINO-KNN: Training-Free Multiclass In-Context Segmentation via Nearest Neighbors

**abstract/A1：** In-context segmentation (ICS) segments a target image given a few annotated reference images. Recent training-free methods built on frozen foundation models segment one class at a time and gain little from additional references. We study the multiclass, multi-reference setting and ask how far a simple joint decision rule can go. We introduce DINO-KNN, which stores every labeled reference patch of a frozen DINOv3 encoder in a single memory and labels each target patch by a distance-weighted vote of its k nearest neighbors. All classes are predicted in a single pass, with one label per pixel, without training or a mask decoder. We evaluate on eight datasets, four natural and four medical, with R=1 to 15 reference images and three reference seeds. DINO-KNN achieves the best average mIoU at every R; it is the best method on six of the eight datasets from R=3 and on seven of the eight from R=7. Its accuracy continues to grow with the number of references, from 37.8 mIoU at R=1 to 56.2 at R=15, while the strongest baseline, INSID3, rises from 36.1 to 42.9. DINO-KNN is also 2.1x faster than INSID3. The code will be made public.

</details>

### 288. [SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28134v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28134

**作者：** Matiur Rahman Minar、Seunghun Oh、Ganghyeon Jeong、Unsang Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28134v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28134v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SceneTether，一种免训练的注意力读取策略：保留最新 latent 的全部 key，但把低活动区域的 value 向源图像同位置混合、高活动区域保持不变，用首轮生成估计并冻结的活动图决定混合位置，从而在长时程自回归图像动画中固定场景又保留运动。

**相关性简评：** 其「活动门控的 value 锚定」直接改变 KV 缓存向注意力返回的视觉内容，可能为 LVR 中如何在维持状态更新与运动的同时防止视觉细节漂移、信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但任务属图像动画生成，与多模态推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds with 1.5x its late activity, and by 7.31 dB over spatial Echo-Forcing on a preselected four-minute subset. At equal recent-memory coverage, value anchoring alone adds 8.14 dB. A post-hoc pixel composite with the same map matches static fidelity but retains nearly twice the moving-region color drift, and viewers in a small blinded study preferred SceneTether for its natural scene and motion preservation. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/scenetether/

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://minar09.github.io/scenetether/

</details>

### 289. [Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28135v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28135

**作者：** Xiangkui Cao、Jie Zhang、Meina Kan、Shiguang Shan、Xilin Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28135v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28135v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出对 LVLM 的隐私微调或模型编辑只改变了输出分布：模型在正常解码下拒答，但在句子补全场景仍会泄漏隐私信息，说明内部仍保留对敏感信息的感知能力。为此提出 VIPE，用隐私敏感图像与掩码图像配对产生的内部特征残差定位隐私相关视觉成分，并在其被模型感知前加以抑制，同时把擦除方向投影到松弛的良性子空间并自适应控制强度，以保留通用视觉表示。

**相关性简评：** 其「输出抑制不等于内部信息消除」的诊断与 LVR 中答案是否真正使用内部视觉状态、视觉旁路的问题相通；用配对输入的特征残差定位任务相关视觉成分并做表示级干预，可供核查是否可用于筛选 LVR 轨迹依赖的视觉证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure

**abstract/A1：** Large vision-language models can extract personally identifiable information from images, making privacy protection essential for their deployment in perception-oriented tasks. Existing targeted fine-tuning and model-editing methods usually suppress sensitive answers by aligning the model toward safe responses. In this paper, we show that such protection can be illusory: although the fine-tuned model refuses to disclose private information under normal decoding, privacy leakage still occurs in sentence completion scenarios. This indicates that existing algorithms only change the model's output distribution, but the model still retains the ability to perceive private information. Private information therefore still remains inside the model. To address this problem, we propose Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to weaken the model's ability to perceive sensitive information. VIPE constructs paired privacy-sensitive and privacy-masked images, uses their internal feature residuals to identify privacy-related visual components, and suppresses these components before they are perceived by the model. To preserve benign visual representations, the erasure objective projects feature differences onto a relaxed benign subspace and adaptively controls the erasure strength. VIPE compels the model to ignore the extraction of sensitive information in the visual representation space, thereby blocking the source of privacy leakage more fundamentally rather than merely altering the model's output distribution. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-OneVision show that VIPE substantially alleviates prefix-triggered privacy leakage while maintaining competitive utility on general visual-language benchmarks.

</details>

### 290. [ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28136v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28136

**作者：** Chenhao Wu、Zhaolong Su、Yang Liu、Tianrui Su、Yingguang Yang、Shang Luo、Yancheng Chen、Chongyang Zhang、Hao Zheng、Kefu Xu、Congjing Ran、Bin Chong

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ENGRAM，一个面向相机条件视频世界模型的 latent 空间记忆框架：用可靠性加权的递归融合在通道归一化 latent 空间中整合重复观测，并以遮挡感知的分层读出暴露多层深度候选及其可靠性，从而在视角变化时让生成器访问多个表面信息。

**相关性简评：** 其「可靠性加权融合巩固重复证据」与「按深度分层给出带可靠性的 latent 候选」可供核查 LVR 中重复视觉证据的状态更新与多 latent 假设筛选，但论文任务是视频生成而非推理，迁移需读者自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models

**abstract/A1：** Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. However, set-union updates in latent spatial memory leave repeated observations unconsolidated, while frontmost-only readout limits simultaneous access to stored evidence at different depths. To address these limitations, we present ENGRAM, a latent spatial memory framework combining reliability-weighted latent fusion and occlusion-aware layered readout. Specifically, recursive fusion integrates geometrically and visually compatible observations in a channel-normalized latent space, consolidating repeated evidence into a shared scene representation. Layered readout exposes multiple depth-ordered latent candidates with their reliability and availability at each target cell. This gives the generator access to information from multiple surfaces as visibility changes. Explicit camera rays provide viewpoint information independently of memory coverage, while geometric consistency constraints guide memory updates. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. On 100 RealEstate10K test scenes, ENGRAM improves novel-view-synthesis and closed-loop PSNRs over Spatia by 0.82 and 4.48 dB, respectively. On a 200-case WorldScore evaluation subset, it achieves an average score of 67.78, exceeding Spatia by 3.31 points. Project page: https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, including supplementary material

</details>

### 291. [Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28137v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28137

**作者：** Hyunwook Kang、Junoh Park、Hyunggyu Lim、Taesup Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28137v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28137v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向交互式长视频生成，为冻结的自回归扩散生成器构建对象级 KV 记忆：保留被跟踪对象区域的原始 KV、按注意力分数挑选背景 KV，并附上源场景与外观记录，由 LLM 选择所需记录后整合生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「对象区域 KV + 注意力分数筛选 + LLM 选记录」的选择性检索机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、以及 KV 缓存结构如何影响 latent 相似度提供可核查的方法线索，但任务目标为视频生成，检索的因果作用需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

</details>

### 292. [Dynamics-Guided Conditional MeanFlow from Regional Interaction to Internal Revision and Its Application to CT Imaging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28139v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28139

**作者：** Md Shifatul Ahsan Apurba、Md Selim、Jin Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28139v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28139v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 IRCMF，将区域交互与循环内部修正结合的 Conditional MeanFlow 框架：解码器预测带符号区间速度与速度变化线索，据此引导瓶颈特征的反复更新，并用 actor-critic 策略决定区域更新与额外修正次数，用于 CT 核与低剂量增强。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测变换动态→反馈修正内部特征→策略决定何时停止迭代」的循环计算与自适应预算机制，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新和 STOP 收益/成本权衡提供借鉴，但需核查能否迁移到多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamics-Guided Conditional MeanFlow from Regional Interaction to Internal Revision and Its Application to CT Imaging

**abstract/A1：** Conditional image enhancement requires spatially varying corrections, yet fixed-depth models allocate similar computational budgets regardless of where additional refinement is needed. Although one-step flow models reduce inference costs and iterative restoration methods introduce subsequent corrections, how predicted transformation dynamics can guide internal feature refinement remains underexplored. We introduce IRCMF, a dynamics-guided Conditional MeanFlow framework that combines regional interaction with recurrent internal revision. The decoder predicts signed interval velocity and a learned velocity-change cue. A soft-region graph aggregates contextual information for velocity estimation, while a dynamics-conditioned graph establishes regional relationships to guide recurrent bottleneck updates. The revised features are processed by the shared decoder to recompute velocity, establishing feedback between transformation dynamics and internal representations. An actor-critic policy controls regional updates and further revisions to balance enhancement quality and computational cost. We evaluate IRCMF on two computed tomography (CT) datasets, NLST for STANDARD-to-LUNG kernel enhancement and LDCT-and-Projection-data for simulated low-to-routine-dose enhancement. With nine decoder evaluations, IRCMF achieves slice-level PSNR of $36.24 \\pm 3.49$ dB and SSIM of $0.97 \\pm 0.01$ on NLST, and PSNR of $32.45 \\pm 1.97$ dB and SSIM of $0.84 \\pm 0.05$ on LDCT-and-Projection-data. The learned policy reduces average decoder evaluations to 4.42 and 3.45, respectively, lowering per-slice latency from 97.00 to 51.82 ms and from 97.12 to 41.95 ms, with PSNR reductions of only 0.20 and 0.06 dB.

### 293. [Close the Loop on the Retrievability Gap](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28146v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28146

**作者：** Guangyuan Dong、Wenhao Li、Zhen Tian、Jiaqi Zhang、Haoyu Wang、Junhao Xu、Mingzhe Liu、Pan Wang、Fei Shen、Tat-Seng Chua

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28146v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28146v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出遥感全色锐化中，保真度指标与冻结视觉语言编码器的可检索性不一致（称为 retrievability gap），并归因于位置平均损失的面积加权使小目标欠表达；提出 LEDGER，将输入索引为命名概念集合，用同一冻结编码器重编码输出，并以集合级 soft-Jaccard 覆盖损失作为免标注训练目标。

**相关性简评：** 「按面积加权的重建损失会系统性牺牲小目标与细粒度概念」这一诊断及集合级覆盖监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节与实体在 latent 状态下被压缩、坍缩的问题提供训练监督线索；其实验只涉及图像复原与检索，尚需核查向推理状态的迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Close the Loop on the Retrievability Gap

**abstract/A1：** A frozen vision-language encoder now guides image restoration and later indexes what it produced. Over a fixed set of eighteen pansharpening systems on one WorldView-III test set, the fidelity index that ranks them, $Q2^n$ with a reference and HQNR without one, picks the less retrievable of two systems one time in three and one in two; the disagreement lies between the pixel-supervised and the language-conditioned family, and even the best system falls short of the reference, small objects first. We call this the retrievability gap and trace it to the area weighting of position-averaged losses. LEDGER closes the loop around the encoder: it indexes the input into a set of named concepts, generates, re-encodes the output alone with the same frozen encoder, and minimises a set-level soft-Jaccard loss on the coverage of that set, a label-free target available at test time, so that every present concept of a scale receives a gradient share independent of its area. Measured outside the loop by label-grounded probes, held-out retrievers, language-free evaluators, detectors and human raters, LEDGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in fidelity on four sensors, raises retrieval by seven to nine points within its vocabulary and two to five outside it, closes two thirds of the reduced-resolution gap to the reference, lifts extraction on raw SpaceNet imagery above the vendor product in each of four cities, and transfers to existing generators as a training-only loss at no inference cost.

</details>

### 294. [Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28158v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28158

**作者：** Shardul Bansal、Seth Schilbe、Jarrod Barnes

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28158v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28158v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SMB Bench：一个 90 天批发经营模拟器，含 18 组因果配对任务与 859 条前沿模型轨迹，用来考察 16 个前沿模型能否察觉并应对自身决策的延迟后果；并以存档决策及其后果作为可复用训练经验来微调 Qwen3.8-27B。

**相关性简评：** 其「笔记中已有诊断却不及时改变采购」的诊断—行动落差，以及把归档决策与后果转成监督信号的思路，可供核查 latent 状态是否真正参与后续动作、以及延迟回报下的贡献分配与轨迹训练设计；但任务为纯文本经营模拟，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences

**abstract/A1：** Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 7 figures. Benchmark report: https://oroagents.com/benchmarks/smb-bench ; dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/oro-agents/smb-bench

</details>

### 295. [RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28171v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28171

**作者：** Kewei Lian、Jiayi Zhai、Anji Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28171v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28171v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对长上下文解码中反复访问完整 KV cache 的瓶颈，提出 RefineKV：将 KV cache 分簇，由 attention 输出误差上界导出「重要性＋失真」的选择准则，按 query 自适应地决定哪些簇用紧凑代表、哪些展开为原始条目，在保持接近全注意力质量的同时加速。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 中「视觉证据筛选」及缓存和注意力结构对 latent 分析的影响有方法线索：其误差上界驱动的重要性—失真权衡，可能可供核查作为判断哪些 KV 或视觉 token 必须保留原始精度、哪些可被压缩表示的准则。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RefineKV: Query-Adaptive KV Cache Compression via Attention-Error Bounds

**abstract/A1：** Repeatedly accessing the full key--value (KV) cache is a major bottleneck in long-context language model decoding. We find that small query-specific subsets can accurately approximate full attention, yet their union covers nearly the entire cache, motivating query-adaptive access for the KV cache. A natural approach is to split the KV cache into clusters, using compact representatives for clusters that incur negligible error while expanding the rest to their original KV entries. We derive a selection criterion from an upper bound on attention-output error, which reveals two complementary factors governing the error: importance measures the impact of a cluster, while distortion measures how faithfully the cluster can be represented. Based on this criterion, we propose RefineKV, a decoding-time query-adaptive KV compression method. Experiments on two models and three benchmarks demonstrate that RefineKV retains near-full-attention quality while achieving up to 7.6x speedup in the attention phase and 1.66x faster decoding, establishing a new quality-latency Pareto frontier.

</details>

### 296. [A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28175v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28175

**作者：** Jingyi Wu、Chenghua Guo、Qianlin Zuo、Pengfei Li、Luxia Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28175v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28175v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文基于 Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture 构建「健康世界模型」，用状态编码器、动作与上下文条件化的预测器及带 stop-gradient 的目标编码器在潜空间中刻画老年人健康状态的演化，并在多国队列上做纵向风险预测与反事实轨迹模拟。

**相关性简评：** 其潜空间状态预测、动作条件化状态更新与 stop-gradient 目标监督，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新方式和轨迹监督提供架构线索，但领域为健康队列数据且无视觉输入，需核查其表示是否保留任务必要细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts

**abstract/A1：** Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Open-loop evaluation assessed discrimination and calibration for mortality and worsening of activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL). In the held-out HRS test set, the areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) for mortality, ADL worsening, and IADL worsening were 0.89, 0.93, and 0.93 at the first horizon and 0.84, 0.84, and 0.85 at the fifth horizon, respectively. Predicted risks stratified subsequent outcomes across horizons. Across the evaluated horizons, mortality AUROC ranged from 0.867 to 0.881 in ELSA and from 0.796 to 0.801 in CHARLS. Simulated trajectories preserved the expected risk ordering across predefined action regimes. In counterfactual simulations, changes in lifestyle actions shifted predicted risks in directions consistent with observed associations. The model provides a framework for longitudinal risk prediction and action-conditioned simulation in older adults.

</details>

### 297. [BReD: BEV Residual Diffusion for Feed-Forward Road Gaussian Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28191v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28191

**作者：** Baizhi Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28191v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28191v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** BReD 从标定六相机序列前馈重建路面高程、外观与语义：先以 LiDAR 监督深度学习和 BEV 提升得到粗高程，再用以相机深度—高程差为条件的轻量 BEV 残差扩散精化，并据此锚定道路对齐高斯，推理时无需逐场景优化。

**相关性简评：** 它把粗 BEV 高程作为可精化的中间状态、以「深度—高程不一致」信号条件化残差扩散，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新与误差信号条件化提供可核查线索；但任务属几何重建而非推理，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BReD: BEV Residual Diffusion for Feed-Forward Road Gaussian Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Accurate road surface reconstruction is essential for autonomous-driving mapping and simulation, but existing methods trade reconstruction quality for cross-scene inference. Optimization-based methods recover detailed surfaces through costly per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods lack road-specific constraints and often produce large elevation errors. We propose \\textbf{BReD}, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing road elevation, appearance, and semantics from calibrated six-camera sequences. BReD first estimates coarse elevation through LiDAR-supervised depth learning and BEV lifting, using only cameras at inference. A lightweight BEV residual diffusion model then conditions elevation refinement on a camera-derived depth--elevation discrepancy and elevation-aware image features. Diffusion-indexed perturbations expose the model to different discrepancy corruption levels during training, while inference performs one deterministic refinement from the clean discrepancy. The refined elevations are temporally aggregated to anchor road-aligned Gaussians, whose attributes are predicted by a geometry-prior-guided decoder without test-time optimization. On four held-out nuScenes scenes, BReD achieves 7.34 cm elevation RMSE and 90.92\\% semantic mIoU, compared with 14.43 cm for RoGS without test-time LiDAR and 8.88 cm for its test-time-LiDAR-assisted variant; both RoGS variants require per-scene optimization.

</details>

### 298. [From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28197v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28197

**作者：** Changyu Du、Stavros Nousias、Syed Salman Ahmed、Kai Dietmair、Mohammad Alrabab'h、André Borrmann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28197v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28197v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将场景级 Scan-to-BIM 形式化为 agentic 3D 编码任务，构建覆盖 128 个真实场景的 S2Bench，让编码 agent 在 Python 中测量点云、在 CAD/BIM 内核中构建语义构件并迭代修改代码，同时提出由 lead 分派带版本任务、并行异步整合修订提案的协作方式，并评测多个 agent 与一个协作团队。

**相关性简评：** 其「扫描残差直接引导几何修复」与带版本任务分派、修订绑定整合的并行协作机制，可能为 LVR 的并行生成、状态更新与贡献分配提供可核查线索；但对象是点云到工程 CAD 模型的重建而非视觉推理内部状态，与主线的距离需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment

**abstract/A1：** Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\\%$ coverage within $5\\,\\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

</details>

### 299. [AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28202v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28202

**作者：** Mark Zhao、Pengcheng Wang、Rui Yang、Jiarui Yao、Xirui Jiang、Yuxi Chen、Bingxuan Li、Hanyang Chen、Ke Yang、Manling Li、Tong Zhang、Huan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28202v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28202v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AutoPILOT 这一视觉智能体执行框架，让模型在一次调用中选择发出原语动作、开环宏操作，或直接编写可在无模型调用下持续接管的闭环控制器，并构建含 120 款浏览器游戏的实时基准 AFK-Bench 进行评估。

**相关性简评：** 其核心在于把模型输出转化为跨时间持续起作用的动作状态并压低调用预算，与 LVR 中「昂贵推理调用与轻量过程分离、停止/接管决策及成本核算」的思路可能相关，可供核查能否迁移到动态计算与 THINK/STOP 的代价评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 10 figures, 21 tables

</details>

### 300. [Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28227v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28227

**作者：** Benhao Huang、Xuezhe Ma、Hector Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28227v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28227v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对把上一层顶层隐状态回灌到下一位置输入的 latent feedback Transformer，提出 Feedback Shortcut：用状态对齐训练轻量投影以生成可替代 draft 的近似状态，并在验证阶段流水线修正，使投机解码在几乎不损失精确解码质量的前提下加速 2.4–2.8 倍。

**相关性简评：** 论文讨论的正是循环隐状态反馈下「真实状态 vs 近似替身」的误差与验证期重算，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的缓存近似、并行草拟与验证修正是否会歪曲推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within $10^{-4}$ bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/ifm-ai/LoRM

</details>

### 301. [A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28240v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28240

**作者：** Lemar Abdi、Amaan Valiuddin、Fida Mohammad Thoker、Karen Sanchez、Bernard Ghanem、Fons van der Sommen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**内容简述：** 提出 STRIDE：在已训练的手术三元组识别器之后加一个后处理时序读出，对多个固定时间窗内的特征与 logits 取平均，再用岭回归在当前帧上闭式求解融合，从而在不重训模型的情况下提升识别并降低误报。

**相关性简评：** 其「多时间尺度池化 + 闭式回归读出」及响应延迟与误报的权衡，可能为 LVR 中累积历史证据、决定何时停止或回看的多窗口状态读出提供轻量实现线索，需核查该读出是否只做后处理而无法影响内部表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Surgical triplet recognition requires identifying which instrument performs which action on which anatomical target, and following these interactions as they unfold over time. The task is challenging because several triplets can occur at once, their components span very different durations, and the evidence for an interaction is rarely complete in a single frame. We introduce STRIDE, a post-hoc temporal readout that adds temporal context to any trained recogniser. It averages the recogniser's features and logits over a few fixed temporal windows and combines them with the current frame through ridge regression, solved in closed form on a CPU. Applied as a plug-and-play readout to nine existing methods, STRIDE improves $AP\_{IVT}$ in 24 of 27 method-dataset pairs, by up to 7.4 points. Moreover, we propose a simple pipeline consisting of an adapted foundation vision encoder with a linear classifier and STRIDE. Across thirteen encoders, STRIDE improves 37 of 39 encoder-dataset pairs by up to 7.2 points. STRIDE reduces false alarms by 41%, at the cost of a slower response at interaction boundaries. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>

### 302. [DeFlowCritic: Dense Latent Reward Alignment for Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28265v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28265

**作者：** Zeeshan Khan、Xin Yu、Shizhe Chen、Cordelia Schmid

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28265v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28265v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DeFlowCritic，一个面向文生图 flow matching 的在线 RL 框架，用扩散模型自身特征构建内部 critic 对含噪中间 latent 给出稠密奖励，从而在去噪轨迹早期进行监督，并用于推理期扩展。

**相关性简评：** 其「用模型内部表示评估中间 latent 状态、为整条轨迹提供稠密信用分配」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与状态评价提供可核查线索；但研究对象是图像生成而非视觉推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeFlowCritic: Dense Latent Reward Alignment for Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models

**abstract/A1：** Online reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning text-to-image flow matching models with complex user intent. However, existing methods typically rely on sparse rewards computed only from final decoded images. This delays credit assignment across the denoising trajectory and makes training computationally expensive. Moreover, simply combining multiple rewards does not reliably produce a Pareto trade-off, where gains in compositional accuracy often degrade aesthetic quality. In this work, we propose DeFlowCritic, an efficient online RL framework based on Dense Latent Reward Alignment. Unlike prior work, our method provides dense supervision on intermediate latents, enabling early-stage guidance for the denoising trajectory. To achieve this, we introduce an internal critic that evaluates noisy latents using features extracted directly from the diffusion model, a representation inherently better suited for latent-space reward estimation than standard image encoders. We construct a high-quality reward-modeling dataset with continuous scores for critic training, capturing compositional correctness on high-quality reference images. The resulting dense reward enables efficient online RL training and inference-time scaling. Experiments show that our method achieves a superior balance between prompt faithfulness and visual quality on GenEval2 and T2I-CompBench++ benchmarks. The approach also generalizes across text-to-image flow matching models, including SD3.5-Medium, SD3.5-Large, and FLUX.1-dev.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://zeeshank95.github.io/deflowcritic/

</details>

### 303. [Failure Modes and Data-Efficient Remedies for Transformer-Based Prediction of Viscoplastic Flows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28267v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28267

**作者：** Maedeh Saberi、Hugo Franca、Maziyar Jalaal、Safa Jamali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.flu-dyn

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28267v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28267v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在稳态 Bingham 通道流上系统考察 Transformer 型神经算子 RheOFormer 的失效模式，发现数据集结构、数值范围和输入表示决定插值/外推能力，随后用对数速度表示、梯度感知损失和少量策略性样本缓解低梯度塞流区与跨尺度外推的误差。

**相关性简评：** 其输入场表示与梯度感知损失专门针对低梯度区域的信息退化与训练覆盖不足，可能为 VLM latent 状态中低对比视觉细节的保留、信息坍缩与监督设计提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Failure Modes and Data-Efficient Remedies for Transformer-Based Prediction of Viscoplastic Flows

**abstract/A1：** Fast and accurate prediction of viscoplastic flows remains a challenge in computational rheology due to yield surfaces, discontinuous gradients, and strongly nonlinear transitions between yielded and unyielded regions. Transformer-based neural operators such as RheOFormer have recently shown strong potential for surrogate modeling of non-Newtonian flows. However, their applicability to viscoplastic systems and their efficacy in recovering realistic flows remain poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic investigation of RheOFormer applied to steady Bingham channel flow. By isolating the problem to a simple geometry and constitutive model, we examine how dataset structure, numerical value range, and input representation govern the model's ability to interpolate and extrapolate within the parameter space. The data regimes in which RheOFormer remains accurate and those in which errors emerge are identified, particularly for plug-dominated flows and for conditions outside the velocity scales or flow structures represented during training. Upon identifying these failure modes, targeted enhancements to the input representation and loss formulation are introduced to better predict low-gradient plug regions. Logarithmic velocity representations and gradient-aware loss formulations substantially improve accuracy in challenging regimes where the baseline formulation fails. In addition, extrapolation errors are reduced by augmenting the training set with only a few strategically selected cases spanning the missing physical regimes. Finally, a single partially developed snapshot suffices for an accurate steady-state prediction, and the model outperforms simply copying its input throughout flow development. These results highlight the importance of appropriate field representation and parameter-space coverage for data-efficient neural-operator prediction of viscoplastic flows.

</details>

### 304. [Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28277v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28277

**作者：** Edjard Mota、Artur d'Avila Garcez、Maria Azevedo、Odalisio Neto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28277v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28277v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出可微神经符号框架 tLTN，用多类逻辑把事件（可学习梯形模糊时长、可微 Allen 关系）与状态（时间点上的模糊真值路径）结构性地联结，并将静态、事件结构与状态动态三类满足性合成为单一可微接地；在合成场景中展示单模态学习失效的情形及事件区间定位对长轨迹计算量的削减。

**相关性简评：** 其事件—状态双向约束与可微时序接地，可能为 VLM 中对 latent 中间状态与证据区间施加结构化监督、并按事件跨度局部化计算提供线索，尚待核查能否用于 latent 推理轨迹而非仅符号约束。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework addressing this duality via a formal, multi-sorted logic where events and states are structurally interdependent. Extending Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN), tLTN grounds state predicates as fuzzy truth-value paths over time points, while events are first-class entities with learnable trapezoidal fuzzy durations and differentiable Allen-style relations. A compositional semantics fuses static, event-structural, and state-dynamic satisfaction into a single differentiable LTN grounding. Crucially, the modalities constrain each other bidirectionally: the interval layer dictates where point-wise constraints (e.g., Until, Since) are evaluated, restricting them to event-defined spans; conversely, the point-wise layer validates interval relations, rejecting them if underlying state dynamics contradict the relation. Through controlled synthetic examples, we show when single-modality learning fails and how this localization reduces frame-level computational cost on long traces.

</details>

### 305. [Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28281v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28281

**作者：** Renjie Liang、Mengxian Lyu、Zijian Xu、Boxin Zhao、Yang Yang、Jinqian Pan、Zhengkang Fan、Mei Liu、Yonghui Wu、Jie Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28281v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28281v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一个 agent 系统，为每个报告模型学习可执行的规则库（rule bank），在推理时依据独立分类器预测与定量图像测量对 3D 胸 CT 报告做局部修订，且每处修改都可追溯到触发规则。

**相关性简评：** 规则库实质是「外部视觉证据何时、如何改写生成结果」的可学习策略，与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、证据贡献分配及修订/停止判断可供核查；但其作用于离散文本编辑而非内部 latent 状态，迁移性需进一步核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence

**abstract/A1：** Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank.

</details>

### 306. [Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28286v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28286

**作者：** Ulrik Unneberg、Shiyi Wang、Lee Cheuk-Kit、Felix Berg、Boris Kozinsky、Yilun Du、Michael S. Albergo、Eric Vanden-Eijnden

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28286v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28286v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Scalable Beckmann Maps，为 Beckmann 传输模型引入无分类器引导（CFG）和可扩展训练配方，在表示自编码器的 latent 中从零训练，实现仅需单次网络评估的一步生成，并用于文生图与机器人操作世界模型。

**相关性简评：** 其把多步迭代生成动力学摊销进单次前向、并分析引导如何移动吸引域边界的思路，可能为多步 latent 推理的少步/一步摊销及条件信号对状态收敛区域的影响提供可核查线索，但与 VLM 推理本身无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation

**abstract/A1：** Beckmann Transport Models (BTM) learn one-step generative maps end-to-end from data, without a teacher, a distillation stage, or pretrained features. We introduce Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM), which bring to BTM the two ingredients behind the quality of modern multistep generators: classifier-free guidance (CFG) and a training recipe that scales, while keeping sampling at a single network evaluation. CFG combines conditional and unconditional velocity or score predictions, which a Beckmann map does not have. Our guidance rests on one observation: the BTM current is a positive multiple of an autonomous denoising field, to which CFG applies as it does to a velocity. With exact denoisers this gives guided BTM. In practice we substitute the map's own conditional and null predictions for the denoisers, which requires no additional network and introduces a bias that we characterize. We show that the guided update is consistent with a guided conservation equation, and that guidance can move the boundaries between basins, sending more noise to the modes a condition favors. Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs. In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation. As a world model, where we train without guidance, the recipe alone outperforms DriftWorld on all five metrics of two robot-manipulation benchmarks, with 1.9-2.8x less training compute and no pretrained auxiliary feature encoder.

**comment/C1：** 40 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://tullebulle.github.io/projects/sbm/

</details>

### 307. [GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28295v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28295

**作者：** Yiyu Qian、Xing Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28295v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28295v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GERF：把科学文献建成连接 schema 字段、文本块、图与图注的异构证据图，以字段为检索锚点，结合语义检索、随机游走重启与空值感知扩展组装紧凑的多模态证据包，仅对图上选中的图做视觉解析，并以证据召回覆盖率和输入 token 消耗两方面评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「先图检索筛选、再按需解析图」的视觉证据筛选与 token 成本控制，可能为 LVR 中何时引入视觉证据、如何压缩推理上下文提供可供核查的线索；但论文目标是 schema 引导的信息抽取而非 latent 推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction

**abstract/A1：** Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On the expert-annotated SOFC-Exp corpus, GERF retrieves gold-supported evidence for 94.55% of the evaluated field instances, providing broad field-level evidence coverage for downstream extraction. In the token comparison, GERF reduces average input-token usage by 73.40% relative to full-context processing and uses fewer tokens than the evaluated page-level pipelines.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 3 tables

</details>

### 308. [INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28314v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28314

**作者：** Ivan Brugere、Junqi Jiang、Saumitra Mishra、Sumitra Ganesh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28314v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28314v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 INSEP 防御：通过微调降低有害与良性激活沿「拒绝方向」的可分性，用对抗性特征分解挑选最难处理的提示子集，并以低秩适配器削弱该方向上的类均值差异，同时用行为损失保持拒答能力与良性回答质量，在八个 LLM 上比较六种防御与五种攻击。

**相关性简评：** 其「类均值差方向估计＋投影消融＋低秩子空间修改」可供核查是否能改造为检验 latent 推理状态是否被答案因果使用的干预式探针；但论文对象是安全对齐而非视觉推理，联系属方法借鉴层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration

**abstract/A1：** Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 2 figures, 42 tables

</details>

### 309. [Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28321v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28321

**作者：** Amani Aifi、Wassim Bouachir、Ahmed Zgaren、Nizar Bouguila

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28321v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28321v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向类别无关目标计数的多模态密度框架：以冻结分割模型把单次点击扩展为精确目标掩码，再在迭代的原型细化过程中每一步融合文本描述，从而摆脱对手绘边界框的依赖，并在计数精度上优于既有点击式方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「点击→掩码→逐步原型细化」的迭代状态更新与逐步骤多模态融合，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据指定与 latent 状态反复修正提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向计数这一密集预测任务，未涉及显式推理状态或答案生成，迁移性需阅读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting

**abstract/A1：** We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. We make two contributions: first, a click-derived exemplar extraction module that removes the bounding-box requirement of prior exemplar-based counters; second, a per-step text-fusion mechanism that combines visual and textual prompts throughout refinement. Combined with text guidance, our model achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, outperforming prior click-based counting methods across all metrics and surpassing the box-exemplar base architecture in mean absolute error. The code is available at github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027). Code: https://github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count

</details>

### 310. [AV-FLARE: Feature-Level Reliability Estimation for Multimodal Emotion Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28327v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28327

**作者：** Ines Jemmali、Alaa Nfissi、Wassim Bouachir、Nizar Bouguila

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28327v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28327v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AV-FLARE，在时序建模前从时间与特征两个维度显式估计细粒度可靠性分数并据此调制特征表示，可靠性由与分类任务联合训练的监督网络和无监督 GMM 两部分构成，再以文本为语义参考引导音视频分层跨模态注意力融合，在 IEMOCAP 上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「先估计模态与特征可靠性再加权调制」的做法，可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与噪声门控；但论文任务是情感识别而非生成式推理，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉旁路或停止决策，联系仅停留在输入筛选层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AV-FLARE: Feature-Level Reliability Estimation for Multimodal Emotion Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal emotion recognition (MMER) systems typically rely on learned feature representations and attention mechanisms that implicitly weight information across time and modalities. However, these mechanisms do not explicitly incorporate input reliability, despite the presence of noise in audio, occlusions in visual data, and the sparse and event-driven nature of affective cues. We propose AV-FLARE, a framework that explicitly estimates fine-grained reliability scores across both temporal and feature dimensions prior to temporal modeling and uses them to modulate feature representations. Reliability is computed using two complementary components: (i) a supervised network trained jointly with the classification objective, and (ii) an unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model that models global feature distributions. These signals are combined to provide both task-driven and distribution-aware reliability estimates. To integrate modalities, we introduce a hierarchical cross-modal attention mechanism in which textual features are used to guide audio-visual fusion as a semantic reference modality. Experiments on the IEMOCAP dataset show that AV-FLARE improves over a no-reliability baseline, achieving 90.81\\% accuracy and 81.69\\% F1-score, corresponding to gains of +4.41% and +8.56%, respectively. These results suggest that incorporating explicit input reliability estimation may improve robustness in multimodal emotion recognition under the evaluated setting.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027)

</details>
