### 311. [TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28335v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28335

**作者：** Mohammadreza Bakhtyari、Bogdan Mazoure、Renato Cordeiro de Amorim、Guillaume Rabusseau、Vladimir Makarenkov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28335v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28335v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TabK，把表格数据的簇数 k 估计表述为 amortized Bayesian 推断：用置换不变 Transformer 配合 Quantile Feature Encoder 从经验边缘分布提取免位置、内容驱动的表示，在合成先验上学习通用结构偏置，每个集成成员一次前向即可给出估计，50 个真实基准上 MAE 为 1.04。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉多模态推理无直接关系，但其「在合成先验下摊销训练 Transformer、单次前向近似离散隐变量后验并以集成体现不确定性」的做法，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的生成与筛选提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data

**abstract/A1：** Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 compared to 2.14 for the closest competitor. TabK also achieves the lowest average inference time, producing estimates in less than one second on average and running $2\\times$ faster than TabClustPFN and $30\\times$ faster than traditional CVIs such as Silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz. Code is available at https://github.com/mrbakhtyari/TabK.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 312. [Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28336v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28336

**作者：** Charles Weng、Alexander Martin、Sandra Arcos-Holzinger、Andrew Yates、Dixin Zheng、Yue Zhang、Landi Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28336v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28336v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 hard negative re-pairing（把每张图的 caption 换成相似图的 caption），检验 CKA 与 neighborhood agreement 是否真能识别单个图文配对：22 个图文模型中 CKA 仍高于保留八成原配对的随机重配，近邻一致性损失远小于完全崩溃的 top-1 检索，并给出尺度分解说明近邻对几乎不贡献 CKA。

**相关性简评：** 对 latent 相似度诊断有直接方法线索：CKA 类指标由池化尺度与多邻居主导，而非个体配对内容，可供核查用这类指标判断 latent 是否保留具体视觉细节时是否失真，以及聚合相似度与检索式证据之间的取舍。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Do vision and language models represent the world alike? That question hides three: what structure each modality has, whether the two modalities organize images and their captions alike, and whether a model ranks an image's own caption highly. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) and neighborhood agreement answer the second, yet matching and model selection use them as if they identified individual pairs and answered the third. To test this reading, we introduce hard negative re-pairing: every image receives the caption of a similar image, and nothing else changes. Although no image keeps its own caption and annotators judge a majority of the substituted captions wrong, CKA stays higher than under a random re-pairing that keeps 80% of the original pairs. In all 22 image-text models we test, neighborhood agreement loses far less than top-one retrieval, which collapses. The reason is scale: these diagnostics pool over many neighbors, matching and retrieval are decided among the nearest ones, and an exact decomposition shows that near-neighbor pairs contribute almost nothing to CKA. In the matching problems we test, an exact maximizer of CKA would not return the original pairing. On COCO and Flickr30k, the model with the highest diagnostic value retrieves worse on held-out data than the model chosen by validation recall, even where the two correlate positively. What re-pairing removes is the informative part: that share tracks retrieval on both datasets and ranks encoder pairs before alignment training. A diagnostic should be reported with its question and its scale, and tested against hard negative re-pairing.

**comment/C1：** 52 pages, including references and supplementary material

</details>

### 313. [Toward Adversarially Robust World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28345v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28345

**作者：** Ethan Rathbun、Jonathan Nöther、Christopher Amato、Alina Oprea、Goran Radanović

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28345v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28345v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对潜空间动态世界模型提出「状态幻觉」与「动态漂移」两类攻击，并给出分析潜空间鲁棒性的理论视角；在四个模型家族上验证，发现鲁棒编码器是鲁棒世界模型的关键，对抗训练可显著提升鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 其攻击可直接扰动 latent 状态、对抗训练则约束编码器，或可作为检验 LVR 内部状态是否真正保留任务必要视觉证据、以及信息坍缩的扰动诊断线索，但属具身世界模型场景，需核查可否迁移到 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Toward Adversarially Robust World Models

**abstract/A1：** Latent dynamic world models have proven to be highly versatile tools for embodied artificial intelligence systems, enabling online action planning, safe policy evaluation, and scalable policy learning. However, this versatility makes world models a vulnerable and centralized point of failure as a compromised model can impact planning, evaluation, and training at once. Therefore it is critical that the security and robustness properties of world models are properly understood before they are universally deployed in embodied AI systems. In this work we take a unifying approach towards this understanding, developing two novel attacks against world models, named state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks, aimed directly at impacting downstream systems, and proposing a new theoretical lens through which to study the robustness of latent dynamic world models. Through our analysis we identify robust latent space encoders as the key component of robust world models. We empirically validate this finding on four separate latent dynamic world model families, studying Dino World Model, Le World Model, r2Dreamer, and Cosmos 3, demonstrating significant improvements in robustness through adversarial encoder model training.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages

</details>

### 314. [Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28350v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28350

**作者：** Yihao Wu、Runjia Zeng、Tongyan Wang、Renzhong Huang、Chongzhou Fang、Qifan Wang、Fan Heng、Dongfang Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28350v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28350v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出现有 JEPA 世界模型只用单动作行为数据训练，局部线性近似下动作响应沿策略不变方向不可辨识；为此从同一恢复状态执行两个动作（fork futures），用结果差抵消状态项，并在训练期加入行为预测锚定与保持前驱可恢复的 lookback head，在三个视觉控制任务上提升规划成功率。

**相关性简评：** 成对反事实轨迹相减以消除状态项、并借可回溯头抑制 latent 信息坍缩，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的贡献分配与视觉信息保留监督提供可核查线索，但该工作属视觉控制世界模型，与 VLM 生成式推理仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare

**abstract/A1：** JEPA world models are trained to predict logged transitions but used to compare counterfactual actions from one state. The logged behavior data show one action per state, and under a local linear approximation we prove the action response is unidentified along any direction the policy never varies within a state. We therefore supplement behavior data with measured outcomes of alternative actions from the same state. Our fork futures execute two actions from one restored state, and their outcome difference cancels the state term, identifying the action response on the sampled span. The resulting model, Fork-JEPA, matches predicted to measured differences, anchors the logged successor with behavior prediction, and adds a lookback head that keeps the predecessor recoverable, all at training time, leaving planning unchanged. On three visual control tasks, behavior-only training leaves the predicted action effect no better than a constant guess. Fork-JEPA makes it readable and raises planning success by up to 14\\% over LeWM, its base model. Where the action response changes across hidden zones, it nearly doubles cross-zone success, and 1,024 fork pairs beat 1.2M extra behavior steps. Our project is available at https://fork-jepa.github.io/.

</details>

### 315. [Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28366v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28366

**作者：** Mason Kadem、Rong Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28366v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28366v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Cross-Site Transformer，依据心跳沿动脉树传播的延迟与变换结构，把多部位 PPG 的融合限制为站点之间的 cross-attention，在 WildPPG 上降低心率估计误差，并可沿有向路径做重采样消融来审计信息流。

**相关性简评：** 把融合限定为结构化的跨源注意力路径、再按路径方向做消融归因，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据与 latent 状态的选择性注入、以及各证据流的贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但任务与信号模态相距较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators

**abstract/A1：** Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along the arterial tree, appearing across body sites as delayed and transformed copies of the same cardiac event. We propose the Cross-Site Transformer, which introduces a hemodynamically informed inductive bias by restricting multi-sensor fusion to cross-attention between PPG sites. On WildPPG, the largest in-the-wild benchmark available, our model establishes a new single-model state of the art, reducing error by 21% over the previous best and 35% over the best prior transformer. The same cross-site restriction makes the trained network directly auditable. Because each cross-attention head lies on one directed pathway between sites, causal resample ablation can isolate and test each direction of information flow. Ablating the chest-to-wrist pathway doubles error, whereas the reverse costs far less. Encoding hemodynamic structure into attention routing thus improves real-world sensing robustness and enables rigorous auditing of multi-sensor fusion.

</details>

### 316. [CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28369v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28369

**作者：** Devansh Arpit

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28369v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28369v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 NTP 训练的 transformer 并不只依赖左文中的因果相关 token，给出因果世界模型的贝叶斯最优预测刻画，并提出把预测蒸馏到非因果数据视图的训练算法 CausalNTP，以逼近真实因果预测器并改善 OOD 泛化。

**相关性简评：** 「蒸馏到非因果视图、借 Occam 偏好只保留因果相关输入」这一训练监督思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、答案对 latent 内容的因果使用及贡献分配问题相关；但该文为纯文本设定、不涉及视觉 latent 状态，可供核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data

**abstract/A1：** This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.

</details>

### 317. [TOGO: Take One Image Editor, Get One Video Editor for Free](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28397v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28397

**作者：** Yixuan Luo、Jose Caballero、Yanjing Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28397v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28397v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TOGO：在共享 latent space 的图像编辑器与视频生成模型之间，把「指令下与中性提示下的 velocity 之差」作为 edit velocity 注入视频采样器，并据其仅在粗尺度、高噪声下可靠且跨帧不相关的特性，设计一个在噪声水平、空间与时间上受限的 guidance 算子，实现免训练视频编辑。

**相关性简评：** 论文对编辑器速度信号「何处、何噪声水平才可靠」的分析与门控注入方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据何时、如何注入 latent 状态以及 latent 内容可靠性判别提供可供核查的线索，但本身不研究多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TOGO: Take One Image Editor, Get One Video Editor for Free

**abstract/A1：** Instruction-based image editors are trained on millions of edit pairs and follow instructions far more reliably than current video editors. We show that this ability can be transferred to video editing without any training. Our key observation is that a growing number of image editors and video generators share the same latent space. Their velocity fields can therefore be combined at sampling time: the difference between the editor's velocity under the instruction and under a neutral prompt, which we call the \\emph{edit velocity}, can be added to the sampler of a video model. Added naively, however, it blurs the video, alters the background and flickers. An analysis of the edit velocity explains why. It is small and reliable only at coarse scales and high noise levels, not concentrated on the edited object, and uncorrelated across frames. From these properties, we derive a simple guidance operator that amplifies the edit velocity and restricts it in noise level, space, and time. The video model then turns the incoherent per-frame signal into a temporally coherent edit. Our method, TOGO, combines Qwen-Image-Edit with the Wan2.1 video model without training or fine-tuning. On FiVE-Bench, it raises the edit success rate from 47.0\\% (the same video model without the editor) to 65.6\\%, above the best published method (59.2\\%). At the same time, it maintains the background PSNR and obtains the best LPIPS and SSIM of all methods. Because the video editor is assembled at inference time, it can be upgraded to any newer image editor that shares the latent space with no cost.

</details>

### 318. [Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28402v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28402

**作者：** Yixuan Luo、Yanjing Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28402v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28402v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究自回归视频生成中大型模型在 rollout 的哪个位置才真正必要，发现让 14B 模型只生成首个 chunk、由 1.3B 模型续写可保留 95% 的语义优势，据此提出免训练的规划—渲染采样器 BigSmall，并用近似、窗口化、惰性的跨模型 KV cache 降低大模型进出 rollout 的开销。

**相关性简评：** 其「只在语义关键片段调用大模型、其余交给小模型延续」的计算分配，以及跨模型近似窗口 KV cache 的状态交接，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 latent 状态在模型间传递复用提供可供核查的线索，但领域为视频生成，需进一步判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).\`

</details>

### 319. [Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28442v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28442

**作者：** Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez、Danny Xie-Li、Fabian Fallas-Moya、Camile Lendering、Joaquín Figueira、Erkut Akdag、Giacomo D'Amicantonio、Egor Bondarev

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28442v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28442v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无需训练的小样本菠萝检测器：用支持图估计白化的前景-背景方向，对冻结视觉基础模型的稠密特征逐 patch 打分，再以自适应阈值与几何先验解码成框；另测试将预测相对深度直接送入 RGB 预训练冻结编码器，并发布航拍菠萝种植园数据集。

**相关性简评：** 对冻结特征做单一方向的线性打分，可视为「任务必要视觉信息能否从内部状态直接读出」的廉价诊断，其 patch 级证据打分与阈值化解码可供核查 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与停止判据；但论文不涉及多步推理或 latent 状态更新，迁移仅为方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection

**abstract/A1：** Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. We release the Pineapple Plantation dataset (4,908 aerial frames, 1,995 annotated with 17,609 boxes, predicted depth, leakage-aware splits) and analyse transfer to two further agricultural datasets.

**comment/C1：** Accepted in WACV HARVEST Vision Workshop 2027

</details>

### 320. [CAMA: Calibrated Anti-Collapse Marginal Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28461v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28461

**作者：** Jinho Kang、Yunhui Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28461v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28461v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析视觉语言模型在测试时适应中因特征压缩而使熵最小化走向类别坍缩的机理，并提出 CAMA：以批互信息最大化结合参考类别分布对齐来防止坍缩并恢复精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「不同图像特征趋同」的特征压缩诊断与 LVR 关注的信息坍缩相近，CAMA 的互信息加边际对齐目标可供核查能否用于抑制 latent 推理状态退化；但本文面向分类式 TTA，未涉及推理状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAMA: Calibrated Anti-Collapse Marginal Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model using unlabeled test data to help it handle distribution shifts. However, prior work has found that image corruption causes a vision-language model (VLM) to produce more similar features for different images, a phenomenon known as feature compression. Under compression, entropy minimization, the most common TTA objective, can cause the model to favor a few classes and perform worse than before adaptation. Despite these observations, a detailed analysis of how these failures are connected and an effective strategy for preventing them are still lacking. In this paper, we first analyze why entropy minimization fails for VLMs. We then propose CAMA, a new test-time adaptation objective that maximizes batch mutual information to encourage confident predictions for individual images while maintaining diverse predictions across the batch. CAMA also estimates a reference class distribution early in the test stream and aligns each batch's average prediction with this reference during adaptation. We prove that feature compression biases the predictions and that entropy minimization amplifies this bias into collapse, whereas CAMA is guaranteed to preserve every class. Across standard corruption benchmarks, we observe collapse on nearly every VLM backbone evaluated. CAMA prevents collapse in every observed case and, in turn, achieves the best accuracy on every backbone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses confirm that CAMA reverses the feature compression behind the collapse, and ablations show that each of its components contributes.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables

</details>

### 321. [HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28465v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28465

**作者：** Zhaodong Guo、Haoyun Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28465v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28465v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HiPPO-FM：先用 masked self-attention 在观测间交换内容，再把更新后的值投影到核平滑的 HiPPO-Legendre 特征上，经正则化 Gram 求解得到 rank-M 函数系数，从而把不规则历史写成可在任意时间坐标读取的固定大小状态，并给出子空间近似误差界；在 Spiral、UEA、事件与 PhysioNet 上评估。

**相关性简评：** 固定秩、按坐标查询的函数记忆及「子空间近似误差与学习记忆误差」的分离，可能为 LVR 中紧凑 latent 状态如何写入视觉证据、按需读取及容量/信息坍缩分析提供可核查的方法线索，但跨模态迁移尚待检验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Irregular time series are recorded at nonuniform times and are often queried at other times: between observations, after the last one, or on a regular grid. Continuous-time models answer such queries by integrating latent dynamics, and time-aware attention models answer them by revisiting the observation tokens. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), an attention operator that writes an irregular history into a rank-M function space with explicit time coordinates. Masked self-attention first exchanges content among the observations; the updated values are then contracted against kernel-smoothed HiPPO-Legendre features and solved through a regularized Gram matrix, so the retained coefficients define a function that is read at any time through the same features. The write and read have the form of an interdomain sparse Gaussian-process mean: every readout lies in an M-dimensional reproducing-kernel subspace, and a pointwise bound separates the approximation error of this subspace from the error of the learned memory. Removing the functional memory from the encoder raises Spiral reconstruction RMSE 18-fold. The full model has the lowest error in 11 of 12 Spiral settings, the highest overall accuracy and best average rank on 20 irregular UEA datasets, the highest event-type accuracy on all five multi-type event benchmarks, and a 21% lower extrapolation MSE than CRU on PhysioNet. Because the memory has fixed rank, the state retained after encoding keeps a fixed size as the history grows and is 102 times smaller than a token cache at 1,024 observations.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 322. [PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28476v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28476

**作者：** Pradeep Kumar Ragu Chanthar、Saksham Sahai Srivastava、Jaewoo Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28476v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28476v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PAMS 零阶优化框架：用前向激活统计在线追踪逐层低秩主导激活子空间及其谱，据此对扰动方差软重加权并做 trace 归一化，在无梯度、不构造稠密曲率矩阵的前提下实现预条件式 LLM 微调，并给出平滑偏差与非凸收敛分析及 GLUE/SuperGLUE 实验。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态 latent 推理无直接关系，但其在线的逐层低秩激活子空间与谱重加权可能为探查、扰动内部状态中承载视觉证据的方向提供工具线索，可供核查其能否用于 latent 表示几何分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning

**abstract/A1：** Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a computationally efficient approach to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), but conventional methods typically rely on isotropic perturbations that ignore the anisotropic structure of neural-network parameter spaces. We introduce Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace (PAMS), a ZO optimization framework that uses forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries without computing gradients or forming dense curvature matrices. PAMS tracks a low-rank approximation of the dominant activation subspace and its associated spectrum online, and uses the spectrum to softly reweight perturbation variance while preserving exploration in directions outside the retained subspace. A trace normalization separates the perturbation geometry from its overall scale, enabling consistent perturbation magnitudes across layers. We show theoretically that the resulting perturbation covariance induces right-side preconditioning of the gradient of the corresponding Gaussian-smoothed objective. We further characterize the estimator's smoothing bias and second moment and derive a nonconvex convergence guarantee that captures the effects of the perturbation geometry and smoothing radius. The proposed low-rank tracking procedure requires $\\mathcal{O}(n\_l r)$ persistent memory for a layer with input dimension nl and retained rank r, avoiding the $\\mathcal{O}(n\_l^2)$ memory required by a dense activation covariance. Experiments on transformer-based language-model fine-tuning tasks across GLUE and SuperGLUE demonstrate that PAMS improves the effectiveness and stability of zeroth-order optimization while retaining its gradient-free and objective-evaluation-based advantages.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to IEEE BigData 2026

</details>

### 323. [Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28483v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28483

**作者：** Santiago Rivadeneira Quintero

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文让 AI agent 在不做反向传播、不拟合任务样例答案的条件下，向预训练模型的既有层中插入门控注意力头与 MLP 神经元来写入新能力，并在六项 BBH 子任务、多位数乘法等场景验证单模块与组合效果，同时声称原模型输出分布保持不变（KL 为 0）。

**相关性简评：** 其「单次前向 vs 链式思维」对照与门控模块组合、对基础分布零扰动的训练-free 写入方式，可供核查 LVR 中少步/并行计算能否替代显式推理链，以及能力模块注入与副作用控制的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights

**abstract/A1：** We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. The agent also writes exact multiplication up to 20 digits, running the model only up to 6 (100.0% on the absent lengths of the sealed test in both models; a LoRA with the same budget: at most 2.1%). Sets, rules and report sentences were sealed in git before the first session (manifests timestamped in Bitcoin), with dated amendments listed in Appendix D; a frozen evaluator ran the sealed test once. Verdicts (H5: tracking; H6: composite; H8: one pass vs. chain of thought; H9: fresh and rewritten instances; H10: side effects; H12: multiplication), on the preregistered sealed test, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web\_of\_lies) success, H9 success, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success; Gemma-3-1B-it (H7: H5, H6, H8 and H9 in this model): H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web\_of\_lies) success, H8 (tracking 3) success, H9 partial, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success. Not everything worked: 4 of 45 single modules show small side effects and 5 of 50 sessions hit the 12-hour limit without a module.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 324. [VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28485v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28485

**作者：** Runheng Lin、Jialiang Shen、Jiyang Zheng、Ruiqi Liu、Zonglin He、Yu Yao、Huajie Chen、Chris Russell、Runqi Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28485v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28485v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 VICA 框架：对视频局部区域施加互补掩码，用冻结的 V-JEPA 从周围时空上下文预测被掩区域的表示，再比较预测与观测表示得到空间残差和双向时间残差，用于 AIGC 视频检测与篡改定位。

**相关性简评：** 「掩码区域表示预测 + 残差比较」这一线索可供核查：或可作为探测 VLM 内部状态是否保留局部视觉细节、并按上下文一致性筛选视觉证据的诊断信号，但其视频取证设定与 LVR 推理的迁移可行性尚待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization

**abstract/A1：** The rapid advancement of AI-generated content (AIGC) video generation and editing technologies has raised growing societal concerns about the authenticity and reliability of digital videos. Existing video detection methods primarily exploit temporal inconsistencies through holistic frame-level representations, whereas manipulation localization methods focus on artifacts within individual spatial regions. However, holistic representations may obscure localized artifacts through global feature aggregation, while region-centric approaches may overlook disagreements between individual regions and their surrounding spatiotemporal context. To address these limitations, we propose VIdeo Contextual Agreement (VICA), a unified framework that masks individual video regions and leverages a frozen V-JEPA model to predict their representations from the surrounding spatiotemporal context. Complementary masking ensures complete regional coverage, while context-conditioned predictions establish references for assessing regional agreement with the broader video context. By comparing predicted and observed representations, VICA derives spatial residuals that characterize intra-frame discrepancies and bidirectional temporal residuals that capture inconsistencies across preceding and subsequent frames. These residuals characterize contextual disagreements, providing a shared forensic representation for both tasks and shifting the focus from identifying isolated manipulation artifacts to assessing regional agreement with expectations inferred from the broader video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VICA achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across multiple benchmarks, with strong generalization to unseen video generators and editing methods.

</details>

### 325. [State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28508v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28508

**作者：** Yuxiang Wei、Zundong Wu、Weiyu Sun、Qizhen Lan、Yanteng Zhang、Vince D. Calhoun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28508v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28508v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Spectator：一个以联合嵌入预测目标训练的线性潜变量世界模型，用双时间尺度潜状态从 fMRI 历史推断脑状态并预测其受刺激驱动的演化；同时构建 BrainStateBench 评估状态推断、预测与更新。

**相关性简评：** 其持续潜状态、双时间尺度历史编码、新观测更新及用冻结线性探针区分刺激驱动与个体状态的设计，可能为 LVR 的潜伏工作区维护、视觉证据筛选和贡献归因提供方法线索，需核查线性状态转移与评估方式是否适用于视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28560v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28560v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SAFE-DRIFT 监督微调数据筛选框架：把「提升目标能力同时限制其他行为漂移」表述为带 Fisher 信息漂移预算的约束优化，得到对参考分布敏感方向降权的阻尼自然梯度闭式更新，并在共享低维子空间近似 Fisher 与目标梯度以实现可扩展估计，在代码与医学问答等任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其数据选择与漂移约束思路或可供核查 LVR 训练数据构造：例如在强化 latent 推理轨迹监督时限制视觉证据使用等旁路行为退化，但该联系纯属推测，原文未涉及多模态或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts

**abstract/A1：** We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. We evaluate SAFE-DRIFT against state-of-the-art data selection methods across diverse domains including coding and medical question answering, yielding competitive target performance while reducing degradation on specified off-target behaviors.

</details>

### 327. [Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28582v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28582

**作者：** Rongyi Zhu、Tanqiu Jiang、Fenglong Ma、Ting Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28582v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28582v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用 Re-Ranking 与 Preamble 两种 prompt 级受控攻击说明 self-rewarding optimization 的脆弱性，提出 self-reward fidelity（SRF）衡量自评奖励与 oracle 奖励的在线一致性，发现存在任务相关的相变阈值，并据此设计 Projection Decoupling Defense 抑制沿奖励生成器敏感方向的更新。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本自奖励训练，无视觉或 latent 状态，但 SRF 作为自监督可靠性诊断、阈值式相变与「对奖励敏感方向做梯度投影」的做法，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹训练的贡献分配与崩溃预警。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Self-rewarding optimization (SRO) promises to improve language models by enabling them to generate their own reward signals. Yet when and how SRO succeeds or fails remains poorly understood. We reveal that SRO is fundamentally fragile: even seemingly benign perturbations to training prompts can corrupt the self-generated preference signal and trigger iterative collapse. We demonstrate this through two prompt-level attacks that serve as controlled stress tests: a Re-Ranking attack that concentrates training on prompts where self-reward diverges from an oracle, and a Preamble attack that learns short prefixes inflating self-reward without any gain in oracle quality. To explain why these attacks succeed, we introduce self-reward fidelity (SRF), a metric quantifying on-policy agreement between self-evaluated and oracle rewards. We show that SRF can serve as a diagnostic signal of self-supervision reliability, and that controlled SRF perturbations induce a phase-transition region: SRO improves when SRF remains sufficiently high, but collapses once SRF drops below a model- and task-dependent threshold. This analysis motivates Projection Decoupling Defense, which suppresses SRO update components along directions to which the reward generator is locally sensitive, improving SRO robustness under adversarial conditions. This work sheds light on the fragility of SRO and charts promising directions toward making it more robust.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 32 figures

</details>

### 328. [OKB-CFM: Observation-Keyed Barycentric Conditional Flow Matching for Unpaired Sparse-to-Dense Cardiac Shape Completion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28600v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28600

**作者：** Kangneng Zhou、Shuang Song、Yitian Zhao、Dian Song、Yujia Wang、Xinghua Zhang、Li Wang、Xi Li、Hao Dai、Feng Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28600v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28600v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究稀疏心脏电影 MRI 标签到稠密形状的补全，提出观测为键的条件流匹配框架：独立训练的 VAE 编码稀疏观测与稠密形状，用固定键值记忆检索候选稠密编码，匹配网络将其聚合为查询相关的重心端点，再由端点条件流把稀疏编码输运至该端点。

**相关性简评：** 其「稀疏观测为键→潜在空间检索候选→多候选端点可作备选补全」的机制，可能为 LVR 中依据部分视觉证据筛选潜在假设、产生多个终点状态提供线索；需核查检索是否真由观测内容驱动而非队列先验，且评估基于模拟稠密参考重构。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OKB-CFM: Observation-Keyed Barycentric Conditional Flow Matching for Unpaired Sparse-to-Dense Cardiac Shape Completion

**abstract/A1：** Completing cardiac segmentations from sparse cine magnetic resonance labels is challenging because acquired planes do not uniquely determine the underlying anatomy and patient-matched dense annotations are rarely available. We propose observation-keyed barycentric conditional flow matching for completion between clinically unpaired cohorts. Independently trained variational autoencoders represent sparse observations and dense shapes. A fixed memory associates simulated sparse keys with their source dense encodings, enabling candidate retrieval within the sparse latent space. A matching network aggregates the retrieved values into a query-dependent barycentric endpoint, toward which an endpoint-conditioned flow transports the sparse encoding. Individual candidate values provide alternative completion endpoints. On 327 real unpaired inputs, the method obtains encoder-feature Fréchet and squared maximum mean discrepancy scores of 7.93 and 2.02 after scaling by 10,000 and 10,000,000, respectively, corresponding to reductions of 47.0\\% and 94.2\\% relative to contrastive unpaired translation. On a 34-file simulated test partition, evaluation against dense-VAE-reconstructed references yields a five-class mean Dice of 0.889, squared Chamfer distance of 6.15 square voxels, 95th-percentile surface distance of 3.88 voxels, and average symmetric surface distance of 1.50 voxels. These results characterize cohort-level feature agreement, observed-label consistency, and reconstruction under the stated reference construction. By complementing routine cine-based functional assessment with inferred multi-chamber anatomical context, this framework provides a basis for investigating how chamber morphology and spatial relationships relate to cardiac function.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 329. [Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28603v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28603

**作者：** Zeyi Huang、Jiuxiang Gu、Eli Shechtman、Yong Jae Lee、Zongze Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28603v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28603v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对教师规模增大时蒸馏收益递减甚至反转的问题，提出在固定主干参数下用 weight-shared looping 与 cross-token recurrence 扩展学生的有效容量，并在预训练 KD 与数学后训练的教师强制 KD/OPD 中比较两者，还展示了把预训练 LLM 直接微调为循环架构的路径。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本蒸馏工作，但其对「loop 式与跨 token 递归」的区分、递归深度与容量吸收关系以及近 vanilla 推理延迟，可能为 LVR 的循环状态更新与动态计算成本提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from large language models to smaller students, yet stronger teachers do not always yield better students. Recent studies report diminishing or even negative returns from teacher scaling. We hypothesize that these limitations arise in part from insufficient student capacity to absorb the teacher's knowledge. We therefore investigate loop and recurrent computation as a way to expand the student's effective capacity by modifying its computation graph while keeping the backbone parameter count fixed. Under teacher-forced KD during pretraining, weight-shared looping improves performance but retains teacher-size saturation, whereas cross-token recurrence avoids the observed reversal with larger teachers. In mathematical post-training under both teacher-forced KD and on-policy distillation (OPD), recurrent students scale better with increasing teacher size than looped and vanilla LLMs do. Crucially, we show that a pretrained LLM can be readily fine-tuned into a looped or recurrent architecture jointly with OPD, without repeating pretraining. Our recurrent Qwen model improves with larger teachers and consistently outperforms looped and vanilla LLMs. This suggests a new post-training paradigm that integrates architectural conversion into distillation, avoiding a separate conversion stage while substantially improving student performance and maintaining near-vanilla inference latency.

</details>

### 330. [Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28611v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28611

**作者：** Emil Mittag、Richard Dazeley、Peter Vamplew

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28611v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28611v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ACTI 检测器，用前向与后向转移似然之比、按时间步对照分布内画像校准并做短窗平滑，在 OOD-RL-Bench 六个环境中做 OOD 状态检测，并与 PEDM 等基线比较，最终推荐更快的 forward-only 版本。

**相关性简评：** 其「前向/后向转移似然差＋逐步校准＋窗口平滑」的在线序列打分，可能可迁移为 latent 推理轨迹的可靠性或异常信号乃至停止判据，其不使用未来信息的设定可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement-learning agents shape the observations they encounter; consequently, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) states requires analysing action-conditioned trajectories rather than treating inputs as independent samples. We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), a detector that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods, calibrates this comparison against the in-distribution profile at each timestep, and smooths the score over a short window, using no future information. We tested ACTI across six environments and fifteen detectors within OOD-RL-Bench, using the four anomaly mechanisms that qualified in every environment, with ten policy replicates per environment. All primary metrics are matched-time: each score after anomaly onset is compared with a clean twin rollout's score at the same timestep. Our method secured the top macro matched-time AUROC, outperforming the dynamics-model baseline (PEDM), while scoring transitions roughly two orders of magnitude faster. Compared to the state-only variant, ACTI achieved a small but consistent AUROC gain and a shorter detection delay. The capacity-matched forward-only baseline, ACTI-Forward, secured a statistically significant advantage in AUPRC alongside a reduced detection delay. The discrepancy in AUROC did not reach statistical significance. Ablation studies suggest instead that performance improvements stem from action conditioning, calibration at each timestep, and smoothing of the transition-likelihood scores. Based on these results, we recommend using ACTI-Forward.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 331. [Internalized Experience: How Training Data Shapes Memory Formation in LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28613v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28613

**作者：** Xianxuan Long、Xinnan Dai、Kai Guo、Jiliang Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28613v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28613v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 FSMem，用有限状态机的状态转移框架构造训练数据，在合成世界、经典规划与代码执行任务上考察数据内容与组织方式如何影响 LLM 对可复用任务规则的内化，发现动作类型多样性会损害规则学习、单一执行深度导致深度特化，而长短轨迹混合语料可用更少 token 取得更好效果。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本工作、未涉及 latent 状态，但其「执行深度特化」与长短轨迹混合训练的证据，可供核查 LVR 中多步 latent 轨迹监督的数据组织、长度泛化与停止深度选择问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Internalized Experience: How Training Data Shapes Memory Formation in LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Parametric memory enables large language models (LLMs) to retain information from past experience and reuse it in subsequent tasks. Yet how training data supports the internalization of reusable task rules remains unclear. We introduce FSMem (Finite-State Machine Memory), a state-transition framework for constructing training data and studying how data content and organization shape memory formation. We evaluate rule reuse across synthetic worlds, classical planning, and code execution through valid-action identification and execution-outcome prediction, complemented by next-operation prediction in code. Our experiments reveal several systematic learning patterns. Under matched training conditions, even unchanged task rules become harder to internalize when learned alongside a larger variety of action types; by contrast, scaling the training data to provide broader state-action coverage generally improves rule learning. We further find that training at a single execution depth produces depth-specialized behavior, with models performing best when training and test executions have similar lengths. Motivated by this finding, we construct cumulative corpora that combine short and long trajectories, which can outperform long-trajectory-only training while using fewer training tokens. Together, these results demonstrate that the same task rules can be internalized differently depending on how execution experience is constructed, and that understanding these learning patterns can guide the design of more effective training data for parametric memory.

</details>

### 332. [VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28617v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28617

**作者：** Saeid Rajabi、Chengmo Yang、Satwik Patnaik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28617v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28617v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 VeriLadder：一个五级 Verilog 数据集及多智能体规格精化框架，由 EDA 合成器与形式等价检查器决定接受与否，保留失败规格与反例，并加入改写与单点变异硬负例；用其微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 后 VerilogEval v2 功能 pass@1 从 31.7% 升至 50.0%。

**相关性简评：** 「另一模型家族仅凭规格重建出等价电路」可视为信息充分性判据，加之反例留存与单点变异负例，可能为 LVR 的内部状态是否保留任务必要信息的检验、以及监督信号构造提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets

**abstract/A1：** Training data is a bottleneck in AI, especially for large language models (LLMs) that write Verilog, because register-transfer-level (RTL) code is rarely published and existing datasets mostly check code for syntax, not instruction correctness. This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset, and the multi-agent framework that builds it, in which LLM agents write and revise specifications, and EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker) decide what is accepted. Its levels follow an engineer's checks. Level 1 labels designs from two large Verilog corpora, namely RTLCoder and PyraNet, with synthesis results, failure causes, critical warnings and post-synthesis metrics. 28% of RTLCoder designs fail synthesis and are kept as negatives. Level 2 grades each instruction on four specification qualities, and low grades predict failed rebuilds. Level 3 rewrites each instruction into a refined specification and accepts it only if an LLM from another model family, reading only that specification, writes a circuit formally equivalent to the original. This raises the share of rebuildable designs from 26.1% to 78.2%, keeping every failed specification with its counterexample. Levels 4 and 5 add verified paraphrases and one-fact variants, hard negatives that differ only in one behavior from the verified design. VeriLadder labels the synthesizability of 716,627 designs and, from RTLCoder, provides 11,247 refined specifications, 32,393 paraphrases and 8,397 one-fact variants. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on VeriLadder raises functional pass@1 from 31.7% to 50.0% on VerilogEval v2 and from 35.0% to 45.2% on RTLLM v2. The dataset and fine-tuned models are publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 28 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 333. [Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28621v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28621

**作者：** Yukinori Yamamoto、Kotaro Yoshida、Ryotaro Shimizu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28621v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28621v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把 LatentQA 从 LLM 激活扩展到扩散模型，提出 DAO：用自然语言问答解读去噪过程中的中间激活，并据此描述最终图像内容、引导生成属性、以及通过 attribution patching 定位相关组件。

**相关性简评：** 「用开放问题读出中间激活内容」的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要的视觉细节，以及不同深度/步数的状态可解码性差异；但对象是图像生成而非 VLM 推理，迁移性需阅读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interpreting Diffusion Model Activations in Natural Language

**abstract/A1：** Interpreting the intermediate activations of diffusion models (DMs) is key to understanding how they generate images. Existing interpretability methods for DMs provide limited support for open-ended interrogation, making it difficult to extract human-interpretable insights. We extend LatentQA, the task of answering natural-language questions about Large Language Model activations, to DM activations. We introduce the Diffusion-specific Activation Oracle (DAO), which translates DM activations into natural-language answers to open-ended questions about the ongoing generation. Our experiments show that DAO can effectively describe the content of the final image from activations at early denoising steps. Additionally, we demonstrate that DAO captures the structure of the DM's activation space well enough to steer image generation toward target attributes. Furthermore, we show that attribution patching through DAO identifies DM components that contribute to visual attributes specified in natural language. Our code is available \\href{https://github.com/yamanoko/dao/tree/main}{here}.

</details>

### 334. [Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28629v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28629

**作者：** Yuan Wu、Zhiqiang Yan、Zhengxue Wang、Guangfa Wang、Jun Li、Jian Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28629v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28629v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SAP 场景自适应投影框架，用冻结深度模型预测的度量深度作为几何先验，引导多视图到 3D 的视角变换：先按先验支持区域构造混合参考点集，再用径向学习偏移在多个候选位置聚合特征，在 Occ3D 上取得最优结果并可提升多种占据框架。

**相关性简评：** 其「按几何先验分配参考点」与「多候选偏移聚合以补偿估计误差」的思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、采样预算分配及内部状态中的几何信息保真提供参考，但该文属纯 3D 感知任务，能否迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection

**abstract/A1：** Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction infers voxel-wise geometry and semantics from multi-view images, where 2D-to-3D view transformation is a crucial step. Many existing methods adopt a backward-projection paradigm, projecting uniformly distributed 3D reference points onto image planes to aggregate multi-view features. However, their scene-agnostic sampling patterns overlook the non-uniform distribution of scene geometry, allocating many references to empty space and reducing sampling efficiency under a fixed sampling budget. To address this challenge, we propose SAP, a scene-adaptive projection framework that leverages depth-based geometric priors to guide view transformation. Specifically, we back-project metric depth maps predicted by a frozen depth model into 3D space to obtain geometric priors. To leverage these priors, we design a Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder comprising two complementary components. First, Prior-Guided Reference Generation constructs a hybrid reference set for feature sampling, allocating references within prior-supported height regions and retaining full-range sampling where valid support is unavailable. Furthermore, to account for potential spatial misalignment caused by depth estimation errors, Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation explores multiple candidate locations through learned radial offsets to aggregate potentially displaced feature evidence. Extensive experiments on Occ3D demonstrate that SAP achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently improves results across diverse occupancy frameworks.

</details>

### 335. [Mitigating Backdoors in Masked Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28640

**作者：** Chengzhong Wang、Lang Lin、Shengfang Zhai、Chenru Wang、Daniel Yiming Cao、Sheng-Yen Chou、Jiaheng Zhang、Pin-Yu Chen、Shengwei An

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28640v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28640v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 masked diffusion language model 的后门威胁提出 UNMASK 防御框架，利用触发词的「特异性」与「支配性」为每个输入 token 打可疑度分数，实现含触发输入检测、触发 token 定位与后门移除。

**相关性简评：** 其用并行预测与任意位置 token 重建来逐 token 打分定位关键输入，方法与「定位驱动 latent 推理结论的视觉证据 token」及贡献分配问题形式相近，可供核查是否能迁移到多模态 token 级归因。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mitigating Backdoors in Masked Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models because they can predict multiple tokens in parallel rather than generating tokens sequentially. However, recent studies have shown that MDLMs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks: when an input contains an attacker-chosen trigger, a backdoored model generates a targeted output, such as malicious code, while otherwise behaving normally. Despite this threat, backdoor defenses for MDLMs remain largely underexplored. We present UNMASK, the first defense framework for MDLMs that detects trigger-containing inputs, localizes the trigger tokens, and removes the backdoor from the compromised model. UNMASK exploits two fundamental properties of backdoor triggers, specificity and dominance, to assign a suspiciousness score to each input token. By leveraging two distinctive capabilities of MDLMs, parallel token prediction and token reconstruction at arbitrary positions, UNMASK computes these scores both effectively and efficiently. We further provide a theoretical analysis supporting the design of UNMASK. Evaluations across 40 settings spanning two attacks and four models show that UNMASK detects 99.3% of trigger-containing inputs at a 5% false-positive rate, substantially outperforming the strongest adapted baseline, which achieves 54.8%. UNMASK also achieves over 99% trigger-localization accuracy and reduces the average attack success rate from 95% to 1%, while largely preserving the model's utility on clean inputs.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 Hand2CAD：215K 合成与 1,000 组真人手绘三视图—CAD 程序基准，并构建 OrthoLatentCAD，在正投影平面上融合局部几何与全局上下文、按共享轴坐标跨视图交换证据，再通过冻结 CAD 自编码器的查询把空间表示映射为有序程序 latent。

**相关性简评：** 其跨视图几何证据对齐与“视觉特征—程序 latent”对齐可供核查 LVR 中几何信息是否保留在内部状态、latent 如何与输出表示接口；但该方法是单次前向的图到程序生成，未涉及推理期状态迭代或动态计算，迁移价值需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OrthoLatentCAD: Orthographic Spatial Latents for Hand-Drawn CAD Program Generation

**abstract/A1：** Freehand orthographic drawings capture early design intent, yet recovering executable sketch--extrude CAD programs from raster front, right, and top views remains challenging: noisy, dimension-free 2D layouts must be reconciled into an ordered construction history. We introduce Hand2CAD, a benchmark of 215K ABC-derived synthetic orthographic-drawing--CAD program pairs and 1,000 real three-view sets drawn by CAD-trained participants. Recovering CAD programs from orthographic drawings requires both cross-view geometric reasoning and alignment between visual features and program representations. We propose OrthoLatentCAD to address these two challenges. It fuses local geometry with global context on canonical planes, exchanges evidence between paired plane lines indexed by the same shared-axis coordinate, and maps the spatial representation to ordered program latents through queries inherited from a frozen CAD autoencoder. Across the evaluated one- to three-view configurations, OrthoLatentCAD outperforms protocol-matched baselines in procedural accuracy, compiled geometry, and CAD-kernel validity while benefiting from additional views. Without real-data fine-tuning, it also outperforms the baselines on held-out real drawings. We will release the dataset, code, and evaluation scripts.

### 337. [Beyond Full-Context Accuracy: Context-Marginalized Evaluation of Test-Time Structure-Aware Inference in EEG-to-Image Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28648v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28648

**作者：** Ke Xiao、Banghua Yang、Yingjie Li、Hang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28648v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28648v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Context-Marginalized Retrieval Evaluation（CMRE），在采样的查询上下文中重复评估 EEG-to-image 检索的测试时结构化推理，把「结构可利用性」与「上下文稳健性」分离，并发现全上下文下最优的推理规则在多数缩减上下文中不再最优。

**相关性简评：** 其「测试期利用无标签查询间关系」及按上下文边际化评估的做法可供核查：LVR 中基于 latent 相似度的推理收益是否同样依赖查询集组成，以及能否用同查询一致性刻画稳健性，尚需读原文确认可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Full-Context Accuracy: Context-Marginalized Evaluation of Test-Time Structure-Aware Inference in EEG-to-Image Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Test-time structure-aware inference can improve cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval by exploiting relations among unlabeled test queries, but it also makes predictions depend on query-set composition. Existing evaluations typically report accuracy under a single full-query context, leaving unclear whether gains and comparative conclusions hold as context changes. We introduce Context-Marginalized Retrieval Evaluation (CMRE), which repeatedly evaluates each target query in sampled contexts using the corresponding rows of a fixed query-gallery similarity matrix. CMRE distinguishes structural exploitability, quantified by gains over independent retrieval, from context robustness, measured by same-query Top-1 context consistency. Under leave-one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2 across six frozen representations and six structure-aware inference rules, structure-aware inference improves full-context Top-1 accuracy by up to 20.40 percentage points over independent retrieval. However, the rule selected under full-context evaluation is no longer optimal in 17 of 24 representation-context-size conditions (70.8%). Selecting the full-context winner incurs an average loss of 2.70 percentage points and a maximum loss of 8.29 percentage points under reduced contexts. Representation rankings are likewise inference- and context-dependent: the ordering under independent retrieval is not consistently preserved under structure-aware inference. Moreover, larger retrieval gains do not necessarily imply greater context robustness, showing that retrieval effectiveness and prediction stability provide complementary views of structure-aware inference. Full-context accuracy captures one operating point of context-dependent inference. CMRE complements it by characterizing how structural gains, context consistency, and comparisons of rules and representations change with query context.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28650

**作者：** Ming Cheung

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28650v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28650v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出先构造探针问题诱导模型自报身份，再在 LoRA 模块内定位并消融高幅值权重，以移除模型身份标识，并在 Qwen3.5-2B、Gemma4-E2B 上检验移除率与通用能力保持。

**相关性简评：** 其「探针式微调定位参数子集 + 定向权重消融」可迁移为一种核查线索：用参数级或状态级消融检验 latent 内容是否为答案所实际使用，以及贡献分配是否集中于局部子集；与视觉推理本身无直接关系，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unlearning Model Identity: Ablating LoRA Weights from Question-Based Identity Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models are trained on diverse corpora containing outputs from proprietary teacher models and provider-curated sources. Models subsequently inherit embedded self-identity traits, persistently asserting specific proprietary names. Service providers of open-weight models frequently require the removal of model identity for downstream applications, such as custom interfaces, without exposing provider affiliations to end-users. Effective identity modification is therefore critical for customized model alignment and deployment. This study proposes a method to localize parameter-level representations of self-identity within low-rank adaptation modules to perform targeted weight ablation. By generating probing questions designed to elicit self-naming outputs and fine-tuning the base model on these responses, the approach identifies and ablates high-magnitude weights within the parameter set. Experimental results demonstrate that distilled identity traits reside within a localized subset of low-rank weights, achieving a complete removal rate in Qwen3.5-2B and a 10% rate in Gemma4-E2B while preserving general task capabilities. These findings confirm that ablating top-tier adaptation weights suppresses distilled self-identification without compromising broader model performance.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 339. [Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28654v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28654

**作者：** Youheng Zhu、Chenyang Wang、Minshuo Chen、Yiping Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28654v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28654v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对奖励引导扩散采样中近似值函数引入的偏差，以及每步全多项重采样的 SMC 粒子数须随引导深度线性增长的问题，提出无梯度 Stein Guidance：用中心化高斯候选的值加权选择近似梯度引导，并以整路径独立 Metropolis-Hastings 校正；在均匀值与空间正则假设下给出不随引导深度增长的误差界。

**相关性简评：** 其「每步仅少量查询＋路径级 MH 校正替代逐步粒子重采样」的做法，可能为扩散式 latent 推理中沿轨迹施加价值引导、以粒子搜索筛选推理状态提供降低粒子数与计算成本的线索；但论文无多模态实验，与 LVR 的对应关系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stein Guidance without Gradients: Discretization Uniform Diffusion Inference Time Scaling beyond Particle SMC

**abstract/A1：** Reward-guided diffusion requires effective steering and correction of the bias introduced by approximate value functions. A Brownian example shows that SMC with full multinomial resampling at every step can require particle counts to grow linearly with guidance depth to maintain accuracy. We propose Stein Guidance, which combines derivative-free guidance with whole-path independence Metropolis-Hastings correction. Value-weighted selection from centered Gaussian candidates approximates gradient guidance in expectation, using as few as two queries per step. Centering stabilizes the local normalizer estimates, and the same queries yield an explicit path weight for correction. Under uniform value and spatial regularity bounds, we prove superpolynomial decay of finite-grid total variation error in the number of MH updates, with constants that do not grow with guidance depth. The error prefactor tends to zero as the value functions approach exact Doob values and the time grid is refined.

</details>

### 340. [UACR: Uncertainty-Aware Collaborative Routing for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Inspection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28655v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28655

**作者：** Yiwei Li、Qiyang Chen、Zheming Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28655v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28655v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UACR 两阶段框架用于工业异常检测：先离线训练检测模块并校准不确定性估计器，再按样本不确定性将输入协同路由到不同检测路径，在在线时延预算下兼顾精度、效率与可解释性。

**相关性简评：** 其「按不确定性分配计算、疑难样本走更深路径」的路由与校准机制，可供核查是否用于 LVR 中动态计算分配与停止决策的触发信号设计，但应用域与推理状态表示距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UACR: Uncertainty-Aware Collaborative Routing for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Inspection

**abstract/A1：** Industrial anomaly inspection requires not only accurate anomaly discrimination but also trustworthy explanations for operators, while satisfying the strict latency constraints of online inspection. Existing methods, however, typically apply a fixed computational path to all samples, making it difficult to strike a good balance among detection accuracy, inference efficiency, and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose UACR, an uncertainty-aware collaborative routing framework for explainable industrial anomaly inspection. UACR aims to deliver reliable anomaly decisions together with operator-facing explanations under the online inspection budget, while adaptively allocating computation so that ambiguous cases receive deeper scrutiny. The framework consists of two stages. Stage I, Offline Training and Routing Hyperparameter Search, learns the anomaly inspection modules and calibrates the uncertainty estimator that drives routing. Stage II, Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Routing, collaboratively dispatches each input across inspection paths according to its estimated uncertainty. Experimental results on multiple public datasets show that UACR achieves over 5.16% improvement in accuracy compared to the baseline method, while reducing latency by over 31.5%. It also enhances the interpretability of industrial detection by over 15%.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 341. [RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28666v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28666

**作者：** Sarosij Bose、Gitika Karumuri、Chenqi Li、Allen Tu、Srikumar Sastry、Mellon Zhang、Avinash Ravichandran、Alexander Schwing、Konstantinos Karydis、Amit K. Roy Chowdhury

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28666v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28666v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RecallWorld，为具身视频世界模型加入持久记忆：将短多视角片段联合重建为几何互相独立的 Scenelet，用覆盖率检索挑选互补历史片段，并在外观融合前做目标视角的几何可见性判定，以缓解智能体重访场景时的几何与外观漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其「分块情景记忆＋覆盖率检索＋几何可见性筛选」的可供核查线索，可能对应 LVR 中视觉细节与几何证据的长期保留、按需召回及误差累积抑制；但论文任务是视频生成，迁移到推理期状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models

**abstract/A1：** Video world models generate plausible novel views but often lack persistent memory, failing to preserve a place's geometry and appearance when an agent revisits a scene. A central challenge is how previous views should be effectively used for creating memory. Reconstructing them independently underutilizes geometric constraints between nearby views, while repeatedly reconstructing a growing history can propagate later prediction errors into earlier geometry. We introduce RecallWorld, a persistent embodied video world model that jointly reconstructs short multi-view episodes into Scenelets while keeping geometry independent across episodes. Starting from a single source image, camera-aware ray lifting places perspective and native fisheye images in a common world frame, retaining wide-field content for perspective generation. Each generated segment extends the Scenelet memory and conditions subsequent generation. Coverage-based retrieval selects complementary Scenelets from the full history, while target-view visibility is resolved geometrically before appearance fusion, providing consistent memory conditioning for guiding subsequent generation. Across four datasets, RecallWorld improves revisit PSNR over the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.6 dB on partial revisits and 3.9 dB on full cycles, demonstrating substantially stronger preservation of scene identity across exploration and return.

</details>

### 342. [Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28669v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28669

**作者：** Maohao Ran、Yanting Zhang、Chendong Ma、Jun Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28669v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28669v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 72 种物理机制上考察 LLM 是否会把公式用到有效范围之外，并比较 RLVR、少量示例 SFT 加 RL、以及由教师提供正确公式的蒸馏等训练后手段能否改善这种「区分物理适用区间」的推理。

**相关性简评：** 虽属纯文本科学计算且不涉及 latent 或视觉，但其「适用条件是否被保留并真正用于答案」的诊断，以及用教师给出的正确中间公式监督、可验证奖励训练的线索，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹监督与贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 9 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information appended. Code and data: https://github.com/acodercat/AtmosRegime

### 343. [Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28680v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28680

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向高风险的肿瘤病理分期与生存预测任务，先搭建多模态证据驱动的临床 Agent 流程 CliAgent，再提出 Semantic PID-RSI：借鉴 PID 控制，用 P/I/D 三种诊断角色筛选候选修改批次，并把选中方案编译为行为契约分阶段探测与独立采纳判定。

**相关性简评：** 其「用历史试验与响应动态估计回归风险来抑制递归自改进过拟合」的控制式反馈思路，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的迭代训练监督与贡献分配提供可核查的稳定化线索；但论文本身不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement

**abstract/A1：** High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.

</details>

### 344. [CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28682v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28682

**作者：** Yi Wang、Yubo Zhao、Chi-Keung Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28682v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28682v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CHORD，两阶段 rectified-flow 框架生成文本驱动的 3D 人-物交互动作：第一阶段用每时间片 12 个 part token 联合规划物体 6-DoF 轨迹、接触状态与各运动链的首末端关节，并在每个 flow step 用闭式 clean estimate 解码交互、与物体表面比对后把反馈路由回对应 token；第二阶段固定该计划并补全其余肢体与手指关节。

**相关性简评：** 其「紧凑 part token 计划 + 闭式估计解码 + 表面测量反馈回路由到责任 token、零额外前向」可能在方法上可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何被证据测量并局部修正、以及贡献分配与停止/迭代决策的线索，但领域为动作生成，与 VLM 推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition

**abstract/A1：** Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

</details>

**内容简述：** 用 CANDOR 语料为 710 位真人构建 LLM「AI 分身」，让其在 5,680 场模拟初次对话中互相见面，再用真实见面后的喜好评分检验预测力，并比较拟人化风格微调与小型 appraisal head 的作用。

**相关性简评：** 其 swap control、偏相关与「对话通道而非 persona card」的归因协议，可能可供核查 latent 推理中答案是否真正经由动态状态而非静态旁路获得信息；但该工作纯文本、无视觉输入，仅作方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?

**abstract/A1：** Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($ρ$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $ρ$=0.16 \[0.05, 0.26\]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 \[-0.294, -0.066\]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 \[0.001, 0.115\], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 \[-0.001, 0.111\]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.
