**相关性简评：** 其「何时承诺或延迟」策略及轨迹级及时性、稳定性奖励，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与提交后状态稳定性提供训练和评价线索；但无视觉或 latent 状态机制，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).

### 384. [Mirrored Min-of-K Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29008v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29008

**作者：** Jiaru Zhang、Zeyun Deng、Hyunsoo Yun、Yupeng Zhou、Bingyao Du、Juntong Peng、Zichong Yang、Can Cui、Chuheng Wei、Ruqi Zhang、Ziran Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29008v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29008v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析 Min-of-K 训练中 K 值导致的 mode dropping 与分布平坦化偏差，并提出 mirrored MoK：额外采样一个候选，并以候选间距离修正训练目标，以改善数据分布恢复。

**相关性简评：** 其多候选「选最近者」及候选间相对距离目标，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的多样性、覆盖与候选择优监督提供可核查线索，但并非直接研究视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mirrored Min-of-K Training

**abstract/A1：** Min-of-K (MoK) training is widely used to train models that produce diverse outputs from random noise. For each target, it draws K outputs from the model and backpropagates only through the one closest to the target. However, MoK generally does not make the generated distribution match the data distribution. In this paper, we analyze the MoK bias across all values of K and show that tuning K shifts between failure modes, from mode dropping at small K to distribution flattening at large K. We further prove that every nontrivial loss based only on target-candidate distances fails to recover some data distribution, since these distances do not reveal how the candidates are placed relative to each other. Based on these analyses, we propose mirrored MoK (MMoK), a drop-in modification of MoK training that draws one extra sample from the model, applies the closest-candidate selection rule against it, and subtracts the resulting distance. Since this distance is measured between samples of the model, it provides additional information about how the candidates are placed relative to each other. We prove that MMoK can in principle recover data distributions that MoK cannot. We empirically validate MMoK on five scenarios, namely synthetic mixtures, pedestrian and vehicle trajectory prediction, tropical cyclone forecasting, robotic policy learning, and ambiguous medical image segmentation. The results confirm the effectiveness and generality of MMoK in both distribution learning and task performance.

</details>

**内容简述：** 构建 T2ISpec 基准（1400 条提示，覆盖七类渲染主题与两档难度），从延迟、目标模型计算量和图像质量三方面评估 AR 与扩散/流式投机解码，并提出免重训的 TopicRoute 提示路由加缓存控制插件。

**相关性简评：** 图像生成不属 VLM 推理主线，但其「目标计算量大幅下降未必带来延迟收益」的成本拆分以及按主题分层的评测方式，可能为 LVR 中投机/缓存加速与动态计算的收益评估提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** T2ISpec: Benchmarking Speculative Decoding for Text-to-Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-image (T2I) generators produce detailed images but remain slow at inference. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost, yet its behavior across the rendering requirements of T2I prompts remains insufficiently understood. We introduce T2ISpec, a benchmark of 1,400 prompts balanced across seven rendering topics and two difficulty levels. It evaluates autoregressive and diffusion/flow accelerators by latency, work performed by the target model, and image quality. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) aggregate results hide large differences between topics, (2) alignment and preference scores can disagree with prompt constraint satisfaction, and (3) large reductions in target work can yield limited latency gains. Motivated by these findings, we propose TopicRoute, a plugin that combines prompt routing with speculative and cache controls without retraining the generator. Across six model--method pairs, it achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.0308x over the native methods, and the speedup carries over to external prompts with the same settings, while quality gains and losses vary across configurations.

</details>

### 386. [Certified Comparative Statics for Conservation-Law Equilibrium Layers, with an Application to RNA Interference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29050v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29050

**作者：** Shadi Khodagholi、Sara Karimi、Niloofar Yousefi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29050v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29050v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究守恒律平衡层（隐式层）比较静态的符号认证：证明当残差 Jacobian 为非奇异 M-matrix 时输入—输出灵敏度符号可被认证，并给出失效的相边界，在 siRNA 脱靶竞争等真实数据上验证；作为可训练层可在端到端学习中保持认证单调性。

**相关性简评：** 隐式固定点层的灵敏度符号认证与「按构造保持单调」可能为 LVR 中循环推理状态如何随视觉证据更新、以及输入到输出的贡献分配提供可核查线索，但其研究对象是平衡层与生化竞争，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Certified Comparative Statics for Conservation-Law Equilibrium Layers, with an Application to RNA Interference

**abstract/A1：** Implicit and equilibrium neural layers define their output as the fixed point of a map. Existing theory certifies that this fixed point exists; it does not certify how it responds to its inputs. For a conservation-law layer with order-preserving coupling we give a form-independent answer: every input-output comparative static is sign-certified if and only if the residual Jacobian is a nonsingular M-matrix, and the certified sign depends only on the sign of the occupancy derivative, so one guarantee covers Langmuir, Hill, and saturating-exponential occupancies. The M-matrix machinery is classical; the contribution is form-independence as the portable invariant, the first certified-sign sensitivity result for a layer of this class, and a sharp phase boundary at which certification is lost while the equilibrium remains well posed. Three consequences follow: the phase boundary, which is strictly stronger than the M-matrix condition; competitive derepression, whose derivative is identically zero for any independent per-target scorer and provably nonzero here; and non-submodularity of resource-coupled suppression. We instantiate on siRNA off-target competition and validate on real public data only, across seventeen microRNAs, two titration studies, and a paired chemical-modification experiment; a second, non-biological instantiation shows the same certified sign on measured physical data. As a trainable layer the operator learns end-to-end while remaining certified-monotone by construction, reaching magnitude parity with a parameter-matched feedforward baseline while expressing a competition effect that baseline cannot represent for any weights. The single-pool instantiation validates the mechanism but does not rank off-target magnitude or resolve position-specific design. Code: https://github.com/shadi97kh/certified-equilibrium-layers

</details>

### 387. [DiRGeo: Learning Directional Geometry of Visual Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29057v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29057

**作者：** Muhammad Ahtesham、Xin Zhong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29057v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29057v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DiRGeo，基于 Randers 几何在冻结视觉表征上学一个状态依赖的方向场，用有序图像轨迹做自监督对比，从而给出打破对称性、能区分正反向的表征几何度量，并在多编码器、多深度与视频事件上检验其方向偏好。

**相关性简评：** 其非对称、路径级的方向几何可为 LVR 中 latent 相似度分析提供线索：用于核查「先看后想」与「先想后看」等有序状态转移的不可交换性，以及该结构随表征深度的变化，但与原论文主线无直接重叠，需核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DiRGeo: Learning Directional Geometry of Visual Representations

**abstract/A1：** Conventional geometric measures of visual representations are symmetric, assigning equal costs to forward and reverse motion along the same path. We propose DiRGeo, a framework for learning directional geometry over frozen visual representations. Grounded in Randers geometry, DiRGeo learns a state-dependent directional field from ordered image trajectories through self-supervised contrast, without semantic labels. Sphere-tangent correction and attractor-relative decomposition distinguish learned directional structure from normalization artifacts and common convergence. Experiments across 17 visual processes, three encoder families, and multiple representation depths demonstrate consistent directional discrimination and whole-path asymmetry beyond simple attractor-based explanations. The learned fields become increasingly process-specific in deeper representations, while natural-video experiments reveal event-dependent directional preferences. As functional validation, DiRGeo guides restoration selection. These results establish directional geometry as a useful complement to symmetric representation analysis.

</details>

### 388. [Recurrent Point Transformer via Test-Time Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29059v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29059

**作者：** Wentao Zhou、Xuweiyi Chen、Charles Saunders、Aruni RoyChowdhury、Zezhou Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29059v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29059v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PoinTTT：在 Point Transformer V3 编解码器中加入残差式大块测试时训练（LaCT）层，用每个 chunk 的 token 更新紧凑的 fast weights 作为循环状态，从而在固定尺寸块上训练、处理任意空间或时间范围的点云分割，并把激活显存限制在块大小内。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「以 fast weights 作为跨块循环状态、按输入流更新」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何更新、训练与推理状态不一致以及长度泛化的问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recurrent Point Transformer via Test-Time Training

**abstract/A1：** Real-world point clouds are not naturally bounded: 3D scans grow as sensors move through rooms, LiDAR surveys extend across forest plots, and 4D captures can span thousands of frames. Yet most point-cloud encoders are designed for fixed-size inputs, forcing inference-time cropping or tiling that loses long-range context and requires ad-hoc output stitching. We formulate arbitrary-extent point-cloud segmentation as recurrent sequence-of-chunks processing and introduce PoinTTT, a recurrent point-cloud encoder built on Point Transformer V3 (PTv3). PoinTTT augments PTv3 with residual Large Chunk Test-Time Training (LaCT) layers in both the encoder and decoder. Each LaCT layer maintains compact fast weights as recurrent state: tokens from each chunk update the fast weights, which are then applied to produce chunk features and passed to the next chunk. This design allows PoinTTT to train on fixed-size chunks while processing scenes of arbitrary spatial or temporal extent, with activation memory bounded by the chunk size. A pilot study on ScanNet and nuScenes shows that recurrent TTT improves segmentation over PTv3 baselines. On FOR-instanceV2, PoinTTT achieves state-of-the-art forest semantic segmentation of 87.9 mIoU with nearly constant memory. On HOI4D, online full-sequence recurrent inference carries state across clips rather than resetting at benchmark boundaries, reaching 42.6 mIoU; a matched full-sequence Mamba control reaches approximately 39.9. These results suggest that test-time training is a practical primitive for scalable spatial and temporal point-cloud understanding.

</details>

### 389. [Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29064

**作者：** Hao-Yu Hsu、Shenlong Wang、Alexander G. Schwing

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29064v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 UNIFIED，把像素编码器、latent 生成器和解码器折叠为同一个 diffusion transformer：三种模式统一为位置对齐的序列映射，仅靠 mode token 与时间步区分，并用重建损失与 flow-matching 损失单阶段从零训练，在 ImageNet-1K 与文本到图像生成上取得优于 UNITE 的 gFID 和 GenEval 分数。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属图像生成，与 VLM 推理无直接关联；但「单一共享 backbone 由 mode token 切换编码、迭代生成、解码」的模式条件化共享状态设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据编码与 latent 推理状态更新是否共用同一网络提供可核查的结构线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Latent generative models typically rely on three separate networks: an encoder that tokenizes pixels, a generator that models the latent distribution, and a decoder that maps latents back to pixels. UNITE recently merged the first two into a single generative encoder trained in one stage, but its decoder remains a separate network. We ask whether this last network can be folded in too, so that one diffusion transformer encodes, generates, and decodes. Simply letting the shared backbone decode does not help. What makes it work is to cast all three modes as position-aligned sequence maps over one fully shared backbone, distinguished only by a mode token and the timestep. The resulting model, UNIFIED, is simple: one network trained from scratch in a single stage with only reconstruction and flow-matching losses, without adversarial losses or pretrained encoders (e.g., DINO). On ImageNet-1K 256x256 at matched parameters, UNIFIED improves gFID over UNITE at three sizes (~60M, ~115M, and ~215M) and reaches 2.08 with 215M parameters, the lowest among compared models under 250M parameters. On text-to-image generation, UNIFIED-B (218M) reaches a GenEval score of 0.87 at 512x512, exceeding single-stage pixel diffusion models with around one billion parameters. Full unification of latent diffusion is thus not merely feasible but beneficial.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://haoyuhsu.github.io/Unified-LDM/

</details>

### 390. [Supply the Global, Supervise the Local: Combining Representation Conditioning and Alignment in Diffusion Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29138v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29138

**作者：** Chaojie Ji、Sergio Quiroga-Sandoval、Ruxin Wang、Zheju Zheng、Yankai Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29138v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29138v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 diffusion transformer 中把图像 patch 表征拆成图像级全局部分与图像内局部部分，用一个全局 token 作条件输入、REPA 作对齐监督，考察两种角色是否冲突，发现二者协同并提出 GC-REPA，显著加速收敛。

**相关性简评：** 「全局条件 + 局部对齐监督」的表征拆分与互补关系，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节如何保留在 latent 状态、以及条件输入与对齐监督如何分工提供可核查线索；但工作属图像生成，迁移到多模态推理仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Supply the Global, Supervise the Local: Combining Representation Conditioning and Alignment in Diffusion Transformers

**abstract/A1：** A pretrained image representation helps train a diffusion transformer in several roles, including as an alignment target, which the model's hidden states learn to match, as in representation alignment (REPA), and as a condition, an extra input describing the image to be generated. Combined, they would give the model an input and a target, but whether they conflict is unknown. To test this, we let the condition carry only part of REPA's target: we split the representation of each image patch into an image-level (global) part, shared by all patches of the image, and a within-image (local) part, the patch's difference from the image-level part, and use one token carrying the image-level part as the condition. Then, the two roles overlap on the image-level part, where they could conflict, while only REPA supervises the within-image part, where we can see whether the token helps REPA. We find that the token and REPA together teach both the image-level part and the within-image part, the main source of REPA's FID improvement, far more than the sum of what each teaches alone, so they cooperate rather than conflict. These findings give one design rule for combining REPA with an image-level condition, supply the global, supervise the local, which we implement as Global-Condition REPA (GC-REPA): REPA with the token as an extra input; the token carries no information beyond REPA's target and is drawn at sampling from a separately trained token prior. GC-REPA greatly accelerates convergence: on ImageNet 256\*256, SiT-XL/2 + GC-REPA reaches REPA's 4M- and SiT-XL/2's 7M-iteration FIDs within 200K and 100K iterations (20 and 70 fewer).

</details>

### 391. [ARC: Adaptive Rollout Control for Efficient Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29156v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29156

**作者：** Yihui Zhang、Tianyu Wo、Jinghao Wang、Xiao Zhou、Huitian Xue、Xiaoyang Sun、Zeying Wang、Chunming Hu、Renyu Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29156v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29156v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出同步 RL rollout 的闭环调度框架 ARC，用流式回填依据部分生成判断整个 group 是否值得继续完成，配合延迟完成、自适应准入与流水线来减少等待和无效计算，从而加速 GRPO 训练。

**相关性简评：** 其「从部分观测预测是否继续生成、并把存疑的早停暂存后可恢复」的机制，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与部分推理轨迹复用提供可核查线索，但该文只针对训练吞吐而非视觉推理状态，迁移需评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ARC: Adaptive Rollout Control for Efficient Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Synchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models proceeds through a repeated rollout--barrier--update loop. Each update must wait for a fixed number of complete, group-relative training samples, yet individual response lengths and reward outcomes vary widely and only emerge as generation progresses. Static admission and unconditional completion therefore leave accelerators idle in some steps, and waste computation generating samples that will never contribute to the current update. We present ARC, a closed-loop rollout architecture that governs synchronous RL rollout at group granularity. ARC uses \\textit{Calibrated Streaming Backfill} to judge from partial observations whether a group is still worth completing, backfilling a fresh candidate immediately when it is not; \\textit{Deferred Group Completion} to park an uncertain early stop and resume it later instead of discarding it outright, bounded by a resume-cycle limit that guarantees termination; and \\textit{Adaptive Admission} and \\textit{Pipelining} to order admitted samples by early-measured duration and to admit further candidates only while expected supply still falls short of the target number of accepted groups. Under online evaluation, ARC reduces rollout time by $37.4\\%$, a $1.60\\times$ speedup, and improves effective GRPO throughput by $50.1\\%$ over existing baselines, while directly recovering 98.9\\% of the training groups that would ultimately have been kept.

</details>

### 392. [Training-Free 3D Editing via Feature-Divergence Localization and Trajectory Correction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29165v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29165

**作者：** Tri Ton、Siwoo Lim、Joshua Tian Jin Tee、Chang D. Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练 3D 编辑框架 FocusFlow，把积分轨迹拆成两个阶段：粗结构形成期用特征散度定位（FDL）借内部交叉注意力对速度场做空间门控，结构成形后用参考生成引导（RGG）把轨迹拉向显式的干净 latent 目标以完成编辑收敛。

**相关性简评：** 其「按阶段调度 latent 更新＋显式干净 latent 目标校正轨迹＋注意力定位后局部化更新」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、停止与收敛判定及视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，但原文属 3D 编辑领域，迁移性待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training-Free 3D Editing via Feature-Divergence Localization and Trajectory Correction

**abstract/A1：** Modifying 3D assets requires enacting targeted structural transformations while strictly preserving the geometric identity of unedited regions. While recent probability flow models enable training-free editing, bounding these modifications within a high-dimensional latent space presents severe mathematical challenges. Current inversion-free trajectories rely on global velocity updates, which often cause spatial bleed into preserved structures and induce trajectory under-commitment, causing edits to stall mid-path. To resolve these dual failures, we introduce FocusFlow, a segmentation-free framework that structures the integration trajectory into two disjoint phases. During early coarse structure formation, FocusFlow applies Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL) to spatially gate the velocity field using intrinsic cross-attention. Once coarse structure has formed, FocusFlow applies Reference Generation Guidance (RGG), a trajectory-correction term that drives convergence to the target shape by pulling the trajectory toward an explicit clean-latent target. Evaluated on the joint Google Scanned Objects and PartObjaverse-Tiny benchmarks, FocusFlow obtains the best preservation scores and the largest edit magnitude among compared methods, suggesting that it can reduce the traditional preservation-modification trade-off. By providing stable, localized geometric control without manual spatial annotations, this phase-scheduled approach lowers technical barriers to the modification of synthetic 3D media.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 393. [SpatialDuet: Bayesian task routing between a metric expert and a geometry expert for spatial intelligence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29168v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29168

**作者：** Duy Tran Thanh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29168v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29168v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SpatialDuet，用贝叶斯任务路由连接一个冻结的度量型空间 VLM（含免训练采样、度量感知 MBR 解码与按题型校准）和一个带 3D 几何编码器的 VLM，按题型估计各专家更优的概率并在输出层融合答案，在四个空间基准上验证且不训练权重。

**相关性简评：** 其按题型估计专家可靠度并加权汇合输出的做法，可供核查 LVR 中多假设、视觉证据来源选择与贡献分配的设计，但只作用于答案层，未涉及内部 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpatialDuet: Bayesian task routing between a metric expert and a geometry expert for spatial intelligence

**abstract/A1：** Embodied assistants and wearable devices need 3D spatial reasoning, and their limited hardware restricts them to small vision-language models (VLMs). Small spatial VLMs acquire different abilities from their training: a model trained on large spatial question sets estimates object and room sizes well, whereas a model with a 3D geometry encoder is better at relative directions and absolute distances. Instead of training a single model for all spatial tasks, as published methods do, we build one system that uses each frozen model for the tasks it handles best. We propose SpatialDuet, which pairs a metric expert with a geometry expert under a Bayesian task router. The metric expert is a data-driven spatial VLM run with three training-free modules: training-aligned sampling, metric-aware minimum Bayes risk decoding and per-type metric calibration. The geometry expert is a VLM with a 3D geometry encoder. For each question type, the router estimates from labelled development questions how likely each expert is to be better, and pools their answers with that probability as weight, in log space for numeric answers and over the option distributions for multiple-choice answers. Extensive experiments on four spatial benchmarks covering video and single images validate SpatialDuet; it outperforms the best published small VLMs by 3.17% on VSI-Bench and, excluding a model trained on CV-Bench-style data, by 1.44% on CV-Bench, without training any model weight.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables

</details>

### 394. [On Adaptive Step Sizes for Eligibility Traces in Deep Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29178v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29178

**作者：** Esraa Elelimy、Martha White

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29178v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29178v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究 deep RL 中 eligibility trace 的向量步长问题，论证自适应向量步长必须纳入 trace 才能保持 forward/backward 视角等价，指出 Adam 等优化器缺少在线 backward view，并提出 Function-Space Distance（FSD）优化器，在四类 trace 算法上验证其优于 SGD 与直接套用的 Adam。

**相关性简评：** 其无需 replay buffer 的多步增量贡献分配机制及「保持前后向等价」的步长设计，可能为 latent 推理轨迹上的跨步信用分配与训练监督提供线索，但与原论文的视觉多模态场景差异较大，可供核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On Adaptive Step Sizes for Eligibility Traces in Deep Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Many deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms store agent-environment interactions in a replay buffer and later learn by sampling transitions from it. However, this approach can be memory-inefficient and can delay learning because the agent can learn from a transition only when the buffer samples it. Additionally, most of these methods use one-step or short multi-step temporal-difference (TD) updates, which are slow at credit assignment. An alternative approach is to learn from the stream of observations as they arrive without relying on a buffer. Eligibility-trace algorithms allow these incremental updates and can also assign credit over many steps. These algorithms were common with linear function approximation but have only recently been used in deep RL. Basic questions, such as how to use vector step sizes with eligibility traces in the deep RL setting, remain open. In this work, we first show that adaptive vector step sizes must be part of the eligibility trace to keep the equivalence between the forward and backward views. We then show that the step sizes of common optimizers, such as Adam, do not have an online backward view. We introduce a new optimizer, Function-Space Distance (FSD), that maintains the forward-backward equivalence. We test four eligibility-trace algorithms covering semi-gradient and gradient TD updates, as well as value-based and actor-critic methods. We show that FSD performs better than SGD or naively applied Adam. The resulting algorithms outperform or match other streaming methods and are comparable to or better than PPO, which uses a buffer, in most environments. Code available at https://github.com/esraaelelimy/ada\_traces

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/esraaelelimy/ada\_traces

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「单轨迹训练＋中间步骤贡献分配」思路可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的训练与贡献分配提供借鉴线索；但对象为纯代码 agent，不涉及视觉状态，具体机制可供核查。

**title/T1：** Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents

**abstract/A1：** AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

### 396. [Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29194v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29194

**作者：** Tailai Chen、Jiawei Yu、Yiming Cheng、Ping Nie、Yongyong Chen、Tao Zhou、Zheng Zhu、Ming Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29194v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29194v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PointTool：无预训练点云编码器，直接用 AFPT 对原始点云做局部 patch 化以保留细粒度几何，配合解耦 LoRA 在冻结 LLM 中聚合 3D 知识，并用可执行工具与程序监督实现交互式 3D 推理，同时发布 PointCloud-TR 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「预训练编码器造成表示瓶颈」的论证与无编码器 token 化，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留与视觉旁路问题；单次闭卷生成改为工具驱动的主动取证，也与获取证据、动态计算的讨论有间接联系，但属 3D 领域且不涉及 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Standard 3D point cloud language models typically rely on pretrained point encoders to extract 3D features and project them into representations processable by large language models (LLMs). However, these encoders are often originally optimized for pre-defined tasks, resulting in a representation bottleneck that may lead to a substantial mismatch with downstream 3D understanding. Moreover, existing models largely follow a single pass closed-book generation, limiting their ability to actively inspect task-relevant 3D regions or retrieve necessary external knowledge. In this work, we present PointTool, an encoder-free and tool-augmented framework for 3D reasoning. PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) to locally aggregate raw point clouds while preserving fine-grained geometric structure, and Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) to facilitate global aggregation and 3D knowledge internalization within a frozen LLM. Building upon these designs, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) enables the model to explicitly operate on raw 3D data and external resources through executable tools, supporting interactive 3D reasoning grounded in spatial evidence. We further introduce PointCloud-TR, a benchmark comprising 13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, and 35.6K tool trajectories to facilitate training and evaluation of complex 3D reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that PointTool achieves strong performance on both standard and complex 3D understanding tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 4 figures. Tailai Chen and Jiawei Yu contributed equally

</details>

### 397. [PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29213v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29213

**作者：** Hannuo Zhang、Zhixiang Chi、Xuanchen Li、Yiqun Zhou、Yang Wang、Xinxin Zuo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29213v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29213v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PartPO，用于从 3D 点云生成结构化形状程序：利用形状程序「自描述」的性质，将生成程序按语义部件切块，把部件级与类别级奖励只施加到对应代码段，并用开放词表分割得到的部件接地作为免标注监督。

**相关性简评：** 其按结构分段做细粒度 credit assignment 的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中长推理轨迹的贡献分配与局部监督设计，但任务与模态均为 3D 形状程序，与视觉 latent 推理只是方法层面相似。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation

**abstract/A1：** We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/HannuoZ/PartPO.

</details>

### 398. [NANO: Unifying Missingness and Input Uncertainty in Tabular Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29214v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29214

**作者：** Kuangdai Leng、Maria Tsekhmistrenko、Matteo Bagagli、Simon Jeffery、Tarje Nissen-Meyer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29214v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29214v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向表格数据，提出 NANO 输入编码插件：以 Bayesian evidence weighting 按置信度缩放所给数值的影响，将所有零置信估计映射到同一「未观测」表示，并为「不适用」及原因设置独立表示；在 11 个数据集、9 个骨干网络上验证混合置信度训练可跨推理置信水平泛化。

**相关性简评：** 按置信度调节输入证据权重、把零置信证据归入统一空观测状态的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据可靠性筛选及「无证据/不可用」状态表示相关，值得核查能否迁移到多模态输入的证据门控。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NANO: Unifying Missingness and Input Uncertainty in Tabular Learning

**abstract/A1：** Missing values are common in tabular data, yet current approaches to handling them often overlook two dimensions. First, an observed value may be uncertain, while a Not-Observed (N.O.) value may still have a reasonable estimate. Inputs should therefore span a continuous spectrum from no evidence to a fully trusted observation. Second, Not-Applicable (N.A.) means that no meaningful value exists for a record, yet this semantic state often lacks explicit representation. To address both dimensions, we introduce NANO, a unified plug-in for input encoding that fits most token-based architectures. Guided by Bayesian evidence weighting, NANO adjusts the influence of a supplied value according to confidence, with all zero-confidence estimates mapped to the same N.O. representation. NANO accepts, but does not require, per-example confidence information during training or inference. For N.A., a separate representation enables models to encode inapplicability and its schema-defined reasons into context. Experiments across eleven datasets and nine backbones show that mixed-confidence training enables a single NANO model to generalize across inference confidence levels, remaining competitive without estimates and improving steadily as estimate reliability and confidence increase. The effectiveness of NANO's handling of N.A. is further demonstrated on three augmented datasets.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, including appendices

</details>

### 399. [Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29236v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29236

**作者：** Mingle Jiang、Jikui Zhou、Chenghan Lyu、Rui Xu、Yunke Wang、Chang Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29236v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29236v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 Gaussian Splatting 渲染深度与实际场景表面不符的问题，提出 REVEAL 框架：在冻结的原始表示之外，把源视角深度重投影到目标视角做鲁棒多视图一致性融合，并学习一个选择机制判断候选深度是否比原预测更准确；同时发布带真值深度的 RGB-D 基准 RIG。

**相关性简评：** 其「不改动内部表示、仅靠外部多视图证据聚合，并由学习到的选择器决定是否采纳候选」的设定，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、旁路修正与采纳/停止决策提供方法线索；但对象是渲染深度而非推理状态，联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Gaussian Splatting has achieved high visual quality in novel view synthesis, but the accuracy of its rendered geometry remains a challenge. In particular, the rendered depth is computed as an opacity-weighted average along each ray, which may not correspond to the actual scene surface. In this paper, we observe that depth predictions from different views of the same frozen Gaussian representation exhibit complementary errors, allowing us to improve novel-view geometry using information from other views without modifying the original representation. Based on this observation, we propose REVEAL, a general framework that selectively refines novel-view depth using complementary geometric information. Specifically, we first reproject depth predictions from source views to the target view and combine them using robust multi-view consensus. We then introduce a learned selection mechanism to determine whether the candidate depth is more accurate than the original prediction, based on the expected reduction in depth error. In addition, we introduce RIG, a real-world benchmark captured with synchronized RGB-D cameras, which provides ground-truth depth for evaluating both static and dynamic reconstruction models. Experiments on 6 Gaussian Splatting backbones across 3 benchmarks show that REVEAL consistently improves depth accuracy while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

**comment/C1：** 14 Pages, supplementary material included

</details>

### 400. [Tissot indicatrix for location encoders: Characterizing local distortion in learned geographic embeddings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29249v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29249

**作者：** Guofeng Cao、Gengchen Mai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29249v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29249v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把地图投影中的 Tissot 指示图改造为位置编码器的局部畸变度量：在每个地点于 32 个方向取等距位移、比较编码器输出并拟合椭圆张量，以伸长率（各向异性）和方向刻画畸变，在已知几何参照上验证后用于 5 个编码器族共 13 个 checkpoint，并考察畸变对「近邻」判定的影响。

**相关性简评：** 这种仅依赖输出的黑箱局部度量探针，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 视觉状态的空间几何：等距视觉扰动是否引起等量状态变化、各向异性是否扭曲证据邻域，但需判断其能否迁移到多模态内部状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tissot indicatrix for location encoders: Characterizing local distortion in learned geographic embeddings

**abstract/A1：** With the increasing adoption of geographic artificial intelligence, location encoders are widely used to map geographic coordinates to learned embeddings for tasks in Earth observation and geospatial modeling. Similar to map projections, location encoders can distort geographic space, that is, equal-distance displacements in different directions can result in unequal embedding changes. However, such distortion remains largely unexamined, and it can propagate into downstream applications. We adapt Tissot's indicatrix, a cartographic tool for map projection distortion, to characterize this distortion. At each location, we compare encoder outputs at equal distances in 32 directions and fit a tensor, represented by an ellipse, whose elongation (anisotropy) and orientation describe the local distortion. The fit requires only encoder outputs without access to model internals and is validated against references with known geometry. By applying the method to thirteen released checkpoints of five encoder families, we find that distortions vary across space and inherit the input geometry to varying degrees, closely in GeoCLIP with its Equal Earth input (anisotropy correlation of 0.88) and weakly or moderately in the other encoders. The distortion also affects the locations an encoder treats as neighbors. Within 1km of 20 query sites, the 40 nearest neighbors in geographic and embedding space overlap by a median of only 57.5--87.5% across the checkpoints, while the fitted ellipses select exactly the same embedding neighbors in 265 of 299 comparisons. These findings provide a geographic basis for assessing location encoders, and the accompanying eTissot package implements the methods for user-specified encoders.

</details>

### 401. [Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29259v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29259

**作者：** Jinwoo Kim、Toghrul Abbasov、Lucius E. J. Bynum、Aahlad Puli、Stephanie Milani、Hyunwoo Ryu、Seunghoon Hong、Kyunghyun Cho、Rajesh Ranganath

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29259v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29259v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 REINFORCE Look Back：用反事实世界模型预测同一环境随机性下替换动作后的结果，并以反事实回报作为策略梯度基线，分析其无偏性与方差缩减。

**相关性简评：** 其用反事实回报区分动作效应与环境运气，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 动作的贡献分配与监督提供基线设计线索，尚需核查如何迁移到多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models

**abstract/A1：** Agents in complex, stochastic environments must contend with dynamics that can exceed their world models' predictive capacity and randomness that obscure the consequences of their actions. We hypothesize that, compared to imagining entirely new trajectories in such complex environments, it can be easier to transform observed trajectories with alternative actions. Counterfactual world models condition on observations to predict alternative outcomes under the same underlying environmental randomness, using experience as a reference for predicting action-dependent changes. We present a policy gradient estimator, REINFORCE Look Back (RLB), that uses counterfactual returns as baselines to distinguish action effects from environmental luck, and prove conditions for unbiasedness and variance reduction. In settings where environmental evolution is harder to predict than action-induced changes, we show that counterfactual world models are easier to learn and support better policy learning than ordinary world models. Our findings suggest that counterfactual thinking can help agents learn effective behavior without independently reproducing the full complexity of their worlds.

**comment/C1：** Code available at: https://github.com/ToghrulAbbasov19/look-back

</details>

### 402. [Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29269v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29269

**作者：** Bowyn Tan、Zhilong Zheng、Yang Guan、Liming Xiao、Liye Tang、Xiao Li、Naizheng Wang、Keqiang Li、Shengbo Eben Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29269v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29269v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 DUET，将新任务训练后的参数调整表述为双向约束优化问题，同时施加旧任务与新任务的 Jacobian 零空间约束，并给出交替投影算法与秩感知步长准则，用于持续学习中的灾难性遗忘缓解。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其零空间投影式的「保留旧行为同时学习新任务」约束，或可借鉴到 LVR/VLM 微调中抑制视觉信息坍缩与能力干扰的训练监督设计，值得核查其可行性与代价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning requires a model to learn multiple new tasks sequentially while retaining performance on previous tasks. Projecting model parameters onto the Jacobian null space of previous tasks after unconstrained training on a new task has emerged as an effective paradigm. However, unidirectional projection merely minimizes the parameter distance to the new-task optimum, overlooking the new-task loss landscape. To address this limitation, we propose DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that imposes Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks during post-training projection. Specifically, DUET formulates the post-training adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem. It minimizes the distance between parameters before and after training on a new task, subject to loss preserving constraints on both tasks. To solve the optimization problem, we develop an alternating bidirectional projection algorithm, whose convergence is guaranteed by the contraction mapping theorem. For reliable multi-step projection, we rectify existing step size selection criteria via an effective-rank aware formulation, overcoming their failure under rank-deficient Jacobians. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET consistently outperforms existing unidirectional projection methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 403. [QASparse: Query-Adaptive Sparse Attention with Tailored Budgets and Tokens](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29280v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29280

**作者：** Zhiyuan Chen、Zihao Yang、Quanjiang Li、Haijiang Li、Jiancheng Pan、Qichao Zhao、Zihan Dong、Qiushi Shi、Jinshi Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29280v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29280v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** QASparse 提出查询自适应的稀疏注意力：在跨头共享重要性估计的基础上，用局部预算回归按查询区域与注意力头估计计算预算，并用边界投票在实际 query/key 分数上精修保留 token 集合，配合长度专用 kernel 加速长序列 prefill。

**相关性简评：** 其「按查询区域分配计算量 + 修正保留 token 集合」的机制，可能为 LVR 中的动态计算预算分配与视觉证据筛选提供效率层面的可核查线索，但目前仅是文本 LLM 的 prefill 加速，与推理状态生成无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QASparse: Query-Adaptive Sparse Attention with Tailored Budgets and Tokens

**abstract/A1：** Long-sequence inference in large language models is constrained by the high cost of prefilling, where dense attention scales quadratically with context length. Exploiting similarity across attention heads offers a way to reduce redundant computation. Prior approaches in this direction have relied on localized query observations to determine head-level computation reuse or budget allocation. However, inter-head similarity does not imply uniform query requirements, leaving adaptation to varying budget needs and selection preferences across query regions a key challenge. We introduce QASparse, a Query-Adaptive Sparse attention mechanism with hardware-efficient execution. QASparse preserves the efficiency of shared cross-head importance estimation while adapting computational budgets and token selections to query requirements, and it executes these dynamic sparse decisions through dedicated kernels. Its query adaptivity stems from two complementary innovations: Local Budget Regression models local variations in computational demand along query positions to estimate budgets for different query regions and attention heads; Boundary Voting lets queries within each head vote over candidates near the selection cutoff using actual query/key scores, refining the retained set while preserving the initial selection size. To reduce the execution overhead of dynamic budgets, we further design length-specialized selection kernels that efficiently support query-adaptive sparse patterns across context lengths. Together, these designs efficiently combine shared estimation with local decisions while adapting both how much attention is computed and which interactions are retained. Experimental results demonstrate improved benchmark scores and faster prefill attention computation compared with existing sparse attention baselines.

</details>

### 404. [Compared to What? Calibrating Machine-Unlearning Diagnostics with Present, Absent and Suppressed Anchors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29285

**作者：** Arsalan Kaleem

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29285v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建「存在／从未习得／被抑制」三类锚点（被抑制锚点通过冻结底层使事实按构造仍被编码），在 GPT-2 Small 与 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 上以 AUROC 对标 oracle，检验线性探针、logit lens、重学习速度等内部诊断能否区分「真正移除」与「仅行为抑制」，并发现不同方法下这些诊断结论相互冲突。

**相关性简评：** 其「用探针与 logit lens 判断内部状态是否仍编码信息、并与行为指标对照」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留视觉细节、答案是否真正使用 latent 内容而非旁路，但纯文本设定需改造，且未涉及多模态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compared to What? Calibrating Machine-Unlearning Diagnostics with Present, Absent and Suppressed Anchors

**abstract/A1：** Unlearning methods for language models are judged mainly by behaviour, but a model can stop producing an answer while still encoding it. Internal diagnostics such as linear probes, the logit lens and relearning speed are used to tell removal from suppression, yet none has been checked against cases where the answer is known. We build such cases. A present anchor learned a set of synthetic facts; an absent anchor is a never-taught oracle retrained without them; and suppressed anchors are unlearned with their lower layers frozen, so the facts stay encoded below the frozen block by construction. We compare these anchors with NPO, RMU and gradient difference at a matched operating point on GPT-2 Small and Qwen3-0.6B-Base, scoring every diagnostic per entity with AUROC against the oracle. Behaviour cannot separate the suppressed anchors from the oracle (AUROC 0.51 to 0.58), while probes, the logit lens and relearning gain can (0.65 to 1.00), and the oracle seeds stay near 0.5. Applied to NPO on both models and RMU on Qwen3, the validated diagnostics disagree: probes put the facts at the oracle's level, while the models still relearn them much faster than a never-taught model does. Every unlearned model, anchor or method, also assigns the forgotten answer a far lower log-probability than the oracle does, a black-box signal that flagged all of them. A drift-ratio specificity rule fails on known cases. Code, data and every run are at https://github.com/ArsalanKaleem/unlearning-audit.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 6 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/ArsalanKaleem/unlearning-audit

</details>

### 405. [GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29293v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29293

**作者：** Youngmin Kim、Seonghyun Jin、Jong Chul Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29293v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29293v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GALILEO：在做几何位置编码前，先按估计速度与时间偏移把每个 key 的 3D 位置平移到 query 时刻，从而让 RayRoPE、URoPE 等编码适配动态场景；并在 LVSM 新视角合成、3D 点跟踪和视频生成任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 该文表明只改 key 的位置即可改变注意力实际对齐的内容与时刻，且给出注意力可视化，可能可供核查 LVR 中位置编码、时间偏移与注意力结构如何影响视觉证据筛选和对齐。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes

**abstract/A1：** Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.

</details>

### 406. [DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29306v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29306

**作者：** Yifan Duan、Du Yin、Siyuan Zheng、Chao Xue、Lihuan Li、Flora D. Salim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29306v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29306v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 DoppelVet，在自演化 agent 把候选更新写入持久记忆或技能前进行安全校验：无需安全标签，先构造与现有验证器所用信号完全匹配的「替代」更新，再从同一状态重放两者并交换呈现顺序比较行为，以决定是否保留候选。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「同一证据下两个状态结果相反、故须对比而非单侧判定」的构造式反事实核查思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正支撑答案、以及轨迹或记忆更新的准入筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents

**abstract/A1：** Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. Across nine open-weight and proprietary verifiers, DoppelVet raises mean harmful-update detection AUC from 0.762 to 0.940 on DoppelVet-Grid and from 0.681 to 0.826 on DoppelVet-Tool, outperforming VaG and AgentDoG 1.5. On DoppelVet-Grid, it reduces trajectories experiencing degradation from 30.39% to 0.43% over a ten-generation self-update loop and leaves no final degradation.

</details>

### 407. [PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29311v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29311

**作者：** Yizhu Chen、Chen Ju、Donghao Zhou、Ziyu Guo、Shuai Xiao、Jinsong Lan、Xiaoyong Zhu、Ying Chen、Haodong Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29311v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29311v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PrimiTok 组合式视觉 tokenizer，把码字视为可复用视觉基元：DQP 增强子码本质心多样性以减少冗余，DPA 依 token 复杂度自适应选择并加权组合基元，用量化误差监督选择数量，联合重建与图文对比学习训练。

**相关性简评：** 按内容复杂度动态分配离散表示容量的机制，可能与 LVR 中「视觉细节是否保留在内部状态」及按需计算分配的思路有关，可供核查；但工作聚焦 tokenizer 重建与语义对齐，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization

**abstract/A1：** Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. PrimiTok integrates two complementary components: Diverse Quantitative Primitives (DQP), which encourages diversity among sub-codebook centroids to reduce redundancy, and a Dynamic Primitive Allocator (DPA), which selects primitives according to token complexity. Embedding quantization error supervises how many primitives are selected from each sub-codebook, and DPA aggregates them with input-dependent weights. Joint reconstruction and image--text contrastive learning encourage the resulting representations to retain visual fidelity and semantic alignment. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction and semantic alignment over SOTA baselines, with further evaluations on multimodal understanding and visual generation.

</details>

### 408. [Hybrid state-space and attention neural operators for nonlinear structural dynamics under environmental loading](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29334v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29334

**作者：** Anastasios Stamou、Rui Teixeira、Maria Nogal、Michalis Fragiadakis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29334v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29334v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DeepOJamba，将选择性状态空间递归与全注意力结合为混合神经算子，用物理参数条件化和序列间预测状态传递来预测海上风机在风浪载荷下的非线性响应历史，并能生成超出训练序列长度的轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测状态传递」实现长度外推、混合 SSM-注意力承担状态更新，可能为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态的传递与长度泛化提供架构线索，但原文不涉及视觉证据或推理监督，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hybrid state-space and attention neural operators for nonlinear structural dynamics under environmental loading

**abstract/A1：** The computational burden of repeated nonlinear time-history analyses limits their application for structural assessment and design. We therefore propose DeepOJamba, a hybrid neural operator that combines selective state-space recurrence with full attention to predict the structural response history due to dynamic loading. Physical-parameter conditioning and predicted-state transfer between sequences enable a single trained operator to represent varying system conditions and generate response histories beyond its training sequence length. DeepOJamba is evaluated on a 15~MW monopile offshore wind turbine under wind and wave loading. The proposed operator is compared to pure attention, pure state-space, Fourier, and DeepONet operators and is found to give the lowest window error on every channel and the lowest closed-loop fatigue and ultimate-load errors of $9.4\\%$ and $6.0\\%$, against $14.6\\%$ and $8.7\\%$ for the next-best pure attention operator examined. Moreover, on sea states outside the training wave band, the error slightly increases by approximately $0.4$ percentage points. Pure state-space operators can approach similar low errors only with a much wider convolution kernel tuned to the tower eigenperiod, which increases the training cost by $40\\%$. In all, the results obtained support hybrid neural operators for robust long-duration structural response and demand prediction.

</details>

### 409. [Probe Before You Learn: Allocating Prompts from Initial Gradients under Label Noise](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29336v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29336

**作者：** Jiazhe Zhang、Zibin Geng、Qiang Ma、Xuefeng Jiang、Yijun Lin、Jingyi Wang、Yu Yan、Xingzhou Zhang、Min Liu、Yuwei Wang、Sheng Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29336v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29336v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究噪声标签下 prompt learning 的鲁棒性，提出 GPrompt：在提示优化前仅用少量图像与伪标签做初始化探针，提取文本与视觉提示的成对损失梯度，按 Gram 矩阵的模态内集中度与模态间重叠度推导闭式分配比例，再在固定参数预算下投影为具体提示数量，从而免训练地选出文本/视觉提示预算分配。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练前用初始梯度几何推断参数预算如何在两种模态间分配」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态与视觉证据通路的计算或容量分配，以及噪声监督下训练信号的筛选；但论文本身不涉及推理期状态生成与停止决策，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probe Before You Learn: Allocating Prompts from Initial Gradients under Label Noise

**abstract/A1：** Prompt learning provides a parameter-efficient way to adapt pretrained vision--language models through text and visual prompts, but noisy labels prevalent in real-world data inevitably bias prompt updates and thereby undermine adaptation effectiveness. Prior work on robust prompt learning focuses on suppressing unreliable updates under noisy supervision. We uncover a pivotal yet overlooked aspect--prompt allocation: shifting the parameter budget between text and visual prompts can substantially enhance robustness while keeping the training objective and total budget fixed. However, suitable prompt allocations vary across tasks and are unknown a priori, rendering brute-force candidate training computationally prohibitive. We propose GPrompt, a training-free method that derives allocation between text and visual prompts using only loss gradients at initialization before prompt optimization. Using a small sample of images and generated pseudo-labels as shared supervision, GPrompt performs an initialization probe to extract paired text and visual loss gradients, and characterizes the geometry of their trace-normalized Gram matrices through both concentration within each modality and overlap between modalities. GPrompt then derives a closed-form allocation, and projects it onto feasible prompt counts under the exact parameter budget, enabling task-specific selection without training candidate configurations. Experiments across eleven datasets show that GPrompt outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 7.75% while selecting configurations close to the best allocation identified through exhaustive training. The average runtime of gradient probe across datasets is 99.9% lower than that of exhaustive candidate training.

</details>

**作者：** Qiuyu Tian、Haojie Yin、Yingce Xia、Youyong Kong、Zequn Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29340v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29340v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DeciForm，在单一决策模型内统一候选选择、布尔判断与数值打分，并按答案空间结构设计计算与监督：候选无关查询与隔离候选分支保证分类对重排序一致，log-spherical 目标与十进制前缀读出分别用于概率与数值评分。

**相关性简评：** 其「按答案空间结构定制读出与监督」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何映射到有序／无序判断输出、以及验证头与评分头的监督设计提供可核查线索，但原文不涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeciForm: Incorporating Task Structure into Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** Decision models unify candidate selection, Boolean judgment, and numerical scoring within a single model. Their answer spaces nevertheless carry different structures: classification candidates form an unordered set, while numerical scores have an intrinsic order and distance. We introduce Deciform, which incorporates these distinctions into computation and supervision. Candidate-free queries and isolated candidate branches support consistent classification under reordering. A log--spherical objective trains candidate probabilities, while a decimal-prefix readout combines individual-value and interval-weighted cumulative supervision for numerical scoring. Shared adapters, task-private residuals, and output-channel gains support joint adaptation. On a shared 15,000-request test set, Deciform improves all three decision metrics on Qwen and ModernBERT; source-normalized errors support the Score gains across the data mixture. Canonicalized joint encoding also eliminates tested order flips, while isolation further improves prediction metrics. Separate objective studies and main-configuration ablations examine the classification and numerical components. After one epoch of MIND-small adaptation, Deciform improves multi-positive news ranking on both backbones. These results support matching encoding and supervision to answer-space structure within a unified decision interface.

</details>

### 411. [BenchMint: From Real-World Tasks to Executable Benchmarks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29367v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29367

**作者：** Zining Huang、Zuo Wang、Mengyao Zhang、Yilan Piao、Zhe Wang、Shuohan Wang、Ruiying Wang、Huicong Yi、Qianyu Yang、Zilong Pan、Wenlong Wu、Jiajun Shi、Shen Yan、Xingyu Pan、Houxuan Chen、Yuan Xu、Jinzhao Li

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29367v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29367v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BenchMint 自动基准构建流程，从同一来源文档联合生成任务与评分标准，并构建覆盖 11 个日常领域的 100 个任务集 Daily-Life，由语言模型评审结合工具轨迹与私有证据打分，报告 26 种配置的结果并分析参考答案错误。

**相关性简评：** 其「同一来源联合生成任务与评分准则」及基于证据、工具轨迹的评审协议，可能为 LVR 评价中的证据定位与判分设计提供可核查线索，但不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BenchMint: From Real-World Tasks to Executable Benchmarks

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) need evaluations of everyday reasoning and tool use, such as planning itineraries under user constraints and grounding numerical answers in evidence. We introduce BenchMint, an automated benchmark-construction workflow, and Daily-Life, its collection of 100 selected tasks across 11 real-world domains. BenchMint jointly constructs tasks and scoring criteria from the same source documents. Language-model judges assess possible answers against these criteria using tool traces and private evidence. We report 26 model/harness configurations, including GPT, Claude and Gemini families; 17 have complete domain profiles. These are descriptive configuration results, not a controlled model ranking. In one selected travel task, we corrected the reference total from 320 to 380 minutes while keeping both answers unchanged. The incorrect answer's arithmetic verdict switched from pass to fail; the correct answer's switched from fail to pass. With one ballot per cell, this exposes a reference error without establishing repeatability or collection-wide validity. Incomplete construction comparisons establish no general advantage of joint authoring or feedback-guided revision.

**comment/C1：** Supplementary analysis and reproducibility materials are included as ancillary files

### 412. [SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29368v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29368

**作者：** Junbo Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29368v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29368v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究临床试验结果预测：把 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的冻结 SAE 转成临床概念词表，用历史试验拟合的稀疏探针挑出与结局相关的概念，以带方向和强度的自然语言证据在推理时优化黑盒 LLM 的答案，并附带概念级可核查解释。

**相关性简评：** 「SAE 内部特征→稀疏探针筛证据→推理时注入」这条流程可能与 LVR 中 latent 内容鉴别、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配有方法类比，可供核查其探针选择与证据可靠性；但原文限于文本临床预测，无多模态推理状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence

**abstract/A1：** Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.

**comment/C1：** Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit

</details>

### 413. [ClothCast: Generative Cloth World Modeling under Partial Observability](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29369v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29369

**作者：** Yushen Hu、Yilong Song、Zhen Zhou、Apurv Kushwaha、Harshvardhan Chandirasekar、Zhu-Tian Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29369v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29369v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ClothCast 面向布料操作的部分可观测世界模型：从单帧 RGB-D 提升出含推测遮挡层的分层点集，用以夹爪位姿推导的刚体先验携带点集，再用视频扩散点流模型预测残余运动，并发布带真值网格的 ClothCastBench。

**相关性简评：** 其「带推测遮挡层的分层点集」是显式维护未观测视觉细节的内部状态，刚体先验加学习残余的分解也可能为 latent 状态更新与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但不涉及 VLM 推理或答案使用，故仅作方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ClothCast: Generative Cloth World Modeling under Partial Observability

**abstract/A1：** World models support robotic manipulation by predicting how the scene evolves under a planned action. For garments this prediction is notoriously difficult: deformations are complex, and self-occlusion leaves much of the cloth unobserved. Planned gripper trajectories provide a useful motion prior because cloth held by a gripper moves with it, while the remaining deformation must be predicted. We introduce ClothCast, a world model that applies this prior to the cloth's points and learns the residual motion. ClothCast takes one RGB-D observation, the camera pose, the robot's own model and the planned gripper trajectories, with no cloth mesh or material parameters. It lifts the observation to a layered point set that includes hypothesized occluded layers, carries the points with a blended rigid prior derived from the gripper poses, and predicts the residual motion with a video-diffusion point-flow model. Over entire 4- to 11-second episodes at 10 Hz, the moved points are rendered into depth, from which a geometry-conditioned completion model synthesizes RGB; after release, a hand-designed settling step replaces the learned motion. We further release ClothCastBench, 10,000 simulated dual-arm cloth-manipulation episodes with the ground-truth cloth mesh, including occluded layers, at every frame. On 492 held-out episodes, ClothCast achieves 2.5x lower sequence-averaged visible-surface Chamfer distance than Flex-π, the strongest baseline in geometry (14.0 mm vs. 35.6 mm), and 3.7 dB higher cloth-region PSNR than Cosmos-Predict2.5, the strongest baseline in cloth PSNR. On a 50-episode ablation subset, the rigid prior alone, applied to ClothCast's learned initial geometry with the same post-processing, already outperforms both geometry-capable baselines, and the learned residual lowers its error by about a third.

</details>

### 414. [SpectralGS: Spectral Gaussian Splatting for Unsupervised Spectral Super-Resolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29388v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29388

**作者：** Qiaoying Qu、Bin Pan、Chen Jia、Haiyang Xu、Xia Xu、Zhenwei Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29388v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29388v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SpectralGS，以共享光谱与局部空间高斯基元构建连续空谱表示，再用光谱响应函数做积分投影渲染 RGB，依靠渲染与观测图像的一致性在无配对高光谱数据下训练。

**相关性简评：** 其「低秩结构化连续表示＋可微前向成像投影的一致性监督」可为 LVR 中如何压缩保留任务必要视觉证据、以观测一致性替代标注监督内部状态提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpectralGS: Spectral Gaussian Splatting for Unsupervised Spectral Super-Resolution

**abstract/A1：** Unsupervised spectral super-resolution aims to recover spectral information from RGB images without paired hyperspectral data. However, the limited spectral information in RGB observations makes learning an effective spatial-spectral representation challenging, requiring the incorporation of structured spectral modeling with sensor imaging. In this paper, we propose SpectralGS, a spectral Gaussian splatting framework comprising two components: Shared Spectral Gaussian Representation and Spectral Response Projection Rendering. The representation module constructs a continuous spatial-spectral representation via shared spectral and local spatial Gaussian primitives, exploiting the low-rank spectral structure of hyperspectral images. The rendering module utilizes the spectral response function (SRF) to apply integral projection to the continuous representation, blending it to generate an RGB image. Consistency between the rendered and observed RGB images provides training supervision. Our main contribution is a Gaussian splatting framework that integrates structured continuous spatial-spectral representation with imaging response-based rendering, enabling unsupervised spectral reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods.

</details>

### 415. [PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29389v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29389

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29389v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29389v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PINE，用单步 Omni Diffusion Transformer 在一次前向中同时预测点图、表面法向与实例图，把每种图视为一条 token 流并用流掩码控制流间交互，配合相机射线编码与 DINOv3 特征注意力增强几何和语义预测。

**相关性简评：** 其单步扩散一次前向并行产出多路 latent 地图、并以流掩码显式约束跨流信息交换的做法，可能为 LVR 的并行 latent 状态生成与跨模态信息坍缩控制提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不研究多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model

**abstract/A1：** Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages. Project page: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/PINE

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29396

**作者：** Haocheng Li、Juepeng Zheng、Guilong Xiao、Kaiqi Du、Gengmeng Pu、Haohuan Fu、Jianxi Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29396v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29396v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建农艺场景的广义视觉接地数据集 AgroVG+（7,404 张图、含单目标、多目标与无目标查询），并提出 ReSAG 框架：在生成答案前计算共享空间证据分布并对各目标等权监督，用 BOX/END 协议显式决定继续出框还是终止，坐标仍走原词表生成。

**相关性简评：** 其 BOX/END 终止动作与逐目标等权证据监督，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策与多证据贡献分配的设计线索；但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系属方法借鉴层面的推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 9 figures. Includes supplementary material

</details>

### 417. [HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29431v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29431

**作者：** Xianglong Guo、Haobo Xu、Zanyi Wang、Zhen Lei、Chang Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29431v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29431v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HorizonFlow，将 DMD 梯度中高信噪比的外观/布局成分与低信噪比的运动成分解耦，仅通过训练期回归目标修正（Chunk Evenness 均匀展开每个 latent chunk 的运动、Semantic Commitment 锚定粗布局），在 600 次迭代内把 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步视频生成模型。

**相关性简评：** 其对 latent 梯度各成分信噪比失衡的诊断，以及「保持原损失、只改回归目标以分别校正静态与动态成分」的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态训练中区分内容保持与状态更新、避免静态信息主导坍缩提供可核查的训练监督线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations

**abstract/A1：** Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

</details>
