### 418. [Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29436v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29436

**作者：** Pulkit Bansal、Vivek Srivastava、Shirish Karande

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29436v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29436v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对文生图偏好对齐中成对标注稀疏的问题，提出 PrefLens，在预训练奖励模型定义的偏好空间里围绕人类偏好图像生成受控感知变体，并筛选紧凑的高信息邻居集，把单条偏好标注扩成结构化比较邻域以增强监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「围绕偏好样本构造细粒度对比并筛选高信息邻居」的做法可能为 LVR 中的轨迹/潜在状态监督构造与视觉证据筛选提供可核查的数据侧线索，但本身不涉及多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences typically relies on large-scale pairwise annotations, which are expensive to obtain and provide only sparse supervision. Moreover, not all preference comparisons contribute equally to learning: comparisons between semantically distant images often reveal little about the fine-grained perceptual factors underlying human judgments. We argue that informative supervision can arise from local preference neighborhoods surrounding human-preferred images, where semantically aligned alternatives expose meaningful perceptual and structural differences. Motivated by this observation, we propose PrefLens, a framework that recovers local preference neighborhoods from sparse human feedback. Specifically, PrefLens generates controlled perceptual variations around preferred images that largely retain semantic identity and selects compact sets of informative neighbors in a reward-defined preference space induced by pretrained reward models. By transforming each human preference annotation into a structured neighborhood of informative comparisons, PrefLens enriches supervision without requiring additional human labeling. Our experiments and diagnostic evaluations show that the recovered neighborhoods capture human-relevant preference characteristics and provide effective supervision for preference alignment across diverse settings.

</details>

### 419. [Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29460v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29460

**作者：** Shaked Perek、Avihu Dekel、Ben Wiesel、Sivan Harary、Eli Schwartz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29460v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29460v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出利用答案 schema 已知结构的非自回归文档关键信息抽取器：按 schema 写入结构，计数确定列表长度，并用 CTC 在槽块中并行解码所有值。

**相关性简评：** 其固定轮次的槽位并行解码、CTC 免长度预测及按未完成值追加预算，或可为 LVR 的并行状态生成与动态计算分配提供方法线索，但研究对象是输出空间抽取而非 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

</details>

### 420. [RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29468v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29468

**作者：** Pengzhen Chen、Yanwei Liu、Xiaoyan Gu、Jinxia Liu、Siwei Ma、Weiping Wang、Wu Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29468v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29468v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 RSWP，一个基于二十面体群（I₂₀）理论的球面全景图像水印框架：把 SO(3) 旋转分解为局部平面旋转与面片置换，将水印嵌入离散面片，并用「等变特征提取 + 置换不变排序」的解码范式实现无需几何标定的盲提取。

**相关性简评：** 其「等变编码—不变解码」的解耦结构可能为 LVR 中视觉证据在视角/置换变化下保持稳定表征提供可核查线索，但论文本身针对水印信号同步而非推理状态，迁移价值需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images

**abstract/A1：** Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\\mathcal{I}\_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

</details>

### 421. [OnCache: Learning Dynamic Caching Schedules for Efficient Diffusion Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29480v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29480

**作者：** Zhikang Xie、Xichen Ye、Yifan Wu、Yuxuan Liu、Qianlong Wang、Haoshen Yu、Peizhu Gong、Weizhong Zhang、Cheng Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29480v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29480v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对扩散模型推理延迟，提出 OnCache：在线按 prompt 动态决定分配多少计算量、何时刷新缓存特征，并用轻量神经校正器缓解缓存误差累积；在 FLUX.1-dev 与 Wan2.1 视频生成上取得加速与质量折中。

**相关性简评：** 其「同一状态下的成对续算＋以终端保真度和 NFE 差作为决策后果」的离线策略训练，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本分配与刷新/停止决策提供可核查线索；但属生成加速工作，与视觉推理状态无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OnCache: Learning Dynamic Caching Schedules for Efficient Diffusion Inference

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models have revolutionized generative tasks but incur high inference latency due to iterative denoising. Cache-based strategies accelerate inference by reusing intermediate features, yet they largely rely on static, sample-agnostic schedules. Our empirical analysis reveals two factors that these schedules overlook. (i) denoising dynamics and computational requirements vary across prompts, motivating adaptive computation allocation. (ii) sensitivity to caching errors varies across timesteps, so static schedules may reuse features at error-sensitive steps or waste computation at less sensitive ones. We therefore propose OnCache, a dynamic caching framework that makes prompt-adaptive decisions online about how much computation to allocate and when to refresh cached features. A policy is trained offline on paired compute and cache continuations from identical denoising states, using differences in terminal fidelity and the number of function evaluations (NFE) to account for the downstream consequences of each decision. To further improve the generation quality, a neural corrector compensates for caching-induced errors and mitigates their accumulation throughout the denoising trajectory. Both components are lightweight and introduce negligible additional inference latency. On FLUX.1-dev, OnCache achieves a nearly $3\\times$ generation speedup at $1024^2$ resolution, with LPIPS of $0.156$ and SSIM of $0.860$. We further extend OnCache to video generation on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, achieving state-of-the-art efficiency--quality trade-offs across both modalities.

</details>

### 422. [Learning Global Probabilistic Explanations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29493v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29493

**作者：** Frédéric Koriche、Louenas Bounia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29493v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29493v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在基数约束下寻找「全局概率解释」，即一小组特征 K，使随机输入与其在 K 上一致的重采样输入获得相同预测标签的期望概率最大；提出基于 Fourier 分析与 junta 学习的谱解释器，仅用成员查询即可给出 PAC 保证，并对解释规模、特征基数与精度是固定参数可解的。

**相关性简评：** 其「小特征子集固定后保持预测」的全局相关度度量与 junta 查询式学习，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、最小充分证据集的因果评估提供可核查的形式化与估计工具；但该方法针对黑箱分类器的事后解释，未涉及内部 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Global Probabilistic Explanations

**abstract/A1：** Interpreting the predictions of complex black-box classifiers remains a central challenge in explainable artificial intelligence. While local explanations clarify individual predictions, there is a significant need for global probabilistic explanations that capture a model's overall behavior across the input distribution. Such an explanation is a small subset $K$ of features, whose relevance is measured by the expected probability, over a random input $\\mathbf x$, that the classifier assigns the same label to $\\mathbf x$ and to a random input agreeing with $\\mathbf x$ on $K$. In this study, we investigate the task of identifying maximally relevant global explanations under a cardinality constraint, focusing on product distributions with full support on discrete feature spaces. We introduce a spectral explainer that leverages membership queries to the black-box classifier and employs Fourier-analytic, junta-learning methods to produce probably approximately correct (PAC) explanations. Our algorithm is fixed-parameter tractable with respect to the explanation size limit, maximum feature cardinality, and desired accuracy. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets confirm the theoretical guarantees and show that the spectral explainer outperforms a greedy baseline as the explanation size increases.

</details>

### 423. [Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29513v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29513

**作者：** Linghua Zhang、Yunhe Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29513v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29513v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 SELFWRITE：让语言模型在持久 Python 会话中查看自身权重与激活，自行编写程序构造低秩权重编辑，并用隐藏门控集选出严格提升的编辑合并进权重，换代循环，全程不使用梯度；在数学题上经过五代迭代带来小幅准确率提升。

**相关性简评：** 非多模态工作，但「用正确/错误答案的激活对比构造秩一投影与低秩编辑」以及按门控集筛选编辑的做法，可供核查如何在不依赖梯度训练时塑造或筛选内部推理状态、并为正确与错误轨迹分配贡献。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.

</details>

### 424. [Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29532v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29532

**作者：** Honghao Feng、Shanhan Qu、Kai Tong、Shuquan Man、Huiping Zhuang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29532v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29532v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 P-TAP：在启用测试时学习（TTL）的多轮对话服务中，攻击者仅用逐轮升级的对抗查询污染会话适配器，使模型在累积状态下回答最终有害请求，并在四个开源指令模型上量化了攻击成功率提升，说明查询筛选有效而基于困惑度的不安全适配检测完全失效。

**相关性简评：** TTL 把输入本身当作适配数据并跨轮持久累积状态，与 LVR 关心的「推理期状态由何种内容驱动更新、如何监督与监测漂移」相通，其适配数据选择与检测失效结果可供核查 latent 工作区的状态污染风险。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Test-time learning (TTL) enables large language models to adapt to unlabeled inputs during deployment. The model updates a lightweight adapter by minimizing the next-token prediction loss on the input it receives. When these updates persist across conversation turns, every user query serves both as the request answered in the current turn and as adaptation data for later turns. By choosing the queries used for adaptation, an attacker can influence parameter updates and weaken safety alignment through ordinary interactions with a TTL chat service. To demonstrate this risk, we introduce Progressive Test-Time Adaptation Poisoning (P-TAP), a query-only multi-turn attack that jailbreaks the model by poisoning its session adapter through the service's own updates. A sequence of escalating adversarial queries shapes the adapter turn by turn; the final harmful request is then answered under the accumulated state without itself being used for adaptation. Across four open-weight instruction-tuned models, enabling updates raises attack success rates on average by 13.00 percentage points under greedy decoding and by 22.25 points under best-of-10 sampling, relative to matched sessions receiving the same queries without updates. Answering adversarial queries but adapting on unrelated text or on benign text about the same topic removes most of this increase. Among existing safeguards, screening incoming queries flags every attack stream before the final request, while a perplexity-based detector of unsafe adaptation flags none of the successful attacks.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 425. [SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29545v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29545

**作者：** Peng Chen、Chao Huang、Wenqiang Wang、Mingbo Yang、Yannan Chen、Yunkang Cao、Wei Wang、Li Shen、Fangjun Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29545v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29545v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SCRA-CLIP 用于零样本异常检测：以 von Mises–Fisher 混合建模正常/异常 patch 特征的方向分布并生成原型条件化文本提示，同时用多尺度邻域上下文偏差和自适应门控精炼 patch 表示，从而改善细粒度异常检测与定位。

**相关性简评：** 其「相对多尺度邻域上下文的偏差 + 门控」选择并改写 patch 表示的机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与细粒度细节保留提供可核查的线索；但该工作属下游检测适配，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究一步生成器的表征对齐损失应加在哪条训练路径上，发现对齐配对重建路径（配冻结 DINOv2）优于对齐生成路径，并据此提出兼顾加速与质量的方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「对齐目标是否携带输入实例信息，决定特征是否坍缩为类原型」的分析与「哪条路径承担损失」的分配视角，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态表征对齐与信息坍缩的成因，但属于图像生成情境下的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Align the Pair, Not the Sample: Representation Alignment for Faster and Better One-Step Generato

**abstract/A1：** Representation alignment markedly accelerates diffusion training, but one-step generators raise a question that diffusion does not: \\emph{which training path should receive the loss?} A one-step generator sees two kinds of inputs. Corrupted real images come with their clean counterpart, which provides an instance-paired target. Samples generated from pure noise have no corresponding real image, yet this is where the final model operates. We study this question on Priming, which trains one-step generators from scratch by reconstructing corrupted images and then matching feature distributions with optimal transport. Aligning the generative path, the natural choice, collapses recall ($0.45\\!\\to\\!0.15$--$0.25$) in all 17 configurations we test, including five target constructions and loss weights down to $0.05$. Aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder instead helps in every setting we test. A short analysis explains this asymmetry: when the target carries no instance information about the input, the optimal aligned feature is constant within each class, so the loss pulls samples toward class prototypes. A control confirms this: aligning the paired path to a random same-class image instead of the input's own image removes most of the gain. Inside the generator, paired-path alignment creates an interface block through which post-training routes noise, and the image semantics carried through it predict sample quality across 16 models. The resulting recipe, \\method, accelerates \\emph{both} training stages on ImageNet $256\\!\\times\\!256$: it matches the 160-epoch baseline with $2\\times$ fewer priming epochs, surpasses its final quality with $4\\times$ fewer post-training updates, and lowers FID to 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) at the standard budget. A joint single-stage variant trains native one-step generators and reaches FID 1.22 with 115M parameters.

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TTC4TS，一个与骨干无关的推理期框架：由冻结的预测骨干结合增强、检索和 adapter 生成多条候选预测轨迹，再通过聚合、分类或候选打分排序合成最终预测，并用于不确定性量化与区间预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「多候选生成—打分选择—测试时增加计算」流程可供核查 LVR 中候选推理状态筛选、验证与计算分配问题，但论文本身针对时间序列预测、无视觉或多模态内部状态，迁移性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Think Before You Forecast: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Time Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Test-time compute has become an important paradigm in computer vision and language modeling, where additional computation at inference time enables models to explore multiple candidate solutions and select or refine the most reliable one. However, time series forecasting models typically produce predictions through a single forward pass, leaving them vulnerable to distribution shifts and non-stationarity that frequently arise in real-world temporal data. We propose Time Test Compute for Time Series (TTC4TS), an architecture-agnostic framework that improves the predictive performance of frozen forecasting models at inference time. Given a pretrained backbone, the generator produces multiple candidate forecast trajectories using augmentation, retrieval, adapter. The synthesizer then selects or combines these candidates using aggregation, classification, or candidate-scoring and ranking methods to produce the final forecast. By increasing the number of candidates, TTC4TS scales test-time compute without retraining the forecasting backbone. Beyond improving point-forecast accuracy, TTC4TS can exploit candidate forecasts for uncertainty quantification, which supports improved interval forecasts. We also theoretically analyze when additional test-time computation improves forecasting. Experiments across diverse datasets and backbones demonstrate consistent gains in accuracy and calibration. Code is provided in https://github.com/Anoise/TTC4TS.

</details>

### 428. [Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29600v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29600

**作者：** Abdessalam Ed-dib、Amine Mohamed Aboussalah

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29600v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29600v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从信息几何角度刻画 GNN 过平滑：把每层传播算子对应的游走分布视为概率单纯形上的点云，用平方根嵌入下的 Hellinger 距离构造「聚合弥散度」D\_k，并证明其与传播矩阵秩一、随深度单调不增、受谱隙控制等性质，且在多个数据集上无需训练即可与测试精度相关。

**相关性简评：** 该深度方向上的表示弥散度指标无需训练即可度量状态坍缩程度，可能可供核查 latent/循环推理中推理状态随深度或迭代趋于同质化的问题；但图消息传递与视觉证据筛选场景的对应关系尚需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Aggregation Dispersion: An Information-Geometric Diagnostic of Oversmoothing in Graph Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) learn node representations by iteratively aggregating information from neighbors, but stacking too many layers causes all representations to converge, an effect known as oversmoothing. We propose a geometric perspective on this phenomenon. At each depth $k$, the propagation operator assigns to every node $v$ a walk distribution $p\_v^{(k)}$, a probability distribution over source nodes. These walk distributions form a point cloud on the probability simplex, whose contraction to a single point characterizes complete mixing of the propagation operator, and thus oversmoothing. To measure this contraction, we use the Fisher-Rao metric, the unique Riemannian metric on the simplex invariant up to scale under sufficient statistics, whose scaled chordal distance under the square-root embedding $p \\mapsto \\sqrt{p}$ is the Hellinger distance. The resulting diagnostic, the aggregation dispersion $D\_k$, is the variance of the embedded point cloud on the unit sphere. We prove that: (i) $D\_k = 0$ if and only if the $k$-th step propagation matrix has rank one, a necessary and sufficient condition for complete operator mixing; (ii) $D\_k$ is non-increasing with depth; (iii) the spectral gap of the propagation matrix controls the rate of this decay; and (iv) for contractive MPNNs, the aggregation dispersion upper-bounds the representation dispersion up to graph- and initialization-dependent constants. Across 14 model configurations and 11 datasets, $D\_k$ attains the highest mean absolute Pearson correlation with test accuracy across depths among eight diagnostics ($\|r\| = 0.721$, using log-transformed diagnostic values), numerically comparable to the post-training effective rank ($\|r\| = 0.688$), while requiring no training.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29618v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29618v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对自回归视频蒸馏中 DMD 的 mode-seeking 导致多样性下降的问题，提出 Mass Forcing：从共享的学生生成前缀分支多条续写，通过 latent 空间 score 积分估计 teacher-student 密度比来重加权条件 DMD 更新，并与重加权参考分布对齐。

**相关性简评：** 其把监督粒度从整段输出细化到单个状态、用分支 rollout 估计概率质量并重加权低覆盖轨迹的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索；密度比估计能否迁移到推理状态尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mass Forcing: On-Policy Mass-Aware Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for real-time video synthesis, distilling pretrained diffusion models into few-step autoregressive generators. However, its reverse-KL objective is mode-seeking and can collapse the student's conditional video distribution onto a narrow subset of modes, leading to reduced sample diversity, diminished temporal dynamics, and color oversaturation. Existing methods mitigate this issue mainly via coverage-oriented student initialization, but we observe that such coverage is transient: across three initializations, the fraction of dynamic videos drops sharply during subsequent DMD training, indicating that the mode-seeking objective, not the initialization, drives this degradation. We propose Mass Forcing, a probability-mass-aware framework that moves on-policy DMD supervision from whole videos to individual states. Each update branches several continuations from a shared student-generated prefix, making the student's probability mass at that state measurable against the teacher. First, Mass Forcing estimates relative teacher-to-student density ratios among these continuations through latent-space score integration and uses them to rebalance conditional DMD updates, amplifying rollouts underrepresented relative to the teacher. Second, since mismatched mode probabilities do not necessarily induce strong local score corrections, it aligns generated rollout sets with a reweighted reference distribution defined by the same mass estimates, providing cross-rollout supervision. Experiments on MovieGen and VBench show that Mass Forcing improves video fidelity and sustains temporal dynamics throughout training, achieving the highest Total scores among compared methods and a Dynamic Degree of 83% after 1,000 generator updates, versus 12-32% for the baselines, with no additional inference-time overhead.

</details>

<a id="paper-430"></a>

### 430. [One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29661v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29661

**作者：** Sharven Rane

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29661v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29661v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用 ExecuTorch、LiteRT、ONNX Runtime、TensorRT 的 FP32/INT8 配方转换 5 个公开 checkpoint，在 7,854 张图像和 1,938 句子上逐条比对 top-1 决策与 PyTorch 源模型是否一致，发现准确率持平时仍有超过 1% 的决策翻转，并提出以源模型 margin 最小的 200 个训练输入构成 probe set 来检出这类翻转。

**相关性简评：** 其「聚合精度不变但逐输入决策改变」的审计设计与 margin 触发的 probe set，可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 推理在量化与数值精度变化下 latent 状态与答案是否稳定；论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 表示，迁移方式需自行核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Checkpoint, Four Converters: Per Input Disagreement After On Device Conversion and a Probe Set That Catches It

**abstract/A1：** A model converted for on device or accelerated inference ships once its top 1 accuracy matches the source model. Accuracy can match while individual decisions change, and the converter, its INT8 recipe and its calibration draw each move them. We convert 5 public checkpoints (four ImageNet classifiers and a sentiment model) with the documented FP32 and INT8 recipes of ExecuTorch, LiteRT, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT and compare every top 1 decision with the PyTorch source on 7,854 images and 1,938 sentences. All 34 strict FP32 conversions reproduce every decision, yet each of the 4 vision INT8 recipes that keeps accuracy equivalent flips more than 1% of decisions: ONNX Runtime static INT8 flips 4.07% (95% CI \[3.65, 4.53\]) of ResNet 50 decisions while accuracy moves by -0.15 points, and two builds of that recipe from different calibration draws disagree on 3.44% \[3.06, 3.88\]. Where accuracy is kept, the flipped inputs are the ones the source model barely decides (AUROC of the source margin 0.90 to 0.97 on ResNet 50, every 95% CI inside \[0.89, 0.98\]), but our preregistered claim that this holds for every recipe fails on the two mobile networks, where INT8 breaks accuracy outright. A probe set of the 200 training inputs with the smallest source margin, chosen before any conversion, flags all 40 vision stacks (recall 95% CI \[0.91, 1.00\]) and all 6 text stacks that flip at least 0.5% of decisions and none of the exact FP32 conversions, so conversion checks should compare decisions on such a probe set, not accuracy.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 3 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433993

</details>

### 431. [DeclareViT: Decoupling Early Classification from Feature Refinement with Exit Query for Efficient ViTs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29674v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29674

**作者：** Xinrui Gong、Yao Rong、Chuangtao Chen、Daniel Ochs、Ulf Schlichtmann、Bing Li、Kristian Kersting、Grace Li Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29674v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29674v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DeclareViT：为每个早退分支设置独立 query，通过单向 cross-attention 从 ViT 中间层读取特征完成早分类，不修改主干 token 流，并冻结主干与最终分类器，以缓解联合训练的梯度冲突；在 ViT、DeiT、Swin 上报告了精度-效率权衡与实测加速。

**相关性简评：** 早退层选择可作为动态计算与 STOP 决策的参照，而「只读 query 不扰动主干」的设计可供核查 LVR 中如何抽取中间层证据而不破坏推理表示；不过其任务是图像分类，未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeclareViT: Decoupling Early Classification from Feature Refinement with Exit Query for Efficient ViTs

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformers achieve remarkable recognition performance but incur substantial computational cost during inference, limiting their use in latency- and compute-constrained deployment scenarios. Early-exit inference offers a promising solution by allowing easy samples to terminate at intermediate layers. However, existing approaches typically couple early classification with the shared backbone, requiring intermediate representations to support both early classification and subsequent feature refinement. Under joint training, the corresponding optimization objectives jointly update shared backbone parameters, which can lead to conflicting gradient directions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce DeclareViT, a framework that decouples early classification from feature refinement. Each exit uses a dedicated query to read intermediate features through one-way cross-attention without modifying the backbone token stream. The query branches are optimized for early classification while the backbone and final classifier remain frozen. Across ViT, DeiT, and Swin on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K, and Food-101, DeclareViT consistently establishes a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off: It achieves 1.58 times to 2.57 times multiply-accumulate (MAC)-based speed-up with only a 0.39-1.91 percentage-point accuracy drop. Wall-clock measurements on CPU and GPU further demonstrate practical inference acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/TUDa-HWAI/DeclareViT.

</details>

### 432. [Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29681v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29681

**作者：** Wendy Zheng、Yinhan He、Jundong Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29681v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29681v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GCSGNN，将反事实解释生成内嵌进 GNN 架构以实现自解释，并在 latent 空间构造全局（模型级）反事实模式，避免离散图结构改动的组合爆炸。

**相关性简评：** 其「在 latent 空间做反事实干预并与预测器联合训练」的做法，或可作为核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用的因果诊断线索，但属图领域、需较多迁移核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. To address these limitations, we propose GCSGNN (Global Counterfactual-based Self-explainable GNN), a unified framework that integrates counterfactual generation into the GNN architecture, encouraging explanations that faithfully reflect the model's decision-making process. Beyond local explanations, GCSGNN discovers shared latent patterns influencing predictions across graphs, yielding global (i.e., model-level) counterfactual explanations. We further introduce an efficient latent-space counterfactual mechanism that avoids the combinatorial complexity of discrete graph manipulation, enabling scalable discovery of generalizable modification patterns. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GCSGNN outperforms existing methods in generating effective counterfactual explanations. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/gcsgnn.

</details>

### 433. [Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29732v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29732

**作者：** Anurag Kadkol、Lawson L. S. Wong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29732v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29732v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 用 LLM 生成「建议策略」以零人工成本产出示范数据，据此 warmstart DQN 并在训练中引导探索；由于建议常次优，提出只初始化价值、不直接复制动作的 value warmstart，并在长时稀疏奖励任务上系统性退化各子技能以检验稳健性。

**相关性简评：** 「从次优建议中提取状态价值而非模仿动作」可能为 LVR 中利用次优推理轨迹做监督、避免直接对齐错误 latent 轨迹提供线索，可供核查；但该文任务是纯 RL 控制，与视觉推理状态无直接证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \\textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations. However, collecting demonstrations is expensive, and the demonstrations themselves can be suboptimal. In this work, we use a large language model (LLM) to generate an advice policy that produces demonstration data with effectively no human cost. We use this data to warmstart a DQN agent, and use the advice policy itself to guide exploration during training. Because LLM-generated advice is often suboptimal, we further introduce a value warmstart method that initializes the agent to recognize promising states from the advice policy's behavior, without directly copying its actions. To characterize the robustness of this method, we systematically perturb individual sub-skills of an LLM-generated advice policy for a long-horizon, sparse-reward task. Degraded advice still meaningfully accelerates learning relative to unaided baselines. These results suggest that LLM-generated advice, though suboptimal, can be a cheap alternative to costly human demonstrations.

</details>

### 434. [Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29735

**作者：** Behraj Khan、Shabir Ahmad、Tahir Qasim Syed、Syed Ahmad Chan Bukhari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29735v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究零样本视觉语言分类器对类别名称措辞的敏感性（「词汇漂移」），在四个 ImageNet 变体上用无泄漏协议测得 CLIP ViT-B/16 换名后 top-1 下降 14.8–17.6 点，并提出免训练的「图像接地概念链接」加可靠性门控来缓解，在 20 个骨干–数据集组合中 16 个有提升。

**相关性简评：** 可靠性门控与「将标签映射到视觉概念」的机制，可供核查如何依据视觉证据可信度筛选与加权候选，可能对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与是否真正使用视觉信息的判定；但其任务是分类而非 latent 推理，联系需较多迁移确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition

**abstract/A1：** A zero-shot vision-language classifier is highly sensitive to the class names it receives. Even when images remain unchanged, replacing familiar labels with synonyms, abbreviations, or ontology terms can significantly alter predictions. We investigate this \\emph{vocabulary shift} using a leakage-free evaluation protocol across Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ImageNetV2. With CLIP ViT-B/16, alternative class names reduce top-1 accuracy by $14.8$--$17.6$ percentage points. To address this issue, we propose \\emph{image-grounded concept linking}, a training-free method that maps class names to visual concepts and uses a reliability gate to improve predictions. The method outperforms a template ensemble across all four datasets, achieving a pooled gain of $1.8$ points. We further evaluate five vision-language backbones across four datasets. Our method improves performance in $16$ of $20$ backbone--dataset combinations, with no significantly negative results. It also reduces pooled negative log-likelihood across all five backbones. Stronger text linking and transductive refinement provide no consistent improvements, suggesting that accurate visual class-name linking remains the main challenge. A second CLIP ViT-B/16 seed confirms the improvement on ImageNetV2, but not on ImageNet-A.

</details>

### 435. [Who Sent It or How It Moved? Sender Shortcuts in Cryptocurrency Anti-Money-Laundering Benchmarks, Audited on Elliptic2 and Elliptic++](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29744v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29744

**作者：** Mohammad Nasir Uddin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29744v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29744v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文检验加密货币反洗钱基准中模型是否只学到「谁转出资金」而非「资金如何流动」，提出由发送方查找基线、新颖性基线、发送方不相交划分与泄漏检查，以及把性能分解为发送方、接收方与内在信号的诊断协议，并在 Elliptic2 与 Elliptic++ 上得到截然不同的结论。

**相关性简评：** 其基线对照加划分泄漏检查加信号分解的诊断思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中答案究竟依赖视觉证据还是语言或标签捷径，用于区分 latent 内容贡献与旁路信息；线索较远，需较多迁移核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Who Sent It or How It Moved? Sender Shortcuts in Cryptocurrency Anti-Money-Laundering Benchmarks, Audited on Elliptic2 and Elliptic++

**abstract/A1：** Two public benchmarks dominate graph-based anti-money-laundering (AML) research on Bitcoin: the transaction-level Elliptic dataset, extended as Elliptic++, and the subgraph-level Elliptic2. In both, a label is assigned according to the entity that sends the funds. We ask whether models trained on these benchmarks learn how laundering moves or merely who sent the money, and we propose a diagnostic protocol to tell the two apart: a sender lookup baseline, a novelty baseline, a sender-disjoint split with a leakage check, and a decomposition of performance into sender, receiver and intrinsic signal. On Elliptic2 the task largely reduces to classifying the sender. Under the standard random split, a no-learning lookup of sender history reaches a PR-AUC of 0.954, against 0.975 for gradient boosting on 456 features; our reimplementation of RevClassify reproduces its reported 0.97 and falls to 0.126 without sender information. When senders are held out, performance drops to 0.746, and the subgraph's own structure, transactions and receivers fall from 0.619 to 0.186. On Elliptic++ the same protocol finds the shortcut negligible: sender history reaches only 0.340 against 0.986 for the full model (3.5 against 10.1 times the test prevalence), adding it to the full model raises PR-AUC by less than 0.004 in every seed, and the transaction's own features keep 0.883 when sending addresses are held out. We trace the difference to the unit of sender identity: Elliptic2 senders are entity clusters that recur across many labeled subgraphs, whereas Elliptic++ senders are individual addresses, and fewer than half of test transactions have a sending address seen in training. A shared sender-based label rule thus produces a severe shortcut in one benchmark and a negligible one in the other, so the diagnostic must be run on each benchmark.

</details>

### 436. [Why Units Die in the Layer After a Frozen Random Encoder, and What the Number of Live Units Measures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29752v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29752

**作者：** Scott M. Norton

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29752v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29752v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究冻结随机卷积编码器之后 ReLU 单元大量死亡的原因，提出用输入「偏移量」解释，并在 Atari 智能体等设置中验证减去输入均值可提高存活单元数、加快 Pong 学习，同时修正存活单元数反映游戏复杂度的旧结论。

**相关性简评：** 其偏移诊断与输入均值减法可供核查：冻结视觉前端后，表示偏移可能导致推理层单元死亡和视觉信息坍缩；但研究对象是 RL 智能体而非 VLM 推理，迁移到 LVR 的有效性仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Why Units Die in the Layer After a Frozen Random Encoder, and What the Number of Live Units Measures

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement-learning agents can learn Atari games through a convolutional encoder whose random weights are never trained. They reach expert play in Pong and, without random action repeats, in Breakout, but training takes far longer and few ReLU units in the layer after the encoder stay alive. A dead unit outputs zero for every input and cannot learn. In earlier work we took the number of live units to measure the game's complexity. Here we ask why units die and correct that conclusion. We find that more units die as the layer's inputs lie farther from zero relative to how much they vary. We call this ratio the offset. Earlier work showed this in sparse autoencoders at the start of training. We saw it after training in agents, image classifiers, a reservoir computer and sparse autoencoders on GPT-2. A random encoder leaves the offset of its input roughly unchanged, and a formula predicted its median offset within 25 percent in all 44 cases. So a game with a bright, mostly unchanging screen gives the next layer a large offset. In Pong, subtracting the average screen raised the number of live units from between 3 and 6 of 64 to between 59 and 63, so the number alone cannot show a game's complexity. On unaltered screens none of the agents reached a training score of 18 in 50 million steps. With the subtraction all did within 5 million, about as fast as a trained encoder on unaltered screens. In Breakout the subtraction left more units alive, but average training scores did not clearly improve, and a large gap to a trained encoder remained. So we do not treat their number as something to raise for its own sake. The evidence is from small networks and three games, and in agents and image classifiers changing the offset also changed the size of the inputs. We suggest measuring the offset before training a layer on a fixed front end and, if it is large, trying to subtract the mean input.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material (121 pages) is included as an ancillary file

</details>

### 437. [DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29753v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29753

**作者：** Sriram Mandalika、Athira Nambiar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29753v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29753v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向自动驾驶 LiDAR 语义分割，提出 DREAM 双记忆框架：冻结主干，在严格在线设定下维护存储语义抽象的 latent memory 和记录不确定预测的 error memory，按余弦相似度检索并通过轻量调制注入特征空间。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜在记忆＋错误记忆的检索与特征调制」可供核查 LVR 中跨步持久潜状态更新、失败模式抑制与相似度检索（内容与位置影响）的借鉴线索，但论文本身是 3D 感知任务，不含多模态推理或 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.

**comment/C1：** CVPR 2026 Workshop

</details>

**作者：** Renhao Zhang、Abhranil Chandra、Bruno Castro da Silva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29759v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29759v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MotionPort，用低维潜表示刻画身体运动轨迹而非动作块，并按运动相似性组织搜索空间，使预测精度的提升能转化为长程规划的成功执行率。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测准确不等于可优化」的论点，以及让潜空间几何与搜索目标对齐的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的组织方式是否支持轨迹搜索与答案选用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Should World Models Plan Over? Learning Geometry-Aligned Representations of Body Motion

**abstract/A1：** We introduce MotionPort, which learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion for accurate dynamics prediction and effective long-horizon planning. Existing world-model planners often search over action representations learned for prediction, yet we show that predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that optimization can discover successful trajectories. MotionPort addresses this mismatch by representing body trajectories rather than action chunks and organizing the search space by motion similarity, helping predicted improvements translate into successful execution. Without fine-tuning state encoders, MotionPort raises average goal-reaching success from 37.9% to 87.8% across three backbones and seven settings in four domains. On the evaluated AntMaze-OGBench tasks, it achieves 72% success, compared with 4% for the strongest baseline.

</details>

### 439. [probly: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29762v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29762

**作者：** Paul Hofman、Clemens Damke、Timo Löhr、Santo M. A. R. Thies、Alireza Javanmardi、Valentin Margraf、Jakub Paplham、Yusuf Sale、Eyke Hüllermeier、Maximilian Muschalik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29762v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29762v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** probly 是一个模块化 Python 库，把不确定性表示（二阶分布、credal sets、conformal prediction）、相应的量化度量与评估协议统一起来，并在选择性预测、OOD 检测、主动学习以及目标本身为分布的一阶数据上开展基准研究。

**相关性简评：** 其 conformal prediction 与 credal set 等置信度表示及选择性预测协议，或可供核查作为 LVR 中停止决策（STOP）与弃权判据的实现工具，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** probly: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning

**abstract/A1：** As machine learning systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, the question of how to represent and quantify uncertainty has moved from a methodological side issue to a central concern. In practice, however, making a model uncertainty-aware is still surprisingly difficult: relevant tools tend to be scattered across libraries, each tied to a particular framework and a particular approach to modeling uncertainty, and the choice of representation, quantification, and evaluation is typically left to the user without much guidance. In this paper, we present probly, a Python package that addresses these issues in a single, modular framework. probly offers (i) lightweight transformations that turn existing models into uncertainty-aware ones, currently supporting PyTorch, scikit-learn, and Flax, (ii) several representations, including second-order distributions, credal sets, and conformal prediction, (iii) the corresponding quantification measures, and (iv) a number of evaluation protocols, which can be combined more or less arbitrarily. Using probly, we conduct a benchmark study on three standard tasks --- selective prediction, out-of-distribution detection, and active learning. In addition, and unlike existing benchmarks, we evaluate suitable methods on first-order data, i.e., datasets for which the target itself is a distribution over outcomes. We further illustrate the flexibility of the package on a number of less standard case studies, including large language models, graph neural networks, and data streams. The package is publicly available at https://github.com/pwhofman/probly.

</details>

### 440. [Constrained Diffusion from Binary Evaluations via Learned Doob h-Functions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29779v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29779

**作者：** Ssaumya Kammal Jaiswal、Mahfuza Farooque

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29779v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29779v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出基于 Doob h-transform 的约束扩散生成框架：仅用对干净样本的二值评估，在加噪状态上做平方误差回归，学习「噪声样本最终去噪后落入约束集的概率」这一单函数；冻结基模型、每约束训练一个轻量头，并以该概率作为引导信号（其特例为噪声状态分类器引导）。

**相关性简评：** 用仅结果级二值反馈在中间带噪状态上学习「最终成功概率」，可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中对 latent 中间状态的成功/价值预测，用于计算分配或停止决策；但论文场景是图像与分子约束生成，与本主线的联系属推测，需核查其信号消失区与逆概率权重的处理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Constrained Diffusion from Binary Evaluations via Learned Doob h-Functions

**abstract/A1：** Conditional generation under constraints that can only be checked on a finished sample, such as a molecular property filter, remains challenging for diffusion models: most guidance methods require differentiable measurement operators, paired conditional data, or rollouts of the base model at every step. We present a framework grounded in the Doob $h$-transform that reduces conditional generation to learning a single function, the probability that a noisy sample denoises into the constraint set. We learn this function from binary clean-sample evaluations alone, by squared-error regression on forward-noised labels; the base model is frozen, one lightweight head is trained per constraint, and noisy-state classifier guidance arises as a special case. The exact guidance step fades where the constraint signal provably vanishes and carries a factor of the inverse probability across samples, which normalized guidance discards: with the schedule and mean step size held fixed, equalizing the step costs 17.0 to 18.5 points of constraint satisfaction on CIFAR-10 at comparable FID, across independently trained estimators. Guidance is more than 50$\\times$ cheaper per satisfying sample than rejection sampling at a 1.7% base rate, raises a Lipinski-type property filter on QM9 from 54.3% to 96.8%, and lifts satisfaction on Stable Diffusion 1.5 from 7.2% to 60.0% at one sixteenth of the cost of derivative-free selection, which reaches 9.0%. These results demonstrate that binary evaluations of clean samples are sufficient supervision for constrained generation across pixel, latent, and molecular diffusion.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 441. [Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29795v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29795

**作者：** Qiyao Liang、Kajetan Schweighofer、Xin Qiu、Risto Miikkulainen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29795v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29795v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 PG 与 ES 视为同一梯度的不同估计器，用“有效维度/技能数”和“有效时域”解释二者噪声成本，在可控合成任务及 20 个 NLP、数学与 agent 任务上测量并比较 Qwen2.5-7B，另在 Terminal-Bench 做初步验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「有效时域」和贡献分配视角与长程推理中的监督传播、信用分配成本直接相关，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练及停止决策的样本效率分析提供参照，但能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. We train both methods on a synthetic task where the number of skills and the effective horizon can be varied separately. PG is cheaper when the horizon is short, ES becomes cheaper once it is long enough, and this crossover moves to longer horizons as the number of skills grows. We then measure the effective horizons of 20 NLP, math reasoning, and agentic tasks and compare the two methods with Qwen2.5-7B. PG leads on short-horizon tasks, the two tie on the moderate-horizon math ones, and no task has a horizon in the regime where the theory predicts an ES advantage. Terminal-Bench has a far longer horizon. There, in a preliminary comparison with Qwen3.5-4B, ES without any credit assignment reaches a higher success rate than the PG checkpoint released with Tmax, as the theory predicts. ES should thus have the advantage on long-horizon tasks with few independent skills and a nonvanishing reward signal. Current benchmarks are only at the onset of this regime, so ES should become more competitive as agentic tasks grow longer.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 442. [Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29829v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29829

**作者：** Vaishnavi Chaughule、Yuchen Zhang、Mohammed Ahnaf Tajwar、Sai Akshay Menta、Saanidhya Vats、Vinija Jain、Aman Chadha、Divya Chaudhary

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29829v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29829v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用三层溯源协议（个案实际因果、干预式 Shapley 归因、上游风险分数的中介分析）审计一条用于非法加密货币交易监测的 agentic LLM 流水线，并单独测试 LLM 裁判在不同证据包、骨干和提示下的判决行为。

**相关性简评：** 其「哪个组件真正作出决定」的归因思路和「证据包本身已编码捷径分数」的发现，可供核查 LVR 中答案对 latent 与视觉/输入旁路的贡献分配，该审计协议或可迁移用于判断推理状态是否真被使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring

**abstract/A1：** Agentic pipelines that combine graph detectors, deterministic rules, retrieval-augmented generation and an LLM judge are being proposed to monitor illicit cryptocurrency flows and to write regulation-citing justifications for analysts. They are evaluated on end-to-end accuracy or on the quality of those justifications, and neither shows which component made a decision. We audit such a pipeline on the Elliptic++ Bitcoin dataset with decision-source attribution, a trace-level protocol with three layers: per-case actual causation, interventional Shapley credit, and mediation of upstream risk scores. A deterministic wallet-score override carries about 94% of the credit for flags, and a verification gate cancels most of the judge's own flags, which fall on licit transactions. Testing the judge alone over 76 evidence bundles, four backbones and two prompts, we find that it follows an injected risk score on the anonymous transaction features it is given, although stronger models decide correctly when the facts are explicit; that a context too short for the system prompt leaves it with no verdict at all; and that it cites regulatory clauses that do not apply, which a substring-based citation check accepts. Hiding the score does not fix the judge, because evidence gathered with the score visible still encodes it. For illicit-activity monitoring, an LLM's justification should therefore not be read as evidence of which component flagged a transaction.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Big Data Analysis AND Illicit Trends (BANDIT) at IEEE BigData 2026

</details>

### 443. [Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29839v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29839

**作者：** Xin Zhou、Cong Miao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29839v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29839v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Dynamics Forcing 训练方案：在因果视频世界模型中用随机加噪、模型自重采样和「最近块仍带噪」的联合去噪来改写历史呈现方式，并把历史引导与首帧锚定引导从推理移入训练，以缓解误差累积和复制前一帧的捷径，无需教师模型、蒸馏或额外推理模型。

**相关性简评：** 其把模型自生成、部分带噪的中间历史作为训练条件并提供引导监督，可能为 LVR 中基于自生成轨迹的训练、干净前缀监督带来的 exposure bias，以及中间 latent 状态的使用与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是视频世界模型，与 VLM 推理状态的联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models

**abstract/A1：** Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 444. [MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29847v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29847

**作者：** Zhiyu Zhang、Yuankai Li、Muhao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29847v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29847v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出端侧可部署的移动 GUI agent 运行时安全护栏 MobileGrail：用一个循环任务状态只保留后续安全判断所依赖的证据，并区分 unsafe 与 block 两类标签以在干预窗口内提前阻断，配套可验证标签的 32 应用环境和离线基准 MobileVeto 进行训练与评测。

**相关性简评：** 「循环状态仅保留决策所需证据」与干预窗口内的提前阻断，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、状态压缩和 STOP 时机决策相关；但该文面向安全护栏而非视觉推理，可供核查是否真有可迁移机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety

**abstract/A1：** Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.

</details>

### 445. [Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29859v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29859v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29859v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文用基于质心的框架评估 GPT-5 与 Gemini 3 Flash 在 15 个 H5N1 One Health 问题上的语义可重复性与可再现性，对 5400 条回答计算 MPNet 嵌入的余弦相似度，并引入 ICC 与 Cronbach's α 等一致性统计量。

**相关性简评：** 其「嵌入质心相似度＋信度统计」的度量方式可供核查是否用于量化 latent 推理状态在多次采样与提示改写下的稳定性，但原文仅做领域问答的答案一致性分析，未涉及视觉或内部状态，迁移性需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions

**abstract/A1：** Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has re-emerged as a One Health concern since 2024, and the public is increasingly consulting large-language-model (LLM) chatbots for health information during outbreaks. Before a chatbot's accuracy can be meaningfully assessed, its consistency must first be understood, so that any single response can be trusted as a fair representative of the model's behavior. We characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Flash (Google) on 15 H5N1 One Health questions sourced from social media discourse by adopting and extending a centroid-based evaluation framework. Each question was submitted 30 times and reformulated using five Chain-of-Thought (CoT) variants with 30 runs each, yielding 5,400 responses. Pairwise cosine similarity was computed on MPNet embeddings, with sensitivity analyses across three additional transformers. Statistical inference combined standard nonparametric tests (paired Wilcoxon and Friedman with Holm--Bonferroni correction) with inter-embedding agreement statistics (ICC(2,k) and Cronbach's $α$) introduced here as a methodological addition. Both models produced high mean consistency (0.93--0.97, rescaled to {\[}0, 1{\]}). GPT-5 showed reproducibility significantly higher than repeatability (W = 3.0, p = 0.0003), whereas for Gemini 3 Flash the two metrics were statistically indistinguishable (W = 42.0, p = 0.33). Differential Diagnosis ranked among the top two CoT framings for consistency in both models. The tested chatbots behave as semantically stable sources on H5N1 One Health questions, and the developed consistency evaluation framework is portable to other domains.

</details>

### 446. [Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29877v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29877

**作者：** Chenwei Xu、Shang Wu、Zhenyu Pan、Jianshu Zhang、Pranav Maneriker、Lie Lu、Fan Du、Manling Li、Han Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29877v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29877v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 VCMR 框架 RELAY：用批内 query bank 抑制热门视频偏置，VLM 为候选视频一次性生成场景与实体笔记供 LLM 重排，再由 VLM 定位时刻，并通过 prompt caching 在多个查询选中同一视频时复用帧。

**相关性简评：** 其「视频笔记」式证据压缩、跨查询记忆复用与帧缓存机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、中间状态缓存及匹配贡献分配提供可核查线索，但论文并未研究 latent 推理状态或推理期计算调度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

</details>

### 447. [SpectralRoute: Adaptive Spectral Routing for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Hyperspectral Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29919v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29919

**作者：** Qingmei Li、Xiaoya Fan、Juepeng Zheng、Jianxi Huang、Haohuan Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29919v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29919v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SpectralRoute，一个免训练的高光谱开放词表分割框架：从高光谱构建互补光谱视图、用外部光谱知识扩充类别描述，并引入按类别自适应的光谱路由与物理先验来选择性放大判别性响应。

**相关性简评：** 其「按类别选择性路由多路光谱证据、避免均匀融合」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与多视图贡献分配提供线索；但该工作面向遥感分割、无 latent 推理状态与停止决策，路由是否仅依赖单次前向响应仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpectralRoute: Adaptive Spectral Routing for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Hyperspectral Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables the recognition of arbitrary categories through natural language descriptions and has recently been extended from natural images to remote sensing. However, existing approaches primarily focus on three-channel optical imagery or limited-band multispectral data, while pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to directly exploit the rich spectral information of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) without additional adaptation. More importantly, different land-cover categories rely on distinct spectral cues, which may be weakened by uniform fusion. To address these challenges, we propose SpectralRoute, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary hyperspectral segmentation. Specifically, we construct complementary spectral views from HSI and enrich category descriptions with external spectral knowledge, enabling frozen vision-language models to extract diverse spectral-semantic responses. We then introduce a class-adaptive spectral routing mechanism that selectively amplifies discriminative spectral responses for each category, overcoming the limitations of uniform fusion. Furthermore, physical spectral priors are incorporated to refine predictions for visually similar land-cover categories. Experiments on three hyperspectral benchmarks demonstrate that SpectralRoute consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods without additional training.

</details>

### 448. [Reward Blindness: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Reinforcement Learning Reward Limitations in Text-to-SQL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29930v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29930

**作者：** Lakshmi Muraleedharan Nair、Shiqi Huang、Fangyu Lo、Yihua Xu、Dingyan Shang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29930v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29930v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Reward Error Sensitivity 度量与「奖励盲区」定理：当奖励对某类错误不敏感时，策略梯度不含消除该错误的系统性信号；并在 BIRD 上用 14 种细粒度错误信号估计多种奖励设计的敏感性，显示各奖励族存在可预测盲点，且数据库级检查可检出 45–60% 语义错误。

**相关性简评：** 其「奖励是否对特定错误类型敏感」的诊断框架可供核查：或可迁移到 LVR 中检验训练信号能否区分某类视觉/推理失败，从而辅助判断 latent 内容的贡献分配与监督是否真实生效。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reward Blindness: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Reinforcement Learning Reward Limitations in Text-to-SQL

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-SQL systems let users without programming expertise query relational databases in natural language. Reinforcement learning has become the dominant way to train such systems, yet progress is still judged by a single number, execution accuracy, which counts correct queries but says nothing about which kinds of semantic error survive training. This paper develops a theoretical framework that examines text-to-SQL from the perspective of reward design. We introduce Reward Error Sensitivity, a measure of how strongly a reward function separates queries that contain a given error type from queries that do not, and prove a Reward Blindness theorem: when this sensitivity is zero, policy-gradient training carries no systematic signal for removing that error. Using fourteen published finegrained error signals for four text-to-SQL systems on the BIRD benchmark, we build error profiles and estimate sensitivities for common reward designs. Predicate and result-level errors are the most frequent, firing on up to 27 percent of queries, while structurally deep errors such as suboptimal joins persist at 5 to 12 percent. Each reward family has a distinct and predictable set of blind spots, and inexpensive database-level checks that need no language model calls detect 45 to 60 percent of semantic errors. Controlled training simulations confirm that executiononly reward leaves output-preserving errors untouched, whereas a signal-grounded reward removes them even when the detectors are noisy.

</details>

### 449. [KGLP-Net: Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning With Group Fisher Pruning for Hyperspectral Image Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29944v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29944

**作者：** Wenshuai Deng、Wen Xie、Abdel Hamid Soliman、Qianzheng Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29944v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29944v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 KGLP-Net，用 Global Mamba 编码器与 Local CNN 编码器构成双视角高光谱分类框架，并以 Kalman 式后验更新按不确定度融合全局先验与局部观测，再依据后验精度结合 Group Fisher 重要性做结构化剪枝。

**相关性简评：** 其按估计不确定度对全局上下文先验与局部观测做后验加权的做法，可供核查多源视觉证据可靠性筛选与 latent 状态的加权更新机制；但该文面向高光谱分类与模型压缩，不涉及推理步或生成式 latent 推理，迁移仅为可能。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** KGLP-Net: Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning With Group Fisher Pruning for Hyperspectral Image Classification

**abstract/A1：** Accurate hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires both the effective integration of broad spatial context and fine-grained spectral--spatial information surrounding target pixels. However, the reliability of these complementary representations may vary considerably across heterogeneous scenes, and uncertainty estimates obtained during feature fusion are rarely exploited to guide subsequent model compression. To address these challenges, we propose Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning with Group Fisher Pruning (KGLP-Net), a unified framework that couples uncertainty-aware feature fusion with reliability-guided structured pruning. Specifically, an asymmetric dual-view architecture employs a Global Mamba Encoder to capture long-range spatial dependencies and a Local CNN Encoder to extract fine-grained spectral--spatial features from target neighborhoods. To adaptively integrate these complementary representations, Kalman-Reliable Fusion (KRF) estimates their relative uncertainties in feature space and performs a Kalman-inspired posterior update, treating global features as a contextual prior and local features as an observation. Building upon the resulting posterior uncertainty, Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning (KRGF) quantifies group-level reliability through normalized posterior precision and integrates it with Group Fisher importance to identify and prune Kalman-coupled channel groups, enabling structurally consistent model compression. Experiments on four public HSI datasets demonstrate that the resulting Compact48 model, with a hidden width of 48, achieves the highest overall accuracy among ten representative competing classifiers. Compared with the unpruned Dense64 model, Compact48 reduces the number of parameters, FLOPs, and inference time by 38.5%, 34.8% and 37.6% on average, respectively, while incurring only a 0.03-percentage-point decrease in mean overall accuracy.

</details>

### 450. [Beyond Fixed Prompt Configuration: Alternating Policy Learning for Adaptive Topology-Based Prompting in Few-Shot Graph Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29950v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29950

**作者：** Yizhuo Ma、Yihong Huang、Rongzheng Wang、Jiakai Li、Ke Qin、Shuang Liang、Jie Shao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29950v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29950v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究少样本图学习中的拓扑式提示，先实证分析提示内容与传播结构耦合导致的非对称性能效应与配置选择困难，再提出 TTPR 两阶段强化学习框架，用边级策略构建连接模式、节点级策略生成提示节点方案，两策略在对方固定条件下交替优化。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理主线无直接关联，但其以「固定一方策略」条件更新来解耦内容与结构的训练方式，以及 group-wise 相对策略优化做配置贡献比较的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容与传播结构分离、训练监督与贡献分配的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Fixed Prompt Configuration: Alternating Policy Learning for Adaptive Topology-Based Prompting in Few-Shot Graph Learning

**abstract/A1：** Graph Prompt Learning (GPL) adapts frozen pre-trained graph models to few-shot graph tasks through a small set of trainable prompts that encode task-specific information. Topology-based prompting instantiates this idea by augmenting an input graph with new prompt nodes and edges, yielding promising performance. However, prompt content and propagation structure are coupled, making it difficult to assess their individual effects and learn compatible configurations. In this paper, we empirically analyze two challenges in learning adaptive policies for topology-based prompting: asymmetric performance effects and coupled configuration selection. We then propose TTPR, a two-stage reinforcement framework that alternately optimizes two policies to generate adaptive configurations, with each policy conditioned on configurations generated by the other fixed policy. These conditional updates separate policy evaluation while preserving configuration compatibility. Specifically, TTPR models an edge-level policy to construct connection patterns and optimizes it with Connection Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO) through group-wise comparisons of complete connection patterns. The other is a node-level policy that generates prompt-node schemes and is optimized with Incremental Node Proximal Policy Optimization (INPPO) through incremental prompt-count decisions and feature generation. Across diverse datasets and pre-training strategies, TTPR ranks first in 8/10 few-shot node classification settings and attains the highest average performance across graph classification benchmarks.

</details>
