### 451. [Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29954v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29954

**作者：** Cosmo Santoni

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29954v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29954v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Yggdrasil，将每层循环转移放入树路由的循环专家库，每步仅沿一条树路径读取单个专家，使模型容量与单步计算解耦；并证明跨层上下文对条件重置是必要的，同时保留并行扫描训练，在状态跟踪任务与 enwik8/hg38 上评测并强调 CPU 推理效率。

**相关性简评：** 其循环状态转移、条件重置、稀疏专家路由与「活跃权重小、容量大」的设计，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、动态计算分配及长度泛化提供可核查的架构线索，但属纯文本序列建模，需确认能否迁移到视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference

**abstract/A1：** Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\\times$ and $3.3\\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\\,μ\\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\\,μ\\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/CosmoNaught/yggdrasil

</details>

### 452. [Aligning Judge Models to Be Logically Consistent Multi-Rule Interpreters](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29975v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29975

**作者：** Michel Liao、Nimra Nadeem、Luxi He、Peter Henderson

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29975v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29975v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文揭示评判模型在一次性读入完整规则集时比逐条判定更宽松的「多规则不一致」现象，并比较提示、GRPO 一致性训练与迭代规则细化三种缓解手段。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本裁判任务，但「上下文规则集改变模型内部解释」及一致性训练、迭代规则细化的做法，可供核查 LVR 中训练监督与上下文旁路如何偏移 latent 推理状态；与视觉证据筛选无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Aligning Judge Models to Be Logically Consistent Multi-Rule Interpreters

**abstract/A1：** Technical governance of AI models will soon require them to reason over and follow thousands of rules from different jurisdictions. However, as we show in this work, presenting an entire ruleset to a judge model---rather than asking it to judge one rule at a time---changes the way the model interprets the requirements, making it reach conclusions that conflict with its rule-by-rule judgments. We call this challenge multi-rule inconsistency and find that models are more lenient when judging rules embedded within the full ruleset than when judging rules separately. For example, we find that when a safety-critical rule prohibiting a model from pursuing objectives other than those it was given appears in a larger ruleset, all tested judge models are less likely to deem it violated. We examine several methods for reducing inconsistency, including prompting, consistency training using GRPO, and iterative rule refinement. As in human statutory interpretation, surrounding rules shape how a rule is interpreted. Unlike the legal setting, however, these interactions are currently happening implicitly inside the judge model's reasoning. We argue that multi-rule interactions must be measured and handled explicitly by ruleset designers to prevent undetected shifts in interpretation from causing downstream alignment failures.

</details>

**作者：** Xinyu Yan、Yurong Hao、Zherui Li、Yebo Wu、Tiantong Wu、Jiaming Zhang、Zihao Zeng、Zheng Lin、Zijie Wang、Pengpeng Qiao、Yang Cao、Wei Yang Bryan Lim

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Antiphony 框架做深伪视频检测：以真实视频为共享参考，对四个视觉专家的打分做校准融合并控制误报，再让工具调用的多模态调查器只在接近校准阈值的样本上补充判断，并用反事实专家输出训练该调查器。

**相关性简评：** 「仅在阈值附近触发调查器」是一种按不确定性分配视觉证据获取的机制，可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选提供线索；其用反事实专家输出训练对不可靠证据的鲁棒性，可供核查 latent 证据的贡献分配与融合。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. To refine decisions near the calibrated threshold, a tool-using multimodal investigator examines these videos and contributes an additional fusion score. We train the investigator on generator-held-out predictions and counterfactual expert outputs, to improve robustness to unreliable expert evidence. Across six benchmark protocols, Antiphony achieves a mean benchmark score of 88.3%, exceeding the strongest evaluated MLLM and conventional detector baselines by 14.7 and 11.5 points, respectively. It also outperforms ARGUS by 20.2 points on average and by 3.6 balanced-accuracy points on FaceVid's 20 unseen generators.

</details>

### 454. [MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30022v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30022

**作者：** Xiangyu Li、Yu Jiang、Tianyi Wang、Liang He、Qixing Huang、Zhaomiao Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30022v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30022v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对残差世界模型会丢弃弱时变线索（如等待的行人、静止车辆）的问题，论文提出 MOVER：训练期教师通过删除历史帧测量各空间事件查询的敏感度，并与该事件的池化时间残差对比，优先选出「依赖历史但残差证据弱」的事件；学生从无扰动历史预测这些优先级，再以固定总质量的路由分布缩放低秩 BEV 更新并偏置轨迹条件的事件读取，推理不增加教师开销。

**相关性简评：** 其基于扰动敏感度的事件证据筛选与训练期教师—学生路由，可能可供核查 LVR 中「哪些视觉证据应写入 latent 状态」及如何以低成本监督证据分配；但该工作面向自动驾驶规划，未涉及多模态 latent 推理，迁移性需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion

**abstract/A1：** Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QSRadar: Query-Conditioned Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Efficient 3D Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Reliable 3D object detection for autonomous trucks requires both the semantic detail provided by cameras and the geometric and motion cues measured by 4D radar. Existing radar-camera detectors commonly construct global radar bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, whose computational and memory costs grow with the perception range. Sparse query-based detectors offer greater efficiency, but global feature construction can obscure point-level radar geometry and motion information. We present QSRadar, a query-conditioned sparse radar fusion framework for efficient long-range 3D detection. Built on a Sparse4Dv3-style visual-temporal detector, QSRadar retrieves a compact set of raw radar points around each evolving object hypothesis. The selected points are represented in an anchor-aligned coordinate frame, augmented with motion residuals, radar cross section, and sweep timing, and aggregated by a query-conditioned set encoder. Radar neighborhoods are retrieved again after each anchor refinement, coupling evidence selection with object estimation. Under the official MAN TruckScenes validation protocol, QSRadar achieves 38.09 mAP and 52.20 NDS, compared with 37.08 mAP and 50.78 NDS for our reproduced Sparse4D-Radar global Radar-BEV baseline. In matched tests on an RTX 4090 D, QSRadar reduces latency by 45%, peak memory usage by 49%, and GFLOPs by 43%.

**comment/C1：** Radar-camera fusion, 3D object detection, autonomous driving

</details>

### 456. [Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30025v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30025

**作者：** Byunggu Yu、Justin Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30025v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30025v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DAWIN，一种用闭式阻尼演化把空间投影与经过时间耦合进局部复数状态的连续时间神经元，可替换 MLP、Transformer、GNN 中的标准层，并给出闭式梯度、稳定性分析与并行前缀扫描实现。

**相关性简评：** 与该工作主线无直接视觉推理关联，但其按时间间隔更新复数潜在状态、避免数值求解的闭式演化，以及 O(log L) 前缀扫描的并行状态计算，可供核查 LVR 中推理状态更新与并行/循环生成的实现线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neurons (DAWIN): A Universal Primitive for Continuous-Time Spatiotemporal Learning

**abstract/A1：** Conventional artificial neurons separate spatial feature aggregation from continuous physical time, limiting their ability to model irregular observations. We introduce the Damped Atomic Wave Integration Neuron (DAWIN), a continuous-time primitive for replacing standard neural layers in MLPs, Transformers, and graph neural networks. DAWIN couples spatial projection with elapsed-time-dependent wave excitation and integrates it into a local complex state through closed-form damped evolution, avoiding numerical differential equation solvers. We show that DAWIN generalizes static sinusoidal and memoryless wave neurons on interval-augmented inputs, derive closed-form gradients, and establish bounded-input bounded-output stability for positive damping and sampling intervals bounded away from zero. An associative Triton prefix-scan implementation, DAWINLinear, uses FP32 accumulation and achieves O(log L) parallel depth for sequence length L. Across 11 parameter-matched tasks covering irregular oscillators, MuJoCo dynamics, pedestrian trajectories, and PhysioNet 2012 clinical sequences, DAWIN outperforms Neural CDE on 9 tasks and ReLU-MLP on 8. It achieves the lowest error on dense clinical dynamics (0.9531 NRMSE, winning across all 10 seeds) and ties for the best mortality prediction (0.9993 AUROC). Shuffling elapsed intervals increases error by 58.2%-77.4% on selected dynamics tasks, versus 0.06% on a time-irrelevant control, supporting reliance on physical timing. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, parallel wave integration accelerates inference by up to 2,630 times over its serial implementation and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 97.6% relative to Mamba in the tested configurations.

**comment/C1：** 17 Pages, 3 Figures, and 4 Tables

</details>

### 457. [Teaching How to Reason, Beyond What to Answer: Evidence-Faithful On-Policy Distillation for streaming video understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30040v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30040

**作者：** Mengnan Liu、Sanping Zhou、Kun Xia、Jiaxuan Lin、Gang Hua、Le Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30040v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30040v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向视频时刻检索，提出 MPAR：由查询初始化多个可学习表示槽，向其中注入目标相关的视觉属性，再将各槽与对应视频区域对齐，以缓解稀疏文本描述与丰富视觉细节之间的对齐落差。

**相关性简评：** 可学习表示槽在保留查询意图的同时注入视觉线索、并与视频区域对齐，可能为 LVR 中把视觉证据写入 latent 状态及多假设筛选提供线索；但属视频定位任务应用，且标题所称 on-policy distillation 未在摘要体现，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teaching How to Reason, Beyond What to Answer: Evidence-Faithful On-Policy Distillation for streaming video understanding

**abstract/A1：** Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to localize the temporal segment in a video that corresponds to a given textual description. However, a textual query often provides only a sparse semantic description of the target event, whereas the video contains rich and fine-grained visual variations. This mismatch creates an inherent gap between textual semantics and visual content, making a single textual input insufficient for precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, when multiple temporally adjacent or semantically similar segments exist, the model may struggle to distinguish the target moment from confusing candidates. To address this challenge, we propose a Multi-Perspective Auxiliary Representation (MPAR) framework, which aims to bridge this alignment gap by enriching a single textual input with complementary visual cues from multiple perspectives. Specifically, MPAR consists of three key components: (1) Auxiliary Representation Initialization (ARI) constructs multiple learnable representation slots from the original query, preserving the query intent while preparing flexible carriers for subsequent visual cue injection; (2) Visual-Induced Semantic Structuring (VISS) injects target-specific visual attributes into each representation while preserving semantic coherence with the original query; and (3) Multi-Perspective Semantic Aligner (MPSA) aligns each auxiliary representation with corresponding video regions to enhance discriminative localization. By constructing multi-perspective auxiliary representations and guiding the model to attend to relevant visual regions across these representations, our model achieves more accurate moment localization. Extensive experiments on MR benchmarks demonstrate that our MPAR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of MPAR.

</details>

### 458. [PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30050v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30050

**作者：** Yasaman Mohammadpour、Pouya Shaeri、Ariane Middel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV、eess.SP、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30050v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30050v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PsyDrift，在自闭症谱系障碍的脑功能连接数据上，把有监督编码器得到的 128 维表征与仅用健康样本训练的 latent DDPM 结合，以扩散去噪重建距离作为连续偏离分数，并在 ABIDE-I 多站点及跨队列数据上评估分类与迁移表现。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但「健康参考 latent 扩散 + 重建距离打分」或可迁移为对 LVR 内部状态是否偏离有效表征流形的监控与打分线索，值得核查其分数是否真正反映内容而非表征伪影。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PsyDrift: Healthy-Reference Latent Diffusion for Anomaly Scoring in Autism Spectrum Disorder

**abstract/A1：** Individual heterogeneity and acquisition-site variability complicate neuroimaging-based characterization of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). We propose PsyDrift, combining ASD/healthy-control-supervised functional-connectivity representations with healthy-reference latent diffusion. An encoder produces 128-dimensional representations, and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) learns exclusively from healthy training latents. Distance from a diffusion-denoised reconstruction provides a continuous deviation score. We evaluate 1,102 subjects from all 20 ABIDE-I sites using five-seed leave-one-site-out cross-validation. The classifier and DDPM achieve mean-site AUROCs of $0.798 \\pm 0.003$ and $0.718 \\pm 0.013$, respectively; uncertainties denote seed standard deviations. Matched healthy-reference scorers on the same representation achieve 0.68-0.71; the statistical significance of diffusion's modest numerical advantage remains unestablished. Within ASD, scores show weak associations with ADOS Total (Spearman $ρ= 0.108$, $p = 0.038$) and full-scale IQ ($ρ= -0.138$, $p = 0.002$), without adjustment for age, sex, site, or head motion. Frozen evaluation without retraining or hyperparameter adaptation yields pooled AUROCs of 0.69 on ABIDE-II and 0.61 on ADHD-200, providing preliminary evidence of cross-cohort and cross-disorder transfer. These results demonstrate healthy-reference deviation scoring within an ASD-supervised representation; incremental predictive and clinical value remains unestablished.

**comment/C1：** Extended version of a paper accepted at the CVPath-Vision4Neuro Workshop at WACV 2027. Includes expanded related-work and future-work discussion

### 459. [Bi-Refine: Semantic Verification-Guided Progressive Refinement for Moment Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30055v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30055

**作者：** Mengnan Liu、Sanping Zhou、Kun Xia、Jiaxuan Lin、Yuxuan Wu、Gang Hua

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30055v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30055v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Bi-Refine，把视频时刻检索建模为「定位—语义验证」闭环：定位分支产生候选片段，验证分支在语义增强的隐空间中评估候选与查询的一致性，并用可靠性估计门控查询更新与特征反馈，最后以收敛式自适应策略终止迭代。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐空间候选-查询验证 + 门控式状态更新 + 自适应停止」与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及 STOP 的收益/成本判断有可核查的方法线索，但任务属视频时刻检索，迁移性需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bi-Refine: Semantic Verification-Guided Progressive Refinement for Moment Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the temporal segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural language query. Existing approaches commonly refine temporal predictions within the localization pathway, without explicitly verifying candidate-level semantic consistency. Moreover, directly reusing semantic scores as feedback can cause over-correction when the verification signal is unreliable. To address these issues, we propose Bi-Refine, a semantic verification-guided progressive refinement framework that formulates MR as a closed-loop verification-and-refinement process. A Heuristic Localization Branch first generates candidate moments, while a Semantic Verification Branch evaluates their query consistency in a semantically enriched latent space. Query supervision further trains the verifier with the same candidate moment but different queries, encouraging it to distinguish the matched query from semantically similar mismatched queries. The resulting verification features are incorporated into a Progressive Refinement Loop that updates both query representations and multimodal features. To suppress potentially harmful updates, a lightweight reliability estimator gates query updates and reweights candidate contributions in feature feedback. A convergence-based adaptive stopping strategy additionally terminates unnecessary refinement during inference. Experiments on three standard MR benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance of our method.

</details>

### 460. [FireDesmoke: Fire Smoke Removal via Real Smoke Transfer and Semantic Rectification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30057v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30057

**作者：** Chih-Chung Hsu、Rong-Lin Jian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30057v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30057v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FireDesmoke 用于真实火灾烟雾去除：一方面把真实火场烟雾场迁移到清晰图像上合成训练对，另一方面用像素特征校正冻结基础编码器中被烟雾污染的 token，以在去除浓烟的同时保持清晰区域不变。

**相关性简评：** 其「退化在空间上局部集中、并按位置校正冻结编码器中被污染的 token」这一机制，可能为 LVR 中受损视觉证据的筛选与内部视觉特征的局部纠错提供借鉴，可供核查其能否迁移到 latent 状态的保真问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FireDesmoke: Fire Smoke Removal via Real Smoke Transfer and Semantic Rectification

**abstract/A1：** Fire smoke removal must restore dense and medium smoke regions while preserving the clear (smoke-free) content. Existing methods either leave the smoke or alter the visible content, and generative models may hallucinate people or remove flames. Real fire smoke is spatially local: the degradation and its corruption of semantic features are both concentrated in the smoke regions. We propose FireDesmoke, built on this locality: Real Smoke Transfer calibrates smoke fields on real-fire recordings and transfers their spatial layout onto clean images to synthesize training pairs, and Semantic Rectification uses pixel features to rectify the tokens of a frozen foundation encoder where smoke corrupts them. With matched training budgets, replacing the transferred pairs with SmokeBench pairs lowers dense-smoke PSNR by 0.74 dB, and removing Semantic Rectification leaves clear regions 1.31 dB below the input. On what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first paired dataset of real fire smoke for image restoration, with 1,500 test frames from a held-out viewpoint, FireDesmoke improves dense- and medium-smoke PSNR by 3.73 and 2.63 dB while keeping clear regions at the input level (+0.41 dB); no other compared method gains at least 1 dB in dense smoke without lowering clear-region PSNR, and no hallucinated person is found in its outputs. It achieves state-of-the-art overall results on this benchmark and, trained on SmokeBench, the highest PSNR with the second-best SSIM and LPIPS.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages

</details>

### 461. [How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30064

**作者：** Xuanya Zhu、Da Li、Xiatian Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30064v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从动作条件转移场视角研究世界模型的潜在转移几何如何影响多步规划：以曲率正则化作为受控干预，在四个连续控制任务上检验其影响，并把转移场分解为仿射与非仿射成分，定位动作敏感性下降的来源。

**相关性简评：** 其把多步规划效用与单步预测精度分离，并在冻结模型中直接操纵非仿射响应做干预的思路，可供核查 LVR 中潜在状态几何是否真正支撑多步候选比较与最终答案使用，属可借鉴的诊断手段。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models

**abstract/A1：** World models support planning by predicting how the environment evolves under candidate actions. However, one-step predictive accuracy alone does not characterize multi-step planning utility, which depends on distinguishing candidate futures. This raises a natural question: How does latent transition geometry shape planning? We investigate this through an action-conditioned transition-field view, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention. Across four continuous-control tasks, appropriately tuned regularization improves planning, while excessive regularization can be detrimental. By decomposing the transition field into affine and non-affine components, we find that regularization reduces action sensitivity mainly through the non-affine component. To assess its role in planning, we directly manipulate the non-affine action response in frozen models and show that it affects candidate selection and closed-loop success. Further analysis shows that curvature generally brings predicted futures closer together, while preserving more of the differences along the goal direction. This helps explain why the planning effects vary across tasks. We observe broadly consistent planning trends across five sampling- and gradient-based solvers on LeWM and similar rollout-geometry trends on DINO-WM. Qualitative attention visualizations reveal accompanying shifts toward task-relevant visual structure. Together, these findings clarify how latent transition geometry influences multi-step planning.

</details>

### 462. [Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30069v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30069

**作者：** Xu Yuan、Pangjing Wu、Wenqi Fan、Qing Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30069v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30069v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RenderEmbed：先将文本、图像及组合输入统一渲染为视觉输入，由 VLM 编码，再用交错的可学习 anchor 跨层融合视觉 token 状态得到紧凑检索表示，并以干预式渲染训练增强内容敏感性与渲染不变性，在 MMEB、ViDoRe v2 上评测。

**相关性简评：** 「先统一再编码」的视觉通路与跨层 anchor 汇聚 token 状态，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据保留与表示压缩的权衡提供借鉴线索；但其目标是检索嵌入，不涉及推理状态生成与停止决策，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. Interventional Rendering Learning trains these representations to remain sensitive to content changes and stable across rendering variations through complementary semantic and rendering interventions. Extensive experiments on MMEB and ViDoRe v2, spanning diverse retrieval tasks, show that RenderEmbed outperforms prior state-of-the-art models at the same scale and exhibits strong out-of-domain generalization. Compared with MetaEmbed, RenderEmbed improves MMEB Overall Precision@1 by 1.7 points, with a larger 2.1-point gain on out-of-domain tasks. Transfer and scaling analyses further show that a shared visual pathway enables more effective learning from heterogeneous supervision.

</details>

### 463. [The Growth Path Is the Missing Half of Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30081v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30081

**作者：** Tingan Jin、Haosong Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30081v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30081v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为每个神经元在常规「任务通路」之外增加一条守恒预算的「生长通路」：营养自输出反传，各层获得固定预算，单元按上层对其使用程度被喂养，富养则分裂、饥饿则死亡，从而在全训练过程中自行决定网络规模，无需额外剪枝阶段或目标尺寸；在三层感知机的 MNIST 类数据上考察窄域部署与 800 个变化任务下的计算节省与少用内容保留。

**相关性简评：** 其按激活与权重分配资源的生长通路、以及让饥饿单元「休眠」以保住少用内容的做法，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与视觉细节/低频信息防坍缩提供可供核查的训练期线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 推理状态生成，且实验规模较小。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Growth Path Is the Missing Half of Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** An artificial neuron computes and learns, but it does not live: the units of a network are fixed when it is designed, and every one of them is kept and paid for whether it is used or not. We give each neuron a second pathway. Beside its Task Path, the usual computation and gradient learning, a dual-pathway neuron has a Growth Path: a nutrient flows from the outputs back through the network, every layer receives the same fixed budget, and each unit is fed in proportion to how much the units above it use it. A well-fed unit divides and a starving unit dies. This allocation is not a separate analysis or pruning step: it runs throughout training and reads only activations and weights. The task is still learned from labels with the ordinary loss, and the training procedure gains no phase, no schedule and no target size. Because the budget is conserved, the competition is zero-sum and a single number sets the size of the network. Switched on in a pretrained network that is deployed on a narrower domain, the Growth Path shrinks the network while it keeps learning. With Adam the network ends 1.0 to 1.2 points more accurate on the domain than the same network trained ordinarily, at 24% to 60% of its compute, and at 12% of the compute it is still ahead; a random choice of the same number of units gives no gain. Letting starving pretrained units sleep instead of die keeps 1.2 to 4.6 points more of the rarely used content. Over 800 changing tasks a network with the Growth Path holds its accuracy while ordinary networks decline. With plain SGD the gains are smaller: at deployment the method trades compute against rarely used content, and on one of the two continual-learning streams it only ties networks of equal size. The experiments are small (three-layer perceptrons on MNIST-like data); what they show is that a conserved, loss-free second pathway can decide by itself which units a network needs.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Tingan Jin and Haosong Li contributed equally

</details>

### 464. [LMnOP: Pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting via Leave-Many-Out Importance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30102v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30102

**作者：** Sunjae Jeong、Jaeseung Kim、Hyoseok Hwang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30102v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30102v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 LMnOP，用于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的剪枝：以「移除其他高斯时某高斯的重要性」替代逐个移除的 leave-one-out 分数，通过闭式求出随机移除下像素颜色的均值与方差来近似该重要性，无采样、无微调，在 90%/99% 移除率下取得较好结果。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是「单独移除时冗余、共同移除时关键」的联合移除重要性与闭式近似，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中视觉 token 或 latent 状态的贡献分配与冗余/信息坍缩诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LMnOP: Pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting via Leave-Many-Out Importance

**abstract/A1：** 3D Gaussian Splatting renders photorealistic views in real time. However, a single scene often needs millions of Gaussians, so these models are costly to store and render. Pruning reduces this cost by keeping a subset of the Gaussians. A common score is the leave-one-out importance, which is the loss increase when a Gaussian alone is removed. At high pruning ratios, many Gaussians are removed together, so Gaussians that are redundant alone but essential together are lost. We present LMnOP (Leave-Many-Out Pruning), which estimates the importance of each Gaussian under the removal of the other Gaussians. This leave-many-out importance is the average loss increase when a Gaussian is removed while the others are also removed at random. We compute the exact mean and variance of each pixel's color under random removal in closed form, and approximate the importance from them without sampling removal patterns. We refine each Gaussian's probability of remaining with its importance and prune once at the end. Without fine-tuning, LMnOP achieves the best results in 16 of 18 metrics on three datasets at 90% and 99% removal. It improves SSIM and LPIPS over GaussianPOP in all 13 scenes.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 465. [Thermal-Guided Low-Light UAV Image Enhancement: A Reliability-Aware Guidance Network and a Unified Benchmark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30114v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30114

**作者：** Zhicheng Zhao、Yu Wang、Jiangong Xu、Lixiang Xu、Chenglong Li、Jin Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对夜间无人机低照度可见光增强，提出 RMGNet：先用粗到细位移估计校准热成像引导并评估其可靠性，再通过多策略路由在细节保留、高光保护重照明与热补偿之间按区域分配贡献，同时构建了弱对齐光学—热成像数据集 UWOT。

**相关性简评：** 其「先判断跨模态引导是否可靠、再据此按区域路由不同来源贡献」的设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据可信度筛选与多源信息按需加权提供可核查线索，但该文属像素级增强任务，与推理状态生成本身无关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Thermal-Guided Low-Light UAV Image Enhancement: A Reliability-Aware Guidance Network and a Unified Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Thermal-guided low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is promising for nighttime unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) perception because thermal imagery remains informative under severe visible degradation. However, the degraded visible image serves as both the alignment reference and the enhancement target, making thermal guidance uncertain in its spatial correspondence and local utility under low illumination, sensor differences, and UAV motion. Misaligned or unsuitable thermal cues may introduce artifacts, while spatially varying degradation requires region-specific restoration rather than uniform enhancement. To address these challenges, we propose a Reliability-Aware Multi-Strategy Guidance Network (RMGNet) for thermal-guided UAV LLIE under weak optical-thermal alignment. Its Reliability-Aware Guidance Calibration Module (RAGCM) performs coarse-to-fine displacement estimation and jointly evaluates the reliability of aligned thermal guidance and the usability of degraded visible evidence. Based on calibrated guidance, degradation, and reliability cues, the Multi-Strategy Enhancement Routing Module (MSERM) generates candidates for detail preservation, highlight-protected relighting, and thermal compensation, then spatially routes their contributions. We further construct the UAV weakly aligned Optical-Thermal dataset (UWOT), the largest UAV-oriented benchmark to date for weakly aligned optical-thermal low-light enhancement, containing 5,000 triplets. Extensive experiments show that RMGNet outperforms representative single-modal and multimodal state-of-the-art methods in enhancement quality while retaining competitive computational efficiency and greater robustness to practical cross-modal misalignment. The dataset and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 12 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 466. [What Remains After Concept Erasure? Sparse Autoencoder Probes for Auditing Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30117v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30117

**作者：** Zhuan Shi、Lu Wei、Yuta Nakashima、Noa Garcia、Golnoosh Farnadi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30117v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30117v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 SAE-Audit，在文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除场景中，用共享稀疏自编码器特征定位擦除后响应减弱的目标概念方向，并将原始模型得到的稀疏方向固定注入编辑模型，检验能否在不改权重和测试提示的情况下恢复目标生成。

**相关性简评：** 「输出未出现不等于内部已移除」的诊断思路，加上 SAE 特征定位与激活空间定向注入，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否仍保留任务必要视觉信息、以及这些信息是否真正被答案所使用，属于方法线索而非主线研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Remains After Concept Erasure? Sparse Autoencoder Probes for Auditing Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Concept erasure aims to remove selected visual concepts from text-to-image diffusion models while preserving the generation of non-target concepts. Evaluation typically measures target suppression and non-target preservation in generated images, but a concept's absence from these outputs does not establish its removal from the model. We introduce SAE-Audit, a white-box audit using sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes to test whether activation interventions can restore target-concept generation without changing model weights or test prompts. After verifying target suppression, we compare the original and edited models using a shared SAE representation learned from original-model activations, identifying features whose target-related responses weaken after erasure. We inject sparse directions derived from the original-model responses into the edited model, keeping these directions fixed across test prompts, and evaluate recovery on held-out scene families. Experiments span six erasure methods and four domains: objects, artistic styles, copyrighted content, and nudity. Interventions using a few dozen selected SAE features yield higher average recovery rates than matched random-feature interventions, with recovery concentrated in objects and nudity following cross-attention edits. Most styles and copyrighted concepts show limited recovery under the tested intervention settings. These findings show that output suppression can coexist with responsiveness to sparse concept directions supplied from the original model.

</details>

### 467. [WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30134v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30134

**作者：** Linxi Xie、Chonghua Liao、Mengxuan Wu、Guandao Yang、Zhangyang Wang、Kai Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30134v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30134v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** WASP 面向流式 LLM 个性化，训练一个共享超网络，从原始交互中维护紧凑用户表示并单次前向生成个性化 LoRA 适配器，新交互到来时增量更新该表示而无需重跑全部历史。

**相关性简评：** 其「循环紧凑状态＋超网络生成权重、单次更新成本与历史长度无关」的机制可供核查是否能映射到 LVR 中固定预算的 latent 工作区更新与长度泛化，但该文针对纯文本个性化，与视觉证据和推理状态的关系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization

**abstract/A1：** Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 7 figures

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30148v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30148v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 STMemoLLM，用记忆原型把多传感器输入自适应压缩成语义摘要 token，并以记忆校准路由器按上下文偏移、压缩不足与原型对齐程度筛选可靠残差信号，用于鲁棒的交通预测。

**相关性简评：** 压缩摘要 token 加门控残差的思路，可供核查 latent 状态如何平衡压缩率与细节保留、以及如何判定信息坍缩与证据取舍；但领域为时序预测，与视觉推理无直接联系，需判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** STMemoLLM: A Spatial-Temporal Memory-Augmented LLM for Robust Traffic Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Traffic forecasting is essential for intelligent transportation systems. However, traditional deep-learning models often rely heavily on high-quality observations. Recent LLM-based approaches incorporate pretrained knowledge to improve forecasting, but they remain sensitive to input perturbations and struggle to preserve long-term patterns. To address this, we propose STMemoLLM, a spatial-temporal memory-augmented LLM for robust traffic forecasting. STMemoLLM introduces memory prototypes to compress inputs into compact summary tokens while extracting reliable dynamics from residual signals, achieving a balance between stability and variability. Specifically, a memory-enhanced tokenizer encodes prototypes and sensor characteristics into attention biases to guide adaptive compression of correlated sensors into semantic summary tokens. A memory-calibrated router further evaluates contextual deviation, compression deficiency, and prototype alignment to identify reliable residual signals, which complement the summaries while suppressing noise. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets show that STMemoLLM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional experiments examine point masking, additive Gaussian noise, structured missingness, and limited training data, demonstrating strong robustness. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/STMemoLLM-70BF.

</details>

### 469. [Revisiting Continual Learning in Language Models: A Three-Interface Diagnosis of Stability and Plasticity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30151v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30151

**作者：** Keuntae Kim、Beomseok Lee、Hyunwoo Kim、Yong Suk Choi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30151v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30151v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在语言模型持续学习中提出三种评测接口——随骨干训练的分类头、冻结特征上新训练的探针、无分类器的骨干诊断，以区分遗忘源于表示退化还是读出失配。

**相关性简评：** 其「表示—读出」分离诊断可供核查：在 LVR 中或可用于判断答案增益来自 latent 视觉状态还是答案头捷径，但需迁移到多模态推理设定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revisiting Continual Learning in Language Models: A Three-Interface Diagnosis of Stability and Plasticity

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning in language models is commonly studied in the incremental learning (IL) setting, where a model learns a sequence of tasks and is evaluated through its final classifier or language-model (LM) head. This interface, however, does not indicate where forgetting occurs: a drop in accuracy may reflect representation degradation in the backbone, readout mismatch in the head, or both. We therefore argue that backward transfer (BWT) and forward transfer (FWT) should be interpreted as interface-dependent quantities rather than as single modellevel properties. We study three evaluation interfaces: the trained head, which is updated sequentially with the backbone; a probe newly trained on frozen backbone features; and a classifier-free backbone diagnostic. They measure deployed performance, recoverability under a new readout, and representation separability, respectively. Across class-incremental experiments with encoder and decoder language backbones, plus task-incremental sanity checks, conclusions about forgetting and plasticity change with the interface: the trained head often indicates severe forgetting, the probe near-complete recoverability, and the backbone diagnostic intermediate representation drift with a consistent negative relation between stability and plasticity. This relation holds for clustering-free diagnostics such as nearest-class-mean accuracy and across five clustering algorithms and three metrics. Finally, Just LM-Head Tuning (JLT), a head-only intervention on a fixed incrementally trained backbone, recovers 96-99% of the gap to joint training for replayand distillation-based methods but only about three quarters for plain sequential fine-tuning, suggesting that many failures attributed to catastrophic forgetting reflect head-backbone mismatch plus partial representation drift. Our results call for reporting where forgetting is measured, not only how much.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 - main

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReVAgent 多智能体框架：先求解题目，再为解题步骤生成关键帧并合成教学视频；各智能体共享解法程序的执行记录、复用中间构造，并通过检查渲染出的关键帧来修订解法或场景，另配一套经人工评分校准的多模态评判量表。

**相关性简评：** 其「渲染关键帧回检—再修订内部解法」的闭环可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与推理状态一致性校验的做法；但论文目标是教学视频呈现质量而非 latent 推理本身，属间接方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WaDiS，一个用于医学图像分割的小波条件 latent diffusion 框架：用多尺度小波条件编码器保留结构特征，在扩散 U-Net 跳跃连接中引入频率感知门控块做自适应频谱过滤与残差融合，并以 LAB 空间颜色统计迁移增强跨域泛化。

**相关性简评：** 任务本身是分割而非推理，但小波条件与频率门控显示了在 latent 压缩路径中显式保留高频边界细节、抑制无关内容的手段，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节是否留存于内部状态及证据筛选提供可核查的表示层线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WaDiS: Boundary-Preserving Diffusion Segmentation via Multi-Scale Wavelet Conditioning and Frequency-Aware Gating

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models have shown strong potential in medical image segmentation due to their generative capabilities and robustness. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve fine anatomical boundaries and to retain multi-scale structural information due to the loss of spatial and frequency details during feature encoding, particularly in complex clinical imaging conditions. This work presents WaDiS, a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that addresses these limitations through multi-scale wavelet conditioning and frequency-aware information filtering for boundary preservation. The model adopts a multi-scale wavelet conditioning encoder to retain rich structural features, leveraging its lossless nature to better preserve semantic priors critical to the diffusion process. In addition, a Frequency-Aware Gating Block (FAGB) is introduced into the skip connections of the diffusion U-Net, enabling adaptive spectral filtering and residual fusion to better emphasize boundary structures while reducing irrelevant content. To improve generalization across clinical domains, we adopt a structure-preserving color augmentation strategy during training. Specifically, global color statistics are transferred between samples in the LAB color space, allowing the model to decouple appearance from structure and focus more on anatomical shape rather than color bias. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that WaDiS consistently outperforms existing diffusion-based and conventional segmentation methods, with notable improvements in boundary accuracy, robustness to noise, and generalization under color variation. The code for this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Multimodal View Training：把同一文本样本渲染成语音与文字图像视图，训练多模态语言模型对三种视图输出相同目标，并用轻量 connector 让纯文本 LLM 在训练时接收多模态输入、推理时保持文本架构；在问答、机器遗忘与知识编辑上报告了提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨视图共享事实内容、弱化视图特有特征」的训练思路，可供核查视觉旁路是否只在编码层面起作用、以及对 VLM 内部事实性表示与模态不变性的影响；但不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或证据筛选，与 LVR 主线仅有训练监督层面的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multimodal View Training: Learning More Through Different Modalities

**abstract/A1：** Can a language model learn more from the same information simply by encountering it in different forms? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing Multimodal View Training (MVT), a simple training approach that presents identical information through text, speech, and images, without requiring new facts or supervision. Starting from a text sample, MVT generates corresponding audio and rendered-text image views, and trains a multimodal language model to produce the same target output across all three views. To further bring these benefits to text-only large language models (LLMs), we train lightweight connector modules to pretrained audio and vision encoders, allowing the LLM to learn from multimodal inputs while retaining its text-only architecture at inference. Across question answering, machine unlearning, and knowledge editing, adaptive MVT improves QA recall by +15.2 percentage points, forget quality by +40.7 points, and editing generality by +25.2 points over text-only training. Combining MVT with standard augmentation further improves QA and editing generality. Our theoretical analysis illustrates how training across modalities can shift weight updates toward shared factual content and reduce their reliance on features specific to each view.

</details>

**title/T1：** GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

</details>

**title/T1：** Audio-Visual Rearrangement

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

### 475. [PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30205v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30205

**作者：** Runguo Li、Dezhen Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30205v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30205v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究 Looped 语言模型在并发解码下的效率问题，指出负载下真正失效的是投机工作的布局而非投机本身，提出 PackLoop：只在本来就要读取的行内做投机，并以 EOQ 闭式准入规则决定累积长度，在 FP32、采样与早退下仍与自回归解码逐 token 一致。

**相关性简评：** 其按代价模型标定的「累积多久再成块推进」准入规则与早退下的精确解码，可能为 LVR 中 loop 步数分配、动态计算预算与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 停止决策提供可供核查的借鉴；但论文本身面向服务吞吐，不涉及视觉证据或多模态状态内容。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency

**abstract/A1：** Looped language models reuse one block of weights T times per token, trading parameters for test-time depth, but autoregressive decoding then pays T sequential passes per token. Self-speculative decoders recover 2-10x for a single request, yet their gains fade as requests share a GPU, and current practice is to speculate less as load grows. We show that what fails under load is the layout of speculative work, not speculation. In concurrent decoding the unit of cost is the row, one request advancing on one loop, which reads that loop's key-value (KV) cache once; additional positions inside a row are nearly free. Pipelined schedules such as the wavefront place every speculative position on a different loop, hence in a row of its own, so each token is still read T times. We present PackLoop, built on one principle: speculate only inside rows that are read anyway. Deep loops accumulate positions and advance them as a block in one row, context-copy proposals join the row that the first loop already reads, and a closed-form admission rule, the economic order quantity of inventory theory, sets how long to accumulate from a cost model calibrated once per engine. PackLoop is exact: in FP32 its output is token-for-token identical to autoregressive decoding, also under sampling and early exit. Across 164 load points spanning three GPUs, four Ouro models, six benchmarks, and contexts up to 32K tokens, one PackLoop configuration is faster than the best existing schedule, chosen per point, at 161 points (median 1.25x, up to 1.76x) and never significantly slower. Its lead grows with concurrency and context length, the regime in which existing self-speculation gains least.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将记忆写入与顺序检索策略分别从大模型动作轨迹独立蒸馏到 3B 模型，与固定答案生成器组合而不做联合优化，在 LongMemEval 与 PersonaMem-v2 上评测组合效果并做组件消融与任务特定适配。

**相关性简评：** 其「独立训练子策略 + 固定生成器」的模块化组合与顺序检索策略，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、何时继续检索或停止的独立策略训练及贡献分配提供可核查线索，但工作本身不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of independent specialist distillation for modular multi-agent systems. Source code and datasets of teacher-generated memory-editing and retrieval trajectories are released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.

</details>

### 477. [RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30278v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30278

**作者：** Bo Wang、Dekang Zhu、Jian Li、Zhipeng Meng、Bo Wang、Dewen Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30278v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30278v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把无人机—卫星跨视角地理定位重构为求解两幅不同尺寸图像间的平面刚体变换（2D 平移加面内旋转），提出 RigidAnchor 迭代求解：构建多级相关金字塔，每轮用当前估计索引金字塔、把所有单元描述符池化为一个 hidden state，再由两个解耦头分别预测平移与旋转增量，旋转以复合而非相加方式更新。

**相关性简评：** 将检索到的视觉描述符池化为单一隐状态并迭代复合几何增量，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态逐步更新与几何一致性提供可供核查的线索；但该文属定位任务，隐状态是否真正承载证据、增量预测能否迁移到推理状态更新仍需阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment

**abstract/A1：** A UAV that flies without GNSS has to estimate its absolute position and heading without any external signal. Most existing methods for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization (U-S CVGL) treat the task as image retrieval: they compress the UAV image and each satellite tile into separate descriptors, rank the tiles by their similarity, and return the center of the best tile. The output can therefore only lie on a pre-defined grid, its accuracy is limited by the tile size, and no heading is produced. Regressing the pose in a single pass removes the grid, but it leaves no chance to correct the estimate afterwards. We observe that satellite tiles are not independent samples. They are laid on the map at a fixed spacing, scale and orientation, so neighboring tiles join into one continuous satellite block with a consistent metric, and a nadir UAV view of that block differs from it by a planar rigid transform only, i.e. a 2D translation plus an in-plane rotation. We therefore reformulate U-S CVGL as solving for this transform between two images of different sizes. Position and heading then become parts of one geometric quantity, and the accuracy is no longer limited by the tile grid. We propose RigidAnchor, which solves the transform iteratively. The network encodes the two images and builds a multi-level correlation pyramid between them. At each iteration, it indexes the pyramid with every aerial cell carried through the current estimate, pools the descriptors of all cells into one hidden state, and lets two decoupled heads predict a translation increment and a rotation increment, the latter being composed rather than added. On Bearing-UAV-90K, the cross-view mean errors are 78.6% lower in position and 69.7% lower in heading than Bearing-UAV, and HSR@15 increases by 19.06 points. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor.

</details>

### 478. [A statistical measure of trust in generative AI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30286v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30286

**作者：** Alina Ermilova、Valeria Yakupova、Nikita Sushko、Andrey Lovyagin、George Ovchinnikov、Maksim G. Sharaev、Evgeny M. Mirkes、Denis Turdakov、Ivan Y. Tyukin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30286v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30286v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出以专家模型分布为参照、结合学生模型内部 latent 特征与 token 级输出统计的「AI ontology calibrator」，估计逐 token 可信度，并与置信度、熵、困惑度组成 15 个响应级指标用于正确性与幻觉检测。

**相关性简评：** 其用内部 latent 特征做逐 token 可靠性校准的思路，可能可供核查能否用作 latent 推理状态的可靠性诊断或停止判据；但该工作仅在纯文本任务上评估，跨模态推理迁移性尚不明确。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A statistical measure of trust in generative AI

**abstract/A1：** Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. Combined with traditional token-level confidence, entropy, and perplexity statistics, calibrator scores yield a compact set of $15$ response-level indicators for correctness classification. Evaluated across BF program generation, mathematical problem solving, and medical question answering, combined calibrator and traditional indicators provide complementary reliability signal which could be used to build detectors of untrustworthy outputs and hallucinations. Remarkably, our experiments show that these detectors are transferable across domains, although transferability is not always symmetric.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MMMem 任务感知多模态记忆框架，通过带来源链接的多视图记忆、源生成任务的知识对齐与自训练、任务经验蒸馏及任务感知检索，让智能体从已完成任务中积累并复用经验，在多个记忆基准上优于八个基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「来源链接的多视图记忆 + 带支撑链接的经验蒸馏与检索」提供了视觉证据筛选、跨记录线索组合和证据复用机制，可供核查其是否能为 LVR 的 LOOK/证据组织及工作区状态保留提供可迁移线索，但论文并非研究推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation

**abstract/A1：** AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出拓扑先验引导的区域潜变量动力学代理模型：按网格拓扑把结构响应编码为空间耦合的区域潜变量，引入一步预测辅助任务监督状态转移，再由载荷条件化的 Mamba 预测潜轨迹并用共享解码器重建全场节点响应。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构化区域潜变量＋潜空间转移监督＋潜轨迹预测再解码」的做法，可能为 LVR 中潜状态的组织方式、转移监督与潜表示可预测性提供借鉴线索，但属工程结构仿真领域，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Topology-Prior-Guided Regional Latent Dynamics for Transient Structural Response Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Predicting the transient nonlinear responses of complex engineering structures remains challenging due to large finite element meshes, heterogeneous structural components, and history-dependent mechanical behavior. This study proposes a topology-prior-guided regional latent dynamics (TPLD) surrogate model that combines physically structured regional representations with dynamics-aware latent learning for full-field time-history prediction. Based on mesh topology and engineering priors, structural responses are encoded into spatially coupled regional latent variables through region-aware feature extraction and topology-constrained interactions. An auxiliary one-step prediction task enhances latent-space dynamical predictability by introducing state-transition supervision. A load-conditioned spatiotemporal Mamba model then predicts regional latent trajectories by integrating temporal causal scanning and bidirectional spatial scanning, while a shared coordinate-conditioned decoder reconstructs full-field nodal responses. The framework is evaluated on three finite element datasets: a parametric stiffened panel, a partitioned pressure impact plate, and a Toyota Yaris full-vehicle crash model. The relative L2 errors for the three displacement components range from 4.00% to 8.21% on the stiffened panel and from 1.41% to 12.22% on the approximately 1.49-million-node vehicle model. On the BIW crash benchmark, TPLD achieves a relative L2 position error of 0.620%, representing a 30.7% reduction compared with the best-performing GeoTransolver configuration. Ablation studies demonstrate the advantages of topology-guided regional representations over global latent and learnable soft-slice alternatives, while auxiliary one-step prediction particularly improves the prediction of accumulated plastic strain.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HEART: Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer for ECG Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Learning robust representations from electrocardiograms (ECGs) is challenging because repeated cardiac cycles coexist with subtle and sparse diagnostic cues in local morphology and rhythm-level context. Existing ECG foundation models commonly rely on Transformerbased patch encoders with uniformly shared dense refinement pathways, limiting adaptive processing across heterogeneous ECG tokens. We propose HEART (Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer), an ECG foundation model that introduces stage-specific conditional expert refinement during self-supervised pre-training. HEART places a local-level MoE over patch-level representations before temporal contextualization and a global-level MoE over context-integrated token representations after self-attention. Token-level Top-1 routing allows different patches or contextual tokens within the same ECG to follow different expert pathways. On public ECG benchmarks, HEART achieves strong performance under both linear probing and fine-tuning, with particularly large frozen-encoder gains on PTB-XL Form and Rhythm (+6.76 AUROC points each over the strongest protocol-reproduced baseline). Routing analyses provide qualitative evidence of complementary local and global expert specialization. We release our code and pretrained models at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HEART-5E9F.

### 482. [SafeRank-ReID: Candidate-Conditioned Re-Ranking under Identity Conflicts for Multimodal Person Re-Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30314v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30314

**作者：** Yizhi Wang、Zixuan Li、Zhuwen Chen、Feiwei Qin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30314v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30314v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向多模态行人重识别的候选条件式安全重排序框架：为每个「模态—候选」对估计信任与冲突 logits 以归一化模态权重，再用自注意力对候选集建模并预测残差分数精化排序，最后用查询级回退门在不确定时与最可靠单模态分支插值；在 RGBNT201 与 MSVR310 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其按候选而非全局估计证据可信度、降低潜在不可靠证据贡献并在冲突高时回退的做法，可能为 LVR 中「按候选假设筛选视觉证据」及不确定性触发的回退与停止决策提供方法线索，可供核查能否迁移到 latent 状态加权。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SafeRank-ReID: Candidate-Conditioned Re-Ranking under Identity Conflicts for Multimodal Person Re-Identification

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID) exploits complementary identity cues from different sensing modalities to mitigate the performance degradation caused by challenging imaging conditions. Existing methods typically estimate Modality Reliability at the query level, making it difficult to identify conflicting inputs that retain normal visual quality but correspond to an incorrect identity. Such inputs may receive high confidence, promote irrelevant gallery candidates, and lead to negative fusion. To address this issue, we propose SafeRank-ReID, a candidate-conditioned safe re-ranking framework for Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID). To capture the varying support of the same modality for different candidates, we introduce a candidate-conditioned evidence arbitration mechanism that integrates unimodal retrieval evidence, input quality, and cross-modal consistency to estimate trust and conflict logits for each modality-candidate pair. Together, these logits contribute to the normalized modality weights, allowing support strength to vary across modalities and candidates while reducing the contribution of potentially unreliable evidence. A candidate-set refinement module subsequently applies self-attention to jointly model candidate representations and predicts residual scores from their competitive relations, thereby refining the initial fused ranking. For fusion results that remain uncertain after refinement, a query-level fallback gate estimates an interpolation coefficient from the overall conflict level and cross-modal uncertainty, adaptively combining the fused scores with those of the most reliable unimodal branch. Experiments on RGBNT201 and MSVR310 show that SafeRank-ReID maintains competitive clean-input retrieval while improving robustness to Identity Conflicts across person and vehicle benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 483. [Video Generalized Category Discovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30316v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30316

**作者：** Bardia Safaei、Vishal M. Patel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30316v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30316v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VideoGCD 框架，用于视频动作识别中的广义类别发现：用分块 MoE 促使已知类与新类专家分化，配以新类平衡损失缓解对已知类的偏置，并用时序最优传输损失约束跨帧路由一致。

**相关性简评：** 其用最优传输在时间维度上约束「路由/表征分配一致、并抑制多数类偏置」的做法，可能可供核查为多步 latent 推理状态一致性与专家贡献分配的迁移线索；但它本身是视频分类任务，与视觉推理证据使用的联系尚不明确。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Video Generalized Category Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to categorize unlabeled data from both known and unknown classes using labeled data from only the known classes. While recent GCD methods have shown promise on static images, their performance degrades in videos due to temporal dynamics, larger intra-class variation, and the lack of temporal consistency in existing approaches. We introduce VideoGCD, a framework tailored for video action recognition under the GCD setting. Our method integrates (i) a partitioned Mixture-of-Experts module that encourages specialization for known and novel categories, (ii) a novel-class balancing loss to reduce bias toward known classes, and (iii) a temporal optimal transport loss that promotes consistent routing across frames. Experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoGCD significantly improves performance over existing GCD methods, particularly on novel categories. Our findings highlight the importance of combining temporal modeling and expert specialization for video GCD.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to WACV 2027

</details>

### 484. [Verifiable On-Policy Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30325v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30325

**作者：** Juntong Shi、Stefano Ermon、Jure Leskovec、Minkai Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30325v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30325v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 VOPD，把 RLVR 的稀疏验证奖励与 on-policy distillation 的稠密教师信号放入同一隐式奖励空间，将验证偏好投影到教师的隐式奖励方向并在全词表上做 Rao–Blackwell 化，从而为未采样动作提供基于验证结果的稠密监督，并在数学推理基准上验证其性能与学习效率。

**相关性简评：** 该方法线索是「稀疏结果奖励与稠密教师监督耦合、向未采样动作传播信用」，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹级与 token 级贡献分配、教师蒸馏监督的设计；但对象为纯文本推理，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Verifiable On-Policy Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving language-model reasoning, but its supervision is inherently sparse: a sequence-level verifier reward is propagated only through sampled trajectories and provides no direct signal for alternative actions. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a complementary form of supervision by providing dense teacher feedback over the full next-token distribution, but this signal is not grounded in verified task outcomes. Simply co-optimizing the two objectives does not couple these signals: verifier feedback remains sparse and does not inform the dense teacher supervision. We introduce Verifiable On-Policy Distillation (VOPD), which transfers sparse verifier feedback into dense, verifier-grounded supervision. Our key observation is that the implicit-reward view of OPD places teacher supervision and verifier feedback in a common reward space while retaining a reward signal available for every next-token action. Under this view, VOPD projects verifier preference onto the teacher's implicit-reward direction and Rao--Blackwellizes the resulting signal over the full vocabulary, propagating verifier-grounded supervision to actions that were never sampled. The resulting objective can also be interpreted as adaptively extrapolating the distillation target according to teacher--verifier agreement. Across two teacher--student configurations and eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VOPD consistently improves both final performance and learning efficiency over vanilla OPD and other on-policy distillation baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/juntongshi48/VOPD.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 485. [TAED: Trajectory-Aligned Encoder--Decoder Distillation for Detection Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30326v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30326

**作者：** Zilong He、Zhangchi Hu、Hebei Li、Yijun Pan、Yifan Zhao、Xiangyu Yu、Yansong Peng、Xinghao Wang、Dongsheng Jiang、Xiaoyan Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30326v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30326v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 DETR 类检测器蒸馏中师生独立选择 top-K 查询导致同名次查询空间与目标不一致的问题，提出 TAED：用编码器多尺度特征蒸馏增加同源查询对，并以源索引对齐查询、沿解码层保持轨迹对应做定位蒸馏，在 COCO 小模型上取得提升且不增加推理成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「按来源对齐、跨解码层保持对应」的轨迹式监督可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但检测查询对齐能否迁移到推理状态尚需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TAED: Trajectory-Aligned Encoder--Decoder Distillation for Detection Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Distilling localization knowledge into compact detection transformers (DETRs) requires consistent teacher-student query correspondence across decoder layers. However, in DETRs with encoder-based query selection, the teacher and student select top-K proposals independently. Same-rank queries can originate from different spatial locations and correspond to different objects, making rank-based layer-wise supervision unreliable. To address this problem, we propose Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED), a framework for knowledge transfer between DETRs of different capacities. Encoder feature distillation matches normalized multi-scale features to strengthen student representations and increase the number of teacher-student query pairs from the same encoder locations. Source-indexed query alignment pairs native queries from the same encoder locations and retains pairs associated with the same object for which the teacher provides reliable and more accurate final localization than the student. Trajectory-aligned localization distillation maintains these correspondences and uses teacher proposals and corresponding decoder-layer box predictions to guide student refinement, without introducing additional queries. On COCO, TAED improves DINO-R18 and two-stage Deformable DETR-R18 by 2.5 and 1.7 AP, respectively. Further gains on D-FINE and ECDet demonstrate applicability to recent real-time DETRs at no additional inference cost.

</details>

### 486. [Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30328v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30328

**作者：** Chenkai Xu、Yuji Ren、Zihui Liu、Yijie Jin、Yuhao Shen、Xin Wang、Yajing Chen、Keyang Luo、Shengju Qian、Litong Gong、Tiezheng Ge、Zhijie Deng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30328v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30328v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Draft Forcing，用于自回归视频扩散的分块推测解码：以目标模型多层隐状态为条件的特征级草稿模型产生候选块，并用 on-policy 训练的特征空间验证器按 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE 门控提案，无需 VAE 解码，在 14B Self-Forcing 上获得约 1.6 倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 其「草稿—验证—门控」以及复用已提交块的隐状态、在特征空间做免解码一致性校验，可能为 latent 推理中的候选状态筛选与采纳/停止决策提供方法线索，但面向视频生成，迁移可行性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\\times$ DiT and $1.57\\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\\times$ DiT ($1.82\\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables, including appendix

</details>
