### 487. [Learning Teacher Output Preferences from Final Responses for Reasoning Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30338v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30338

**作者：** Hongli Shen、Shaopeng Fu、Qinbo Zhang、Jian Li、Di Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30338v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30338v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究模型无关的隐藏 CoT 重建，提出 Final-Output Preference Learning（FOPL），用偏好优化训练单一重建模型，仅凭输入提示与可见最终答案恢复目标 LLM 隐藏的推理轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 「从可见最终输出反推推理轨迹、并以偏好对比区分推理模式」与 LVR 中轨迹监督、贡献分配和 latent 内容的可读出性有间接联系，可供核查其是否能用于为 latent 推理提供监督信号；但属纯文本方法，迁移性需另行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Teacher Output Preferences from Final Responses for Reasoning Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Many large language models (LLMs) use chain-of-thought (CoT) to solve complex problems, but hide their CoT traces to prevent reasoning capabilities from being distilled. While recent studies have shown that hidden CoTs can be reconstructed, existing methods typically require training a separate attacker for each target LLM. This paper studies model-agnostic CoT reconstruction, aiming to reconstruct hidden CoT traces from arbitrary target LLMs using only input prompts and visible final responses. We propose Final-Output Preference Learning (FOPL), which trains a single reconstruction model that generalizes to unseen LLMs without target-specific adaptation. To achieve this, the reconstruction model must learn which reasoning patterns match a given final response without knowing the target LLM's identity. We address this using preference optimization, training the reconstruction model to prefer native CoTs over synthetic alternatives for the same question and final response. By learning these preferences from LLMs with accessible CoTs, the reconstruction model learns to distinguish reasoning patterns based on visible responses. Experiments show that reconstructed CoTs capture distinct reasoning patterns across LLM families, including a family unseen during training. Moreover, students trained on reconstructed CoTs match or outperform those trained on native CoTs across several reasoning benchmarks.

</details>

**title/T1：** AirVT-15k: A Query-Diverse UAV Video-Text Dataset and Query-Adaptive Evidence Alignment Network for Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Shift by Analogy，用「加减加」残差规则把已见图像-文本对上的属性变化迁移到目标物体的参考残差，将目标文本特征移向其视觉中心，再经学习精炼得到可匹配查询图像的代理特征，用于组合零样本识别，并结合语义与原始特征证据联合学习。

**相关性简评：** 该工作并非研究 LVR 推理，但其用类比残差构造未见组合的视觉代理表示、训练时把目标排除在支持集外，可能为 latent 视觉证据构造与留一监督提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Shift by Analogy for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning

**abstract/A1：** Compositional zero-shot learning recognizes attribute-object pairs absent from training. An unseen pair has a semantic description but lacks an observed visual reference. We propose Shift by Analogy (SBA) to make unseen compositions visually seen through a shift-then-match process. Its core add-subtract-add rule transfers an attribute change between two seen image-text residuals on a source object to a reference residual on the target object. This shifts the target's own text feature toward its visual center; learned refinement produces a proxy for matching query images. During training, each target is excluded from its supports, and recognition is learned using references constructed from other pairs. An analogy library and same-object attention extend this construction across candidates, while joint learning integrates proxy matching with semantic and primitive evidence. Visual-center analysis confirms substantially improved correspondence for unseen compositions. Experiments across three standard benchmarks show that SBA consistently outperforms strong CZSL baselines under both closed- and open-world evaluation.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network（FLPN），把零样本分类表述为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并用 Logic Tensor Network 将类层级、类级属性例外与同类相似性等先验写成可微逻辑公理参与训练，同时以注意力学习属性级原型。

**相关性简评：** 将结构化先验以可微逻辑损失施加于嵌入与原型表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的属性级约束和训练监督设计提供借鉴线索；但该工作针对图像零样本分类、无推理期状态生成，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Boosting zero-shot learning through neuro-symbolic integration

**abstract/A1：** Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to train deep neural networks to recognize objects from unseen classes, starting from a semantic description of the concepts. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration refers to a class of techniques that incorporate symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning with the learning capabilities of deep neural networks. However, to date, few studies have explored how to leverage NeSy techniques to inject prior knowledge during the training process to boost ZSL capabilities. Here, we present Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN) that formulates the classification task as prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space, which is trained by optimizing a NeSy loss. Specifically, FLPN exploits the Logic Tensor Network (LTN) framework to incorporate background knowledge in the form of logical axioms by grounding a first-order logic language as differentiable operations between real tensors. This prior knowledge includes class hierarchies (classes and macroclasses) along with robust high-level inductive biases. The latter allow, for instance, to handle exceptions in class-level attributes and to enforce similarity between images of the same class, preventing premature overfitting to seen classes and improving overall performance. % CHECK: original sentence had no verb ("Both class-level and attribute-level prototypes through an attention mechanism ...") FLPN learns both class-level and attribute-level prototypes, the latter through an attention mechanism specialized for either convolutional- or transformer-based backbones. FLPN achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GZSL benchmarks AWA2 and SUN, matching or exceeding the performance of competing algorithms with minimal computational overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoManigrass/FLPN

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将目标检测数据集蒸馏表述为数据集级的渐进监督分配问题，用类别-尺度监督配额和记录已选图像累积检测预测的全局状态，引导对象采样、画布精修与边际增益候选选择，在 COCO 和 VOC 上优于对比基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「累积状态 + 配额差距 + 边际增益」的贪心覆盖机制可供核查，可能迁移为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与避免冗余监督的选择策略；但研究对象是训练数据合成，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the target quotas and accumulated supervision guide adaptive object sampling, detector-guided canvas refinement, and marginal-gain-based candidate selection, encouraging complementary supervision across images. On MS COCO, SGSA outperforms a matched OD3 baseline by 3.73-4.06 mAP points across three image budgets (0.25%-1.0%). On PASCAL VOC, SGSA outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.53-6.90 mAP50 points across three image budgets. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of dataset-level supervision allocation guided by accumulated detector feedback under limited image budgets.

**comment/C1：** Jiehui Xie and Zhengxun Jin contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Sung-Ho Bae and Chaoning Zhang

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LRMOT，将多边际最优传输的传输计划约束为有界多线性秩的张量，从而以紧凑结构化方式表示多边际耦合，给出近似界，并在实验中显著降低计算时间同时保持较低传输代价。

**相关性简评：** 用低秩张量紧凑参数化多变量联合耦合的做法，或可为 latent 推理状态及多模态证据联合分布的低成本表示与更新提供方法线索，其近似误差与可扩展性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Low-Rank Tensor Representations for Efficient Multimarginal Optimal Transport

**abstract/A1：** Multimarginal Optimal Transport (MOT) suffers from exponential computational and memory costs in the number of marginals, as transport plans are represented by high-dimensional tensors. We introduce Low-Rank Multimarginal Optimal Transport (LRMOT), which restricts transport plans to tensors with bounded multilinear rank, providing a compact and structured representation of multimarginal couplings. This structure enables efficient algorithms with a low memory footprint. We establish approximation bounds for the resulting low-rank formulations and demonstrate experimentally that the proposed algorithms substantially reduce computational time while achieving solutions with low transport cost.

</details>

### 493. [BASE: A Backend-Agnostic Streaming Embodiment Layer for Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30388v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30388

**作者：** Chenye Yang、Jin Jiang、Shengcai Liao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30388v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30388v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 BASE，一个与对话后端解耦的流式「具身层」：仅以对话模型输出的语音为接口，用音频驱动的对话状态管理器统一处理说话、倾听、空闲、打断与主动发言，并通过滑窗续写加重叠前瞻集成把离线 2 秒 flow-matching 手势模型搬到实时流式场景，再用 Drift-Aware History Perturbation 缓解自生成历史误差累积。

**相关性简评：** 其「流式差距主要源于自生成历史中的误差累积」及在训练历史中注入推理式漂移的 DAHP 做法，可能为 latent 轨迹训练中的暴露偏差与状态漂移、贡献分配提供可核查的借鉴线索，但研究对象是手势动作而非 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BASE: A Backend-Agnostic Streaming Embodiment Layer for Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars

**abstract/A1：** Many end-to-end spoken dialogue models can now converse in real time and full duplex, and turning them into 3D avatars requires full-body gestures, listening feedback, and turn-taking. Existing methods couple the motion generator tightly to one dialogue model by reading its internal states or training speech and motion jointly. The motion module must then be retrained whenever the dialogue model changes, cannot be attached to cloud APIs that expose only audio, and entangles role, voice, and motion style. We propose BASE, a backend-agnostic streaming embodiment layer whose only interface to the dialogue model is its emitted speech. First, a conversation state manager driven solely by audio handles speaking, listening, idling, barge-in, and proactive turns on one timeline, while role, voice, motion style, and 3D appearance are set independently. Second, to run an offline 2 s flow-matching gesture model on live audio, we reformulate inference as sliding-window continuation with overlapped look-ahead ensembling, which removes seam jitter. Third, we show that the remaining streaming gap comes from errors accumulating in the self-generated motion history rather than missing future speech; our Drift-Aware History Perturbation (DAHP) reduces this gap in about 50 min on one GPU by injecting inference-like drift into ground-truth training histories, and transfers to a second generator. On BEAT2, streaming BASE reaches an FGD of 0.342, on par with the tightly coupled MIBURI (0.333), and viewers prefer its body motion over MIBURI's in 82% of forced-choice judgments. Without retraining, the same layer drives a cascaded pipeline, three open full-duplex models, and a cloud API in real time.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30390

**作者：** Nihel Loubna Ghennani、Mourtada Benazzouz、Julie Mauclair

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30390v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30390v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出基于 HuBERT 自监督表征与不确定性估计的语音自闭症筛查框架，结合 LOSO 交叉验证、平衡 k-bagging 与 MC Dropout 集成，并分析预测熵与分类错误的关系。

**相关性简评：** 其用集成与预测熵做错误检测、可靠性排序的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 的停止判据与答案验证；但该文不涉及视觉推理状态，迁移尚需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles

**abstract/A1：** Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliability: incorrectly classified segments show higher entropy than correctly classified ones (0.4605 $\\pm$ 0.2314 vs. 0.1717 $\\pm$ 0.1830), with a significant correlation with errors (r = 0.3981, p = 7.38 x 10 -170 ) and an error-detection ROC-AUC of 0.8359. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework as a robust and uncertainty-aware computer-aided tool for ASD screening.

**comment/C1：** Accepted version. To appear in IEEE Xplore

</details>

### 495. [Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30397v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30397

**作者：** Ruixue Li、Chaofei Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30397v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30397v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics，将优化器生成的候选参数更新先累积到中间状态，再按事件触发释放并重置，在 CIFAR-100 上验证稀疏释放仍可接近常规训练性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「累积—触发—释放—重置」机制虽作用于训练参数而非推理状态，但可能为 latent 推理中的状态更新门控、稀疏写入与重置策略提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning

**abstract/A1：** Standard neural network training typically applies optimizer-generated update signals to model parameters at every iteration. This work introduces a spatiotemporal view of parameter updating and proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which separates candidate-update generation from their application through an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset. In a canonical coordinate-wise instantiation, accumulation produces temporal integration, release imposes a spatial budget, and reset separates successive inter-release intervals, while conventional dense updating is recovered as a boundary case. Across four model--optimizer configurations on CIFAR-100, EPD maintains final performance close to conventional training even when only a small fraction of coordinates are released at each step, including the 1\\% regime. Matched-control experiments further show that temporal accumulation, state-dependent selection, and post-release reset each contribute to the observed behavior. Together, these results identify parameter-update realization as a controllable dimension of optimization and provide a concrete basis for studying its temporal and spatial organization separately from candidate-update generation.

</details>

### 496. [Time Series Foundation Models on the Edge](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30404v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30404

**作者：** Marco Pichler、Patrick Podest、Günter Klambauer、Sepp Hochreiter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30404v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30404v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察九种时间序列基础模型在边缘设备上的流式预测刷新，比较非因果重算、线性增长的 KV cache 与固定大小循环状态在精度、延迟和峰值内存上的表现，并将循环状态跨刷新持久化且验证其与全量重算等价。

**相关性简评：** 其固定大小循环状态、常数时间增量更新与等价性校验，可供核查 LVR 中循环 latent 状态的更新方式，以及缓存结构如何影响长度泛化与计算成本；但属时间序列远领域，需确认向多模态推理迁移的可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Time Series Foundation Models on the Edge

**abstract/A1：** Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast zero-shot with accuracy exceeding that of task-specific models, and the smaller ones fit on edge devices. Operational deployments must refresh their forecast as new observations arrive, and privacy and latency requirements often force this refresh onto resource-constrained edge devices. To serve as a forecasting system there, a TSFM must refresh quickly, keep latency and peak memory bounded as the stream grows, and retain its accuracy as the observed history accumulates. Refreshing incrementally without altering the forecast requires temporal causality: non-causal models recompute at every update, causal attention admits a KV cache that grows linearly, and causal recurrent models update a fixed-size state in constant time and memory. We make these states persist across refreshes for every causal architecture and verify equivalence to full recomputation. We evaluate nine TSFM configurations on univariate forecasting against all three requirements, measuring accuracy as a function of context length, single-refresh latency, and latency and memory on streams of up to one million time steps on a server-grade GPU and three edge devices. No model gains on average accuracy beyond its trained context and most lose it well before the full history is reached, while KV caches leave latency and memory growing linearly with the retained history. TiRex-2 is the only one of the nine configurations meeting all three requirements: it refreshes in 14 ms on the GPU and 120 ms on a Raspberry Pi 5, keeps latency, energy and peak memory constant over a million steps, and retains its accuracy on the untruncated history.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TS-LIMITS

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30405v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30405v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将 coding agent 的激活引导策略选择建模为带延迟任务级反馈的多臂老虎机问题，用残差流激活得到的轮级预测提示引导任务内策略选择，并以终局任务反馈校正累计奖励估计，给出遗憾界与编码基准实验。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本 agent 工作、不涉及视觉，但「内部激活作轮级提示＋延迟聚合反馈做信用分配与策略选择」的框架，或可为 LVR 中动态决定 latent 步数、停止决策与轨迹贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimistic Online Learning for Coding Agents with Aggregate Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) coding agents operating on Web development platforms can interact with repositories, issue trackers, and continuous integration services to carry out long-horizon software engineering tasks. However, behavioral drift remains a major bottleneck in such multi-turn reasoning and action trajectories. To mitigate this, activation steering has emerged as a promising approach for regularizing agent behaviors by intervening on the LLM's transformer residual streams. Nonetheless, existing methods typically apply a static steering policy across all tasks, overlooking the fact that a single policy is rarely effective across heterogeneous tasks and varying execution turns. This limitation motivates dynamic online selection among candidate steering policies. Yet, doing so in long-horizon agentic settings is challenging: verifiable task-level feedback is only revealed upon task completion, leaving the contributions of individual steering turns unobserved. To address this challenge, we formulate online steering-policy selection as a multi-armed bandit problem with delayed task-level feedback and turn-level predictive hints derived from residual-stream activations. Within this formulation, we introduce Online Optimistic Activation Steering, a meta-framework that uses hints to guide within-task steering policy selection and leverages terminal task-level feedback to correct cumulative reward estimates. Theoretically, against the best fixed policy in hindsight, we prove regret bounds that tighten with increasing hint accuracy and establish a matching lower bound with respect to prediction error and candidate policy count. Empirical evaluations on realistic coding benchmarks demonstrate that our framework outperforms both static steering policies and naive online adaptive baselines.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 498. [DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30412v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30412

**作者：** Haochen Li、Xiaobing Tu、Yinggui Wang、Jinkui Ren、Xiantao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30412v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30412v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DMC-5 双模型协作框架：由通用压缩模型整合全历史、专门 agent 模型仅基于紧凑 Decision View 生成动作，并用 YAMATO 在无损前提不可得时保留执行关键信息，在长程 agent 任务上降低输入与端到端成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「原始追加视图＋紧凑决策视图」与稳定前缀复用、完整性感知的有损压缩设计，可供核查如何压缩长程视觉/潜在状态并避免信息坍缩，但论文本身面向纯文本 agent，与视觉推理无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an Append-only Canonical View, preserving global access while allowing the compressor to reuse a stable historical prefix instead of recursively rewriting or recomputing prior context. The agent operates only on a compact Decision View with recent raw interactions, reducing repeated input while retaining the information needed for the next action. DMC-5 further incorporates YAMATO (integritY-Aware Memory Abstractions for Tool Operations) to preserve execution-critical information during lossy compression. Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and 8-objective QA show that DMC-5 reduces agent model input by 38.5-57.0% and end-to-end cost by 14.5-28.0% with 78.0-85.0% compressor cache-hit rates, while improving task performance by 1.0-5.8% over the uncompressed baseline.

</details>

### 499. [HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30422v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30422

**作者：** Peilong Zhou、Cangyuan Li、Kaiyan Chang、Ying Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30422v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30422v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** HWRE-Bench 是面向 LLM agent 的硬件逆向工程基准：按前向设计流程各环节丢弃的信息（命名、层次、字级结构、生成参数、编程模型）划分信息丢失层级与五类任务，并要求 agent 用可执行交付物证明恢复出的功能，另设必须得零分的「复制网表」控制任务；论文报告了两智能体、148 条轨迹的试点结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「信息丢失层级 + 强制零分控制 + 分阶段标注轨迹」的评测装置，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 是否真正保留并使用任务必要信息、以及通过率是否能代表理解，而非仅凭等价或分数判断；迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?

**abstract/A1：** Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audit, Interoperate, Modify), four information-loss levels and white- versus black-box access, all on original designs. We report a pilot of 148 rollouts from two agents on four seed tasks under 16 conditions, with stage-annotated trajectories. Agents built their own layout extractors and audited a sanitized layout as reliably as a netlist, at about 27% more turns. Keyless, equivalence-preserving obfuscation changed neither pass rates nor defect-repair scores. Whether agents read the structure at all depended on task framing rather than on necessity, so pass rate alone does not show understanding. Provider safety filters stopped 16% of one agent's runs on the audit tasks. These results argue for deliverables beyond equivalence and for reporting run validity explicitly.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress

</details>

### 500. [Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30423v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建面向环境执法的 LLM/RAG 筛查系统：用烟羽轨迹模型把空气质量、气象与居民投诉对齐到排放事件，再检索设施许可条件生成事件与周期报告及调查建议，并以 plant-aware 重排和证据消融评估报告质量。

**相关性简评：** 其按证据来源逐一消融、并用引用重叠与 LLM 评审判定证据是否真被使用，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「视觉旁路、贡献分配」的诊断式评测设计；但该任务本身与视觉及 latent 推理状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System

**abstract/A1：** Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics. GPT-5-mini performed comparably to GPT-5.1, whereas GPT-5-nano scored lower on legal grounding and legal faithfulness. In an evidence ablation, removing air quality (AQ) data changed judge scores and period recommendations most; citation overlap changed only slightly under any removal, and removing complaint details had no measurable effect. This suggests a need for rules and guidelines that link complaints to incidents and permit conditions, so that community reports can count as evidence. The results support screening of events that may need further investigation. Design implications for involving environmental service experts are derived.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to ACM FAccT 2027

</details>

### 501. [Does coverage explain core-set active learning? Mean, max, and the choice of distance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30450v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30450

**作者：** Ferdinand Equilbey

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30450v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30450v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文重新审视 core-set 主动学习的覆盖论证：给出不依赖零风险假设的更紧泛化界，比较「均值覆盖」与「最大覆盖」的可信息尺度，并提出错位准则检验覆盖半径能否像池上损失间隙或测试误差那样给选择排序；在高斯池与 digits、MNIST 图像池上实验。

**相关性简评：** 其“覆盖是均值还是最大值”“代理排序是否与真实误差一致”的检验思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据/支持集筛选准则的有效性；但原文针对池式训练样本选择，迁移到推理期证据获取需再判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does coverage explain core-set active learning? Mean, max, and the choice of distance

**abstract/A1：** Core-set selection casts batch active learning as a covering problem, in which the points to label minimise the covering radius of the pool. Its main argument is a generalization bound in which this radius controls the gap between the loss on the pool and on the labelled sample. We examine what this bound requires and what it says in practice. We first state it with the assumption that its proof uses at the labelled points, a zero conditional risk, and show that it then holds for any dissimilarity and any selection rule that uses no label outside the sample. The proof works point by point and involves two averages, the mean distance of the pool to the labelled sample and the purity of the cells attached to the labelled points. Keeping them gives, when labels are deterministic at the labelled points, a bound on the pool loss with no zero-loss assumption and without the factor C, the number of classes, of the original constant. We then compare scales, for deterministic labels and a regression function Lipschitz on the whole pool. With the original constant, the bound can be informative only if the radius is below the smallest distance between two classes divided by C. Without C, its radius form can be informative only once the nearest-neighbour rule built on the sample is exact on the pool. Finally, a misalignment criterion measures whether a quantity ranks selections as the gap or the test error do. Experiments on a Gaussian pool and on two image pools, digits and MNIST, the latter under eight distances, and with a network retrained at each cycle, show that the radius does not rank selections consistently with the gap and, on the image pools, that the bounds that do not use the labels of the pool are never informative and that covering in mean rather than in maximum, as greedy k-medoids does, gives a higher purity and accuracy than random sampling.

</details>

### 502. [Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30458v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30458

**作者：** Zhisong Wang、Wanxing Chang、Weiwei Cao、Fenghe Tang、Bowen Shi、Ruifeng Yuan、Yong Xia、Jianpeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30458v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30458v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出医学 VLM 在同一批 3D CT 上的诊断 VQA 表现优于其生成报告，称之为「诊断到报告差距」，并提出 DeCAD：先识别阳性发现，再按区域组织诊断与描述任务，并将每个任务限制在对应区域的视觉 token 上。

**相关性简评：** 该差距分析触及“模型是否真正使用视觉证据”的旁路问题，其「先诊断、再分区域描述、区域视觉 token 约束」的做法可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与区域定位监督提供可核查线索，但需确认其与 latent 状态生成的实际距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation

**abstract/A1：** Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin. Analyses show greater CT-token attention during diagnosis and higher recall of reference-positive findings in both the diagnostic output and final report than with Report Adaptation. These results show that explicitly organizing diagnosis improves diagnostic reporting and helps narrow the diagnosis-to-report gap.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables, including appendices

</details>

### 503. [Struct2Det: Grounding Category Structure in Visual Evidence for Few-Shot Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30469v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30469

**作者：** Kaixuan Chang、Huabing Zhou、Yanduo Zhang、Tao Lu、Liwei Wang、Zhongyuan Wang、Jiayi Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30469v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30469v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Struct2Det 面向少样本目标检测：把类别图结构编码为部件嵌入与全局条件，用部件查询从多尺度图像中检索证据以调制类别文本嵌入，并依据候选与其高分类别部件是否匹配来校正区域特征后再检测；同时构建含结构图的工程图纸数据集 InduSym。

**相关性简评：** 其「部件查询检索视觉证据 + 匹配可靠性决定是否校正特征」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、候选验证与基于证据的状态更新提供借鉴线索，但机制限于检测框分类输入，需核查能否迁移到推理期 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Struct2Det: Grounding Category Structure in Visual Evidence for Few-Shot Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Few-shot detectors struggle to distinguish categories that look alike but differ in local components, because a few examples rarely reveal which differences determine category identity. Category descriptions specify components and relations but do not establish their presence in an image. We propose Struct2Det, which uses category structure to guide detection and verify candidates in three stages. Relational Structure Encoding maps category graphs to component embeddings and a global condition. Component-Grounded Detection uses component queries to retrieve multi-scale image evidence that, with the global condition, modulates category text embeddings for initial detection. Verification-Guided Refinement matches candidate regions with components expected by their top-scoring categories; when class scores are close and matches are reliable, matched pairs correct region features before the shared detector predicts again. Category structure informs both classification inputs: text embeddings integrate image-wide component evidence, while region features incorporate candidate-specific matches. We also construct InduSym, with 88,912 symbol instances across 275 categories from 674 engineering drawings and a structural graph per category. Struct2Det improves few-shot-category AP over the strongest baseline by 6.02 points on InduSym and 9.68 on Digitize-PID, with the highest base-category AP on both. InduSym ablations show few-shot gains from correct category structure, image-level retrieval, and candidate verification. Further tests show gains in few-shot natural-object detection and zero-shot Chinese character recognition.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 14 figures

</details>

### 504. [Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30472v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30472

**作者：** Zishan Qin、Rui Li、Zeyu Zhang、Sevvandi Kandanaarachchi、Lina Yao、Dong Gong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30472v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30472v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究能否在不改结构的前提下，用基于 DPO 的偏好微调把预训练部件感知 3D 生成器适配到少量部件标注数据：按多种子生成的质量差距挑选（物体，目标部件）样本，构造共享同一 GT 组合 latent、仅高斯噪声不同的轨迹对，结合目标块上的 GT flow-matching 监督，只更新 DiT。

**相关性简评：** 其偏好对只在高斯噪声上不同、且把监督定位到目标 latent 块，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的局部贡献分配与偏好式轨迹训练提供可核查线索，但属 3D 生成场景，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation

**abstract/A1：** Part-aware 3D generation requires not only globally plausible objects but also complete, well-separated semantic parts, yet high-quality part decompositions remain too scarce to support large-scale supervised fine-tuning. We study whether preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) can adapt a pretrained part-aware generator from limited part-annotated data without architectural changes. We rank candidates generated with different random seeds against ground-truth (GT) geometric metrics, and select the (object, target-part) examples with the largest across-seed quality gap. Each selected example stores a seed pair whose two flow trajectories share one clean GT compositional latent and differ only in Gaussian noise. We derive a reference-relative target-block preference loss from FlowDPO that compares the two trajectories against a frozen reference model. GT flow-matching losses on the target block and complete part set provide absolute supervision, while only the diffusion transformer (DiT) is updated. Human-ranked controls test an alternative ordering source, and synthetic cropping provides controlled loser targets that are incomplete by construction. Among the three training-set scales, the medium-scale setting gives the strongest result on held-out Objaverse and outperforms both the pretrained generator and the reported direct supervised fine-tuning baseline on the multi-part aggregate. Further analysis shows sensitivity to pair ordering, target-part coverage, and the balance between pairwise and GT supervision. Cross-dataset experiments show less consistent gains under distribution shift.

</details>

### 505. [Do learned image captioning metrics generalize? Auditing duplicated samples in human-judgment benchmarks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30488v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30488

**作者：** Xiaochen Zhang、Jin Li、Chunlong Xia、Longjiang Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30488v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30488v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文审计 Polaris、Nebula、Spica 三套人类判断图像描述评测集：通过像素级匹配发现训练/测试重复样本，用受控重训练量化重复样本对学习型指标相关性的虚高，并把 Kendall τ 分解为「识别最差样本」与「其余排序」两项，进而提出排除测试样本、同时报告两分量并做配对检验的评测协议。

**相关性简评：** 其泄漏检测、相关性分解与配对检验协议可供核查 LVR 评测中 judge、latent/特征相似度指标的可信度与基准污染，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do learned image captioning metrics generalize? Auditing duplicated samples in human-judgment benchmarks

**abstract/A1：** Learned image captioning metrics are trained and tested on human judgments, so their reported correlation is a claim about generalization. We audit this claim for the three most recent collections of such judgments, Polaris, Nebula, and Spica, matching images at the pixel level. First, test samples reappear in training sets: the Spica training set contains about two-thirds of the Polaris test set, with identical human ratings. Second, controlled retraining shows that duplicates can inflate a metric: for Pearl, the gain is confined to the duplicated samples and grows with every epoch; for DENEB, it stays below one point. The gain depends on the learner and on how often a training set repeats a sample. Third, Kendall's $τ$ over all samples is the sum of two terms, detecting captions with the lowest human score and ranking the others; the first supplies most of the reported correlation and is nearly saturated. The recent test sets cannot order Polos, DENEB and Pearl consistently, and a ridge regression on frozen features matches or exceeds all three. Fourth, we propose a protocol that ranks a learned metric only with a model trained without test samples, reports both terms, and compares metrics by paired tests. Under it, zero-shot vision--language judges rank first on the three recent test sets, and a fine-tuned judge ranks first on the three earlier benchmarks. The same analysis applies to any evaluator learned from human judgments; filter lists and code are released at https://github.com/morninghut/ic-dataset-audit .

</details>

### 506. [Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30494v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30494

**作者：** Junrui Zhang、Zeyu Xu、Runchuan Zhu、Jie Peng、Long Zhang、Zixin Ding、Jiaxin Lin、Kai Wang、Jianmin Ji、Junyuan Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30494v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30494v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建覆盖不同推理模式的基准，比较多种让 LLM 自身充当「上下文工程师」、从离线试验中提炼指令或经验的方法，发现没有统一赢家，且收益与失败模式多样性负相关，并归因于指令遵循改善与经验提炼瓶颈。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本上下文工程研究，但其「从多样失败轨迹中能否抽象出可泛化经验」的瓶颈分析，可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练与监督信号分配的设计，如失败模式多样性是否同样削弱 latent 推理状态的训练收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers

**abstract/A1：** As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \\textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation iterations, LCEs do not consistently boost existing performance. Across all datasets and models, the performance gains of LCEs are negatively correlated ($r=-0.5, p\\le 0.05$) with the diversity of the failure modes of reasoning trajectories. Investigating how LCEs work, we find that (1) the improvement in instruction adherence can explain some success of LCEs; (2) one major bottleneck is whether LLMs can extract effective experiences out of natively diverse failures. Through this study, we uncover the limited capabilities of LCEs in abstracting principled contexts from diverse failure modes and understand how LCEs work, providing guidelines for future work.

</details>

### 507. [When Do Spatial Plans Help Text-to-Image Generation? Causal Control, System Utility, and Text Responsiveness](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30514v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30514

**作者：** Lu Han、Jingyao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30514v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30514v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文通过控制实验考察文本到图像生成中额外空间布局条件是否真正带来收益：在 18 组配对训练种子上纠正预测位置与尺寸，并在匹配训练算力下与纯文本条件比较；在预训练生成器上比较固定规则布局与文本适配器，再用最小间距指令检验不同条件路径对文本的响应程度。

**相关性简评：** 其因果纠正、匹配算力对照以及排除基线饱和的解释方式，可能为判断 LVR 中额外 latent 状态是否被实际使用、收益归因与条件路径冗余提供可核查的方法线索，但任务为图像生成，缺少显式推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Do Spatial Plans Help Text-to-Image Generation? Causal Control, System Utility, and Text Responsiveness

**abstract/A1：** A generator can follow a spatial plan, but the benefit of supplying that plan depends on what the model can already do from text. In a controlled study with 18 paired training seeds, correcting predicted positions and sizes improves spatial intersection-over-union by 0.030, yet direct text is non-inferior at matched training compute. In a pretrained generator, a fixed rule layout improves two-object task success over the same text-only adapter by 12.50 percentage points, mostly by separating objects that already appear in the correct order. We then ask whether a more precise instruction can achieve the same separation across conditioning paths. On 288 new task families, adding a minimum-gap instruction improves success by 37.15 points with the text-only adapter, by at most 0.69 points with widely spaced regions, and by 6.94 points with tightly spaced regions. Under tight regions, 230 of 288 baseline images have the correct objects and direction yet miss the required gap, ruling out a high baseline success rate as the sole explanation for the weak text response.

</details>

### 508. [GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30519v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30519

**作者：** Zhangcheng Hou、Kevin Tonkich、Tomoaki Ohtsuki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30519v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30519v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究从部件描述进行 3D 指向与物体重定向，提出学习观测点上的证据权重、以加权质心定位部件，并用几何读出监督（GRS）透过质心位置与方向训练这些权重；系统 GeoRead3D 将分割证据与直接预测的点证据双路融合。

**相关性简评：** 用下游几何读出替代掩码重叠作为监督信号，可能为 latent 状态的读出式监督与贡献分配提供线索，其双路证据加权融合可供核查是否类比视觉证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation

**abstract/A1：** Language often refers to an object by its parts, as in asking to point to a part or to turn an arbitrarily posed object so that two named parts lie in given directions. Both tasks need the direction from the object's center to the part's center, not the part's own orientation. A natural approach segments the part and takes the centroid of its mask. However, high mask overlap predicts the pointing direction poorly when a part is spread out relative to its distance from the object center. Language-guided part segmentation is trained and evaluated by mask overlap, which leaves a gap between the masks it produces and the part geometry that these tasks use. We close this gap by learning point evidence, weights over the observed points whose weighted centroid gives the part's location. Geometric Readout Supervision (GRS) trains these weights through the centroid's position and adds direction supervision on the parts used in reorientation commands. GRS improves both tasks even with a single frozen encoder and a single input pose. We implement this supervision in GeoRead3D, a system for pointing and reorientation from part descriptions. A language model maps each description to a known part name. Dual-Route Part Evidence combines refined segmentation evidence with directly predicted point evidence to locate each part. On PartNeXt and Artiverse, GeoRead3D points within $22.5^\\circ$ for 74.1% and 60.0% of queries, 5.8 and 7.3 percentage points above the strongest baselines. Its reorientation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 7.8 points.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 509. [Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30530v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30530

**作者：** Michael Hollmer、Andreas Fischer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30530v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30530v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将工业装配正确性验证重构为预测式世界建模任务，基于 JEPA 世界模型 LeWorldModel，用装配前后的观测做自监督预测表示，以检测细粒度错误状态与动作-状态不匹配，并在新数据集上报告 AUROC 86.9%。

**相关性简评：** 其「前后观测预测 + 预测表示判别状态是否一致」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节、以及如何用预测误差作为证据/验证信号提供可核查线索，但属非语言模型场景，迁移需较多确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification

**abstract/A1：** Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.

</details>

### 510. [Near-Far Attention: Region-Aware Sparse Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30554v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30554

**作者：** YuanShuo Wang、Jianchao Tan、Lei Gong、Teng Wang、Wenqi Lou、Xuehai Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30554v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30554v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 Near-Far Attention：在 prefill 阶段用轻量门控估计器跳过可忽略区域，再以无需离线校准的子空间特征对近、远页面差异化打分，在共享预算下联合选择 token，以降低长上下文解码开销。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本长上下文加速工作，但其按距离区分的两级打分与廉价区域跳过机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据/缓存的选择预算分配及位置-注意力结构对相似度的影响提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Near-Far Attention: Region-Aware Sparse Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context decoding, but token selection introduces additional scoring and ranking overhead. Moreover, uniform page scoring overlooks differences in relevance between near and far context. We propose Near-Far Attention (NFA), which adapts retrieval to regional attention patterns while keeping candidate scoring lightweight. During prefill, the Lightweight Gate Estimator identifies regions that can be skipped during decoding, adding less than 1% to dense-prefill time. For the remaining regions, the Calibration-Free Subspace Extractor supplies compact features shared by page-level and token-level scoring without offline calibration. The Distance-Aware Two-Level Selector then scores near and far pages differently and jointly ranks candidate tokens under a shared budget. Evaluations across model families, parameter scales, and GQA/MLA architectures show aggregate task quality comparable to full attention. On Qwen3-8B at 512K context length, NFA achieves up to $5.49\\times$ operator speedup and $2.97\\times$ whole-model decoding speedup over FlashInfer, including selection overhead.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 511. [Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30559v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30559

**作者：** Shengyao Wang、Siyuan Su、Siyu Song、Mengsong Wu、Yiming Luo、Wenbo Wu、Hao Hao、Aimin Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30559v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30559v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出教学智能体在维护课程文件、练习记录与学习者画像时会出现「内容—状态解耦」：回答看似合理却破坏工作区状态；为此提出 State-Verified RL，在快照沙箱中用确定性验证器审计工具调用的效果、顺序与副作用，并以分级部分分加关键违规归零的硬门控配合证据对齐评分器来做在线 GRPO 训练。

**相关性简评：** 其「按可验证状态转移而非文本自述给奖励、对关键违规硬门控」的监督设计，可能可供核查用于 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否真正依据视觉证据更新、抑制无依据的状态改写，但属远域借鉴线索，需人工确认迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents

**abstract/A1：** Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

</details>

### 512. [Reliable Recursive Memory for Causal Multi-scale Video Polyp Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30568v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30568

**作者：** Tong Wang、Wenbo Peng、Yaolei Qi、Yuting He、Yutong Xie、Guanyu Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30568v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30568v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 STREAM 流式视频息肉分割框架：用固定数量的递归 slot memory 将多尺度特征与软前景/背景线索压缩为常量状态供后续帧读取，并用由局部误差监督的像素级质量图控制槽位写入，在常量内存下保留长程历史。

**相关性简评：** 其「以误差监督质量图、按可靠性门控写入固定槽位」的机制可供核查是否能用于 LVR 中长期视觉证据的压缩缓存与低质量（模糊、遮挡）证据的过滤，但原论文属医学视频分割，与 VLM 推理无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reliable Recursive Memory for Causal Multi-scale Video Polyp Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Video polyp segmentation (VPS) is essential for computer-aided colonoscopy, as it localizes and tracks polyps frame by frame. However, VPS remains challenging because polyps resemble the mucosa and change quickly in scale, which calls for history beyond a short clip, and because blur, specular highlights, and occlusion often degrade only part of a frame. Existing methods keep history as whole frames, so their cost grows with the history length, and a partly degraded frame carries its degraded content to later predictions. To address these issues, we propose STREAM, a streaming framework for VPS that extends the causal multi-scale aggregation (CMA) of our conference work from a fixed clip to an online stream. STREAM introduces a Recursive Slot Memory (RSM) that summarizes multi-scale features and soft foreground and background cues into a constant number of slots, which the current features read and pass to CMA, supplying long-range history at a constant cost. Furthermore, we design Reliability-Aware Slot Writing (RASW), which estimates a pixel-level quality map from the current frame, supervised by its local error, and uses it to control which locations are written into RSM and how much each slot is updated. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB demonstrate that STREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Dice of the conference model from 81.3% to 85.7% on the hardest subset while running at 48 FPS with a constant state of 0.32 MB. Code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/STREAM.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Extended version of CMSA-Net (MICCAI 2026). Submitted to Medical Image Analysis

</details>

### 513. [Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30573v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30573

**作者：** ZiAn Wang、Tianyi Wang、Zhihao Chen、Manni Cui、Junkai Chen、ZhiJin Chen、Ruiqi Liu、Junfei Wu、Huanyu Zhang、Shu Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30573v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30573v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PersistWorld，将车载相机帧流式写入一个场景锚定的持久 3D 世界状态（每帧只写一次而非由历史帧重建），并用与预测端到端联合学习的 evolver 在自车轨迹上任意查询时刻预测该状态，用于 4D 语义占用预测；作者指出相机世界模型的主要短板在于守住已见空间，而非预测变化。

**相关性简评：** 其「状态一次写入、锚定于场景、按查询时刻演化」的持久状态设计，可能与 LVR 中如何保留视觉证据、避免内部状态信息坍缩以及状态更新与动态计算的问题相关，可供核查；但任务是驾驶占用预测，迁移性尚待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

</details>

### 514. [Physics-Constrained Neural ODEs for Learning Traffic Dynamics and Trajectories from Road Entry/Exit Times](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30577v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30577

**作者：** Dennis Bogatov Wilkman、Karl Henrik Johansson、Matthieu Barreau

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30577v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30577v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用 Neural ODE 结合局部密度近似，从路段进出口时间戳与探针车位置学习跟驰模型，令速度—密度关系由神经网络表示，并用带可学习状态切换的单调网络归一化保证物理可行的端点条件，在仿真与实测环道数据上重建车辆轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 其从极稀疏端点观测推断连续隐状态轨迹、并以结构约束保证所学关系可容许的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹监督与状态转移合理性的建模提供核查线索，但领域距离较远、迁移需较多论证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physics-Constrained Neural ODEs for Learning Traffic Dynamics and Trajectories from Road Entry/Exit Times

**abstract/A1：** We consider the problem of learning microscopic traffic dynamics and reconstructing vehicle trajectories from section entry/exit timestamps (EET) recorded by cameras and from the positions of a probe vehicle leading the platoon. The dynamics are difficult to recover as each vehicle's position is measured only at two points, and its trajectory between them is unknown. By combining Neural ODEs with a local density approximation, we learn a follow-the-leader model whose speed--density relation is a neural network. With such sparse data, an unconstrained network may learn physically unrealistic relations, such as negative speeds or non-zero speeds on a fully congested road. We therefore introduce a normalization that, applied to a monotone neural network with a learned regime change, enforces the endpoint conditions, guaranteeing an admissible speed--density relation while provably retaining the ability to approximate any admissible one. We validate the method on first- and second-order simulations, recovering the speed--density relation of the first-order model and reconstructing the trajectories of both models, with mean maximum position errors of 2.50~m and 2.51~m, respectively, on a 125~m road segment. On real-world ring-road data, the proposed model still yields an admissible relation, whereas both baselines violate the constraints; the large spread in the data, however, highlights the limitations of a first-order model with homogeneous driver behaviors.

</details>

### 515. [A Search Worth a Billion Pixels: Explaining Gigapixel Classifiers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30578v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30578

**作者：** Danilo Danese、Angela Lombardi、Tommaso Di Noia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30578v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30578v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无模型归因方法 WaFR，用自适应层次搜索加稀疏多尺度回归，只在影响预测的区域细化扰动，在千兆像素全切片图像上以百余次前向获得高定位精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「先粗定位、再按证据空间分布分配细化预算」的层次搜索思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、证据区域定位与 look/stop 计算分配提供可供核查的线索，但原文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Search Worth a Billion Pixels: Explaining Gigapixel Classifiers

**abstract/A1：** Perturbation-based attribution methods explain model predictions without accessing their internal representations, but scaling them to high-resolution images requires balancing perturbation granularity and computational cost. Fine-grained perturbations require many model evaluations, whereas coarse masks may overlook small but relevant evidence. We introduce Wavelet Find-and-Refine (WaFR), a model-agnostic attribution method combining adaptive hierarchical search with sparse multiscale regression. By selectively refining regions that influence the prediction, WaFR maintains fine-grained localisation with a computational cost that depends on the spatial distribution of the evidence. As image resolution increases to 8,192 pixels per side, WaFR maintains a Pointing Game score of at least .995 in controlled localisation experiments, including at matched forward-pass budgets. On gigapixel whole-slide images, it requires a median of 176 forward passes and achieves the highest mean patch-level AUROC among the evaluated perturbation-based methods (.949).

</details>

### 516. [HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30592v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30592

**作者：** Xiaoqi Wei、Li Li、Kejiang Chen、Hanzhou Wu、Xinpeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30592v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30592v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HOSE，把参数更新投影到与通用知识正交的子空间来做扩散模型的概念擦除，并按 U-Net 的层级差异构造分层自适应投影，以缓解擦除目标概念与保留图像质量之间的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 「将更新约束到与非目标知识正交的子空间、并按层差异化施加约束」可能可供核查用于修改 VLM 行为或抑制某种推理模式时保护视觉推理能力，但该工作面向图像生成的安全编辑，与 latent 推理状态、证据筛选无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. Considering the hierarchical heterogeneity of the U-Net architecture, we further propose a hierarchical adaptive mechanism, constructing differentiated subspace projections for different layers to precisely adapt to the model's hierarchical structure, thereby resolving the inherent trade-off between erasure and image quality in unified constraints. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed method reduces harmful content generation by 80% compared with the unedited model. While it inevitably incurs some image quality degradation, it still outperforms other editing-based baselines in terms of quality preservation, and achieves a significantly better trade-off between harmful content suppression and quality loss than these baselines. Notably, our approach demonstrates higher adversarial robustness than existing SOTA method, indicating that the target concepts have been more thoroughly erased. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sevenqiiu/HOSE.

</details>

### 517. [Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30601v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30601

**作者：** Merel Kuijs、Till Richter、Rushin H. Gindra、Korbinian Traeuble、Christian Matek、Rebeka Luknárová、Tingying Peng、Fabian J. Theis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、q-bio.GN

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30601v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30601v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CAMEO，用对抗学习实现跨模态 latent 对齐，把预训练单模态编码器组合成共享表示，仅需少量配对样本，并在计算病理的分类任务上验证低配对数据下的数据效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「配对稀缺下的跨模态 latent 对齐」可能为弱配对监督下对齐视觉证据与 latent 推理状态提供训练侧线索，但论文不涉及推理状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，对齐是否保留任务必要细节仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data

**abstract/A1：** Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.

</details>

### 518. [Vasicek Diffusion Bridge for Graph Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30605v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30605

**作者：** Junyi Tang、Chang Liu、Kun Zhan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30605v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30605v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Vasicek Graph Diffusion：借助 Vasicek 动力学得到带数据锚定漂移、有闭式解的图扩散过程，使潜状态在整个扩散中持续被拉向目标图分布，从而在保持不确定性平滑变化的同时快速提升信噪比，并在多个图生成基准上验证生成质量与结构保真度。

**相关性简评：** 其「数据锚定漂移+闭式解」的潜状态轨迹设计与信噪比/不确定性演化控制，可供核查 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成中如何持续引导状态、让有效信息更早出现；但研究对象是纯图生成，与视觉推理证据无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Vasicek Diffusion Bridge for Graph Generation

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion-based graph generation models progressively transform Gaussian noise into structured graphs through stochastic dynamics. We observe that the effectiveness of this transformation is fundamentally determined by the evolution of the diffusion trajectory. Existing graph diffusion models often suffer from excessive uncertainty during diffusion and delayed growth of the signal-to-noise ratio, causing useful structural information to emerge only in the later stages of generation. To address this issue, we propose the Vasicek Graph Diffusion (VGD), a graph diffusion process derived from the Vasicek dynamics. The key insight of VGD is data-anchored mean dynamics with a closed-form solution, which analytically establishes a continuous transition from Gaussian noise to the target graph distribution. Unlike conventional graph diffusion processes that rely predominantly on stochastic evolution, VGD introduces a data-anchored drift that continuously steers the latent state toward the target distribution throughout diffusion. As a consequence, VGD maintains a smoothly evolving uncertainty while rapidly increasing the signal-to-noise ratio throughout diffusion, allowing informative graph structures to emerge much earlier during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple graph generation benchmarks demonstrate that VGD outperforms existing diffusion-based graph generative models in terms of generation quality and structural fidelity.

**comment/C1：** Work in progress

</details>

### 519. [CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30613v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30613

**作者：** Junyan Lin、Jianqi Ma、Shujie Duan、Hanxin Zhu、Zhihao Hu、Jinming Liu、Shuai Li、Jun Zhang、Xin Jin、Chang Wen Chen、Weidong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30613v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30613v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CineAct 研究目标驱动的交互式视频生成：语言模型智能体负责推理，冻结的图像与视频生成器仅充当渲染器，通过显式世界状态（空间布局、相机、场景图、资产库）、目标末帧生成与严格验证来保持多片段一致性，并提出多空间基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「状态先行」设计、末帧验证与跨片段状态持久化，可能为 LVR 中内部状态是否保留必要信息、以及证据核验与状态更新提供方法线索；但任务是视频生成而非 VLM 推理解题，迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation

**abstract/A1：** Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

</details>

### 520. [Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30634v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30634

**作者：** Da Xiao、Qingye Meng、Shengping Li、Xingyuan Yuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30634v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30634v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 loom attention：让每个 token 的注意力在「垂直」方向（对先前 head 输出计算 query/key/value）与「水平」方向（对 token）交织，从而动态重连电路；用归一化门控线性注意力在 per-token 矩阵记忆上实例化，形成把控制与内容分配到向量流和矩阵流的双流 LoomFormer。

**相关性简评：** 其「垂直注意力 + 矩阵记忆充当第二残差流」提供了跨层 latent 状态如何被后续层压缩、取用与更新的具体机制线索，可供核查 LVR 中视觉信息在内部状态里的保留与坍缩问题；但论文仅在语言建模上验证，与视觉证据筛选的联系尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention

**abstract/A1：** We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normalized and gated linear attention over a per-token matrix memory, which stores the compressed head outputs and serves as a second residual stream. This yields LoomFormer, a dual-stream architecture that splits control and content between the vector and matrix streams. Across model sizes and training token budgets in language modeling and downstream tasks, LoomFormer matches Transformers trained with over 3x compute and recent residual-stream baselines (HC/mHC, MUDDFormer, AttnRes) trained with ~1.7-2.8x. For example, trained on the same 300B tokens with only 2% extra FLOPs, LoomPythia-2.8B achieves ~1.6x the average downstream gain of mHC-Pythia-2.8B over Pythia-2.8B, and matches (0-shot) or surpasses (5-shot) Pythia-12B. Code is available at https://github.com/Caiyun-AI/LoomFormer

</details>

### 521. [WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30662v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30662

**作者：** Binhui Xie、Jinmin Li、Haomiao Tang、Guangting Wang、Song Jin、Jianwei Zhu、Fengyun Rao、Jing Lyu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30662v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30662v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** WeMM-Ecom 是面向微信电商的多模态大模型系列（0.8B 稠密到 35B-A3B MoE），经两阶段继续预训练与 hybrid-thinking 后训练（on-policy distillation 结合 RL）同时支持思考与非思考模式，并构建 28 个电商基准评测。

**相关性简评：** 整体属领域 VLM 能力刷分与落地报告，未涉及 latent 状态或视觉证据筛选；仅其统一思考/非思考模式的后训练配方可供核查是否含模式切换、推理长度与监督分配细节，可能为 THINK/STOP 训练提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce

**abstract/A1：** We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.

</details>
