### 522. [Zhengrong: World Models with Pole-Based Action-Response Factorization for Direct Visual Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30666v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30666

**作者：** Yu Zhang、Jingrui Li、Congyu Wang、Yuhang Cheng、Wenbo Chen、Xiaobo Zhang、Jing Zou、Yuxi Dai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30666v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30666v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Zhengrong-PoleWM 世界模型，把 latent 轨迹分解为初始条件锚点、自由响应和对动作的延迟响应，由共享的稳定共轭极点决定各响应随时间的演化，并用 CEM 在四个图像目标控制基准上做直接视觉规划。

**相关性简评：** 其将 latent 状态更新显式拆成「锚点＋动作响应」并保证未来动作不影响早期预测，可供核查 LVR 中潜状态更新结构与视觉证据、动作贡献分配的借鉴线索，但任务是控制规划而非多模态推理，迁移性待查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zhengrong: World Models with Pole-Based Action-Response Factorization for Direct Visual Planning

**abstract/A1：** Direct visual world models predict the effects of candidate action sequences without recursive latent rollout, yet they leave the temporal structure of action effects unspecified. We introduce Zhengrong (Zhengrong-PoleWM), a world model that decomposes a latent trajectory into an initial-condition anchor, a free response, and delayed responses to action innovations. Nonlinear networks map visual history and causal action prefixes to response coefficients. A shared bank of stable conjugate poles determines how each response evolves with elapsed time. This factorization preserves nonlinear interactions across actions, anchors predictions exactly at the initial state, prevents future actions from affecting earlier predictions, and yields bounded responses to finite control plans. We derive an exact re-anchoring identity that identifies the additional basis direction $Ψ\_κ(s)$ needed to represent shifted trajectory tails. Across four offline image-goal control benchmarks (Cube, TwoRoom, PushT, and Reacher), Zhengrong-PoleWM achieves $90.83\\% \\pm 0.47\\%$ macro-average success over two training seeds at epoch 20, exceeding the strongest baseline (QQWorld) by 6.08 percentage points. Selecting checkpoints by validation loss yields $91.21\\% \\pm 1.00\\%$. In a controlled first-epoch Cube study without restart regularization, neural and pole response heads outperform a generic direct predictor by 20.67 and 23.34 percentage points, respectively. On an NVIDIA A100 GPU, median latency for a full 30-iteration cross-entropy method search ranges from 74 to 87 ms across the four tasks. The mean of these medians is 77.5 ms, a 15.8% latency reduction relative to Fast-LeWM and a $7.1\\times$ speedup over autoregressive LeWM.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Technical report, Beijing Freedo Technology Co., Ltd

</details>

### 523. [Lowering the Bar for Everyone: Hidden Validation-Seeking Goals in Empathetic RL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30702v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30702

**作者：** Xinche Zhang、Shanghong Xie、Zhiyuan Ma、Jinhao Li、Sen Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30702v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30702v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 LLM 模拟用户驱动的共情式 RL（RLVER、GRPO、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）中只改变“寻求认可”用户的比例，用 1000 条 Reddit AITA 帖检验策略是定点迎合这类用户，还是整体下调对他人的认可门槛。

**相关性简评：** 其信号检测分析将判断标准偏移与辨别力下降分离，可能可供核查 LVR 中答案与停止决策究竟依赖视觉证据，还是被训练信号整体抬高的阈值；方法与视觉推理主线无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lowering the Bar for Everyone: Hidden Validation-Seeking Goals in Empathetic RL

**abstract/A1：** When RL learns from the reactions of many users, the policy usually cannot see what each user wants. We ask what it learns from users who privately want validation: to validate them alone (targeting), or to lower its bar for endorsing everyone (a threshold shift). We answer this in one setting, empathetic RL against LLM-simulated users (RLVER, GRPO, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct): we vary only the share of validation-seeking users (0--50%; RLVER's default: 24.6%) and evaluate on 1,000 Reddit AITA posts with community fault verdicts. The policy shifts its threshold. Endorsement of at-fault posters rises by 3--4 percentage points per 10 points of share; without such users the Qwen model stays at base, and the effect persists at matched KL and under a goal-blind reward. Signal-detection analysis shows that the criterion for endorsing falls while discrimination between at-fault and not-at-fault posters does not decline. An explicit request to be told if one is wrong gives no measurable protection: at-fault posters who make it receive nearly the same rise as those who do not (+0.11 vs. +0.13). When the goal is stated during training, the policy instead largely targets, endorsing seekers regardless of fault. Standard sycophancy and empathy benchmarks miss the shift; five of six usable released empathetic-RL checkpoints also endorse at-fault posters who ask for honesty more than their base models, though a pre-registered prediction for two held for only one. The user mix is a training hyperparameter to audit and report.

</details>

### 524. [Speculate in the Right Order: Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30704v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30704

**作者：** Yihan Chen、Jintao Zhang、Jun Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30704v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30704v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文理论分析随机顺序自回归图像生成中生成顺序对自推测解码效率的影响，指出 draft-target 失配与早期拒绝代价两个因素，并提出免训练的离线顺序优化方法 SAO，用成对条件 TV 统计构造低拒绝代价的生成顺序。

**相关性简评：** 其「并行草稿—顺序验证」的接受/拒绝代价刻画与顺序调度线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中并行产生 latent 步骤、验证预算分配与 STOP 时机的权衡；但对象是图像生成效率，未涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Speculate in the Right Order: Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Self-speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive image generation by leveraging the same model for parallel drafting and sequential verification, without requiring an additional draft model. While existing methods primarily focus on improving drafting and verification strategies, recent advances in random-order autoregressive modeling introduce an additional degree of freedom: the generation order. In this work, we theoretically analyze how generation order affects self-speculative decoding efficiency, identifying two key factors: draft-target mismatch, which determines token rejection probabilities, and early-rejection cost, which reflects the higher cost of rejecting tokens earlier in a speculative round. Motivated by these insights, we propose Speculation-Aware Ordering (SAO), a training-free framework for offline optimization of generation orders. Instead of evaluating candidate orders through costly speculative decoding, SAO uses simple pairwise conditional-TV statistics to formulate a rejection-cost-aware objective and efficiently construct speculation-friendly generation orders offline. Extensive experiments across different backbones and speculative widths demonstrate that SAO improves decoding efficiency, with the additional benefit of improved generation quality. Furthermore, SAO provides complementary efficiency gains when combined with existing self-speculative decoding methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to identify generation order as a new optimization dimension for efficient self-speculative decoding in autoregressive image generation.

</details>

### 525. [Intra-Class Diversity Loss for Person Re-Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30707v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30707

**作者：** Wei Zhou、BaXian Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30707v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30707v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种 Intra-Class Diversity 损失：把表征按几何关系分解为沿类权重方向的分量与正交分量，在同身份样本的正交分量之间鼓励差异，并配合分类损失保持判别性，作为额外正则项接入现有行人重识别框架。

**相关性简评：** 「沿任务判别方向 vs. 正交方向」的显式分解与正交子空间多样性约束，可能可供核查 LVR 隐状态中视觉细节被答案方向压缩、信息坍缩的问题，但论文属纯视觉 ReID、无多模态推理与 latent 生成，迁移价值需要较多判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Intra-Class Diversity Loss for Person Re-Identification

**abstract/A1：** Person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve images of the same pedestrian across different cameras. However, the non-overlapping identities between training and testing sets, together with large intra-class variation, make it challenging to learn generalizable pedestrian representations. Most existing ReID loss functions mainly focus on intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, which may overlook useful intra-class differences. To address these issues, we propose a novel Intra-Class Diversity (ICD) loss that aims to maximize intra-class differences in classification-irrelevant directions. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce this class-weight-orthogonal diversity learning objective for person ReID. Specifically, based on the geometric relationship between the learned representation and its corresponding class-weight vector, we decompose each representation into the component along the class-weight direction and its orthogonal component. This decomposition provides a clear and interpretable geometric basis for modeling intra-class diversity. ICD then encour- ages larger differences among the orthogonal components of samples belonging to the same identity, while the classification loss maintains identity discrimination. The proposed ICD loss can be incorporated into existing ReID frameworks as an additional regularization term without modifying the feature extraction network. Extensive experiments on three widely used ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ICD and its complementarity with existing metric learning losses.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30720v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30720v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文检验固定四位量化 KV-cache 实现的「保持契约」：重复写入再取原始行、惰性重排与前缀视图扩展是否改变缓存内容；用配对相对 L2 与同形重编码对照量化布局相关漂移，并给出同步、检查点回滚等边界结果。

**相关性简评：** 研究兴趣涉及缓存与位置对 latent 相似度的影响、内部状态是否保真保留历史证据；其配对对照与不变式检验协议可能可供核查 LVR 缓存状态保留，但需较多迁移工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration

**abstract/A1：** Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

</details>

### 527. [Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30742v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30742

**作者：** Yulliwas Ameur、Samia Bouzefrane、Soumya Banerjee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、stat.ME

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30742v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30742v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出用 LLM judge 一次性估计的误差率校正各 agent 成功率时，若 judge 误差依赖轨迹会引入偏差；作者推导该偏差的渐近形式，给出从识别到排名的检查链，并用 AIPW 配合随机审计及 e-process 置信序列给出有效边界与排名集合。

**相关性简评：** 其中轨迹依赖的 judge 误差校正与可预测自适应审计下仍有效的区间，可能为 LVR 轨迹中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的贡献分配和停止策略评估提供统计工具，可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

**comment/C1：** Author's accepted version (without the publisher's template) of a paper accepted at ICAART 2027 (paper \\#38). The final version will be published by SCITEPRESS; DOI to be added upon publication

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GRAIN，在冻结检测器上跨图像统一分配裁剪调用预算：以分辨率缺口增益与乘性残差构造单调子模替代目标规划裁剪，并用正区域融合让推理后准入与计划的内部支撑对齐，再做类平衡 top-k 选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「一次裁剪即一次额外检测调用」并按证据增益与覆盖折扣分配共享预算的规划思路，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 的收益—成本衡量与视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的线索；但任务为纯检测、不涉及语言推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRAIN: Shared-Budget Complementary Re-observation for Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Re-running a frozen detector on enlarged image crops recovers small and crowded objects without retraining, yet every crop costs an extra detector call. Existing slicing and adaptive-cropping pipelines plan crops per image in isolation, even though inspection demand varies widely across an image collection. We present GRAIN, which unifies cross-image call allocation and bounded-output admission around cross-image comparable resolution-closure gains over boundary-safe crop interiors. Coarse hypotheses carry resolution deficits, crops close a geometric share of those deficits for hypotheses enclosed in their interior positive region, and multiplicative residuals discount covered evidence within a monotone submodular surrogate. Prefix sums and a global max-heap execute this collection-wide plan on CPU before crop inference, and Positive-Region Fusion aligns post-inference spatial admission with the planned interior support before class-balanced top- selection. Across 17 frozen detectors from five families on COCO, CrowdHuman, and VisDrone-DET, GRAIN beats call-matched tiling in 100 of 102 AP@100 settings and transfers to AI-TOD-v2. With RF-DETR-S on CrowdHuman, it nearly matches two-crop tiling using one eighth of the crop calls. At fixed budgets, the surrogate orders candidate plans with Spearman correlations of 0.95 to 0.99 while the sweep attains at least 98% of the exact surrogate optimum. Code will be publicly released.

</details>

### 529. [BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30787v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30787

**作者：** Jianfei Jiang、Haochen Yu、Qiankun Liu、Rui Yang、Hongyuan Liu、Xianglong Meng、Jiansheng Chen、Huimin Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30787v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30787v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BridgeMVS，在级联多阶段 MVS 框架中用双向动态融合（BDF）让单目深度特征与多视角 cost volume 相互更新，并以分阶段相对尺度与度量尺度监督提升稠密深度估计。

**相关性简评：** 其「两支表征互为条件地动态更新、并逐阶段粗到细传播与分层监督」的结构，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据驱动 latent 状态迭代更新及监督分配提供方法线索，需核查融合模块的具体实现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) provide complementary cues for dense 3D reconstruction. While MVS leverages explicit geometry for metric depth, it struggles in challenging regions where feature matching is unreliable. Conversely, MDE provides robust structural priors but typically yields scale-ambiguous results. Existing hybrid methods mainly exploit monocular cues in a unidirectional manner, leaving the mutual enhancement between MDE and MVS insufficiently explored. To address this limitation, we propose BridgeMVS, a unified cascaded multi-stage MVS framework that bridges monocular depth features and multi-view cost volume representations through Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion (BDF). At each stage, BDF performs dynamic mono-to-cost and cost-to-mono updates, where monocular structural features guide cost volume refinement for more robust MVS depth estimation, while multi-view geometric evidence recalibrates monocular representations to improve their metric-scale consistency. Furthermore, the fused monocular and multi-view representations are progressively propagated from coarse to fine stages and constrained by stage-wise relative-scale MDE supervision and metric-scale MVS supervision, enabling cross-branch interactions to benefit subsequent high-resolution depth estimation. In addition, BDF is designed as a plug-and-play module that can be conveniently integrated into existing cascaded MVS frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BridgeMVS achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DTU, Tanks-and-Temples, and ETH3D benchmarks, while simultaneously boosting the accuracy of monocular depth estimation. Notably, BridgeMVS ranks first on both the Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate and Advanced benchmarks. The source code is available at \\href{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 530. [PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30796v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30796

**作者：** Xueheng Li、Yu Wang、Yuxiang Shen、Wen Xue、Rui Li、Jie Zhang、Chengjun Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30796v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30796v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PestWeave 多模态害虫识别框架：视觉侧在 RWKV 架构上加入语义 token 分组与聚类原型、全局、register 三类辅助 token，实现内容自适应扫描与分组上下文建模；再用这些原型评估文本各语义成分是否被图像支持，据此调节其贡献与融合强度。

**相关性简评：** 其「用视觉原型评估文本成分是否被图像支持并调节融合强度」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与不可支持描述抑制提供可借用的门控线索，但任务为细粒度农业识别，需核查该支持度评分能否用于 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning

**abstract/A1：** Agricultural pests threaten crop yield and quality, making accurate pest recognition essential for targeted management and sustainable agriculture. Their diverse appearances complicate recognition and motivate multimodal approaches incorporating complementary species knowledge from text. However, complex backgrounds can obscure discriminative visual cues, while textual descriptions may contain information unsupported by the current image, limiting effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose PestWeave, a multimodal framework connecting content-adaptive visual organization with text fusion through visual prototypes. Its visual pathway augments a Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) architecture with semantic token grouping and three types of auxiliary tokens, enabling content-adaptive scanning and contextual modeling while preserving spatial structure. Feature-similar tokens are reordered into adjacent scanning positions, while cluster prototype, global, and register tokens provide group-level summaries, global context, and additional interaction capacity, respectively. These prototypes also guide text modulation by assessing visual support for semantic components and regulating their relative contributions and overall fusion strength, reducing interference from unsupported descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple pest recognition datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of PestWeave and its potential for practical pest management.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 531. [Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30816v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30816

**作者：** Gizem Karagoz、Tanir Ozcelebi、Nirvana Meratnia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30816v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30816v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文将 XAI 的 alignment 评估形式化为由 GT 表示、指标族、软/硬指标形式与阈值策略构成的配置空间，在 2D/3D 合成与真实数据上分析这些设计选择如何改变归因图评估结论，并提出基于局部熵与边界质量比的归因行为分类。

**相关性简评：** 若用归因对齐来检验 LVR 的视觉证据筛选或贡献分配，其「指标配置本身会改变结论」的发现可供核查 GT 表示与阈值设定的敏感性；但研究对象是 XAI 归因图而非 latent 推理状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI

**abstract/A1：** Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods, GT representations, metric families, metric formulations, and thresholding strategies across 2D and 3D synthetic and real-world datasets. In addition, we propose a novel taxonomy of XAI output behavior based on local entropy and boundary mass ratio, enabling structured characterization of attribution patterns for alignment evaluation. Our experiments reveal systematic flows (triples of XAI-GT-metric configurations), showing that alignment outcomes provide distinct behavior patterns under certain configurations, such as soft/hard metric implementations. We further observe varying levels of threshold sensitivity across metric families and attribution structures. These findings demonstrate that alignment evaluation cannot be treated as a fixed or invariant measure of explanation quality, and provide practical guidance for designing more reliable and behavior-aware XAI evaluation protocols.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations &amp; Datasets Track

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30817v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30817v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NeuroMotion，用 VQ 将连续运动离散为可复用的 motion primitives，借助原型对比与监督对比把 EEG 表示对齐到这些原语，再由 E2M Transformer 预测运动码序列并做几何精修，实现跨范式的连续运动解码。

**相关性简评：** 以离散码兼作对齐原型与中间预测目标、再从潜表示生成码序列的思路，可能为 LVR 中离散 latent 步骤的监督与表示对齐提供可供核查的线索，但论文不涉及视觉证据使用或推理停止等问题，联系仅限方法层。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NeuroMotion: Aligning EEG to Discrete Motion Primitives for Continuous Motion Decoding

**abstract/A1：** EEG-to-motion decoding remains challenging because noisy scalp EEG is difficult to map directly to continuous kinematics. We present NeuroMotion, a framework that aligns EEG representations to discrete motion primitives for continuous motion decoding across heterogeneous paradigms, including full-body free movement, lower-limb treadmill locomotion, and upper-limb freewill reaching and grasping. A VQ-based motion prior discretizes continuous motion into reusable primitives that serve as both alignment prototypes and intermediate prediction targets. Prototypical and supervised contrastive objectives align EEG embeddings to motion-derived prototypes and organize them according to primitive assignments. An E2M Transformer predicts motion-code sequences from the learned EEG representations, while a final geometric refinement stage improves continuous trajectory reconstruction through motion-level training. Under a last-session test protocol, NeuroMotion achieves the best mean reconstruction performance among the compared EEG decoding baselines across all three datasets, with the clearest gains on full-body motion in both reconstruction accuracy and distribution-level quality. Multi-subject ablations further support the contributions of EEG-to-primitive alignment, token prediction, and refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/Liuyi2351433/NeuroAction.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30829

**作者：** Marco Lavorini、Davide Bacciu、Giancarlo Bigi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30829v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30829v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将图消息传递中「吸收邻域信号」与「保留节点自身信息」的权衡建模为势博弈（势函数为度归一化的严格 Dirichlet 能量），并提出 CG2：每层用基于局部通道统计的共享六参数策略自适应决定自身表示与邻域聚合的混合比例，可按任务监督或该能量目标训练，在异质图与长程基准上与固定混合对比。

**相关性简评：** 其按局部统计决定「吸收多少外部信息、保留多少自身状态」的轻量共享门控，以及用能量项抑制表示过度平滑的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态更新与表示坍缩、区分度监督的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Potential Games for Self-Neighborhood Channel Mixing in Graph Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Graph message passing must balance two competing objectives: incorporating neighborhood signals while preserving node-specific information. We model this trade-off as a game in which nodes choose how to mix their own representations with strict-neighborhood aggregates. For fixed channel representations, task supervision defines a common-payoff game, while local distinctness payoffs induce an exact potential game whose potential is the degree-normalized strict Dirichlet energy. We introduce CG2, which amortizes these choices through a shared six-parameter policy per layer based on local channel statistics and can be trained using either objective. Controlled comparisons show that the shared task-trained policy improves mean performance over fixed mixing on three of five heterophily benchmarks, with significant gains on two, while free per-node actions trained with either objective rarely improve on the same baseline. On the ECHO long-range benchmark, the clearest contribution of the gate appears on eccentricity, where the task-trained policy substantially reduces prediction error.

### 534. [The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30835v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30835

**作者：** Zhen Yang、Wei Tang、Chu Chen、Rui Qian、Yixuan Chen、Fan Yang、Kangning Cui

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30835v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30835v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 850 万条带认证参考的输入上系统检验 PyTorch 中 18 类闭式 KL 族与 F.kl\_div 的数值值与梯度误差（CPU/GPU、FP32/FP16），并给出稳定闭式分解、补偿算术与解析梯度等修复方案，可消除 97% 以上的显著误差。

**相关性简评：** 若 LVR 训练以 KL 正则、近邻分布蒸馏或 KL 作 latent 状态相似度与贡献排序，其实现误差可能污染梯度与排序，文中稳定分解与解析梯度可供核查；但与视觉推理主线无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch

**abstract/A1：** A Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is never negative, yet PyTorch users have reported negative values for years, and the standard advice is to clamp them at zero. The sign is only the visible part of a silent failure. Many machine-learning applications compare nearby distributions, where conventional KL formulas lose accuracy. On 8.5 million inputs with certified references across 18 closed-form KL families and F.kl\_div, we find widespread errors in values and gradients on CPU and GPU. Among scalar families in ordinary parameter ranges, over 85% of FP32 values have at least 1% relative error near KL 10^(-7) (FP16: 10^(-3)), and about 30% become negative at smaller divergences. More precision is not the cure: evaluated one precision higher, the same formulas still leave 7--51% of FP32 values significantly wrong for 22 of 23 configurations. Stable closed-form decompositions, compensated arithmetic, and analytic gradients remove over 97% of significant errors in the working format. Strict repairs eliminate significant errors on 7.2 million scored closed-form samples and correctly round all 567 million scored F.kl\_div components. The errors affect parameter fitting, Bayesian decisions, identical-start distillation (up to 97% top-1 disagreement), KL-based layer rankings in a quantized LLM, and 19--59% of GPT-2 circuit edge scores. With the repaired code they all but vanish. Code and data: https://github.com/xi-xiaoran/stablekl

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MakeSense 多模态融合框架：以私有流保留各传感器证据，通过共享 bottleneck tokens 融合，并用同一退化观测的全集/子集配对训练抑制「负融合」，在五个具身感知数据集上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其私有证据保留与子集监督可能为 LVR 中避免视觉信息被语言先验淹没、判断新增视觉证据是否有害提供线索，但能否迁移到推理状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?

**abstract/A1：** Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究交通标志上对抗补丁的认证防御：发现 PatchCleanser 搭配常规训练分类器时认证准确率极低（GTSRB 仅 1.7%–4.8%），因为单个掩码可遮住区分类别的中心符号；作者提出 mask-aware training，在防御自身掩码集合的随机成对遮挡图上训练（偏向遮挡标志中心），掩码集合与认证流程不变，ResNet-50 认证准确率从 4.8% 升至 60.0%。

**相关性简评：** 其「按掩码遮挡训练 + 掩码式认证推理」或可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据被局部遮挡/筛除时如何通过训练监督保留任务必要线索，但论文不涉及内部状态与多模态推理，是否可迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training

**abstract/A1：** Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision. PatchCleanser is a certified defense that applies two rounds of masking and, for every image it certifies, provably returns the correct label for any patch that fits inside one mask. We show that on traffic signs the defense certifies almost nothing when paired with a normally trained classifier (1.7% to 4.8% certified accuracy on GTSRB), because a single mask can hide the small central symbol that distinguishes sign classes. We propose mask-aware training, which trains the classifier on images occluded by random pairs drawn from the defense's own mask set, with a sampling bias toward masks over the sign's centre. The defense, mask set and certification procedure are unchanged, so the guarantee is preserved. For an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, mask-aware training raises certified accuracy from 4.8% to 60.0%. Under real per-image adversarial patches, the defended ResNet-50 reaches 85.7% accuracy, versus 74.6% for the original PatchCleanser with a normally trained ResNet-50.

**comment/C1：** 4 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 537. [DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30844v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30844

**作者：** Lernie Li、Yuanliu Liu、Pengfei Xiong、Wei Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30844v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30844v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DyLoMo-DiT：以权重共享的循环方式重复应用中间层、并结合稀疏专家复用参数容量，同时按噪声水平动态改变循环次数，在 ImageNet 256×256 与文生图上验证其在参数与计算预算上的效率。

**相关性简评：** 权重共享循环与按噪声级分配计算，可能为 LVR 中循环式推理状态更新和动态计算预算（THINK/LOOK/STOP 类决策）提供方法线索，但该工作面向图像生成、未涉及推理状态与证据使用，可供核查其迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

**comment/C1：** 46 pages, 29 figures, 33 tables. Code, weights and project page: https://oneboxcream.github.io/DyLoMo-DiT/

</details>

### 538. [CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30859v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30859

**作者：** Shima Salehi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30859v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30859v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对输电走廊 LiDAR 与图像分割，提出在四个冻结专家上做后处理式 MoE：预测为可用性感知概率均值附近的校准残差，并用 harm penalty 抑制在均值已判对的点上产生额外损失，最终 mIoU 84.906%。

**相关性简评：** 其「以均值为基线、只加保守残差并以 harm 惩罚保护已正确部分」的融合与监督思路，可能为 LVR 中多路 latent 假设的合并、残差式状态更新及避免新增计算破坏原有正确推理提供可核查线索，但属远距迁移，需判断是否真有对应机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts. Its deployable prediction is a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging, while a harm penalty discourages extra loss on points that the mean already classifies correctly. A matched component study shows why each design choice is needed: an unconstrained learned mixture loses 1.032 mIoU points relative to probability mean, harm regularization restores 0.359 points at fixed capacity, and removing an unnecessary point-wise gate slightly improves accuracy and stability. With three zones for fitting, two disjoint zones for residual-strength selection, and router-untouched t5b5 for final reporting, CableMoE obtains 84.906% mIoU and 98.140 % overall accuracy. This is +10.000 points over SPT and +0.263 over probability mean; all three seeds improve the latter. Across pylon, conductor, structural-cable, and insulator classes, macro-IoU rises from 84.517% for SPT and 97.153% for probability mean to 98.144 %. The results support conservative residual composition, not a claim of a new segmentation backbone or universal state of the art

**comment/C1：** Submitted to IEEE TPEC 2027

</details>

### 539. [AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30891

**作者：** Zitong Shuai、Zengliang Zang、Chunlei Shi、Lang Liu、Ning Liu、Yiwen Hu、Dan Niu、Chenyan Zhou、Shangjian Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30891v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AeroJEPA 两阶段联合嵌入预测框架用于区域地表 PM2.5 预报：第一阶段融合历史观测、模式背景与气象信息预测未来初始状态及多尺度结构，第二阶段以预测气象引导状态细化并解码浓度场。

**相关性简评：** 其 JEPA 式潜空间预测监督与「气象引导＋多尺度结构」的状态更新，可供核查是否能迁移为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的组织与训练监督线索；但属地球科学时空预报，与视觉推理差异较大，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning

**abstract/A1：** Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure. However, analysis-initialized forecasts make limited explicit use of historical observations, while pointwise regression tends to smooth local variations and provides limited constraints on fine spatial structures. In this work, we propose AeroJEPA, a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework for regional surface PM$\_{2.5}$ forecasting. Specifically, Stage I fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorological information to predict an initial future state, meteorological conditions, and multi-scale structures. Morphology-guided encoding and joint-embedding predictive supervision support learning future spatial representations, supplementing concentration regression with structural constraints. Stage II uses predicted meteorology to guide state refinement and incorporates coarse- and fine-scale structures into state updates and decoding to generate the concentration field at a single future time step. Experiments show that AeroJEPA reduces gridded and independent-station RMSE by 17.23\\% and 7.90\\%, respectively, relative to PFGNet, while improving spatial consistency with analysis fields. In a 48 h recursive forecasting case study, AeroJEPA generally achieves lower RMSE and MAE than the numerical forecasts across the forecast period, indicating promising short- to medium-range forecasting performance.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 540. [World Models as Native Latent Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30898v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30898

**作者：** Qinyue Li、Weijie Qiao、Qingyi Tao、Zerui Gong、Zhe Yang、Quanzhou Li、Taolin Zhang、Jinglin He、Zhonghua Wu、Chen Change Loy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30898v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30898v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文将预训练视频扩散世界模型直接当作 latent action model，用同一 transformer 兼作逆动力学与正动力学模型，仅以可学习 dynamics registers 作为因果桥梁，并在仅运动不同的反事实时序对上训练，把视频动态蒸馏为紧凑的 latent action，再作为 VLA 策略预训练的动力学教师。

**相关性简评：** 其「从密集纠缠的生成模型内部状态中经 registers 抽取紧凑 latent，并用反事实配对做监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何压缩进内部状态、以及潜在内容的贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但任务是机器人动作而非多模态推理，迁移性待判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World Models as Native Latent Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi\_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://pawteam-eai.github.io/native-lam/

</details>

### 541. [Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30939v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30939

**作者：** Yujie Zhang、Tianyi Zhao、Guanghui Min、Chen Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30939v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30939v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Spectral Circuit Analysis（SCA），用前向梯度在释义间的谱结构替代反事实激活替换来定位电路：逐 block 做 SVD 提取任务子空间，并按一致性加权把谱能量分摊到单元上，在 GPT-2 Small 与 Pythia-160M 的十二个任务上做单元排序与跨任务共享结构分析。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是区分「承载任务信号的内部方向」与「随输入表述漂移的噪声方向」，并给出单元级贡献分配，可供核查能否用于判定 VLM 内部状态中的视觉证据与 latent 内容是否真的被答案使用，以及 latent 相似度中内容与表述因素的分离；但该工作仅在纯文本小模型上验证，向多模态推理期状态的迁移性待查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis

**abstract/A1：** Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors. The dominant paradigm scores each unit by replacing its clean activation with a corrupted counterpart as causal intervention. While effective, this approach rests on a brittle prerequisite: the structure prompt pairs are task-specific, expensive to engineer, and silently couple the discovered circuit to prompt-design choices. In this work, we propose Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a gradient-spectral pipeline that achieves consistent circuit discovery along both axes: stable across input formulations of the same task, and natively exposing structure shared across tasks. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a counterfactual-free reframing of circuit discovery: causally relevant directions are recoverable from the spectral structure of forward gradients across paraphrases, with leading directions concentrating task signal and trailing ones absorbing paraphrase noise, yielding circuits tied to the task rather than the prompt. Second, we introduce SCA, a block-wise SVD pipeline that extracts a task subspace per architectural block and redistributes spectral energy onto constituent units via a consistency-weighted share, producing per-unit rankings competitive with attribution-patching baselines under strictly less supervision. Finally, on twelve circuit-discovery tasks in GPT-2 Small and Pythia-160M, SCA performs comparably or exceeds EAP-family methods under the standard recovery-score protocol and recovers IOI canonical heads with Precision@K = 1.0 in top-10 slices on GPT-2 Small; the same machinery extends to a unified cross-task analysis classifying units as universal, family-shared, or task-specific and exposing compositional structure invisible to per-task analyses.

</details>

### 542. [Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30951v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30951

**作者：** Yue Pei、Shining Bo、Yingying Zhang、Qinggang Ge、Zhiling Zhao、Jian Cheng、Haogang Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30951v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30951v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 R-LLMC：行为监督的 LLM 解码出 25 种升压药-补液动作上的精确分布以生成贴近临床记录的候选，再由离线 critic 按估计长期价值挑选，理由在选定后撰写，并在 MIMIC-III 留出患者上以双稳健价值评估。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系，但其「候选生成＋离线 critic 价值选择＋事后解释、使解释无法反向影响决策」的分离结构可供核查，可能对应 LVR 中多 latent 假设的筛选、停止决策以及推理状态与解释解耦的问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection

**abstract/A1：** Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.

</details>

### 543. [MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30983v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30983

**作者：** Yitong Qiao、Lei Liu、Yue Shen、Jian Wang、Jinjie Gu、Zhixuan Chu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30983v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30983v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建 MedUIGym，一个覆盖六类临床任务家族、15,739 个任务的可交互 EHR GUI 环境：agent 从截图感知界面状态并执行键鼠动作，同时提供共享同一临床数据的原生工具接口，校验最终答案与关键临床动作，并支持轨迹离线学习与在线 RL；对 12 个视觉语言模型评测显示，单纯提高推理努力并无稳定收益。

**相关性简评：** 截图 GUI 与原生工具的双接口对照、以及「增加推理投入却无一致增益」的结果，可供核查视觉证据是否真正被利用（视觉旁路）与 THINK 的收益成本，其轨迹采集与奖励训练也可为 VLM 推理的监督线索提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows

**abstract/A1：** Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

</details>

### 544. [Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31025v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31025

**作者：** Julian Wyatt、James Willoughby、Allison Clement、Irina Voiculescu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31025v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31025v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MCTP，通过在前向过程中显式移除 token 并做蒙特卡洛估计来衡量各 token 对预测的影响，比较不同 ViT 与深度的剪枝响应，指出维持预测与空间聚合一致性需要保护高范数 sink token。

**相关性简评：** 其 token 影响评估与 sink 保护可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、视觉信息坍缩诊断提供线索，但论文仅研究纯视觉编码器剪枝，尚未涉及推理状态或答案对视觉内容的实际使用，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token's impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm "sink" tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3's prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object's bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep "sinks".

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/Julian-Wyatt/MCTP

</details>

### 545. [Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31038v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31038

**作者：** Hengzhi Jiang、Haixu Liu、Jindou Jia、Tinglan Wang、Shaobo Chen、Yiren Zhao、Ziyang Rao、Laiyuan Cui、Jiaxin Dong、Yin Ma、Hai Wei、Jiaqi Bai、Tuo An、Xinyu Zhou、Hao Ban、Hongdong Zhu、Yanqi Wang、Jiaqi Dou、Nuo Qian、Qi Liu、Bin Jin、Chang Wu、Qingfeng Li、Hui Yang、Weiyu Guo、Dicong Qiu、Qi Gao、Jianwei Niu、Kai Wen、Jianfei Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31038v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31038v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Boltz-Flow，用观测与指令条件的 Boltzmann 机替换 flow-matching 策略固定的高斯初始噪声源，以 listwise 目标让能量对齐冻结积分后动作的质量，推理时将能量定义的 Ising 实例解码为连续噪声。

**相关性简评：** 以条件能量模型学习并监督 latent 起点、按最终输出质量回传目标，可能为 LVR 中初始推理状态设计与信用分配提供核查线索，但论文本身面向机器人动作生成，不涉及视觉推理状态的生成与更新。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine

**abstract/A1：** Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. At inference, the energy defines an Ising instance whose solution is decoded into continuous noise before a single standard integration. We use a physical coherent Ising machine during training. Experiments show that Boltz-Flow improves $π\_{0.5}$ across three benchmarks, outperforming the compared strong policy baselines and competing noise optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and ranking second only to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus. Additional experiments show gains under noise-adapted fine-tuning, with action-to-action warm starts, and on the SmolVLA backbone.

</details>

### 546. [Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31048v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31048

**作者：** Jiaze Li、Jingyang Chen、Wenhao Zhao、Haoran Xu、Zhenlong Yuan、Dianmo Sheng、Yuanxing Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31048v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31048v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 text-to-image 自蒸馏中教师会连带吸收 critic 无意添加内容的问题，提出 Hindsight Twins：用同一修订模板分别填入目标修正与观察到的错误，只蒸馏两者的 velocity 差，并对齐槽位外的 token 状态。

**相关性简评：** 「只蒸馏修正量而非整段重写」以及抑制单槽编辑扩散到其他 token 的表征对齐，可能为 LVR 中修正信号的贡献分配与局部 latent 状态编辑提供核查线索，但与多模态推理本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.

</details>

### 547. [LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31105v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31105

**作者：** Tianyi Huang、Samuel Xu、Ivy Gu、Nathan Huang、Siqi Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31105v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31105v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LiveLoRA，一种模型与运行时协同设计：利用冻结的下层解码块与固定的 K/V 低秩下投影，使每个 token 的基投影与低秩坐标在 adapter 版本切换后保持一致，再通过末层块重算最近 token，完成 KV cache、adapter 与下一 token logits 的同步提交。作者在精确算术下证明其与全历史重新 prefill 的续写等价，并在 Qwen2.5-3B 上报告相对全历史重算的中位加速与较低解码开销。

**相关性简评：** 其「缓存状态在模型版本变化后是否仍可复用、如何判定等价」的论证方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent/注意力缓存的跨步骤复用与失效条件提供可核查的参考线索，但该文面向 agent 服务效率而非视觉推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session. Yet reusing key-value (KV) cache entries computed under an earlier version mixes model versions, while full-history re-prefill becomes increasingly costly as histories and session fleets grow. We introduce LiveLora, a model-runtime co-design for exact final-block KV cache migration. Frozen lower decoder blocks and fixed K/V adapter down-projections preserve each token's base projections and low-rank coordinates across adapter versions. The runtime reconstructs candidate K/V, reevaluates the latest token through the final block, and commits the adapter, cache, and next-token logits together. We prove continuation equivalence to full-history re-prefill in exact arithmetic under the stated model assumptions. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, median paired publication speedups over full-history re-prefill average $68.98\\times$ across five runs for 32 active sessions with 8K tokens each. Serving benchmarks show approximately 4.8% decoding overhead relative to native cached decoding. Compared with retained-boundary replay, compact retention gives a $3.42\\times$ reduction in additional session storage at 8K, with similar measured publication-plus-decoding cost. LiveLora allows persistent LLM agents to adopt new adapter versions without replaying their full interaction histories.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AgenticOS: Co-designing Systems and ML Foundations of an OS Layer for Agentic AI

</details>

### 548. [Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31113v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31113

**作者：** Ruben Navasardyan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31113v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31113v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察训练期注意力改动（block-sparse attention、attention dropout、ALiBi）在零样本上下文外推评测中受 temperature 失校准混淆的问题：用种子配对的 365M/1.2B 模型，按模型与长度分别校准 temperature 后重做比较，发现原本 6–35% 的优势大多消失，并指出 bf16 训练下归一化 gain 几乎不动会放大失校准。

**相关性简评：** 该文不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，但其「先校准温度、确认 gain 是否更新」的评测诊断线索可供核查：若在 LVR 中比较稀疏注意力、位置编码或缓存/注意力结构改动，类似未校准差异可能被误读为结构收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension

**abstract/A1：** A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β\_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1.2B. We recommend reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/rubentium/SparseAtt

</details>

### 549. [SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31135v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31135

**作者：** Fareeha Amir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31135v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31135v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SRCWDNet 用于多标签遥感场景分类，通过跨窗口注意力获取局部与全局视觉上下文，并用统计共现图与语义嵌入图组成的双标签图以及神经分类器链显式建模标签间依赖。

**相关性简评：** 标签关系图与链式顺序预测可能为 latent 推理中的实体关系表示与逐步状态更新提供参考，但该文面向遥感分类而非多模态推理，也无内部推理状态或证据筛选，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification

**abstract/A1：** Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the MLRSNet and China-MAS50k datasets, respectively, outperforming CNN, transformer, and lightweight baselines. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages 11 figures

</details>

### 550. [Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31143v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31143

**作者：** Umut Kocasari、Bartłomiej Baranowski、Richard Shaw、Eduardo Pérez-Pellitero、Matthias Nießner

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31143v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31143v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将预训练单图 image-to-3D 生成器的原生 3D latent 改造为多图联合去噪器，用轻量 correspondence-attention adapter 让每个 3D token 只关注其他图像中的对应点，从而在表情与视角变化下生成一致的头部网格。

**相关性简评：** 其用对应关系约束跨图注意力、仅融合相关位置证据并在拟合对应噪声上训练的做法，可能为 LVR 中的多视图视觉证据筛选与对齐提供可核查的机制线索，但任务本身是 3D 网格生成，不涉及推理状态或答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images

**abstract/A1：** Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.

**comment/C1：** Project website: https://kocasariumut.github.io/HeadAnything/ , Video: https://youtu.be/EQm6y\_Z0Frk

</details>

### 551. [Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31156v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31156

**作者：** Sagnik Ghosh、Aswin C. Sankaranarayanan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31156v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31156v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把源图像 token 视为保持局部性的空间锚点，用轻量路由器依据源 token 与视点预测少量关键 token，使解码器只在固定预算的 top-ranked token 上做注意力，渲染成本不再随源图数量增长；路由器以解码器注意力为监督，并用非极大值抑制压低冗余 token。

**相关性简评：** 其「用注意力监督学习 token 排序、固定预算筛选与冗余抑制」可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选和随预算伸缩的 latent 计算分配提供线索，但论文面向新视角合成，与多模态推理无直接关系，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing

**abstract/A1：** Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects. However, their decoder attends to every source token for every frame, so rendering slows with each source image. Rasterization avoids this by culling primitives that the viewpoint does not see, but source tokens cannot be culled this way, as they have no explicit position or extent. Our key insight is that source tokens are nonetheless spatial anchors: each encodes a local region of the scene, so the decoder's attention for any viewpoint concentrates on a few of them. A lightweight router predicts these tokens from the source tokens and the viewpoint, and the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of top-ranked tokens, so its cost no longer depends on the number of source tokens. We supervise the router with the decoder's attention, using non-maximum suppression to demote redundant tokens. With 24 source images and two views' worth of tokens, our model renders 6.4 times faster than LagerNVS, at a PSNR only 0.68 dB lower. One ranking serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages

</details>

### 552. [Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31166v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31166

**作者：** Nan Chen、Soledad Villar、Soufiane Hayou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31166v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31166v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TipSweep，只训练最后 k0 个 block 来搜索学习率，并给出跨可训练 block 数的精度相关缩放规则，在 1–7B 模型上验证并用分析模型解释 BF16 更新舍入效应。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本后训练超参迁移，与视觉推理无直接关联；但其「最优学习率随深度按 k^{-1} 或 k^{-1/2} 缩放」及低精度更新舍入分析，可能可供核查循环深度或可变有效深度的 latent 推理模型训练。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \\textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k\_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k\_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.

</details>

### 553. [Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31174v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31174

**作者：** Bodong Liu、Dongyoung Go、Sofian Zalouk、Kilian Q. Weinberger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31174v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31174v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发现十种决策模型普遍存在选项顺序敏感性，并随选项数量和多步决策放大；系统比较八种缓解方法后，发现将选项作为共享上下文的并行分支处理的 tree attention 能以很少或几乎不损失精度的方式实现顺序不变。

**相关性简评：** tree attention 的「共享上下文＋并行分支」结构可能为 LVR 中并行候选状态或多路视觉证据评估提供去偏与共享计算的线索，且原文涉及顺序敏感性与多步误差累积，可供核查其与多模态推理状态更新的联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering. Across ten open- and closed-source decision models, we find that \\emph{order-sensitivity} is pervasive, causing substantial accuracy degradation and unreliable decision-making. These effects become more pronounced as the number of options grows and can compound across multi-step decisions. To address this problem, we systematically compare eight methods for mitigating order sensitivity in terms of robustness, predictive accuracy, and inference efficiency. Among these methods, we find that \\emph{tree attention} is a surprisingly effective and efficient method. It achieves order invariance by processing options as parallel branches of a shared context. When used during training, it matches the baseline's average accuracy. Applied to the baseline without retraining, it also eliminates order sensitivity with only a 1.1-point drop in accuracy. Our findings demonstrate that order invariance can be enforced directly in decision models with little or no loss in predictive accuracy.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31184

**作者：** Boyang Wang、Kevin Blackburn-Matzen、Oindrila Saha、Matheus Gadelha、Zezhou Cheng

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CodecOPSD：先借鉴视频编解码思想剪除条件 token 中的冗余时空信息，再用 on-policy 自蒸馏训练 DiT adapter 适配该剪枝模式，在 16 种条件模态上平均剪掉约 66% 条件 token 而几乎不损生成质量，并加速去噪、压缩 KV cache。

**相关性简评：** 「判断哪些信息是真正新增」的剪枝准则与 on-policy 自蒸馏训练压缩适配器的做法，可能为 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选、视觉 token 压缩后的信息保真与监督分配提供可核查线索，但其面向生成效率，剪枝是否保留任务必要细节尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://kiteretsu77.github.io/CodecOPSD\_website/

</details>

### 555. [Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31190v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31190

**作者：** Avinash Kumar Singh、Bhaskarjit Sarmah、Stefano Pasquali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、q-fin.CP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31190v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31190v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 Text-to-SQL 的置信度估计建模为潜变量正确性下的查询验证问题：生成器 LLM 生成并执行 SQL，另一个 critic LLM 评判结果，再与生成器的口头置信、token 级不确定性和 SQL 结构特征在随机森林中融合，最后用 Learn-then-Test 阈值与 conformal p 值对接受/弃答给出有限样本风险保证。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成与验证分离」以及带风险预算认证的弃答阈值，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与验证器、证据筛选的设计提供可核查线索，但该工作非多模态、不产生 latent 推理状态，迁移需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration time through gold-SQL execution and latent at deployment. Our estimator separates generation from validation. A generator LLM writes and executes the query, and a different critic LLM judges the query and its execution result. The critic's validation and execution-grounded alignment scores are fused with the generator's verbalized confidence, token-level uncertainty, and SQL-structural features in a Random Forest, using two sequential LLM calls. Two calibration steps give finite-sample guarantees. A Learn-then-Test threshold ensures, with probability $1-δ$, that the error rate among accepted queries stays below a user-chosen budget. A conformal p-value bounds the false abstention rate. On Spider we use GPT-OSS-120B as generator and Gemma-4-31B as critic. The estimator obtains an AUARC of 0.899. Without abstention, 22.6% of queries are wrong. With a 15% risk budget ($δ=0.1$), a threshold is certified on all 10 resampled splits, and the system accepts 52.4% of queries on average with 9.1% observed error. Five different critic models give similar results. In a controlled comparison on Spider with Olmo-3-32B as generator, the estimator obtains an AUARC of 89.5, compared with 81.2 for the strongest logit-based baseline. Applied to BIRD without retraining, the confidence scores remain informative (AUROC 0.72, against 0.79 on Spider), but the risk guarantee does not transfer, as expected without exchangeability.

</details>

### 556. [LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31216v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31216

**作者：** Richeek Das、Pratik Chaudhari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31216v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31216v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析 LeJEPA 中 SIGReg 各向同性高斯正则难以在实际中达成且目标过严，指出对齐项使特征模长与方向耦合，进而提出仅约束模长与方向边缘分布的 PolarReg，在多个数据集和嵌入维度上免调超参并加快收敛、提升精度。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯自监督视觉表征正则工作，但其对特征分布几何、模长与方向是否解耦及正则强度的分析，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态几何约束、表示坍缩与训练监督设计时借鉴，是否能迁移到多模态推理尚未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be

**abstract/A1：** The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

</details>
