### 557. [Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31225v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31225

**作者：** Mohammad Hossein Moslemi、Mahdi Beitollahi、Zhimin Mei、Jiale Cai、Bissan Ghaddar、Boyu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31225v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31225v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MIPA，将合成图像视为可学习原型，用冻结编码器按特征相似度把真实样本分配给原型，并通过最大化同一图像不同增强视图间分配结果的互信息、同时抑制样本集中于少数原型的平凡解，实现自监督设定下的数据集蒸馏。

**相关性简评：** 其以互信息目标维持增强不变信息、显式避免分配坍缩的做法，可供核查是否可作为 latent 推理中状态信息保留与信息坍缩抑制的训练目标线索；但该工作属数据蒸馏，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成或证据获取。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization

**abstract/A1：** Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

</details>

### 558. [TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31233v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31233

**作者：** Hani Alomari、Md Atabuzzaman、Chris Thomas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31233v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31233v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 CLIP 式双编码器的 modality gap，用配对统计量定位「两塔在 hard negative 上比在匹配对上更一致」的方向，由 LLM agent 直接写出闭式权重修改而无需反传，并蒸馏为秒级可算的 TowerBridge 配方，在多个 checkpoint 上提升检索且几乎不降零样本精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「用统计量找出误导性一致方向、再做权重空间闭式修正」的做法，可能可供核查是否适用于抑制 VLM 内部状态中与视觉证据无关的相似性方向，或作为免训练诊断—干预模板；但论文面向检索表示而非 latent 推理，联系仍属间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming

**abstract/A1：** CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages (13 main + 29 supplementary), 11 figures, 35 tables

</details>

### 559. [Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31237v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31237

**作者：** JB Kim、Byungwoo Jeon、Kyungmin Lee、Hyeonmo Kang、Cheonbok Park、Shinyoung Joo、Jinwoo Shin、Jeonghoon Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31237v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31237v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Integral：用 Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的层级表示形成共享视觉 token，并引入仅在 block 边界与 VLM 交互的轻量生成流 Block-wise MoT，把预训练 VLM 扩展为统一理解-生成模型。

**相关性简评：** 其共享视觉表示空间与层级特征聚合可供核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留足够的视觉细节，block 边界接口也可能类比 LVR 中视觉旁路或信息坍缩的瓶颈，但论文目标是图像生成，未涉及 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations

**abstract/A1：** Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

**comment/C1：** Preprint. Project page: https://thejb.ai/integral

</details>

### 560. [Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31240v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31240

**作者：** Seongchan Kim、Soowon Son、Sangoh Kim、Hyunah Ko、Eunbeen Hong、Hyunkoo Lee、Sanghyun Lee、WonJun Moon、Kihong Kim、Dongyeon Son、Woongchan Nam、Seungryong Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31240v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31240v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对自动驾驶推理式 VLA 模型做结构化剪枝：基于 Alpamayo-1.5-10B 的 Taylor 重要性分析发现推理目标与轨迹目标对同一 VLM 结构的偏好不同，据此提出 MoOP，融合两种目标的重要性排序剪 VLM，并对 action expert 的 MLP 通道按去噪步聚合重要性后固定选择子集。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理目标与动作目标对同一内部结构重要性排序不一致」以及剪枝过量时「推理先崩塌」的现象，可能为 LVR 中推理状态是否真正服务答案、贡献分配与信息坍缩诊断提供可核查线索，但论文本身是压缩效率工作，未做因果验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

**comment/C1：** 45 pages. Project page: https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/MoOP

### 561. [Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26504v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26504

**作者：** Élodie Côté-Gauthier、Doina Precup、Isabeau Prémont-Schwarz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26504v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26504v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将内嗅皮层网格细胞解释为 successor representation 的特征向量，用固定参考策略转移矩阵的特征向量构造基，使每个 successor feature 是该基特征乘以闭式系数 1/(1−γλ\_i)，从而无需 successor-feature 网络或回放缓冲，任务切换只需对奖励做线性回归；在双目标 gridworld 中切换目标时仍保持接近最优回报。

**相关性简评：** 谱分解给出固定、可复用的 latent 状态基与闭式系数，可能为 LVR 中内部表示几何结构及任务/目标切换时的状态复用提供概念线索，可供核查；但该工作限于离散 gridworld 的纯 RL，与视觉多模态推理没有直接接口。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Continual reinforcement learning requires agents to adapt when the task changes while reusing what they know about the environment. Successor features separate dynamics from task-specific reward, but their effectiveness depends on the choice of base features. Taking the identification of entorhinal grid cells with eigenvectors of the successor representation as a design principle, we build this basis from eigenvectors of the transition matrix of a fixed reference policy. With such a basis, the successor features at a state-action pair are a linear combination of the base features at that same pair, which is not true in general, and the coefficients are known in closed form: each successor feature is its base feature multiplied by $θ\_i = 1/(1-γλ\_i)$, where $λ\_i$ is its eigenvalue. The long-term return is thus predicted from the same features as the immediate reward, no successor-feature network or replay buffer is needed, and adapting to a new task reduces to a linear regression on the reward. The agent acts greedily on the action values of the reference policy, which is one step of policy improvement over it and suffices to reach a single goal. In a two-goal gridworld, with the uniform random walk as reference policy, whose eigenvectors are the low-frequency Laplacian eigenvectors, agents built this way maintain near-maximal return across every change of goal, whereas SimpleSF and DQN lose most of their return at each change.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurReps and WiML workshops at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 562. [Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26717v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26717

**作者：** Tanzimul Alam Fahim、Mohammad Arif Hossain

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26717v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26717v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「以构造保证连贯」的关系型数据生成范式：LLM 代理提出意图，确定性裁判依据显式世界模型裁定事件，仅在事件发生时产出关系，并证明对这类生成器而言，只读图特征的校验器会被结构匹配的随机图复现而失去信息量。

**相关性简评：** 其以结构匹配随机图作零假设、按组件消融归因并论证校验器可能只奖励平凡性的思路，或可供核查 latent 状态是否真携带任务相关内容而非表面统计，但属远领域类比，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation

**abstract/A1：** Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. Using Erdős-Rényi controls we realize the theorem four times, as structural separation, embedding transfer, inductive link prediction, and real-data augmentation each reward a triviality rather than coherence; we give the mechanism behind each and the conditions a valid benchmark must meet.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 5 figures. Includes supplementary material (Sections S-I through S-X)

</details>

### 563. [TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26722v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26722

**作者：** Moritz Pötzsch、Andrea Gentilini、Lisa Rossgoderer、Tom Osterfeld、Kesava Prasad Sanjivi Arul、Swanand Ravindra Kadhe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26722v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26722v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了约 450 万条多轮/单轮工具调用偏好对数据集 TOUMAII，并发布可从 SFT 对话数据生成含自然失败模式偏好对的管线 TOUMAII-Gen，用 3B 模型 DPO 验证其效果与现有高质量数据集持平。

**相关性简评：** 其「正例 + 貌似合理的错误调用」偏好对构造方式，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的对比式监督与错误贡献分配提供可核查的数据构造思路；但论文不涉及视觉输入或内部推理状态，与主线距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator

**abstract/A1：** To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. In an environment where even a minor formatting error can invalidate a call and an incorrect decision can derail the interaction, direct preference optimisation (DPO) targets exactly this contrast. DPO, therefore, requires preference pairs rather than plain demonstrations. For tool-calling, such data, especially in realistic multi-turn settings, remains extremely scarce. To address this scarcity, we introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing ~4.5M validated preference pairs, derived from Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M (apache-2.0) conversations. The dataset consists of multi- and single-turn interactions and includes parallel and sequential function calls. Additionally, we release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that consumes tool-calling SFT datasets and generates a preference dataset with naturally occurring model-generated tool-calling failure modes. To validate the effectiveness of our DPO data, we fine-tune a 3-billion-parameter model, achieving performance parity with other high-quality tool-calling preference datasets. Furthermore, we release a second small preference dataset derived from ToolACE (apache-2.0), showcasing the source-agnostic nature of our pipeline. We release the complete code and datasets: https://github.com/tum-ai/toumaii-gen and https://huggingface.co/collections/tum-ai/toumaii-generated-datasets

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. 27 pages, including 5 pages of main text, references, and appendices; 17 figures and 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/tum-ai/toumaii-gen. Datasets: https://huggingface.co/collections/tum-ai/toumaii-generated-datasets

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26726

**作者：** Eduardo Campos、Willam Cardoso、Diego Furtado、Solange Oliveira、Alneu Lopes

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PRISM 框架，通过显式结构映射把单一图像源转换为多个具有不同归纳偏置的视图表示，并给出度量各视图贡献的协议；其手工实例 PRISM-HD 在七个艺术与非艺术图像数据集上与经典描述子、微调深度网络组合评估。

**相关性简评：** 「单源构造多种异质表示并量化各视图贡献」可能为多 latent 假设的多样性设计与贡献分配提供类比线索，但该工作是静态分类特征，未涉及推理期状态更新或答案对 latent 内容的使用，需核查其贡献度量是否能迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decomposing images in a PRISM: A Single-Source Multi-View Framework for Image Representation

**abstract/A1：** Multi-view learning has shown that combining complementary views can improve predictive performance, yet many datasets provide a single raw source of information. How can multiple useful views be constructed from one source? We propose PRISM (Plural Representations of Images via Structural Maps), a framework that transforms an image into representations with distinct inductive biases through explicit structural maps, together with a protocol for measuring what each view contributes. We evaluate PRISM-HD, a hand-designed instantiation of PRISM in which the constructed views are summarized through representation-specific descriptors, on three artistic and four non-artistic image datasets. Analyses at a fixed feature budget show that the gains of the structural views are not explained by feature dimensionality alone. PRISM-HD by itself outperforms WND-CHARM on all seven datasets. Moreover, PRISM-HD and Fisher Vector provide complementary predictive signals: their equal-weight combination improves over the better individual representation by 5--8 percentage points on the artistic datasets. When combined with fine-tuned deep networks through a fixed parameter-free fusion rule, the PRISM-based representation improves performance on four of seven datasets and leaves it statistically unchanged on the remaining three, indicating that the constructed views provide predictive signals that are complementary to learned deep representations.

</details>

### 565. [Cross-Attack Robust Aggregation for Federated Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26731v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26731

**作者：** Eyhab Al-Masri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26731v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26731v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究联邦学习中恶意或故障客户端带来的投毒问题，提出 FedTether：按客户端更新相对坐标中位数的偏离计算带死区的鲁棒分数进行重加权，并作为服务端优化步骤，在多数据集、多攻击类型与部分参与条件下兼顾鲁棒性与精度。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但「偏离中位数即降权」的鲁棒聚合与免鲁棒性代价的评价思路，可能启发多 latent 假设或视觉证据筛选时对不可靠来源的加权取舍，属较远领域迁移，需核查其在高维状态聚合下的可用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-Attack Robust Aggregation for Federated Learning

**abstract/A1：** Federated learning (FL) lets resource-constrained IoT and edge devices train a shared model without exchanging raw data, but compromised or faulty devices can poison the global model. Existing robust aggregators each fail in some regime: naive averaging (FedAvg) collapses under high-magnitude attacks, whereas distance- and statistics-based defenses (Krum, median, trimmed mean) sacrifice accuracy on non-IID data and remain vulnerable to stealthy attacks. We present FedTether, which reweights client updates by their deviation from a coordinatewise median through a robust, dead-zoned score applied as a server-side optimizer step. Across three datasets, three attack types, and Byzantine fractions up to 40%, FedTether is the only method top-tier in every regime: it matches FedAvg under stealthy attacks with no robustness tax, exceeds robust baselines by up to 42 accuracy points, and stays accurate where high-magnitude attacks reduce FedAvg to near-random. These properties persist at 50 clients under partial participation, with no shared data or validation set.

</details>

### 566. [INCISE: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation of Surgical Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26734

**作者：** Yifan Xu、Bofang Zheng、Guangyu Meng、Nishchal Sapkota、Xianshi Ma、Xu Cao、Tianjiao Yu、Danny Z Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26734v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向手术视频的免训练上下文分割框架：从多段视频中挑选能覆盖目标视频局部外观的未标注帧作为参考标注，再用冻结模型分割目标视频，以极少参考帧超过微调 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 其按外观覆盖度选取少量参考帧的思路，可能与 LVR 中预算受限的视觉证据筛选与采样策略有概念联系，但该文不涉及推理状态或答案生成，可供核查的借鉴较为间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** INCISE: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation of Surgical Videos

**abstract/A1：** Surgical video analysis requires video object segmentation (VOS), yet existing methods are commonly based on pretrained model fine-tuning using a large number of expert labels. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers the promise of bypassing this high cost by segmenting a target video using a few annotated references, which are the sole source of surgical knowledge for a frozen model. However, existing ICS methods tend to draw such references at random, which concentrate on a few views that dominate a surgical video and can miss other objects of interest (e.g., transient instruments and small structures). To address these challenges, we propose INCISE, a training-free ICS framework for surgical videos. INCISE selects unlabeled frames from multiple surgical videos that jointly cover the local appearances of a target video, and then segments the target video using these references. With only 1.7% of training frames selected and annotated as references and no target video frame labeled, INCISE obtains 67.2% mean mIoU and outperforms the best SOTA fine-tuned method by 9.2 points. We hope INCISE can help establish ICS as a practical alternative to fine-tuning in surgical video analysis and other domains with a costly labeling burden.

</details>

### 567. [Who Should Verify? Reviewer Selection with Partial Information and Outcome Audits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26770v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26770

**作者：** The Viet Bui、Tien Mai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26770v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26770v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在只能付费核查部分答案键与评审的情形下，如何以最低成本证明所选评审程序与最优程序相差不超过指定题数，给出精确停止规则、整数规划与对数因子近似算法，并分析搜索成本下界，在 MMLU 等数据上重放验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「按需付费核查＋停止规则＋证书成本」框架可能为 LVR 中何时停止获取视觉证据、在有限预算下比较多种 latent 推理配置提供形式化参考，但完全不涉及视觉内部状态，可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Who Should Verify? Reviewer Selection with Partial Information and Outcome Audits

**abstract/A1：** Selecting an AI reviewer requires evidence about what it does after reading a draft. On a fixed batch of items, a team can keep the original answers or adopt one reviewer's answers throughout. We ask how much it costs to certify that the chosen procedure falls at most a specified number of correct answers short of the best available procedure, for every completion of the unobserved evidence. When all reviews are available and only verified answer keys cost money, we give an exact stopping rule and an integer program for the cheapest certificate in hindsight. When reviews and keys both have prices, a polynomial-time algorithm using the completed record approximates the minimum certificate cost within a factor logarithmic in the number of procedures. This dependence is tight to leading order unless P equals NP. Finding a certificate can be much more expensive. We exhibit a two-procedure family with $n$ unresolved items where one purchase suffices in hindsight but the exact minimax expected search cost is $(n+1)/2$. For two binary procedures under a known independent and identically distributed item law, five counts suffice to compute an optimal search policy. We replay reviews on 2,000 MMLU questions, 896 numerical reports, and 48 Singapore electricity forecast reports. With reviews available, a targeted audit used 6.9% fewer keys on MMLU and 1.2% fewer on numerical reports than a fixed order selected on development data. Compared with selection by stand-alone accuracy, the chosen procedures gained 2.94 percentage points on held-out MMLU questions and zero on numerical reports. On electricity reports, five checks certified a tie across all 48, yet each procedure was correct only eight times.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 568. [Tracktail: Multi-View 3D Point Tracking without Depth Input](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26779v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26779

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Tracktail：无需深度输入，从多个标定视角跟踪 3D 查询点；架构先按相机分别编码视频特征、再做逐查询解码，相机交叉注意力只在解码器内的查询之间进行，并利用相机几何计算逐相机场景尺度以归一化输入与预测，在多视图基准上取得 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 其以查询为单位、跨帧跨视角持续更新的紧凑状态与尺度归一化，可能可供核查 LVR 中几何证据如何写入低维 latent 状态并在多视角间融合；但该工作面向跟踪而非 VLM 推理，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tracktail: Multi-View 3D Point Tracking without Depth Input

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Tracktail, a novel architecture designed to efficiently track query points in 3D from multiple calibrated views without any depth input. Our architecture separates the task as a per-camera video encoding of features and a per-query decoder. Notably, camera cross-attention is only performed across queries in the decoder, allowing for efficient inference (7 FPS and less than 4 GB memory for 10 views and 100 query points). We further introduce a per-camera scene scale computed from camera geometry, which allows us to normalize inputs and predictions appropriately across a vast variety of dataset scales. We train on a synthetic Multi-View Kubric dataset as well as a novel Multi-View Point Odyssey benchmark dataset, which consists of synthetic renders of humans and animals across 499 frames. Tracktail achieves state-of-the-art results on the Panoptic Studio, DexYCB, and Multi-View Kubric benchmarks, outperforming methods that rely on estimated depth. Tracktail also demonstrates a strong ability to maintain accurate tracking over longer ranges compared to existing methods. Our code, data, and weights are publicly available: https://ai-hhmi.github.io/tracktail/

</details>

### 569. [CADENCE:Temporally Coherent Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery that Preserves Expressive Hand Motion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26783v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26783

**作者：** Keniel Peart、Jagmohan Chauhan、Indu P. Bodala、Shelly Vishwakarma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26783v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26783v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CADENCE 单目视频全身 SMPL-X 重建系统：由共享编码器加高分辨率手部通路的逐帧估计器产生初值，再用离线时序细化器沿运动链做注意力，为每个关节、每帧选择学习的零相位滤波器组合，在平滑躯干的同时保留快速手指动作。

**相关性简评：** 其按关节、按帧自适应选择过滤强度以保住携带语义的高频手部运动的思路，可能为 LVR 中如何在时序聚合或状态更新时选择性保留任务必要视觉细节、避免信息坍缩提供可核查的类比，但属较远领域的概念借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CADENCE:Temporally Coherent Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery that Preserves Expressive Hand Motion

**abstract/A1：** Whole-body SMPL-X estimators recover body, hand, and face meshes from single images, but applied frame by frame to video they produce jittery motion. Smoothing the output removes the jitter at a cost that body-only benchmarks do not measure: a temporal filter strong enough to steady the torso also flattens the fast finger strokes that carry meaning in sign language and gesture. We present CADENCE, a whole-body SMPL-X system for monocular video designed around this trade-off. A per-frame estimator built on a shared C-RADIOv4 encoder, with a high-resolution hand pathway that reuses the same encoder on hand crops, produces each frame's estimate. An offline temporal refiner then filters the SMPL-X rotation sequence: attention along the kinematic tree selects, for every joint and every frame, a mixture of learned zero-phase filters, so the torso is smoothed while fast finger strokes pass through. On 3DPW, the refiner reduces acceleration error from 17.4 to 5.4 mm/s2 while lowering PA-MPJPE from 41.9 to 40.2 mm; generic smoothers applied to the same predictions reach 6.2 to 7.7 mm/s2. On SignAvatars/How2Sign sign-language sequences, the refiner has the lowest hand jitter among the compared smoothers while keeping a hand-speed peak amplitude of 0.98, against 0.35 for a SmoothNet retrained on the full SMPL-X vector. The per-frame estimator also obtains the lowest full-body mesh error (25.7 mm) and hand joint error (8.3 mm) among the compared methods on EHF.

</details>

### 570. [Graph-XGB: A Hybrid GNN Framework for Outdoor-to-Indoor 5G Signal Reconstruction via Aerial-Only UAV RF Sensing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26828v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26828

**作者：** David Hason Rudd、Eunkwang Shin、Nithiwat Pattrapong、Huan Huo、Xiangmeng Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NI、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26828v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26828v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 Graph-XGB，用改进 SpiderGNN 在楼层感知的物理图上将无人机外部 RF 测量传播为 128 维室内嵌入，经 PCA 压至 10 维后交由独立 XGBoost 回归器重建室内 5G RSSI/RSRP。

**相关性简评：** 其「内部状态无法直接采样、室内观测仅作训练监督、由边界测量推断内部状态」的设定，可能与 LVR 中由部分观测推断潜在状态及表示压缩是否保留任务必要信息的问题形式上有类比价值，但领域与机制相距较远，仅供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Graph-XGB: A Hybrid GNN Framework for Outdoor-to-Indoor 5G Signal Reconstruction via Aerial-Only UAV RF Sensing

**abstract/A1：** Delivering robust In-Building Coverage (IBC) is critically impeded by severe Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I) attenuation, a constraint that intensifies as deployments move from 5G mid-band towards mmWave and prospective 6G sub-THz carriers, where losses of 60-80 dB have been reported across modern building envelopes. While Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer scalable exterior RF sensing platforms, a fundamental inversion problem persists: interior 3D signal states cannot be directly sampled from constrained exterior flight paths. This paper proposes Graph-XGB, a hybrid inference framework that decouples spatial topology reasoning from non-linear signal regression to resolve this challenge. A modified SpiderGNN encoder, operating on a topology-aware graph constructed with a physically grounded Floor-Aware 3D Distance metric and Bridge Edge Guarantees, propagates UAV boundary measurements into 128-dimensional indoor embeddings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) compresses these into a 10-dimensional manifold retaining 96.6% of embedding variance, fused with raw spatial features and decoded by independent, physics-tailored XGBoost regressors. This decoupling mitigates the optimization conflict between smoothly decaying path-loss signals and volatile interference-dependent metrics. Evaluated on a real-world 5G NR dataset of 613 verified nodes spanning the 10 floors of a single building, Graph-XGB attains the strongest accuracy among the architectures compared, with $R^2$ of 0.759 (RSSI) and 0.770 (RSRP), improvements of 35.5% and 64.9% over the SimpleGNN baseline, using no interior RF measurement as a model input; indoor observations enter only as training supervision, with evaluation on held-out internal nodes. Interference-dependent targets (RSRQ, SNR and CQI) remain bounded well below the path-loss metrics, delimiting the reach of purely spatial inference.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted manuscript of a chapter published in BESC 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science 17175 (Springer, 2027)

</details>

**作者：** Mohamed Hamad、Bilal Mutahir、Mohamed Mabrok、Nizar Zorba、Hamid Saeedi、Halim Yanikomeroglu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26847v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26847v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在两种交通基准上，对 GNN、Transformer 与 selective state-space 三类预测架构按从无缺失到传感器全失的稀疏程度做系统评测，并定义可用性阈值，发现全数据精度与稀疏鲁棒性之间存在明显取舍。

**相关性简评：** 其观测稀疏下的退化曲线与「可用性阈值」思路可能可供核查 VLM 在视觉证据缺失或筛选时的推理可靠性与停止决策；但对象为交通时序预测，与 latent visual reasoning 的迁移性仍需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Sparsity Analysis of Traffic Forecasting Architectures: How Much Missing Data is Too Much?

**abstract/A1：** Traffic forecasting models are typically evaluated under ideal conditions with complete data. This evaluation does not reflect the frequent sensor failures and communication outages common in real-world deployments. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of multivariate traffic prediction models to evaluate their performance under varying levels of sensor data loss during inference. We benchmark several architectural paradigms, including graph neural networks, attention-based Transformers, and selective state-space models, across sparsity levels ranging from zero to complete sensor loss, using two widely used multi-channel traffic benchmarks. To ensure consistent comparison across traffic variables, we use normalized metrics and define a usability threshold to identify when predictions become unreliable. Our results show a clear trade-off between baseline accuracy and robustness: models with the highest accuracy under full-data conditions often degrade most sharply as data becomes sparse, while less accurate models maintain more stable performance. These findings show that model selection should be based on the expected reliability of the sensor network rather than peak accuracy alone. This work provides a practical framework for assessing traffic forecasting models and highlights the importance of robustness in real-world applications.

</details>

### 572. [Scoliosis5K: Multimodal Gait Analysis via Clip-Conditioned RGB-Silhouette Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26849v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26849

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26849v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26849v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建 Scoliosis5K 多站点步态数据集（RGB 人像裁剪、二值轮廓、二维姿态按帧对齐），在预训练 RGB 编码器内用各 patch 相对片段均值的像素偏移加权低秩更新，再融合轮廓序列与区域核岭回归分数，做受试者级脊柱侧弯步态分类，并报告完整系统与冻结编码器、置零轮廓向量下的对照结果。

**相关性简评：** 医学步态分类本身不在主线上，但其在固定权重下置零某一视觉证据通道以度量该通道对预测的边际贡献，可供核查 LVR 中「latent 是否真正使用视觉证据」的贡献分配与消融设计思路；用片段均值偏差调制编码器更新的做法也可能为视觉旁路适配提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scoliosis5K: Multimodal Gait Analysis via Clip-Conditioned RGB-Silhouette Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Color walking video records body boundary motion alongside clothing folds, surface appearance, and recording-environment cues. To examine what an explicit binary silhouette contributes to participant-level classification of scoliosis-related gait when a classifier already observes the paired color sequence, we construct Scoliosis5K, a multi-site collection of 4,998 corridor-walking sequences across 3,010 participant identifiers in which RGB person crops, binary silhouettes, and two-dimensional poses share each recording identifier and frame index. Our architecture uses each patch's pixel deviation from its clip mean to weight two low-rank query and value updates inside a pretrained RGB encoder, fusing the resulting video representation with a silhouette transformer sequence and regional kernel ridge scores extracted from one native-resolution RGB frame per window. Across 988 participants in five participant-disjoint cross-validation folds and three training seeds, the complete system reaches 83.77% accuracy and 79.91% macro-averaged F1, compared with 83.27% accuracy and 79.56% macro-F1 when the video RGB encoder remains frozen under identical inputs. Zeroing the silhouette vector at fixed weights shifts overall accuracy by only 0.10 percentage points while raising positive-category recall from 68.52% to 77.78% and lowering recall for both remaining categories. Macro-averaged AUROC is 0.950 across the cohort and 0.879 among participant pairs matched on acquisition site and recording-count group.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages (8-page main paper and 3-page supplementary material), 3 figures, 12 tables

</details>

### 573. [Beyond Demographic Discrimination: Benchmarking Normative-Descriptive Calibration in LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26870v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26870

**作者：** Radhika Bhargava、Shinibali Bhattacharyya、George Mihaila、Jay Prajapati、Anwesan Pal、Yue Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26870v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26870v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出「规范—描述校准」概念与 NDCB 基准，用 697 组匹配情景分别在「预测」和「决定」两种指令下提问，并以三项指标衡量 LLM 对同一候选的区分是否随框架改变。

**相关性简评：** 其匹配对加双框架对照的评测协议、以及候选顺序偏好（位置偏差）分析，可能为核查 latent 推理状态是否受 prompt 框架与位置扰动影响提供可借用的评价设计，但需较多迁移改造。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Demographic Discrimination: Benchmarking Normative-Descriptive Calibration in LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, where they must distinguish between normative reasoning (what should happen) and descriptive reasoning (what is likely to happen). Most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none we know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. We introduce normative--descriptive calibration, the extent to which a model's differentiation between matched candidates depends on whether it is asked to predict or to decide, and measure it with the Normative--Descriptive Calibration Benchmark (NDCB): 697 matched-pair scenarios across six domains, each posed under both framings, and three metrics, Normative Engagement Rate (NER), Normative Leakage Rate (NLR), and Normative--Descriptive Separation (NDS). Across six LLMs, NDS separates 13 of 15 model pairs, against 7 for BBQ accuracy and none for BOLD, although these counts also reflect each benchmark's sample size. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6 separate the framings most strongly (average NDS $= +0.55$ and $+0.52$, with overlapping confidence intervals), whereas GPT-5.5's average NDS is negative ($-0.14$) under the single-pick instruction and near zero ($+0.02$) without it. In a simplified prompt template, removing single trigger words never changes the sign of a model's average NDS but can shift it by up to 0.46 and reorder models. Reversing candidate order reveals a further effect: when forced to choose between identical candidates, all six models favor whichever is listed first, and once order is averaged out their demographic-aligned lean is toward the marginalized candidate. Describing disparities and prescribing them are separable behaviors that differ across models.

</details>

### 574. [Self-similar Organization of Information in Language](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26935v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26935

**作者：** Leon Lufkin、Cutter Dawes、Kamesh Krishnamurthy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26935v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26935v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一套关于语言中预测信息组织的理论，基于一族信息度量的标度行为，并在长文档中观察到跨尺度的标度塌缩，说明预测信息在每个可测尺度上均存在且呈自相似结构。

**相关性简评：** 其「信息在不同历史长度上如何分布、何时饱和」的量化框架，可能为 LVR 中跨尺度视觉证据筛选、动态计算分配与长度泛化的预测提供问题表述和评价视角，但未涉及多模态或 latent 状态，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-similar Organization of Information in Language

**abstract/A1：** How much information relevant to predicting the future of a passage (i.e. predictive information) is carried by the preceding text, and how is this information distributed along that history? These questions are fundamental to understanding both the statistical structure of language and what large language models (LLMs) can learn about it. Indeed, LLMs trained to predict the next token in text must exploit this predictive information, so its organization determines how the structure of language becomes available to the model to learn. We develop a theory for the organization of predictive information based on the scaling behavior of a family of information measures, and the theory predicts that if this organization has the same form at all measured length scales -- i.e., it has a self-similar structure -- then the information measures evaluated at different lengths collapse onto a common form. We observe this scaling collapse in long text documents, showing that predictive information is present at every length scale we measure and has a self-similar structure. Self-similarity is a considerably stronger property than showing the existence of long-range dependencies, and it constrains the process generating the text. More broadly, our results give quantitative support to the empirical observation that conditioning on more distant text continues to reveal new structure in language to LLMs.

</details>

### 575. [CENTRY: A Probabilistic Latent-State Model for Continual AI Risk Estimation, Monitoring, and Regulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26940v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26940

**作者：** Bonny Banerjee、Geetha Raju

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26940v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26940v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CENTRY 概率框架，把 AI 风险归因于数据、硬件、模型三类内在来源，用结构化隐变量模型（一个快速交互子空间加三个慢速风险子空间）结合变分下界进行持续风险估计、监测与调节，并给出安全性、收敛、可辨识性等理论刻画。

**相关性简评：** 其快/慢隐子空间分解与隐风险状态的可辨识性、一致性分析，可能为 LVR 中区分承载任务内容的 latent 状态与无关状态、以及状态更新的贡献归属提供概念参考，但领域相距较远，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CENTRY: A Probabilistic Latent-State Model for Continual AI Risk Estimation, Monitoring, and Regulation

**abstract/A1：** Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, yet existing AI safety frameworks primarily define, categorize, or govern AI risk rather than proposing implementable models and methods for continually estimating, monitoring, and regulating risk throughout an AI system's operational lifetime. This paper proposes CENTRY, a probabilistic framework that enables continual risk estimation, monitoring, and regulation of a deployed AI system from its interactions with its environment. The framework models AI risk as arising from three intrinsic sources: datasets, hardware resources, and models/algorithms. A structured latent-variable model is developed in which the latent representation is decomposed into a fast interaction subspace that captures the evolving AI--environment dynamics and three slow latent subspaces that encode the long-term risk states associated with the dataset, hardware, and model components. Rather than requiring a ground-truth risk label at every time step, the component-risk states are treated as latent variables and are learned by maximizing a variational evidence lower bound, optionally informed during training and continual refinement by evidence-supported behavior--cause records. The resulting framework unifies continual probabilistic inference, online risk estimation, and adaptive risk regulation in an implementable architecture. Under the explicit assumptions stated for the corresponding results, we establish formal guarantees spanning safety, learning, inference, and operations, including finite-horizon and asymptotic risk-budget compliance, regret and convergence bounds for adaptive regulation, consistency and identifiability of component-risk ratings, and detection-delay, false-alarm, containment, and computational-complexity characterizations.

</details>

### 576. [Distributional Algebro-Geometric Persistence (dAGP): Wasserstein-Stable Polynomial-Relation Signatures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26986v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26986

**作者：** Edisy Kin Wai Chan、Andersen Ang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26986v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.26986v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 dAGP：用正交多项式特征下的矩矩阵 G\_m(μ) 的小特征值方向刻画在分布上近似消失的低阶多项式关系，并按次数与容差统计得到双参数整数签名，同时给出其在 1-Wasserstein 距离下的 Lipschitz 稳定性与实验验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「小特征值即近似退化关系」的谱计数思路可能可供核查用于检测视觉 latent 分布沿深度或位置的低维坍缩与视觉信息丢失，但原文面向点云分布的几何签名，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Distributional Algebro-Geometric Persistence (dAGP): Wasserstein-Stable Polynomial-Relation Signatures

**abstract/A1：** A circle and a quartic superellipse have the same homology, but their defining equations have degrees two and four, respectively. We study this algebraic distinction for point-cloud distributions. For a probability measure $μ$ on $Ω=\[-1,1\]^d$ and an orthonormal polynomial feature map $φ\_m$ of degree $m$, the moment matrix $G\_m(μ)=\\mathbb{E}\_{X\\simμ}\[φ\_m(X)φ\_m(X)^\\top\]$ satisfies $c^\\top G\_m(μ)c=\\mathbb{E}\_μ\[f\_c(X)^2\]$, so coefficient directions associated with its small eigenvalues represent low-degree polynomials that nearly vanish on $μ$. Counting these near-relation directions across degree $m$ and the tolerance $\\varepsilon$ gives a two-parameter integer signature. We call this representation distributional algebro-geometric persistence (dAGP), the population counterpart of the point-cloud algebro-geometric persistence (AGP) construction. For empirical measures, dAGP is the sample-normalised counterpart of point-cloud AGP. We also show that $μ\\mapsto G\_m(μ)$ is Lipschitz in the $1$-Wasserstein distance, so its ordered eigenvalues vary Lipschitz-continuously under transport of mass, while its threshold counts remain unchanged under perturbations satisfying a spectral-margin condition. We give an explicit support-localised Lipschitz constant and identify the regime in which the resulting guarantee is informative. Experimentally, the population noise-floor prediction agrees with the finite-sample mean to $0.1\\%$, within sampling error. At a selected tolerance, relation onset orders the conic, quartic, and non-algebraic closed curves, while their count profiles distinguish them from the two-dimensional control. Calibration identifies an empirical tolerance range. A $100$-repetition sensitivity study quantifies onset recovery and shows that the count grid and two continuous spectral baselines nearly saturate the four-family discrimination task.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL)

</details>

### 577. [JevRisk: Zero-Shot Financial Risk Assessment with a Language Decision Model](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26999v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.26999

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JevRisk：先用代码依监管规则算出精确的金融风险指标，再由语言决策模型结合客户画像与活动记录做情境化判断，输出零样本风险评分，并在反洗钱与信用风险任务上评测。

**相关性简评：** 「先精确计算证据、再由语言模型情境化判断」的分解可供核查外部证据如何进入模型的推理状态并左右决策，其无标签的决策评价也可能启发 STOP/判定环节的评估；但领域与视觉推理距离较远，联系仅为类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JevRisk: Zero-Shot Financial Risk Assessment with a Language Decision Model

**abstract/A1：** Banks must monitor every customer's financial risk, such as money laundering and credit default, by interpreting financial activity in the context of the customer's profile. Existing risk monitoring systems of banks are mostly based on expert-designed risk indicators, which apply predefined thresholds to every customer and cannot adapt to their personal situations. Supervised models recognise risk patterns from labelled customers, but each label often needs an expert's review or months of repayment history, which is slow and costly. Financial risk assessment therefore calls for a zero-shot decision system that minimises the need for labels and generalises across customers and risk types. To this end, we present JevRisk, a system for zero-shot financial risk assessment with a language decision model. JevRisk works in two steps. First, following regulatory guidelines in the finance domain, JevRisk computes exact risk indicators with code. Second, the language decision model (e.g., \\jev{}) reads these indicators together with the customer's profile and activity, judges the case in context with broad world knowledge, and returns the score of high risk. We evaluate JevRisk on the anti-money laundering task with public synthetic data from Scotiabank and on the credit risk task with real data from Home Credit and Lending Club. On both tasks, JevRisk outperforms rule-based and unsupervised methods, and is on par with or better than supervised methods (e.g., GBDT and TabPFN) trained on about a thousand labelled customers.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 1 figure, 15 tables, including appendices

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MPAO，面向连续时间物理系统的多方案规划：采样满足边界条件、未经训练的神经网络生成轨迹，训练同分布网络共享的修正项，保存所有已验证方案，并依据已发现结果自适应采样，从而在给定预算内输出多个低成本且互相区分的方案。

**相关性简评：** 其「低成本加区分度阈值」的多假设保留、以新发现驱动再采样的 anytime 机制，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的多样性维持、候选证据筛选与动态计算/停止决策提供类比线索，尚需核查其标准能否对应推理状态而非仅轨迹空间。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Many Plans at Once: Diverse Top-Quality Planning in Continuous Time

**abstract/A1：** Planners for physical systems usually return a single trajectory, which leaves no alternative when an unmodeled constraint invalidates the chosen route or downstream preferences change. A set of plans computed in advance provides ready-made alternatives and warm-starts for fast adaptation, but only if the plans are both low-cost and mutually distinct. Discrete planning addresses this with top-quality and diverse planning, but these ideas do not transfer to continuous time, where every valid trajectory has infinitely many valid near-copies, and existing trajectory planners converge to one or a few solutions. We present Many Plans at Once (MPAO), which treats every plan it finds as a reason to search elsewhere: it samples untrained neural networks whose outputs meet the boundary conditions by construction, trains corrections shared by networks from the same distribution, stores every validated plan, and adapts its sampling to what it has found, which makes it anytime. We define the goal by bringing the cost bound of top-quality planning and the distinctness threshold of diverse planning to continuous time. Under equal budgets against five baselines, MPAO is the only method that solves all 40 instances across four domains. On contact-rich manipulation, it is the only method with plans within 25% of the best known cost on one task, and returns about ten times as many such plans as the strongest baseline on the other two.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Ruby 是小分子效价预测器，复用结构基础模型 Pearl 的中间表示且不要求每个化合物有显式结合构象，同时发布带溯源与审计标注的公开训练数据集，并在多个公开基准和零样本实验中取得领先。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其可调推理开销在两个数量级上权衡富集率与计算成本、并随累积实验数据再校准，可为 THINK/STOP 的计算分配与停止决策评价提供远距离类比，机制是否可迁移可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations

**abstract/A1：** Small-molecule drug discovery proceeds through repeated design-make-test-analyze cycles. The goal is often to maximize potency while keeping other properties within the ranges required for a viable therapeutic candidate. Compound prioritization places different demands on computational methods as drug discovery progresses from hit identification through hit-to-lead and lead optimization, with changing computational budgets and increasing amounts of on-target experimental data. We introduce Ruby, a Robust Universal Binding affinitY predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Ruby is trained on proprietary data plus GenesisPotency-2026, an audited public-source potency training dataset released for academic and commercial use under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license with row-level provenance and audit annotations. Ruby achieves the highest aggregate early enrichment across seven public hit-identification targets among evaluated methods, with adjustable inference effort trading off enrichment and computational cost over more than two orders of magnitude. Ruby achieves the highest average correlations across four public benchmarks: OpenFE, CASP16, FEP+ 4, and OpenBind. Ruby significantly outperforms other methods in zero-shot prediction across eight biochemical and cellular assays from five ongoing Genesis-Incyte programs, widening its performance advantage relative to the public benchmarks. Ruby continues to improve more than other methods when all are given the opportunity to recalibrate using earlier assay measurements. Together, these contributions provide an annotated training resource for the field and a state-of-the-art potency predictor for broad screening, prioritization within related chemical series, and assay-specific prediction as experimental measurements accumulate.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27018v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27018v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究用整数参数、两层隐藏层的 ReLU 网络精确表示最大值函数，给出六输入与七输入 max 的最小正整数输出倍数界，并借助整立方填充、同调障碍与有限构造证书刻画七输入问题的剩余困难。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其关于 ReLU 网络精确表示能力与不可绕过障碍的结论，可能可供核查「内部状态能否精确承载某类比较/选择型函数」这一表示容量问题，联系较远且未涉及推理动态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Integral Multipliers and Arithmetic Obstructions for Two-Hidden-Layer ReLU Maxima

**abstract/A1：** We study exact representations of maximum functions by ReLU networks with two hidden layers and integer parameters. The least positive output multiplier is two for the six-input maximum, and either two or six for the seven-input maximum. We obtain these bounds from integral cubical fillings and a coefficient-preserving passage from polytope identities to networks. For the coordinate-facet complex of the six-simplex, we compute a coning index of six over the integers and three after inverting two, allowing arbitrary integral directions within each facet. A class in the homology of the unrestricted kernel complex characterizes the remaining seven-input problem; its vanishing is equivalent to an integral filling of a fixed target. We also construct a finite character that separates rational from three-local representability in a dictionary containing two known constructions and all pairs of edge-disjoint three-edge forests. This obstruction permits nonsymmetric coefficients and is confined to the specified dictionary. Control of lower-dimensional remainders yields a sufficient criterion in the top-dimensional quotient. Exact certificates and verification programs accompany the finite calculations.

**comment/C1：** 22

</details>

### 581. [Mind World Models: Joint Learning of Motor EEG Representations and Action-Conditioned World Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27029v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27029

**作者：** Weikang Qiu、Zheng Huang、Tinglin Huang、Yujun Yan、Rex Ying

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27029v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27029v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Mind World Model，将当前帧之前的 EEG 视为世界模型的 latent action：由「心模型」编码 EEG 并预测未来帧的表示，从而在无动作标注的自然 EEG 与第一视角视频上做运动表征预训练，并引入侧化感知 Transformer 分离左右半球共享与特异特征；在 9 项分类和 7 项回归任务上评测运动解码与动作条件下的预测。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线关联较弱，但把生理信号当作 latent action、用「预测未来帧表示」作为监督目标的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的可学习性、状态监督与预测目标设计提供类比线索，可供核查其 latent 是否承载实际运动信息。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mind World Models: Joint Learning of Motor EEG Representations and Action-Conditioned World Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Motor decoding from electroencephalography (EEG) supports non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, yet existing methods either rely on costly cue-based trials and coarse categorical labels or use pretraining objectives that do not directly capture how movement unfolds, limiting their ability to learn transferable motor representations. To this end, we propose the Mind World Model (MWM), a framework that learns motor EEG representations from scalable naturalistic EEG and egocentric video without action annotations. MWM treats EEG observed up to the current frame as the latent action of a world model: a mind model encodes the EEG, and a world model uses it to predict the representation of a future frame, yielding a movement-grounded pretraining objective. We further introduce the Lateralization-Aware Transformer (LAT), which uses frame averaging to separate shared bilateral from side-specific lateral features, encoding hemispheric correspondence to reduce the burden of learning left-right relationships from data. MWM pretraining produces two models: a mind model for downstream motor decoding and a world model that can be adapted to prediction conditioned on real actions, opening a scalable and flexible path to collect egocentric data for embodied AI. Across 9 classification and 7 regression tasks, the mind model improves task-averaged balanced accuracy by 5.9% and Pearson correlation by 16.2% relative to the strongest baseline in each task family. Compared with an inverse-dynamics latent-action baseline, the world model achieves lower prediction error and benefits 3.3 times more from matched real actions within recordings and 4.7 times more on held-out subjects.

</details>

### 582. [Action-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27044v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27044

**作者：** Yutong Xia、Yangyou Liu、Yuxuan Liang、Yuankai Wu、See-Kiong Ng、Roger Zimmermann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27044v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27044v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PairST 基准，在交通、输电与配水网络上构造来自同一状态的配对参考／干预未来，以分别评估受影响区域精度与静默区域误响应；并提出 ActionST，在无干预参考预测上写入显式响应，由节点-时间寻址查询、状态条件响应写入器和图感知局部性门控共同决定响应强度。

**相关性简评：** 其反事实配对评价与「局部性门控的残差式状态写入」可能为 LVR 提供线索：如何判断 latent 状态是否因果地使用了视觉证据，以及如何限制证据注入的强度与范围；跨领域迁移尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Action-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** We study spatio-temporal forecasting in networked systems under specified actions. The challenge is to capture the action's effects without predicting spurious changes in unaffected regions. However, direct supervision and evaluation of these effects require paired futures with and without the action, whereas observational trajectories reveal only the realized future. We introduce PairST, a benchmark comprising six datasets across traffic, power transmission and water distribution, with paired reference and intervened futures simulated from the same system state. These pairs enable separate evaluation of affected-region forecast accuracy and quiet-region response error. We further propose ActionST, which forecasts the intervened future by writing an explicit response onto an intervention-independent reference forecast. Specifically, node-time addressing constructs a query for each response position, a state-conditioned response writer computes candidate responses, and a graph-aware locality gate controls their strength. Experiments on six datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ActionST at new action targets, with the lowest mean absolute error on five datasets and the best average rank. Our source code and the PairST benchmark are available at https://github.com/yutong-xia/ActionST.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 583. [Rethinking Cross-Sensor Domain Adaptation for Bridge Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27060v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27060

**作者：** Linghui Huang、Zipeng Wang、Shunjie Chen、Peng Guan、Jiandong Wang、Siqing Li、Luming Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文重新审视桥梁点云 TLS→MLS 跨传感器域适应协议，分析采样密度、表面粗糙度、颜色与采集视角在 8 cm 稀疏体素表示中的体现，并在不同训练轮次下比较自适应 BN、熵最小化、Mean Teacher 与置信度自训练的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其用受控输入扰动（如 4 mm 位移仅改变 4.4% 体素占用、颜色置零几乎无影响）来归因哪些视觉因素真正进入表示，并指出评测方差与多种方法增益相当，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留及增益贡献分配提供借鉴，但领域距离较远，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Cross-Sensor Domain Adaptation for Bridge Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Segmentation models for bridge point clouds lose accuracy when trained on terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) data and applied to mobile laser scanning (MLS) data. This study re-examines the SemanticBridge TLS-to-MLS protocol to determine how sampling density, surface roughness, color, and acquisition viewpoint are expressed in the 8-cm sparse-voxel representation, and how adaptation gains depend on source-model convergence. Using one sparse-convolution U-Net, we combine raw-point statistics with controlled input perturbations and compare adaptive batch normalization, entropy minimization, Mean Teacher, and confidence-filtered self-training under 100- and 300-epoch schedules. TLS and MLS have similar nearest-neighbor spacing after preprocessing (12.08 and 12.02 mm), and a 4-mm perturbation of TLS points changes voxel occupancy by only 4.4%. Color distributions differ systematically, but zeroing color on identical voxels changes target mean intersection over union (mIoU) by only +0.02, and by +0.06 after the color augmentation is scale-corrected. The sensors also observe different portions of the bridge, yielding different class proportions. A 300-epoch source-only model obtains 57.80 mIoU on the paired-bridge protocol. Confidence-filtered self-training improves the 100-epoch baseline, but from a converged model it changes target mIoU by -0.97 (source-selected checkpoints) and -2.44 (final-50-epoch means). Repeated evaluation (standard deviation 0.27-0.64) and seed variation (1.88 across three seeds) are comparable to several method differences. Adaptation results on this benchmark therefore depend on representation scale, source-model convergence, and evaluation variability.

</details>

### 584. [V2VFusion: Text-Controlled Video-to-Video Diffusion for Degradation-Aware Video Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27063v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27063

**作者：** Jiajun Chen、Han Xu、Yunfei Huang、Zhuoya Zhang、Guangcan Liu、Jiayi Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27063v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27063v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 V2VFusion，将多源退化视频融合重构为 latent 扩散空间中的视频到视频条件生成，并结合文本引导的退化条件 ControlNet 与状态调制的分层 MoE 处理复合退化、维持时序一致。

**相关性简评：** 其按扩散 latent 状态筛选专家并路由的机制，可能为 LVR 中依据内部推理状态动态选择计算或更新模块提供线索；但研究任务是视频融合与退化抑制，与视觉推理的证据使用和停止决策无直接联系，值得核查其状态表示是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** V2VFusion: Text-Controlled Video-to-Video Diffusion for Degradation-Aware Video Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Video fusion integrates complementary information in multiple source video streams into a single sequence for complete scene perception. Existing methods perform frame-wise fusion and lack unified spatio-temporal modeling across sequences, damaging temporal coherence across sequences. When dealing with degradations, they also ignore temporal dynamics and overload a single network with diverse degradations, leading to limited and imbalanced degradation suppression. To address these issues, we propose V2VFusion, the first unified video-to-video fusion framework that directly generates temporally coherent, high-quality fused videos from degraded multi-source inputs. By reformulating video fusion as a video-to-video conditional generation problem in latent diffusion space, our approach holistically models spatio-temporal dependencies across entire sequences and intrinsically ensures sequence-level consistency. On this basis, a text-guided degradation-conditioned ControlNet bridges high-level textual degradation descriptions with low-level visual priors, enabling interpretable and controllable guidance for structure-preserving fusion beyond purely data-driven conditioning. To handle heterogeneous and compound degradations, a state-modulated degradation-aware hierarchical mixture-of-experts module decouples expert selection into diffusion-state-aware filtering and degradation-aware routing. It prevents unreliable routing and fosters expert specialization to mitigate representation conflicts among diverse degradations. Experiments on infrared-visible, multi-exposure, and multi-focus video fusion tasks and complex degradations validate that V2VFusion surpasses existing methods in fusion quality and temporal stability. The code is available at https://github.com/ChenDoubleJ/V2VFusion.

</details>

### 585. [Online Learning for Minimizing Maximum Tardiness in Single-Machine Scheduling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27067v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27067

**作者：** Yiyang Chen、Kohei Hatano、Eiji Takimoto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27067v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27067v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究单机调度中最小化最大延迟（OMMT）的在线学习：每轮先选一个固定作业的排列，环境随后揭示处理时间与截止期，并以 α-regret 与最优固定排列比较；随机情形给出 FTL 的 regret 界与复杂度，对抗情形证明下界并用 FTPL 得到对 n 的对数级 α 依赖。

**相关性简评：** 其「每轮先决策、反馈事后到达、用 α-regret 对比最优固定策略」的在线学习框架，可能可供核查用于形式化 latent 推理中的动态计算分配与停止策略及其评价，但与原论文问题相距较远，需较多迁移判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Online Learning for Minimizing Maximum Tardiness in Single-Machine Scheduling

**abstract/A1：** We study online learning for minimizing maximum tardiness (\\OMMT) in single-machine scheduling. In each round, the learner selects a permutation of \\(n\\) fixed jobs, representing a schedule. The environment then reveals a processing time and a due date for each job, and the learner incurs a vector-valued loss whose components correspond to the tardiness of the individual jobs. The goal of the learner is to minimize \\(α\\)-regret, the difference between the learner's maximum cumulative tardiness and \\(α\\) times that of the best fixed permutation in hindsight, for as small \\(α\\) as possible. We investigate OMMT under both stochastic and adversarial environments. In the stochastic setting, we prove that the expected \\(1\\)-regret of the Follow-the-Leader (FTL) algorithm is \\( O\\!\\left(\\frac{n\\log n}{Δ^2}\\right) \\), together with a corresponding high-probability bound, where \\(Δ\\) is a distribution-dependent gap parameter. At round \\(t \\in \\{1,\\dots,T\\}\\), FTL runs in \\(O(tn^2)\\) time and \\(O(tn)\\) space. In the adversarial setting, we prove that, for any \\(0&lt;c&lt;\\log\_2 n/16\\), the \\(α\\)-regret is \\(Ω(T)\\) whenever \\(α&lt;\\log\_2 n/16-c\\). We then reduce OMMT to a surrogate online learning problem and apply Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL), obtaining an expected \\(α\\)-regret bound of \\(O(n^2\\sqrt{T})\\) for \\(α=O(\\log n)\\). Thus, the logarithmic dependence of \\(α\\) on \\(n\\) is tight up to constant factors. Each FTPL update admits a mixed-integer programming formulation whose size is polynomial in \\(n\\) and \\(t\\).

**comment/C1：** Appears in the Proceedings of the 52nd International Conference on Current Trends in Theory and Practice of Computer Science (Sofsem 2027)

</details>

**作者：** David Madras、Zi Wang、Marco Andreetto、Ken Burke、Caroline Pantofaru、Utsav Prabhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27104v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27104v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把大生成模型中的行为发现形式化为一类问题，强调需控制误发现率（FDR），并提出 DISCO：基于 coarsened e-processes 的迭代搜索方法，在温和条件下可证明控制 FDR，且通过适应数据依赖的假设数量提升检验功效，在合成数据与「模型既是发现引擎又是对象」的实证设定中验证。

**相关性简评：** 其多重假设检验与 FDR 控制框架可能为 LVR 中大量候选 latent 假设、视觉证据筛选的可靠性提供统计表述，可供核查在假设数自适应且数据依赖时如何约束误发现，但与 VLM 推理内部状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reliable Behavior Discovery via False Discovery Rate Control

**abstract/A1：** Reliable methods for discovering behavior patterns in large generative models are increasingly essential as models become both more complex and capable. We formalize behavior discovery as a problem class of interest and highlight the task of controlling false discovery rate (FDR) as crucial for guaranteeing reliability in behavior discovery. Building upon the multiple hypothesis testing literature, we propose DISCO (Discovery through Iterative Search with COarsened $e$-processes), a method which provably controls FDR in behavior discovery under mild conditions. DISCO improves power over previous related eBH-based approaches by allowing for adaptivity to a data-dependent number of hypotheses to be tested. We demonstrate empirically that DISCO controls FDR with higher power than comparable approaches on both synthetic data and a novel empirical evaluation of FDR-controlling methods in settings where large generative models act as both discovery engines and targets. Code is available at https://github.com/google-deepmind/disco .

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27110v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27110v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RemoteEvolver：在基座模型参数固定的前提下，用一个外部 harness 依据执行反馈演化遥感智能体的工具与工作流，按需获取缺失工具并把已验证的执行经验蒸馏为可跨任务复用的技能，从而在后续任务中共同支撑规划与执行。

**相关性简评：** 其「识别能力缺口—按需调用工具—验证后沉淀技能」的循环，或可为 LVR 中何时补充视觉证据、如何复用成功轨迹提供问题表述上的启发；但该方法停留在 harness 层，不涉及 latent 状态表示与生成，借鉴价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RemoteEvolver: Expanding Earth Observation Capabilities through Agent Harness Evolution

**abstract/A1：** We are interested in developing a continually self-improving remote sensing agentic system. It should identify and address its capability gaps, retaining the resulting improvements to enhance performance on subsequent tasks. However, existing systems typically rely on fixed toolsets and confine their experience accumulation to re-orchestrating predefined capabilities, constraining both capability expansion and the transfer of improvements across tasks. As the infrastructure for agentic systems, the harness manages tools and workflow knowledge as editable, persistent resources outside the base model. These resources can therefore be updated and reused across tasks without additional post-training. Based on these observations, we propose RemoteEvolver, an external harness for remote sensing agents that drives tool and workflow evolution through execution feedback. With the base model parameters fixed, RemoteEvolver acquires missing specialized tools on demand and distills verified successful execution experience from individual tasks into agent skills that can be reused across tasks. The acquired tools and accumulated skills jointly support planning and execution on subsequent tasks. Experiments on Earth-Bench and OpenEarthAgent-Bench show that RemoteEvolver achieves average accuracy gains of 8.18 and 23.86 percentage points over its initial state when tools are fully available and partially missing. Under the same settings, it also outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by an average of 6.77 and 17.10 percentage points, respectively.

</details>

### 588. [CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27116

**作者：** Chuan Xiao、Baojie Wang、Haizhao Fan、Hongzhe Du、Xander Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27116v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CoEvoBench：让 LLM 充当研究者，在 24 小时预算内联合改进目标 agent 的模型与 harness，并在独立测试任务上评分以考察五个 agentic 领域的递归协同演化能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「两个相互耦合的组件中该改哪一方」的评测设定，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据获取、latent 推理与停止决策之间的贡献分配问题类比，可供核查；但与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?

**abstract/A1：** The performance of an LLM agent depends on both its model and its harness, the code that mediates its interaction with tools and environments. Can LLM researchers drive this co-evolution as a recursive improvement process, deciding round after round which component to change when each change alters the value of the other? Existing benchmarks evaluate post-training or data research with the harness out of scope, or harness optimization with the model fixed, leaving this joint decision unmeasured. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs as researchers co-evolving the model and harness of a target agent across five agentic domains. Researchers start from a common base model and initial harness, train and revise within a 24-hour budget, and submit a model-harness pair that is scored on separate test tasks. Across five frontier researchers, the strongest closes more than four fifths of the gap to an instruction-tuned reference system, and co-evolution succeeds on interaction tasks but rarely on long-horizon coding. These results suggest that current LLMs can make a strong first improvement, but cannot yet turn feedback from an improved system into the next one. CoEvoBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring the research capabilities that recursive co-evolution requires.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/CoEvoBench

</details>

### 589. [Portable Active Recovery under Timed and Position-Dependent Visual Outages](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27121v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27121

**作者：** Jinyuan Zhang、Shengshuo Jiao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27121v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27121v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把四旋翼在视觉中断后的恢复建模为最坏条件下的主动可观测性问题，在无外部定位的立体视觉惯性平台上提出零重训的可插拔恢复模块，协调视觉丢失检测、限 jerk 制动、有界后退探测、稳定回归与高度积分微调，并在 1,920 次飞行的预注册基准上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是仅凭观测“悬停等待还是主动移动以重新获取视觉证据”，与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益判断、证据可获取性区分可能有概念联系，可供核查；但属机器人控制，不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Portable Active Recovery under Timed and Position-Dependent Visual Outages

**abstract/A1：** When a camera blackout depends on physical position rather than elapsed time, stable hovering prevents visual recovery and mission completion. On stereo visual-inertial quadrotors without external localization, an exogenous timed blackout and an endogenous position-dependent dark zone appear identical at loss onset yet require opposite responses: hover-and-wait completes 93/96 timed blackouts but 0/96 spatial outages (13 hard failures), whereas blind continuation traverses many spatial zones yet fails heavily during timed blackouts. We formulate visual-outage recovery as a worst-condition active-observability problem and introduce a portable recovery module at the reference interface of an unchanged host controller with zero retraining. Using deployable telemetry alone, the module coordinates visual-loss detection, jerk-limited braking, bounded backward probing, settled rejoining, height-integral trim, and an optional gated prior-map branch. On a preregistered 48-scene benchmark (1,920 flights), our full MPPI configuration reaches 88.5% \[81.2, 94.8\] worst-condition completion, outperforming development-selected DATT-L1 by +29.2 pp \[17.7, 40.6\] and exceeding all six external baselines after Bonferroni correction. Attached without retraining to SimpleFlight, the module lifts worst-condition completion by +17.7 pp \[7.3, 28.1\] to 86.5% (and 90% across 1.0x/1.25x speeds, 0/80 hard failures). Trace diagnostics reveal that survival hinges on visual-inertial re-acquisition asymmetry at vision return -- not blind IMU drift suppression - and uncover a bias-drift map crossover confirmed on 72 held-out EuRoC windows.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 590. [TrajRealm: A Large-Scale Point Tracking Dataset with Diverse Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27136v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27136

**作者：** Ni Yang、Weiguang Zhao、Jiafei Cao、Yankai Jiang、Haoyu Guo、Tao Yang、Chunhua Shen、Junting Dong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27136v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27136v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TrajRealm 构建了首个达到千万帧规模的公开合成点跟踪数据集，融合游戏与具身仿真环境，提供 RGB、深度、相机参数以及持续的 2D/3D 点轨迹，并配套含 Interaction 与 Locomotion 八个子类的基准来评测现有跟踪器。

**相关性简评：** 其长时点对应与几何一致的 3D 轨迹标注可能为 LVR 中跨帧保持视觉证据、维护持久视觉状态这类问题提供训练或评价线索，但能否与多模态推理状态耦合仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TrajRealm: A Large-Scale Point Tracking Dataset with Diverse Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** General-purpose point tracking requires large-scale training data with diverse dynamics, yet existing datasets struggle to combine rich dynamic content, accurate scene geometry, and sufficient scale. We introduce TrajRealm, the first public synthetic point-tracking dataset to reach the ten-million-frame scale, constructed from games and embodied simulations. TrajRealm uses the rich environments and motion systems of modern games to capture diverse targets, activities, and interactions across diverse worlds, while embodied simulations add robot manipulation and indoor navigation data. The dataset provides RGB observations, depth, camera parameters, and persistent 2D and 3D point trajectories. These annotations provide precise, geometrically consistent supervision across foreground objects and static environmental surfaces. We also build TrajRealm-Bench with eight subcategories under Interaction and Locomotion to evaluate tracking across diverse scenes. Benchmark evaluations reveal the strengths and limitations of existing trackers in handling complex motion and maintaining long-term point correspondences. Training on TrajRealm improves the performance of existing tracking methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 5 figures. Project page: https://purplehihi.github.io/TrajRealm/

</details>
