### 627. [Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27811v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27811

**作者：** Michael W. Spratling、Heiko H. Schütt

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27811v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27811v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以皮层简单细胞／复杂细胞交替层级为蓝本的浅层网络（少于十对层），用新的选择性—容错表示组件做图像分类，在未知类与纯噪声上给出低置信预测，使对抗样本可被识别，同时保持有竞争力的泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其「不为不存在物体给出高置信判断」的行为，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据是否支持答案、弃答与停止决策的评价提供线索，可供核查低置信度能否作为无证据信号；但该文是纯视觉分类架构，无多模态 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks

**abstract/A1：** Early deep learning models attempted to simulate visual perception using a neural hierarchy that alternated between two types of layer: one modelled on cortical simple cells (that was designed to increase selectivity), and one modelled on cortical complex cells (that aimed to increase tolerance). We show that such a neural network (NN) architecture, when implemented with novel components that are better able to learn selective and tolerant representations, is capable of accurate and robust image classification and improved alignment between the behaviour of the model and the perceptual abilities of humans. Firstly, the proposed models are shallow, fewer than ten layer-pairs, which is more consistent with the rapid feedforward object categorisation performed by the biological visual system. Secondly, they are far less prone to producing classification predictions with high confidence for samples from unknown classes or for image consisting of pure noise, and hence, like humans are not easily fooled into perceiving objects that are not present in the image. Thirdly, for the proposed NNs adversarial samples cause predictions with low confidence, enabling them to be accurately identified. In contrast to humans, our networks still do not correctly classify adversarial samples. However, the behaviour of our networks is a significant step towards human-like behaviour compared to standard DNNs that produce highly confident, but incorrect, classification predictions for adversarial samples. The increased robustness to adversarial and unknown samples is achieved while maintaining competitive performance in terms of generalisation to novel samples from the training categories. This enables models of this type to be competitive with state-of-the-art DNNs across multiple different evaluation metrics and benchmark tasks.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://codeberg.org/mwspratling/STEAL/

</details>

### 628. [Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27835v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27835

**作者：** Samarth Sarin、Lovepreet Singh、Dhagash Mehta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27835v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27835v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 schema 驱动的流程，用 LLM 分阶段从金融文档抽取实体、量化观察与关系，经实体归并和时间约束构建带来源信息的知识图谱，并给出与下游检索解耦的内在质量评估框架。

**相关性简评：** 其「独立于下游任务的内在质量评估」与细粒度 provenance、冲突属性管理等思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的可审计性与视觉证据溯源筛选提供评价类比，但仅为概念层面线索，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Financial documents combine narrative disclosures, accounting metrics, corporate structures, management commentary, and time-dependent facts, making them difficult to represent using conventional chunk-based retrieval-augmented generation systems. This paper presents an auditable, schema-driven methodology for constructing temporal financial knowledge graphs from page-delimited documents parsed using a general purpose document intelligence service. Overlapping document windows undergo phased large language model extraction of structural entities, quantitative observations, and domain-specific relationships. Candidate graph elements are validated against predefined schemas and consolidated through scope-aware exact, normalized, fuzzy, embedding-based, and LLM-assisted entity resolution. Temporal merge constraints, deterministic edge deduplication, conflict-aware property management, and fine-grained provenance preserve issuer identity, reporting-period validity, and traceability to source evidence. The contributions of this work comprise the proposed methodology for financial knowledge graph construction, the creation of an evidence-grounded temporal knowledge graph from heterogeneous financial documents, and an intrinsic framework for evaluating the quality of the resulting graph. The evaluation framework assesses seven weighted dimensions, two hard validation gates, and structural diagnostics. By separating graph-quality assessment from downstream retrieval and answer generation, the framework supports systematic diagnosis and iterative refinement of the constructed graph.

**comment/C1：** The paper was accepted in ICAIF Conference 2026 and presented in Milan, Italy

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 发布 OpenAHBU 开源人脸行为理解工具箱，覆盖 11 项功能（landmarks、blendshape、AU、表情、效价/唤醒、疼痛、抑郁与人格），多数功能在聚合多数据集语料上重训，并用 SMTE 模块借助相关支持任务的预测增强各功能。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身是人脸情感感知工具箱而非 VLM 推理，但 SMTE 按功能自适应借用支持任务预测的做法，可能为 latent 推理中多源视觉证据加权与假设组合提供可供核查的线索。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OpenAHBU: Open-sourced Automatic Human Behaviour Understanding Toolkit Through Facial Behaviour Analysis

**abstract/A1：** Automatic facial behaviour understanding (AFBU) is fundamental to various human-centred applications, yet existing academically available toolkits offer limited functionality, closed training pipelines, and weak generalisation. This paper presents OpenAHBU, a fully open-sourced, generalisable toolkit integrating 11 AFBU functions across three semantic levels: (i) short-term external facial attributes, including landmarks, blendshapes, Action Units, and expressions; (ii) short-term facial behaviour-related human psychological states, including valence/arousal and pain; and (iii) long-term facial behaviour-related psychological traits, including depression and personality. Particularly, we re-developed eight functions, where at least four deep learning models covering different computational complexities are developed for each function, providing flexible deployment on resource-constrained and high-throughput computing scenarios. More importantly, models of most functions are trained on a comprehensive corpus aggregating multiple academically available datasets, ensuring robust cross-dataset generalisability.In addition, we include a Synergistic Multi-task Enhancement (SMTE) module to efficiently and adaptively enhance each OpenAHBU function by leveraging the complementary cues contained in its most-related support function's predictions.Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our OpenAHBU outperformed existing open-source toolkits not only in functional coverage but also the predictive performances, while providing superior deployment flexibility across diverse computational scenarios.With fully publicly available training and inference scripts, pre-trained weights, user-friendly GUI, Python library, and cross-platform compatibility, our OpenAHBU provides a reproducible, scalable and extensible toolkit at https://github.com/OpenAHBU/OpenAHBU.

### 630. [SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27865v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27865

**作者：** Arshia Rafieioskouie、Matthew Lucas、Tzu-Han Hsu、Borzoo Bonakdarpour

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27865v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27865v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SLICR，用 Strategy Logic 配合 LTL 描述多智能体目标与约束，并将其转化为奖励塑形，使部分可观测对抗环境下的强化学习能够显式推理各智能体策略及其相互应对方式，并在 Predator-Prey、Google Research Football 与扩展 SMAC-HARD 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「对其他智能体策略的显式量化与响应」可能为 LVR 中把关于他人策略与部分观测证据的信念写入 latent 状态、并据此决定继续获取证据或停止提供概念参照，但需核查其表示是否真为内部状态而非仅奖励工程。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Specification-guided reinforcement learning (RL) translates formal specifications of desired behavior of agents into shaped rewards. This paper introduces SLICR, a significant paradigm shift that advances the state of the art to specification-guided RL in adversarial settings under partial observability. We employ Strategy Logic (SL), which allows explicit quantification over agents' strategies and uses the linear temporal logic (LTL) to specify the agents' objectives and constraints. This enables reasoning not only about how agents should act to satisfy a specification, but also about how they should respond to the strategies and behaviors of other agents. We evaluate SLICR on three popular benchmarks: Predator-Prey, Google Research Football, and our home-grown extension of SMAC-HARD, demonstrating its effectiveness, scalability, and ability to adapt to diverse adversarial strategies.

</details>

### 631. [From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27875v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27875

**作者：** Luca Saglietti、Luca Giammanco、Marc Mezard、Chiara Plizzari、Luca Biggio

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27875v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27875v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「记住单张图像」当作控制问题：用学习到的条件信号驱动冻结扩散模型逼近目标图，并追踪训练中记忆从保留语义主干（gist）、外观多样，逐步收敛到精确复现（verbatim），发现抽象阶段更接近文本条件且更利于编辑、单样本识别与检索。

**相关性简评：** 其「哪些细节必须存储、哪些可交给生成先验补全」的 gist/verbatim 划分及记忆作为相关性结构探针的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 状态里的保留程度与视觉旁路重建提供概念参照；但属图像生成与记忆场景，与推理期状态生成的迁移可行性需要核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior

**abstract/A1：** Modern generative models are typically studied for their ability to generalize, while memorization is treated as a failure mode. We invert this perspective and ask how a generative model can recall a single datum. We frame memorization as a control problem: a learned conditioning signal steers a frozen diffusion model toward a target image, and we follow the formation of this memory throughout training. Before converging to exact reproduction (verbatim), memory passes through a regime of abstraction: samples preserve the target's semantic content (gist) while remaining diverse in appearance, leaving predictable detail to the generative prior. This semantic organization emerges despite the absence of labels, captions, or any explicit semantic objective. In the abstraction regime, the learned memory approaches ordinary text conditioning and supports editing, one-shot recognition, and retrieval more effectively than in the near-perfect reconstruction regime. These results suggest that memorization can serve as a probe of the relevance structure encoded by a generative model: what must be stored about a datum, what can be reconstructed from prior knowledge, and how learned memories interpolate between reconstructive recall and literal data storage.

</details>

<a id="paper-632"></a>

### 632. [Renormalized Entropy from Symmetries: Simplicity Bias and Neural Heat Death](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27889v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27889

**作者：** Vasco Portilheiro、Samuel Liebana、Andrew Saxe、Peter Orbanz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27889v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27889v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从参数对称性出发，在 Gaussian 正则下的 Langevin 动力学中取零正则极限并引入重整化，推导出一种新的熵，用以刻画对称性诱导的隐式偏置：线性网络偏好奇异、低秩函数，齐次激活网络偏好失活神经元，并可能出现输出趋零的「神经热死亡」平衡。

**相关性简评：** 其函数空间熵与平衡态集中于退化解的结论，或可作为解释 latent reasoning 中表示坍缩、latent 更新失效与信息消失的概念工具，但论文无多模态或推理实验，联系仅为概念层面，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Renormalized Entropy from Symmetries: Simplicity Bias and Neural Heat Death

**abstract/A1：** Neural networks have parameter symmetries: parameter transformations that do not affect the represented function. How do these symmetries affect the functions that neural networks ultimately learn? We study the implicit bias arising from these symmetries by calculating the equilibrium distribution over represented functions under Langevin dynamics with Gaussian regularization. To isolate the effect of symmetries on this distribution, we study the limit in which the strength of the regularization is taken to zero. In certain cases, we show that the zero-regularization and infinite-time limits commute. In the low temperature limit, we recover known effective regularizations. At positive temperature, a renormalization procedure allows us to derive a novel entropy which predicts symmetry-induced preference for certain functions. For linear networks, we obtain explicit entropy terms that favor singular and low-rank functions. For networks with homogeneous activations, we find entropy terms that favor inactive neurons, which can lead to neural "heat death" in which equilibrium mass concentrates on networks with vanishing output. We interpret these results through the neural tangent kernel, as a simplicity bias selecting for functions that vary slowly under variations in the parameters.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 14 figures (including appendices)

</details>

### 633. [Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27891

**作者：** Guanning Zeng、Andrea Zanette

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27891v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DICE：在投机解码中预先采样并与验证阶段同步随机数，使 drafter 结合已知采样结果，把候选树构建与异步预取的计算集中到当前采样运行更可能采用的续写上，从而提升解码吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 其「用受限草稿计算预判目标路径并定向分配计算」的构想，可能与 LVR 中动态计算预算、候选分支筛选及预测式预取有概念联系，但对象是 token 级加速而非推理状态，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow. Anticipating this path involves two sources of uncertainty: the target model's predictions and the randomness of sampling. Yet the former requires a target-model forward pass, while the latter can be fixed before drafting. Building on this observation, we introduce DICE (Draw-Informed Candidate Selection), which pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification. By combining these known draws with predictions from an existing drafter, DICE allocates computation toward continuations more likely to be used in the current sampling run. This principle guides node selection throughout draft-tree construction and extends to asynchronous prefetching, where DICE predicts which next-round drafts to prepare. Without additional drafter training or changes to the target sampling distribution, DICE achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput across diverse settings, with speedups of up to 24.6pp over strong baselines.

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

### 634. [Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27913v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27913

**作者：** Erik Großkopf、Paula Tamara Buzduga、Hendrik Möller、Florian Kofler

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27913v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27913v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 StarPQ 评价框架：在预测与参考实例的二分图中构造 star forest，将 clean、merge、split 三类失败模式分离，再按模式分别加权，使参考标注有偏时也能有针对性地评估全景分割质量。

**相关性简评：** 其将实例匹配失败分解为合并／分裂并分项加权的诊断思路，可能可供核查于刻画 latent 视觉状态中实体被合并、拆分或信息坍缩的情形；但原文仅为分割评测指标，未涉及推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances

**abstract/A1：** Detecting individual instances is crucial for many segmentation problems. However, expert instance annotations are often unavailable, so instances are approximated heuristically (e.g., as connected components of semantic maps), which can merge touching objects or split fragmented ones. Even when expert annotations exist, expert disagreement or structural delineation biases can yield split or merged reference instances, corresponding to over- or under-segmentation, respectively. Panoptic Quality (PQ) and related metrics capture both segmentation and detection quality while weighting all instances equally, regardless of size. Yet when the references are biased, these metrics can neither detect split or merged instances nor distinguish valid from invalid overor under-segmentation. We present Star Panoptic Quality (StarPQ), a novel evaluation ramework, which closes this gap in two steps: First, we construct a so-called star forest in the bipartite graph whose clean, merge, and split stars isolate different failure modes. Second, we calculate the final metric by individually weighting each failure mode, allowing practitioners to account for instance delineation biases. Across various experiments, we demonstrate that StarPQ not only enables targeted penalization or eniency towards specific failure modes, but also serves as a diagnostic tool to reveal their prevalence.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 7 figures

</details>

<a id="paper-635"></a>

### 635. [SUAF: Spectral Universal Advantage Features for Zero-Shot Policy Improvement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27919v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27919

**作者：** Huaze Tang、Runqing Miao、Tianren Peng、Lam Nguyen、Chao Wang、Jairong Li、Wenbo Ding

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27919v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27919v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究无奖励表示应捕获何种统计依赖、保留哪些成分才能改进策略，构造以动作为中心的正滞后典型依赖矩阵，并用其 SVD 得到成对谱优势特征（SUAF），配合 Soft-HGR 目标从无奖励数据中学习。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「保留前几个谱模态可得最优秩约束近似、丢弃其余成分如何影响决策」的分析，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态该保留哪些任务必要信息、以及信息坍缩的诊断与筛选相关，但面向 RL 表示而非视觉推理，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SUAF: Spectral Universal Advantage Features for Zero-Shot Policy Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Reward-independent representations enable reinforcement learning agents to reuse knowledge across tasks, but limited representation capacity raises three fundamental questions: what statistical dependence should these representations capture, which components of that dependence should be retained for policy improvement, and how does discarding the remaining components affect decision-making? We address these questions through canonical dependence analysis. For a reference policy, we construct an action-centered, positive-lag canonical dependence matrix (CDM) that isolates the additional predictive contribution of the current action beyond the current state. Its singular value decomposition yields Spectral Universal Advantage Features (SUAF), paired features that recover delayed advantage through linear reward projections. We show that the spectrum quantifies mutual information between current action and future state-action visitation conditioned on current state and determines reward specific approximation errors. Retaining the leading modes gives optimal rank-constrained approximations under both isotropic average-case and reward-uniform minimax criteria. Separating the immediate reward contrast also avoids the spectral floor arising from direct compression of the full advantage operator. To learn SUAF from reward-free data, we develop an action-centered Soft-HGR objective with bidirectional temporal-difference estimation. We further connect spectral approximation errors to sufficient conditions for policy improvement. Finite-state experiments validate the spectral predictions and feature-learning method, while zero-shot evaluations on discrete tasks and continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the utility of the learned representations across rewards.

</details>

### 636. [ESSI: Computationally Efficient Semantic Search for Sparse Autoencoder Concepts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27921v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27921

**作者：** James Baker

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27921v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27921v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ESSI 面向扩散模型 SAE 特征定位，用分割掩码标注 SDXL 激活，对 SAE 特征排序并二分搜索仍可线性分离概念的最小特征集，再复用该分类器校准 steering 强度，并在概念插入与物体遗忘上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「概念到特征」的搜索与最小充分特征集验证，可能为 LVR 中 latent 假设筛选和视觉证据选择提供方法线索；但研究对象是图像生成 steering 而非推理状态，线性可分判据能否迁移尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ESSI: Computationally Efficient Semantic Search for Sparse Autoencoder Concepts

**abstract/A1：** Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose diffusion model activations into interpretable features, but steering a model with them requires identifying which features map to a given semantic concept, if any. Existing methods for this concept to feature task are expensive, relying on grid searches or repeated passes through the frozen UNet. We propose Efficient Semantic Sparse Identification (ESSI). Using segmentation masks to label SDXL activations as concept or non-concept, ESSI ranks SAE features and binary-searches for the smallest set on which a linear classifier still separates positive from negative samples while not falling below a performance threshold, then reuses that classifier to calibrate the steering strength. We evaluate the same selected features on both concept insertion and object unlearning. Compared with prior work, ESSI is as cheap or cheaper, and performs well on both insertion and removal.

</details>

### 637. [The Optimal Sample Complexity of Agnostic PAC Learning for Partial Concept Classes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27946v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27946

**作者：** Liang-Yu Zou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27946v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27946v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究有限 VC 维部分概念类（取值含「⋆」即未定义）在 agnostic PAC 框架下的学习问题，构造确定性学习器并给出与已知下界吻合的最优样本复杂度 O((d+log(1/δ))/ε²)。

**相关性简评：** 「部分概念」与必须输出全定义假设的设定，可能为 LVR 中「latent 状态仅部分确定答案、需要据缺失证据给出总答案」的监督量与泛化分析提供概念化工具，可供核查其是否映射到视觉证据缺失或 STOP 决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Optimal Sample Complexity of Agnostic PAC Learning for Partial Concept Classes

**abstract/A1：** Let $\\mathcal H\\subseteq\\{-1,+1,\\star\\}^{\\mathcal X}$ be a partial concept class of finite VC dimension $d$. We construct a deterministic agnostic PAC learner that, for every $\\varepsilon,δ\\in(0,1)$, uses $O((d+\\log(1/δ))/\\varepsilon^2)$ i.i.d. examples from an arbitrary distribution $\\mathcal D$ over $\\mathcal X\\times\\{-1,+1\\}$ and returns a total concept $\\hat h:\\mathcal X\\to\\{-1,+1\\}$ satisfying $\\text{er}\_{\\mathcal D}(\\hat h)\\leq \\min\_{h\\in\\mathcal H}\\text{er}\_{\\mathcal D}(h)+\\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-δ$, where $\\text{er}\_{\\mathcal D}(h)=\\mathbb P\_{(x,y)\\sim\\mathcal D}\[h(x)\\neq y\]$. This establishes the optimal sample complexity, matching the lower bound of Alon et al. (FOCS 2021).

</details>

### 638. [Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27959v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27959

**作者：** Mamoona Tasadduq、Maryam Bashir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27959v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27959v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 RPC 框架，用进化优化挑选一个小规模 coreset，使子集上评估超参数配置的相对排序与全量数据排序的 Spearman 相关性最大化，从而加速 GA、CHC、PSO 的演化式超参搜索。

**相关性简评：** 「以保持配置排序为目标选择数据子集」可能为视觉证据筛选提供一条线索：核查能否用「保留候选间相对优劣」作为筛选 latent 视觉 token 或证据的指标，而非仅保留绝对正确性；其进化搜索子集的做法也可供参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is essential for high predictive performance, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when candidate configurations require repeated training on large datasets. This paper proposes a ranking-preserving coreset (RPC) selection framework for accelerating evolutionary HPO. The method constructs a compact coreset that preserves the relative ranking of hyperparameter configurations observed on the full training data. Coreset selection is formulated as an evolutionary optimization problem that maximizes Spearman rank correlation between full-data and subset-based configuration rankings while penalizing subset size. The selected coreset is then used for HPO with three evolutionary algorithms: Genetic Algorithm (GA), Cross-generational elitist Selection, Heterogeneous Recombination and Cataclysmic Mutation (CHC), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Experiments on seven tabular, two text, and two image benchmark datasets show that RPC substantially reduces HPO time while maintaining test accuracy comparable to full-dataset HPO across decision tree, text classification, and image classification tasks. Across datasets and optimizers, HPO-stage speedups range from approximately 1.14x to 8.80x, while the one-time coreset construction cost is accounted for separately through end-to-end runtime and break-even analysis. On 20 held-out configurations excluded from coreset construction, RPC achieves higher ranking correlation than same-size random sampling on 8 of 11 datasets (dataset-level Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p = 0.014). These results show that ranking preservation extends beyond the configurations used during selection. The one-time construction cost can be amortized when the coreset is reused across HPO runs.

</details>

### 639. [A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&amp;P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27978v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.27978

**作者：** Hari Sitaula、Joseph Opitz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.27978v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.27978v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在统一的预处理与时间序评估流程下，对线性回归、RNN 与 LSTM 的标普 500 单日预测进行基准比较，并审计三类会抬高结果的做法：小波去噪后的评估目标、缺少朴素持续性基线、以及 best-of-N 重复报告，随后在修正协议下重评各模型。

**相关性简评：** 金融时序本身与 LVR 无关，但其「朴素基线缺失、多重重复取最优、评估目标被预处理污染」的审计框架可能可供核查 latent 推理收益是否只是基线或挑选偏差所致。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&amp;P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning

**abstract/A1：** This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&amp;P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. We benchmark three model families, namely linear regression, vanilla recurrent neural networks (RNN), and long short-term memory networks (LSTM), within a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline. A central contribution of this work is a methodological audit of common practices in the deep-learning-for-stock-prediction literature. We identify three sources of result inflation that frequently appear in published methodologies: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, the absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. We then re-evaluate all model families under a corrected protocol that controls for each. Performance is reported using root mean squared error, mean absolute percentage error, and the Pearson correlation coefficient, averaged across N = 30 independent replicates per configuration. We compare models on accuracy, stability across replicates, and architectural depth sensitivity, using the naive persistence forecast (predicting today's close as tomorrow's close) as a primary baseline against which all candidate models must demonstrate improvement.

</details>

### 640. [Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28077v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28077

**作者：** Dharini Raghavan、Amritpal Singh、Anant Madabhushi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28077v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28077v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张 diffusion/flow 医学图像生成的公平性评估应把采样过程（步数、调度、求解器）视为被评估系统的一部分，给出两组在精确动力学与参考采样器下输出相同、但换用其他采样器后临床任务误差不同的数学例子，并用年龄条件生成模型的探索性实验说明采样步数与时机可改变图像衍生测量。

**相关性简评：** 其「采样路径与中间生成状态决定下游测量」的论证，可能为 LVR 中迭代 latent 状态更新、计算量分配与停止决策的评价提供概念线索，但论文面向公平性而非推理，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging

**abstract/A1：** Medical image generation models are often evaluated using images produced by a single sampling procedure. However, diffusion and flow models can use different numbers of sampling steps, sampling schedules, or numerical solvers without changing their trained parameters. These changes may affect the generated images and the clinical measurements derived from them. We argue that fairness results obtained under one sampling procedure should not be assumed to hold under another, particularly when changes in sampling affect clinical task errors differently across patient groups. Building on previous work on medical image quality, accelerated sampling, generation dynamics, and generative model fairness, we examine why the sampling procedure should be considered part of the evaluated system. We define subgroup differences in clinical task error across sampling procedures and provide a mathematical example showing that two groups can have identical outputs under the exact dynamics and a reference sampler but different errors under an alternative sampler. We also extend this result to stochastic generation under shared noise. An exploratory experiment with an age-conditioned image generation model illustrates how changing the number and timing of sampling steps can alter image-derived measurements, although these differences do not establish clinical unfairness. We therefore argue that fairness evaluation should assess the sampling procedure used in practice and examine intermediate generation states when they help explain differences in clinically relevant errors across patient groups. Analysis code is available here https://github.com/rdharini2001/generation-path-fairness

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop Position Paper Track

</details>

### 641. [Multimodal Violence Understanding and Temporal Retrieval in Movies with Adaptive Audio-Visual Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28080v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28080

**作者：** Jiaqian Li、Rohitash Chandra

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向电影与流媒体中的暴力内容检测，用预训练视觉与音频特征经注意力自适应融合和 Transformer 时序建模，联合完成暴力严重程度分类、多标签类型预测与时间定位，并在 XD-Violence 与 AIRTLab 上评测及做跨域分析。

**相关性简评：** 其音视频自适应融合与长视频时序定位可能为 LVR 中的多模态视觉证据筛选与「何时 LOOK/定位证据」提供可核查的线索，但目前仅属应用层面的检索与分类，与 latent 推理状态无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multimodal Violence Understanding and Temporal Retrieval in Movies with Adaptive Audio-Visual Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Violence in films and streaming media remains a concern for audience protection and creates substantial workload for manual content classification. Existing violence-detection methods often rely on limited modalities or short video clips, making it difficult to capture complementary evidence and localise violent events in long, untrimmed videos. In this study, we develop a framework for multimodal video understanding that classifies violence severity, predicts multiple violence types, and locates violent events in time. We combine temporally aligned visual and audio features extracted using pretrained encoders through attention-based adaptive fusion, followed by Transformer-based temporal modelling. Our framework supports three complementary tasks: video-level violence-severity classification, multi-label violence-type prediction, and temporal localisation of violent events. We evaluate the framework on the XD-Violence benchmark and examine its cross-domain performance using AIRTLab. On XD-Violence, our multimodal model achieves 93.27\\% severity-classification accuracy and a micro-F1 score of 88.60\\% for multi-label violence-type prediction, outperforming the corresponding unimodal configurations. We achieve a mean temporal intersection-over-union (tIoU) of 0.5075 for temporal localisation. Our cross-domain experiments reveal performance degradation under different recording conditions, while our movie case studies demonstrate the framework's potential to retrieve potentially violent scenes for further review. Our results highlight the practical value of multimodal intelligent systems in supporting human reviewers with the identification, classification, and temporal retrieval of violent content in films and streaming media.

</details>

**作者：** Claudio Mucignat、Kamila Zdybal、Ivan Lunati

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对粒子图像测速（PIV），从物理可容许位移出发推导所需空间支撑的上界，说明更深的金字塔网络远超实际需求，并提出仅 58.9 万参数的轻量位移估计器 LIMA3，在合成与实验基准上与现有方法精度相当而内存和吞吐显著更优。

**相关性简评：** 其「按任务物理可容许信息范围反推网络深度与支撑」的思路，或可供核查 LVR 中 latent 工作区深度、计算预算能否由任务必要信息量设定；文中所报告的随粒子信息丢失而出现的分辨率粗化，也可能类比视觉证据衰减下的表示坍缩，但迁移性仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Shallow may be better: Physics-Constrained Lightweight Networks for High-Throughput Particle Image Velocimetry

**abstract/A1：** Convolutional networks for optical flow typically adopt progressively deeper pyramidal encoders under the assumption that larger receptive fields improve motion estimation. For particle image velocimetry (PIV), however, tracer-particle displacement between frames is bounded by the acquisition geometry, allowing network depth to be derived from the physically admissible displacement rather than inherited from general-purpose architectures. Using a layer-by-layer analysis of spatial-support growth, we derive its explicit upper bound and show that deeper architectures substantially exceed the support required for PIV, compromising training stability, spatial resolution under particle loss, and inference efficiency. Based on this analysis, we develop LIMA3, a lightweight pyramidal displacement estimator with 589,000 trainable parameters. Across synthetic and experimental benchmarks, LIMA3 matches the accuracy of established learned and classical methods with at least an order of magnitude less memory and substantially higher throughput, while retaining the physically expected coarsening of spatial resolution as tracer information is lost. Its linear memory scaling enables megapixel processing within embedded memory budgets, such that LIMA3 can reach over 900 image pairs per second at $640\\times480$~pixel on an RTX 5090 and 99 image pairs per second on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. The spatial-support analysis provides a transferable design principle for compact optical-flow architectures and bounded-window attention, offering an alternative to compressing oversized general-purpose networks and enabling efficient operation alongside image acquisition.

</details>

### 643. [When Recognition Meets Discovery: Learning Need Not Be Entangled in One Representation Space](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28092v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28092

**作者：** Chenglin Liu、An Tian、Mingxuan Du、Shang Rui Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28092v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28092v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究广义类别发现中已知类识别与新类发现之间的表征冲突，通过谱分析提出双空间谱路由，将监督识别与无监督发现分配到互补子空间，并利用双空间新类信号组织候选类别。

**相关性简评：** 其「识别与发现争夺表征容量」及主导／残差子空间分解，可能为诊断 LVR 内部状态中任务必要视觉信息与通用信息的分布提供启发，但方法面向图像类别发现，需核查向多模态推理状态迁移的可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Recognition Meets Discovery: Learning Need Not Be Entangled in One Representation Space

**abstract/A1：** Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known classes while discovering novel categories from unlabeled data containing both old and novel samples. Existing methods typically optimize recognition and discovery within a shared representation space, implicitly assuming that the same representation geometry can serve both objectives. Through controlled spectral analysis, we uncover a striking asymmetry: old-class discrimination is increasingly concentrated in the dominant singular directions, while novel-class structure is better preserved in the complementary residual space. More importantly, strengthening the former can even degrade the latter, revealing that recognition and discovery compete for representation capacity rather than merely for optimization weight. Motivated by this observation, we propose Dual-Space Spectral Routing, which dynamically decomposes the representation via online SVD and routes supervised recognition and unsupervised discovery to complementary discriminative and general subspaces. We further exploit their distinct responses to old and novel samples to construct a dual-space novelty signal, which guides Subspace Relation Aggregation (SRA) for organizing candidate novel categories. Extensive experiments across multiple GCD baselines, backbones, and benchmarks demonstrate a consistently improved recognition-discovery balance without introducing additional inference parameters. Code will be open source.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 644. [Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28098v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28098

**作者：** Yifan Shen、Xinyi Yang、Peiyuan Zhu、Yichang Jian、Jinyuan Hu、Xilin He、Fengming Zhu、Guangyi Chen、Kun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28098v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28098v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Causal Dioramas，将视频分解为可单独干预的概念图变量，把指令转成对概念及其依赖项的干预，并经连接器传递给视频生成器，在复用原始噪声的条件下生成保留其余内容的反事实视频，用于可控生成、生成视频修正与真实视频编辑。

**相关性简评：** 其「概念图变量干预＋复用噪声保留非目标内容」的思路，可能为 LVR 中按实体或属性编辑内部视觉状态、以及用反事实一致性检验 latent 内容贡献提供可核查的概念框架，但工作本身面向视频生成而非多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention

**abstract/A1：** Two centuries ago, an early cinema-like theater called the Diorama could already control its scenes at will. Today's video generation models produce videos of near-cinematic quality, yet they still lack this controllability. This limitation stems from the inherent semantic gap between text and pixels, since a prompt can describe a video only coarsely and leaves its details and relations beyond control. We bring this ability to video generation with Causal Dioramas, modules that decompose a video into a concept graph of variables that can be intervened on individually. Each instruction is translated into an intervention on the concept graph, modifying the specified concepts and their dependents. A connector then conveys this intervention to the video generator, which reuses the original noise to produce a counterfactual video while preserving all other content. Building on Causal Dioramas, we develop a unified framework for controllable generation, counterfactual revision of generated videos and editing of real videos. We outperform both open-source and commercial models in controllability on T2V-CompBench, CoVEBench and OpenVE-Bench.

</details>

<a id="paper-645"></a>

### 645. [VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28099v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28099

**作者：** Dayu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28099v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28099v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 发布 VidRouteBench：覆盖 7 个开源家族、16 个「模型×采样配置」组合的文生视频路由基准，含实测成本、9 维质量分与加密测试集；并提出 OPMU，用少量探针提示标注新臂、一次性预测各质量维度，再按场景效用标量化出路由选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定预算下按 prompt 选择计算支路」以及用探针廉价估计效用再决策的设定，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算价值评估与证据获取/停止决策类比，但对象是视频生成而非推理状态，可供核查其成本-效用框架是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each. We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm. Per-prompt specialisation here is real and predictable (oracle gap 0.642, 47% reproducible across seeds, prompt-arm interaction F=4.47 at p=1.6e-63), unlike LLM-routing arms, where the same pipeline finds none. We then propose OPMU (one probe, many utilities): label a new arm on K probe prompts, predict its 9 dimensions once, and serve any scenario utility by scalarising afterwards. Over 215 utility directions OPMU Pareto-dominates the prompt-agnostic baseline for 94% of directions versus 90% for per-scenario routers, with no per-scenario retraining. Three baselines fail instructively: bag-of-words features lose almost all routing gain in the low-data regime (0.009 vs 0.168); crediting a new arm with its probe average is harmful (-3.32 recovery) although it is the strong baseline on RewardBench-style arms (0.786); Chebyshev scalarisation does not help, our cost-utility front being convex.

</details>

### 646. [Benchmarking Foundation Models for Bone Scaffold Pore Detection: A Comparative Analysis of Few-Shot Performance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28113v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28113

**作者：** Tri Tin Vo、Vu Thien An Ngo、Nhi Kieu、Cuong Hung Luu、Giang V. H. Phan、Kien Nguyen、Clinton Fookes

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28113v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28113v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建首个专家标注、像素级密集标注的骨支架 SEM 图像数据集（含五个放大倍率），在 12-shot 微调下比较实例分割模型 SAM3 与检测模型 YOLOv26，并把预测的孔几何送入回归头估计杨氏模量与抗压屈服强度，发现两类模型的失败主要取决于孔隙密度而非放大倍率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联（无 latent 推理状态），但其「按场景密度刻画视觉提取失败（计数饱和、过分割与相邻孔合并）并传导至定量估计」的分析，可能为核查视觉证据保真度与下游推断误差之间的耦合提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking Foundation Models for Bone Scaffold Pore Detection: A Comparative Analysis of Few-Shot Performance

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating the mechanical properties of bone scaffolds conventionally requires destructive testing or costly Finite Element Analysis, while deep learning alternatives are constrained by the scarcity of labeled biomaterial imaging data. This study introduces the first expert-annotated, pixel-dense dataset of biopolymer bone-scaffold SEM images, spanning five magnification series, and uses it to benchmark two state-of-the-art pre-trained foundation models under a 12-shot fine-tuning regime. SAM3, an instance segmenter, and YOLOv26, a bounding-box detector, feed the predicted pore geometry to regression heads that estimate Young's modulus and compressive yield strength. Our central finding is that both models fail by pore density rather than magnification: YOLOv26's predicted pore counts saturate and porosity estimation collapses on the most crowded frames, whereas SAM3 over-fragments sparse pore fields and merges adjacent pores in dense ones, producing eight catastrophic failures against three for YOLOv26. Averaged across the 44-image evaluation set, YOLOv26 achieves lower porosity error (19.9% vs. 23.1% MAE), higher precision, and a higher F1 score, whereas SAM3 offers pixel-level instance segmentation that YOLOv26's bounding boxes cannot reproduce. We conclude that model selection should be driven by pore density rather than SEM magnification alone.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Australasian Data Science and Machine Learning Conference (AusDM 2026)

</details>

### 647. [RALC: Risk-Controlled Local Adoption of Segmentation Updates with Few Calibration Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28122v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28122

**作者：** Shize Yin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28122v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28122v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RALC：在固定模型更新下，用少量正常图像校准，以置信度差构造嵌套的局部替换候选（如 8×8 像素单元），并用“每个替换至多多一个错误”的候选相关界控制净损失增加，从而在无测试标签时选取可采纳的最大局部改动集合。

**相关性简评：** 其「用校准图像界定局部改动带来的净错误增加」的采纳/停止规则，可能为 LVR 中何时采纳或停止潜在状态更新、如何为引入新证据的风险定界提供评价与门控线索；但该工作属道路分割部署，与 latent visual reasoning 相隔较远，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RALC: Risk-Controlled Local Adoption of Segmentation Updates with Few Calibration Images

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning a road-scene segmenter for rain and nighttime driving can introduce errors on normal daytime images. With few labeled normal images for calibration, a whole-image risk check may reject changes that would pass if adopted locally. Risk-Controlled Adoption of Label Changes (RALC) selects local changes from a fixed model update, using confidence differences and an image score to form nested candidates. On each normal calibration image, RALC measures how many more errors each candidate makes than the original model, assigning zero loss when errors stay the same or fall. At test time, each replacement can add at most one error, so the replacement count bounds the net increase without test labels. RALC combines this candidate-dependent bound with recorded calibration losses to select the largest set that passes the risk check. If the models and adoption rules are fixed before calibration and normal calibration and test images are exchangeable, the expected per-image loss stays within budget. On held-out BDD100K, we evaluated three weight-interpolated updates with 10 additional normal images per calibration draw. At a common fixed budget, adverse-scene mIoU was 1.89--3.19 percentage points higher with RALC than with whole-image adoption, while measured mean normal loss was also higher. After matching this loss post hoc at 1,000 pixels per image, RALC still led by 1.135--2.428 points. Selecting changes in $8\\times8$-pixel cells recovered 93--98% of this advantage. With 250 calibration images at the original budget, both rules adopted all three updates in full.

</details>

### 648. [Robust Trajectory Prediction Under Sensing and V2X Noise: Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28128v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28128

**作者：** Shahab Salehi、Luca Lusvarghi、Miguel Sepulcre、Javier Gozalvez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.NI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28128v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28128v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 评估五个 Transformer 交互感知轨迹预测模型在真实感知与 V2X 噪声下的精度退化，并比较输入端去噪模块与噪声增强数据重训练两种缓解策略，同时公开该噪声增强数据集。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其「输入端去噪不如训练期噪声增强」的结论可供核查：当视觉证据本身含噪时，latent 状态的可信度应靠训练期扰动还是输入端清洗来保障，噪声敏感度评价方式或可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Robust Trajectory Prediction Under Sensing and V2X Noise: Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies

**abstract/A1：** Anticipating the future behavior of surrounding objects is key for the safe and efficient navigation of autonomous vehicles. State-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models are typically trained and evaluated on large-scale, highly curated datasets obtained by filtering any object detection and tracking noise through extensive offline post-processing. However, in real-world deployments, the detected objects' state (position, heading, and speed) estimates are inherently affected by sensing and localization uncertainties. These uncertainties can be even higher for connected and automated vehicles receiving information from other road users through Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications. In this paper, we first investigate the sensitivity of five state-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models to realistic noisy object state estimates. Numerical results show that prediction accuracy degrades by up to a 6x factor as the noise level increases, highlighting the models' sensitivity to the mismatch between the noise conditions encountered during training and those experienced at deployment. We then show that retraining models on a more realistic noise-augmented dataset is a more effective strategy to mitigate the impact of noisy object state estimates on trajectory prediction accuracy than using denoising modules at the input. Retrained models limit the prediction accuracy degradation below a 1.5x factor. The noise-augmented dataset is openly released to support further research.

</details>

### 649. [Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28129v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28129

**作者：** Binay Kumar Singh、Niels Da Vitoria Lobo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28129v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28129v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇综述，提出「城市状态表示」（USR）这一地理参照、分层、随时间变化且带不确定性的共享状态概念，把 BEV、occupancy、神经场、3D Gaussian、场景图、语言 token 与世界模型 latent 等表示形式、感知平台与融合方法纳入统一分类，并整理 26 个数据集与基准及一个五测试评估协议。

**相关性简评：** 其「多平台可写、下游任务可读」的共享状态及其分层、时变、不确定性要求，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区应保留哪些信息、如何界定并测量状态的共享性与不确定性提供概念参照，但距离 VLM 推理机制较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks

**abstract/A1：** Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative world models and data engines in one taxonomy that spans sensors to decisions; (iii) compile 26 urban datasets and simulators across ego, cooperative (V2X), aerial, trajectory, and language settings, with a metric glossary, a cross-benchmark results snapshot, a trend analysis, and a platform-coverage gap analysis; and (iv) review applications and propose, as an outlook, USR-5, a five-test protocol with explicit references and one aggregate score for measuring whether a state is shared, together with a research agenda of six open problems covering cross-city and cross-sensor transfer, uncertainty, efficiency, sim-to-real evaluation, and governance. This survey is an entry point for computer vision, autonomous driving, transportation, and urban computing researchers; the paper list, datasets, and USR-5 code are at https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the UrbanState Workshop at WACV 2027. 8 pages + references + 5-page supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation

</details>

### 650. [Don't Test Where You Trained: Geographic Overlap Inflates End-to-End Driving Scores](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28177v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28177

**作者：** Willi Poh、Kevin Rösch、Christoph Stiller

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28177v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28177v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 NAVSIMv1 中 89.6% 的测试场景与训练场景地理距离在 4m 内，据此构建地理不相交的数据划分，并在两组模型都未见过同一批场景上比较；结果显示 DiffusionDrive、Latent TransFuser、DrivoR 等传感器模型掉 3.4–6.1 PDMS，且会预测相机不可见的道路几何，说明端到端驾驶分数部分衡量的是位置记忆。

**相关性简评：** 其「同场景交叉训练对照 + 预测相机不可见几何」的设计，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正依赖视觉证据、还是利用数据先验或位置捷径，属评价与因果作用层面的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Don't Test Where You Trained: Geographic Overlap Inflates End-to-End Driving Scores

**abstract/A1：** In NAVSIMv1, the standard benchmark for end-to-end driving, $89.6\\%$ of the test scenes lie within 4m of a training scene. We show that this geographic overlap inflates the reported scores. We propose a geographically disjoint split of NAVSIMv1 and an evaluation that compares models trained on either split on the same scenes, which neither has seen in training. All sensor-based models we test, DiffusionDrive, Latent TransFuser, and DrivoR, lose 3.4 to 6.1 PDMS points on these scenes, mainly by leaving the road and coming close to other objects, against 1.5 points for a baseline without sensors. The loss concentrates where a training drive of the original split passed the same place. At all other places, models trained on the original split are no better than those trained on the geographic split. Models trained on the original split predict road geometry that no camera can see. The gap persists when the auxiliary map loss is removed, so the models memorize locations even without being supervised to. On nuScenes, the geographic split cuts SparseDrive's mapping accuracy by $59\\%$ and also degrades its planning. Driving scores on logged scenes thus partly measure how well a model remembers the test locations. We release the split to evaluate generalization to new places.

</details>

### 651. [SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28185v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28185

**作者：** Sudhakar Mishra

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28185v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28185v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 SAMA：对 POS 与 CHROM 色度谱做质量加权共识，用同帧无脉搏参考信号抑制干扰频率，并在随机游走先验下以 Viterbi 岭跟踪随时间变化的心率，输出带逐窗置信度的波形；在五个公开数据集上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其基于先验的动态状态跟踪与逐窗置信度筛选（丢弃低置信窗口可大幅降误差），可能为 LVR 中多步推理状态的置信度估计、证据筛选与停止决策提供可供核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets

**abstract/A1：** Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20\\% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2--1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

</details>

### 652. [FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28193v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28193

**作者：** Meng Bi、Yili Jin、Kaiyuan Hu、Xize Duan、Jiaxin Huang、Hong Huang、Xue Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28193v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28193v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析 D4RT 的推理开销，发现后段 decoder 主要关注少量共享 token，进而提出免训练加速框架：仅在稀疏 anchor 处编解码，并通过时间与像素平滑插值恢复其余输出。

**相关性简评：** 其“后段注意力集中于共享 token、输出可稀疏插值”的观察，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态冗余、token 复用与缓存、近似解码的计算—精度权衡提供可核查线索，但任务本身是 4D 重建而非推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking

**abstract/A1：** Query-based 4D reconstruction models such as D4RT encode a video once into a global scene representation and obtain outputs by decoding independent point queries. However, inference is often influenced by dense outputs and long videos. Although D4RT separates encoding from decoding, a dense output still requires one decoder query for every pixel of every frame, and a long video is still encoded as many overlapping segments. In this work, we analyze the inference cost of D4RT and show that a large part of it is redundant. In particular, we find that the later decoder blocks attend to a small set of tokens shared by all queries. Based on these findings, we propose FastD4RT, a training-free framework that accelerates D4RT. By exploiting the smoothness of the outputs over time and across pixels, FastD4RT encodes and decodes only at sparse anchors and recovers the remaining outputs via interpolation. It decodes the remaining queries against a shared token set selected once per segment. We further characterize the errors introduced by both components. Experimental results show that FastD4RT accelerates D4RT by about 5 times on average across all its tasks with competitive accuracy, and further improves accuracy on long videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lycheemeng/fastd4rt.

</details>

<a id="paper-653"></a>

### 653. [Learning the Projection onto the Data Support: Distribution Learning that Avoids Memorization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28234v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28234

**作者：** Lin Chen、Dejan Slepčev

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28234v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28234v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以学习「到数据支撑的最近点投影」为核心的分布学习框架，构造使最优解恢复该投影的目标泛函，给出流形投影恢复与有限样本 Wasserstein 泛化界，并引入直接记忆度量验证生成的是新样本而非训练样本。

**相关性简评：** 学到的投影算子可能为 LVR 中把 latent 状态拉回视觉证据支撑提供一种状态更新思路，其记忆度量也可供核查 latent 轨迹是在泛化还是复现训练样本；但与多模态推理距离较远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning the Projection onto the Data Support: Distribution Learning that Avoids Memorization

**abstract/A1：** We introduce a framework for learning distributions supported on manifolds based on estimating the nearest-point projection onto the data support. Specifically, we define an objective functional over a class of functions whose minimizer recovers this projection. The proposed framework automatically adapts to the intrinsic dimension and allows for data supported on unions of manifolds with varying dimensions. The resulting objective can be optimized using standard neural network architectures. We present population-level results establishing recovery of the manifold projection and prove finite-sample Wasserstein generalization bounds. Furthermore, we validate the approach empirically across a range of settings. In contrast to widely used generative models such as diffusion models, whose objectives can be minimized by memorizing training samples, our formulation excludes such behavior. We also introduce a direct memorization metric to verify that the learned projection generates new samples rather than reproducing the training set.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, 8 figures, accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 654. [Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28244v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28244

**作者：** Kelvin Kiu-Wai Tam、Newt Hue-Nam K. Nguyen、Tianshi Zheng、Yunxiang Mo、Weihan Li、Zhongwei Xie、Chiu Yeung Tang、Jui-Yu Ho、Yangqiu Song、Ginny Y. Wong、Simon See

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28244v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28244v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文系统拆解 autoresearch agent 的 harness 设计，比较不同上下文管理方式（保留可单独访问的历史尝试记录 vs 滚动摘要 vs context folding）与技能管理方式（合并、提升为常驻规则 vs 删除长期未用条目），并在 MLE-Bench、KernelBench 上隔离各组件的影响，最终组合出 MLEvolver。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留细粒度可访问记录优于摘要压缩」「丢弃长期未用经验」的结论，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、推理状态压缩与冗余历史清理提供概念参照，但与 latent 视觉推理无直接机制联系，需核查其抽象层次能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents

**abstract/A1：** Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\\mathrm{fast}\_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 17 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 655. [FoGConcept: Identifying Interpretable Movement Concepts for Freezing-of-Gait Detection from Multi-Scale IMU Signals](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28262v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28262

**作者：** Chuntian Chi、John Clapham、GinaMari Blackwell、Leslie Cloud、Ingrid Pretzer-Aboff、Yanfu Zhang、Huajie Shao、Gang Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28262v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28262v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作从多尺度 IMU 信号中识别出九类人类可理解的步态运动概念，并据此提出 FoGConcept 可解释检测框架，验证概念跨被试复现、与模型决策功能相关且随短/长时窗出现专门化。

**相关性简评：** 其「概念级可解释性＋多时间尺度专门化」的问题表述可能为检验 LVR 内部状态是否编码可命名、可分层的任务概念提供评价思路，但领域与视觉推理相距较远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FoGConcept: Identifying Interpretable Movement Concepts for Freezing-of-Gait Detection from Multi-Scale IMU Signals

**abstract/A1：** Freezing of gait (FoG) is a disabling motor symptom of Parkinson's disease, characterized by an episodic inability to initiate or sustain effective stepping. Current inertial measurement unit (IMU)-based models can detect FoG accurately, but they fail to explain their predictions in terms of human-understandable movement concepts. A major contribution of this work is to identify nine human-understandable movement concepts encoded by a multi-scale FoG model, including gait initiation, rhythmic bilateral gait, trembling in place, shuffling steps, and pivot turns. These concepts recur across subjects, are functionally linked to the model's FoG decisions, and exhibit emergent specialization across short and long temporal contexts. Repeating the concept-discovery procedure on a new FoG dataset, wider temporal contexts, and a deeper backbone recovers the same comparatively stable set of movement concepts. Accordingly, we propose FoGConcept, a mechanism-based interpretability framework for learning movement concepts from multi-scale IMU signals. Domain experts independently recognize 88.9% of the identified concepts, while the proposed model achieves an F1 score of 94.2% for FoG detection. Our findings show that accurate FoG detection can be understood through human-recognizable movement patterns, providing new insight into what a detection model learns to distinguish FoG from non-FoG movement.

</details>

### 656. [What Do Differentiable Rule Learners Need? FLARE: Fuzzy Rules with Additive Evidence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28272v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28272

**作者：** Javier Fumanal-Idocin、Javier Andreu-Perez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28272v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28272v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文剖析可微规则分类器中哪些部分决定性能，发现性能主要来自规则加权方式而非规则学习本身，据此提出 FLARE——以模糊规则前件加性累积证据的可微规则学习器，并给出面向千级类别变量的学习编码，在表格数据与图数据上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「随机规则+学习权重已超过既有可微规则学习器」的组件归因，以及加性证据聚合与概念到标签头设计，可能为 latent 推理中的贡献分配与概念级监督提供类比线索；但材料未涉及视觉或多模态状态，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Do Differentiable Rule Learners Need? FLARE: Fuzzy Rules with Additive Evidence

**abstract/A1：** Rule learners are used where transparency and accountability are required, because they give practitioners patterns they can read. Learning rules is a discrete problem, so neurosymbolic pipelines that use rules as explanations rely on relaxations such as the straight-through estimator. However, these differentiable rule learners often lag behind both classical rule learners and black-box classifiers in terms of performance. We study which parts of a rule-based classifier affect performance, and how well gradient-based training learns each of them. We found that most of the performance comes from how the rules are weighted: random rules with learned weights are already more accurate than every published differentiable rule learner we tested. Based on our results, we propose FLARE (Fuzzy Learned-Antecedent Rule Evidence), a differentiable rule learner that learns simple rules that combine to make the final decision. We also propose a learned encoding for variables with thousands of categories. We test FLARE on tabular data, using 42 datasets of OpenML-CC18 and the 38 classification tasks of TabArena. On CC18, FLARE exceeds the compared rule learners by 7.69 to 12.38 macro-F1 points and performs comparably to random forests, while remaining 1.00 to 1.11 points below tuned gradient-boosted trees. On TabArena it ranks at the same level as random forests and ahead of the other rule learners. As the concept-to-label head of a concept bottleneck model, FLARE is the best rule-based head in five of six settings. On graphs, it is competitive on PubMed and EMOGI but falls behind graph neural networks on Cora and Citeseer. Our code is available at https://github.com/Fuminides/FLARE

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28318

**作者：** Smit Anand

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28318v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28318v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在相同遗传算法框架下比较两种父代选择规则与一个无交叉变异的随机基线，在固定参数字节上限下为小型语言模型各矩阵分配 2/4/8 bit 量化精度，并以 Qwen3-1.7B 上的 held-out 下一词 NLL 为主要评价指标，结论是 tournament 规则优于均匀 4-bit，但未在 ARC-Challenge 上体现精度收益。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定存储预算下逐模块精度分配 + 留出集选优」的搜索与选择流程，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态、缓存或子模块的容量/精度分配及候选筛选提供类比线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Selection Policies for Equal-Byte Mixed-Precision Quantization of Small Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Can changing which matrices receive 2, 4, or 8 bits improve a small language model without increasing its parameter storage? I compare two parent-selection rules in the same genetic algorithm: a binary-tournament variant and an Alternis-inspired rule. A separate baseline samples repaired random allocations without crossover or mutation. All three use the same MLX affine quantizer, byte ceiling, initialization and candidate allowance within each study. An exploratory study on Qwen3.5-2B evaluates 90 allocations per run. The main study on Qwen3-1.7B evaluates 500 distinct allocations per run over 10 paired seeds. Against uniform four-bit, tournament reduces held-out next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0616 on AG News and 0.0152 on IMDb on average, improving all 10 seeds on each corpus at identical parameter storage. Alternis improves five seeds and ties five on AG News; on IMDb its mean gain is near zero. Random returns uniform four-bit in every seed. The tournament representative answers 156 of 400 ARC-Challenge questions correctly versus 163 for uniform; no accuracy gain is demonstrated on this subset. The result favors this tournament variant for text prediction under the tested protocol, not for compression ratio or task accuracy.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 MatHarness 智能体框架，用预检校验、专家技能注入、即时审计、持久研究工件与异构多智能体圆桌，支撑从构思到成稿的长周期计算材料学研究，并以 Cu-Zn 合金表面偏析为例做了多周、约 10^3 GPU 小时的实证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science

**abstract/A1：** Materials science research is a non-linear, long-horizon process. Existing scientific agents, however, largely rely on specific task execution or predefined workflows, rendering them brittle in open-ended settings. To bridge this gap, we present MatHarness, an agent harness designed for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research spanning the complete lifecycle from initial ideation to manuscript writing. MatHarness couples three mechanisms: execution robustness through pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing; epistemic adaptability through persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model; and collective intelligence through a heterogeneous multi-agent round table under targeted human oversight. We evaluate MatHarness on adsorbate-induced surface segregation in Cu-Zn alloys, an open question in methanol-synthesis catalysis. Over a multi-week trajectory consuming roughly 10^3 GPU-hours (50 production DFT relaxations prescreened by 171 machine-learning-potential evaluations) the system revised its plan six times, recovered autonomously from failed calculations, and had an independent auditor overturn one of its own over-attributed claims before publication. Within the sampled metallic dilute-limit models, the validated DFT analysis supports an adsorbate-induced tendency toward greater surface Cu exposure at both composition endpoints, with facet- and coverage-dependent exceptions. These results were compiled into a complete manuscript with human involvement concentrated in specification, approval, and strategic steering gates. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/pippin.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment

**abstract/A1：** Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper we study three related questions using the UAV decision benchmark, UAVBench. First, are small structured decision models good candidates for these tasks? Second, can an ordinary local machine (a Mac) screen candidate models before we test them on physical devices? Third, what software and resource limits govern deployment? Our main Mac evaluation covers 24 model configurations on the same 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions from UAVBench. These include 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models, plus four open-weight structured decision models that received no additional UAVBench-specific training. A structured decision model, H2O Lightning 4B, achieved the highest accuracy we observed, scoring 77.65% on the Mac. This shows that these models are well suited to this kind of task. However, when we tried to deploy the decision models, we ran into conversion and runtime limits on the edge devices we tested, which we describe in detail. To test local screening, we ran matched evaluations of two generative models on both the Mac and a Qualcomm RB3 board. The accuracies did not match exactly, but the ranking did. LFM2 2.6B ranked above Qwen2.5 1.5B on both platforms. This supports using a local machine to shortlist candidates. That said, individual answers still differed between platforms, so testing on the actual hardware remained necessary.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model

**abstract/A1：** Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

**title/T1：** Which Loans, Not How Many: Exactly Level-Invariant, Anytime-Valid Monitoring of Deployed Risk Models

**abstract/A1：** A refinancing wave can change the number of mortgage prepayments without changing the relationship between scores and prepayment. In a logistic model, conditioning on the monthly count removes the intercept from the likelihood of which loans prepay. Our fixed-start slope product tests a lower bound on the calibration slope. At threshold 20 its probability of ever crossing under the null is at most 5%. The restarted level sum tracks departures from intercept tolerance. A confidence sequence estimates a constant slope, and the restart-intersection rule detects changes in that slope. A continuous mixture avoids the off-grid width floor of a discrete prior. On Freddie Mac loans, fixed-slope resampling reproduces 78% of maintained-model monthly AUC variance in development and 70% in the holdout (95% intervals 57-100% and 48-100%). From fresh holdout starts, the restarted level sum crosses on both paths, and the fixed-start slope product stays below threshold on both. The restart-intersection rule signals a downward change for the frozen model in April 2018 and an upward change for the maintained model in a supplementary run in August 2019.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 662. [SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28348v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28348

**作者：** Qinghua Liu、Junpeng Wang、Mingzhi Hu、Menghai Pan、Shubham Jain、Yuzhong Chen、Yan Zheng、Yiwei Cai、John Paparrizos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28348v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28348v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 SMAD，一个基于 LLM 多智能体的无监督时间序列异常检测框架：先用自然语言「语义契约」明确要检测的目标事件模式与验证问题，再由智能体生成检测流水线，并以契约匹配的合成干预提供无标签证据进行迭代自改进和语义感知集成。

**相关性简评：** 其「把要检测什么显式写成契约、再用合成干预作为无标签证据并归因到具体组件」的思路，可能与 LVR 中验证问题的定义、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配有概念联系，可供核查；但领域相距较远，迁移性未知。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) lacks a one-size-fits-all detector for heterogeneous data and anomaly types. Existing automation is limited by implicit objectives, potentially unreliable historical knowledge, or high computational costs. More fundamentally, it selects how to detect anomalies without explicitly defining what to detect. We propose SMAD, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that translates anomaly intent into executable, testable detection pipelines. Rather than selecting detectors against an implicit target, SMAD establishes a natural-language semantic contract grounded in measurable time-series properties, specifying target event patterns, expected score responses, and validation questions. This contract governs both detector construction and evaluation: LLM agents propose pipelines, while contract-matched synthetic interventions provide label-free evidence from the target series to assess semantic coverage and guide iterative self-refinement. A semantics-aware ensemble integrates validated candidates and attributes each alert to contributing detectors and supporting evidence. On univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks, SMAD improves detection performance over the strongest baseline by 11.5% and 9.6%, respectively, while outperforming general-purpose coding agents at 2-5x lower language-model token cost.

</details>
