### 663. [Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28356v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28356

**作者：** Huanran Li、Nhat X. T. Le、Kevin De Angeli、Yao Xuan、Alireza Vahdatpour、Djordje Gligorijevic

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28356v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28356v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 Engram，一个用于 LLM agent 自动调优异构模型的多阶段记忆系统：它把过往试验结果与背后的假设及理由关联，在初始引导、会话检索和候选审查三个决策点提供证据，并在会话间离线蒸馏已验证经验，使记忆自我改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「判定过往证据是否适用于当前模型」的检索与有效性筛选机制，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与跨样本经验复用提供类比线索，可供核查，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

**comment/C1：** 5 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables

</details>

### 664. [Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28368v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28368

**作者：** Martyna Plomecka、Yao Yan、DJ Sterling、Jon Lipovetz、John Schultz、Michael Aaron、Chiamaka Chukwuka、Will Cukierski、Christopher D'Mello、Bovard Doerschuk-Tiberi、Robert Fraser、Ian Gemp、Yuting Han、Addison Howard、Oran Kelly、Siqi Liu、Jeff Moser、Meghan O'Connell、Jun Peng、Laurel Prince、Meg Risdal、Jonathan Ward、Domino Weir、Marc Lanctot

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28368v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28368v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向LLM智能体游戏评测的持续评估框架，包含按Bradley-Terry不确定性分配对局预算的自适应调度器、融合异质结果的统一排行榜（游戏平衡BT模型加bootstrap区间）以及游戏技能画像，并在十个游戏套件上报告能力画像、成本节省与性能-推理成本Pareto前沿。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系，但其依据不确定性分配评测预算、显式刻画推理成本与性能权衡的做法，可能为LVR中动态计算与停止决策的评测成本核算提供参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games

**abstract/A1：** Games are a robust test for large language model agents: they require sequential decisions, adversarial or cooperative interaction, state tracking, reasoning under uncertainty, and long-horizon planning. However, a one-time game benchmark can go stale as models, prompts, environment implementations, and evaluation policies change, and refreshing it is costly: full round-robin evaluation scales poorly in the number of model pairs, and the resulting outcomes live on incompatible per-game scales. We present a framework for continuous evaluation of LLM agents in game settings, organized around three coupled components. First, an adaptive scheduler that maps pairwise Bradley-Terry uncertainty to reduced per-pair match targets, concentrating budget on comparisons that remain unresolved. Second, a Unified Leaderboard (ULB) that reduces heterogeneous outcomes to pairwise evidence and fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model by minorization-maximization with bootstrap intervals, so that high-throughput games cannot dominate the aggregate ranking. Third, a game skill-profile methodology that scores each game along diverse skill dimensions, making the capability coverage of the suite explicit and turning game selection into a design decision rather than an artifact of availability. In this paper, we specify the research design and outcome reduction of the current implementation and evaluate the framework on a ten-game suite spanning perfect-information board games, imperfect-information games, and social/language settings, reporting LLM capability profiles, evaluation-cost savings across model-refresh cycles, and an empirical Pareto frontier relating model performance to inference cost. As deployed, the scheduler saved 61.7% of episodes; it counted each episode in the two team games as four records, overstating their savings, and the other eight games save 61.9%.

**comment/C1：** 50 pages, 18 figures

</details>

### 665. [WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28418v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28418

**作者：** Yiming Yang、David Xia、Jisen Li、Yuqing Jian、Yunjia Yang、Koray Aydin、Zhaoran Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28418v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28418v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 WingBench：一个面向跨声速机翼设计的多保真基准，让优化器与 AI agent 在有限次序贯 CFD 评估预算内，结合廉价代理模型预测与可能返回失败类型的昂贵真实测试进行设计搜索，并分别评估推荐设计的有效性与气动质量。

**相关性简评：** 其「廉价预测—昂贵验证—失败类型反馈—固定预算」的评测框架，可供核查 LVR 中何时调用视觉证据（LOOK）、如何依据失败信号继续或停止（STOP）以及证据获取成本与收益的度量方式，但领域与 VLM 推理距离较远，迁移仅为可能。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs

**abstract/A1：** Design search often uses cheap learned predictions to choose which candidates deserve expensive tests, but these tests can fail, especially on the unusual designs that optimization favors. We introduce WingBench, a multifidelity benchmark in which optimizers and AI agents design transonic wings with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) inside the search. They can query a learned aerodynamic surrogate and spend a fixed budget of sequential CFD evaluations, each returning a score or a failure type. WingBench grades the design each method recommends, reporting separately whether it receives a valid score and how good that score is. Using WingBench, we contribute a study of five baseline optimizers and a comparison of three AI agent methods, which produced 6,629 CFD evaluation records. Feedback helps baseline optimizers deliver valid designs when it changes their later proposals, but the differential-evolution variant does so with lower aerodynamic quality. An open-ended research agent finds designs of similar quality to the strongest baselines over 32 CFD queries, with different prior information and unmatched total computation. In early search, our reflection and planning implementations do not consistently improve on it. We release the data, code, agent prompts, and analysis scripts for reproducibility.

</details>

### 666. [Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28420v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28420

**作者：** Navapat Nananukul、Mayank Kejriwal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28420v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28420v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DiVE，用共享记忆、失败日志与「最佳想法胜出」轮次组织五个 8–12B 开源小模型的集成来做程序递归自我改进，在 MLE-bench Lite 上以较低成本接近更大模型的表现，主张模型多样性可部分替代规模。

**相关性简评：** 其多候选共享上下文、记录失败并逐轮择优保留的机制，可能为 LVR 中并行生成多个 latent 假设的保留、筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的线索，但任务为纯文本代码自我改进，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models

**abstract/A1：** The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents across various tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, in which a language model repeatedly rewrites a program and builds on its previous version, now perform well in machine-learning tasks, but they rely on frontier models and hundreds of calls per run. Small open-weight models are far cheaper, yet when used alone, their programs often crash and their improvements stall. We propose DiVE (diverse models evolve), an ensemble method for RSI that aims to improve creativity and diversity of generated solutions. DiVE uses three components: a shared memory, a failure log, and best-idea-wins rounds. This allows models to write candidate solutions from the same context and retain the best idea at each iteration. On 22 MLE-bench Lite competitions, an ensemble of five 8-12B open-weight models has 25.4% less test error than its average member and 16.7% less than Llama 3.3 70B, and comes within 7.1% of Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B at 75% of its cost. Diversity among small models can thus stand in for part of the scale that RSI relies on.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PFN-Syn，用 prior-data fitted networks 做免训练（training-free）的合成表格数据生成，并在八个二分类数据集上与需训练的生成器比较下游效用、生成吞吐、分布相似性与最近记录距离隐私。

**相关性简评：** PFN 在上下文中隐式逼近后验预测分布、无需按数据集重训的思路，可能为 LVR 中信念状态维护与免任务训练的状态推断提供概念线索，但任务域相距较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PFN-Syn: Generating Synthetic Tabular Data with Prior-Data Fitted Networks

**abstract/A1：** Synthetic tabular data can help enable data sharing and model development in privacy-sensitive domains, but existing generators often require dataset-specific training and substantial computation. We introduce PFN-Syn, a training-free framework for synthetic tabular data generation based on prior-data fitted networks. We evaluate PFN-Syn against training-based generators on eight binary classification datasets. PFN-Syn achieves the highest average downstream utility among evaluated synthetic generators, with higher generation throughput than training-based baselines, while maintaining competitive distributional similarity and distance-to-closest-record privacy behavior. Our results suggest that tabular foundation models can serve as useful building blocks for practical synthetic tabular data generation.

### 668. [When a Permitted Action Completes a Forbidden Workflow: Designing Consequence-Oriented Approval for LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28454v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28454

**作者：** S M Asif Hossain、Ruksat Khan Shayoni、Md Kishor Morol、M F Mridha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28454v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28454v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出「累积授权失败」：单步动作看似无害，但多步累积后果可能违背用户意图，属于交互设计问题；作者提出 Cumulative Consent Ledger 审批界面（重述意图、绑定具体动作、合成累积后果、保持可核查），配合追踪工件来源的可信监控器，并用 80 人 960 次审批决策的被试间实验及系统评测检验。

**相关性简评：** 轨迹级证据的合成与可核查性、以及基于累积状态做审批/放行判断，可能与 LVR 中跨步证据聚合、latent 状态是否保留可核查的任务必要信息及停止决策的评价问题构成概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When a Permitted Action Completes a Forbidden Workflow: Designing Consequence-Oriented Approval for LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Tool-using language-model agents increasingly ask people to approve consequential actions, yet an approval prompt shows only the next step. A request to send a file to an approved recipient can look harmless even when that file was assembled, several steps earlier, from data the user said must never leave. We call this a cumulative authorization failure and argue that it is an interaction design problem as much as a security problem. The evidence a reviewer needs is spread across the trajectory, and listing it in time order leaves the reviewer to reconstruct the causal chain. We present the Cumulative Consent Ledger (CCL), an approval interface built on four design principles that restate the user's intent, bind the review to the exact action, compose the cumulative consequence, and keep every claim checkable. A trusted monitor that tracks artifact lineage supplies the evidence. In a between-subjects study with 80 participants and 960 approval decisions, CCL was associated with fewer unsafe approvals than an evidence-matched chronological log (24.2% vs. 32.5%), higher comprehension, and faster decisions, although the adjusted difference in unsafe approvals remained uncertain (-7.9 points, 95% CrI \[-19.7, 3.8\]). In a system evaluation, the monitor detected 89.2% of 120 violating checkpoints and, used as an execution gate, reduced executed unsafe effects from 43.3% to 5.0% for one agent at a small cost to benign completion. We derive implications for designing consent around consequences rather than individual calls.

**comment/C1：** Under Review at the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)

</details>

### 669. [AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28488v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28488

**作者：** Hong-Phuc Phan、Tuan-Anh Vu、Tung Kieu、Son Ha Xuan、Sean Bin Yang、Bin Yang、Christian S. Jensen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28488v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28488v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AMP-OD：先在目标数据集上运行少量廉价 probe 检测器，把其得分模式作为证据，经 Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior 转为带门控的检测器族证据，再结合历史可靠性先验、序贯 probe/停止策略与 LCB 仲裁选出最终检测器。

**相关性简评：** 其「先探查后提交」、序贯停止与证据门控的思路，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡和 latent 证据筛选提供概念参照；但该工作属非视觉的无监督模型选择，实际迁移线索需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version

**abstract/A1：** Outlier detection is often deployed in fully unsupervised settings, where labels are unavailable and practitioners must choose a detector without direct performance feedback. Existing unsupervised outlier model selection methods predict detector quality from static meta-features and historical performance on meta-datasets, but they commit before observing how any detector behaves on the target dataset. We propose AMP-OD, an execution-conditioned probe-then-commit framework. AMP-OD runs a small number of inexpensive probe detectors, uses their score patterns as target-dataset evidence, and then selects a final detector from a larger candidate pool. To interpret unlabeled probe responses, we introduce a Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior (LOO-FPP), which converts probe score patterns into gated detector-family evidence while reducing self-validation in pseudo-label construction. AMP-OD further combines this evidence with historical reliability through a warm-start prior, a sequential probe/stop policy, and lower-confidence-bound arbitration. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that detector responses provide useful evidence beyond static meta-features, with the LOO-FPP and conservative arbitration as key contributors.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages. An extended version of "AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection" accepted at KDD 2027

</details>

### 670. [VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28520v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28520

**作者：** Jingong Chen、Qingwen Zhang、Lin Lian、Xinxin Zuo、Yang Wang、Chulwoo Pack、Kyle Gao、Patric Jensfelt、Kwanghee Won

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28520v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28520v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将预训练视频生成模型（Wan2.1）改造为前馈 3D 重建模型：用片段级位移预测校正逆深度解码中的畸变，并用跨 transformer 层的相机头直接回归逐帧相机参数，从而免去迭代去噪。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成模型内部已含深度与相机运动、但形式不适配重建」的观察，以及跨层读出几何量的做法，可能类比 LVR 中内部状态是否保留几何证据、如何从 latent 中读取任务必要信息的问题，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R

</details>

### 671. [DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28522v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28522

**作者：** Nurlan Nazaraliyev、Elaheh Sadredini、Nael Abu-Ghazaleh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28522v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28522v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作将 top-p（nucleus）稀疏注意力端到端集成进 vLLM 服务系统：把块选择移出调度器关键路径、用双流流水线隐藏选择延迟，并以单遍直方图核实现 top-p 选择，同时针对块内重要性混杂提出按 prefill 注意力分数引导的 token 重排核。

**相关性简评：** 其用注意力质量分布自适应决定保留预算（相对固定 top-k）、并据注意力分数重排 token 的做法，或可为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与自适应保留/计算预算提供可核查的思路线索，但论文本身面向 KV cache 服务吞吐，未涉及推理状态或视觉。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving

**abstract/A1：** Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/nnurlan008/DisSparse

</details>

### 672. [Walks2Maps: Learning Indoor Geometry from Crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and Motion Trajectories](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28532v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28532

**作者：** Enguang Fan、Binh Minh Tran、Fulin Wang、Jiaxi Li、Klara Nahrstedt

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28532v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28532v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Walks2Maps，从众包 Wi-Fi RTT 与运动轨迹重建室内共享度量地图，无需平面图、AP 坐标或位置标签，联合估计行人轨迹、AP 位置与步幅尺度，并用非对称距离损失应对多径时延。

**相关性简评：** 其“仅靠相似性可识别场所但得到扭曲地图、需保留度量信息消歧”的发现，可能与 LVR 中内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要信息、以及视觉证据筛选的可辨识性问题类比，但领域较远，仅供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Walks2Maps: Learning Indoor Geometry from Crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and Motion Trajectories

**abstract/A1：** Everyday smartphone walks offer a scalable source of indoor geometry, but their motion traces drift and their radio measurements are distorted by multipath. We present Walks2Maps, a physics-guided framework that reconstructs a shared metric map from Wi-Fi round-trip-time (RTT) and motion observations, without a floor plan, surveyed access-point (AP) coordinates, or position labels. Walks2Maps jointly estimates pedestrian trajectories, AP locations, and per-trajectory stride scales, then recovers the pathway layout from the reconstructed paths. Shared AP observations connect walks recorded in different local frames, while metric ranges constrain their relative geometry and scale. An asymmetric range loss accommodates multipath-induced excess delay. On 22 phone trajectories collected along 11 routes on an office floor with 30 APs, Walks2Maps achieves median AP and trajectory errors of 0.87 m and 0.89 m, respectively, and a walked-area F1 score of 0.985. Ablations show that radio similarity can recognize places while still producing a distorted map; retaining the metric information in RTT resolves this ambiguity. Asymmetric modeling further reduces AP error by 54% relative to a symmetric loss. These results demonstrate how radio and motion measurements can jointly reveal indoor geometry without a dedicated mapping survey. We will release the dataset and toolkit.

**comment/C1：** This paper is accepted to NeurIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI Workshop

</details>

### 673. [Analyzing Atypical Local Features in Museum Artifacts using Generative Image Inpainting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28549v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28549

**作者：** Maho Kinoshita、Wakana Kuwata、Ryota Mibayashi、Hiroaki Ohshima

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28549v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28549v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文以图像生成模型学到的外观分布作为类别内“常见外观”的参照：对每个目标区域，用其余区域图像微调 LoRA 并排除该区域，再对目标区域局部做 inpainting，用 LPIPS 差异衡量重建难度，从而在博物馆藏品（小芥子人偶、鼓、面具）中挖掘区域特有的颜色、纹样与彩绘细节。

**相关性简评：** 用生成先验下的局部重建难度作为“信息量／意外性”的代理，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选和「哪些局部细节值得进入推理状态」提供一种度量思路，但需核查其度量是否区分内容特异性与生成伪影，与原论文的推理机制无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Analyzing Atypical Local Features in Museum Artifacts using Generative Image Inpainting

**abstract/A1：** This study proposes a method for analyzing local visual features in museum artifacts that may appear atypical or unexpected. Objects in the same category often share a similar overall shape, while local details such as patterns, decorations, and facial expressions may reflect regional or cultural characteristics. We use the appearance distribution learned by an image generation model as a reference for what is generally expected within an artifact category. For each target region, we exclude images from that region and fine-tune a generative model using only images from the remaining regions. We then mask selected parts of artifact images from the target region and ask the region-excluded model to complete them. If the completed result differs greatly from the original image, the masked part may contain features that are difficult to predict from the appearance learned from other regions. We measure this difference using LPIPS and treat it as reconstruction difficulty for the generative model. We conduct experiments on images of kokeshi dolls, drums, and masks from the collection of the National Museum of Ethnology. For each category, we select several target regions, build region-excluded LoRA models, and perform inpainting on predefined local parts. The results show that typical shapes and simple decorations are often reconstructed consistently, whereas some region-specific colors, patterns, cord arrangements, and painted details are replaced with more common appearances. These results suggest that region-excluded inpainting can serve as an exploratory tool for finding region-specific local visual features in museum artifact images.

**comment/C1：** BESC 2026; 20 pages

</details>

### 674. [From atomic events to material degradation across metre and year scales](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28559v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28559

**作者：** Kun Li、Tian Luo、Haozhi Han、Ruge Zhang、Yifeng Chen、Xinfu He、Yunquan Zhang、Ting Cao、Yunxin Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cond-mat.mtrl-sci

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28559v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28559v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向材料降解的跨尺度模拟，提出 AtomWorld，从多尺度结构观测与轨迹历史中重建「动力学预测状态」，以区分瞬时涨落与驱动持久结构演化的微观路径，并在保持 KMC 事件合法性的约束下学习状态转移。

**相关性简评：** 其「瞬时构型不足以判断后果、需由历史重建预测状态」的信息瓶颈论述，可能与 LVR 中单次视觉观测不足、需在 latent 状态中积累并筛选证据的问题同构，可供核查状态抽象与瞬态/持久信号分离的表述。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From atomic events to material degradation across metre and year scales

**abstract/A1：** Material degradation emerges from microscopic events whose consequences accumulate over years, yet mechanism-resolved simulations remain confined below engineering timescales. The challenge is not just the sheer number of events: atomistic evolution is dominated by recurrent local motion, with only a tiny fraction driving lasting structural change. This distinction is not encoded in an instantaneous atomic configuration. Locally indistinguishable states can exhibit different event competition, escape times, and long-horizon outcomes, revealing missing kinetic context as a critical information bottleneck. This context spans space and time: the future consequence of a local transition depends on its surrounding defect environment and the kinetic history leading to its current state. To solve this, AtomWorld reconstructs a predictive kinetic state from multiscale structural observations and trajectory history, distinguishing transient fluctuations from microscopic pathways that drive persistent structural evolution. Learning operates only over transitions admitted by the underlying kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) process, preserving event legality, state evolution, and physical time. Across BCC Fe-Cu precipitation, FCC Ni-Cr-Al ordering, and HCP Zr-H interstitial transport, restoring kinetic context consistently advances persistent evolution while maintaining physical fidelity and transferring to unseen conditions. In irradiated reactor-pressure-vessel steel, this approach achieves up to 420-fold greater persistent evolution under matched event budgets. Combined with scalable execution, it successfully extends mechanism-resolved trajectories to service-year timescales across metre-scale heterogeneous domains.

</details>

### 675. [Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28565v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28565

**作者：** Salman Hajizada、Mohammed Yusuf Ansari、Gianni Di Caro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28565v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28565v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向 Jupyter notebook 中跨步骤关联的开放式作业，先从参考解生成评分 rubric 并做「软化」以容纳合法替代解法，再按题组单次调用 LLM、结合代码、文本、数值与图像进行路径感知的自动评分，并在真实课程与存档提交上评估与人评分的一致性、跨模型方差、成本与学生观感。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，教育评分属远端领域；但其「依前序选择判定后续步骤」及软化 rubric 以免惩罚合法替代路径的思路，可能可供核查多步推理轨迹的路径级评价与替代 latent 路径的容错计分设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks

**abstract/A1：** Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at IEEE TALE 2026

</details>

### 676. [Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28579v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28579

**作者：** Moïse Blanchard、Ezra Edelman、Surbhi Goel、Shyam Narayanan、Jialin Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28579v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28579v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究对抗者可注入任意多污染样本的 i.i.d. 序贯预测问题，提出加权 shattering potential 及相应算法，在 μ 已知、μ 未知（oblivious 与 adaptive 对手）及删失反馈下给出误差与弃权代价的紧致权衡界。

**相关性简评：** 其「错误—弃权」权衡刻画可为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益与成本、停止规则设计提供形式化参照，但设定是带注入噪声的序贯预测、不涉及视觉证据获取与 latent 状态，可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tight Mistake-Abstention Tradeoffs for Sequential Prediction under Adversarial Injections

**abstract/A1：** We study the sequential prediction problem introduced by Goel et al. (2023), where an adversary can inject arbitrarily many corrupted instances in an i.i.d. stream from a clean distribution $μ$, while the learner is allowed to abstain from making a prediction at no cost if the current instance was indeed injected. When $μ$ is unknown, Yu and Blanchard (2026) show a polynomial tradeoff between mistakes and false abstentions for classes with finite VC dimension and oblivious adversaries, but still leave open a significant gap between upper and lower bounds in their tradeoff landscape. In this paper, we propose the weighted shattering potential, and based on variants of this potential, provide gap-closing algorithms that essentially characterize the tradeoffs under various settings of interest: When $μ$ is known, our algorithm improves over Goel et al. (2023) and achieves their conjectured $O(d\\log T)$ mistake bound; When $μ$ is unknown, for oblivious adversary, our guarantees are tight both in $T$ and in terms of the VC dimension $d$, which completely characterizes the abstention-mistake tradeoff in this setting and gives an $O(\\sqrt{dT})$ balanced rate. For adaptive adversary, our results are tight up to $\\operatorname{poly}(dD\\log T)$ factors for structured classes with finite so-called reduction dimension $D$. Our guarantees also extend to censored feedback, where the label is hidden after an abstention.

**comment/C1：** 49 pages

</details>

### 677. [Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28610v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28610

**作者：** Zhe Chen、Emma Hsieh、Vicky Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Agent Money Benchmark，让 12 个模型在模拟卖家与真实链上支付环境下完成付款任务和信息购买型研究问题，统计支付错误、受骗事件，并把数据与推理开销折算为浪费金额来评估花钱是否值得。

**相关性简评：** 论文以货币成本衡量「付费获取信息」对最终答案的贡献，可能为 LVR 中证据获取的成本—收益权衡与停止决策提供外部评价思路，但完全不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，可供核查的迁移点较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?

**abstract/A1：** Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks, estimated waste ranged from \\$21.0 per \\$100 for Claude Fable 5.2 to \\$70.8 for GPT-6 Luna.

### 678. [Nearly Minimax-Optimal Sample Complexity of Natural Policy Gradient with a Matching Information-Theoretic Lower Bound](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28628v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28628

**作者：** Asha Barua、Sajad Khodadadian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28628v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28628v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究已知奖励、未知转移核的 tabular 有限时域 MDP，在生成模型下用反向扫描的采样型 NPG 更新策略，给出与自适应查询信息论下界 Ω(SAH^4/ε^2) 匹配的 last-iterate 样本复杂度，并证明精确 NPG 在常数步长下的迭代下界。

**相关性简评：** 其针对自适应查询的样本/迭代下界框架，可能为 LVR 中「获取视觉证据」所需查询量与动态计算开销提供评价标尺，可供核查是否能形式化迁移；该方法与视觉表示、latent 状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Nearly Minimax-Optimal Sample Complexity of Natural Policy Gradient with a Matching Information-Theoretic Lower Bound

**abstract/A1：** A fundamental question in reinforcement learning is how many sampled transitions are needed to learn a near-optimal policy, and whether direct policy optimization can attain this statistical limit. To answer this question, we consider natural policy gradient (NPG), a widely used policy optimization method. We study tabular finite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with known rewards and unknown horizon-dependent transition kernels, accessed through a generative model. Our sample-based NPG algorithms update the policy by backward sweeps and do not estimate transition probabilities. Under three different batch-size and step size schedules, we establish last-iterate guarantees with sample complexity $\\widetilde O(SAH^4/\\varepsilon^2)$, where $S$, $A$, and $H$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, and the horizon length, respectively. In this setting, horizon-dependent transition kernels contribute a factor of $H$ to our transition-query bound. Our information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω(SAH^4/\\varepsilon^2)$ shows that the resulting $H^4$ dependence is unavoidable in the worst case, even for agents that select their queries adaptively. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first last-iterate guarantees for NPG whose sample complexity matches an information-theoretic lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our results demonstrate that direct policy-space optimization through NPG can achieve the fundamental statistical limits of reinforcement learning while guaranteeing the performance of the final policy. Furthermore, for known kernels, we prove that exact NPG with a constant step size $η=1/H$ requires $Ω(H^2/\\varepsilon)$ iterations in the worst case, matching the known upper bound for that step size.

**comment/C1：** 41 pages

</details>

### 679. [Dual-Stream Event-to-Video Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28656v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28656

**作者：** Lei Sun、Zhendong Li、Chenxin Shao、Weilun Li、Ruibo Ming、Kaiwei Wang、Jinjin Gu、Danda Pani Paudel、Luc Van Gool

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28656v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28656v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EvDualDiff 双流扩散框架，用一路提供亮度参考的时间映射事件、一路提供运动事件线索，从单一时间映射自回归重建长视频序列，并用光度约束与自生成 rollout 微调抑制漂移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dual-Stream Event-to-Video Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Event cameras capture brightness changes with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but converting event streams into videos remains fundamentally ill-posed due to the lack of absolute intensity information. Resolving this ambiguity calls for a brightness reference that complements the intensity changes recorded by events. Inspired by the complementary spatial and temporal processing of the parvocellular and magnocellular pathways in human vision, we propose EvDualDiff, a dual-stream framework that combines a brightness reference from temporal-mapping events with motion-event cues for video reconstruction. Conditioned on both streams, our video diffusion model autoregressively reconstructs long sequences from a single temporal map. Photometric constraints and finetuning on self-generated rollouts reduce accumulated drift. At the hardware level, our approach requires only a minimal light-modulation mechanism on the lens of an event camera. We build this setup and collect a dataset comprising temporal-mapping events, motion events and synchronised ground-truth RGB frames. Experiments on a public benchmark and on our collected EvDual dataset demonstrate that EvDualDiff outperforms existing event-to-video reconstruction methods in fidelity, perceptual quality and video-level realism. The code and dataset will be released.

</details>

### 680. [Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28660v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28660

**作者：** Bangyan Ju、Xiaolin Sun、Yibin Hu、Zizhan Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28660v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28660v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将多智能体 LLM 辩论与共识中的内部恶意成员形式化为序贯决策问题：先从离线轨迹学习良性智能体的世界模型，再据此训练说服策略并规划消息，并以攻击数据对抗训练作为防御。

**相关性简评：** 其「世界模型预测并干预他人答案更新轨迹」与对抗数据加固，或可供核查 LVR 中外部证据如何改变推理状态及训练期鲁棒性，但无视觉输入与 latent 表示，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuaders from prior work. The attack also transfers to other target models, larger groups, and unseen datasets, and remains effective under existing Byzantine-resilience defenses. The learned insider also enables a new defense: adversarially training benign agents on the attack data largely removes both our attack and the strongest prior persuasion attack. These results show that combining world models with reinforcement learning and planning is an effective route to both attacking and hardening language-based multi-agent systems.

</details>

<a id="paper-681"></a>

### 681. [Peel, Don't Whack: Partial Coverage, Imperfect Validators, and Intervention Based Shortcut Mitigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28701v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28701

**作者：** Ali Alavi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28701v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28701v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在线性模型中分析干预式捷径缓解下覆盖不完整与验证器误判的影响，给出最差组精度与假接受容忍度的理论，并提出从模型错误中提议编辑的 Peel 流程，在合成与真实图像上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「模型可能忽略核心特征」以及编辑覆盖度、验证器假接受如何影响特征使用的分析，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、诊断 latent 是否依赖任务必要内容提供评价与探测思路，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Peel, Don't Whack: Partial Coverage, Imperfect Validators, and Intervention Based Shortcut Mitigation

**abstract/A1：** Without group labels, shortcut mitigation increasingly relies on interventions : label-preserving edits, such as background or watermark replacement, that are proposed automatically and accepted by a validator. Invariance to a complete family of valid edits yields robustness, but in practice coverage is partial and validators err. We analyze both in a stylized linear model. For the population logistic solution and the max-margin limit of gradient descent, the decision on every shortcut-flip group follows one additive rule. Hence worst-group accuracy never decreases with coverage, while individual groups can provably degrade, a mechanism for the Whac-a-Mole effect; full coverage is not always needed. In the logistic regime the validator's false-accept rate must stay below a closed-form tolerance that grows with coverage. With noiseless training data, one false accept can make the max-margin solution ignore the core. In this model, sensitivity-based discovery removes shortcuts in decreasing salience. We also give a model-agnostic certificate, valid under content-independent validation, whose validator-error term comes from an audit. Simulations match the theory, and deep networks on synthetic and real images show the predicted Whac-a-Mole signs, monotone worst-group accuracy and validator fragility. The resulting procedure, Peel (Propose-Edit-Evaluate-Learn), can propose candidate edits from the model's own mistakes. Given an oracle library of the benchmarks' intervention operators, it selects the right ones and beats group-label methods on Waterbirds and UrbanCars. With fully generated edits, run end to end from three discovery seeds, it improves on empirical risk minimization (ERM) on five of six benchmarks but trails exact edits.

</details>

### 682. [How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28727v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28727

**作者：** Miit Daga、Swarna Priya Ramu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.LO、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28727v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28727v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文精确求出离散区间及 j 个区间并集的 Littlestone 维数，给出随 switch budget 分三段增长的闭式公式，构造可达最优的块配对学习器与对抗下界，并给出随机化情形的部分精确结果与 Lean 4 机器验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「对抗序列下最少被迫犯错数」可视为对需要多少证据才能定论的容量刻画，可能与 LVR 中的证据获取与停止决策的信息量估算相关；「自然二分学习器并非最优」这一现象可供核查是否类比启发式 LOOK 策略的次优性，但该文为纯学习理论、无多模态设置，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions

**abstract/A1：** The Littlestone dimension of a hypothesis class equals the smallest number of mistakes an online learner can guarantee against an adaptive adversary. For discrete intervals and unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points, only its order of growth was known. We determine it exactly. For every switch budget $k$ (with both end labels fixed when $k$ is odd), the smallest size on which $d$ mistakes can be forced follows a three-regime law: $d+1$ while $d\\le k$, then $2d-k+1$, and beyond $d=\\lceil 3k/2\\rceil+k-1$ doubling the size adds exactly $k$ mistakes. Unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points correspond to $k=2j$ and size $m+1$, and a single interval gives the thresholds $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\\dots$. The natural learner that waits for a positive example and binary-searches both endpoints is not optimal: it can be forced into one extra mistake for 50,847 of the domain sizes below $10^5$. Upper bounds come from a gap potential and a block-pairing learner, and lower bounds from adversary strategies and a refinement step. These tools give an explicit optimal learner with $O(\\log m)$ time per round, which on random streams makes more mistakes on average than the natural learner. For randomised learners, we compute the randomised Littlestone dimension of thresholds exactly and prove that a greedy adversary forces an explicit closed-form number of expected mistakes on intervals; this bound is within $0.64$ of optimal and, we conjecture, exact (confirmed for $m\\le70$). Exact computation tests every result, and the formulas for every switch budget are machine-checked in Lean 4.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/researchbackup27-sudo/exact-littlestone-intervals

</details>

### 683. [PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28756v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28756

**作者：** Wonsik Shin、Jinju Jang、Junhoo Lee、Yeonjin Chang、Jimyeong Kim、Nojun Kwak

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28756v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28756v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练框架 PSC-Gen，用一个 Physics Agent 迭代规划物理状态并核验生成的关键帧，再将关键帧插值成连续物理序列后仅注入其低频分量，引导视频扩散模型生成符合物理动态的视频。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属视频生成，并非 LVR 研究；但其「粗粒度动态作为条件注入、细节交由生成器」与「规划—核验—修正」循环，可能为 latent 轨迹的粗略监督与可验证状态更新提供概念线索，需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

**comment/C1：** Arxiv Preprint

</details>

### 684. [The Complexity of Oracle-Efficient Realizable Transductive Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28757v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28757

**作者：** Changlong Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28757v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28757v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究可实现直推式在线学习中，仅允许多项式次 ERM oracle 查询的学习器能否达到与显式访问假设类相当的错误界；作者用组合引理构造困难实例，给出了 Ω(√(T log N)) 的期望错误下界，并指出与随机 playout 上界之间的尖锐分离。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，但其「信息论可达 vs 有限 oracle 查询可达」的分离，可能为 LVR 中有限次外部调用（如搜索、验证、证据获取）所能带来的收益上限提供概念参照，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Complexity of Oracle-Efficient Realizable Transductive Learning

**abstract/A1：** In realizable transductive online learning, the learner knows the entire sequence of $T$ instances in advance, and the labels are consistent with one of $N$ hypotheses. With explicit access to the hypothesis class, the halving algorithm makes at most $\\log\_2 N$ mistakes. Can a comparable guarantee be achieved using only polynomially many empirical risk minimization (ERM) queries? We answer this question negatively, even for a weighted-ERM oracle that optimizes arbitrary real-valued linear objectives and returns a complete maximizing hypothesis. For every fixed $β\\in(0,1)$ and every randomized learner making polynomially many oracle queries, there exists a fixed realizable instance with exactly $N=2^{\\lfloor T^β\\rfloor}$ hypotheses on which the learner makes $Ω\_β(\\sqrt{T\\log N})$ mistakes in expectation. This matches the agnostic-rate upper bound achieved by random playout using $O(T)$ oracle calls. The separation persists for much smaller classes as well: along a sequence with $\\log N=Θ((\\log T)^2)$, we establish a mistake lower bound of $\\exp(Ω(\\log T/\\log\\log T))$. Our main technical contribution is a composition lemma that combines two realizable prediction problems such that their mistake lower bounds add, up to a small loss, while their hypothesis class sizes grow only additively. Iterating this lemma yields a family of hard instances spanning the desired parameter regimes, establishing a sharp separation between information-theoretic and oracle-efficient mistake guarantees.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 1 figure

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28759

**作者：** Mohammad Adeel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SP

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 NASA C-MAPSS FD002/FD004 上对涡轮风扇剩余寿命预测中的工况标准化做回顾性对照审计，用引擎不重叠划分、匹配工况的历史基线及多随机种子、工况数、RUL 上限与不对称评分等敏感性检查，重新审视标准化带来的误差下降。

**相关性简评：** 其「匹配历史基线＋配对区间＋指标间权衡」的审计思路，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 表示带来的收益是否只是基线或评价指标选择的产物，但与视觉推理本身无直接联系，需较多迁移判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Operating-Condition Normalization in C-MAPSS: Matched Historical Baselines, Multi-Seed Robustness, and Prognostic-Score Trade-offs

**abstract/A1：** Operating-state changes can obscure turbofan degradation signals, but a reduction in remaining-useful-life (RUL) error after condition-wise standardization may reflect weaknesses of the comparison features instead of a unique benefit of normalization. A controlled retrospective audit examines NASA C-MAPSS FD002 and FD004 with engine-disjoint folds, raw condition identifiers, two constructions of causal history, early-life baselines, and continuous operating-setting correction. Ridge regression, random forests and XGBoost are compared under explicit training-engine-only fitting rules. The previously reported XGBoost FD004 terminal RMSE decreased from 30.38 to 29.08 cycles following six-condition standardization; however, raw sensor values accompanied by condition-matched histories and condition identifiers achieved 28.09 cycles, reversing the naive point estimate ranking, although the paired-engine interval spans zero. For FD002, normalized XGBoost reduced terminal RMSE yet increased the asymmetric NASA score (12,616 to 13,289). Additional model-seed, condition count, RUL-cap, grouped-validation and explanation checks test sensitivity rather than postulating a universally optimal representation. The six clusters reproduce known simulator operating regimes; no new condition discovery algorithm, causal diagnostic method, or field ready prognostic system is claimed. Since the official test endpoints were also used in earlier exploratory comparisons, all newly examined alternatives are reported as retrospective benchmark evidence, not as results from a pristine confirmatory holdout.

</details>

**作者：** Ahmad Dabaja、Rachid El-Azouzi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究无线网络中联邦学习的客户端调度与资源分配，提出统一的上行资源块、轮次期限、更新信息量与能量约束下最小化采样方差的选择框架 RAOCS，并给出带上限的注水式解，在精度接近 OCS 的同时大幅降低每次迭代上传时间。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「在资源预算下选择子集以最小化对整体更新的偏差、并按重要性与成本做注水解分配」的表述，可能为 latent 推理中的视觉证据筛选、支持组合或动态计算预算分配提供形式化类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Joint Client Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Optimal Federated Learning over Wireless Networks

**abstract/A1：** Federated learning often relies on partial client participation because full participation is costly in cross-device wireless systems with limited uplink resources, heterogeneous channel conditions, energy constraints, and strict upload deadlines. However, partial participation introduces sampling variance, causing the sampled update to deviate from the full-participation update. Existing optimal client sampling methods reduce this variance but usually rely on simplified client-count budgets, while wireless-aware scheduling methods account for communication constraints but do not directly optimize sampling variance. This paper proposes resource-aware optimal client sampling (RAOCS), a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints. The resulting problem admits a capped water-filling solution that balances client update importance, wireless resource cost, and energy feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that RAOCS achieves accuracy comparable to that of OCS while reducing the average upload time per iteration by more than a factor of 252.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DiscernBench 基准，评估 LLM 智能体在航空、执法、应急等制度约束场景中「服从/拒绝/上报」的判断能力，并分析多智能体审议过程中的中间判断与「少数信号覆盖」聚合现象。

**相关性简评：** 其上报/拒绝决策与多专家冲突聚合的评价方式，可能为 LVR 中停止与弃权决策、多 latent 假设的筛选合并提供评价视角，但该工作非视觉任务且不涉及内部状态，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings

**abstract/A1：** The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Directions Are Flat: Decomposed-Gradient Flatness for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Many applications of novel view synthesis, such as augmented reality and robotics, can afford only a few input views, since dense capture is costly. With such sparse views, however, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) overfits the training views and degrades at unseen viewpoints. Among the approaches to this problem, flat-minima optimization treats the Gaussians as trainable parameters and steers training toward flat minima, which generalize better, by perturbing the Gaussians with random noise or along the training gradient. However, these perturbations ignore their direction relative to the other training views. Interestingly, we find that the direction of the perturbation determines whether it improves generalization. Specifically, we decompose the gradient of each training view into a component parallel to the average gradient of all views, on which the views agree, and an orthogonal component, on which they disagree. Perturbing along the orthogonal component improves generalization, whereas perturbing along the parallel component does not. We further find that the flatness correction often opposes the reconstruction gradient, shrinking or even reversing the reconstruction step. Based on these findings, we propose DecoFlat, which perturbs each Gaussian along the orthogonal component together with random noise. Furthermore, we introduce a conflict-aware correction, which removes the part of the flatness correction that opposes the reconstruction gradient, and a rescheduling of the spherical-harmonics color, which suppresses the overfitting of view-dependent appearance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoFlat, as a plug-in optimizer, consistently improves vanilla 3DGS and a wide range of sparse-view 3DGS methods.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 689. [Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28827v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28827

**作者：** Ayush Khaitan、Liam Fowl、Tomàs Ortega、Alex Kontorovich、Sanjeev Arora

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28827v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28827v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究让前沿 LLM 在 100 个几何分析开放猜想中先自选自评成功率不低于 50% 的题目并给出成功概率，随后尝试解决并经 Lean 形式化与语义等价检查验证，比较自评置信度与实际解决率。

**相关性简评：** 其「置信度数值严重过度自信、但排序仍保留区分度（AUROC 0.714）」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与自评验证信号的使用方式提供参考，可供核查这类校准偏差是否会削弱以置信度作为停止或证据筛选依据的可靠性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study

**abstract/A1：** How does confidence correlate with actual performance in large language models, when attacking open research-level math problems? We address this question by studying the performance of ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra on a set of 100 open conjectures in geometric analysis. By construction, the model first selected open problems in geometric analysis that it assessed that it had at least a 50\\% chance of proving or disproving, and then assigned a probability of success to each question. 13 questions were then excluded after an audit, and the model was asked to resolve the remaining 87 problems. Its mean stated resolution probability was $0.617$, versus an observed rate of $0.103$ (Brier score $0.351$, ECE $0.513$), thereby demonstrating that the model was systematically over-confident in its self-assessment. However, the scores retained ranking signal (AUROC $0.714$). The model was highly overconfident in probability magnitude but did more often than not assign a high probability of success to the problems that it did resolve, than the problems that it did not. Hence, its probabilities were numerically mis-calibrated but directionally correct. All proofs have been formalized in Lean, thereby verifying correctness, and have been run through a semantic equivalence pipeline to ensure semantic equivalence between the formalized and informal statements. These are exploratory campaign outcomes, not fixed-budget success probabilities. The certificates prove formal statements; for a couple of questions, some geometric inputs are assumed in the lean proofs.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 6th AI-Math Workshop at NeurIPS'26

</details>

### 690. [MQCODet: Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization for UAV-Based RGB-T Tiny Pedestrian Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28850v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28850

**作者：** Hui Li、Jianbo Ma、Hui Luo、Guanglin Qi、Zhixing Wang、Haorui Zuo、Jianlin Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28850v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28850v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向无人机 RGB-T 微小行人检测，提出以模态质量先验引导融合与定位协同优化的检测器，包含动态校正与区域感知融合模块、上下文交互编码器以及模态自适应损失。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「模态质量先验＋跨模态空间对齐」思路可能为视觉证据可靠性加权、噪声或错位条件下的证据筛选提供参考，可供核查这些质量估计能否迁移到推理期状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MQCODet: Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization for UAV-Based RGB-T Tiny Pedestrian Detection

**abstract/A1：** Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based RGB-thermal (RGB-T) remote sensing provides complementary visual and thermal information for pedestrian perception under complex aerial observation conditions. However, detecting tiny pedestrians in UAV-based RGB-T imagery remains challenging due to cross-modal spatial heterogeneity, manifested as modality quality imbalance and spatial position misalignment. Existing RGB-T detectors primarily address these challenges at the feature fusion stage, without establishing an effective coupling between feature fusion and object localization, potentially resulting in suboptimal detection performance. To address this limitation, we introduce a Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization Detector (MQCODet), which extends modality quality from a fusion prior to a localization supervision cue. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Calibration and Region-Aware Fusion (DCRF) module that progressively refines cross-modal spatial alignment and performs region-aware fusion to generate reliable multi-scale features and a scene-level modality quality prior. We further design an Efficient Contextual Interaction (ECI) encoder to enhance multi-scale feature interaction while preserving fine-grained spatial details. Moreover, we propose a Modality-Aware Adaptive (MAA) loss that incorporates the modality prior and object scale to adaptively balance spatial consistency and geometric similarity for localization supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MQCODet surpasses state-of-the-art methods on two UAV-based RGB-T tiny pedestrian detection benchmarks while achieving real-time inference on the edge platform.

</details>

### 691. [PhyMind: Physics-Informed Masked Autoencoding for EEG Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28856

**作者：** A Adith

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28856v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文用物理生成式前向模型（68 个皮层区域的阻尼随机振荡器加 OU 过程，经固定导联场投影）替代 EEG 掩码自编码器的自由解码器，并以频谱似然、动力学残差等约束联合训练，在受控比较中考察编码器 token 的频谱可解码性及下游冻结/微调表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「要求隐状态能被结构化前向模型解释」的思路与 token 级探针评价（且发现可解码性不等于解剖可解释性）可能为 LVR 的 latent 内容监督与「解码增益 vs 真实使用」判别提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhyMind: Physics-Informed Masked Autoencoding for EEG Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** EEG foundation models are pre-trained almost exclusively with masked reconstruction through a free-form decoder, sometimes with hand-crafted spectral targets added, as in MANAS-2. We study what happens when that decoder is replaced by a generative forward model of EEG. PhyMind keeps a standard masked transformer encoder, but its decoder must explain the masked signal through 68 cortical regions, each driven by damped stochastic oscillators and an aperiodic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, projected to the recording's own montage by a fixed boundary-element lead field evaluated per derivation. Training combines masked reconstruction with a Whittle spectral likelihood, an oscillator-dynamics residual, a minimum-norm source prior and a penalised neural residual. In a controlled comparison (same encoder, data, steps and seed), the physics decoder produces encoder tokens whose spectral content is far more linearly decodable than with a masked-autoencoder decoder or with the MANAS-2 objective: mean R^2 on a token-level spectral probe with amplitude-normalised targets is 0.67/0.77/0.77 on three datasets, against 0.24/0.50/0.50 (MAE) and 0.48/0.67/0.66 (MANAS-2 objective), approaching the released 92.8M-parameter MANAS-2 (0.71/0.81/0.80). Downstream gains in the controlled setting are small (four-task mean balanced accuracy 56.6 vs. 53.8 for MAE frozen, 63.8 vs. 62.7 fine-tuned). Region-level features from the physics decoder raise frozen four-class motor-imagery accuracy by 7-14 points, so a 7.2M-parameter model pre-trained on 3k hours of open EEG is comparable to the released MANAS-2 with frozen features (63.0 vs. 61.6). After full fine-tuning, MANAS-2 remains better (66.8 vs. 65.4 for our best model). The inferred sources do not reproduce the lateralisation that a classical inverse solution finds in motor imagery, so we do not claim anatomical interpretability. Code and weights are released.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/Aditharavind/PhyMind

</details>

### 692. [SENSA: Visual-to-Brain Generation with Individualized Subject-State Transfer and Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28872v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28872

**作者：** Yihang Zou、Chunmei Qing、Ruixi Liang、Haichuan Wei、Junpeng Tan、Qifan Yang、Wanxiang Luo、Haodong Li、Xiangmin Xu、Yefeng Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28872v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28872v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SENSA 这一视觉到大脑响应的生成框架：用独立响应先验刻画共享活动，视觉描述子驱动的时空基与共享 Response Refiner 生成响应，并以 Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport 和残差记忆在少量配对数据下做个体化校准。

**相关性简评：** 其把共享活动与图像特异响应显式分离、并以紧凑 subject state 做少样本适配的思路，可能为 LVR 中通用推理状态与证据特异更新的拆分提供概念参照，但领域相距较远，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SENSA: Visual-to-Brain Generation with Individualized Subject-State Transfer and Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Visual-to-brain encoding predicts neural responses to visual stimuli, supporting visual cognition research and neural decoding. However, challenges in disentangling shared from image-specific activity, together with inter-subject distribution shifts and representational heterogeneity, limit accurate encoding and cross-subject generalization with limited calibration data. We introduce SENSA, a structured continuous neural response generation framework that separates shared activity from image-dependent responses and calibrates a compact subject state. An independent response prior captures shared activity, while complementary visual descriptors drive separable sensor-time bases and a shared Response Refiner. Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport adjusts the spatiotemporal expression of shared bases, while Source-Grounded Residual Memory predicts image-dependent corrections in source-response coordinates. Together, they personalize a frozen generator using limited paired support. Experiments demonstrate that the generation backbone outperforms recent generators across three datasets, with image-identity perturbations confirming stimulus specificity. Using only 400 paired images, electroencephalography (EEG) and the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) calibration achieve residual Pearson correlations of 0.1091 and 0.2995, respectively, demonstrating effective brain-response generation and cross-subject adaptation.

**comment/C1：** Includes supplementary material

</details>

### 693. [Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28890v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28890

**作者：** Wang-Chi-Shiun、Wei-Huan Hu、Liu-En-Chi、Liu Zhi Shun、ChengYi Peng、Shin-Jye Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28890v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28890v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在受控「一键」协议下比较稀疏提示医学分割，并提出 Support-Aware Recalibration（SAR）：在 MultiverSeg 的 support–query 融合后加入大核空间门控与通道重校准，用阈值无关的 Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC 在三个数据集上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其融合后的空间/通道门控重校准可能为 LVR 中视觉证据加权与筛选提供机制线索，但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态、动态计算或停止决策，与主线距离较远，可供核查其门控是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)

</details>

### 694. [Gaze Graphs: A Scene-Level Representation of Visual Attention in the Operating Room](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28901v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28901

**作者：** Séraphin Baributsa、Keqi Chen、Vinkle Srivastav、Nicolas Padoy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28901v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28901v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把 gaze graph 作为手术室场景级视觉注意表示，仅用外视角相机联合估计 3D 注视目标与受关注场景实体，并将其用于细粒度手术动作识别和语义场景图生成。

**相关性简评：** 将「看向哪个实体」显式结构化为场景级注意图，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与注意力结构、位置因素分析提供参照；但该工作不涉及 latent 推理状态，与主线的联系需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gaze Graphs: A Scene-Level Representation of Visual Attention in the Operating Room

**abstract/A1：** Purpose: Analyzing clinicians' visual attention from exocentric camera views can support surgical scene understanding without requiring wearable eye trackers. However, existing gaze-following research in the operating room (OR) estimates only 2D gaze locations without identifying attended scene entities or localizing gaze targets in 3D space. In this work, we investigate gaze graphs as a scene-level representation of visual attention that connects clinicians to attended scene entities, and evaluate their utility for fine-grained surgical action recognition and semantic scene graph (SSG) generation. Methods: We extend the public EgoExOR dataset with gaze annotations to create EgoExOR-Gaze, the first benchmark for multi-view gaze graph generation in the OR. We propose a novel architecture that jointly estimates 3D gaze targets and predicts attended entities using only exocentric camera views. Specifically, our approach exploits 3D gaze geometry to sample local visual features across multiple views for attended entity prediction. We further utilize predicted gaze graphs for fine-grained surgical action recognition and SSG generation. Results: For gaze graph generation, our model outperforms both exocentric-only and combined exocentric-egocentric baselines. For surgical action recognition, our model incorporating predicted gaze graphs outperforms both exocentric and egocentric baselines across all evaluated metrics, with particularly strong gains in temporal metrics. For SSG generation, incorporating gaze graphs improves macro-F1 from 0.42 to 0.52 compared to exocentric inputs alone, although performance remains below that achieved with egocentric inputs. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate the value of gaze graphs for surgical action recognition and SSG generation, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling scene-level visual attention even when egocentric views are unavailable.

</details>

### 695. [StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28902v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28902

**作者：** Xinglong Xu、Yuxia Zhu、Siyuan Li、Lixu Tian、Xiaofei Zhao、Yuxin Liu、Caijun Jia、Jintao Chen、Bihui Yu、Alden Cai、Asher Qin、Jingxuan Wei、Cheng Tan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SD

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28902v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28902v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 StudioBench，用 160 个任务和 33 个生成、编辑、检查工具评测通用 MLLM 端到端完成数分钟音视频作品的能力，并通过重建工作流图分析其生产行为与失败模式。

**相关性简评：** 其「检查—选择—修正」质量回路缺失和工具调用次数与质量弱相关的发现，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、停止决策及计算量—收益评价提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation

**abstract/A1：** Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and composition, object structure, motion, and lip sync. All models spontaneously organize multi-stage production workflows without predefined templates. However, higher-quality models exhibit more selective production workflows, whereas additional tool calls alone show little association with quality. These findings identify the missing quality loop of effective inspection, selection, and revision as a key bottleneck in productive audiovisual creation.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://openraiser.github.io/StudioBench/ and code: https://github.com/openraiser/StudioBench . Equal contribution: Xinglong Xu, Yuxia Zhu. Corresponding authors: Asher Qin, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan

</details>

### 696. [Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28917v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28917

**作者：** Haomeng Zhang、Raymond A. Yeh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28917v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28917v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「多样化 3D 可供性定位」任务，要求对同一物体与交互查询预测多个合理区域，并给出基于 transformer 的集合预测模型 Div3DAffordNet，以及用 2D 生成模型加 3D 重建自动合成、辅以轻量人工核验的数据构建流程和 Div3DAfford benchmark。

**相关性简评：** 其多假设集合预测与「一张输入对应多个可能区域」的建模方式，可能与 LVR 中维持多种 latent 假设、以及用视觉证据在候选间筛选的问题形成概念类比，但任务本身属 3D 交互定位，是否可迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding

**abstract/A1：** 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.

</details>

**作者：** Bangxun Tang、Chen Chen

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 XShot：给定同场景另一镜头的参考视频与物体示例图，无需 mask、框或相机位姿，基于视频 Diffusion Transformer 做 in-context 生成实现跨镜头物体插入，并用模型自身对应估计对极几何来引导几何感知的跨镜头注意力；训练上用擦除-恢复数据引擎构造监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** XShot: Cross-Shot Video Object Insertion from a Reference Video

**abstract/A1：** We present XShot, a framework for cross-shot video object insertion, which adds objects to a shot by watching another shot of the same scene. Video productions show a scene through many shots, and objects added to one shot must appear consistently in the others. Most video editors take the appearance of new objects from reference images and their location from a text prompt, a mask or an edited keyframe, leaving this consistency to the user. XShot reads both from a reference video of another shot, which need not be aligned with the target, and needs no mask, box or camera pose. We build on a video Diffusion Transformer and formulate the task as in-context generation over the reference video, a few images of the objects and the target video. A geometry-aware cross-shot attention estimates the epipolar geometry between the two shots from the model's own correspondences and uses it to guide where the target reads the reference and the exemplars. We train XShot with an erase-and-restore data engine: objects are erased from one shot of a film or a multi-camera recording and restored from another shot of the scene. Experiments show that XShot places objects more accurately and renders them more faithfully than open-source and commercial video editors, while leaving the rest of the shot intact.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables

</details>
