### 698. [Learning Land-Surface Hydrology World Model from Satellite Observations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28963v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28963

**作者：** Suya Li、Zekun Qi、Xiaochong Xu、Duo Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28963v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28963v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 LandWM：以降雨为动作、从七年 SMAP 与 CYGNSS 观测学习地表水 latent 世界模型，用物理观测算子把隐状态锚定到土壤水，并以质量守恒约束状态对降雨的响应，再用替换部件和人为加暴雨等方式检验状态含义。

**相关性简评：** 其「高预测精度不等于隐状态有可读含义，需用多种干预检验状态对驱动量的因果响应」的评估思路，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正承载视觉证据、以及不同干预下响应是否一致提供可借鉴的协议。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Land-Surface Hydrology World Model from Satellite Observations

**abstract/A1：** A world model should tell us not only what will happen, but what would happen under a different action. Learned Earth models now forecast remarkably well, yet forecast skill says little about what their state means or how it responds to a changed driver. We build LandWM, a world model of land-surface water in which rain is the action, learned from seven years of SMAP and CYGNSS observations: physical observation operators tie its latent state to soil water, and a mass-conserving balance governs how that state responds to rain. Over the U.S. Southern Great Plains, the model, never shown a soil-moisture value, tracks 28 in-situ probes as well as the operational SMAP Level-4 product, even from CYGNSS alone, and a storm added to the forcing of a station's cell wets its soil as natural storms wet the probes. Replace either piece and the forecasts stay, but the meaning goes: with neural operators, only a probe fitted to the stations finds the soil water; with a generic recurrent transition, rain on a single cell barely moves it. Yet when the same rain covers the whole region the two transitions swap roles, and the conserving one responds too weakly. Grounding makes a world model readable; its response to actions must be tested under more than one kind of intervention.

**comment/C1：** Tech Report

</details>

### 699. [What the Background Hides: Thresholds, Vocabularies and Collisions in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28966v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28966

**作者：** Wendong Yao、Binhua Huang、Soumyabrata Dev

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28966v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28966v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文审计13种免训练开放词汇语义分割方法的背景类配置，复跑其中7种，比较官方设置与统一协议下的mIoU差异、方法排名变化及背景词与类名冲突。

**相关性简评：** 其揭示的按数据集阈值、背景词表和词名碰撞对视觉-语言评测的强烈影响，可能可供核查LVR中基于CLIP标签或视觉证据筛选的评价是否被后处理与词表混淆项污染。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What the Background Hides: Thresholds, Vocabularies and Collisions in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) built on CLIP has advanced rapidly, with methods typically ranked by mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) across standard benchmarks. On datasets with a background class, however, implementations rely on per-dataset thresholds and background word lists that are rarely documented or unified (11 of 13 surveyed methods configure per-dataset background decisions). We audit configurations and papers of 13 training-free OVSS methods, re-run seven from official codebases, and compare official settings against a strict unified protocol under pre-registered contracts. The protocol gap depends strongly on the benchmark---ranging from 22.8 mIoU points on PASCAL VOC (VOC21) to 0.1 points (indistinguishable from zero) on ADE20K---and alters pairwise method rankings. Despite large shifts in absolute mIoU, most of the reported improvement of later CLIP-only methods over SCLIP remains under the unified protocol (roughly 79% of the published gain). Decomposing official background handling shows that it combines numeric settings and class-name files whose dominant component reverses across benchmarks, while no tested tuning-free rule transfers reliably across all datasets. Moreover, exact collisions between background words and target names---present in six of seven official COCO-Object configurations through "bed"---make affected classes unpredictable under official post-processing, while the main per-class drops under language-model-generated vocabularies on VOC21 are largely attributable to a few generated terms. We offer reporting recommendations and release our evaluation code, frozen configurations, contracts, and a collision-check tool.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding. Code: https://github.com/WendongYao/ovss-background-audit ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24338613

</details>

### 700. [AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28979v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.28979

**作者：** Zhilu Yang、Kun Yang、Shiyan Wang、Anqi Xu、Xinran Huang、Yizheng Jiao、Huan Yang、Rolandos Alexandros Potamias

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.28979v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.28979v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AlignHand，在冻结的单目手部重建先验之上做多视角校准：先以跨视角关节观测及其可靠性估计建立共享度量参考完成对齐，再按解剖区域选择性融合互补表面证据，并用局部图像特征预测有界残差做像素对齐细化。

**相关性简评：** 其「按可靠性加权、按区域筛选并融合多源视觉证据」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与多假设取舍提供可核查的外部线索，但该文属 3D 几何重建任务，与推理状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior

**abstract/A1：** Modern monocular hand estimators recover detailed 3D meshes from individual images, yet effectively leveraging their predictions across multiple views remains challenging. Independently predicted meshes can disagree in scale, placement, and articulation, limiting the integration of complementary multi-view information. Hence, we present AlignHand, a calibrated multi-view framework that builds on a frozen monocular hand reconstruction prior to align and enhance its predictions. Specifically, AlignHand refines cross-view joint observations and estimates their reliability to establish a shared metric reference for alignment. Once the meshes are brought into a common frame, their complementary surface evidence is selectively fused across anatomical regions, followed by pixel-aligned refinement that predicts bounded residual displacements from local image features. This global-to-local integration enables AlignHand to exploit complementary observations while preserving the strong monocular prior. Extensive experiments on DexYCB-MV, HanCo, and HO3D-Eval-MV demonstrate that AlignHand achieves the lowest MPVPE and MPJPE among the compared methods under the respective evaluation protocols, reducing MPVPE by 30.1%, 29.1%, and 8.0%, respectively, compared with a matched geometry baseline.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 6 figures. Project page and code: https://ada-zy2425.github.io/AlignHand/

</details>

### 701. [RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29026v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29026

**作者：** Sadia Mubashshira、John Quarles、Kevin Desai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29026v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29026v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RAGA，从单张照片约 1 秒构建可动画的全身 Gaussian 头像，并在有新图像时把观测映射到规范化 UV 空间、按可见性与视角加权累加后重新解码，实现无需重训或梯度优化的「刷新」。

**相关性简评：** 其将多次观测以可见性和角度加权的 running sums 累积为可复用的规范化潜表示、再交由固定解码器使用，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与状态增量更新、以及训练分布外仍使用融合证据的问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo

**abstract/A1：** Avatars created from a single photo are fixed once made: regions the photo never showed, such as the back of a garment, are hallucinated and remain that way. We present Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars (RAGA), a full-body Gaussian avatar that is created from a single image in about one second and can be refreshed whenever new images of the same person become available, without retraining or gradient-based optimization. RAGA maps each new observation into canonical UV space, accumulates it as visibility- and angle-weighted running sums, and re-decodes the fused map with the same decoder used for the photo. Although this decoder is trained only on single images, it makes use of the fused evidence. On 163 clips from five datasets, RAGA created from one photo outperforms LHM, LHM++ and IDOL, including on three datasets never used in training. Refreshing from later frames adds 0.49 dB PSNR overall and 0.68 dB on views turned at least 135° from the photo, where SSIM and LPIPS also improve. Given the same 16 images on all clips, LHM++ gains 0.15 dB, against 0.48 dB for RAGA. Creating an avatar takes 1.08 s and animating it 48.1 ms per frame on a laptop RTX 3080 GPU, with body fitting and matting included in creation and pose estimation included in animation. Code will be released on GitHub.

</details>

### 702. [Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29028v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29028

**作者：** Kelsey Sikes、Sarath Sreedharan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29028v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29028v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把目标错误指定问题形式化为适配 LLM 的版本，并在五个 IPC 规划域、四个 LLM 上检验提示模型主动向用户提问澄清真实意图是否比不提问更能识别目标。

**相关性简评：** 「主动提问以降低目标不确定性」与 LVR 中筛选视觉证据、决定何时继续获取信息或停止的决策问题概念相近，可供核查；但该工作无线视觉状态与 latent 推理，联系仅为概念层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent

**abstract/A1：** As with conventional AI agents, a common source of misalignment between Large Language Models (LLMs) and their human users is misspecified goals. Often, this happens when the human has skewed beliefs about the system's model and provides it with information that causes behavior different from what they expected, with potentially unwanted side effects. To ensure goal alignment, one solution would be for the LLM to ask the human questions about their objectives. However, it has been well-documented that LLMs most often provide default responses to user requests rather than try and ask questions to clarify their true intent. In this paper, we address these challenges by adapting a novel formulation for the objective misspecification problem to work with LLMs. We then test if LLMs that are prompted to ask questions about a user's true underlying objectives are better at identifying them compared to those that do not. We evaluate our method using four state-of-the-art LLMs tested on five standard IPC domains, showing that for some domains, asking questions greatly improved model performance.

</details>

### 703. [Hypothesis Generation and Semantic Attribution in Inverse Perturbation Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29055v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29055

**作者：** Pascal Passigan、Manolis Kellis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29055v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29055v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在基因调控网络中做逆向扰动建模：用稀疏、类型化的图神经网络从基线与终点表达恢复被扰动基因，再借助积分梯度与路径 conductance 把干预提名归因到基因状态、类型化消息与残差连接。

**相关性简评：** 其沿「基线→目标」路径归因、并以消息删除效应检验归因的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与因果作用评价提供表述线索，但领域相距较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hypothesis Generation and Semantic Attribution in Inverse Perturbation Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Understanding gene regulatory relationships at scale can help identify intervention points and anticipate unintended effects, but connecting a black-box model's learned computation to biological knowledge remains difficult. We investigate whether a sparse, typed gene network can generate inspectable hypotheses for steering malignant transcriptional programs toward expression patterns associated with favorable prognosis. Using LINCS L1000 CRISPR/Cas9 profiles paired with matched plate controls, we train a graph neural network to recover the perturbed gene from baseline and endpoint expression. Nodes combine ProTrek-derived protein representations with expression features; edges encode signed regulatory relationships and other gene interactions. We use this inverse formulation to nominate interventions for a desired multigene expression change in a specified cancer-cell context, and use integrated gradients and conductance along a path from the cell baseline toward the requested endpoint to attribute each nomination to gene states, typed messages, and residual connections. In A549, the model nominates TTK although its expression is unchanged in the request; the account assigns supporting credit through the checkpoint-associated MAD1L1 relationship and opposing credit through the E2F4 transcriptional-regulatory channel. Across 333 screened nominations in nine held-out cell lines, request-path attribution shows positive line-averaged correspondence with finite message-deletion effects at every transition. Existing TTK knockout measurements show requested-direction agreement across other markers at the 98.2nd percentile (10 wells), and ten of seventeen measured cases in the illustrative screen meet the predefined support criterion. These analyses make competing biological accounts of a nomination examinable and open to experimental test.

**comment/C1：** 50 pages, 12 figures

</details>

### 704. [Projecting Beauty: Transferring Image Aesthetic Analysis onto 3D Heritage and Urban Scenes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29071v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29071

**作者：** Sophia Kovalenko、Alexander M. Rusnak、Vittoria Meroni、Yasmine Kroknes-Gomez、Frédéric Kaplan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29071v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29071v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究把图像美学评估迁移到3D遗产与城市场景点云，比较三种避开大规模人工标注的密集美学伪标签路线（分数提升、冻结骨干回归头、视觉语言文本查询），发现文本查询最连贯，并设计部件级人工评分协议以定位人机分歧。

**相关性简评：** 其「从特征中投影去除类文本方向以提升跨模型一致性」及以跨模型一致性检验伪标签可靠性的做法，可能可供核查如何在latent状态中分离任务相关内容与语义干扰、以及如何评估表示相似度的可信度，但与LVR推理机制无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Projecting Beauty: Transferring Image Aesthetic Analysis onto 3D Heritage and Urban Scenes

**abstract/A1：** Judgments about the beauty of buildings and streets inform architectural design, urban planning, and heritage conservation, yet increasingly rely on scanned 3D models over material fabric. Automatic aesthetic assessment remains largely confined to 2D photographs. We ask what survives when image aesthetic assessment crosses this dimensional gap to produce dense, per-point aesthetic descriptions of heritage and urban point clouds. We examine three routes that sidestep costly, and sometimes ethically dubious, human labeling at scale: (1) lifting scalar scores from image aesthetic models (NIMA, SAAN) onto geometry; (2) training Aesthetic Visual Analysis (AVA) regression heads on frozen vision backbones (DINOv3, TIPS, SigLIP2, PE, RADSeg) or, in a 3D-native variant, a generalist point encoder on feed-forward AVA reconstructions; and (3) querying lifted vision-language features with a natural-language aesthetic label, taking similarity as a score. The two supervised routes transfer poorly: heads fitting AVA in-domain produce architectural class profiles that neither reproduce one another nor track other signals, while the 3D-native probe stays near chance due to reconstruction geometry quality. Text querying is markedly more coherent. Projecting out the class-text direction from point features raises mean cross-model agreement on architectural part profiles from +0.035 to +0.352, and from +0.113 to +0.293 per point; the four backbones passing a semantic sanity check correlate at 0.31-0.73, while the failing one remains an outlier. Since model agreement is not agreement with human aesthetic perception, we detail a part-aware rating protocol to clarify where human and automatic ratings disagree. We provide a reproducible transfer protocol, an account of which pseudo-labeling routes carry signal, and dense aesthetic pseudo-labels meant as hypotheses rather than ground truth.

</details>

### 705. [HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29094v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29094

**作者：** Wen Xu、Xiaomin Zhang、Yucheng Yang、Danny Liu、Xunlong Gui、Fei Huang、Sha Meng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29094v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29094v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向广告推荐场景，提出 HME-PFD：把仅训练期可见的 privileged features 接入 MoE 学生模型的路由模块，用硬编码与可学习路由根据这些特征的可得性和取值动态分配专家，以应对特征部分覆盖、分布异质的数据；在两项后点击转化预测任务上优于基线。

**相关性简评：** 该文按「训练期特权信号是否可用及强弱」来条件化路由与算力分配，可能为 LVR 中依据视觉证据可得性动态决定是否继续看、加算力或停止提供一种可核查的类比思路，但领域与模态距离较远，需进一步判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HME-PFD: Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer knowledge from large teacher models to smaller student models, facilitating efficient serving of machine learning systems. In the context of ads recommendation, privileged features distillation (PFD) extends KD by allowing the teacher model to leverage privileged features, i.e., features available only during training, to enhance distillation performance. However, in real-world scenarios, privileged features often have limited coverage and exhibit heterogeneous distributions, resulting in training examples of varying importance for distillation and model learning. We propose Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Privileged Feature Distillation (HME-PFD), a novel approach that incorporates privileged features into the routing module of a Mixture-of-Experts-based student model. Our method introduces both hard-coded and learnable routing modules, enabling the student to dynamically determine expert assignment based on the availability and values of privileged features. This design allows the student model to better handle the heterogeneous data scenario, where privileged features are partially observed, by differentiating between high- and low-signal samples. Extensive experiments on two post-click conversion prediction tasks demonstrate that HME-PFD consistently outperforms baseline methods. Our results show that leveraging privileged features for expert routing in the student model leads to improved model performance, even when privileged features are incomplete or sparse.

</details>

<a id="paper-706"></a>

### 706. [TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29099v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29099

**作者：** Atakan Topcu、Mohammadhossein Momeni、Alfredo De Goyeneche、Michael Lustig

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29099v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29099v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TesseraFlow，一种用于动态医学影像反问题重建的复数像素空间 flow 先验：全局编码器每步只读低分辨率视图，浅解码器在早期步骤用该视图、后期改用全分辨率时空 tile，配合随机网格平移与 re-noising 的 ReTile 采样器，大幅降低每帧 GPU 时间。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身是医学图像重建而非视觉推理，但其「早期步骤只做低分辨率计算、后期再细化」的分阶段算力分配可能可供核查 LVR 中动态计算预算与粗到细状态更新的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems

**abstract/A1：** Generative priors are state-of-the-art for modeling medical images in image reconstruction tasks, but reconstruction with video priors takes tens of seconds to minutes per frame. Latent priors inherit the errors of their autoencoder, the memory of pixel-space whole-frame priors grows with the frame size, and pixel-space patch priors are slow for two reasons. First, their deep networks process every frame at full resolution at every sampling step, even though early steps resolve only low frequencies. Second, their samplers spend many network evaluations per sampling step on overlapping windows, multiple re-noising rounds, or backpropagation through the prior. We introduce TesseraFlow, a complex-valued pixel-space flow prior that reduces the first cost. A global encoder reads a low-resolution view of every frame once per sampling step. A single shallow decoder operates on this view during early steps and on full-resolution space-time tiles during later steps, so no network processes a whole frame at full resolution. Our sampler, ReTile, addresses the second reason. We use randomized grid shifting at every sampling step along with re-noising, which acts as a stochastic gradient instead of computing overlapping tiles, so a single network pass per sampling step suffices. On its own, ReTile speeds up an existing global-context patch prior by 6-9x, and our prior adds a further 3-5x speedup. TesseraFlow reconstructs about one 256x256 frame per second, 20-367x faster than patch and latent video priors, and can match or exceed the best generative baseline on cardiac, brain, and abdominal MRI and lung CT, at a fraction of its GPU time.

</details>

**title/T1：** Pain Reassessment from Pulse Waveforms with Language Model Explanations

**abstract/A1：** Routine photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a continuous physiological signal for pain reassessment between self-reports. Whether prior recordings provide an individualized physiological reference beyond care-process timing remains unresolved. Across 52,082 report-linked assessments from 21,514 patients in MIMIC-III critical care and MC-MED emergency care, we evaluate a workflow that pairs longitudinal PPG representations with local evidence-linked language interpretation. Among 27 methods, source-selected full-history models achieved average precision of 0.824 from critical to emergency care and 0.822 in reverse. Removing historical pulse-run representations while retaining reassessment availability and elapsed time lowered critical-to-emergency four-hour within-patient concordance from 0.718 to 0.534. This comparison supports the contribution of prior pulse-run representations to within-patient ordering beyond timing cues. Across 2,905 test patients, a local Qwen model interpreting frozen predictions achieved a 94.7% patient-equal pass rate on automated evidence checks after at most one revision. Longitudinal pulse context and evidence-linked language interpretation support a patient-centred workflow for pain reassessment.

### 708. [The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29133v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29133

**作者：** Wei-Jung Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29133v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29133v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析「静态同任务重试」策略：任务失败后原样重置提示与工作区重试，直到验证成功或达到尝试上限，并以幸存者选择框架证明每次完成成本不低于一次性服务，再按现有基准运行记录重放估计不同上限下的完成率与成本。

**相关性简评：** 其区分「平均每次完成成本」与「新增一次尝试带来的边际成本」，可能可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 额外计算的收益—成本核算与停止决策的评价口径，但该分析针对无反馈的智能体重试，未涉及视觉状态，迁移性待定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion

**abstract/A1：** Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. We then arrange each task's existing benchmark runs in different orders, stop each sequence at verified success or the attempt cap, and average the resulting completion and spending at each supported cap. For one OpenHands configuration, replay estimates completion of 59.7 percent with one attempt and 70.0 percent with four, while cost per completion rises from about USD 0.70 to USD 1.32. The recorded trade-off describes fixed configurations on the available tasks. Choosing a cap requires comparing the additional spending with the application's value for the additional completions.

</details>

### 709. [Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation via Topology-Aware Distillation and Progressive Kinematic Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29163v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29163

**作者：** Kanglei Zhou、Zikai Hao、Liyuan Wang、Xiaohui Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29163v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29163v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建模拟结构缺失的手部基准 IncNYU，并提出 InsHaPE 框架，用拓扑感知蒸馏与沿运动链的渐进推理，在部分关节持续缺失时仍给出解剖一致的姿态估计。

**相关性简评：** 其沿拓扑链的逐步结构化推理与关系先验蒸馏，可能为 LVR 中关系结构保留、证据缺失下的状态更新提供概念线索；但属三维感知任务，与多模态推理相距较远，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation via Topology-Aware Distillation and Progressive Kinematic Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Hand pose estimation aims to recover the spatial configuration of hand joints from visual observations and serves as a fundamental perception module for downstream systems that rely on complete and topologically consistent hand representations. Most existing methods are developed under the assumption of fully articulated hand structures and tend to produce unstable or implausible predictions when parts of the kinematic structure are persistently absent, resulting in degraded performance or even system failure despite available partial observations. To study this challenge, we construct IncNYU, a physiologically constrained benchmark that simulates structural incompleteness through morphological modification of complete hand models and retains reference locations for both intact and synthetically removed regions. Based on this benchmark, we propose InsHaPE, an Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation framework designed to remain robust under structural incompleteness while preserving performance on standard, fully articulated hands. Built on hierarchical kinematic modeling, InsHaPE introduces two complementary components. First, a topology-aware distillation strategy transfers joint-level and relational priors from fully articulated hand representations, providing anatomically consistent initialization under missing structures. Second, a progressive kinematic reasoning module performs structured inference along the kinematic chain, enabling complete and anatomically consistent pose estimation under severe structural variations. Extensive experiments on NYU/IncNYU, together with external validation on MSRA, demonstrate that InsHaPE improves robustness under structural incompleteness while maintaining competitive performance on complete hands. System-level evaluations further show that InsHaPE improves robustness for downstream applications that require fixed-topology hand pose representations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)

</details>

### 710. [PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29184v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29184

**作者：** Conghan Yue、Yuanjie Chen、Yunyan Xiao、Zeyu Peng、Xingsong Ye、Ya Gao、Yanglin Huang、WeiYao Zhang、Yue Han、Zhineng Chen、Yu-Gang Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29184v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29184v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PhyCoVE，一个覆盖刚体、弹性体与流体的物理反事实视频编辑基准（533 例、110 段源视频），并设计衡量生成视频复现多少物理变化的 counterfactual fidelity 指标，评测了七个开源与商业视频编辑模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「只改外观、不改演化」的失败诊断与「变化复现比例」指标，可能可供核查 latent 状态是否保留物理动力学与反事实因果变化，并为评价推理结果对场景演化的贡献提供思路，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Physical counterfactual video editing turns a source video and a language-specified physical edit at a given execution frame into a counterfactual video that shows how the scene would evolve after the edit. Existing evaluations with counterfactual target videos mainly cover object removal or specific rigid-body motions, although real scenes also involve elastic deformation, fluid flow, and interactions among rigid bodies, elastic solids, and fluids. We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object. For the simulated cases, a language model proposes scene designs, coding agents build them with solvers suited to each material and physically based rendering and then simulate each edit from the source scene state, and humans check every stage. For the real cases, we record continuously from one camera position before and after each edit. We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces. We evaluate seven open-source and commercial video editing models and find that counterfactual fidelity ranks them nearly as human preference does, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The models change how a scene looks but rarely how it evolves, whereas a physical edit requires understanding the dynamics that it changes. Physical counterfactual video editing thus remains far from solved, and PhyCoVE provides a foundation for developing and evaluating methods for it.

</details>

### 711. [THETA: Heat Diffusion as a Structural Prior for Cross-Domain Transfer in Graph Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29210v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29210

**作者：** Haonan Liu、Shuo Wang、Zhao Kang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29210v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29210v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 THETA，用热核签名（HKS）作为基于拓扑的结构先验，将多尺度热扩散的节点「热回返」特征与属性结合，用于图基础模型的跨域预训练与少样本适配。

**相关性简评：** 其多尺度热扩散描述子可能为刻画 LVR 中 latent 状态在局部—全局范围内的传播与回返结构提供可核查的表示几何类比，但论文本身面向图跨域迁移，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** THETA: Heat Diffusion as a Structural Prior for Cross-Domain Transfer in Graph Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across domains with heterogeneous node attributes and graph structures. However, relations inferred from node attributes can rely on domain-specific feature semantics, limiting their transferability to unseen graphs, particularly in low-label regimes. We propose THETA (Topology-aware HEat-based TrAnsfer), a graph foundation model that leverages Heat Kernel Signatures (HKS) as a topology-based structural prior for cross-domain transfer. By characterizing nodes' heat-return behavior across diffusion scales, HKS provides a common structural descriptor across graphs without requiring aligned attribute semantics, complementing feature-based relations with information about local and multiscale connectivity. THETA incorporates this prior into both pre-training and few-shot adaptation. During pre-training, it combines HKS with node attributes to construct refined graph views and trains a shared encoder via contrastive learning. During adaptation, it uses HKS to guide edge-weight adjustment and prototype refinement while keeping the encoder frozen and retaining the contribution of labeled support nodes. Through HKS, THETA uses structural information from heat diffusion to guide both representation learning and few-shot adaptation with unlabeled target-domain data. Extensive experiments across diverse graph domains demonstrate that THETA consistently outperforms existing baselines on downstream tasks, highlighting the value of heat diffusion as a structural prior for transferable graph representations.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出从两张第一人称端点图像生成连贯 3D 人体运动序列的任务，并用两阶段扩散框架在一个模型中统一端点姿态估计与时序一致的运动补全。

**相关性简评：** 其“在端点约束下扩散生成中间序列”并强调时序连续性与物理一致性的思路，可能为 LVR 中受证据端点约束的 latent 推理轨迹生成与状态更新提供概念启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/gaogehan/Ego-HMB.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

### 713. [Curvature Mismatch and Local Errors in Galaxy Property Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29224v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29224

**作者：** Austin Lutterbach、Angus Hoy、Jasper Chong、Aman Kumar、Michael J. Smith

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29224v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29224v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在五个预训练编码器的星系嵌入上拟合线性探针，提出由流形第二基本形式与探针法向分量内积给出的「probe-facing curvature」，并通过干预该曲率项评估内在几何对探针误差的贡献，在星系属性估计上获得小幅局部 R² 提升。

**相关性简评：** 其核心观察——信息虽在表示中但线性探针无法读取，部分误差来自表示流形的曲率——可为判断 VLM 内部状态是否真正保留视觉细节提供表示几何的诊断视角，曲率分解与干预能否用于 latent 状态分析可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Curvature Mismatch and Local Errors in Galaxy Property Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Linear probes are widely used to evaluate learned representations and infer physical quantities from unlabelled data. The probe's predictions are from an affine function in ambient space restricted to the underlying representation, and consequently, even a representation that has complete information needed to predict a target can produce systematic probe errors when that information is encoded in a form inaccessible to the linear probe. Here we share that some of this probing error is due to the innate geometry of the manifold. Linear probes, when evaluated on a curved manifold, generally have a nonzero intrinsic Hessian (what we colloquially call "probe-facing curvature") given by $\\langle w\_N,\\mathrm{II}\\rangle$, the manifold's second fundamental form dotted with the probe's normal component. We fit linear probes to galaxy embeddings from five pretrained encoders and intervene on this curvature term to evaluate its contribution to the probe performance. We find that keeping this inherited curvature improves the local fit where it matches the label's curvature. Removing the curvature component of the probe where it does not match the label curvature also provides improvements, and correcting it in every neighbourhood raises held-out local $R^2$ by 0.006 to 0.010 on galaxies, gaining more where the two curvatures disagree. We isolated these gains to be from the underlying geometry and not an automatic guarantee from least squares training.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 9th Workshop on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences (ML4PS 2026)

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29255

**作者：** Pinaki Prasad Guha Neogi、Spyros Mastorakis、Ankur Mallick、Saravan Rajmohan、Victor Rühle

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NoeVera，一个面向 LLM 服务系统配置优化的 agentic「第二大脑」：将论文、代码、基准与实验结果组织为带来源的持久知识库（源证据、可复用综合、agent 记忆三层），由决策感知检索组装证据包、按角色分工推理并按需调用模拟器，再把结论写回为限定适用范围的证据记录。

**相关性简评：** 其「决策还缺少哪些证据」的检索、模拟器调用预算下的配置搜索与停止，以及带来源和适用范围限定的证据写回，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的获取和终止判断提供概念参照，但任务领域为服务系统调优，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?

**abstract/A1：** With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 2 figures

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Denoised but Not Improved: What EEG Denoising Does to a Downstream Task

**abstract/A1：** Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is routinely denoised before it reaches a downstream model, and the denoising literature scores a method by how closely its output matches a clean reference waveform. That reference does not exist for real scalp recordings: it is synthesized by adding artifact templates to signals merely presumed clean, and even an exact separation would return cortical activity blurred by volume conduction rather than the activity itself. Fidelity to it is therefore an unvalidatable objective, and whether it predicts any downstream benefit has gone largely unexamined. We report an audit that examines it. Holding a seizure-detection pipeline fixed and varying only the preprocessing stage, we find that five standard denoising methods, spanning analytic, cross-channel and supervised deep families, all fail to improve on the unprocessed signal, and most degrade it. To say what such a stage must instead do, we formalize a label-only, classifier-free probe that reads it by the separability geometry it induces on task-relevant features, decomposing any change into a between-class distance and a within-class scatter term. On a transform that does improve the task, the probe attributes the entire gain to a roughly one-quarter reduction of within-class scatter, with class separation statistically unchanged. What a downstream model benefits from is therefore variance suppression on task-relevant structure, which waveform-fidelity metrics neither measure nor reward.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the IEEE Symposium on CI in Health and Medicine

</details>

### 716. [MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29274v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29274

**作者：** Tianxing Wang、Mingming Zhao、Shuai Huang、Chaoyue Niu、Huiyang Xu、Fan Wu、Guihai Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29274v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29274v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MetaSkill 两层框架：方法层从 26 种精选方法中挑选并把抽象角色绑定到任务对象，执行层据此确定中间目标、协调原生技能并指导修复或方法重选；在 SkillsBench 与 ToolHop 上均优于所评估基线。

**相关性简评：** 「抽象方法角色—中间目标—修复/重选」的编排结构可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、停止与再规划决策形成类比，可供核查抽象方法表示能否约束推理轨迹；但材料未涉及视觉或多模态证据，联系仍属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, including appendices. The MetaSkill library is provided as ancillary material

</details>

### 717. [DriveOddsBench: Are Driving Video World Models Aligned with Real-World Odds?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29275v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29275

**作者：** Jiaxi Liu、Keshu Wu、Bin Ran、Xiaopeng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29275v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29275v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出预注册基准 DriveOddsBench，用真实未来在生成样本中的秩均匀性检验，在 200 段 Argoverse 2 历史、11 个驾驶世界模型的 35,200 个采样未来上检验采样是否与真实概率对齐。

**相关性简评：** 其无需概率标签的秩检验与「各模型普遍低估不确定性」的诊断，可能为评估 LVR 采样状态是否匹配真实后续分布、以及停止决策的置信度校准提供评价线索；但对象是驾驶视频生成而非 latent 推理，可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DriveOddsBench: Are Driving Video World Models Aligned with Real-World Odds?

**abstract/A1：** Video world models predict how a scene will evolve, and their sampled futures are increasingly used in place of the real one, from planning to simulation. These uses assume that the samples are aligned with real-world odds, with each future appearing among them as often as it would follow the same history in reality, yet current evaluations only score how real each sample looks. Testing this assumption on real driving data is hard for three reasons. Each recorded history has only one real future, so the true probabilities are unknown. Physical quantities must be read from video, where reading errors can look like model errors. Finally, the many possible analyses invite selective reporting. We introduce DriveOddsBench, a pre-registered benchmark that addresses all three. First, if the samples follow the real distribution, the rank of the real outcome among them is uniform in every history, so pooled ranks test them without probability labels. Second, one validated instrument reads the same quantities, such as the lead-vehicle gap and the ego motion, from the generated futures and from the real future, which first passes through the world model's autoencoder so that both are read alike. Third, all confirmatory analyses were frozen before any test clip was measured. We test eleven general and driving world models on 200 held-out Argoverse 2 histories in five scenario families, with 35,200 generated futures. None is aligned, and every model underestimates its uncertainty. The real outcome falls outside the range of all 16 samples in 28-61% of cases instead of the 11.8% expected under the real distribution. Five models are significantly skewed, in opposite directions, and the largest errors are in the ego motion. Nine models beat climatology without being aligned, and among these models neither type nor scale predicts which comes closest.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://hhjj233.github.io/DriveOddsBench-page/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/DriveOddsBench

</details>

### 718. [ContinuLoc: Continuous Pose Inference over Neural Fields for UAV Geo-Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29276v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29276

**作者：** Weikun Zhou、Jinliang Lin、Yu Zang、Lin Xie、Haiqing Fu、Sheng Ao、Shangshu Yu、Zhiming Luo、Cheng Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29276v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29276v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ContinuLoc，把地理参考地图编码为可连续查询的语义神经场，将 UAV 跨视角定位表述为 4DoF 位姿空间（地面位置、平面朝向、视角尺度）上的显式优化，并借助共享语义特征空间中的全局描述子按需评估位姿假设，推理由粗到细逐步集中到高兼容区域。

**相关性简评：** 其「按需评估假设＋由粗到细收敛」的搜索与验证结构，可能与 latent 推理中的假设筛选、计算分配与停止决策有概念联系，可供核查；但论文属机器人地理定位任务，与视觉推理表示的关联需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ContinuLoc: Continuous Pose Inference over Neural Fields for UAV Geo-Localization

**abstract/A1：** Cross-view UAV geo-localization involves three design choices: how to represent the UAV observation, how to represent the geo-referenced map, and how to infer pose from their interaction. The dominant paradigm organizes the map as a discretized 2DoF candidate library, coupling map representation to pose inference and thus bounding spatial localization precision by candidate sampling resolution. We decouple map representation from pose inference by encoding the geo-referenced map as a continuously queryable semantic neural field, enabling localization to be formulated as explicit optimization over a continuous 4DoF pose space parameterized by 2D ground position, in-plane heading, and viewing scale. Pose hypotheses are evaluated on demand using global descriptors in a shared semantic feature space, bypassing the sampling bottleneck of retrieval. We learn 4DoF pose-sensitive visual representations under full 4DoF supervision provided by ContinuScenes, a multi-city benchmark with dense near-nadir UAV imagery and complete pose annotations. Inference proceeds hierarchically, progressing from broad pose-space coverage to adaptive concentration on high-compatibility regions. Experiments demonstrate substantial gains over representative localization paradigms under progressively stricter 4DoF accuracy criteria. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhouWeikun/ContinuLoc/

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 719. [Prompt-Consistent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29312v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29312

**作者：** Lingyun Xing、Wenning Hao、Kai Jiang、Dawei Jin、Xiaohan Zhang、Xiaoxiong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29312v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29312v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究跨视角目标地理定位中的「提示不服从」过拟合现象，发现模型在点击点移动或移除时预测几乎不变，遂构建多目标数据集 CVOGL-MO 并提出跨视角同场景多目标对比损失，使同场景不同点击点获得区分性表示，同时设计提示敏感性评价指标。

**相关性简评：** 其「提示敏感性/预测漂移」诊断可用于核查 VLM 是否真正依赖所指定的视觉证据而非场景捷径，多目标对比监督也可能为提示条件下的证据筛选与表示区分提供线索；但任务本身是检索式定位，不涉及 latent 推理状态，需阅读原文判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Prompt-Consistent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization

**abstract/A1：** Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object indicated by a click point in a ground or drone query image within a satellite reference image. Through a quantitative prompt-sensitivity evaluation, we find that existing CVOGL methods suffer from a prompt-disobeying overfitting problem: when the click point is moved or removed, their predictions barely respond, indicating that the models rely on spurious feature correlations rather than genuinely following the prompt semantics. We trace this behavior to the limited scale of the benchmark dataset, which contains only 4,343 prompt-object pairs per task, so that the models simply memorize the object associated with each scene instead of learning the true prompt-to-object correspondence. To address this, we propose two plug-and-play components. First, we construct the CVOGL-MO dataset by expanding the existing training and test sets with diverse multi-object annotations, mitigating the memorization that induces shortcut learning. Second, we propose the Cross-View Co-Scene Multi-Object Contrastive Loss (CVMCL), which enforces distinct feature representations for different click points within the same scene, compelling the model to follow prompt instructions. We further design a prompt-sensitivity evaluation protocol with prediction-shift metrics, providing the first quantitative measurement of prompt-following capability for CVOGL. Both components are architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing methods without any architectural modification. Experiments on three representative backbones show that our components substantially improve prompt-following accuracy on the new multi-object test sets and markedly increase prompt sensitivity. Our dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/Sunny-Fresher/CVOGL-MO.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 9 figures

</details>

### 720. [Reward Tilting via Semantic Noising](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29318v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29318

**作者：** Rafał Karczewski、Peter Blohm、Markus Heinonen、Vikas Garg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29318v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29318v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 semantic noising：用带噪语义表示作为条件训练生成器，使后验等价于语义空间中线性二次奖励的指数倾斜，从而用单一模型在训练后选择目标与强度；在分子生成、ImageNet 图文联合扩散及 Kandinsky 2.2 上演示。

**相关性简评：** 该工作对语义 latent 做指数倾斜以实现事后可控生成，其对内部表示施加奖励导向干预、且无需重训的思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的测试时可控调节提供参考线索，但与原论文的视觉推理问题距离较远，需核查其倾斜对表示内容的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reward Tilting via Semantic Noising

**abstract/A1：** Steering a generative model toward a desired property typically requires separate fine-tuning for each reward or additional computation during sampling. We propose semantic noising, which conditions generation on a noisy semantic representation of the data. The resulting posteriors correspond to exponential tilts by linear-quadratic rewards in semantic space, allowing a single model to support objectives and strengths chosen after training. A conditional generator can be trained to approximate these posteriors directly, while models that generate semantic representations by diffusion provide analytic tilted denoisers for the same family of rewards. We illustrate semantic noising in three settings. An autoregressive molecular generator trained with semantic noising controls properties individually and jointly, with a better reward--KL trade-off than property-conditioned models. On ImageNet, a joint diffusion model of images and their CLIP embeddings achieves FID comparable to REG, and tilting it toward a higher aesthetic score matches the best of 16 samples at the cost of a single sample. Finally, pretrained factorized models such as Kandinsky 2.2 support the same tilts without retraining.

</details>

### 721. [MIMORPHEUS: Rethinking Cross-Modal Supervision for Human Pose Estimation from Radar Signals](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29341v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29341

**作者：** Shizhao Zhang、Yanyan Zhang、Deshui Yu、Jun Pan、Guangyou Fang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29341v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29341v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MIMORPHEUS，先用 MIMO-VAE 压缩雷达回波、用 SkeleCoder 通过对比对齐学习人体姿态特征，再以姿态特征为条件在回波 latent 空间做条件扩散，从而由 3D 姿态生成雷达回波以扩充训练数据。

**相关性简评：** 领域较远且无推理轨迹或停止决策，但「对比对齐的语义特征作为 latent 生成条件」这一设计可供核查 LVR 中如何让 latent 状态承载任务必要信息以及如何监督其对齐质量。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MIMORPHEUS: Rethinking Cross-Modal Supervision for Human Pose Estimation from Radar Signals

**abstract/A1：** Deep learning has shown promise for estimating human pose with multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar through walls. Building paired radar and pose datasets demands considerable time and manual effort, while large visual pose datasets provide no corresponding radar echoes. Physical simulation can supply synthetic signals, but requires expertise in scattering models and can leave a gap between simulated and real data. To address this challenge, we introduce MIMORPHEUS, a framework that generates radar echoes from 3D human poses through conditional diffusion. To prepare echo and pose representations, MIMO-VAE compresses the echoes according to their channel and fast time sample structure, while SkeleCoder learns pose features through contrastive alignment with echo features. These pose features then guide diffusion in the MIMO-VAE latent space, and the VAE decoder reconstructs echoes from the generated latents. Once trained, the generator augments radar data by producing different echoes for a recorded pose and supplies the radar modality for pose annotations in existing visual datasets. In data augmentation experiments, our method reduces MPJPE by 6.8%-11.2% across four radar pose estimators. Transfer experiments with three public pose datasets also show that visual pose annotations can supply useful radar training data. Code will be made publicly available on GitHub.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 722. [Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29435v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29435

**作者：** Zehang Weng、Ci Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29435v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29435v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 RoA：将骑手与马的两个冻结单目 4D 重建器在测试时耦合，统一帧索引与像素各向同性相机，并在马体坐标系下用含广义绕数碰撞项的有界修正联合优化，输出相机系与世界系的人马运动。

**相关性简评：** 其「沿相机轴的误差在输入视角中不可见」与测试时对冻结模块施加交互一致性约束，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据不足导致的状态偏差、以及冻结表示间的测试时校正有概念联系，但属几何重建工作，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames

**abstract/A1：** We address the reconstruction of a horse and its rider from a single video. When a human estimator and a horse estimator are applied independently, both meshes can fit their silhouettes well while the rider hovers beside or passes through the horse, slides along its back and jitters relative to it. These errors lie along the camera axis and are not visible in the input view. We present Ride on Anything (RoA), a general, training-free methodology for reconstructing a person riding an animal, which couples frozen estimators of the rider and the mount at test time. We instantiate it for horseback riding with SAM 3D Body and 4DEquine. RoA aligns both estimators on a common frame index, projects both subjects through one pixel-isotropic camera initialized from the horse estimator, and jointly optimizes bounded corrections under interaction terms defined in the horse's body frame, including a collision term based on generalized winding numbers that remains valid on the non-watertight horse mesh. The result is lifted to a levelled world frame using the camera rotation from the background and the field of view from MoGe-2. On our riding clips, the raw outputs of the two estimators leave the rider's pelvis 15 cm from the horse's back on average. RoA reduces this seat gap to 1 cm, the drift of the seat along and across the spine by 64% and 89%, the 90th-percentile penetration depth by 57%, and the share of rider surface inside the horse from 12.1% to 7.9%. The motion is markedly smoother (94% lower acceleration of the rider relative to the horse, 80% lower horse jerk), while the rider's silhouette IoU decreases from 0.59 to 0.52. Qualitatively, the rider stays seated on the horse and moves together with it. A quantitative evaluation of 3D accuracy awaits calibrated recordings of ridden animals. We also test a clip outside the task, a horse led on foot, and analyse the failure modes.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code and interactive results: https://wengzehang.github.io/rideonanything/

</details>

### 723. [Optimal Bandits with Switching Costs: $(T/\\log(T))^{2/3}$ Regret](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29438v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29438

**作者：** Chenyu Gan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29438v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29438v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究带切换代价的对抗多臂老虎机，证明 minimax 遗憾为 Θ(min{T, K^{1/3}T^{2/3}/log^{2/3}(2+T/K)})，说明固定分块策略次优；其算法在每个块内于随机时刻做常数次切换，并在切换点附近加权观测，另引入按损失大小触发的「绕道」临时试臂以抵消时间相关性。

**相关性简评：** 切换代价下的「停留 vs. 切换」与在代价约束下主动试探取信息，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 策略切换和证据获取的成本权衡提供问题表述与最优停止视角，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimal Bandits with Switching Costs: $(T/\\log(T))^{2/3}$ Regret

**abstract/A1：** We study adversarial bandits with switching costs. For $K$ arms, $T$ rounds, unit switching costs, and oblivious losses in $\[0,1\]$, we prove that the minimax regret is \\begin{equation\*} Θ\\!\\left(\\min\\left\\{T, \\frac{K^{1/3}T^{2/3}}{\\log^{2/3}(2+T/K)}\\right\\}\\right)\\,. \\end{equation\*} This shows that simple blocking, which plays one arm throughout each block, is suboptimal. Our algorithm makes at most a constant number of switches at random times within each block. The key idea for the improvement is to extract more information per switch by giving greater weight to observations near switching times. We also introduce detours, during which the learner temporarily plays a newly sampled arm. Larger observed losses make a detour more likely. These detours cancel temporal correlation terms induced by blocking while preserving the observations used in the estimates. A matching lower bound follows from a refined analysis of a modified multiscale random walk construction.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages

</details>

### 724. [RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29444v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29444

**作者：** Kevin Lu、David Bau、Wengong Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、q-bio.BM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29444v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29444v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** RumiFold 让通用 LLM 直接从自身隐藏状态迭代预测蛋白质结构，并利用折叠表示完成功能预测与自然语言描述。

**相关性简评：** 其反复折叠形成的内部 per-residue 工作区及因果干预评估，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、工作区几何与内容使用诊断提供类比，但跨生物分子领域迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function

**abstract/A1：** Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. Code, data, and models are available at: https://rumifold.baulab.info

</details>

### 725. [Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29467v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29467

**作者：** Ryo Kuroki、Amin Mansouri、Philippe Schwaller

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29467v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29467v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一个面向 LLM agent 假设驱动实验规划的诊断基准，在动力学机制识别中把推理拆成信念更新、假设判别、判别性实验设计和干预下预测四步分别评分，并分析探索行为。

**相关性简评：** 其中的信念更新、判别性实验设计与证据获取分解，可能为 LVR 的 THINK/LOOK/证据筛选和停止决策提供任务表述与评价线索，但该工作不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 41 pages, 6 figures. Project website: https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/

### 726. [Vanishing Initialization Turns Diagonal Tensor Gradient Flow into Greedy Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29484v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29484

**作者：** Dmitry Yarotsky、Eugene Golikov、Yaroslav Gusev

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29484v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29484v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究 CP 张量分解下从消失初始化出发的梯度流学习，证明当目标张量在模态正交基下对角时，学习动力学等价于按激活时钟排序的贪心二部匹配，并据此导出模加法任务的大系统损失曲线。

**相关性简评：** 其「原子—标量扇区」匹配与学习事件排序，可能为 latent reasoning 中模块专业化、贡献分配及表示几何的分析提供类比线索；但无视觉或多模态状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Vanishing Initialization Turns Diagonal Tensor Gradient Flow into Greedy Matching

**abstract/A1：** We study gradient-flow (GF) learning of tensors from vanishing initialization in canonical polyadic (CP) factorization models. For tensors of order $ν\\geq3$ whose targets are diagonal in mode-wise orthonormal bases, we prove that the limiting learning dynamics follows a simple greedy bipartite matching process. Each rank-one component of the model, called an atom, can potentially learn each rank-one component of the target, called a scalar sector. Every atom--sector pair has an initialization-dependent activation clock, representing the time at which the atom would grow to macroscopic size in that sector if the pair evolved in isolation. Processing these clocks in increasing order and selecting a pair whenever neither its atom nor its sector has been selected before determines the sequence of actual learning events. We prove that the GF trajectory converges to the corresponding staircase of learned target components. The task of learning modular addition by a CP model with complex weights falls exactly into this framework after Fourier diagonalization. Its activation clocks are independent and identically distributed, allowing us to combine the GF reduction with known random matching asymptotics and derive an explicit, distribution-free large-system loss curve after time reparametrization. We also obtain an asymptotic formula relating this curve to the original GF training time. For models with real weights, conjugate Fourier modes instead form two-dimensional blocks with richer internal structure. We characterize their rank and border-rank cascade and conjecture that the corresponding GF dynamics follows interleaved multi-stage learning processes.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 STAGE，一个面向跨被试脑信号到图像检索的无标签测试时适配框架：用矩校准减小特征统计差异、耦合加权初始化建立对齐，再以耦合引导适配细化残差，并用软耦合排序协调多个 query 间的候选竞争，编码器全程冻结。

**相关性简评：** 其全局熵软耦合排序在 query 之间协调候选分配、抑制预测过度集中，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与证据分配的多样性保持及测试时无标签校准提供可核查线索，但任务本身不涉及视觉推理链或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** STAGE: Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling for Cross-Subject Brain-to-Image Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance. On THINGS-EEG2, STAGE achieves 68.25% Top-1 and 90.47% Top-5, improving Top-1 by 18.52 percentage points over SCORE recovery and CSLS on identical frozen NICE features. Calibrated on 200 queries and a 200-image gallery covering their identities, STAGE retains 42.05% Top-1 when ranking 1,854 images with the transform frozen.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, including the main paper and appendix

</details>

### 728. [Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29542v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29542

**作者：** Jian Zahng、Zhijun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29542v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29542v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 3D 感知图像编辑中照片与渲染 3D 状态的冲突问题，提出仅训练期使用的反事实状态监督（构造隐藏面重绘、重渲染光影、可见纹理替换等受控冲突）与对称反事实校正，使编辑器学会在未见内容上信任 3D 状态、在可见外观上保持照片。

**相关性简评：** 其「构造受控证据冲突 + 定向 latent 扰动纠正」的思路可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、以及 latent 状态在生成过程中能否持续响应条件（避免信息坍缩）相关，可供核查这类训练信号能否迁移到多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing

**abstract/A1：** Rotating, translating, or rescaling an object in a photograph requires revealing unseen surfaces, preserving visible appearance, and updating shadows and reflections. Reconstructed 3D assets, rendered at the target pose as a 3D state, provide explicit geometric guidance, but their imperfect textures may conflict with the photograph, while standard paired training does not explicitly teach the editor which source to trust. To address this, we propose counterfactual state supervision, which constructs controlled photo--state conflicts through hidden-surface repainting, hidden geometry with re-rendered shadows and reflections, and visible-surface texture replacement. This teaches the editor to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance. However, learning this distinction does not ensure that it is maintained during sampling. We therefore introduce symmetric counterfactual correction, which uses state-side and photo-side twins, which share the photograph and the state respectively, to construct directed latent perturbations toward condition-inconsistent targets and train recovery toward the target specified by the current condition. Both strategies operate only during training, requiring no architectural changes or additional inference steps. Experiments on OBJect and SpatialEdit-Bench demonstrate strong spatial editing performance and content preservation, while controlled ablations show improved source selection and sustained responsiveness to conditioning during sampling.

</details>

### 729. [Learning Acceptable Lotteries via Queries: Minimizing Aggregated Violation Distances](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29555v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29555

**作者：** Nicholas Teh、Paul W. Goldberg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29555v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29555v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在多个利益相关者偏好冲突时，仅通过接受/拒绝查询学习可接受的候选随机分配（lottery），并以归一化违约距离的幂平均衡量损失，分析查询复杂度与有限预算下的采样算法。

**相关性简评：** 其查询预算、冲突需求聚合与停止条件的理论刻画，可能为 VLM 推理中有限证据获取及安全—有用性权衡提供问题表述线索，但无视觉或内部状态研究，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Acceptable Lotteries via Queries: Minimizing Aggregated Violation Distances

**abstract/A1：** When deploying an AI system, a developer can randomize over several candidate versions, sending each request to a version chosen at random, to balance the requirements of multiple stakeholders. We study a setting in which each of $n$ stakeholders reveals only whether a proposed lottery over $m$ candidates is acceptable, and each stakeholder's acceptable lotteries lie on one side of an unknown hyperplane. While previous work sought a lottery that every stakeholder accepts, such a lottery need not exist when, for instance, safety and helpfulness requirements are in conflict. We therefore minimize a power mean of the stakeholders' violations; since binary answers reveal neither the size of a violation nor how to compare violations across stakeholders, we measure each violation by a normalized distance to the stakeholder's acceptance boundary. We characterize exactly when accept/reject answers determine these distances. When they do, $\\mathcal{O}(nm\\log(1/\\varepsilon))$ queries suffice to learn them, where $\\varepsilon$ is the precision of the utilities, and this bound is tight; when they do not, a natural worst-case approach is optimal up to a constant factor, even compared with methods that make unlimited queries. For limited query budgets, we give a sampling algorithm whose number of queries for a given accuracy does not depend on $n$, and show that a deterministic algorithm cannot guarantee a small loss without querying almost all stakeholders. Synthetic experiments illustrate the resulting tradeoff between querying many stakeholders and learning each of them accurately.

**comment/C1：** 37 pages, 5 figures, NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 730. [How Multi-Timescale Memory Cools Optimization: Theory and Evidence from AdEMAMix](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29588v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29588

**作者：** Jacopo Graldi、Antonio Orvieto、Anastasia Koloskova

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29588v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29588v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从解耦权重衰减下的精确范数动力学出发，分析 AdEMAMix 中独立加权的慢动量如何改变参数范数与旋转速度，并将其解释为一种内生退火调度，以此说明其相对 AdamW 的预训练优势。

**相关性简评：** 其「多时间尺度记忆改变状态范数与旋转几何」的分析视角，可能可供核查循环或多步 latent 推理中跨迭代状态累积与表示几何变化的建模，但论文本身面向语言模型优化器，与视觉证据使用和推理期状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Multi-Timescale Memory Cools Optimization: Theory and Evidence from AdEMAMix

**abstract/A1：** Augmenting AdamW with multiple momentum timescales improves large language model pretraining, yet the mechanism driving these gains remains poorly understood. We identify an interaction between multi-timescale optimizer memory and the geometry of normalized networks: memory changes parameter norms and thereby controls how fast parameters rotate. Starting from exact norm dynamics under decoupled weight decay, we show that the parameter norm depends on the temporal correlation of the updates, with weight decay controlling how long these correlations influence optimization. We show how an independently weighted slow momentum can substantially increase the norm of parameters, while contributing negligible power to the instantaneous update, therefore acting as an endogenous annealing schedule. We study this mechanism in AdEMAMix for language-model pretraining. Controlled interventions show that this scheduling mechanism has clear practical consequences and is an important factor behind AdEMAMix's advantage over AdamW.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Similarity-Constrained Reweighting for Complex Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning models for Complex Query Answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs estimate the likelihood of answers that are not reachable via direct traversal. Recent work has proposed extending such queries with soft entity constraints, which require the target variable to be similar or dissimilar to specified sets of entities. We study a more general formulation where similarity constraints are specified on an arbitrary variable in a query, and introduce SCORE: a computationally efficient and interpretable method for incorporating similarity constraints on an arbitrary variable of a query. SCORE is based on a lightweight and interpretable score adjustment function that only requires tuning two hyperparameters on a validation set. Our experiments show that SCORE effectively incorporates preferences while maintaining strong query answering performance. It significantly improves ranking quality when constraints apply to the target variable and performs effectively in the more general case involving constraints on intermediate variables, and its performance remains robust when applied to several existing methods for CQA. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/dfdazac/score.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attacking Tabular Foundation Models: An Experimental Taxonomy of Context Poisoning and Test-Time Evasion

**abstract/A1：** Tabular foundation models condition predictions on labeled examples supplied at inference time, creating an attack surface that differs from conventional model training. We study four manipulation families (label flipping, backdoor context poisoning, clean-label context selection, and test-time evasion) and organize them by attack stage, label consistency, and distributional realism. TabPFN-2.5, TabICL, and XGBoost are evaluated on CIC-IDS2017 and N-BaIoT using a common preprocessing and evaluation pipeline. Backdoor context poisoning provides strong targeted control over the in-context models with little change in clean accuracy, whereas selecting real, correctly labeled boundary-crowding rows causes no systematic accuracy degradation up to a 20% bias fraction. A simplified surrogate-transfer constrained PGD attack inspired by, but not equivalent to, CAPGD also produces test-time evasion, outperforming equal-budget random noise in most settings. The comparison shows that attack effectiveness depends strongly on both where manipulation occurs and how much freedom the attacker has to alter the data.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29629

**作者：** Fu Dai、Kamal Taha、Naoufel Werghi、Maregu Assefa
