摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文审计人脸识别中训练集与测试集的同身份重叠，用基于零分布校准的检测器标记污染身份，并表明在固定模型下移除污染身份会使低 FMR 工作点的 FNMR 上升数倍至十余倍，同时首次估计 IJB-C 在 FMR=10⁻⁶ 时仅约 270 万次有效独立比较。

**相关性简评：** 其零分布校准的泄漏检测与「有效独立比较数」估计思路，可能可供核查 VLM 推理基准的测试污染与低错误率下评价样本量是否足够，但与人脸识别之外的领域迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Contamination at the Operating Point: Train-Test Identity Overlap Inflates Low-FMR Face Recognition Accuracy by an Order of Magnitude

**abstract/A1：** Face verification systems are deployed by selecting a decision threshold that achieves a target false match rate (FMR); performance is then reported as the corresponding false non-match rate (FNMR). In practice, deployed systems operate at FMR $\\le 10^{-6}$, but widely used benchmarks can share identities with the models' training corpora. Prior work (Wu et al., 2024) measures the resulting optimistic bias as a small additive change in 10-fold accuracy (up to 1.01 percentage points). We show that the bias is neither small nor constant: it is a multiplicative error that grows as FMR falls. First, we audit train-test overlap with a detector calibrated against a null distribution (rather than a hand-tuned threshold). Relative to WebFace42M, we flag 88.6% of MS1MV3 identities and 14.3% of IJB-C subjects as present, despite WebFace260M's published de-overlap explicitly naming IJB-C. Manual review of 100 flagged IJB-C subjects confirms 69.2%, implying a residual overlap of roughly 9.9%. Second, holding the model fixed, removing only the contaminated identities from the test set increases FNMR by 3.6$\\times$ at FMR=$10^{-4}$, 6.3$\\times$ at FMR=$10^{-5}$, and 13.9$\\times$ at FMR=$10^{-6}$, while a same-size random removal does not. The effect is traced to a shorter impostor tail that lowers the threshold. The magnitude of the shift depends on the training corpus and does not cancel betweent margin between our model and a publicbaseline by half. Third, we give the first direct measurement of the effective number of independent impostor comparisons in IJB-C: only 2.7 million effectively independent comparisons at FMR=$10^{-6}$, which is below all commonly accepted reporting rules. Finallyth a known training corpus, we build areal-face protocol with audited zero overlap that resolves FMR=$10^{-8}$.

### 734. [SuperFine3D: Efficient Global-Local Recursive Refinement for Extremely Detailed 3D Geometry Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29630v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29630

**作者：** Lihan Li、Junwei Zhou、Yu-wing Tai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29630v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29630v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SuperFine3D，从图像生成极细节 3D 几何：学习一个共享的粗到细精化算子并递归复用它，配合空间单元注意力和跨尺度引导，仅在 512³–1024³ 监督下推理到 4096³ 解码网格。

**相关性简评：** 同一算子在远超训练分辨率的目标上递归复用，与 latent 工作区的长度/尺度泛化及循环状态更新可能相关；局部受限的 cell 注意力对推理成本控制可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SuperFine3D: Efficient Global-Local Recursive Refinement for Extremely Detailed 3D Geometry Generation

**abstract/A1：** High-resolution images contain rich visual details that require fine geometric structures for faithful 3D reconstruction. However, generating extremely detailed 3D geometry from images requires substantial computational resources and training data, making high-resolution geometry generation challenging for existing state-of-the-art models. In this paper, we present SuperFine3D, an efficient framework for generating extremely detailed 3D geometry through global-local recursive refinement. SuperFine3D learns a shared refinement operator from paired coarse-to-fine representations and recursively reuses it to progressively synthesize finer geometry beyond the training resolutions, without requiring additional paired supervision at target resolutions. To make recursive refinement computationally efficient, we introduce spatial-cell attention, which restricts high-resolution interactions to local spatial neighborhoods while maintaining bounded communication across neighboring cells. We further propose spatially anchored cross-scale guidance, which leverages globally contextualized coarse geometry to guide local detail synthesis and preserve structural consistency. In addition, geometry-aware training objectives encourage the refinement process to preserve stable geometric structures while introducing fine-grained surface details. Experiments demonstrate that SuperFine3D generates geometry at a $4096^3$ decoder-grid resolution, corresponding to a sparse $256^3$ latent lattice, using a shared refinement operator trained only on $512^3$--$1024^3$ representations. Compared with a full-attention recursive baseline, SuperFine3D achieves a $9.4\\times$ speedup in end-to-end inference and reduces peak GPU memory usage by $23.0\\%$, while improving cross-scale structural consistency and producing cleaner surfaces with finer geometric details.

</details>

### 735. [How Seasonal Reference Choice Changes the Apparent Gains of Chronos Models in Electricity Load Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29653v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29653

**作者：** ChandraMohan K

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29653v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29653v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在小时级电力负荷预测上考察「参照基线选择」如何改变两个 Chronos 零样本基础模型的表观收益：对 60 个固定案例分别对比日持续、周持续、工作日混合等基线及验证期选定参照，并用配对分块 bootstrap 估计不确定性。

**相关性简评：** 其「换基线即改变增益幅度与确定性」的度量思路可能可供核查 LVR 中相对简单基线的收益报告与相关性样本下的置信区间问题，但属远领域评价方法，迁移仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Seasonal Reference Choice Changes the Apparent Gains of Chronos Models in Electricity Load Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** When a forecasting model is said to beat a simple baseline, the size of that win depends on which baseline was used. We measure how much this matters for two zero-shot foundation models, Chronos-Bolt and Chronos-2, on hourly electricity load. The study uses 60 fixed cases drawn from eight series in four public collections, with forecasts 24 and 168 hours ahead and up to 2,048 hours of history. Each model is compared with daily persistence, weekly persistence, a weekday hybrid, a daily-weekly blend, and a reference chosen from these on a validation period. We keep every origin-level forecast and estimate uncertainty with paired circular block bootstrap intervals using 168- and 336-hour blocks. A week ahead, Bolt clearly beats weekly persistence in 21 of 30 cases but the validation-selected reference in only 14, and its median gain falls from 17.3% to 11.9%. For Chronos-2 the clear-win counts are 18 and 15. Chronos-2 has lower week-ahead MAE than Bolt in 24 cases, yet only 12 of those differences are clear. The selected reference is not always the harder baseline, since on some test windows it does worse than weekly persistence. The choice of baseline therefore changes both how large the reported gain is and how sure we can be of it. The results are exploratory: the series and windows are related, an earlier pilot was inspected, pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out, and the case-level intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 736. [PROPS: Can Visual Generators Keep the Current Look of a Prop?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29665v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29665

**作者：** Xiangzhao Hao、Dianyi Wang、Keyan Zhou、Yiqian Zhang、Zefeng Zhang、Bailin Li、Kun Zhan、Junchi Yan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29665v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29665v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「prop drift」这一视觉生成失败模式：多步生成中模型不从历史恢复物体当前外观，而是依请求重绘或用过时外观；作者构建含 2,257 对双生历史的 PROPS 基准加以隔离测量，并发布 PROPS-Train 训练链用于微调，评测 34 个系统均出现该问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「双生历史同请求、仅外观不同」的对照设计可供核查能否迁移为判断生成是否真正使用视觉证据与历史状态的因果式评价，而 prop drift 与 LVR 中视觉信息未进入内部状态、状态更新失败的问题形成概念对应；但任务属图像生成，与 latent reasoning 机制仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PROPS: Can Visual Generators Keep the Current Look of a Prop?

**abstract/A1：** Many generation tasks draw the next image from a visual history, such as storyboards, illustrated stories and multi-turn editing. A new request often states what happens next without restating how earlier objects look. Instead of recovering an object's current look from the history, generators often redraw it from the request alone or bring back an outdated look, and the error can carry into later steps. We call this failure prop drift. Existing evaluations rarely isolate it, because similarity to the history rewards copying and a judge that sees a single history cannot tell a look recovered from that history from one the generator happens to prefer. We introduce PROPS, a benchmark of 2,257 pairs of twin histories that end on the same request but show one prop in two different looks. A pair passes only if the generator draws the matching look on each side and carries out the request, so a look preferred by the generator or the judge passes at most one side. All 34 open and closed systems we test show prop drift, and even systems that carry out the requested action on most sides often lose the current look of the prop. Swapping the planners and editors of agents further shows that both history understanding and image generation limit agent performance. We also build PROPS-Train, 80,250 training chains in four tracks whose targets recover an earlier state or carry scripted changes forward, and fine-tuning on it clearly improves all four tested models. Both datasets will be publicly released.

</details>

### 737. [CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29675v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29675

**作者：** Subhojyoti Khastagir、Kishalay Das、Pawan Goyal、Seung-Cheol Lee、Satadeep Bhattacharjee、Niloy Ganguly

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29675v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29675v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CrysLDM 用 VAE 把 3D 晶体结构编码到平滑低维潜空间，再由扩散模型在该空间中生成新材料，以降低训练与采样成本。

**相关性简评：** 与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但「VAE 压缩为低维平滑潜空间 + 在潜空间做扩散生成」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的紧凑表示与生成式更新提供远域参照，其潜空间几何是否稳定可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent space, where the diffusion model operates. Since CrysLDM leverages a smooth, lower-dimensional latent space, it simplifies the generative process and accelerates both training and inference. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets and tasks, we show that CrysLDM generates stable and valid materials with quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while being significantly more efficient in terms of computational resources and time.

</details>

### 738. [Learning-Augmented QUBO for Time-Expanded Multi-Commodity Flow](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29711v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29711

**作者：** Aikaterini Nikolidaki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29711v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29711v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将时扩展图上的多商品流建模为 QUBO，给出可证保证可行性的惩罚系数，并给出树宽上界、矩阵乘积算子低键维表示与退火间隙正性等结构结果，同时证明「预测与求解器择优」的混合路由其代价随预测误差线性增长的一致性界。

**相关性简评：** 该工作来自组合优化与量子退火，与视觉推理无直接联系；但其「保留预测与求解输出中更优者」的误差界可为 latent 提议与验证/停止决策的结合提供形式化参照，低键维张量网络表示也可能启发对结构化推理状态的压缩刻画，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning-Augmented QUBO for Time-Expanded Multi-Commodity Flow

**abstract/A1：** We study energy-aware multi-commodity flow on time-expanded graphs, a problem that captures dynamic routing in layered networks and is NP-hard in general. We formulate the problem as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem, give an explicit penalty coefficient that provably guarantees feasibility, and show that it is smaller than the standard bound by a factor of roughly the number of active links. The layered structure of the time-expanded graph yields three structural results: a treewidth bound that gives a fixed-parameter tractable exact algorithm in the bag size, a matrix-product-operator representation of small bond dimension, and a proof that the annealing gap of the associated Ising Hamiltonian is strictly positive for every instance with a unique optimum, uniformly over bounded windows. For learning-augmented routing, we bound the Hamming distance between a predicted and an optimal flow by the flow error, and prove a consistency guarantee: a hybrid algorithm that keeps the better of the prediction and the solver output returns a flow whose cost exceeds the optimum by a factor that grows linearly with the prediction error. The results are exact statements about the QUBO and its associated Ising Hamiltonian, and they hold for any physical implementation.

</details>

### 739. [MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29741v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29741

**作者：** Delin An、Mingqi Xu、Jian-Xun Wang、Pengfei Gu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29741v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29741v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MISeg-Agent，一个用于 3D 医学图像分割的人在回路 agent 框架：先按基准性能与算力选择预训练模型，再定位漏分与过分割区域、推荐可疑切片和校正点，用交互式分割模型评估候选点提示并交人工确认后应用。

**相关性简评：** 其「在哪里干预、候选校正是否有用、何时交人确认」的流程，可能与 LVR 中的证据获取、干预定位与停止决策有概念联系，可供核查；但对象是 3D 医学掩码而非 VLM 内部推理状态，借鉴为间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Despite the strong performance of modern medical image segmentation models, their predictions can still contain localized errors that compromise segmentation quality. Identifying and correcting these errors is therefore essential for improving the reliability of existing segmentation results. While interactive segmentation models enable targeted corrections, identifying potential errors, determining where to intervene, and evaluating corrective actions remain challenging. Moreover, each correction changes the current mask, requiring subsequent error diagnosis and recommendations to adapt accordingly. To address these challenges, we propose MISeg-Agent, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that diagnoses segmentation errors and provides evidence-based correction recommendations. MISeg-Agent first selects a suitable pretrained segmentation model based on benchmark performance and computational requirements. Given its predicted mask, the framework identifies potential missing and excess foreground regions and recommends suspicious slices and corrective points for review. The framework then evaluates candidate point prompts using an interactive segmentation model and presents the resulting corrections for human verification before applying them. By operating directly on images and predicted masks, the error diagnosis process remains independent of the underlying segmentation model architecture. Evaluations on CT datasets demonstrate that MISeg-Agent improves initial segmentation results and produces final masks closely aligned with reference annotations. By integrating adaptive error diagnosis with validated correction recommendations, MISeg-Agent provides an interpretable approach to identifying and reducing residual errors in existing medical image segmentations.

</details>

### 740. [Selecting Stable Sampling Dynamics for Compositional Diffusion: A Feynman-Kac Weight Reduction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29764v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29764

**作者：** Sunjin Kim、Sungsoo Ahn、Michael Chertkov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.stat-mech、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29764v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29764v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在不联合重训多个独立扩散模型的前提下，如何从一族等价目标的加权 SDE 中挑选稳定采样动力学；指出标量参数取 λ=1/B 时 Feynman-Kac 瞬时对数权重率中的平方得分项精确抵消，并给出上下界与高斯混合、分子采样实验。

**相关性简评：** 其对 Feynman-Kac 对数权重增长与提议动力学选择的稳定性分析，可能为 latent 推理中粒子式加权、权重退化的抑制与提议分布设计提供借鉴线索，但能否迁移到 VLM 多状态组合与证据筛选尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Selecting Stable Sampling Dynamics for Compositional Diffusion: A Feynman-Kac Weight Reduction

**abstract/A1：** Given $K$ separately trained diffusion models, how should one sample from a $β\_k$-weighted product of their terminal laws without jointly retraining the experts? Existing Feynman--Kac constructions provide many weighted stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with the correct target marginal. The consequential question is how to select useful proposal dynamics among them. We study an explicit family of weighted diffusions that realizes the same product-of-intermediate-experts trajectory. A scalar parameter $λ$ controls how strongly the proposal drift follows the composed expert score, while an additional Langevin component can be varied independently. Writing $B=\\sum\_{k=1}^{K}β\_k&gt;0$, we identify the distinguished choice $λ=1/B$. At this value, the aggregate squared-score term in the instantaneous Feynman--Kac log-weight rate cancels exactly. For positive expert exponents, the remaining score-disagreement contribution is non-positive. We call this structural cancellation Feynman--Kac reduction. Under bounded-divergence assumptions, it yields an upper bound on the instantaneous unnormalized log-weight rate for all $λ\\leq 1/B$. For linear diffusion protocols with compactly supported expert data, $λ=1/B$ yields two-sided bounds at every nonterminal time, for exponents of either sign. A corresponding result holds for a single expert under the same divergence assumption. In these two-sided settings, the selected value is unique within the specified family in a universal worst-case sense. Experiments on Gaussian mixtures and molecular sampling compare the analytically predicted stability with actual sampling quality, including instances in which parameter choices different from $λ=1/B$ perform better empirically.

</details>

### 741. [When Simpler Beats Learned: Dual-Weighted Sampling vs. Machine Learning for the Pricing Subproblem in Graph Coloring](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29769v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29769

**作者：** Nikolai Antonov、Přemysl Šůcha、Mikoláš Janota、Jan Hůla

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29769v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29769v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在图着色分支定价的列生成中，用受限主问题的对偶解替代学习模型分数来加权采样最大权独立集，提出免训练的双重加权采样，并在统一框架下与 ML 定价启发式、手工启发式和精确求解器比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「学习打分器未必必要、可由问题自身信号替代」的受控对比，可能启发 LVR 中对学习式潜变量打分与简单证据信号的基线与贡献归因核查，但领域与视觉多模态推理相距较远，需谨慎看待。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Simpler Beats Learned: Dual-Weighted Sampling vs. Machine Learning for the Pricing Subproblem in Graph Coloring

**abstract/A1：** The graph coloring problem can be solved to optimality by branch-and-price (B&amp;P), but its performance hinges on the column generation (CG) step, where each iteration requires solving a maximum weight independent set (MWIS) pricing problem. The state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) pricing heuristic follows a prediction-sampling paradigm: a learned model scores each vertex of a graph, and independent sets are sampled from the induced distribution. We observe, however, that the scoring procedure does not need to be learned, and critically assess the role of ML by replacing the learned scores with the dual solution of the restricted master problem, resulting in Dual-Weighted Sampling, a proposed lightweight alternative that requires no feature engineering or training. Within a unified CG and B&amp;P framework that varies only the pricing oracle, Dual-Weighted Sampling outperforms MLPH, hand-crafted heuristics, and exact solvers on the established graph coloring benchmark in both runtime and solution quality. In particular, it remains competitive on the DIMACS random family, where MLPH was shown strongest in the original evaluation, while achieving more than a two-fold speedup in CG runtime on recursive-sparse and real-world graph families.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

</details>

**作者：** Angela Lavinia Varazi、Felipe Tobar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出用线性半群构造高斯过程先验：由生成元参数化，把 t=0 的源 GP 演化为 t=1 的先验，并以边际似然拟合观测、以动能正则约束轨迹能量；在独立 GP 采样上验证了预测与能量下降效果。

**相关性简评：** 虽属 GP 理论、与视觉推理无关，但其「用生成元刻画状态演化、并用动能/质量位移正则约束轨迹」的目标形式可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新轨迹的正则化与先验塑形提供概念线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Gaussian Process Priors with Linear Semigroups and Kinetic Regularisation

**abstract/A1：** We introduce a semigroup-based construction of Gaussian process (GP) priors. A linear semigroup transforms a source GP at $t=0$ into a prior at $t=1$, enabling computationally tractable regression. Linearity preserves Gaussianity, allowing us to characterise the evolution of the covariance and draw connections with optimal transport and convolution models. The semigroup is parametrised by its generator, which is learned through two competing objectives: the marginal likelihood encourages agreement with observations, while a kinetic-energy regulariser favours lower-energy trajectories and limits unnecessary mass displacement from the source GP. Experiments on independent GP draws show that, with sufficiently many training functions, the learned prior provides accurate predictions on held-out functions, while kinetic regularisation substantially reduces the energy of the generated trajectories without compromising prediction accuracy.

</details>

**作者：** Geonwoo Bang、Dongho Kim、Moohong Min

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29805v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29805v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究用 LLM 模拟调查公众，指出现有 persona 条件化会产生过度一致、相关性强于真人的回答，并提出 Latent-Predisposition Personas：为每个 persona 分配潜在倾向参数（政治参与度、价值优先级、党际议题偏差），再将答案锐化并校准到总体与交叉表分布。

**相关性简评：** 其「用少量潜在倾向变量换取稳定而非随机的个体差异，并校准到聚合统计」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态参数化、表示稳定性与解码校准的可核查线索有关，但领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent-Predisposition Personas for Heterogeneous and Reliable LLM Survey Simulation

**abstract/A1：** LLM personas are used to simulate survey publics, which should reproduce not only answer distributions but also within-person coherence and stability. Drawing on mass belief systems research, we show that persona-conditioned LLMs produce over-constrained publics. Across three model families and three U.S. surveys, opinions on unrelated issues are 1.6-4.6 times as correlated as among humans, and party identification explains 2.5-7.6 times as much answer variance. Common remedies (temperature, diversity instructions, backstories) weaken these correlations by making answers more random. On Qwen, their ten-day test-retest reliability falls to 33-59% of the human level, and when made consistent they lose correlation fit. We propose Latent-Predisposition Personas (LPP), whose persons differ stably, not randomly. Each persona receives political engagement, value priorities, and party-relative issue deviations that grow as engagement falls. Answers are sharpened and calibrated to toplines and party crosstabs. At selected operating points, LPP is never significantly worse than any baseline and far more reliable. At matched human-level reliability, it has the lowest correlation error in all six model-survey combinations, also at a lower target. Errors still exceed those between human samples, and gains on framing effects and a frontier closed model are partial.

</details>

### 744. [Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29807v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29807

**作者：** Teng Cao、Yu Deng、Kristian Kersting

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29807v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29807v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究递归自我改进 agent 在五个任务域中编写并修订程序，发现环境变化后其自写运行时检查会漏掉大量失败；基于正常运行记录构建的监控器能发现多数失败，且 agent 在被提示后通常可修复。

**相关性简评：** 虽不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其“系统能否察觉自身失败”的评测可能为 LVR 的自验证、停止决策与失败归因提供概念线索，可供核查其检查与监控设计能否映射到 latent 推理状态的核验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents

**abstract/A1：** AI agents can write programs that carry out a task without calling a model at every step, so the task runs fast and its logic stays open to inspection. Agents improve these programs by running them, studying their failures, and revising the code, a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). We ask whether this process also yields runtime checks that can be trusted. In five task domains, with up to seven author models, agents bring their programs to high scores. Yet when the environment changes, the checks they were told to write stay silent on half or more of the resulting failures in four domains. These failures can be detected and repaired: a monitor built from records of normal runs catches most of them in three domains, and the same agents usually repair them once called. The checks do not examine the recorded relations that reveal the failures, and the strongest agent writes checks that catch most of them once told that its checks are the only thing that calls it back. An unreported failure stays unrepaired, which limits what self-improvement is worth in autonomous operation. Evaluations of self-improvement should measure not only scores but also whether a system notices its own failures.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 745. [Information-Theoretic Analysis of Multi-Objective Bandits: Pareto Violations &amp; Gap-Based Regret](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29808v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29808

**作者：** Muhammad Qasim Elahi、Murat Kocaoglu、Mahsa Ghasemi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29808v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29808v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用信息论方法分析贝叶斯多目标 bandit，提出以预测分离度连接候选 Pareto 集的信息增益，分析 Thompson Sampling 并设计 Information-Directed Sampling，并进一步给出 gap-based regret 的参数级分析，指出不同 regret 准则需要不同粒度的环境信息。

**相关性简评：** 其「信息需求层级」与预测分离度／信息预算刻画，可能为判断 latent 状态需保留哪些任务必要信息、以及视觉证据筛选到何种粒度足够提供概念工具，但尚属远距离类推，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Information-Theoretic Analysis of Multi-Objective Bandits: Pareto Violations &amp; Gap-Based Regret

**abstract/A1：** We study Bayesian multi-objective bandits and ask an information-theoretic question: what aspects of an unknown environment must be resolved to achieve low regret? We show that the answer depends on the regret criterion and the information needed to represent its loss. For Pareto-violation regret, which incurs unit loss whenever a dominated action is selected, the Pareto-optimal set is a natural information target. We introduce a predictive separation measure for competing candidate Pareto sets, connect it to information gain about the unknown set, and use this connection to analyze Thompson Sampling and develop an Information-Directed Sampling strategy. We establish sublinear Bayesian regret under uniform and polynomially decaying separation and prove a lower bound showing that weak separation can impose an unavoidable statistical cost. We then study gap-based Pareto regret, which quantifies the magnitude of Pareto suboptimality. Here, Pareto-set information is generally too coarse: distinct environments can share the same Pareto set while inducing different reward geometries and Pareto gaps, and averaging environments consistent with one Pareto set need not preserve Pareto dominance. This motivates retaining finer information about the environment. We develop parameter-level information-theoretic analyses of Thompson Sampling and Information-Directed Sampling to derive gap-based regret guarantees. Under sublinear information budgets, Pareto Thompson Sampling also achieves sublinear gap regret while recovering the full Pareto set on the same run, with a related guarantee for a fixed mixture with gap-based IDS. Together, our results reveal a hierarchy of information requirements: binary Pareto membership can be controlled through set-level information, whereas quantitative Pareto-gap suboptimality can require finer knowledge of reward geometry.

</details>

### 746. [Model Immunization Cannot Reliably Protect Models from Harmful Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29815v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29815

**作者：** Tong Li、Chenru Wang、Chris Thomas、Shengwei An

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29815v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29815v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验「模型免疫」——修改预训练 checkpoint 使其抵抗后续有害能力微调、同时保留良性任务效用——是否真的稳健：在文生图、图像分类及语言模型上分别改变有害数据、适配策略与初始化，发现四种免疫方法的保护都大幅失效，甚至接近未免疫模型。

**相关性简评：** 其核心发现是训练期干预只对特定配置有效、在被优化的配置附近评测会掩盖过拟合，这一评测视角可能可供核查 LVR 的轨迹训练与监督是否也过度拟合单一设置；但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Model Immunization Cannot Reliably Protect Models from Harmful Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Efficient fine-tuning techniques have substantially reduced the cost of adapting open-weight models, enabling malicious actors to readily fine-tune them toward harmful capabilities. In response, model immunization modifies a pretrained checkpoint to resist subsequent adaptation toward designated harmful capabilities while preserving its utility and adaptability for benign tasks. Furthermore, a few immunization methods have sought to keep their protection robust to some changes in the attacker's adaptation. However, fine-tuning offers attackers many more low-cost options, and we observe that existing methods still substantially overfit to the attacker configuration they are optimized against. Such overfitting stays hidden when immunization is evaluated under, or near, this configuration, so the reported protection may give a false sense of security. To rigorously evaluate model immunization, we conduct experiments, varying one component of this configuration at a time: the harmful data, the adaptation strategy, or the model initialization. Across four immunization methods on text-to-image generation and image classification, with additional results on language models, these variations substantially degrade the protection, and in many cases the immunized model relearns the harmful capability nearly as well as the un-immunized model. Existing immunization therefore cannot reliably protect models, leaving them vulnerable to harmful adaptation.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29824

**作者：** Ibrahim A. Ahmed、Ahmed Sameh Khalil

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29824v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29824v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文以 GPT-6.1 Sol 管理工人、在预算内制作 USB 台灯的真实尝试为种子，构建模型模拟环境基准 Memphis，并比较有无采购提示时各模型的表现与失败复现情况。

**相关性简评：** 「用模型自身真实失败轨迹生成仿真任务以复现失败模式」的做法，可能为 LVR 的证据搜索、过早停止与评测任务构造提供间接启发；但论文不涉及视觉或 latent 推理机制，联系较远，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Memphis: A Case Study in Seeding an Agent Task from a Model's Real-World Attempt

**abstract/A1：** Agent benchmarks are usually made harder by scaling up the data their tasks are built from, yet models that do well on them still fail at real work. We propose building simulated tasks from a model's own attempt at an open-ended task in the real world, so that the model's failures in the simulation resemble its failures in reality. As a case study, we had GPT-6.1 Sol manage two human workers in Cairo over chat for five shifts, with a budget of 7,000 Egyptian pounds, to build as many USB desk lamps as it could. It built two. From the real-world attempt's transcript, we build Memphis, an evaluation in a model-simulated world. Memphis is hard: GPT-6.1 Sol delivers 1.0 lamp per trial on average and repeats its real-world mistakes, buying too few stands and giving up the search for them. With a one-page hint on where to buy parts and who can wire them, it delivers 9.2. Claude Opus 5.5 delivers 2.2 without the hint and 4.6 with it. We release the task, the trials, the audits, and a redacted record of the real-world evaluation.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Task, code, trials and data: https://github.com/ia03/memphis-task

</details>

**作者：** Veet Zaveri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29846v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29846v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究域偏移下超参数选择：比较池化源域验证与留一源域的最差/均值-方差适应度，并在独立目标数据集上冻结选定规则后确认，发现域感知指标并未带来可靠的目标域收益。

**相关性简评：** 其“验证准则先开发、再在独立数据集上冻结确认”的方法学警示，可能可供核查 LVR 中各 latent 机制或超参数在跨基准比较时的选择偏差与结论稳健性，但与视觉推理状态本身无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Source-Domain Validation Fails to Transfer: A Staged Study of Hyperparameter Selection

**abstract/A1：** Hyperparameters for an unseen domain are often selected using held-out examples from the available source domains. Withholding entire source domains during validation seems to better reflect deployment shift, but does this produce better selections on independent targets? We investigate this question through two complementary studies. A preliminary factorial experiment crosses particle swarm optimization and random search with pooled source validation and a leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minimum fitness on PACS and Multi-Domain Sentiment. The domain-aware fitness does not provide a consistent target advantage. We then separate selector development from confirmation using a shared pool of 64 configurations per task across four image benchmarks. Complete target-performance landscapes on VLCS and Office-Home inform one rule: retain the top 16 configurations by pooled source validation, then select the largest leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minus-standard-deviation score. The rule is frozen before evaluation on TerraIncognita and SVIRO. Across their 14 target domains, its equal-dataset-weighted balanced-accuracy difference from pooled validation is +0.097 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval \[-0.685, +0.960\]), with five wins and nine losses. Exploratory analyses reveal substantial variation across datasets, target domains, and training seeds. These results do not establish equivalence or a general failure of domain-aware validation. They show that the evaluated source-domain criteria did not establish reliable target gains under the tested protocols, and motivate assessing selection rules on datasets independent of those used to develop them.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 2 figures. Expanded version of work accepted to the AAAI-27 Student Abstract and Poster Program

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Ego2Wrist，从人类头戴式自我中心视频与任务描述合成同步的腕部视角视频并联合生成三视角，同时给出无真值的手部中心跨视角一致性指标 HCC，用于模型选择与生成样本的递归自训练筛选。

**相关性简评：** 其用跨视角一致性替代真值来验证生成观察、并据此筛选样本递归改进的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否保真、以及训练监督如何筛选的问题；但任务本体是视频生成与机器人数据扩增，与 latent 推理状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ego2Wrist: Bootstrapping Wrist-View Synthesis from Egocentric Video

**abstract/A1：** Wrist cameras provide an action-centric view that is directly relevant to robot manipulation. However, collecting human wrist-camera videos at scale is challenging due to cumbersome setups that can interfere with natural hand movements. In contrast, head-mounted human egocentric videos are much easier to scale. We introduce Ego2Wrist, which synthesizes synchronized wrist-camera views from human egocentric videos and task descriptions. Trained on approximately 940 hours of paired head- and wrist-camera recordings, Ego2Wrist jointly generates three views. To evaluate generated wrist views without ground truth, we propose hand-centric cross-view consistency (HCC), which measures consistency between generated wrist views and corresponding hand regions in the input head view. HCC ranks model checkpoints comparably to ground-truth-based LPIPS, and human evaluators prefer HCC-selected generations in 77% of responses. Evaluated on four datasets, Ego2Wrist outperforms fine-tuned WorldWander, reducing LPIPS by 28% and receiving human preference in 76% of responses. More importantly, HCC facilitates recursive self-improvement on in-the-wild egocentric videos by selecting generated wrist views for further training. Generation quality progressively improves over three rounds. These results demonstrate a scalable approach to generating real-world wrist-view human manipulation videos for robot policy training.

### 750. [World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29856

**作者：** Sameera S Kashyap、Akshitha Nagaraj、Razvan Marinescu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、astro-ph.EP、astro-ph.IM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29856v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇立场论文，主张物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型最适合用于模拟火星地球化这一长时程、行动条件化的控制问题；文中给出一个结合 JEPA 式 latent 编码、通用微分方程约束与 Dreamer 系规划头的设想架构，并提出 MarsWorld 基准提案。

**相关性简评：** 其随机-确定性 latent 分解、逐步物理一致性约束与长时程 rollout 稳定性论证，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何更新、如何刻画不确定性提供可供核查的线索，但该工作不涉及视觉证据筛选与答案对 latent 的使用，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming

**abstract/A1：** Terraforming Mars is a long-horizon, action-conditioned control problem that requires predicting atmospheric responses to interventions over centuries to identify effective policies. This position paper argues that physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models are the most promising foundation for this setting. Data-driven climate emulators lack action-conditioning, and physics-based general circulation models (GCMs) are too expensive for policy search. Among learned world models, recurrent state-space architectures with physics constraints are better suited than transformer-based alternatives: they provide native uncertainty quantification through their stochastic-deterministic decomposition, remain stable under sparse non-terrestrial training data, and enforce physical consistency at each rollout step. To make this position concrete, we describe a potential architecture combining JEPA-inspired latent encoding, universal differential equation constraints, and a Dreamer-lineage planning head. We also introduce MarsWorld, an open benchmark proposal for intervention-conditioned planetary world models, and discuss broader implications and objections.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29876

**作者：** Jonghyun Lee、Soojung Kang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29876v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29876v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在材料微观结构—性能回归任务上用物理公式自动标注合成图像做监督预训练，并在 100/400/1600 标签预算下与 ImageNet 初始化、掩码重建对比；结果显示不加偏差校正的 EMA 权重平均仍保留约 16% 初始权重，叠加生成器对比度极性混淆，会主导小预算比较，去掉 EMA 后结论需重新核查。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR/VLM 视觉推理无直接关系，但「权重平均残留初始权重、使小数据微调对比失真」这一评估陷阱可能可供核查 LVR 训练消融（如 latent 轨迹监督收益）时各初始化的比较是否被检查点平均混淆。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Weight Averaging at Small Budgets Confounds Formula-Labeled Pretraining in Microstructure-Property Regression: A Pre-Specified Study with Post Hoc Rechecks

**abstract/A1：** Closed-form physics formulas can label synthetic microstructures at no cost, so supervised pretraining on those labels is an alternative to self-supervised pretraining when labels are scarce. One pre-specified protocol tests this on two public simulated benchmarks, two-phase conductivity and short-fiber stiffness: a ConvNeXt-Small is pretrained on 150,000 synthetic images by formula regression or masked reconstruction and fine-tuned on 100, 400, or 1,600 labels. Five fine-tuning seeds from one formula checkpoint have mean residual correlations of 0.994 (conductivity) and 0.999 (stiffness). On conductivity the formula network compresses its predictions (slope 0.64) and has four times the 400-label error of ImageNet initialization. Two confounds interact: the generator renders the low-conductivity phase with the opposite contrast polarity, and the exponential moving average (EMA; decay 0.995, no bias correction) still holds 16% of the initial weights after the 400-label schedule. Without the EMA the slope is 0.97, and over three subsets and five seeds the mismatched checkpoint has 1.4 times the ImageNet error (0.0119 versus 0.0084). Three pretraining runs per polarity leave the comparison inconclusive: matched means (0.0086, 0.0111, 0.0118) fall below mismatched means (0.0119, 0.0120, 0.0123) in aggregate (0.0105 versus 0.0121) but overlap on two of three subsets, and the matched spread (0.0032) exceeds the mismatched spread (0.0004). On stiffness without the EMA, formula pretraining lowers the 100-label error by 18% versus ImageNet over five seeds, including a re-initialized head, while ImageNet seeds also correlate at 0.992. Weight averages that start at the pretrained weights can dominate small-budget comparisons and should be rechecked at the last weights.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29882

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 IR-ODWSP，将目标检测器各层通过函数保持算子提升到矩、2D-DCT、PCA 与 Stiefel-Procrustes 等解耦子空间，在不反向传播、零额外参数与 FLOPs 的前提下完成权重空间编辑，实现检测器修复、跨域与延迟预算调节。

**相关性简评：** 其「把内部参数提升到结构化子空间并在各向异性度量下编辑」的思路，可能为 LVR 中免训练的 latent 状态修改与表示几何（子空间分解、度量选择）提供类比线索；但任务是目标检测、不涉及多模态推理，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reparameterizing Your Object Detectors for Weight Space Programming

**abstract/A1：** Weight-Space Programming (WSP) edits network weights without backpropagation, yet directly editing converged object detectors stalls or collapses because set prediction penalizes duplicate boxes as false positives while compact parameterizations trap weights in an isotropic Euclidean minimum. We propose Inverse-Reparameterized Object-Detection WSP (IR-ODWSP), lifting detector layers via exact function-preserving operators (E, C) into decoupled moment, 2D-DCT, PCA, and Stiefel-Procrustes subspaces. Solving winner-exclusive updates and folding back (Delta Params=0%, Delta FLOPs=0%) induces an anisotropic Riemannian metric, improving all 26/26 MS COCO settings across 17 YOLO26, EdgeCrafter, and RF-DETR detectors (up to +0.31 APs), +1.42 mAP cross-basin COCO-O, zeroimage repair (+2.95 mAP), and label-free weather adaptation (+2.79 AP). Without retraining, IR-ODWSP supports -100% to +100% latency budgets across bridged contraction, 1.00x folding, dynamic (IR-ODWSP-DYN), and static (IR-ODWSP-SG) graphs: -10% retains 51.62 AP / 33.48 mAP, while positive budgets scale monotonically (+0.30 AP at +10%, +1.12 on RF-DETR-N; 54.83 AP at +100%; 55.91 AP / 35.44 mAP in IR-ODWSP+). Source code is released at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/ODWSP.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 12 figures

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.RO

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在部分可观测强化学习中固定信念估计与策略优化，比较统计摘要、CGF 特征和置换不变集合编码器对粒子信念的表示方式，并在八个任务上考察端到端训练与重构、任务特定预测等预训练方式对策略性能的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「重构得好不等于好的控制输入」及预训练目标筛选的结论，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态应保留何种任务必要信息、以及视觉证据编码器的训练目标选择；但该工作无视觉输入与 latent 推理生成，联动仅为概念层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability

**abstract/A1：** Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.

</details>

### 754. [Second-Order Dynamics in Noisy RNNs Produce Exploration and Temporal Compression in Replay](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29888v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29888

**作者：** Josue Casco-Rodriguez、Nanda H. Krishna、Richard G. Baraniuk

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29888v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29888v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文将噪声 RNN 中自发产生的「replay」重新解释为对时序经验分布逐时间步采样的第二阶 Langevin 过程，提出由 spike-frequency adaptation 驱动空间探索、由树突输入微分提供动量以产生时间压缩，并用三角迷宫、T 迷宫与合成大鼠位置细胞活动仿真加以验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「二阶状态更新—动量—时间压缩」框架可能与 LVR 中 latent 轨迹如何在探索充分性与长度压缩之间权衡相关，且对循环状态如何在内部推进推理提供概念类比，但属神经科学模型，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Second-Order Dynamics in Noisy RNNs Produce Exploration and Temporal Compression in Replay

**abstract/A1：** Biological neural networks (like the hippocampus) can internally generate "replay" resembling stimulus-driven activity. Recent computational models of replay use noisy recurrent neural networks (RNNs) trained to path-integrate. Replay in these networks is described as Langevin sampling, but this theory alone fails to capture the environmental exploration and temporal compression observed in real biological replay. To close this gap, we re-examine spontaneous noisy RNN activity ("replay") as Langevin sampling, one timestep at a time, from a time-series distribution resembling lived experiences (unlike previous works which defined sampling as Monte Carlo inference over a static distribution). We provide a normative second-order Langevin sampling framework wherein spike-frequency adaptation drives spatial exploration at the cost of speed, and momentum via dendritic input differentiation drives temporal compression. We numerically verify our framework via simulations of noisy RNNs trained on 2D triangular and T-maze navigation activity, and others trained on place cell activity of synthetic rats. Crucially, we observe that simultaneous adaptation and momentum increases both replay exploration and speed, and provide one of the first accounts for biologically plausible temporal compression in rate-based RNN replay. Our findings encourage experiments into whether dendritic input differentiation, or other mechanisms, may support temporal compression in memory circuits like the hippocampus.

</details>

### 755. [Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29905v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29905

**作者：** Frédéric Li Combeau、Nicolas Michel、Toshihiko Yamasaki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29905v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29905v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CL-P 设置，把持续学习与测试期适配结合：训练和测试阶段都遇到分布偏移；并诊断出朴素结合的 TTA 会因共享 BatchNorm 统计量而破坏刚学到的域、加剧遗忘，进而提出 DOSE，在测试时推断域归属并按该概率逐图按比例施加适配。

**相关性简评：** 其「按域概率门控的逐样本表示更新」与「测试期适配反而损害已学域」的观察，可能为 VLM 在线/流式适配中 latent 状态与缓存如何更新、何时停止适配提供可核查线索，但完全不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview

**abstract/A1：** Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. The model must then adapt to new domains at train and test time. In this paper, we evaluate mainstream CL and TTA methods that adapt only at train or test time, as well as their naive combination. Experimentally, TTA heavily damages the domain on which the CL method has just trained and increases forgetting. Notably, this damage mostly comes from the BatchNorm statistics shared by all domains. In that sense, we propose DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain), which allows a seamless combination of any CL and TTA methods by adaptive domain inference at test time, where the adaptation is applied to each image in proportion to the probability that it comes from the preview domain. Through extensive experiments with ResNet and ViT backbones, various combinations of CL and TTA baseline methods and datasets considering diverse domains, we show that DOSE matches or improves on CL methods alone in all 24 settings and on the naive combination in all but one. The code can be found in appendix.

**comment/C1：** 37 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 756. [When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29955v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.29955

**作者：** Haoran Zhang、Sarah Lam、Yuting Lin、Nuo Chen、Mingyang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.29955v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.29955v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 CheXpert 上训练 ResNet-50 与 DenseNet-121 并跨数据集迁移到 MIMIC-CXR，用 AUC、ECE、Brier score 和错误样本平均置信度评估置信可靠性，并用 Grad-CAM 分析跨域性能下降的来源。

**相关性简评：** 分布偏移下置信可靠性退化、以及源域 temperature scaling 反而抬高错误样本置信度，可供核查以置信度作为 STOP 或弃权信号时的可靠边界；Grad-CAM 显示的空间注意力集中与分散差异，也可能为视觉证据筛选问题提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift

**abstract/A1：** Deep learning models for chest X-ray analysis often achieve strong performance on benchmark datasets, but their reliability under cross-dataset deployment remains unclear. In clinical practice, models trained in one hospital system may be applied to data from another, where distributional and labeling differences can affect both prediction accuracy and model confidence. We conduct a controlled empirical study of model confidence under cross-dataset transfer. We train ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 on CheXpert and evaluate them on MIMIC-CXR across five experimental settings, focusing on Pneumothorax and Pleural Effusion. We measure predictive performance using AUC and confidence reliability using Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and average confidence on incorrect predictions, all reported with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We further evaluate post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the source validation set and use Grad-CAM to examine the mechanism behind cross-domain performance differences. Cross-domain AUC drops 7-13 percentage points, and the best in-domain model is not the best cross-domain model. Source-domain temperature scaling produces marginal ECE changes but systematically increases confidence on incorrect predictions across all four model-pathology combinations. Grad-CAM reveals that DenseNet relies on a concentrated spatial prior that fails to transfer, while ResNet's more distributed attention generalizes better. These findings argue for cross-site validation and safety-specific calibration metrics in medical AI evaluation.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Course research project, CS585 Image and Video Computing, Boston University, Spring 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在自适应LLM红队循环中追踪攻击多样性下降的起点，通过六个机制、三条实验臂（联合训练、冻结防御者、半学习率）做二十四轮测试，发现仅以成功为奖励经组相对优势传导至攻击者更新是收窄主因。

**相关性简评：** 其「成功奖励—组相对优势—策略更新」导致行为多样性坍缩的分析，可能为核查RL训练下latent推理状态与轨迹的多样性、信息坍缩及信用分配提供类比线索，但领域相距较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 Raspberry Pi 4B 上用四个冻结的 TON-IoT 检测器检验运行时模型选择，结合配对静态对照、固定因子设计与物理测量，比较 Q-learning/DQN 选择器和 DeadlineGuard 规则在检测质量、能耗与截止期错失上的得失，并审计选择器退化为静态 LightLR 及训练支持域外的默认动作。

**相关性简评：** 该文关于成本约束下自适应选择器退化为静态选择、支持域外动作与配对静态基线的分析框架，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等动态计算与停止策略的收益归因和失败模式评价提供概念性启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Learned IDS Model Selection Collapses to a Static Choice: A Measurement Study at the Edge

**abstract/A1：** Runtime model selection trades detection quality against energy and latency. However, comparing a selector only with a more costly static detector conflates detector choice with the benefit of adaptation. We present a framework for analysis and physical measurement that combines a pairwise reward criterion, matched static controls, paired blocks, a fixed load-prevalence factorial design, and reporting of actions outside training support. On one Raspberry Pi 4B with four frozen TON-IoT detectors, tabular Q-learning and a deep Q-network (DQN) both select LightLR throughout. A retrospective audit using validation data only rules out preference reversals for MedRF versus LightLR and HeavyMLP versus LightLR. However, TinyDT has a higher reward than LightLR in seven of the 2,500 windows, so the audit does not establish global LightLR optimality. We also evaluate a causal DeadlineGuard rule under a fixed factorial design with three arrival rates (50, 100, and 4,000 rows/s) and three attack prevalences (0.10, 0.50, and 0.90). Compared with Static-MedRF, DeadlineGuard saves 43.7 J per 500-s run (2.98%; 95% paired CI 41.4--46.0 J) and eliminates all 512 deadline misses among 5,000 windows, at a cost of 1.373 percentage points in F1. Outside training support, Tabular-Q's deterministic tie-breaking rule selects TinyDT, resulting in a false-positive rate of 67.76%. These single-board results motivate joint audits of reward attainability, realized actions, attribution against matched static controls, service feasibility, and default actions outside training support.

</details>

### 760. [Training Dynamics of Large State-Transition Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30005v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30005

**作者：** Yee Man Choi、Fengchi Wang、Ruiquan Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30005v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30005v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 从理论上研究单 token 上下文的「状态转移模型」在嵌入维度 d&lt;V 时联合训练输入/输出嵌入的动力学：在低秩、有界条目的真实转移律下，证明 untied 模型训练末段的相对预测增益可持续高于 7/8，tied 模型在观测状态上接近最优，并在覆盖条件下对未见状态给出预测保证。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本嵌入训练理论，与 LVR 无直接关联；但其关于低秩结构可恢复所需状态维度、tied 嵌入在覆盖条件下向未见状态迁移的结论，可能为 latent 工作区的容量、信息保留与证据泛化问题提供类比，Hessian 迹界也可供核查内部状态的预测增益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training Dynamics of Large State-Transition Models

**abstract/A1：** Next-token prediction relies on learned token embeddings whose dimension $d$ is much smaller than the vocabulary size $V$. Existing analyses of training dynamics either fix the embeddings with $d\\ge V$ or train them only in restricted settings. It remains unclear whether jointly training the embeddings by gradient-based methods from random initialization leads to accurate prediction when $d&lt;V$. In this paper, we study this question in the simplest setting where it is already nontrivial, namely next-token prediction with a one-token context, which we refer to as a state-transition model. The model consists of an input embedding and an output embedding, either untied or tied, and is trained from Gaussian initialization by perturbed gradient descent with weight decay on the population cross-entropy loss. We consider ground-truth transition laws whose centered log-probability table has low rank and bounded entries, and measure the prediction quality by the relative prediction gain (RPG). It is zero for the uniform predictor and one for the optimal predictor. For the untied model, we show that when $d=Ω(\\sqrt V)$, with probability at least $1-e^{-cd}$ for some constant $c$, the RPG is above $7/8$ at every iterate in the final $1-1/d$ fraction of training iterations. For the tied model trained on a subset of states, we prove that the RPG on the observed states is $1-O(V/d^2)$, and under a coverage condition on the ground truth and a bound on the learned embeddings, we further prove a prediction guarantee on the unseen states. Our analysis is based on the bounded trace of the Hessian of the softmax cross-entropy loss, which implies that the approximate second-order stationary points reached by training have high prediction gain. Numerical experiments with practical parameter choices illustrate the persistent training gain and the transfer of the tied model.

**comment/C1：** preprint

</details>

### 761. [OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30017v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30017

**作者：** Jacob Cole、Martin Dimakis、Victor Barres、Bertie Vidgen、Edward Hu、Jason Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30017v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30017v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 OWE-Bench，包含 26 个由领域专家撰写的长时程工程任务（软件、物理工程、机器学习、科学计算），按速度、成本与准确率在可自测的给定用例和隐藏用例上评分，并报告前沿模型在测试时计算扩展与「部署差距」上的表现。

**相关性简评：** 模型在隐藏用例上平均低 18 分、却高估自身表现约 21 分这一自评失准现象，可能为 LVR 中停止决策与自验证的校准、以及长度/分布泛化评价提供参照，但任务为纯文本工程 agent，与视觉 latent 状态无直接联系，可供核查其评价方式能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering

**abstract/A1：** We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake. Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task. Solutions are scored on practical measures such as speed, cost and accuracy, both on provided cases the agent could test against and on hidden cases that an engineer would expect from the task description. The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task. We highlight two findings. First, when models are given more time, they use more test-time compute and achieve higher scores. Models also scale differently with test-time compute: GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at shorter time limits and at equal token use, while Claude Fable 5.2 uses more tokens at longer limits to achieve the highest overall score. Second, each model scores lower on hidden cases than on the provided cases, by an average of 18 points, which we call the deployment gap. Models also fail to predict the deployment gap, overestimating their performance on hidden test cases by an average of 21 points. We hope that OWE-Bench grounds progress toward agents whose engineering solutions perform as well in deployment as they do in testing.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/Mercor-Intelligence/OpenWorldEngineer ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mercor/OpenWorldEngineer ; leaderboard: https://openworldengineer.mercor.com

</details>

### 762. [Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30027v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30027

**作者：** Jian Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DC、cs.PF

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30027v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30027v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析 Hopper GPU 上 4-bit KV cache 解码为何慢（需软件解码、指令发射预算受限），并给出重叠 TMA 生产 warp 与两个计算 warpgroup 的原生解码内核，配合 K 均值移除、旋转、BF16 sink token 与 layer 0 保 BF16 的精度配方，在 H200 上提升带宽利用率与解码吞吐且保持精度。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的关联在成本侧：KV cache 是长推理轨迹的状态载体，其量化后的内存与延迟预算直接影响 THINK/LOOK 迭代的可负担长度；文中「Qwen2 推理变体在 FP8 KV 下崩溃、layer 0 保留 BF16 可恢复」可供核查压缩状态是否选择性损害推理能力，但内核层面没有可迁移的 latent 表示或训练线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them

**abstract/A1：** A 4-bit KV cache reads about half the bytes of FP8, but Hopper GPUs have no FP4 hardware and little instruction-issue capacity per byte of memory bandwidth, so 4-bit values must be decoded in software. On H200, vLLM's NVFP4 KV path (FlashInfer's decode) reaches 10-20% of memory bandwidth and is up to 1.7x slower than FP8. NVBit instruction counts show two causes: the kernels behind vLLM's 4-bit paths (FlashInfer NVFP4, Triton UltraQuant) execute 2-6x Hopper's issue budget per byte and serialize loading, decoding and matrix multiplies. Our Hopper-native decode kernel overlaps a TMA producer warp with two compute warpgroups, lays the cache out at write time so decoded values feed the tensor cores from registers, and swaps the matrix operands so small query groups need no padding. On H200 it reaches 67-75% of peak bandwidth at batch 32-128 and at all 11 shapes is 1.12-1.49x faster than the faster of XQA and FlashAttention-4's proposed native FP8. Inside vLLM, with an accuracy recipe (K mean removal and rotation, 4 BF16 sink tokens, BF16 layer 0), it decodes 1.12-1.64x faster per step on Llama-3.1-8B than vLLM's FlashInfer FP8 path at batch 8 and above (1.04-1.24x over FlashAttention-4's FP8), is level at batch 1, and holds 1.63x as many tokens. On one H200 under a reasoning-like request stream, the highest rate at which 99% of requests meet the latency targets is 1.23-1.32x FP8's on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.67-2.20x on Qwen2.5-72B, as the cache becomes the limit; prefill-heavy streams are worse (7% slower prefill). On five 7B-32B models, repeated runs show no significant accuracy difference from BF16 KV. In Qwen2-family models, whose reasoning variants collapse under FP8 KV, layer 0's key mean is almost entirely the key-projection bias identified by prior work, seen through RoPE and computable from the weights alone; keeping that layer in BF16 restores FP8 KV and, with K mean removal, 4-bit KV.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages. Code: https://github.com/thomaszhang2661/kv4-hopper

</details>

### 763. [SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30042v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30042

**作者：** Jenna Kang、Bingxuan Li、Colin Groth、Anatolii Evdokimov、Sai Zhang、Qi Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30042v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30042v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SWAM 在交互式 3D 环境中把 NPC 状态演化与自回归视觉生成解耦：轻量状态模型仅凭动作、结合运动先验与场景修正预测角色状态，再以条件方式引导扩散 transformer 结合视觉历史生成画面。

**相关性简评：** 其「内部状态不依赖生成帧即可演化、并在视野外维持实体一致性」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态维持与视觉证据筛选相关，可供核查；但该工作是世界模型生成而非多模态推理，迁移价值需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments

**abstract/A1：** Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.

</details>

### 764. [EVD-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for EEG-to-Image Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30061v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30061

**作者：** Kieren Yu、Qian Zhang、Ziyang Liu、Chang Huang、Jintai Chen、Kaishun Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30061v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30061v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 EVD-Bench，在 THINGS-EEG2 上统一 gallery 与 EEG 输入、匹配训练预算，系统比较 within-subject、joint-subject 与严格留一被试三种被试访问设定下的概念级零样本检索，并做 trial 平均、gallery 规模、EEG 时长与通道、置信校准等消融。

**相关性简评：** 属脑信号解码这一较远领域，但其「零 EEG 与错配 EEG」对照用于检验结果是否真正依赖正确刺激配对，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案实际使用的因果核查与报告规范提供借鉴，宜作背景性阅读。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EVD-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for EEG-to-Image Decoding

**abstract/A1：** EEG-to-image decoding recovers visual information from non-invasive brain recordings, providing a window into human perception. However, comparisons across systems are confounded by a variable that is rarely reported as such: which participants' data the system was allowed to use. The same Top-1 score on a 200-way gallery may come from a per-participant system, a pooled model over all participants, or a model that never saw the test participant---cases that differ by more than most architectural changes between the methods being compared. We present \\bench, a benchmark on THINGS-EEG2 that standardizes the gallery and EEG input, matches training budgets across systems within each regime, and compares three participant-access regimes: within-subject, joint-subject, and strict leave-one-subject-out, with unlabeled target calibration reported separately. All three settings evaluate concept-level zero-shot retrieval: the 200 test concepts are disjoint from the 1,654 concepts used for EEG--image fitting and validation. We compare retrieval across access regimes and use zero-EEG and matched-wrong EEG controls to assess dependence on correct EEG--stimulus pairing. We vary trial averaging, gallery size and difficulty, and training data coverage, and compare target adaptation and visual feature targets. We also assess sensitivity to EEG window length and channel count, robustness to input perturbations, and confidence calibration. These results establish participant-access regime as a necessary reporting dimension alongside gallery, repetition, and visual target.

</details>

### 765. [FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30067v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30067

**作者：** Wentao Lu、Shengzhe Cui、Xihao Wu、Dingxin Yan、Yixuan Qin、Pengfei Fang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30067v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30067v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FolioWeaver 以 LayerGraph 组织分层图像资产，用持久化的 Executable Scene State 支撑反馈驱动的定向编辑与自我修复，并发布 LayerFolio 数据集及 AtomicQA、CBLP 两项评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「持久状态＋选择性执行＋视觉验证修复」的循环，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的维护、局部更新与证据核验提供类比线索；但对象是可编辑图层资产而非 latent 推理表示，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing

**abstract/A1：** Layered image generation separates images into compositable layers, allowing users to manipulate individual elements independently. However, such asset-level editability does not enable the generation system to interpret successive feedback, perform targeted edits, and preserve unaffected content. We introduce FolioWeaver, a LayerGraph-grounded agent that unifies layered-image generation and iterative editing through a persistent Executable Scene State. FolioWeaver constructs a LayerGraph and generates independent visual assets conditioned on a shared scene reference. An Editing Agent performs feedback-driven modifications and self-repair through scoped actions, selective layer execution, and visual verification, enabling targeted updates while reusing unchanged assets. We also publicly release LayerFolio, a dataset of 100,377 human-reviewed layered scenes spanning six visual domains, together with two evaluation protocols: AtomicQA for measuring requirement satisfaction and CBLP for assessing layer organization. Experiments demonstrate that FolioWeaver achieves superior layer organization and composite fidelity compared with direct layered-generation methods. Analyses validate the contributions of component adaptation, execution-grounded repair, and cross-domain training. FolioWeaver advances layered-image generation toward persistent, controllable, and iterative visual creation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FolioWeaver/LayerFolio.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 766. [Stable but Hidden: Identifiability and Experimental Design under Missing Compositional Support](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30070v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30070

**作者：** Harry Sevi、Joonatan E. M. Laulainen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.mtrl-sci

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30070v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30070v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究组合支持缺失下的可识别性失败：不同响应函数可在已观测组合上一致、却在缺失组合上分歧，并刻画不可见子空间及最优联合测量设计，在材料数据上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「同支持数据与模型一致性无法暴露结构歧义」及按未识别方向设计测量的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 证据筛选与不确定性评价提供概念借鉴，但领域距离较远，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stable but Hidden: Identifiability and Experimental Design under Missing Compositional Support

**abstract/A1：** AI-guided scientific discovery often uses inexpensive predictors to allocate scarce verification measurements. We study a structural failure when relevant components have been observed separately but never jointly: distinct admissible response functions can agree on all observed compositions while disagreeing on the missing combinations. Additional same-support data cannot resolve this ambiguity, and agreement among fitted models need not expose it. We characterize the unresolved directions as an invisible subspace $\\mathcal{N}\_T(\\mathcal{F}) = \\ker \\mathcal{R}\_T$, whose geometry determines oracle zero-shot ambiguity and minimax risk under a symmetric, bounded ambiguity class. When the missing response lies in an $r$-dimensional, well-conditioned linear basis, optimally designed joint measurements achieve minimax integrated risk $Θ(σ^2 r/m)$, with classical $I$-optimality the fixed-design criterion. We validate on materials. In electrocatalysis, a six-dimensional support-derived structural basis (a prior on candidate directions, not an identified physical model) reduces held-out MSE against a dimension-matched generic basis (median paired ratio 0.75, improving 98% of 60 element pairs at $m = 15$), while $I$-optimal and same-basis posterior-variance acquisition show no detected difference. In Materials Project, removing joint property labels reduces $E\_{\\text{above hull}}$ ranking on 90% of 30 element pairs, more than matched data-removal controls, under a frozen pretrained representation. Pair difficulty is reproducible across learners but poorly predicted by zero-label ensemble disagreement; 20 joint measurements enable transferable pair-level rankings without reliable absolute calibration. In practice, experiment selection should ask which relationships the observed support leaves unidentified before asking where a fitted model is least certain.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop, NeurIPS 2026. 9-page main text plus appendices (53 pages total), 8 figures

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文描述一个自动化蛋白质生产与筛选平台，并检验其溶液相金属亲和测量能否迁移到固定化稀土分离场景：在82组蛋白-金属配对及公开417蛋白LAMBS数据上比较不同终点定义下的相关系数，并引入蛋白身份置换零模型。

**相关性简评：** 与LVR无直接关联，但其核心警示——看似很高的profile层面一致性可能来自系列内共享排序而非个体身份，必须以置换零模型剥离——可供核查「用latent表示相似度作为推理证据代理」时，相似度是否同样被共享深度、位置等全局结构夸大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correlated by Construction: Endpoint Choice and the Validation of Protein Screening

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning for protein engineering depends on functional measurements collected at screening scale, but the designs those measurements rank are deployed in processes that run elsewhere. Whether a miniaturized assay remains informative under the conditions of use is usually assumed rather than demonstrated. We describe an automated production and screening platform and test the transfer of its solution-phase metal-affinity measurements to immobilized rare-earth separation. Primary pKd-derived separation factors tracked those measured on covalently immobilized protein across 82 protein-metal-pair measurements from 35 proteins, with pairwise Spearman correlations of 0.878 to 0.923 (pooled Pearson $r$ = 0.836; Spearman $ρ$ = 0.869). Separation factors at a fixed metal pair are insensitive to the ordering shared across the lanthanide series, so these coefficients report protein-specific correspondence directly; permutation of protein identity confirms it, giving a mean scrambled correlation of 0.003 and, for the 17 proteins measured on all three pairs, $r$ = 0.917 against 0.001 ($p \\approx 0.001$). Profiles compared as profiles behave differently. An independent comparison against published LAMBS profiles for the same protein backbones (417 proteins, 5,212 paired measurements) reproduced normalized raw elution at $r$ = 0.870, but reassigning protein identity still reached 0.840. High profile-level agreement across assay formats is largely attributable to metal preferences shared across the series rather than to protein identity. Transfer can be demonstrated, but the endpoint decides whether a correlation shows it: a pairwise contrast removes the shared ordering; a normalized profile retains it, and needs a null that reassigns protein identity.

### 768. [Grokking as a Subspace Search: Computing the Destination Before Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30116

**作者：** Sunjae Jeong、Jaeseung Kim、Hyoseok Hwang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30116v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 grokking 现象：在群任务上，从任务本身即可在训练前算出泛化所对应的低维嵌入子空间「right subspace」，并证明其基本唯一；通过训练前注入、移除该子空间及训练中干预，验证泛化延迟等于网络搜索到该子空间所需时间。

**相关性简评：** 「表示子空间可由任务预先计算、延迟即搜索该子空间的时间」这一框架，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否收敛到任务决定的低维结构、动态计算与训练长度预算的因果解释提供可核查的类比，但任务限于群运算，与视觉推理的关联需阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Grokking as a Subspace Search: Computing the Destination Before Training

**abstract/A1：** Grokking is the phenomenon in which a neural network generalizes long after it has memorized its training data. Many explanations have been proposed for the delay between memorization and generalization. However, none of them can say before training where the network is heading, so they cannot be tested against one another. We show that on group tasks this destination can be computed from the task itself before training begins. It is a low-dimensional subspace of the network's embeddings, which we call the right subspace, and we prove that it is essentially unique. Knowing the destination makes our hypothesis falsifiable: the delay is a search for the right subspace, and generalization begins when the network finds it. When we give the network the right subspace from the start, the delay disappears. When we take the right subspace away, accuracy stops at a ceiling that we compute before training, and on multiplication the network cannot generalize at all. When we train the network normally, its embeddings move toward the right subspace by themselves, long before test accuracy rises. Finally, interventions during training show that this search sets the length of the delay, and that noise in the optimization does not. On every group task that we tested, grokking is a search for the right subspace, and the delay is the time that this search takes.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 6 figures, 1 table

</details>

### 769. [AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30120v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30120

**作者：** Haiyu Xu、Yiyang Chen、Jiayi Zhou、Jiaming Ji、Juntao Dai、Yaodong Yang、Boyuan Chen

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** AxE Bench 沿智能体与环境八个因素构造受控变体（并扩展 WBench 为 WBench-plus），再提出把生成视频解析为时间定位事件、与参考事件在时序和语义上比对的评测流程，以 Fidelity×Stability 得到 AxE Score，系统衡量视频世界模型的泛化。
