<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events

**abstract/A1：** Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://AxEBench.github.io

</details>

### 770. [AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30139v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30139

**作者：** Zirui Zhu、Cong Zhang、Ni Zhang、Kuan Xu、Zhiguang Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30139v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30139v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AutoSECO，从求解器开发经验中自动演化可复用技能：借助求解器代码与开发决策记录把外部评测差距回溯归因到指导缺陷，且仅在修订后新求解器评测更优时保留该修订；在 TSP 上演化后迁移到多个组合优化问题。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「由最终结果回溯归因到中间决策、并以重新验证为门槛筛选更新」的做法，可能为 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与更新筛选提供参考，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routing, job-shop scheduling, and three-dimensional bin packing without further skill evolution. On TSP, the final mean benchmark gap is 0.52\\%, compared with 0.98\\% for the skill-evolution baseline SkillOpt. Across all four problems, the evolved skill achieves better aggregate results than no skill guidance, the initial skill, and SkillOpt. The same frozen skill also supports solver development under alternative model--harness configurations. These findings suggest that solver-development experience can be retained as reusable expertise for general-purpose LLM agents.

</details>

### 771. [LambdaLens: Auditing a Representation-Changing Hyperparameter in Graph Neighbor Embedding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30140v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30140

**作者：** Juntang Wang、Yihan Wang、Sheng'en Li、Siyuan Cao、Liming Zhu、Man Zhang、Dongmian Zou、Shixin Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30140v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30140v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LambdaLens，解析 SG-t-SNE-Π 中重标度参数 λ 如何从单条边概率的归一化幂路径传导到整体布局几何，并在固定其他条件、变换 λ 的设置下比较六张图的布局稳定性与标签保真度；同时用四个探针在 16 值网格上以更少评估逼近最优分数。

**相关性简评：** 图嵌入与 LVR 距离较远，但其「用少数探针审计一个改变表示的超参数如何影响表示所保留的任务相关信息」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 视觉状态的表示诊断、相似度来源与超参数敏感性分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LambdaLens: Auditing a Representation-Changing Hyperparameter in Graph Neighbor Embedding

**abstract/A1：** Changing a graph embedding parameter can change what the layout represents. In SG-t-SNE-$Π$, the rescaling parameter $λ$ changes the probability assigned to each neighbor before optimization begins. We introduce LambdaLens to trace that change from individual edges to the resulting layout. For nodes with at least two neighbors, we derive a normalized power path. When the original weights are unequal, the number of neighbors determines where the weights become uniform and where their ordering reverses. Near $λ=1$, the rate of change in each edge probability depends on its surprisal relative to the neighborhood entropy. To measure the geometric effect, we vary $λ$ while holding the input graph, initialization, random seed, and optimizer settings fixed. Across six graphs, some layouts continue to move as $λ$ increases, others stabilize early, and others barely move. PubMed has the widest relative spread in node degree, yet its layout changes little. On four datasets with class labels, four probes recover 98.48-100% of the best label-fidelity score on a 16-value grid, using 75% fewer evaluations. In a six-dataset comparison, SG-t-SNE-$Π$ attains the highest observed primary score on four datasets and ranks among the top three on all six. On Citeseer, four probes come close to the dense-grid optimum, yet PHATE better preserves class structure, making a change of embedding pipeline worth considering on that graph. \`\`\`

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 772. [Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30142v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30142

**作者：** Mochamad Rizal Fauzan、Doan Pham Thao Nhu、Jeslin Konthoujam、Purit Hongjirakul、Lakshay Chawla

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30142v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30142v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察行人重识别中时空先验重排序的增益有多少来自评测协议而非学到的时空证据：以 ResNet-50 视觉基线在官方测试集上对比简单对数项、同摄像头惩罚与似然比先验，并用打乱时间戳等对照做归因诊断。

**相关性简评：** 其控制先验与打乱时间戳的增益归因做法、以及「视觉基线越强增益越小」的观察，可能与 LVR 中区分 latent 内容贡献与捷径或协议伪影的评价问题相类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking

**abstract/A1：** Spatio-temporal priors re-rank person re-identification matches using the camera pair and the time gap, and are reported to add large gains on Market-1501. We ask how much of such a gain encodes the evaluation protocol rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence. Starting from a course-project re-ranker that adds log camera-transition and log time-gap terms to cosine similarity, we train a strong ResNet-50 baseline (Rank-1 94.3 %, mAP 86.2 % over three seeds), choose the fusion weights on an identity-disjoint validation split and evaluate on the official test set with control priors. The repository form adds 2.30 mAP points, but a one-parameter penalty on same-camera pairs alone adds 2.19: the protocol never places a true match in the query's camera, so the penalty removes distractors for free. The time term of that form is almost unused; a pair-level diagnostic traces this to its modelling the time gap given a match without dividing by the gap distribution of all candidate pairs. A likelihood-ratio prior adds 4.04 points without the penalty and 5.62 with it; shuffling the time stamps removes the extra gain, so about 3.43 points are tied to identity. The prior fixes the first-ranked match of 4.2 % of the queries and breaks it for 0.1 %. The gain shrinks as the visual baseline improves (11.9 to 5.62 points between a 70.5 % and a 86.2 % mAP model) and concentrates on queries whose true matches share the query's video sequence. The study covers one dataset, one backbone and three seeds.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/rizalfanex/spatiotemporal-bayesian-reid

</details>

### 773. [IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30153v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30153

**作者：** Qinyi Zhang、Duanyu Feng、Yangshuai Wang、Hao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.NA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30153v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30153v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 IADR 神经算子：用保留扩散-反应结构的靶网络维持 Allen-Cahn 相场结构，再用超网络把界面宽度 ε 映射为靶网络权重，从而以单一模型覆盖多个 ε 的平均曲率流模拟，并给出条件式 K 步 rollout 误差界。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其结构保持的靶网络、按参数条件化权重以及多步 rollout 误差界，可能可供核查 latent 迭代更新的稳定性、长度泛化与按推理步数条件化状态生成的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow

**abstract/A1：** The Allen-Cahn equation is one of the standard phase-field models for mean-curvature flow (MCF), parameterised by the diffuse-interface width $\\varepsilon$. Practical simulations span a range of $\\varepsilon$, so a single model covering this range is needed. PDE-specific neural operators are accurate but must be retrained at every $\\varepsilon$; general neural operators cover $\\varepsilon$ in one model but lose the phase-field structure of the target. We introduce Interface-Augmented Diffusion-Reaction (IADR), a neural operator that addresses both shortcomings: a target network with a diffusion-and-reaction (DR) structure preserves the phase-field structure of the Allen-Cahn equation, while a hypernetwork that maps $\\varepsilon$ to the weights of this target network amortises the dependence on $\\varepsilon$ across the range. A single IADR matches the per-$\\varepsilon$ specialists on in-distribution data within the prescribed range, retains their cross-shape generalisation under both $\\varepsilon$- and geometry-out-of-distribution shifts, and retains their compact DR target structure with millisecond-scale inference. We further establish a conditional $K$-step rollout error bound under consistency and stability assumptions.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, 5 figures. Qinyi Zhang and Duanyu Feng contributed equally. Yangshuai Wang and Hao Wang are co-corresponding authors. Code: https://github.com/ArcueidCroft/IADR

</details>

### 774. [Preserve to Compress: Beyond Low-Dimensional Latents in One-Step Diffusion Codec](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30154v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30154

**作者：** Chuqin Zhou、Xiaoyue Ling、Yuhang Wei、Yunuo Chen、Guo Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30154v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30154v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PICS 一步扩散图像压缩框架，用信息保持适配器改造预训练 latent 接口，使编码端获得更丰富特征并在解码全程保留信息，以缓解低维 latent 的细节丢失。

**相关性简评：** 该文对「低维 latent 接口在编码前即丢弃源细节、限制信息到达解码器」的分析及适配器式信息保持设计，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节是否留在内部状态、latent 维度与信息坍缩的关系提供类比线索，需核查其信息度量方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Preserve to Compress: Beyond Low-Dimensional Latents in One-Step Diffusion Codec

**abstract/A1：** Pretrained latent diffusion models bring powerful generative priors to ultra-low-bitrate image compression, but their latent spaces reflect a reconstruction--generation tradeoff. Low-dimensional latents reduce modeling cost but can discard image details, while higher-dimensional latents improve reconstruction yet make diffusion optimization harder under a fixed computational budget. Generative codecs that adopt these pretrained spaces also inherit this compromise, even though compression requires fidelity to a specific source image. In particular, low-dimensional latent interfaces can discard source details before coding and restrict how much decoded information reaches the image decoder. We propose Preserving Information for Compression and Synthesis (PICS), a one-step generative image compression framework that adapts these interfaces to preserve source information. Our Information-Preserving Adaptors (IPAs) expose richer features for coding and retain decoded information throughout reconstruction, while deferred decoder adaptation stabilizes training and helps the image decoder exploit the expanded representations. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC 2020 show average BD-rate savings of 52.64% and 39.61% over StableCodec at matched LPIPS and DISTS, respectively.

</details>

### 775. [UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30157v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30157

**作者：** Ye Pan、Chenfei Liao、Bin Ren、Hanqian Li、Haocong He、Jialei Chen、Jinlin He、Kunyu Peng、Mengyu Jin、Shijie Li、Wenqian Cui、Yuanqi Yao、Yuqian Fu、Kailong Ruan、Yuan Gao、Wei Wang、Xuming Hu、Irwin King、Nicu Sebe、Xu Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30157v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30157v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UUBench，用于评测全双工多模态交互系统能否理解用户通过语调、表情、手势传达的隐含沟通需求并作出恰当的音视频回应，并设计过程导向评分、结果导向评分以及基于带时间戳音视频证据的 JEV 评分模块。

**相关性简评：** 其把评分锚定在可观测的音视频线索、按维度与标注证据的相关性加权聚合的做法，可能为 LVR 中「回答是否真正使用视觉证据」的归因式评价提供思路，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction

**abstract/A1：** Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether systems translate an understanding of such unspoken needs into effective responses. We introduce UUBench, a benchmark for assessing how well multimodal interactive systems Understand the Unspoken intent and address users' implicit communicative needs. The inherent subjectivity of implicit intent inference poses a key challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension's relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human's reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. UUBench provides a foundation for assessing whether multimodal interactive systems respond effectively to meaning beyond literal wording, supporting progress toward context-aware, real-time, full-duplex interaction.

**comment/C1：** 49 pages, 37 figures, 9 tables, including appendices. Preview version; work in progress

</details>

### 776. [AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30162v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30162

**作者：** Jingpu Yang、Fengxian Ji、Tianhao Li、Juanfan Wu、Yufeng Wang、Shuxin Zheng、Xiaoqing Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30162v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30162v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AdaptRouter，用策略学习训练一个紧凑多模态决策模型，读取问题与描述当前可用专家的卡片，在无路由标签、仅依赖任务原生反馈的条件下为每个查询选择一个冻结专家；并支持新任务无回放增量学习、开放权重与 API 专家混合的质量-成本权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其按成本-质量权衡选择外部计算资源的元决策框架，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算分配与停止判断形成概念类比；但作用对象是模型路由而非 latent 视觉推理状态，可供核查迁移价值有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models

**abstract/A1：** Model routing assigns each query to a suitable foundation model, but tasks and available models keep changing, and existing routers are either untrained for the pool at hand or fit once and forget earlier tasks when updated. We present AdaptRouter, an adaptive router trained by policy learning: a compact multimodal decision model reads each question with cards describing the current experts and learns from native task feedback, without routing labels, to select one frozen expert. Open-weight and API experts share the router, its inputs, and the quality-cost trade-off but use different losses: cheap open-weight experts are explored with RL, whereas paid API experts are queried once and their cached feedback is reused as soft labels. New tasks are learned without replay, new experts enter as cards, and an open-weight quality-first advantage provably keeps cost from overriding quality. Across four task stages, AdaptRouter loses at most 0.4 points on earlier tasks, whereas feedback-trained routers lose up to 7.0, and as its pool grows from three to ten experts, its accuracy rises from 67.2% to 72.1%. On five API models, it exceeds GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra (low) by over 22 points at under a third of their cost.

</details>

### 777. [OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30176v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30176

**作者：** Cheng Guo、Qiming Cao、Pu Perry Wang、Pu Wang、Hongfei Xue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30176v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30176v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OmniSenMo，以人体骨架作为各类传感器的公共参考，把 RGB、深度、LiDAR、mmWave、WiFi 分别编码为逐关节 token，在自建多感官模拟器数据上预训练，用同一语言模型完成人体运动估计、理解与预测。

**相关性简评：** 骨架接地的关节 token 把异质传感证据对齐到统一运动词表，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要几何信息是否留在内部状态」与多源视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的表征线索；但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态生成、动态计算或停止决策，联系偏概念层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) estimate, understand, and predict human motion, but mainly from RGB cameras. Depth, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi complement RGB under poor lighting, through occlusions, and in privacy-sensitive applications, but existing multisensory models cover only some of these sensing tasks. Covering all of them from any sensor subset is challenging, since the tokens of heterogeneous sensors are semantically inconsistent and spatially misaligned, paired multisensory data are scarce, and the tasks need different temporal granularities. We present OmniSenMo, a multisensory language model that takes the human skeleton as a common reference for all sensors. Its skeleton-grounded motion representation turns each sensor into joint tokens, one per body joint, so that any sensor subset is fused joint by joint and expressed in the motion vocabulary that the language model learned from motion capture and text. We pretrain it on all five sensors generated by our multisensory simulator, and Multi-Granularity Observation gives each task the frames it needs. On a cross-action split of MM-Fi, the same model with all five sensors outperforms the models compared on each task, including LEO-Fuse in pose estimation (84.1 vs. 89.0 mm MPJPE) and HoloLLM in unseen-action recognition (69.2% vs. 42.8%). Even without RGB, it outperforms both methods that use RGB, and in a cross-dataset validation on XRF55, it recognizes unseen actions far better than HoloLLM.

**comment/C1：** Project website: https://ch3ngguo.github.io/omnisenmo/

</details>

### 778. [Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30190v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30190

**作者：** Zelong Wang、Weiyue Li、Fei Xue、Junru Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30190v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30190v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 web agent 评测的比较过程本身作为研究对象：成功如何定义、判断依据何种证据、agent 间差异如何估计；发现将评判从「预测可能完成」改为「要求记录支持」可在不改变排名的情况下消除大部分报告优势，并提出用评判预测结合抽样任务对的参考标签来直接估计差异。

**相关性简评：** 其对「评判规则—证据要求—差异估计」的拆解可能可供核查 LVR 方法增益报告中由评测口径与证据缺失带来的虚假优势，属评价层面的启发，但不涉及多模态内部状态或 latent 生成本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 779. [Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30195v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30195

**作者：** Tianqi Li、Xin He、Xue Geng、Le Zhang、Ming-Ming Cheng、Yun Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30195v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30195v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PTQ4WAM，在显存、延迟与任务评测预算约束下为 world action models 选择分层量化位宽与执行路线，用校准测量与 GPU profiling 先筛掉不可行方案，再投入昂贵的任务试验。

**相关性简评：** 其按校准灵敏度分配精度、以廉价测量替代昂贵任务验证的预算化筛选思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中「哪些内部状态或计算值得保留」及动态计算成本权衡的评价方式，但属较远领域线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models

**abstract/A1：** World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

</details>

### 780. [Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models under Calibrated Label Errors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30215v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30215

**作者：** Mollah Md Saif、Showrin Rahman、Anindya Majumder、Sowad Rahman、Md. Golam Rabiul Alam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30215v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30215v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出在标签不完美条件下微调地理基础模型的基准协议：把四类空间结构化标注错误校准到相同标签 mIoU，统一施加于九个编码器、六个解码头和十个数据集，并以配对比较和 ±3 点等价边界给出判断。

**相关性简评：** 其「等难度扰动校准＋配对对照＋等价边界」的评价设计可能可供核查，用于 LVR 中差异微小的变体比较与稳健性判定，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models under Calibrated Label Errors

**abstract/A1：** Earth-observation labels from maps, older products or hurried annotation arrive misaligned, coarse, loosely outlined or incomplete. Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) are nevertheless benchmarked with labels taken as correct. A practitioner therefore cannot tell which encoder to choose when the labels are imperfect. We present a benchmark protocol for fine-tuning under such labels. Four spatially structured error types are calibrated to equal label mIoU and applied identically to every model and seed. Every contrast is paired and read against an equivalence margin of $\\pm 3$ points and a minimum detectable effect. We apply it to nine encoders, six decoder heads and ten datasets. In an exploratory reading at a matched learning rate the satellite-pretrained and web-pretrained DINOv3 encoders are equivalent within the margin on 8 of 9 datasets. Multispectral GFMs and an ImageNet ResNet-50 are equivalent within the margin on about half of them. Labels with random offsets cost the least at equal label quality. Under other decoder heads the verdicts mostly hold on FLAIR-2 and are decoder dependent on HLS Burn Scars. On four of five real label pairs the real label costs more than its matched simulated type. No choice of pretraining data makes an encoder consistently more robust, so the encoder is better chosen by its accuracy under imperfect labels.

**comment/C1：** 100 pages (15 pages main text and references, 85 pages appendix), 78 figures, 68 tables. Extended version including supplementary material

</details>

### 781. [RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30219v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30219

**作者：** Xiaohao Sun、Angel X. Chang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30219v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30219v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RoomTokens 表示，把室内场景编码为切片式结构化离散 token（语义类别、实例颜色身份、朝向场），并用 MDIRT 掩码离散扩散模型联合去噪各通道生成家具布局，同时把建筑 token 固定为平面图约束。

**相关性简评：** 该文的离散结构化 token 加掩码扩散逐步去噪、以及硬约束 token 钳制，或可作为 LVR 中多属性 latent 状态编码与并行状态更新的参照，但场景合成与多模态推理相距较远，需核查其表示是否保留任务必要细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis

**abstract/A1：** Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field. This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://3dlg-hcvc.github.io/RoomToken/

</details>

### 782. [TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30240v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30240

**作者：** Qingqiao Hu、Jialin Li、Meilong Xu、Kehan Qi、Yipeng Zhang、Lin Tian、Hongwei Bran Li、Klaus Mueller、Xiaoling Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30240v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30240v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向 3D 医学体数据的交互式标注，将 MLLM agent 的观察压缩为三个正交切面（tri-planes），由外部 harness 把 MLLM 的二维判断转成体素级点击，并判断是否接受 3D 预测，同时构建了 690 个 ROI 的跨模态基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「紧凑但足以暴露预测错误区域」的切面式观察，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 LOOK 的 token 成本权衡相关；harness 的接受/拒绝判定也可供核查是否对应停止决策，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes

**abstract/A1：** Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. We meet both needs with tri-planes, the three orthogonal planes that cross at one point in the volume. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that tri-planes are context-efficient yet keep sufficient detail to show error regions in the 3D prediction. Building on tri-planes, we introduce TriSegAgent, an MLLM agent that refines the 3D prediction iteratively. Within the agent, the MLLM only judges the prediction on tri-planes, while a visual harness turns each judgment into a 3D action in code. To make the loop reliable, the harness places each click at an exact voxel in the volume and checks whether to accept the 3D prediction. To evaluate the agent, we build a diverse benchmark of 690 regions of interest (ROIs) from 35 public medical datasets across three imaging modalities. With frontier MLLMs, TriSegAgent reaches an overall Dice about 10 points above the strongest baseline, and its lead is even larger on targets below 3 cm. With flash-level MLLMs, it outperforms a recent 3D segmentation agent built on a frontier MLLM.

</details>

### 783. [Operator-Valued Q-Learning: Compositional Bellman Recursions for Order-Sensitive Decision Making](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30255v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30255

**作者：** Swagatam Das、Swagato Das

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30255v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30255v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 operator-valued Q-learning：把 Q(s,a) 设为 N×N 算子，Bellman 备份通过动作的对偶映射作用，沿计划展开得到算子的有序乘积，并以迹读出得到 latent 状态上的值；同时给出反格结构、算子 log-sum-exp 上界、历史表增长率与 Hankel 秩下界等理论，并在 SO(3) 指向任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 非交换算子复合与「顺序敏感」可类比 latent 推理步骤的复合次序问题；其「忽略动作顺序的标量值必然混淆交换后的历史」这一负结果，可能为 latent 状态压缩与信息坍缩的诊断及读出维度下界提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Operator-Valued Q-Learning: Compositional Bellman Recursions for Order-Sensitive Decision Making

**abstract/A1：** In quantum pulse sequences, spacecraft attitude control and in-hand reorientation, actions act on a hidden physical state as non-commuting operators, so the outcome of a plan depends on the order of its actions. We let the value function carry this structure: each Q(s,a) is an N x N operator, and the Bellman backup applies the action's dual map to the continuation value, Q(s,a) = K\_a^\*(R(s,a) + gamma E V(s')). Unrolled along a plan, the recursion builds the ordered product of the actions' operators, and the value at any latent state is a linear trace readout. It is exact for policies that do not observe the latent, the backup contracts for unitary and orthogonal dynamics, and an asynchronous operator TD scheme learns it with almost-sure convergence. Classical values live in a lattice, so a maximum over actions exists; self-adjoint operators form an anti-lattice (Kadison) and have none. An operator log-sum-exp still gives one operator per state-action pair whose readout upper-bounds the value of every policy at every latent state. The sampled update converges to it for a finite horizon, and it reduces to soft Q-learning and the QMDP bound when actions commute. We prove that scalar values on observations that ignore action order must confuse swapped histories, that exact history tables grow exponentially for free action groups but polynomially for nilpotent ones, and give a Hankel-rank lower bound on the operator dimension. In experiments the learned policy matches 1000-simulation tree search on SO(3) pointing for horizons up to 20 at ~10^4 times lower decision cost, transfers zero-shot to unseen initial states, and acts exactly on its belief mean when the initial state is hidden, where plugging the mean into a DQN does not. A planner with the same model knowledge is more sample-efficient at short horizons, and a DQN given the operators matches or exceeds OpQ.

</details>

### 784. [AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30283v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30283

**作者：** Zhiyang Cui、Hao Tan、Ruonan Li、Shibin Wu、Junjian Zhang、Hong'an Lin、Zhaoquan Gu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30283v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30283v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AdvMTO，用 2D Gaussian Splatting 的定向 surfel 统一编码外观、几何与不透明度，生成相机与 LiDAR 观测，并构造当前与历史输入、沿历史 BEV 记忆回传梯度，以抑制 BEV 3D 检测器对持久对抗物体的检测。

**相关性简评：** 其「扰动历史记忆中被累积保留的视觉证据以抑制检测」可作为一种探针思路，供核查 latent 状态里视觉证据的留存与因果作用；但论文对象是 BEV 3D 检测而非 VLM 推理，与主线距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.

</details>

### 785. [Temporal Leakage Distorts the TGB Node Affinity Leaderboard: A Point-in-Time Audit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30289v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30289

**作者：** Yuhang Wang、Dongmei Li、Yuze Sun、Xiaolong Qu、Yanxiang Wang、Lei Yao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30289v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30289v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文审计 Temporal Graph Benchmark 的节点亲和度任务，区分标签的「查询时间」与「可用时间」，发现四个数据集及其评测循环均存在时间泄漏，并给出无泄漏协议：泄漏方法 NDCG@10 最多下降 17%，排名与最优配置改变。

**相关性简评：** 其「按时间点正确、区分预测时点与信息可用时点」的审计框架，可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 推理评测中视觉证据是否在决策时点确实可得、是否存在答案或未来信息泄漏；与 latent 状态生成本身无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Temporal Leakage Distorts the TGB Node Affinity Leaderboard: A Point-in-Time Audit

**abstract/A1：** Node affinity prediction in the Temporal Graph Benchmark (TGB) asks how a node's future interactions will be distributed over other nodes. On this task, methods that reuse past ground-truth labels often outperform temporal graph neural networks, and the state of the art builds on them. Such comparisons assume a point-in-time correct evaluation, in which a model receives only information available at prediction time. Drawing on as-of joins and bitemporal databases, we formalize this requirement by distinguishing when a label must be predicted, its query time, from when it is fully determined, its availability time, and we audit the four TGB node affinity datasets and their evaluation loop with model-agnostic tools. None of the four meets it. On three datasets, each label summarizes a single day about five days after its timestamp, not the documented following week, yet the loop feeds it back right after that timestamp; on the fourth, the loop processes the edges from which each label is computed before predicting it. Under a drop-in leakage-free protocol, every method whose inputs leak loses up to 17% of its NDCG@10, the advantage of past labels over the interaction stream nearly vanishes or reverses, and both the best configuration of the state of the art and the rankings change; a blend of training-free long-memory statistics, with weights fit on validation data, matches or exceeds the state of the art under both protocols. Point-in-time correctness should therefore be built into benchmarks, and our tools carry over to other benchmarks whose labels aggregate event streams over time windows.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 4 figures. Code available at https://github.com/quzah521/tgbn-leakage-audit-arxiv

</details>

### 786. [MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30335v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30335

**作者：** Lorenz Brehme、Daniel Hillebrand、Thomas Ströhle、Ruth Breu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30335v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30335v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MH-RAG-DIVE 框架，通过 Context Discoverer 在对话中动态组合文档生成多跳问题，并用 Conversation Cacher 复用已有轮次，以较低 token 成本评测多跳多轮 RAG 系统。

**相关性简评：** 其多轮对话中组合证据生成问题、以及轮次缓存复用以保持动态性的做法，可能为 LVR 中多轮证据获取与缓存状态复用的成本—收益评价提供参考；但属纯文本 RAG 评测，与视觉推理内部状态无直接关联，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation

**abstract/A1：** Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to real-world evaluation scenarios. Overall, our results show that the proposed approach provides a more complex and cost-efficient framework for evaluating RAG systems. All code and experimental data are publicly available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE).

**comment/C1：** This preprint was accepted for presentation at the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART27)

### 787. [FMSNO: Scaling Surface Neural Operators by Learned Flow Matching Reparametrisation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30341v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30341

**作者：** Vasilii Liamin、Oleg Bakhteev、Vladimir Vanovskiy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30341v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30341v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FMSNO，用 flow matching 学习一个从任意不规则表面网格到球面规则二维网格的共享映射（以预计算最优传输映射为预训练目标，再结合几何与 CFD 目标微调），在规则网格上用 FNO/SFNO 做表面压力与阻力预测，并单次前向推广到新几何。

**相关性简评：** 其「学习形变映射将不规则输入投射到共享正则潜网格上计算、再插值回原空间」的结构，可能与 LVR 中把视觉证据归一到固定容量工作区、以及细节保留与计算量权衡的问题相通，可供核查类比价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FMSNO: Scaling Surface Neural Operators by Learned Flow Matching Reparametrisation

**abstract/A1：** We propose the Flow Matching Surface Neural Operator (FMSNO), which combines learning a shared map from irregular surface meshes to a regular two-dimensional grid on the sphere and training a neural operator on the regular grid. Constructing a separate map for each new geometry can dominate inference time on large meshes. We initially pretrain the mapping by flow matching using precomputed optimal transport maps as targets and then continue its training using combined geometry and CFD objectives. We apply it to unseen geometries in a single forward pass. The learned flow deforms the surface points, and we project its endpoints onto the sphere. We then splat geometric features onto the spherical grid, apply a neural operator (we tested both Fourier and Spherical Fourier Neural Operators), and interpolate its output back to the surface. For a mesh with $N$ points, evaluating the map costs O(N), and the full prediction costs O(NlogN) with the FNO backbone. We evaluate surface pressure prediction on ShapeNet-Car, AhmedML, and DrivAerNet++, and drag coefficient prediction on DrivAerNet++. Across the three pressure benchmarks, our accuracy is on par with that of the most accurate baseline. On a surface with one million points, our method achieves a 354x end-to-end inference speedup over that baseline while keeping the same memory usage asymptotics of O(N).

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 788. [SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30345v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30345

**作者：** Ziyang Zong、Canming Xia、Haoran Xu、Guang Tan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30345v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30345v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SceneCast，一个无需标注数据的 3D 室内场景合成框架：用 Transformer 顺序预测物体，并以 LLM 作为空间常识评判者、通过思维链与可执行几何检查给出 RL 奖励；同时用可控视频生成模型构造训练视频，并按多准则质量评估与熵加权筛选高质量前缀片段。

**相关性简评：** 该工作与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其「LLM 生成可分步执行的几何检查作为奖励、并按质量筛选部分可见数据」的思路，或可供 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、轨迹贡献分配与部分观测下的状态补全问题作参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward

**abstract/A1：** 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \\trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

</details>

### 789. [PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30353v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30353

**作者：** Gwangui Hong、Seonho An、Seonkyu Lim、KyungTae Lim、Min-Soo Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30353v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30353v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向封闭网络中员工对金融数据脱敏的需求，提出 PseuDRAGON：把已确认的判断与纠正保存在固定模型之外，通过列名精确查找和学习规则复用，并按机构政策、国家隐私法、国际来源的顺序检索以支持专家复核。

**相关性简评：** 其将判断外置为可复用规则、并显式规定证据检索顺序与审批重建的机制，可能与 LVR 中「何时依赖内部状态、何时检索外部证据及停止」的问题表述相通，但属较远领域，仅供核查，未见与视觉推理的直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks

**abstract/A1：** Staff pseudonymizing financial data in closed networks must interpret abbreviated column names, identify personal information, and choose processing methods. Local language models can assist, but may give different labels for the same input. PseuDRAGON keeps confirmed judgments and corrections outside a fixed model and reuses them through exact-name lookup and learned rules. For expert review, the workflow searches institutional policy, national privacy law, then international sources. Across 92 columns from one institution, rules increase reuse under the same approval checks from 75 to 83 labels without reuse errors when all training judgments are available. With 25% of the training judgments, withholding non-PII rules for unseen names eliminated the extra PII misses in replay at the cost of lower reuse. Revising or withdrawing approvals rebuilds derived rules, and tests on synthetic records verify that selected methods produce the specified outputs. In three paired runs, the history-first baseline cut automated identification time by 83.0% on average versus no reuse.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a full paper in the AI for Intelligent Financial Technologies (AIFT) track of the 42nd ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2027). Gwangui Hong and Seonho An contributed equally

</details>

### 790. [mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30365v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30365

**作者：** Yi-Fei Cao、Tianxin Huang、Hanbo Xie、Jian-Qiao Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30365v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30365v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把心理学实验改造成可交互的动态环境，并训练人类策略模型来度量 LLM agent 行为轨迹与人类行为的相容程度，进而分析 agentic 配置、测试时计算与记忆对该相容性的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其用学习到的策略模型做轨迹级判别、并发现「记忆主要提高可预测性而非更像人」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹是否只是更可预测而非携带更多证据；与视觉细节保留无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments

**abstract/A1：** A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like. Here, we bridge this gap by transforming psychological tasks into dynamic environments in which agents can interact and by using a learned human-policy model to evaluate how compatible the resulting behavioral trajectories are with human behavior. Across these environments, we find that this compatibility varies with an LLM's agentic configuration and the psychological task, and that memory raises it mainly by making choices more predictable rather than more human-like. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation of LLM agents in psychology-inspired environments, accounting for both the backbone model and its agentic scaffold.

</details>

### 791. [ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30372v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30372

**作者：** Jihwan Hong、Sunghwan Steve Cho、Ping Shu Ho、Joo Seong Kim、Bokyung Kim、Nam-Joon Kim、Simon See、Ji Won Kim、Jaeyoung Do

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30372v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30372v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ColonoWorld 是结肠镜世界模型，以相机轨迹与粗 3D 结肠管为条件、在活体视频上训练，可生成从盲肠到直肠的完整检查过程，并在指定位置与时间放入息肉、器械和冲洗。

**相关性简评：** 其「按指令运动+解剖结构保持一致+可控放置病灶」的生成设定，可能为构造可干预的视觉证据环境、评估主动观察与证据使用提供线索，但本身不涉及 latent 推理状态，关系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld

</details>

### 792. [IP-GNO: An Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator for Automated Distribution System State Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30387v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30387

**作者：** Sakshi Kumar、Chhavi Jhari、Ajay Singh、Subho Paul

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30387v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30387v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 IP-GNO，把配电网母线电压估计建模为算子学习问题，借助导纳参数化核、跨层持续的源注入跳跃连接、物理嵌入树编码和正余弦输出，实现跨不同规模电网的零样本状态估计。

**相关性简评：** 其任务本质是由稀疏观测反推隐状态，尺寸无关的位置特征与跨层保留源信息的跳跃连接，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据保留与长度/规模泛化提供概念参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IP-GNO: An Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator for Automated Distribution System State Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Distribution System State Estimation (DSSE) is a crucial tool for real-time monitoring, operation, and control of the new-age distribution systems (DSs) due to intensified voltage fluctuations and operational uncertainties introduced by volatile power injection at the nodes. Existing GNN-based approaches generally exhibit limited generalization across networks with different sizes and topologies, making zero-shot cross-grid transfer to unseen DSs a significant challenge. To overcome the aforementioned challenges, this article proposes an Inductive Physics-Informed Graph Neural Operator (IP-GNO) for scalable and transferable DSSE. The proposed framework frames complex bus voltage estimation as an operator-learning problem inspired by the Neumann series expansion of the inverse bus admittance matrix. An admittance-parameterized kernel, incorporating a self-admittance gate in the zeroth-order term and a persistent source-injection skip connection across network layers, captures the underlying electrical dependencies. Additionally, a Physics-Embedded Tree Encoding (PETE) scheme introduces five grid-size-invariant positional features derived from path impedance and a DC-linearized phase-angle prior. A sine-cosine output formulation is further employed to address phase-angle periodicity and ensure stable training. The proposed IP-GNO module is evaluated on two small (IEEE 33- and 69-bus), two medium (IEEE 123- and 136-bus), and one large (2522-bus) sized DSs. Particularly, its zero-shot cross-grid generalization capability is investigated by training the model exclusively on the IEEE 33-bus system and directly evaluating it on four unseen distribution networks of different sizes without retraining or fine-tuning. A detailed comparative analysis with the existing state-of-the-art DSSE tools proves the superiority of IP-GNO, enabling scalable DSSE across heterogeneous DSs.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 793. [LiquidGazeNet: Towards Event-Based Near-Eye Gaze Estimation under Low-Light Conditions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30392v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30392

**作者：** Himanshu Kumar、Sanjay Singh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30392v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30392v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LiquidGazeNet，用极性分离的事件脉冲延迟编码加指数衰减时间表面表示事件流，并以基于 LTC 的两层循环模块因果整合短时序列，做低光照夜间近眼注视点估计，在 Gaze-FELL 上报告跨被试与跨场景误差。

**相关性简评：** 属远领域的注视估计任务，但其「指数衰减时间表面 + 连续时间常数循环状态」可供核查是否能启发 LVR 中 latent 工作区的时序更新与遗忘机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LiquidGazeNet: Towards Event-Based Near-Eye Gaze Estimation under Low-Light Conditions

**abstract/A1：** Near-eye gaze estimation under low-light nighttime conditions is challenging because the quality and effective temporal resolution of conventional intensity frames can be reduced. This paper presents LiquidGazeNet, an event-only gaze-estimation framework that combines polarity-aware spike-latency encoding with a custom LTC-based recurrent module. Positive- and negative-polarity events are represented in separate channels, while exponentially decayed time surfaces retain per-pixel temporal recency across successive event windows. A shared convolutional encoder extracts spatial features from each window, and a two-layer recurrent module composed of LTC-inspired cells integrates them causally over short temporal sequences. The network is trained using a hybrid objective that combines screen-space coordinate regression with centre-referenced directional consistency. The framework is evaluated on Gaze-FELL under cross-subject and cross-scene protocols and is further assessed through event-representation, temporal-module, window-duration, and computational ablations. LiquidGazeNet achieves mean errors of 3.75 degrees and 2.41 degrees under cross-subject and cross-scene evaluation, respectively. The results indicate that polarity-aware temporal-recency encoding, together with recurrent integration, is effective for event-only gaze estimation under the evaluated low-light nighttime conditions.

</details>

### 794. [Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30399v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30399

**作者：** Giuseppe Canonaco、Alberto Pozanco、Daniel Borrajo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30399v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30399v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在完全可观测非确定规划中提出「代价敏感可逆性」：给定动作代价，定义弱/强反转预算、\\(k\\)-有界可逆性以及有限强反转与最坏代价无界的强环反转之别，给出可逆性格局、代价感知的策略合并结论，并分别用最优经典规划与最坏情况最优 FOND 搜索计算反转预算，另提供拒绝 \\(k\\)-有界可逆的下界检验。

**相关性简评：** 其「反转预算/最坏恢复代价」的形式化可能为 LVR 中「某个推理或作答步骤是否可撤回、代价多大」以及 STOP 与人工介入的成本敏感决策提供概念工具，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态状态，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions

**abstract/A1：** Determining action reversibility requires checking whether the effects of an action can be undone. Recent work has extended reversibility to fully observable non-deterministic (FOND) planning. It distinguishes weak reversibility, where reversal may succeed, from strong-cyclic reversibility, where reversal is guaranteed under fairness. These notions are qualitative: they say whether reversal is possible, but not how costly it is. We introduce cost-sensitive reversibility for non-deterministic actions. Given positive action costs, we define weak and strong reversal budgets, $k$-bounded reversibility, and a distinction between finite strong reversal and strong-cyclic reversal with unbounded worst-case cost. We relate the resulting notions in a reversibility lattice, prove cost-aware policy-merging results, and show how to compute restricted weak and strong universal uniform reversal budgets using cost-optimal classical planning and worst-case-optimal FOND search, respectively. We also give an admissible lower-bound test for rejecting $k$-bounded reversibility. These notions support finer-grained safety decisions: a small finite strong budget bounds recovery cost, whereas a small weak budget certifies only a cheap possible recovery path. Actions without an acceptable strong bound may therefore warrant human approval, as in tool-using agent systems.

</details>

### 795. [GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30402v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30402

**作者：** Nikolaos Stathoulopoulos、George Nikolakopoulos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30402v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30402v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GeLiFiSH 提出一种无需学习的 LiDAR 关键点滤波方法，在滚动体素图上做高度-结构检测，用位置、协方差与存在概率初始化轨迹，并以序贯概率比检验递归地接受或剔除跨帧关键点，同时借助地面分割与运动物体分割提供无传感器先验的高度参考并去除动态点。

**相关性简评：** 其「以存在概率维护持久状态、用序贯概率比检验淘汰由动态物体鬼影造成的伪观测」可能为 LVR 中多假设 latent 的保留/剔除与停止判断提供可核查的类比线索，但领域为 3D 配准，跨模态迁移尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, submitted

</details>

### 796. [TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30419v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30419

**作者：** ChiFung Kwan、Kangzhong Wang、Youqian Zhang、Weijie Chen、Jiaqi Gao、Yongjian Wu、Eugene Yujun Fu、Qingqing Ye、Haibo Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30419v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30419v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建 TamperCert 基准：基于 400 份真实学位证书、38 所高校，用 11 种公开篡改方法与 4 种后处理生成两万余张伪造图像，并评测 13 种检测器及一个商用 MLLM；结果显示没有检测器对全部篡改方式可靠，MLLM 对通用生成模型伪造漏检严重，缩放与拍照后处理显著削弱检测。

**相关性简评：** 该研究并非 LVR 推理研究，但其关于 MLLM 对细粒度视觉篡改漏检、后处理破坏局部证据的负结果，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留与证据筛选评价的薄弱环节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates

**abstract/A1：** Degree certificates play a critical role in high-stakes decisions such as university admission, immigration, and hiring. The issuing institution vouches for the holder, so a forged certificate may let its bearer pass these checks. Degree certificate forgery is increasingly prevalent. Yet, many assume that it is easy to spot. Reported cases show otherwise: in 2024, the business school of the University of Hong Kong found that about 30 master's students had enrolled with forged academic credentials. Few studies have looked at how to detect forged degree certificates, partly because public benchmarks are scarce. We present TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates issued by 38 universities. Each certificate was subjected to 11 publicly available tampering methods to alter the holder's name and further processed with four additional post-processing techniques, resulting in over 20,000 forged images. We evaluate 13 detectors, a commercial multimodal large language model (MLLM), and detectors trained on TamperCert.Our findings reveal that no detector is reliable for every tampering method. Consequently, a determined forger may still evade detection. Moreover, the commercial MLLM misses most forgeries made by general-purpose generative models, and post-processing, such as resizing an image or photographing it with a camera, severely degrades detection.

</details>

<a id="paper-797"></a>

### 797. [SGD Selects Initialization-Dependent Representation in Overparameterized ReLU Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30467v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30467

**作者：** Nikos Tsikouras、Yorgos Pantis、Ahmed Mehdi Inane、Mehrab Hamidi、Ioannis Mitliagkas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30467v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30467v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究无偏置两层 ReLU 网络在高斯输入、线性教师下联合训练两层时的隐式偏好：证明宽度 m≥4 时虽存在无穷多非对齐精确解，batch-size-one SGD 从极小初始化出发仍使每个神经元趋近教师方向，并给出依赖初始化的函数分配。

**相关性简评：** 该理论说明训练算法与初始化会隐式选定内部表示及其在单元间的贡献分配，可能为 LVR 中「latent 状态是否承载任务必要信息、监督与优化如何塑造表示结构」提供可供核查的概念线索，但不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SGD Selects Initialization-Dependent Representation in Overparameterized ReLU Networks

**abstract/A1：** Overparameterized neural networks can represent the same function through many different hidden configurations, raising the question of which representation is favored by a given training algorithm. We study how stochastic gradient descent (SGD), jointly training both layers, resolves this ambiguity in finite-width, bias-free, two-layer ReLU networks trained to learn a linear teacher under Gaussian inputs. At width two, exact fitting leaves no choice: the neurons must align with the teacher directions. At every width $m \\ge 4$, however, infinitely many non-aligned exact fits are possible. Despite this ambiguity, we prove that joint batch-size-one SGD from sufficiently small initialization drives every neuron arbitrarily close to one of the two teacher directions while reaching arbitrarily small population error in finite time. This occurs without explicit regularization, layerwise training, gradient clipping, or a learning-rate schedule. The dynamics additionally select an initialization-dependent allocation of the fitted function across neurons, providing a finer characterization of the representation selected by SGD. Numerical experiments reproduce the predicted alignment, fitting, and initialization-dependent allocation. Our results identify sufficient conditions under which standard SGD exhibits a strong implicit bias toward a highly structured internal representation, even when overparameterization creates infinitely many qualitatively different exact representations.

</details>

<a id="paper-798"></a>

### 798. [Policy Invariance Is Not Learning Invariance: Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Navigation with a Limited View](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30492v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30492

**作者：** Nodirjon Khabibullaev、Rajat Dandekar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30492v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30492v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析 potential-based reward shaping 在保持折扣回报不变的前提下如何改变单步奖励（如 (γ−1)Φ 项、终态规则、势函数平移与非法正环），并以预注册的 PPO 实验在带有限自视角的 MiniGrid 导航任务上测量其学习加速与副作用。

**相关性简评：** 「不改变最优解却改变学习过程」的奖励塑形分析，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督、中间信号的贡献分配与训练设计提供类比线索；受限视角下的部分可观测导航也与证据获取相关，但距离视觉语言推理主线较远，需核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Policy Invariance Is Not Learning Invariance: Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Navigation with a Limited View

**abstract/A1：** Potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) does not change the optimal policy, but how much it speeds up learning depends on the potential and on effects outside this guarantee. We analyse how PBRS changes the one-step reward while it preserves the discounted return: a per-step $(γ-1)Φ$ term, the terminal-state rule, a constant shift of the potential, and positive cycles in a bonus that is not potential-based. We then measure these consequences in pre-registered experiments with a PPO agent. The agent has a limited egocentric view and is tested on two MiniGrid navigation tasks (160 runs, 10 seeds per condition). On LavaCrossing, a geodesic (BFS) potential learned faster than both the sparse baseline and a Euclidean potential with a 7x7 and a 5x5 view (AUC difference +0.27 to +0.39, Holm p between 0.007 and 0.0499). The Euclidean potential did not differ from the baseline. In 20 runs with a non-potential bonus, none of the agents learned the task. The Euclidean potential caused more than twice as many deaths in lava during early training. View size did not detectably change the benefit of shaping. With a 5x5 view on SimpleCrossing, some BFS runs got stuck in loops and never learned; shifting the potential did not remove this, so the per-step term alone does not explain it.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Under review at the MATH4AI Workshop at AAAI 2027

</details>

### 799. [Why Calibrated BM25 Filtering Barely Reduced Context on LongMemEval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30500v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30500

**作者：** John Knight、Erchin Serpedin、Hasan Kurban

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30500v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30500v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 LongMemEval 的 75 个长对话记忆问题上测试校准后的 BM25 段落过滤能否节省输入 token，发现仅改变一个 prompt、只省 0.096% token，并给出针对固定顺序整段打包器的精确判定条件。

**相关性简评：** 区分「检出的证据」与「真正送达模型的证据」这一框架，可能为核查 LVR 中筛选出的视觉证据是否真正进入推理状态、以及上下文预算对证据筛选收益的限制提供概念借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Why Calibrated BM25 Filtering Barely Reduced Context on LongMemEval

**abstract/A1：** An assistant that summarizes old conversations may later need a detail from the original exchange. It can score archived passages against the question, but only passages that fit in the prompt reach the answering model. We tested whether a BM25 filter saves input tokens once that limit is taken into account. We calibrated the filter on passages that individually corrected an answer the model got wrong from the summaries alone. Across 75 LongMemEval questions, filtering changed one prompt and saved 0.096% of input tokens. With and without the filter, the model answered the same questions correctly under a second automated grading. On a random sample, two human graders' settled judgments agreed with the automated grades in 92.9% of definite comparisons (Cohen's kappa = 0.805). Building on earlier work that distinguishes retrieved evidence from delivered evidence, we give an exact test for packers that try whole passages in a fixed order and skip any that do not fit. Run the packer without the filter. The prompt changes exactly when an admitted passage scores below the cutoff. Code and data: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/Certfold

</details>

### 800. [Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30545v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30545

**作者：** Javier Conde、Xiuyuan Qi、Shanshan Liu、Pedro Reviriego

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30545v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30545v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 6 个文生图模型（扩散与自回归）、3 种 GPU、4 种数值精度下固定 prompt 与随机种子，比较单图与批内生成及跨 GPU 输出，发现批组成和硬件会显著改变结果，部分配置结构相似度降至 0.229–0.68，且跨 GPU 差异与批效应同量级。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定种子也不可复现、混批或混硬件的评测会有偏差」的证据，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 比较与因果干预实验的执行噪声：观测到的状态或输出差异可能来自批组成与数值精度而非方法本身。优先级 P2。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models

**abstract/A1：** In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261 with sampled decoding and to 0.229 with greedy decoding, and for an fp8 diffusion model to 0.68. A diffusion model in bf16 stays close to the batch-1 output (0.96-0.98) but changes every image. In most cases the batched image is a different but equally valid image; in some, such as prompts with digits and counters, it is visibly worse. Cross-GPU differences are of the same order as the batch effect: for one autoregressive model in bf16 compared across two GPU architectures (RTX 6000 Ada versus RTX A6000), no image is bit-identical and the cross-GPU LPIPS (0.355 to 0.383) matches the batch effect within one GPU (0.347 to 0.381). The consequences are direct: seeds do not make results reproducible, benchmarks and image-quality comparisons that mix batch sizes or hardware can be biased, and safety audits and A/B tests on generated images need the serving setup reported.

</details>

### 801. [Irreducible shallow tanh neural networks are a manifold](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30553v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30553

**作者：** Ivan Bioli、Isabella Carla Gonnella、Carlo Marcati、Federico Pichi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.DG、math.FA、math.NA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30553v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30553v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究浅层 tanh 网络的函数空间几何，证明无冗余神经元的「不可约」网络所表示的函数集在 Sobolev 空间中是光滑嵌入子流形，并刻画其连通分支数。

**相关性简评：** 其对冗余单元与参数—函数映射流形结构的刻画，可能为 LVR 中 latent 维度冗余与信息坍缩的几何判定提供工具线索，但能否迁移到深层或循环 latent 结构尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Irreducible shallow tanh neural networks are a manifold

**abstract/A1：** Neural networks (NNs) have been increasingly used as function approximators, motivating the study of the geometry of their function spaces. We study the set of functions represented by shallow neural networks with hyperbolic tangent activation, fixed input and output dimensions, and $n$ hidden neurons. In particular, we prove that the subset represented by irreducible networks in the sense of Sussmann (Neural Networks, 1992), i.e., networks with no redundant neurons, is a smooth embedded submanifold of the Sobolev spaces $\\mathrm{W}^{\\ell,p}$ on bounded sets for any $\\ell\\in\\mathbb{N}$ and $p\\in\[1,+\\infty\]$. The key step is to show that if a sequence of networks converges in $\\mathrm{W}^{\\ell,p}$ to an irreducible network with the same number of hidden neurons, then the parameters of the approximating networks remain bounded. Finally, we show that this manifold has exactly $n+1$ connected components when both the input and output are scalar, and is connected otherwise.

</details>

### 802. [Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30556v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30556

**作者：** Lars-Phillip Spiegel、Christoph Beierle、Gabriele Kern-Isberner、Alexander Hahn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30556v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30556v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在条件信念库上提出「条件约束分裂」，允许子库共享条件式，并界定安全与完全局部化的子类，使约束系统可在子库上独立局部求解，同时推广 c-representation 的解分裂并分析其与语法分裂、safe covers 的关系。

**相关性简评：** 信念库分裂与局部化求解是纯符号工作，与视觉无关，但其「将整体信念状态拆为相关子状态并独立求解」的形式化可能为 latent 推理状态的分解、局部一致性与状态抽象提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions

**abstract/A1：** Splitting notions for conditional belief bases aim at localizing reasoning and computation tasks to subbases containing only the relevant parts of the belief base. Among the different reasoning mechanisms, c-representations, a special kind of Spohn's ranking models, have been shown to provide high-quality inferences. c-Representations can be conveniently specified via a constraint satisfaction problem. In this article, we introduce the notion of conditional constraint splittings, extending constraint splittings by also allowing the subbases to share conditionals. Taking inspiration from conditional syntax splittings, we identify the subclasses of safe and fully localized conditional constraint splittings, allowing us to locally and independently solve the constraint system on the subbases. We also generalize solution splittings for c-representations to safe conditional c-solution splittings and provide an in-depth analysis of their relationship to conditional constraint splittings. Additionally, we elaborate on the relationship of these new splitting notions to safe and generalized safe conditional syntax splittings and also to safe covers, which have been proposed for localized computation of c-representations.

</details>
