### 803. [RAPID: Codec-Aware Video Decoding for Efficient Long-Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30557v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30557

**作者：** Yuna Lee、Yulhwa Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30557v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30557v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 codec-aware 框架 RAPID：利用压缩码流中的参考帧与随机访问点信息跳过不必要帧并并行解码目标帧，并用关键帧作为片段粗代表避免帧选择时的密集解码与打分，从而降低长视频 VLM 的解码与预处理开销、提升 TTFT。

**相关性简评：** 其「低成本粗代表预筛 + 跳过密集候选」的做法可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与计算预算分配提供线索，并给出证据获取成本的可核查量化；但工作停留在输入解码层，不涉及 latent 推理状态或模型内部信息使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAPID: Codec-Aware Video Decoding for Efficient Long-Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can process hour-long videos, but the large number of input frames incurs substantial inference overhead. Existing approaches to efficient long-video understanding largely overlook video decoding, which can take longer than LLM prefill. We propose RAPID (Reference- and Access-Point-Informed Decoding), a codec-aware framework that exploits information embedded in compressed bitstreams to reduce both frame decoding and selection costs. RAPID consists of two components. RAPID-Dec exploits reference-frame information and random access points to skip unnecessary frames and decode the retained frames in parallel while preserving exact reconstruction of the target frames. It achieves up to a 3.7x decoding speedup over the fastest baseline on H.264/AVC videos. RAPID-Sel uses keyframes as coarse representatives of video segments, avoiding the dense candidate decoding and scoring required by existing frame selection methods. It achieves comparable accuracy with up to a 3.0x preprocessing speedup. Together, RAPID achieves a 4.9x time to first token (TTFT) speedup on hour-long videos over a state-of-the-art frame selection method using the fastest baseline decoder.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 16 figures

</details>

### 804. [Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30564v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30564

**作者：** Wilson Wongso、Hada Melino Muhammad、Xiachong Lin、Hao Xue、Flora D. Salim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30564v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30564v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GeoDecisions 多模态基准，通过地理感知图像分类与地点评分两个任务，评估六个决策模型的空间意识与地理偏差，并提出无需训练的位置先验融合方法。

**相关性简评：** 其比较视觉与文本坐标、诊断地理偏差及引入位置先验的做法，可能为核查 VLM 推理中的空间证据使用与外部先验影响提供评测线索，但与 latent 状态生成无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Decision models, which output probability distributions over candidate labels instead of generating text, are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs associated with real-world locations. However, it remains unclear whether they can leverage spatial context and whether their predictions are geographically biased. We introduce GeoDecisions, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating the spatial awareness and geographic bias of decision models. GeoDecisions comprises two tasks: (1) geo-aware image classification, and (2) location rating on objective and subjective topics. Evaluating six decision models against supervised task-specific models, we find that spatial awareness requires vision: textual coordinates alone provide insufficient context for classifying everyday photos and satellite images. We also find substantial geographic bias. On everyday photos, despite achieving higher accuracy, open-weight decision models exhibit more spatially clustered errors than supervised models. Moreover, across all five subjective topics, every decision model gives lower ratings to locations with lower socioeconomic conditions. Finally, we propose a training-free method that combines decision models with a location prior to improve their spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias. Our code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将「审问协议」引入高风险的 AI control 场景：由能力较弱的可信监控者就不明所以的动作向不可信智能体追问，并在 BashArena 的留出子集上检验追问能否在 1% 审计预算下提升安全性，同时与「可信模型直接陈述具体疑虑」的对照比较。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是弱验证者借提问区分诚实解释与误导解释并据此做出审计决策，可能与 LVR 中如何核查答案所依据的视觉证据、判断解释是否忠实以及外部验证成本的问题形成类比，具体可迁移性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interrogation Protocols for AI Control

**abstract/A1：** As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp \[+0.9, +20.1\], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 21 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/interrogation-protocols-A11B/

</details>

### 806. [What Environment Invariance Identifies: Minimal Invariant Sets in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30609v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30609

**作者：** Ridham Patel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.ST、stat.ME、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30609v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30609v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 RKHS 算子层面重述不变因果预测：把 Y 对 X\_S 的条件均值嵌入跨环境一致定义为不变集，刻画不变集恰为包含 PA(Y) 且不含 Y 后代的集合，得到唯一最小不变集，并分析有限样本恢复与两种选择规则。

**相关性简评：** 其环境不变性判据或可借用于甄别 VLM 推理中真正被使用的视觉证据与虚假相关，但核嵌入假设及不变性检验的误校准能否迁移到 latent 状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Environment Invariance Identifies: Minimal Invariant Sets in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces

**abstract/A1：** Invariant causal prediction identifies the direct causes of a target $Y$ by searching for covariate sets whose conditional law of $Y$ is stable across environments. We state that criterion at the level of operators, calling a set $S$ invariant when the conditional mean embeddings of $Y$ given $X\_S$ agree across environments, and characterise the resulting family exactly: under two conditions on the environments, which we state separately because they fail independently, the invariant sets are precisely those containing $PA(Y)$ and no descendant of $Y$. Two consequences follow. Invariance does not identify $PA(Y)$ uniquely, since every descendant-free superset is invariant as well; and $PA(Y)$ is the unique minimal invariant set. In finite samples, recovery requires the non-invariant sets to be separated from invariance by a margin, and the sample size splits into a screening term logarithmic in the ambient dimension and a term inherited from conditional mean embedding estimation, which is the binding one. The characterisation yields two selection rules with different failure modes, of which the conservative one controls false positives. Controlled experiments verify each population prediction directly, including the failure of uniqueness. They also show that invariance testing is a practical bottleneck: two natural designs are severely miscalibrated, while the selected test reduces but does not eliminate Type I error inflation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ACM IKDD CODS 2026

</details>

### 807. [Uncovering the Tells: Efficient Black-Box Audits for LLM Data Contamination](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30639v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30639

**作者：** Dominik Bernard Lau、Filip Pawlicki、Jan Dubiński、Sebastian Cygert

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30639v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30639v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出纯黑盒的生成式审计框架，通过目标 token 的差异推断上下文诱导的信息增益，并在查询预算约束下利用成员信号稀疏、集中于少数高信息 token 的特点来检测训练数据污染。

**相关性简评：** 其「稀疏高信息位置 + 预算约束采样」的思路可能与 LVR 中该探测哪些位置或视觉证据、如何在有限查询内分配计算与停止获取证据有概念联系，但属较远领域，迁移价值仅供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncovering the Tells: Efficient Black-Box Audits for LLM Data Contamination

**abstract/A1：** Existing methods for assessing training data contamination in Large Language Models achieve high accuracy, but fundamentally rely on gray-box access, rendering them inapplicable to fully black-box environments. This limitation forces auditors to rely on full-sequence sampling or rigid heuristics, both of which incur prohibitive inference costs and struggle to isolate the underlying memorization signal. To overcome this, we propose a generation-based black-box framework that infers context-induced information gain from targeted token discrepancies. We introduce a budget-constrained auditing regime, building on the empirical observation that the membership signal is highly sparse and concentrated in a few highly informative tokens. We formalize this sparsity, showing why uniform sampling needs many more samples than a policy that targets informative positions. Empirically, our approach achieves state-of-the-art black-box separation accuracy while needing about 3x fewer queries than uniform position sampling. Finally, we apply this methodology to closed frontier models, exploring its capacity and limits in surfacing potential training data overlaps on commercial APIs.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 808. [Motion on Demand: Adaptive Optical Excitation for Event Cameras](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30641v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30641

**作者：** Yingtao Li、Chaoran Feng、Haoran Jiang、Zhenyu Tang、Wangbo Yu、Zhankuo Xu、Jianbin Zhao、Li Yuan、Yonghong Tian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30641v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30641v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EvGaze：在事件相机前旋转楔形棱镜以引入受控图像运动来显露静态边缘，并用融合亮度、事件与惯性观测的学习型控制器自适应调节棱镜转速，以较少事件保留更多边缘。

**相关性简评：** 其「按当前运动条件决定是否及以多快速度补充视觉激发」的主动感知策略，以及快惯性前馈通路在两次视觉更新之间精化决策的结构，可能为 LVR 中「何时获取更多视觉证据」与多速率状态更新提供可供核查的启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Motion on Demand: Adaptive Optical Excitation for Event Cameras

**abstract/A1：** Event cameras respond only to brightness changes, so whether an edge is visible depends on image motion perpendicular to it---a motion that constantly shifts with camera and scene dynamics. Rotating a wedge prism in front of the lens introduces controlled image motion to reveal static or slow edges. However, a fixed rotation speed cannot adapt to changing motion conditions: when natural motion is already sufficient, additional optical excitation generates redundant events and introduces unnecessary alignment errors. Inspired by the division of labor between fast haltere feedforward and slower visual feedback in fly gaze control, we present EvGaze, an event camera system that adaptively regulates prism rotation speed. EvGaze employs a learned multimodal controller that integrates luminance, event, and inertial observations, with a fast inertial pathway that refines speed decisions between visual updates. To preserve geometric consistency during speed changes, we compensate for prism-induced image motion at individual event timestamps using measured encoder angles. On EvMotion, EvGaze recovers more edges than full-speed prism rotation with 39% fewer events. On DSEC with simulated optical modulation, it reaches 0.73 feature-tracking success (compared with 0.55 on native events and 0.67 at 180 RPM) while generating 26% fewer events than 360 RPM. Real-device experiments further demonstrate online closed-loop adaptation, reducing average event rates by 17% relative to full-speed rotation.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://passwerob.github.io/EvGaze/

</details>

### 809. [Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30646v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30646

**作者：** Orion Desbonnet、Kei Higuchi、Alex Sykes、Ayush Deshmukh、Victor Leve、Joao Moura、Sethu Vijayakumar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30646v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30646v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从被动双目图像估计铰接物体各部分的位姿、关节状态与半变形形状：检测 CAD 定义角点并拟合铰接模型，把刚性几何证书推广到铰接物体以判断每个部件估计是否可信，并用可信估计生成伪标签改善 sim-to-real 迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「分部件几何证书」为部分状态给出可判定的可信度（即使部件被遮挡也能输出状态，但可标记不可信），与 LVR 中判断某视觉证据是否被正确利用、latent 状态是否需更新或停止的机制可能构成概念类比，可供核查；但任务本身不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与训练。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo

**abstract/A1：** Robots in manufacturing often handle thin, hinged objects known from CAD models that change shape during the task, like folding cartons. Monitoring such tasks requires estimating the object's articulation state, its pose and the shape of any semi-deformable part. Learning-based estimators generalise across objects but lose precision while handling thin parts. Model-based fitting is precise but often needs accurate depth, a close initial estimate and a clean object mask. We present part-wise certification of an articulated object's state, estimated from passive stereo. Our estimator rivals the precision of the best model-based fitting method without using depth, a close initial estimate or a mask. We detect the corners that the CAD model defines in both stereo images and fit the articulated model to them. Geometric certificates, which we extend from rigid to articulated objects, then tell whether to trust each part, because the fit returns a state even for hidden parts. Certified estimates on unlabelled video become labels that improve sim-to-real transfer. On five of seven simulated objects, we locate the parts we certify three to five times more precisely than the strongest learned baseline on the same readings, given depth and true masks. On a real folding carton, our median corner error on the end panels is 2.1% of the carton's size, at least 40% lower than every learned baseline and also lower than a depth-based fit initialised near the true state.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 810. [Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30670v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30670

**作者：** Yidong Luo、Weihuang Wen、Xuanhao Pan、Yinya Wang、Shanwen Pu、Chenghao Lan、Dongdong Ge、Tianshu Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30670v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30670v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 APEC，一个基于求解器日志的诊断驱动 MIP 调参智能体，由确定性日志剖析、假设驱动的解释和评测控制三层组成，在 MIPLIB 2017 上以更少参数改动取得 1.58 倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理相距较远，但其「先剖析证据、再形成假设、据评测反馈决定下一步探查」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、证据获取与停止决策的表述提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude. Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why. Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers. APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning. On the full MIPLIB 2017 benchmark set, APEC achieves a 1.58X improvement over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes than the baselines, making the results easier to read.

</details>

### 811. [DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30671v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30671

**作者：** Dingyi Yao、Tingdong Yu、Guosheng Zhao、Chaojun Ni、Xiaofeng Wang、Jiming Mao、Guan Huang、Lihui Peng、Zheng Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30671v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30671v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DriveDreamer-RSI，在感知学习与数据构造间建立反馈以实现递归自提升：外循环依当前感知缺口生成带标签视频并更新目标，内循环用 VLM 智能体依观察与执行反馈迭代编辑场景，并从执行经验和下游学习结果提炼可复用的构造策略。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但「依下游学习缺口重设目标、依执行反馈迭代、由学习结果反推策略」的闭环，可能为 latent 轨迹训练的监督分配及证据获取、何时停止等决策提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation

**abstract/A1：** Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.

</details>

### 812. [Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30672v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30672

**作者：** Boyd Kane、Jo J. Jiao、Elizabeth Donoway、Bryce Woodworth、Alex Cloud、Alexander M. Turner

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30672v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30672v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出有限参数微调（LPF）：仅训练 3–25% 的 LoRA 参数，用少量目标行为样例检验模型是否潜藏该行为，并在 8–35B 的模型生物与开源权重模型上借此区分表面行为相同的模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「用轻量适配探测内部是否留存未被表现出的能力」的审计思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否仍存在于内部状态、以及 latent 内容是否被答案实际使用这类表示与因果作用问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning

**abstract/A1：** Large language models can have behaviours which only arise in hard-to-anticipate contexts. These hidden behaviours pose a challenge to alignment audits, which seek to uncover problematic model behaviour but are limited by the scenarios the auditor can anticipate. To address this challenge, we explore limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) on examples of a target behaviour. While training 3-25% of LoRA parameters, LPF reveals whether the model has a hidden behaviour, even when standard behavioural evaluations cannot. LPF succeeds on a suite of model organisms with hidden behaviours (8-14B parameters), and also surfaces naturally occurring hidden behaviours in open-weight models (27-35B parameters). LPF can thus distinguish between models which appear behaviourally identical to an auditor, and does not require the context in which the hidden behaviour surfaces. LPF provides a novel affordance that may be useful for auditing frontier AI models. However, we do not evaluate LPF against baselines in a realistic auditing setting, so further work is needed to determine its practicality.

**comment/C1：** Published at NeurIPS 2026. 53 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables

### 813. [Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30715v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30715

**作者：** Zicheng Chen、Jia Li、Xiaohong Chen、Zhi Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30715v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30715v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张把 agent 技能获取从「按相关性排序单个技能」重构为「集合选择」，提出 Skill-Composer：将用户需求分解为原子需求点、跨多个技能市场检索并合并候选、分解候选能力并逐步剔除重叠项，以组成覆盖全部所需能力且非冗余的技能包并报告缺口；目前仅给出定位与流程草图。

**相关性简评：** 「原子需求—能力覆盖—冗余剔除—缺口报告」这一目标结构可能为视觉证据或工具子集选择、以及覆盖不足时是否继续 LOOK 的停止判据提供类比线索；但该工作面向 agent 技能市场而非多模态推理，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces

**abstract/A1：** Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

</details>

### 814. [Same Seed, Different Picture? Deciding Early at Low Resolution for Seed-Faithful Few-Step Flow Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30728v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30728

**作者：** Huiran Duan、Weilun Feng、Yuqi Li、Yingli Tian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30728v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30728v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析 few-step 扩散/flow 采样器为何从同一噪声得不到 50 步参考图，指出粗结构在采样早期（噪声水平高于 0.9）即被决定，并提出无需训练的 Decide-then-Render：先用低分辨率噪声做几步构图决策，再用原始种子噪声重建全分辨率状态并渲染细节，在多个大模型上取得 11–25 倍加速且更接近参考。

**相关性简评：** 其「低分辨率廉价决策 + 全分辨率细化」的分阶段计算与「同种子对参考采样的保真度」评价协议，可能启发 LVR 中粗粒度 latent 规划先行、动态分配计算以及快速路径与完整推理一致性（保真度）的度量设计，具体可迁移性仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Seed, Different Picture? Deciding Early at Low Resolution for Seed-Faithful Few-Step Flow Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Few-step samplers make large text-to-image flow models fast, but from the same noise they no longer generate the image of the standard 50-step sampler. Subjects, attributes and layout change, not just fine detail. We trace this loss of seed fidelity to the start of sampling. The coarse part of the initial noise decides coarse structure first, while the noise level is still above 0.9. Few-step samplers cross this range in their first steps, which account for 25-52% of their distance to the 50-step reference. Because this decision is coarse, a half-resolution run from the same coarse noise can make nearly the same decision at a third of the cost. We therefore propose Decide-then-Render (DtR), a training-free sampler that decides the composition in a few low-resolution steps, rebuilds the full-resolution state with the seed's own noise and renders the details. On 4 large models, DtR runs 11-25$\\times$ faster than the reference sampler. At each speed-up, it is closer to the reference and rated higher by ImageReward than every compared sampler, including few-step schedules calibrated per budget and published multi-resolution samplers. On FLUX.1-dev, it remains the most faithful sampler down to about $8\\times$, ahead of caching accelerators. A user study on this model found DtR's samples closer to the reference in 86% of pairwise trials. DtR transfers to a held-out model and to video, and distilled models can serve as its renderers. Project link: https://duanhuiran.github.io/DtR

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 27 figures, 38 tables. Project page: https://duanhuiran.github.io/DtR

</details>

### 815. [EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30734

**作者：** Yuan Gao、Dongchen Wei、Xinyang Lin、Shuhua Cao、Xueliang Guo、Zhuohan Li、Yihao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30734v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建 EgoDepth-Bench：覆盖 37 个物理环境、约 94 万条同步样本的第一视角度量深度基准，含六路标定 RGB 视图与鱼眼原生度量深度，并评测单目、双目与多视图模型的深度精度、覆盖率及留出环境上的泛化。

**相关性简评：** 度量深度可作为探针或监督信号，用于核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要视觉信息，其对手部和物体的覆盖率统计及环境留出划分可供借鉴；但原论文不涉及 latent 推理或证据筛选，联系属推测性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation

**abstract/A1：** We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://egodepth-bench.github.io/

</details>

### 816. [Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30745v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30745

**作者：** Yulliwas Ameur、Miqeas Pedro Mendes、Samia Bouzefrane

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30745v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30745v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 IntentFlow——插在未修改 planner 与其工具之间的中介层，用 intent contract 与 provenance policy 逐个校验携带权限的调用参数，在 200 条合成攻击、AgentDojo 离线重放与在线 planner 上评估攻击成功率与良性任务误拦率。

**相关性简评：** 其「来源标签 + 意图契约」的错误值准入控制，可能与 LVR 中「哪些视觉证据或内容允许进入推理状态」的筛选与贡献分配问题形成类比，但该文只做工具调用层的外部拦截，不涉及内部 latent 状态，实际可借鉴性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% \[8.2-17.2%\]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. On 50 trusted-but-unauthorized attacks, provenance-only mediation executes all 50 and IntentFlow none; a CaMeL-style check also blocks all 50 but rejects 16 of 50 benign tasks. On an offline AgentDojo-derived replay, IntentFlow blocks all 20 attacks at 75% benign success, as does a CaMeL-style check; a Progent-style allowlist blocks 19 and keeps all benign tasks. With one live planner and the same oracles, the mediator blocked all 17 corrupted calls proposed in 110 attacks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233094

</details>

### 817. [Screening for nonrigidity in structure from motion using projected reprojection residuals](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30769v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30769

**作者：** Íñigo Cirauqui-Viloria

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30769v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30769v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种 SfM 非刚性形变筛查诊断：先剔除可由小幅点/相机调整与简单时空趋势解释的残差成分，再测量剩余残差与固定时空模式的对齐程度，仅用一次重建给出筛查证据而非形变估计。

**相关性简评：** 与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「剥离可解释 nuisance 成分后再看残差排列」并可主动弃权的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据可信度筛选与停止/复核判定提供可核查的诊断模板。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Screening for nonrigidity in structure from motion using projected reprojection residuals

**abstract/A1：** Sparse structure from motion (SfM) assumes a static scene, yet deformation may still yield plausible reconstructions. Reprojection-error summaries discard how errors are arranged across points and views. We propose a diagnostic that first removes residual components explainable by small point and camera adjustments and simple spatial trends that change over time. It then measures alignment with fixed spatial and temporal patterns. The diagnostic uses one estimated SfM reconstruction and provides screening evidence rather than a physical deformation estimate. Across four synthetic tubular families, the diagnostic detected all eight acquisitions with prescribed motion, compared with five or six for summaries of reprojection-error magnitude. Each family's cutoff was the highest static score among the other three families, so the static acquisition with the highest score also screened positive. With the same cutoffs, the diagnostic retained positive detections in 19 of 20 reconstruction variants spanning changes in appearance and reconstruction pipeline, with one numerical abstention. These findings show that the arrangement of reprojection errors across points and views can reveal inconsistencies that their magnitudes alone miss. The four families were known during development, and the transfer variants reused two of them. Within this setting, the diagnostic offers a practical way to flag a plausible reconstruction for closer inspection using only its estimated cameras, 3D points and image observations.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages including 19 pages of supplementary material. 5 main figures and 5 supplementary figures

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30771

**作者：** Kuan Zhang、Zhihao Yang、Yukun Chen、Xingyilang Yin、Mingyu Ouyang、Yue Su、Xiangnan Wu、Jiaming Li、Longze Chen、Run Luo、Zirong Chen、Lu Wang、Yiming Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30771v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30771v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 GameDojo：覆盖 20 款游戏、120 个 boss 战的实时交互智能体基准，由编码智能体重建环境并产出 600 小时游戏轨迹数据，据此训练 GameDojo-4B 并评测前沿模型在实时交互中的表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「依观测行动、承担动作后果」的实时设定与轨迹训练、跨 boss 迁移，可能为 LVR 的状态更新、轨迹监督与泛化评价提供外部测试台，但任务是否真正依赖视觉细节的 latent 推理尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games

**abstract/A1：** Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and our code is at https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo .

### 819. [Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30775v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30775

**作者：** Viraj Patel、Deblina Bhattacharjee、Katharine Fraser

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30775v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30775v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出平面感知的神经场框架，以空间与时间坐标为输入学习连续三维速度场，在主动脉、动脉瘤计算数据及真实 4D Flow MRI 重采样平面上比较普通 MLP、RBF 与带物理约束的 SIREN 的重建精度。

**相关性简评：** 从稀疏平面部分观测推断连续三维场，以及「物理约束须与流动匹配」的结论，可能为 latent 状态如何被有限视觉证据约束、辅助约束何时有益提供类比线索，可供核查但迁移性未经验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields

**abstract/A1：** Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. A plain multi-layer perceptron (MLP) was more accurate than classical radial basis function (RBF) interpolation on both computational datasets. For the aorta, a physics-constrained SIREN (PC-SIREN) reduced the rRMSE further to $0.3756$, compared with $0.4273$ for the plain MLP and $0.7256$ for RBF, and it was the most accurate model in every anatomical segment of the MRI data. For the aneurysms the plain MLP remained the most accurate model, with an rRMSE of $0.07$ to $0.16$ against $0.55$ to $0.71$ for PC-SIREN. Further experiments investigated scanning configuration, number of scans, and spatial resolution. These findings show that continuous neural fields can reconstruct volumetric cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements, and that physics constraints have to be matched to the flow.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 820. [PVFormer: Proper Velocity Transformer for Stable and Scalable Hyperbolic Representation Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30785v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30785

**作者：** Xianglong Shi、Nicu Sebe、Bernhard Schölkopf、Ziheng Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30785v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30785v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 PVFormer，在 proper velocity（PV）空间中端到端构建双曲 Transformer，重新设计变换、相似度（PV Busemann 分数加点到超平面键变换）与聚合（PV 中点聚合）三个注意力原语，并给出可扩展的 PV 线性注意力变体，在图、文本和视觉基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「表示几何」视角可为 LVR 中 latent 状态的层级结构、深度与位置组织提供概念启发，但其面向层级数据的表示学习，与视觉证据筛选和推理状态生成无直接联系，具体可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PVFormer: Proper Velocity Transformer for Stable and Scalable Hyperbolic Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Hyperbolic representations have shown remarkable success on hierarchical and tree-like data, and Transformers have become a central architecture for representation learning. However, a principled construction of hyperbolic Transformers remains challenging because the self-attention layer decomposes into three coupled primitives, transformation, similarity, and aggregation, that should all respect the underlying geometry. Existing hyperbolic Transformer designs are typically built in the Poincaré or Lorentz models, where bounded domains, time-like constraints, tangent-space detours, or projection steps make it difficult to keep the full block intrinsic and scalable. To address this gap, we propose PVFormer, to the best of our knowledge, the first Transformer architecture that operates natively in proper velocity (PV) space. The proper velocity model provides an unconstrained representation of hyperbolic geometry, and PVFormer exploits this structure to redesign the Transformer block in PV space. On the transformation side, we use PV homomorphism transformations to update query and value representations. On the similarity side, we generalize Euclidean inner-product attention with a PV Busemann score inspired by Busemann-based hyperbolic learning and a PV point-to-hyperplane key transformation. On the aggregation side, we replace Euclidean averaging with PV midpoint aggregation and further derive a scalable PV linear attention variant for large graphs. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of PVFormer across graph, text, and vision benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 821. [Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30802v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30802

**作者：** Jiawei Jiang、Haonan Zhou、Wendi Hu、Jiabei Hu、Yina Xiang、Kaiyue Zhou、Gaoang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30802v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30802v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无需训练的主动多房间3D重建框架 ROAM-GS：每步选择一个持久目标及通向它的可变长度视角前缀，仅在端点采集；用表面重建记忆按更新后缺陷与视线方向评分位姿，并在到达不再带来可测增益时释放该目标，从而以稀疏视角预算获得高覆盖重建。

**相关性简评：** 其「目标剩余价值记账＋可测增益触发的释放/停止＋端点才采证」的决策结构，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的预算分配、中间步骤贡献分配与证据筛选提供概念线索，可供核查是否能迁移到多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views

**abstract/A1：** Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings. However, existing methods degrade sharply in multi-room homes: myopic next-best-view scoring gives transit no credit for distant rooms and over-polishes irreducible nearby residuals, whereas dense mappers reach far rooms only by streaming thousands of frames. We propose ROAM-GS, a training-free active multi-room reconstruction framework that couples persistent goals with selective views: each decision selects a goal and a variable-horizon prefix toward it, capturing only at its endpoint. A Surface Reconstruction Memory scores poses by projecting post-update defects and viewing directions. Persistent goals credit transit with their remaining value and are released once arrivals stop measurably improving them. Without per-scene tuning, ROAM-GS achieves state-of-the-art multi-room reconstruction while preserving single-room Replica fidelity, raising mean coverage from 74% to 93% on HSSD and from 47% to 96% (+11.7 dB PSNR) on HM3D, and matching 90-minute dense mapping using $173\\times$ fewer views.

</details>

### 822. [MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30868v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30868

**作者：** Aymeric Delefosse、Manon Tavernier、Julie Keisler、Anastase Charantonis、Dominique Béréziat

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.ao-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30868v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30868v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MUNDO 生成框架，用零空间参数化在单次前向中保证与观测精确一致的时序降尺度，并借反向马尔可夫学习将观测算子分解为逐级粗化层级，每层只建模相邻分辨率间丢失的自由度，统一时间插值与解聚。

**相关性简评：** 其「强制与观测一致」加「按分辨率层级显式建模丢失自由度」的状态分解思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何留在 latent、以及多尺度信息坍缩的刻画提供概念参照，可供核查是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MUNDO: a multiresolution generative framework for temporal downscaling

**abstract/A1：** Dynamical systems are often observed at coarse temporal resolution through sparse states or temporal aggregates, leaving the underlying fine-scale trajectories unresolved. Recovering these trajectories requires probabilistic models that capture the unresolved variability while remaining consistent with the observations. We present MUNDO (Multiresolution UNified DOwnscaling), a generative framework for temporal downscaling under general linear observation operators. MUNDO introduces a null-space parameterization that enforces exact observation consistency in a single network evaluation, unifying temporal interpolation and disaggregation. To capture complex multiscale dynamics, we leverage reverse Markov learning to factorize the observation operator into a hierarchy of successive coarsenings. Each level models only the degrees of freedom lost between adjacent resolutions. We evaluate MUNDO on two-scale Lorenz-96, four two-dimensional physical systems, and multivariate ERA5 reanalysis over Europe, for both temporal interpolation and disaggregation. Across datasets and tasks, MUNDO generally outperforms flow-based baselines. Single-step MUNDO achieves strong predictive skill, while recursive MUNDO generally improves temporal realism and ensemble calibration, with better spread-skill agreement and predictive coverage.

</details>

### 823. [Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30897v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30897

**作者：** Jingyao Zhang、Mingyu Du、Lu Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30897v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30897v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出解耦框架，利用单代条件拟合与精确计数传播，预测递归生成训练中稀有模式在多代后的坍缩概率和风险边界，并在计数基准、二维学习器及 Fashion-MNIST latent flow-matching 链上验证。

**相关性简评：** 「用单步校准预测多步递归退化」及稀有核心坍缩，可能类比 latent 推理中的信息坍缩与长度泛化预测，但研究对象是生成训练而非 VLM 推理，联系较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Recursive generative training can preserve sample counts in a rare region while silently eroding its characteristic core. Mapping this finite-horizon collapse across real-data quotas, rare prevalences, and feedback perturbations via exhaustive multi-generation chains is computationally prohibitive. We develop a decoupled framework that forecasts multi-generation collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries from independent single-generation conditional fits alone. Pairing an exact three-source multinomial count law with single-generation response banks propagates count marginals in closed form, backed by explicit calibration-error and boundary-resolution bounds. For additive Gaussian perturbations, we further prove that equal-variance all-row and sparse policies reverse their boundary-crossing order at a unique hyperplane distance. Across a 2,178-setting count benchmark, exact propagation cuts risk mean absolute error (MAE) from 1.85 to 0.49 percentage points (pp). Across ten two-dimensional learners, calibration achieves 2.60--5.69~pp six-round core MAE on nine stationary learners (65--81\\% below an unperturbed baseline), diagnoses non-stationary outlier drift in standard DDIM (16.38~pp) via a stability probe, and resolves the predicted six-round geometric reversal. On Fashion-MNIST latent flow-matching chains, calibration outperforms direct-chain Gaussian-process interpolation at lower fit budgets and tracks the 20\\% latent-perturbation boundary shift (3.14 versus 10.78~pp MAE for proportion copying) driven by opposing inflow to the rare region and outflow from its core.

</details>

### 824. [Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30941v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30941

**作者：** Milan Vojnovic

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、math.DS、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30941v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30941v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究网络上互相观察的多个 agent 各自以 KL 正则化偏好步对齐模型时，集体策略实际实现哪种聚合规则，并刻画参考项或挑战项被聚合时分别得到基数规则、序数规则（maximal lottery）或无法确定权重的情形，权重由长期注意力份额与温度决定。

**相关性简评：** 其「按注意力权重与温度聚合多个 KL 正则化策略、区分基数与序数聚合」可能为 LVR 中汇总多条 latent 推理路径或多种视觉证据假设提供概念框架，可供核查何时加权平均即可、何时只能用投票式（maximal lottery）式聚合。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks

**abstract/A1：** We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step. The step involves a reference that the agent is penalised for leaving and a challenger against which its responses are compared, and each of the two may be the agent's own or an average over the agents it observes; attention need not be reciprocal. Aggregating the reference makes the rule collective. Agent $v$ then has the weight $π\_v/β\_v$, its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature. If, in addition, the challenger is fixed, the agents concentrate on the response maximising $\\sum\_v(π\_v/β\_v)r\_v(y)$, where $r\_v$ is agent $v$'s reward, and the rule is cardinal. If the reference is fixed and the challenger aggregated, the agents' policies at a fixed point generally differ, and any weighted mean of them is an approximate maximal lottery whatever the weights, so the dynamics select no weighting. If both are aggregated, the rule is ordinal: averaged over rounds, the collective policy is a maximal lottery of the influence-weighted preference kernel, up to a slack that we bound. Where a collective rule exists, its weights depend only on the attention weights and the temperatures.

</details>

### 825. [Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30962v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30962

**作者：** Wenhao Wang、Panrong Tong、Quyu Kong、Pengxiang Li、Haowen Yang、chenglin Cai、Siheng Chen、Yue Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30962v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30962v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CUA-SEE 闭环自演化评测环境，从 rollout 证据中协同演化任务与可执行 verifier，分别用于扩展基准覆盖与难度、生成 agent 条件化的能力边界探针、以及把变化的需求转成状态可核验的检查点，并保留过程级证据。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的表示和证据使用诊断只有间接联系；其「状态落地检查点＋过程级证据＋agent 条件化边界探针」可供核查能否迁移为检验 latent 状态是否真正采纳视觉证据、THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益边界的动态评测设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents

**abstract/A1：** Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

</details>

### 826. [Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30970v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.30970

**作者：** En-Hao Gao、Yuan Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.30970v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.30970v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文对固定特征的二值溯因学习（ABL）模型做动力学分析，说明同一监督下不同中间概念解释的局部稳定性由概念标签差异决定，不同 Gram 矩阵可选出不同解释，且训练可能收敛到违反约束、误标概念的吸引态，并用视觉 ABL 任务验证。

**相关性简评：** 其关于中间概念解释歧义、证据可纠正性与训练落点的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容的贡献分配、监督不足下的错误解释固化以及视觉证据筛选提供概念线索，需核查其结论能否迁移到连续 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Explanation Selection in Abductive Learning

**abstract/A1：** Abductive learning (ABL) offers a promising framework that connects machine learning and logical reasoning in a mutually beneficial loop. However, this bidirectional feedback can also reinforce incorrect concept semantics, since different interpretations of intermediate concepts may explain the same observed reasoning outcomes. Static analyses characterize this ambiguity but leave open which explanation training selects and whether its labels can still be corrected. We develop a dynamical analysis of a fixed-feature binary ABL model that links the local stability of competing explanations to differences in their concept labels. We prove that Gram matrices with identical spectra can select different explanations even under the same supervision, objective, and initialization. When any two compatible explanations differ in at least two labels, legal evidence above one half guarantees during training that admissible changes in optimization geometry preserve the selected explanation. Even when only the true explanation satisfies all constraints under a shared predictor, training can still converge to a finite attracting state whose hard predictions violate some constraints and mislabel concepts. Experiments on visual ABL tasks verify these predictions, including wrong attraction from random initializations under identifiable supervision, and show that in ordinary end-to-end training SGD and Adam select different explanations of the same supervision, while unseen concept accuracy drops relative to true-concept references as training concept errors grow.

**comment/C1：** 45 pages, 6 figures, including appendices

</details>

### 827. [Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31012v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31012

**作者：** Marvin Kopka、Austen El-Osta、Christoph Kollwitz、Felix Balzer、Florian Bontrup

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.ET、eess.SY、stat.AP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31012v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31012v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文评估 16 个决策模型（多数为开权重模型）在合成与真实分诊病例上的分类准确性与与既有算法的符合度，并考察仅凭有限信息（人口学、主诉、风险因素、红旗答案）早期识别急症的能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「在给定误差边界下对约半数用户即可作出判断、从而缩短问诊」的准确率—覆盖率权衡，可能为 LVR 中「何时停止获取证据再作答」的停止决策与选择性预测提供类比线索，但论文不涉及 latent 状态或视觉推理，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications

**abstract/A1：** Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.

</details>

### 828. [ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31027v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31027

**作者：** Egor Pakhomov、Nina Pakhomova、Anurag Koul、Shafiq Joty、Erik Nijkamp

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31027v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31027v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ComputeWise 基准与自建模拟 GPU，测量 AI 研究 agent 的 GPU 时间中有多少真正用于产生答案所需的工作，并给出「提示词+确定性代码」的开源 harness 来削减无效开销。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身针对研究 agent 的实验算力，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其把计算拆成「答案需要／不需要／空闲」的核算方式，可能为 LVR 中推理期动态计算与停止决策的成本归因提供参照，且其「提高占用率或加调度并不能修复浪费」的结论可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents

**abstract/A1：** AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. Asking the agent to finish the work faster, telling it to keep every GPU busy, or giving it a job scheduler does not fix this. So we built an open-source harness, part prompting and part deterministic code. Across five models, it removed over 80% of the extra time to the answer.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 5 figures. Preliminary version; a revised version is in preparation. Code: https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/computewise. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/computewise

</details>

### 829. [Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31032v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31032

**作者：** Tomas Ortega、Hamid Jafarkhani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SP、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31032v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31032v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究去中心化在线学习中的 network regret：构造两节点反例说明 gossip 类算法即使分歧有界也可能产生指数级 regret，并提出每轮仅一次邻居通信的黑箱归约以获得次线性 comparator-adaptive network regret。

**相关性简评：** 其「通信预算—regret」权衡与有界分歧仍失效的反例，可能为多智能体/并行 latent 状态的有限通信协调、以及用 regret 类信号决定推理是否停止提供分析视角；但本文不含视觉或多模态环节，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Black-Box Comparator-Adaptive Network Regret

**abstract/A1：** We study comparator-adaptive decentralized online learning with network regret, which evaluates each node's prediction on the loss of every node in the network. We show that existing gossip-based algorithms are fundamentally limited for this task, and cannot achieve sublinear network regret with only one gossip step per decision round. To prove this, we construct a two-node counterexample, which shows that gossip-based algorithms can produce exponential regret despite bounded disagreement, resolving a previously open question in the literature. We then introduce a black-box reduction, which uses local learners with sublinear comparator-adaptive regret to obtain sublinear comparator-adaptive network regret. Each node exchanges predictions with its neighbors once per decision round, and a universal choice of edge weights works on every connected undirected graph without graph preprocessing. We also characterize admissible edge weights and show how weights adapted to the graph improve the regret bound. For example, for the complete graph, this improvement is quadratic in the number of nodes. Experiments on synthetic and real-world data illustrate the counterexamples we propose and compare the reduction with decentralized baselines.

</details>

### 830. [RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31049v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31049

**作者：** Yihao Qiao、Jiajian Ma、Wushuang Rui、Abhishek Jha、Aarti Darji、Yiqiu Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31049v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31049v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究低数据多模态表格学习中，冻结图文嵌入经 PCA 压缩后输入 PFN 时性能反而下降的问题，指出 PFN 的逐列标准化会抹去 PCA 分数方差、使样本坍缩为距离全等的正单纯形，并提出免训练的旋转方法 RoFE 以近似保留嵌入几何。

**相关性简评：** 其「压缩加标准化导致样本间距离趋同、表示几何坍塌」的诊断可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息坍缩与相似度结构问题，但与视觉推理本身无直接联系，迁移仅为概念类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/yihao-qiao/RoFE. Project page: https://yihao-qiao.github.io/RoFE

</details>

### 831. [AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31076v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** AlphaDefect 为《Slay the Spire 2》每个角色训练单一 PPO 网络统一处理战斗内外决策，在最高难度与未见种子上以贪心及测试时搜索取得 62–80% 通关率，并用消融表明实体身份编码与引擎计算后果对性能至关重要。

**相关性简评：** 其「实体记录＋学习嵌入」的状态编码及去掉身份后零胜率的消融，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节与实体关系能否保留在内部状态、信息坍缩诊断提供类比线索；测试时搜索的收益也可供核查动态计算与停止决策的成本权衡，但领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2

**abstract/A1：** Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a single-player deck-building game that requires long-term planning under heavy randomness. We present AlphaDefect, an expert-level AI system for STS2: for each character, one network trained with proximal policy optimization (PPO) makes every decision of a run, in combat and outside it. At the highest difficulty, Ascension 10, on two versions of the game current in November 2026 and on test seeds not played in training, AlphaDefect wins 62-77% of runs across six characters with greedy play and 68-80% with test-time search, after 1.3 to 6.7 billion decisions of training per character; runs uploaded by human players of all levels are won 11-20% of the time at the same difficulty. The networks read the game as entity records that identify each card, relic and enemy through a learned embedding and attributes from the game data, together with consequences of public information computed by the engine. Ablations show how much the agent depends on this encoding: without these identities, the network did not win a single run, and without the computed consequences it won 8.3 points fewer. To our knowledge, AlphaDefect is the strongest publicly reported STS2 agent as of November 2026.

</details>

### 832. [ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31082v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31082

**作者：** Tianrun Gou、Qingyao Yang、Wendong Xu、Liang Chen、Kuan Li、Ngai Wong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.AR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31082v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31082v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ChiProgramBench：从开源处理器、加速器等电路构造 18 个任务，令 LLM agent 仅通过驱动和读取隐藏有状态参考电路引脚来做实验、推测功能与时序，并提交门级网表；在 6 种 agent 配置的 432 次试验中，全用例通过率仅 12.0%（黑盒）与 14.8%（功能引导），且少有设计同时改善功耗、面积与延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其「实验探测隐藏状态—假设—被观测反驳—重建」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据获取、动态计算分配与停止决策提供问题表述线索；但任务域与多模态推理相距较远，实际可迁移性需阅读原文核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?

**abstract/A1：** Understanding a system that can be run but not inspected is a core engineering skill: one designs experiments, forms hypotheses about hidden state and timing, discards those that observations refute, and finally builds a replacement that works and is efficient. To evaluate this capability of LLM agents in the hardware domain, we present ChiProgramBench, 18 tasks derived from open-source processors, accelerators, codecs, transforms, interconnects, and control circuits. Agents can only drive and read the pins of a hidden, stateful simulated reference, then submit a gate-level netlist made of public library cells. Agents work in two settings: black-box discovery gives only anonymized functional pins and the interfaces of fixed memories, while function-guided reconstruction adds the circuit's purpose and each pin's role. Hidden test cases compare outputs with the reference cycle by cycle; power, delay, and area earn credit relative to the reference only when every case passes. Across 432 trials of 6 LLM agent configurations, successful agents recover algorithms and numerical conventions, yet only 12.0% of black-box and 14.8% of function-guided trials pass every case. Function-guided reconstruction raises the mean functional score, the cycle-weighted share of passed cases, from 24.6% to 30.9%. Of the 58 fully passing designs, only three improve on the reference's combined power, area, and delay, so behavioral recovery and efficient implementation remain distinct challenges.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 6 figures

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revisiting Learning to Delegate: LLM Discovered Heuristics for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing

**abstract/A1：** Efficient vehicle routing is critical to logistics and transportation, yet solving large-scale capacitated vehicle routing problems (CVRP) remains computationally challenging due to their combinatorial complexity. One approach to solve large-scale vehicle routing optimization is to identify promising subproblems and then optimize them using solvers. In this paper, we propose a framework of automatic heuristic design (AHD) in which a large language model (LLM) autonomously refines heuristics for selecting subproblems, enabling effective optimization of large-scale CVRP instances. Compared to prior approaches that train task-specific neural networks to select among heuristically constructed subproblems, our method discovers generalizable, interpretable LLM-generated heuristics to directly construct subproblems. Experiments show that our approach achieves comparable in-distribution performance while outperforming neural network-based policies on out-of-distribution instances with large-scale problems.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 4 figures

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31096

**作者：** Malay Phadke、Akshay Gokhale

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31096v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 attribution 驱动的医学影像数据整理拆成异常检测、危害估计与干预效用三项可检验主张，在 3D CT 血管造影分类器上做患者不重叠审计，定位 232 个全零数组并用五个配对种子检验删除后的 AUC 变化。

**相关性简评：** 其以 GradCAM++ 空间集中度和多 attribution 方法的排序不一致来筛证据、并用配对干预实验核查因果效用，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的可信度评估提供核查线索，但研究对象是分类数据整理而非 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging

**abstract/A1：** When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the Findings Track of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) Symposium 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SayWhen：一个测试时控制器，在语音代理中选取跨多种续写计划共享的任务行为，并持续否决被后续转录推翻的候选，以免过早播放；同时定义 RFES 指标，在分支诊断与 τ-Voice 模拟中衡量提前承诺的覆盖率与后悔。

**相关性简评：** 其「集合式候选—延后提交—新证据否决—后悔度量」框架可能启发 LVR 中 STOP 决策与答案提交时机的研究，尤其把不可逆公开承诺作为控制单元，可供核查提前输出的收益与代价权衡。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SayWhen: Set-Valued Semantic Commitment for Low-Regret Early Speech

**abstract/A1：** Speaking early turns a prediction into an irreversible public commitment. We introduce SayWhen, a test-time controller that selects a task-directed act shared across typed continuation plans and controls its release as speech. A persistent veto blocks playback when intervening transcripts invalidate the candidate. We define regret-free early speech (RFES) to measure supported pre-endpoint releases without scored incompatibility. On a 72-prefix branching diagnostic, the generated-plan frontier attains 6.0% RFES with zero observed mean regret, versus 8.2% RFES and 0.068 regret for Matched Top-One. Measured planner latency constrains this path; a deterministic retail schema attains 31.7% RFES, compared with 32.0% for the complete policy. In a separate 30-task $τ$-Voice simulation, schema-derived candidates with cached text-to-speech (TTS) audio attain 21/30 task-level RFES. Eligible audio begins 1.51 seconds before the user-audio endpoint among the 22 tasks with early speech, or 1.11 seconds over all 30 tasks with zero for tasks without eligible early speech. Semantic veto and endpoint waiting each pass 16/30 tasks. Together, the studies demonstrate a controlled coverage-compatibility trade-off and schema-based pre-endpoint operation, making the supported public commitment an explicit unit of voice-agent control.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents

</details>

### 836. [Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31125v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31125

**作者：** Edward Holmberg、Elias Ioup、Mahdi Abdelguerfi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31125v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31125v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure（SCBC），把局部物理描述符映射为截断边界上的正交换系数，以封闭局部化扩散模型的边界，并在堤基渗流预报与减压井布置任务上对照 MODFLOW 6 全网格模拟评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「廉价替代算子筛选＋限次全网格校核」的序贯验证设定，可能为 LVR 中低成本预测与昂贵证据核验之间的停止与预算分配提供类比；学习式边界闭包如何保留与外部强迫的耦合，也可供核查压缩推理状态是否丢失外部条件。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement

**abstract/A1：** Truncating a large heterogeneous diffusion model around a localized, threshold-activated outlet saves degrees of freedom but severs exterior feedback that governs when the outlet opens and how much it discharges. By separating forcing-driven background head from local withdrawal drawdown, Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure (SCBC) maps local physical descriptors to positive exchange coefficients at the cut boundary. Supervised on unforced donor-domain withdrawal responses, these coefficients yield a passivity-preserving reduced operator that generalizes across unseen forcing histories without refitting. We evaluate SCBC on flood-driven subsurface seepage beneath levee foundations against full-grid reference simulations (MODFLOW~6). Across three held-out foundation panels, a single frozen SCBC tree estimator reduced peak-discharge log RMSE by 26.1%, 30.9% and 42.6% relative to identical local patches using a shared boundary coefficient. We then test whether better screening forecasts improve constrained placement, minimizing peak landside toe head subject to a discharge capacity limit and a budget of three sequential full-grid checks. On a separate 36-foundation test using a coarser 30-state ring operator, a neural SCBC estimator improved discharge forecasts across candidates yet selected four over-capacity placements before checks, compared with one for a shared-coefficient ring, which recovered all 144 reference optima after three checks.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages

</details>

### 837. [Habitats: A Framework for Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Objectives](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31160v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31160

**作者：** Nicolas Bolouri、Gaya Mehenni、Daniel Toyama

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31160v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31160v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Habitats 框架，让可执行奖励程序与策略共同开放式演化：维护奖励-策略种群并构建交叉适应度矩阵，由独立的 Planner 选择父代奖励并发出变异指令、Mutator 生成经验证的奖励程序，在离散与连续控制环境中提升专精质量与行为多样性。

**相关性简评：** 其用交叉适应度矩阵区分「自我掌握」与「迁移」的做法，可能为诊断 latent 推理训练中监督信号与实际复用贡献的对应关系提供评价思路；但该工作针对 RL 奖励演化、不涉及视觉或多模态推理，借鉴价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Habitats: A Framework for Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Objectives

**abstract/A1：** Designing what an agent should optimize can be as difficult as optimizing the agent itself. Existing language-model-based reward-generation methods typically refine objectives for predefined tasks and couple the decision of what to explore with the synthesis of how to implement it, potentially narrowing the resulting behavioral repertoire. We introduce Habitats, a framework for open-ended evolution of executable agent objectives. Habitats maintains a population of reward-policy pairs and evaluates every policy under every population reward, producing a cross-fitness matrix that exposes self-mastery, transfer, and functional diversity. A population-level Planner uses this information to select parent rewards and issue targeted mutation directives, while a separate Mutator translates those directives into validated reward programs. We evaluate Habitats in a discrete Card Sandbox and three continuous-control environments (Cart-Pole, Hopper, and Cheetah) against Independent Generation and Direct Mutation baselines. Across four environments and three random seeds, Habitats achieves the highest macro-averaged final Specialist Quality and Behavioral Diversity, with final diversity reaching 1.8x that of Direct Mutation and 2.5x that of Independent Generation. Finally, across ten downstream objectives unseen during evolution, frozen Habitats policy libraries achieve higher paired win rates than size-matched Direct Mutation and Independent Generation libraries at 10,000 adaptation episodes, while also surpassing task-specific policies trained from scratch for 20,000 episodes. These results suggest that separating population-level planning from reward synthesis enables the discovery of diverse, learnable, and reusable behaviors.

**comment/C1：** To be published in the Managing Agents that Manage Agents Workshop on Responsible Use of Meta-Agents at the Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (2026)

</details>

### 838. [SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31163v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31163

**作者：** Kangping Hu、Akshay Mehra、Stephen Mussmann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31163v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31163v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究文本到图像偏好微调中的 prompt 选择问题，提出 SPROUT：用纯文本模型预测以目标梯度范数定义的效用分，并配合随机接受规则组成 batch，以减少生成候选图像的开销。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但「用廉价代理预测效用、再决定把昂贵生成计算投到哪里」的思路可能为视觉证据筛选、LOOK/THINK 的计算分配及训练样本监督选择提供类比线索，需核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.

</details>

### 839. [EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31171v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.31171

**作者：** Hao-Run Cai、Si-Yang Liu、Han-Jia Ye、Hairong Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31171v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.31171v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作研究免微调的 EEG 基础模型解码：把带标签脑电记录组织为 in-context 上下文，配合冻结的通用上下文学习预测器，并加入基于度量的上下文自适应机制，在十个数据集、七类范式上取得最高平均平衡准确率。

**相关性简评：** 其核心主张是用上下文构造与度量匹配替代参数更新来适配任务，并显式提升有效信噪比、暴露时空结构，可能为 LVR 中「证据/上下文筛选如何影响推理状态」提供概念参照，但领域相隔较远，需核查其上下文选择机制是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EEG Decoding in Context: A Framework for Tuning-Free EEG Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain-computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters. We first pair raw EEG features with a pretrained general-purpose in-context predictor. This direct formulation provides a promising starting point, but its performance remains limited and unstable and does not generalize reliably across EEG paradigms. We find that suitable context construction can address these limitations by improving the effective signal-to-noise ratio and exposing temporal and spatial structure. Building on this insight, we introduce a general framework that combines EEG-specific context construction with a frozen in-context predictor and a metric-based context adaptation mechanism, which matches each downstream task to an appropriate context representation without relying on validation data. Across ten datasets spanning seven EEG decoding paradigms, our method achieves the highest mean BAcc among eleven specialized and fine-tuned EEG baselines, without task-specific parameter updates or validation-based model selection. This framework provides a practical path toward tuning-free EEG foundation models in which adaptation is expressed through context rather than parameter updates.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables

</details>
